description:
**Role Overview**
 The Asset Lifecycle Analyst III is the senior subject\-matter expert for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the client's physical and digital IT assets — from part\-number creation and assignment through moves, reassignments and retirement. The role owns the accuracy and integrity of asset and master\-data records so that asset, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled, and it keeps the downstream receiving, deployment and invoicing work Astreya performs running on clean, trustworthy data. Errors in asset records ripple straight into fulfilment, three\-way matching and financial reporting, so this is a high\-trust, high\-accuracy remit.
   

  

 As a Level III role, the analyst operates with a high degree of autonomy and acts as the asset\-data escalation point for procurement, catalogue, supplier\-management and finance teams. The role reports to the Procurement \& Asset Team Lead and partners closely with Supplier \& Vendor Management, the Catalogue function and the SAM team. As the incumbent, Astreya can build on established asset records, part\-number conventions and system configurations to drive data quality, cycle\-time and cost outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Global Asset Lifecycle Operations
* Manage the asset lifecycle end to end — creating part numbers, assigning assets and keeping records updated through moves, reassignments and retirements.
* Coordinate manufacturer part number (MPN) and asset reassignments in the database backend to transfer assets cleanly from source MIDs to target MIDs.
* Perform bulk data updates (including MAC addresses, serial numbers, locations and project codes) to maintain hardware master\-data integrity within the database.
* Manage Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflows with suppliers to resolve damaged or incorrect deliveries and keep asset records accurate.
* Asset Master\-Data Integrity
* Maintain accurate asset and master\-data records so that asset, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled at all times.
* Coordinate part\-number creation, submit trade\-classification requests (HTS/ECCN) and secure customs valuations to keep assets transaction\- and shipment\-ready.
* Coordinate regional catalog rollouts and Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchies so new and variant assets are enabled correctly across regions.
* Run periodic reconciliation and data\-quality checks, resolving discrepancies and removing duplicate or stale asset records.
* Asset Administration \& Cost Reallocation
* Administer entries in the asset administration system — creating, editing and activating or deactivating offerings — so the available asset catalog stays current and correct.
* Validate prepayment terms against threshold criteria and coordinate internal cost\-reallocation (chargeback) ledgers.
* Process inter\-departmental chargeback requests by validating mandatory corporate fields (requester, cost centers, location, task numbers), entering verified data into reallocation templates and coordinating with invoicing teams.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) by creating the system IDs needed to transact and track new assets.
* Governance, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Act as the asset\-data escalation point and design authority for asset lifecycle SOPs, tolerances and approval thresholds.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation of asset changes, reassignments, classifications and chargebacks.
* Identify and drive automation and process improvements across asset lifecycle, bulk\-update and reconciliation workflows.
* Coach junior analysts on asset\-data methodology, data quality and system procedures.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
   

  

* Asset Data Accuracy: maintain ≥99% accuracy across reviewed asset and master\-data records, since asset data drives fulfilment, matching and financial reporting.
* Reconciliation Timeliness: complete periodic asset\-to\-finance reconciliation cycles on schedule for 100% of in\-scope records.
* Lifecycle Turnaround: process asset creations, reassignments and retirements within the agreed SLA for ≥95% of requests.
* Discrepancy Resolution: resolve escalated asset\-data and three\-way\-match holds within the priority\-based target window for ≥95% of cases.
* Chargeback Accuracy: process inter\-departmental chargebacks with 100% of mandatory fields validated and correctly reallocated.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): sustain a CSAT score of ≥95% (≥4\.0–4\.5 on a 5\-point scale) across surveyed interactions, reflecting accuracy, responsiveness and professionalism.
* Ticket Quality: ensure ≥95–97% of completed requests pass quality\-assurance checks, with complete documentation, correct categorization and full adherence to the approved SOP.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* ERP \& Procurement Systems: SAP (Materials Management, Procure\-to\-Pay and master\-data uploading consoles) alongside corporate guided buying platforms
* Asset \& Product Systems: asset administration consoles, database backends and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools
* Data Management Tools: bulk data loaders, master\-data validation utilities and collaborative spreadsheet logs
* Ticketing \& Collaboration Tools: advanced ITSM issue\-tracking platforms


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 5–8\+ years of experience in IT asset management, master\-data management or procurement operations, with demonstrated seniority.
* Advanced asset and master\-data management, including part\-number creation, MID/MPN reassignments and bulk uploads with data\-integrity controls.
* Hands\-on experience keeping asset, procurement and finance systems reconciled, and resolving downstream matching/fulfilment issues.
* Sound attention to detail and process discipline, with the ability to sustain ≥99% data accuracy at volume.
* Strong English communication and stakeholder management, including with procurement, finance and supplier teams.


**Preferred**
* Experience with SAP Materials Management, asset administration systems and master\-data upload consoles.
* Exposure to trade classification (HTS/ECCN), customs valuation and part\-compliance processes.
* Familiarity with NPI, Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchies, RMA workflows and chargeback/cost\-reallocation mechanics.
* Experience coaching or leading junior analysts and owning asset lifecycle SOPs and governance.


**LEVELS \& PROGRESSION (I – III)**
 This role sits at Level III, the senior tier of the Asset Lifecycle Analyst profile. One job profile spans the levels; seniority (and compensation) is differentiated by scope, autonomy and ownership, and the JD is common across levels.
   

  

* Level I — performs asset data entry, bulk updates and record maintenance under SOP and close supervision.
* Level II — owns day\-to\-day lifecycle operations, reassignments and reconciliation with limited supervision, and resolves data discrepancies.
* Level III (this role) — is the asset\-data SME and line lead — owning data\-quality standards, reconciliation, classification and chargeback governance, escalations, continuous improvement and coaching of junior analysts.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 The FP\&A Manager is a senior member of the FP\&A team, responsible for owning significant areas of planning, forecasting, performance management and decision support.
   

  

 This is a broad, hands\-on role for someone who can take complex or loosely defined financial problems, turn them into structured workstreams and deliver high\-quality solutions with limited oversight.
   

  

 A key measure of success will be taking end\-to\-end ownership of important FP\&A projects, models and processes, materially reducing the need for the Director of FP\&A to remain involved in their design, build and day\-to\-day operation. The role has no direct reports, but is expected to provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring across the FP\&A team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Planning and forecasting
   

  

* Jointly lead significant elements of the annual budget and planning process alongside the Director of FP\&A.
* Own and improve forecasting methodology, models and processes across FP\&A.
* Challenge assumptions and hold FP\&A and business stakeholders accountable for forecast quality and agreed actions.


 Financial modelling and analysis
   

  

* Build and own complex financial models across revenue, costs, headcount and other business drivers.
* Translate complex business questions into clear financial analysis and decision support.
* Ensure models are robust, scalable, well controlled and capable of being operated by others.


 Business partnering and decision support
   

  

* Act as a proactive Finance partner to LT\-1 leaders and their teams.
* Ensure spend managers are aware of their budget responsibilities and approval processes.
* Consistently and relentlessly enforce spending discipline across the business.


 FP\&A transformation
   

  

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of significant FP\&A projects.
* Lead the use of automation, AI and improved data processes.
* Build solutions that become embedded in normal business activity and free the FP\&A team capacity for high\-value work.


 Performance management
   

  

* Own and improve key elements of FP\&A management information.
* Focus reporting and analysis on underlying drivers of performance, risks and opportunities.
* Ensure senior stakeholders understand what has happened, why it has happened and what action is required.


 Team leadership and development
   

  

* Guide and mentor junior colleagues through complex financial and analytical work.
* Delegate elements of projects, review outputs and help raise standards across the team.
* Share knowledge and build repeatable approaches that increase overall FP\&A capability.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Operate independently, seeking guidance only on the most significant issues.
* Take ownership of outcomes.
* Build scalable solutions.
* Grip ambiguous problems by developing clear plans and recommendations.
* Lead complex projects involving multiple contributors and stakeholders.
* Influence decisions beyond the immediate FP\&A team.
* Strong financial modelling capability.
* Deep understanding of budgeting/forecasting, variance analysis, performance management.
* Demonstrable experience independently owning complex financial models and business processes.
* Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely.


 Desirable
   

  

* Qualified (or close to qualification) as an ACA, ACCA or CIMA accountant.
* Experience within financial services.
* Experience using AI to improve Finance processes.
* Knowledge of the payments industry.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Senior business leaders see FP\&A as a stronger and more valuable partner in decision\-making.
* Significant FP\&A projects, models and processes are independently owned without requiring close involvement from the Director of FP\&A.
* Forecasting, analysis, and financial challenge become more disciplined and decision\-useful.
* Manual FP\&A activity is reduced through better processes, automation and AI.
* The wider FP\&A team becomes more capable through coaching, delegation and stronger ways of working.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we’re committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can bring their whole self to work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds as we believe it’s the right thing for our people, our business, and the community we operate in.

description:
Blackbaud is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Principal to join our Technical Accounting team. This role will report directly to the Manager, Technical Accounting and partner closely with leaders across Revenue Accounting, SEC Reporting, Operational Accounting, FP\&A, Corporate Development, Product Management, and Legal.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong U.S. GAAP expertise and strong analytical skills. This role will support technical accounting, complex revenue accounting matters, implementation of new accounting standards, and quarterly and annual financial reporting activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Research, analyze, and document accounting conclusions for new and / or complex transactions in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
* Prepare technical accounting analyses, memos and position papers supporting key accounting judgments and conclusions.
* Assist with accounting analyses related to revenue recognition, acquisitions, divestitures, segments, software development costs, leases, stock\-based compensation, contingencies, restructuring activities, impairment analyses, and other complex accounting matters.
* Review significant customer contracts, new products, new go\-to\-market activities, strategic initiatives, and business model changes to determine appropriate accounting treatment under ASC 606 and other applicable guidance.
* Partner with the Revenue Accounting team to evaluate complex customer arrangements, revenue recognition matters, principal versus agent assessments, contract modifications, commissions accounting, and other non\-routine transactions.
* Monitor and assess the impact of newly issued accounting standards and lead or support implementation projects.
* Prepare and update disclosures included in quarterly and annual SEC filings.
* Support internal and external audit activities, including preparation of audit support, responding to auditor inquiries, and serving as a key liaison with internal and external auditors regarding technical accounting matters.
* Maintain and periodically update accounting policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Evaluate business initiatives, system changes, and process improvements for accounting, financial reporting, and SOX implications.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Finance, and Business Systems, to identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and implement automation solutions.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across Accounting, FP\&A, Product, Legal, Treasury, Tax, and Corporate Development to ensure accounting considerations are identified and addressed early in project lifecycles.
* Leverage technology and AI\-enabled tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of technical accounting analyses and documentation.
* Perform other special projects and responsibilities as assigned.


**Work Location \& Schedule**
**Work Location:** 
 Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Work Schedule**
* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.

* Participation in after\-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Active CPA license or equivalent professional accounting certification (CA, ACCA, CPA) required.
* 5\+ years of relevant public accounting experience and/or industry experience; Big 4 audit experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting requirements.
* Experience performing technical accounting research and preparing accounting position memos/papers supporting complex accounting conclusions.
* Experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance strongly preferred, including evaluating complex contracts and commercial arrangements.
* Experience evaluating accounting implications of business or asset acquisitions, debt arrangements, stock\-based compensation, leases, and impairment analyses preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate complex accounting concepts to both finance and non\-finance audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to high\-quality work product.
* Experience working with ERP and financial reporting systems; Workday, BlackLine, and Hyperion experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required.
* Experience supporting SOX\-compliant environments and public company reporting processes preferred.
* Self\-motivated team player with a continuous improvement mindset and a willingness to take ownership of complex accounting matters.

title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.
   

  

 If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
   

  

 This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
   

  

 You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**Partner with Productions**
* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.


**Drive Financial Excellence**
* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.


**Deliver Meaningful Insights**
* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.


**Strengthen Financial Operations**
* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
   

  

**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem\-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision\-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.


 Why Netflix?
   

  

 At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
   

  

 You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world\-class stories are produced.
   

  

 If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

 The Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting Lead is part of Citi’s Risk Management community. Within Risk Management the role sits within the Data, Analytics, Reporting and Technology (DART) function. DART is responsible for (i) supporting intelligent risk decisions and proactive management of Citi’s risks across the enterprise, (ii) delivering risk information and analysis to help risk managers, the business, and senior management navigate complex risks and regulatory landscape, (iii) providing deep expertise in risk data and dimensions in the development and production of reports and analytics, (iv) designing policies, defining leading practices and innovative technological tooling in performance of risk data governance and strategy roles.
   

  

 The role will lead the team responsible for Market Risk Stress Testing Reporting including both Internal and Regulatory required processes. The team works with Risk Managers, Business, Finance, Technology, and the Capital Planning teams to establish reporting requirements, develop the tools and analysis necessary to proactively identify and manage risk with respect to portfolios and products while continuously updating the process to reflect the current business structure.
   

  

 The candidate will also play a prominent role in the transformation of the Global Market Risk Reporting Process and will be supporting critical organizational programs helping drive innovation and the migration to modern reporting platforms and business intelligence.

 Leaping Frog Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (LFSPL) is an IT and ERP consulting company specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and ERP solutions . The company works with clients on ERP implementation, consulting and technology solutions. 
 We are looking for a skilled Senior Account Executive to join our Accounts & Finance team and manage accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, reporting and financial operations in a growing IT/ERP environment.

 We are looking for an experienced Senior Account Executive Accounts & Finance to manage day-to-day accounting operations, statutory compliances, reconciliations, MIS reporting, taxation, audit coordination and month-end/year-end closing activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Accounts & Finance, GST, TDS, statutory compliance, banking, reconciliations and MIS reporting , along with experience working on Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) and strong MS Excel skills.

Handle advance and prepaid expense accounting. Assist in annual budgeting and prepare Budget vs. Actual reports. Support cash flow management and management reporting. Coordinate with CA, CS, bankers, auditors and government authorities. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.  As our new Controller, you will be part of a skilled, dedicated, and ambitious team, that is dedicated to managing the performance of our global Support functions.  **Noida, India.**
 As the Controller, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the support organization, focusing on cost management, financial analysis, budgeting, business planning, and performance management. Your role is crucial to ensure transparency and accuracy in financial reporting while providing strategic business partnering support.
   

  

**Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:**
* As a controller and trusted finance partner, you are the custodian of the performance within cost management area.
* Overall responsibility of financial results and financial planning.
* Drive a continuous cost improvement mindset and proactively identifies opportunities to optimize costs by utilizing data driven spend.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and the rest of finance.
* Defining, tracking, and maintaining the sets of KPI’s that are used to steer the function.
* Work closely with the Global head of Finance, functional Director, and local country leadership team.
* Organizing financial reviews together with functional head and head of cost management.
* Being the one for analyses, trends, calculations, and simulations. Support complex business cases.
* Focus on detailed analysis of cost, allocations \& postings, and cost trends.
* Coordinating with local Finance \& accounting controllers. Sparring with them

 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company:

* You thrive of challenging the status que and can put together and execute a plan for change.
* You have a positive attitude and have outspoken collaboration skills and work well with stakeholders at all levels.
* Excellent skills in Excel and PowerPoint are a requirement as you will be leading financial modelling. Experience from working with business intelligence systems is an advantage. Today we use systems like Power BI and Jedox.
* You have a solid understanding of financial statement analysis and accounting principles.
* You are a self\-starter, striving for continuous process improvements and hold high attention to the detail.

* You are hands\-on with excellent attention to details, and you care passionately about being precise and accurate.
* You can work independently as well as in the team.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.

description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 This role will be based in Bangalore, India. At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Hiring Team Description
   

  





 We are seeking a Finance AI \& Automation Engineer to design, build, and scale AI\-enabled workflows and internal applications that change how Finance operates. This role is AI\-first and build\-heavy: you will ship production workflows that combine approved AI services with low\-code platforms (Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate), integrate with enterprise systems including Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, and Allocadia, and apply automation patterns to eliminate manual work.
   

  





 You will partner closely with stakeholders across Finance \- Strategic Finance, FP\&A, Controllership, Procurement, Marketing Finance, and Collections \- to identify pain points, translate them into product requirements, and ship iterative solutions with strong reliability, governance, and responsible AI practices.
   

  





 Core Responsibilities
   

  





 AI\-Enabled Workflow Design
   

  




* Lead with AI: design and ship Finance workflows that use approved AI services for classification, summarization, anomaly detection, narrative generation, assisted triage, and knowledge search.


* Partner with security, privacy, and platform teams to apply guardrails, prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.


* Define success metrics (cycle time, accuracy, deflection rate) and instrument solutions so AI value is measurable.



 Low\-Code / No\-Code Application Development
   

  




* Build and deploy production applications using Microsoft Power Apps (canvas / model\-driven) and Power Automate, with user\-friendly interfaces and role\-based experiences.


* Deliver rapid iterations with engineering discipline: versioning, environments, release practices, and quality checks.


* Create reusable components, templates, and patterns to accelerate delivery across multiple Finance use cases.



 Workflow Automation \& Process Orchestration
   

  




* Automate end\-to\-end Finance processes: request intake, approvals, task routing, exception handling, audit trail, and notifications.


* Target touchless and low\-touch outcomes (e.g., PO lifecycle, expense workflows, close tasks, marketing allocation).


* Optimize for scalability, reliability, and maintainability \- reducing manual steps, cycle times, and operational toil.



 Integrations \& Data Connectivity
   

  




* Build and maintain integrations between low\-code apps and enterprise systems (Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, Allocadia, and adjacent platforms).


* Implement data validations, lightweight transformations, and robust error handling for accuracy and operational resilience.


* Partner with IT and Data teams on integration standards, authentication, and governance.



 Quality, Operations, and Support
   

  




* Own testing and debugging: functional validation, performance checks, regression testing, and production issue triage.


* Monitor application performance and usage; improve speed, stability, and user experience.


* Provide tier\-2 support, runbooks, and documentation to ensure smooth adoption.



 Product Mindset \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  




* Run discovery with Finance stakeholders, translate needs into clear user stories, and manage a prioritized backlog.


* Communicate progress, trade\-offs, and decisions; demo iteratively and adapt based on outcomes.



 Governance, Security, and Documentation
   

  




* Ensure applications meet enterprise standards for data protection, access controls, auditability, change management, and AI responsible\-use policies.


* Produce clear technical documentation (solution design, integrations, configuration) and user guides.


**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience).


* 10\+ years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent experience.


* Hands\-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Power Apps or another low\-code / no\-code platform.


* Demonstrated experience applying AI in production workflows \- at minimum, prompt engineering, evaluation, and responsible\-use practices for enterprise AI services.


* Understanding of software delivery fundamentals (SDLC, environments, testing, releases).


* Experience translating business requirements into working applications and workflows.



 Preferred Qualifications
   

  




* Experience integrating low\-code applications with enterprise platforms such as Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, or Allocadia (APIs, data connectors, authentication patterns).


* Experience with AI\-enabled automation use cases at scale \- document intelligence, summarization, anomaly detection, narrative generation, conversational interfaces.


* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for AI outputs (accuracy, hallucination, bias, drift) and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns.


* Familiarity with automation tooling and workflow orchestration (approvals, exception handling, notifications, audit trail).


* Experience in Agile delivery (sprints, backlog grooming, demos, iterative releases).


* Experience building solutions for complex, regulated environments with strong controls and governance (SOX, segregation of duties, change management).



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* FP\&A
* Workflow Automation
* Low\-Code / No\-Code Application Development


**Additional Information**

 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  





 You are an AI\-fluent builder who can take an ambiguous Finance problem, clarify it with stakeholders, decide where AI adds real value versus where deterministic automation is the right answer, and ship high\-quality solutions quickly. You thrive in cross\-functional environments, take end\-to\-end ownership, and balance speed with reliability, security, and maintainability. You apply AI thoughtfully \- measuring outcomes, designing guardrails, and keeping humans in the loop where the stakes require it.
   

  





 On a Typical Day
   

  




* Run a requirement session with Strategic Finance, turn it into user stories, and start building an AI\-assisted workflow in Power Apps.


* Wire an integration to Oracle Fusion or GetPaid, validate outputs, and add robust error handling and audit logging.


* Tune prompts and evaluation cases for an AI summarization feature; review accuracy and adjust the human\-in\-the\-loop step.


* Debug a production issue, ship a safe fix, and update the runbook.


* Demo a new feature to Finance stakeholders, capture feedback, and prioritize next sprint work.



**India Disability Policy**




 LinkedIn is an equal employment opportunity employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy\_India\_EqualOppPWD\_9\-12\-2023\.pdf
   

  




  


**Global Data Privacy Notice and Compliance Posters for Job Candidates**

title: (Senior) Expert AI Finance
description:
**Purpose \& Overall Relevance for the Organization:**
 The role contributes to the advancement of AI capabilities within Finance by combining strong finance expertise with foundational knowledge of data, modelling, and governance. The incumbent acts as a bridge between Finance and IT by translating business requirements, including use cases and process models, into clear and actionable input for technical teams, while supporting the Head of Finance Data \& Analytics Excellence with sound AI and IT\-related expertise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* AI Strategy, Use Cases \& Business Case Development – Partner with Finance leadership to identify, assess, and prioritize AI opportunities. Support the development of business cases and translate business requirements into solution designs in collaboration with IT, Data \& Analytics teams.
* AI Solution Design \& Process Automation – Design and implement AI\-enabled workflows, automation solutions, and AI agents that streamline finance activities such as reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting, planning, forecasting, document review, and master data processes.
* Data Preparation \& Model Validation – Collaborate with functional experts to validate, cleanse, structure, and prepare datasets for AI solutions. Evaluate AI/ML models to ensure accuracy, stability, performance, explainability, and alignment with business requirements.
* AI Monitoring, Controls \& Human Oversight – Support post\-deployment monitoring of AI solutions, including failure analysis, anomaly detection, output validation, and continuous improvement. Ensure appropriate human oversight of AI\-generated financial insights and recommendations.
* Prompt Engineering \& User Enablement – Develop standardized prompts, templates, and best practices that enable Finance users to leverage Generative AI safely, effectively, and consistently across business processes.
* AI\-Driven Analytics \& Reporting – Integrate AI capabilities into reporting and analytics platforms such as SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and other BI tools to enhance financial insights, forecasting, and decision\-making.
* Finance Process Transformation – Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and controls through AI\-enabled process redesign, automation, and standardization across Finance functions.
* Risk, Governance \& Compliance – Ensure AI solutions comply with financial controls, internal control systems (ICS), responsible AI principles, data privacy requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act). Support audit readiness and documentation requirements.
* Stakeholder Management \& Change Leadership – Act as a trusted advisor to Finance stakeholders, facilitate workshops, communicate AI concepts to business audiences, and drive user adoption through training and change management activities.
* Project Management \& PMO Support – Coordinate cross\-functional AI initiatives, manage stakeholder communications, prepare project governance materials, facilitate project meetings, track deliverables, and support successful execution of Finance AI programs.


**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Advanced degree or studies in economics, information technology, or a related field
* At least 5 years of professional experience in FP\&A, Accounting, IT, or related areas
* Solid understanding of Accounting and FP\&A processes, as well as the broader finance operating model
* Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including key limitations such as hallucinations, bias, and training cutoffs
* Good understanding of process design, data analysis, and improvement techniques; business process management experience is an advantage
* Project management experience; PMP, Agile, or other project management certifications or training are an advantage
* Structured and systematic working style, strong numerical aptitude, and analytical strength
* Persistent and effective in planning and execution
* Ability to work effectively across cultures
* Strategic and systems\-oriented thinking
* Ability to quickly understand and adaZpt to complex business contexts
* Strong team collaboration skills
* Quality\- and results\-driven working style with a solution\-oriented mindset
* Ability to prioritize effectively and adapt to changing conditions
* Ability to perform under pressure with a high level of commitment
* Strong communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and Power BI
* Basic understanding of ERP systems, particularly SAP FI/CO
* Fluent written and spoken English
* Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed

title: Procurement Specialist - Finance
description:
**About Signant Health** 




 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Procurement Specialist to manage day\-to\-day tactical buying activities. This role is responsible for releasing purchase orders, conducting spend analysis, resolving supplier queries, and ensuring the timely and cost\-effective procurement of goods and services. The ideal candidate has hands\-on ERP experience, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication abilities to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities \-** 



* Handle tactical buying activity for low\-value/spot purchase items, ensuring quick turnaround while maintaining compliance with procurement policy.
* Release purchase orders (POs) accurately and in a timely manner based on approved requisitions.
* Monitor PO status from creation through delivery, ensuring timely fulfillment and updating records as needed.
* Conduct spend analysis to identify trends, cost\-saving opportunities, and areas of non\-compliance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for supplier queries related to orders, pricing, delivery schedules, and invoicing discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure data integrity within the ERP system.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders (requisitioners, finance, warehouse/receiving) to resolve order or delivery issues.
* Maintain catalogs for items sourced through p\-card program.
* Administer p\-card purchases for compliance with procurement policy.
* Track key procurement metrics such as on\-time delivery, cost savings, and quality.
* Support supplier onboarding, maintenance of vendor master data, and basic vendor performance tracking.
* Assist with invoice matching and resolution of discrepancies between POs, receipts, and invoices.
* Prepare regular reports and summaries using Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for management review.
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, procedures, and approval workflows.
* Identify process improvement opportunities within tactical buying and order management workflows.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




 Essential:
 


* 3–5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or supply chain operations, with a focus on tactical/operational buying.
* Hands\-on experience with NetSuite or other ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for purchase order management and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis), Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Solid understanding of procurement processes, including requisition\-to\-PO and PO\-to\-invoice workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and order processing.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly around spend and cost analysis.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



 Desirable:
 


* Experience with NetSuite specifically is a plus.
* Familiarity with procurement KPIs and spend analytics tools/dashboards.
* Experience working in a multi\-supplier or multi\-site procurement environment.
* Knowledge of basic contract terms and purchasing compliance requirements.



 KEY COMPETENCIES
 


* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Customer\-service orientation toward internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Sound judgment and integrity in handling supplier relationships and confidential pricing information.
* Adaptability in a dynamic, fast\-paced procurement environment.
* Team player with the ability to also work independently on assigned tasks.



  





**Why Signant Health?** 




 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



  





 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



  





 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



  





 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
 



  





 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Salesforce Developer – Enterprise & Finance Systems - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  





  

 About the Role:
   


 As a
 **Salesforce Developer** 
 at JumpCloud, you will take ownership of the technical solutions that power our business. Based in India, you will be responsible for the cross\-system design, integration architecture, and long\-term health of our Salesforce platform primarily and its connections to the wider system landscape at Jumpcloud. You will tackle complex technical challenges, from high\-volume data migrations to intricate debugging, ensuring our systems are scalable, maintainable, and robust. This is a role for a developer who thinks in terms of architecture, performance, transformation into systems of context and last but not the least business impact.
 


  

 About the Team:
   


 We are a highly collaborative, globally distributed Enterprise Systems Engineering team responsible for the reliability of our core enterprise applications. Because our team spans multiple time zones, we rely heavily on trust, accountability, and seamless asynchronous communication. We value curiosity and continuous improvement, and we actively support each other’s career growth. We operate with deep customer empathy and a discovery\-driven mindset, working cross\-functionally with Sales, Global customer success, Marketing, Product and Finance.
 


  






  




**What you’ll be doing:** 
  

  
* **Support Design and Architecture:** 
 Contribute to design conversations and implement specifications for components, interfaces, and services that span multiple systems including Salesforce, Mulesoft and NetSuite. You will be expected to understand our integration architecture and its dependencies.
  
* **Participate in Projects:** 
 Contribute to features or modules for projects involving multiple enterprise systems or complex integrations, advocating for the right tradeoffs between delivery speed and feature completeness.
  
* **Develop and Innovate:** 
 Find innovative solutions to complex system problems, such as high\-volume data migration or synchronization. You will write clean, scalable, robust and maintainable code for the Salesforce platform.
  
* **Finance Systems:** 
 Provide the required guidance for running the Finance workflows that include working knowledge of NetSuite and the various tasks involved in a B2B SaaS company’s finance operations.
  
* **Own System Quality and Performance:** 
 Champion quality throughout the team by unit testing comprehensively across internal systems. You will lead the investigation and debugging of unexpected cross\-system behavior.
  
* **Accelerate and Elevate with AI:** 
 Employ AI\-powered tools to boost development velocity by generating and optimizing code, enhance quality assurance by assisting in code reviews, and maintain clear standards by automating documentation.
  
* **Transformation Mindset:** 
 Take an ownership stake in the functional objective of the team by creating automated tasks, ensuring data quality, develop preemptive interventions and prepare the CRM delivery to meet the changing landscape through systems of context.
  

  


  


  




**We’re looking for:** 
  
* 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience as a Salesforce Developer
  
* Deep understanding of the Salesforce platform, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and declarative automation tools.
  
* A strong grasp of multiple systems in our landscape (e.g., Salesforce, NetSuite, MuleSoft) and their interdependencies especially within the Finance undertakings of a B2B SaaS company.
  
* Ability to work with Mulesoft or other middleware to bring the vision in the architecture to realisation.
  
* Experience leading the debugging of complex, unexpected cross\-system behaviors.
  
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, essential for a global, asynchronous team.
  
* An ownership mindset, with a proactive approach to finding and solving problems.
  
* Working knowledge of NetSuite or other ERP software is a big plus.
  

  



  




**Preferred Qualifications:** 
  

  
* **Salesforce Certifications:** 
 Holding certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform App Builder is a huge plus.
  
* **Deep Platform Knowledge:** 
 Hands\-on experience navigating and testing core Salesforce features like Flows, Validation Rules, Custom Objects, Permission Sets, and Profiles.
  
* **Familiarity with Salesforce Tools:** 
 Experience using tools like Salesforce Inspector or the Developer Console to troubleshoot data and verify backend changes during manual testing.
  
* **Cloud\-Specific Experience:** 
 Previous experience testing within Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Salesforce CPQ (especially given the Lead\-to\-Cash focus).
  
* **Release Management Awareness:** 
 An understanding of Salesforce’s tri\-annual release cycle (Spring, Summer, Winter) and how to regression test against forced platform updates.
  
* Proficiency in writing
 **SQL** 
 ,
 **SOQL** 
 , Salesforce reporting, Data Import, Postman
  

  


  





  




  






  





**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  



**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.** 




  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  


  
 


  



 One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  


  
 


  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  


  
 


  



 JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
 



  


  
 


  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

description:

This role will recognize, highlight and drive adoption of best practice techniques and to communicate with business users the full scope of capabilities including functional analysis, data flow, and data analysis. Core activities will include gathering and defining requirements, configuration of standard applications and modules within systems, gap analysis, functional design of application workflows, and end user support for multiple modules in multiple geographies. This role will be responsible for, and have significant influence over a portion of projects in the team’s systems portfolio.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Interact with business customers to understand and document their business processes and requirements.
* Perform gap analysis to determine system configuration changes, or document necessary system enhancements or requirements.
* Create business requirements documents, system configuration documents, detailed functional


 design documents, test plans and test cases, user training documents and implementation documents.
   

  

* Work with the business and the rest of the functional team to design and implement system modifications or configurations.
* Work with business customers, third\-party providers, internal teams to troubleshoot, and resolve problems quickly and diligently. Update relevant runbooks as necessary.
* Continuously seek to enhance processes, workflows with latest technologies, capabilities and consistently seeking refinement of better KPIs and operational metrics.

 A day in the life
   

  

 IT APP Engineer will review operational metrics, communicate with customers on open tickets. They will work on implementing new workflows. Including delivering design documents, workflow documents and status updates to stakeholders. IT app analyst will be expected to drive enhancements and new functionality daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The FT\-Treasuryis a fast moving, highly critical organization within the broader Finance Technology organization. We strive to deliver for our customers on a daily basis and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, efficiency and innovation.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or a related field
* Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross\-functional teams
* Experience prioritizing competing demands, scoping large efforts, and negotiating timelines
* Functional knowledge of system design of general SaaS platforms.
* A minimum of four years experience working with SaaS platforms such as Kyriba, Reval, Redbridge or related systems.

* Experience analyzing data and translating business requirements into technical specifications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively organize and communicate across functional and technical lines are critical.
* Finance Technology team is a fast paced, dynamic environment. A strong desire to work in such an environment is an important key to success, as is willingness to learn and adopt quickly.
* Ability to work independently with limited general supervision, deal with potentially substantial ambiguity and deliver results.
* Ability to collaborate with a diverse set of business customers and drive consensus when conflicting requirements are identified.
* Strong business knowledge and strong technical application experience is essential for success.

description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance** 




 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
 



 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
 



 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
 



 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This isn’t a typical Reporting role.
 


* You will work on initiatives that genuinely transform how finance works in India, a type of work few roles offer.
* CoinDCX operates in a market where volumes, products and regulation move faster than any quarterly plan can anticipate. That makes business finance far less about reporting the past and far more about being the analytical engine behind what we do next.
* In this role you will sit close to the sales, marketing, operations and product teams, turning raw performance data into a clear Finance point of view on what is working, what is not, and where the next rupee should go.
* You will build the scorecards, models and ROI frameworks that leadership uses to make calls — and you will be in the room when those calls are made.



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Drive data analysis across KPIs for different sales channels, marketing effectiveness and core business metrics to explain what is actually moving the business
* Develop and automate Finance review scorecards with key KPIs to decode revenue performance across products and channels
* Evaluate cost\-benefit and ROI across different spends to bring scientific rigour to investment decisions
* Build financial models and forecasts, and own your inputs into the annual planning/budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles
* Lead Post\-Implementation Reviews after a project or initiative launches, to verify whether the projected financial benefits were actually realised
* Drill down into the profitability of specific business units and channels to identify opportunities and share insights that change decisions



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 3–5 years of experience in business finance, with a CA or MBA qualification
* Hands\-on experience across data analysis, stakeholder management and finance automation
* Prior experience of working in business finance in a high\-growth environment
* Strong understanding of business financials and P\&L, with the ability to add value and drive a Finance POV in discussions
* Good understanding of different business KPIs — their uses, calculations and limitations
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, plus working fluency with AI tools such as Gemini or Claude
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, with strong collaboration and interpersonal skills



  





**You’ll Excel in This Role If You** 



* Think in first principles and act like an owner of the P\&L, not a reporter of it
* Are as comfortable in the detail of a dataset as you are summarising it in one slide for leadership
* Communicate with precision and empathy, and build working relationships with business stakeholders quickly
* Thrive in ambiguity and build clarity from incomplete data
* Have a bias for automation — if you have built it manually twice, you will find a way to make it run itself
* Bring a Finance point of view and can hold it in a room of strong operators
* Are curious about crypto and energised by an industry that rewrites itself every quarter



  





**You’ll Know You’re Winning When** 




 Key success metrics for the first 6 months:
 


* Finance review scorecards for key channels/products/functions are automated and running with minimal manual effort
* ROI and cost\-benefit frameworks you have built are actively shaping where spend goes powered through regular Post\-Implementation Reviews
* Your inputs into the quarterly forecast are accurate and trusted enough for the business to plan against
* Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You
* You’ll work closely with senior leadership, influence high\-stakes decisions, and create visible impact in one of the world’s fastest\-evolving industries.



  





**Hiring Process** 



* Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving



  





**Where We Work** 




 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
 



 With this belief, we operate as a
 **work\-from\-office organisation.** 
 This role is based out of our
 **Bangalore office,** 
 where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
 



  





**Perks That Empower You** 



* We believe great people deserve great experiences.
* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities



  





**Ready to Build What’s Next?** 




 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
 



 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

About us :
   

  

 Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.
   

  

 Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.
   

  

**Role Summary :**
 BKNG Treasury is seeking a proactive, self\-starting professional to drive the execution of global Treasury activities. In this role, you will lead efforts across bank account management, banking administration, and automated TMS static data management. Initially focused on supporting one of the verticals in our global banking structure, the role will evolve to encompass broader TMS data ownership and operational leadership within our maturing treasury framework.
   

  

 As a vital member of the BKNG Treasury team, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Banking, Technology, Legal, and Risk. This position demands exceptional coordination, disciplined execution, and a passion for process standardization as we transition key operations to our Bangalore Center of Excellence (CoE).
   

  

 You will be expected to champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization, strengthening internal controls, and enhancing data governance across our global banking partnerships and treasury platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
* Bank Account Management
* Manage and optimize the global bank account inventory, ensuring rigorous oversight for in\-scope entities.
* Facilitate end\-to\-end bank account lifecycles, including openings, modifications, and closures, by coordinating internal approvals and external partner requirements.
* Ensure bank account records, account attributes, signer information, and related supporting documentation remain complete and accurate.
* Track account lifecycle events and ensure timely follow\-up on pending requests with internal stakeholders and external banking partners.
* Support the maintenance of centralized repositories for bank account documentation, agreements, and supporting records.


 Banking Administration
   

  

* Execute core banking administration activities including KYC support, signatory management, bank form administration, and documentation handling for in\-scope entities.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and business stakeholders to collect and validate required documentation for bank requests and periodic reviews.
* Manage updates to mandates, signer structures, bank contacts, and related documentation across the banking landscape.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of required information to banking partners in line with regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
* Monitor outstanding bank requests and escalations, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders


 TMS Static Data Management
   

  

* Act as the primary owner for treasury static data within the TMS, overseeing counterparties, settlement instructions, and master data integrity.
* Ensure all static data changes are completed accurately, approved appropriately, and recorded in line with control and governance requirements.
* Support the automation and standardization of static data maintenance processes to reduce manual intervention and improve data quality.
* Perform data quality reviews and reconciliations between the TMS, banking platforms, and supporting source documentation.
* Partner with Treasury Technology and other teams on system enhancements, issue resolution, testing, and process improvements related to static data management.


 Banking Operations
   

  

* Support selected banking operations activities including payment investigations, proof of payment requests, bank query resolution, and follow\-up on operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to investigate payment issues, confirm transaction status, and resolve operational incidents within agreed timelines.
* Maintain clear tracking of cases, dependencies, and actions required to support smooth operational execution.
* Build end\-to\-end understanding of the transitioning operational scope and contribute to a structured knowledge transfer into the Bangalore CoE.
* Help establish clear process documentation, ownership models, and control points for the operational activities brought into scope.


 Controls, Governance and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and policy expectations across all assigned treasury back\-office activities.
* Support periodic reviews, evidence collection, and documentation requests linked to SOX, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify process inefficiencies, control gaps, and recurring pain points, and propose practical improvements.
* Contribute to the design of scalable processes and a sustainable operating model for treasury back\-office activities in the CoE.
* Provide cross\-team support where needed to maintain continuity of treasury operations.


**Qualifications :**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in treasury operations, banking administration, bank account management, cash operations, or similar roles within global multinational corporations, financial institutions, or complex finance environments.
* Hands\-on experience with bank account lifecycle management, banking documentation, KYC coordination, signatory management, and related treasury administration activities.
* Experience supporting banking operations activities such as payment investigations, transaction confirmations, proof of payment requests, exception management, and operational query resolution.
* Good understanding of treasury systems, static data governance, and process controls, with hands\-on experience in one or more Treasury Management Systems such as SAP, Oracle\-based platforms, or FIS Quantum preferred.
* Experience with major electronic banking platforms such as CitiDirect, J.P. Morgan Access, Straight2Bank, HSBCnet, or similar tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications such as Excel and Word and/or Google Workspace tools such as Google Docs and Sheets.
* Ability to work in a complex and dynamic environment, coordinating across Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk and Control, FP\&A, FinCrime, Treasury Technology, external counsel, and banking partners.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to conduct technical discussions, align on requirements, and support stakeholders across multiple BKNG brands, countries, and levels of seniority.
* Strong understanding of legal, regulatory, and business requirements relevant to treasury operations, with the ability to assess implications and support practical, controlled solutions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory developments, new regulations, and internal policy changes, identify risk impacts, and support implementation of appropriate controls with internal teams.
* Prior experience working within a SOX control environment, including control adherence, documentation, evidence gathering, and support for testing or audit requests.
* Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in handling documentation, static data, and operational requests.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, balancing daily operational execution, process improvement priorities, and project or implementation support.
* Strong process\-improvement mindset, including identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual operational effort, and contributing to optimized and scalable treasury processes.
* Interest in systems and technologies, with the ability to work closely with Treasury Technology teams on process improvements, system enhancements, testing, and operational design.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.


**Pre\-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre\-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre\-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*
