title: Analyst — FP&A
description:
Analyst — FP\&A \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Build and hold the models a real assets platform forecasts on — development appraisals, project cash flows, rent rolls, debt schedules — and learn from the Financial Controller how a number becomes a decision. Modelling as a craft, not a skill.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Financial Controller — Head of FP\&A \& Asset Management · EXPERIENCE: 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, in or around real estate
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE MODEL IS THE TOOL; THE FORECAST IS THE PRODUCT
 



 Vantrock separates the two things a finance function does with a number. The accounts team records what happened. The FP\&A and Asset Management team — the Financial Controller and this seat — says what will happen and raises a hand early when the two drift apart. Every asset against the underwriting it was bought on. Every construction budget against its bill of quantities. Every lease against the rent roll it was modelled at. Every procurement decision priced before it is made.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 The Financial Controller's seat is forecasting, red\-flagging and the Asset Review — and it cannot be done alone. The models have to be built, refreshed, reconciled to the books and stress\-tested every month, for a pipeline of 10 million sq ft across four cities and a set of strategies queued behind the first. This seat does that work, and is the seat from which the platform intends to grow the next Financial Controller.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The models. Development appraisals, project cash flows, lease\-up and rent\-roll models, debt schedules, exit models — built to the platform's standard, documented, version\-controlled, and reconciled to the ledger every month.
 



 2\. The rolling forecast, mechanics. The monthly refresh for the platform and every project entity — actuals pulled from the books, assumptions updated with the project, leasing and procurement teams, variances computed and listed for the Financial Controller's review.
 



 3\. The Asset Review pack, first draft. Every asset's page — actuals against underwriting, cost against budget, the triggers — assembled from the dashboards and the models for the Financial Controller to finish and present.
 



 4\. Variance analysis. Every material variance traced to its cause and written up in two lines before it reaches the Financial Controller — not discovered in the meeting.
 



 5\. The founder's question. The ad\-hoc analysis — what does this lease do to the exit, what does this contractor's variation do to cost\-to\-complete — turned around the same day, correctly.
 



 6\. The operating layer. Models and trackers live on the platform's dashboards, not in a private spreadsheet.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, at a real estate developer, an investor, a lender's real estate team, a consultancy serving real estate, or a fund.
 



 – Modelling as a craft. You have built a development appraisal or a project cash\-flow model from a blank sheet — not modified a template — and you can explain every assumption in it. This will be tested in a case.
 



 – Accounting literacy: you can read a trial balance, tie a model to a ledger and know why the two disagree.
 



 – Excel at an expert level, and fluency with at least one of the modern tools around it — Python, SQL, a BI layer, or the platform's own dashboards.
 



 – Precise, fast and honest about uncertainty. You say "I don't know" before you guess.
 



 – A Chartered Accountant, or an MBA in Finance. Either. An MBA from a second\-tier institution with three years of the right modelling outranks a first\-tier degree with none.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, or relocating before joining.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not an investment\-banking analyst seat. The models here are held for years and reconciled monthly; they are not built for a pitch and forgotten.
 



 – Not a reporting seat. You build and analyse; the dashboards report.
 



 – Not a seat for someone who wants to be told what to model. The Financial Controller will set the question; finding the right model is your job.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – The books are in\-house. You reconcile your models to a ledger kept twenty feet away, every month.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. No private spreadsheets; every model has a home, a version and an owner.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every assumption has a source; every variance has a two\-line cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with occasional site visits.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Model conversation. The best model you have built from a blank sheet: what it decided, what it got wrong, what you would change. With the Financial Controller.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A data pack for a warehousing development — land, approvals timeline, construction budget, a pre\-lease term sheet, a facility term sheet — from which you build the project cash flow, compute three headline outputs, and state the three assumptions you are least sure of. Reviewed with the Financial Controller and the CFO — or the Founder \& CEO until the CFO is in seat.
 



 3\. References. One or two former reporting managers, contacted directly.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Analyst — FP\&A — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – One model you built from a blank sheet — anonymised as needed — with three sentences on what was hard about it. A screenshot is not a model; send the file or a link to it.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the assumption in a development appraisal that most often turns out wrong, and how you would build the model so that being wrong about it is visible early. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a model and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

title: Capital Markets Associate - Real Estate
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–8 years, with hands\-on US commercial real estate debt experience required
   

  

**Working hours:** 
 Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time
   

  

**Compensation:** 
 ₹300,000–470,000/month, based on depth of direct US CRE debt experience
   

  

**Start:** 
 Immediate or within 30 days
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Sanctuary is building something most real estate companies aren't even trying to build: wellness\-focused, nature\-integrated home communities across the Texas Hill Country, designed around the idea that where you live should make you healthier, calmer, and more connected. And now we're scaling the capital engine behind it.
   

  

 This is a company in build mode. You'd be joining early enough to shape how we finance growth for years to come, not stepping into a process that's already set in stone.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an Associate to structure and execute debt for our US real estate portfolio \- construction, bridge, and permanent financing across multifamily, commercial, and ground\-up development. This is not a corporate credit, project finance, or loan servicing role: every transaction you'll work on is tied to a specific US property, and you'll be underwriting, structuring, and negotiating real loans against real collateral, not modeling hypotheticals.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Capital Lead and work closely with our CEO to determine how we finance and scale our real estate pipeline.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Deal structuring \& execution: Underwrite and structure construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing for specific US assets. Take term sheets apart and put them back together to win on pricing, leverage, and flexibility.
* Capital modeling: Build the models that drive real decisions — DSCR, LTV, LTC, IRR, debt yield, stress\-tested against rate moves, lease\-up delays, cost overruns.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend how we fund specific projects, balancing cost of capital against risk and timeline.
* Lender relations \& syndication: Be a real point of contact for US lenders and institutional capital partners. Run the diligence process and drive facilities to close.
* Portfolio surveillance: Own the debt maturity ladder across the portfolio and keep every DSCR, LTV, and LTC covenant in view before it becomes a problem.


**What You Bring**
* 3–8 years in real estate capital markets, real estate private equity, CRE lending, or real estate investment banking.
* A specific US commercial real estate deal you can walk us through in detail, the property, the structure, the numbers you calculated, and why.
* Excel and Google sheets mastery, including built debt waterfalls; VBA or Power Query is a strong plus.
* Real working knowledge of US credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards for real estate.
* The ability to turn dense underwriting into a memo an executive can act on in five minutes.
* Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time.


**Not the right fit if:** 
 your background is loan servicing, reconciliation, back\-office operations, or ratings/research without direct property\-level underwriting. We'd rather point you toward a role that's a better match than waste your time or ours.
   

  

**Why join now**
* Real stakes, real speed. You're not modeling hypotheticals \- you're advising directly on how we move millions of dollars to build communities that are already going up.
* A seat at the table. Direct exposure to senior leadership and the institutional lenders who fund our growth.
* Build the function, not just the deals. We don't have a Senior Capital Markets hire yet \- you'd be the first person to lay the groundwork for how this function works at Sanctuary.
* Total ownership. We hand you real runway to improve how we underwrite and close, not a script to follow.
* Mission you can feel. You're financing homes designed to make people's lives measurably better \-v not another spec subdivision.

**Job Overview**
 The GIC Supply Chain team manages planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics to meet market needs, optimize operations, and enable the efficient movement of goods from production to delivery.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Senior Analyst, Product Project Management ensures the availability and effective management of ingredients and packaging materials for US\-based product and business initiatives. Responsibilities include planning\-system setup, risk and waste assessment, mitigation, and project execution.
   

  

 Partners with Project Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Materials Management, PMO, Marketing, Sales, R\&D, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**100% of Time**
**Product Setup \& Commercialization Governance**
* Lead material setup and lifecycle execution through Gate 2, including new items, packaging codes, extensions, and deactivations in SAP and PLM.
* Ensure master\-data accuracy and governance compliance while resolving workflow and system issues with technical and master\-data teams.
* Support mergers, acquisitions, migrations, and commercialization initiatives; serve as SME for SAP, Evolve, PLM, and ServiceNow.


**Raw Material Lifecycle \& Write\-Off Management**
* Drive lifecycle strategy, RMWO forecasting, reconciliation, and risk mitigation to minimize write\-offs and inventory exposure.
* Lead packaging/vendor transitions, material changeovers, and DISCO tie\-out and drawdown plans to reduce obsolescence.
* Partner with Sourcing, Business Operations, and plants on quantities, disposition orders, inventory levels, safety stocks, and operational continuity.


**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary liaison among Commercialization, Sourcing, Business Operations, plants, and Technical teams.
* Provide risk visibility and mitigation recommendations, track milestones, and highlight impacts to launch timelines and financial exposure.
* Communicate metrics and lifecycle health while managing material setup, packaging\-transition, and lifecycle\-risk escalations.


**Reporting, Controls \& Continuous Improvement**
* Maintain dashboards for commercialization cycle times, data accuracy, RMWO performance, and project metrics.
* Improve lifecycle and data\-governance processes through automation, standardization, and CI tools such as Why\-Why, FMEA, Fishbone, and BPIM.
* Develop SOPs and governance standards while identifying cost\-saving opportunities across the inbound and raw\-material network.


**Business Impact \& Financial Stewardship**
* Manage raw\-material budgets and support financial forecasting by reconciling projections with actuals.
* Reduce write\-offs through proactive lifecycle planning and risk mitigation.


**Education – Full\-time graduation from an accredited university (mandatory; this criterion cannot be altered).**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience.


**Specific Job Experience Or Skills Needed**
* Knowledge of Supply Chain, inventory management, total landed cost, and project management.
* Analytical, mathematical, statistical, and critical\-thinking skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, charts/graphs, macros, Solver, queries, and mathematical functions.
* Experience with SAP MM or other ERP systems.
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, meet tight deadlines, and navigate ambiguity.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with the ability to coach others and influence.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented approach with sound decision\-making ability.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.

 Workplace and Leadership Competencies
   

  

 Problem solving and decision making; teamwork and collaboration; accountability; customer focus; planning and organizing; enabling technology; innovation.

 Math, statistics, and analytical thinking; applied science and technology; Supply Chain fundamentals; reading and writing; business management fundamentals.

 Integrity; continuous learning; communication; interpersonal skills; creativity.

**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \| Valuation \& Modeling \| Complex Securities Valuation \| Senior Consultant**
 Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level: Senior or equivalent**
 As a Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards . You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client\-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**The team:**
 The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.
   

  

**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
 The key job responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black\-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client\-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high\-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte\-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S\&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 4\-8 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.


**Education:**
* Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance

 Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
 



  





**Team Leadership**

 Establish a process\-oriented and accountability\-driven culture within the finance function.

 In\-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month\-end/year\-end close processes.
 



 Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project\-wise financial analysis.
 



 Strong knowledge of FP\&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



 Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.
 



 Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.

 Technology\-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data\-driven financial analysis.
 



 Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.
 



 Excellent people\-management, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast\-paced business environment.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience**




 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.
 



 Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.
 



 Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.
 



  





**Key Success Measures**




 Timely and accurate monthly financial close.
 



 Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.
 



 Effective project\-wise financial and cost reporting.
 



 Timely statutory and tax compliance.
 



 Smooth and effective ERP operations.
 



 Strong financial controls and audit readiness.

title: Senior Manager - Capital Formation (Investments/Equity Fundraising)
description:
**About Enfinity Global** 




 Enfinity Global is a purpose\-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon\-free and sustainable economy. Founded in 2019, Enfinity develops, finances, builds, owns, and operates renewable energy and energy storage projects across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, leveraging a vertically integrated model that drives sustainable power deployment at scale. Today the company's global portfolio spans over :39 GW of renewable energy and storage projects, with a significant footprint in solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems, and has attracted multiple billions in investment to support its growth.
 



 Enfinity India is a strategic and expanding regional platform focused on utility\-scale renewable energy. The company has over 4 GW of development pipeline for solar and wind projects across several Indian states, and continues to expand its development pipeline and capital partnerships to support India's energy transition goals
 



 Enfinity has offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan. Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.
 



**Role Overview** 




 Enfinity India is looking for a high\-calibre finance professional to work on equity and structured capital transactions across its renewable energy platform.
 



 This role offers direct exposure to equity, structured equity, and mezzanine transactions at both asset and platform level. The selected candidate will work closely with the Head of Capital Formation, India and be actively involved in deal structuring, investor negotiations, financial modelling, and transaction closure. This is a front\-end transaction execution role in a fast\-scaling renewable energy platform.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Equity \& Structured Capital Execution** 



* Support execution of platform level and asset\-level equity raises
* Assist in structuring and evaluating transactions including: Minority / majority stake sales, Joint ventures and Structured equity\-instruments
* Mezzanine financing
* Analyze capital structure strategies to optimize return, leverage, and risk allocation



**Transaction Management** 



* Support end\-to\-end deal lifecycle: investor outreach to financial close
* Prepare teasers, Information Memoranda, management presentations, and IC materials
* Coordinate with legal, financial, tax, and technical advisors during diligence and documentation
* Support commercial negotiations and term sheet discussions
* Track transaction milestones and drive closure timelines



**Financial Modelling \& Valuation** 



* Build and manage advanced project and platform\-level financial models
* Conduct valuation analysis (DCF, IRR, sensitivity, and scenario modeling)
* Evaluate transaction accretion/dilution, LTV impact, and return profiles



**Investor Interface** 



* Engage with infrastructure funds, private equity investors, and strategic partners
* Manage data rooms Q\&A process, and investor diligence requirements
* Support relationship development with institutional capital providers


**Requirements**

**Experience (6\-7 Years)** 



* Mandatory end to end equity fundraise transaction experience
* Big 4 Advisory Transaction
* Corporate Finance in Renewable Energy / Infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience in deals execution and closures



**Technical Strength** 



* Strong corporate finance and capital structuring fundamentals
* Advanced Excel\-based financial modelling capability
* Strong valuation and investment analysis skills
* High\-quality PowerPoint and investor communication ability



**Preferred** 



* Renewable energy / infrastructure transaction exposure
* MBA (Finance) from reputed institute
* CFA (completed or pursuing)



**What This Role Offers** 



* Direct exposure to equity and structured capital markets
* Front\-end transaction experience in a high\-growth renewable platform
* Interaction with global infrastructure and PE investors
* High visibility within a lean capital formation team



 In Enfinity Global, you will find a dynamic and supportive environment, contributing to one of the most impactful industries. We are committed to fostering your professional and personal growth while providing you the chance to make a real impact on climate change.
 



 Let's build our future together.
 



 Visit www.enfinity.global  to discover more about our culture and values.

title: Project Finance Analyst
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 The Project Finance Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial management, reporting, forecasting, and analysis of assigned projects throughout the project lifecycle. This role partners closely with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, and Tax to ensure accurate project financial records, timely forecasts, effective cash management, contract compliance, and clear financial insights that support project execution and business decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Support the financial management of assigned projects across the full project lifecycle, including project setup, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, billing, cash flow tracking, and closeout.
* Partner with Project Managers and Project Controls to monitor project performance, analyze cost trends, evaluate risks and opportunities, and provide timely financial insights to support decision\-making.
* Review contract terms to understand billing requirements, payment milestones, revenue recognition considerations, currencies, tax implications, financial instruments, and other project\-specific financial obligations.
* Prepare and maintain project forecasts, including gross profit, cost\-to\-complete, cash flow, receipts and disbursements, and variance analysis against prior forecasts, budgets, and actual results.
* Analyze project financial results and provide commentary on gross margin, forecast changes, project investment balances, receivables, contract capital, and key drivers impacting project profitability.
* Prepare project billings and support collection activities in accordance with contractual terms, working with Project Managers, Treasury, and Accounting to resolve billing or cash collection issues.
* Maintain accurate project financial records, reconcile project sub\-ledgers to the general ledger, and ensure financial system data is complete, timely, and aligned with internal controls.
* Coordinate with Treasury and Tax on project\-related cash flow, bank guarantees, letters of credit, withholding taxes, duties, tax receipts, and other domestic or international project finance matters.
* Support proposal and contract reviews by evaluating payment terms, pricing, currencies, escalation provisions, financial risk, and revenue recognition considerations.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen reporting accuracy, forecasting discipline, project controls, and overall financial visibility across assigned projects.


**Monthly** 
**Close and Reporting** 
**Responsibilities**
* Prepare assigned projects for monthly close, ensuring project costs, billings, accruals, intercompany activity, foreign exchange adjustments, and bank transactions are recorded accurately and on time.
* Identify, prepare, and support project\-related journal entries, including accruals, warranty/client support costs, cost transfers, and other required project adjustments.
* Reconcile project financial reports, sub\-ledgers, and trial balance activity to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with accounting policies.
* Prepare monthly reporting packages and financial commentary for assigned projects, including actual\-to\-forecast variances, gross profit movement, cash flow updates, and risks or opportunities.
* Monitor intercompany balances by project and coordinate with project teams and finance stakeholders to resolve out\-of\-balance items and ensure matching activity is properly recorded.
* Ensure financial analyses and supporting documentation are uploaded to the appropriate document management systems in accordance with established deadlines and quality standards.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's/CMA degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in project finance, project accounting, financial analysis, cost control, contract accounting, or a related finance role.
* Experience supporting project\-based businesses, preferably in engineering, technology, energy, petrochemical, construction, EPC, or industrial services environments.
* Strong understanding of project forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, gross margin analysis, cash flow forecasting, billing, accruals, and revenue recognition concepts.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and financial modeling skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Ability to partner effectively with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* High degree of professional integrity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial systems; experience with JD Edwards, Hyperion, or similar ERP/EPM systems is preferred.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.
   

  

**Lummus Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** 
 We value diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law. Applicant information will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: AVP FP&A
description:
****Position Title****
 AVP FP\&A
   

  

****Position Summary****
 We are looking for a highly analytical and business\-oriented Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) professional to support strategic financial planning, business performance management, and decision support across manufacturing, project execution, and commercial operations within the Power Transmission sector.
   

  

 The role will partner closely with Business Unit Heads, Sales, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Corporate Finance to drive profitability, improve working capital, optimize project performance, and enhance management reporting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong financial modeling capabilities, excellent analytical skills, and hands\-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting, business partnering, and ERP\-driven financial analysis.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**
* Prepare annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long\-range financial plans.
* Monitor business performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying key financial risks and opportunities.
* Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, capital investments, and business growth.


**Financial \& Business Performance Analysis**
* Perform variance analysis for Revenue, Gross Margin, EBITDA, and PAT.
* Prepare Gross Margin and PAT waterfall analyses at Business Unit level.
* Analyze project profitability, cost overruns, and execution performance for transmission and distribution projects.
* Conduct order book analysis, revenue visibility, and backlog movement to support business planning.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, inventory, and payable trends to improve cash conversion.


**Reporting \& MIS**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual management reports and business dashboards.
* Develop automated MIS reports using Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Present key financial and operational insights to senior management.


**Business Partnering**
* Collaborate with Sales, Projects, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to support financial planning and decision\-making.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations on pricing, project margins, cost optimization, and profitability improvement.


**Financial Modeling \& Process Improvement**
* Build financial models for scenario planning, investment evaluation, pricing, and business expansion.
* Drive automation and process improvements using BI tools, Power Query, and advanced Excel.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies, internal controls, and reporting standards.


****Critical Success Factors \- Essential****
**Required Qualifications**
* CA, CMA, CFA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent professional qualification.
* 8–15 years of experience in FP\&A, Business Finance, or Commercial Finance, preferably in Power Transmission \& Distribution, EPC, Electrical Equipment Manufacturing, or Industrial Manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and Working Capital management.


**Required Skills**
* Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Variance Analysis \& Financial Modeling
* Project and Business Unit Profitability Analysis
* Order Book \& Working Capital Analysis
* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Financial Modeling)
* Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, etc.)
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 Behavioural \- Initiative
   

  

 Behavioural \- Innovative Thinking
   

  

 Functional \- Financial
   

  

 Functional \- Operational
   

  

 Functional \- People
   

  

 Functional \- Strategic
   

  

**About Us**
 Sterlite is engaged in the business of manufacturing and supplying high\-performance power conductors, extra\-high voltage (EHV), high voltage (HV) and medium voltage (MV) cables and optical ground wires (OPGW), to over seventy countries. Formerly part of Sterlite Power Transmission Ltd Global Products and Services Business, the company has proven track record of being a leading cable solution provider with four state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, Sterlite also possesses EPC turnkey capabilities to provide end\-to\-end integrated cables solutions to its customers. Its specialized EPC vertical provides solutions for the upgrade, uprate, and fiberization of existing transmission infrastructure projects advancing the carriage towards a green energy\-efficient future.

 As a consultant, you will be part of Deloitte's Audit and Assurance business group, specifically within the Securitization team.  administration.
   

* Demonstrated experience managing variations, claims, payment applications, and final accounts.
  


**Additional Information**

 projects.
   

* Experience managing cost/commercial aspects of projects with significant MEP and specialist systems.

**SOFT SKILLS**
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients, contractors, and senior stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem\-solving ability under tight timelines.
* Strong negotiation and commercial judgment.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and accuracy in reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently as well as within cross\-functional teams.
* Proactive, collaborative mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
* Effective presentation and report\-writing skills for client and management audiences.
  


 IT / SOFTWARE SKILLS

title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Business Finance
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We train India's next Allied Healthcare Professionals and we need someone who is a highly analytical and business\-oriented
 **Business Finance professional (Leadership Role) who treats each campus like their own company, not just a row in a spreadsheet and can drive financial performance through data\-driven insights and strategic decision\-making** 
 . This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. This is for someone who wants to be in the room where growth, admissions, and campus operations decisions are made; bringing the financial lens that turns good intentions into profitable outcomes.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Most finance people explain the P\&L after the quarter ends. We want someone who changes it before it does. If you've ever sat in a business meeting thinking "I could've told you that three weeks ago", this is your seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Run the numbers behind real campuses, enrollments, faculty costs, placements, profitability. Know them cold.
 



 ● Be in the room, not the report; sit with Business Heads and speak up before decisions are made, not just summarize them after.
 



 ● Chase the "why" behind the money; why did this channel's cost\-per\-enrollment spike? Why is one campus profitable and a near\-identical one isn't?
 



 ● Follow the cash all the way home from student loan approval to actual money in the bank.
 



 ● Build the model before anyone asks for it; forecasts, business cases, what\-ifs are rooted in real batch sizes and seat fill rates, not last year's numbers with 15% added on.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● 5 to 10 years in FP\&A or business finance; bonus if it's EdTech, healthtech, FinTech, or another fast\-moving, multi\-location business
 



 ● You've worked with business teams, not just for them
 



 ● Excel/Sheets fluent; SQL or BI tools a bonus
 



 ● You can explain a complex model in one sentence a non\-finance person gets instantly
 



 ● Curious by default; you ask "why" before you build the spreadsheet
 



 ● Confident enough to challenge a decision with data, even without authority over the room
 



  





**Bonus Points.** 




 ● CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA. Startup scars preferred over big\-company polish.
 



  





**Winning Looks Like** 




 ● Six months in, a Business Head calls you before making a big call, not after. And you can point to one real number you moved.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

**About The Job**
 Saxo is a global, multi\-asset facilitator providing access to global capital markets and products for all our clients through a truly scalable technology infrastructure supporting traders, investors, and wholesale clients.

Our main tasks are notifying the clients and receiving and submitting the elections from the client to custodian and processing on clients account the relevant pay out and cash/stock reconciliation. **Responsibilities**

Our clientele includes names like Assurance IQ, Inc, Booking.com, Groupon, etc. If you wish to change the game of your brand, visit us here\- https://adsparkx.com/
 



  





**Title: Finance Executive (US Accounting)** 




**Experience: 3\-4 years** 




**Location: Gurgaon** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 




  





**QuickBooks experience is mandatory;** 
 Tally ERP knowledge is preferred.
 



  




* **Accounts Payable \& Receivable:** 
  Manage end\-to\-end AP/AR operations, including invoice processing, verification, payment coordination, vendor reconciliations, and timely ledger updates.
* **Book\-keeping \& Accounting:** 
 Maintain accurate books of accounts, record journal and provision entries, manage prepaid expenses, and ensure proper classification and documentation of financial transactions.
* **Bank \& Account Reconciliation:** 
  Perform regular bank reconciliations and account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure all transactions are accurately reflected in the books.
* **Financial Reporting \& Analysis:** 
 Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, P\&L reports, MIS reports, and budget vs. actual variance analysis.
* **Taxation \& Statutory Compliance:** 
 Support GST filing and reconciliation, TDS calculations and compliance, and ensure timely maintenance of statutory records in accordance with applicable accounting and tax regulations.

* **Vendor \& Customer Accounting:** 
  Maintain accurate vendor and customer accounts, conduct periodic reconciliations, follow up on outstanding receivables/payables, and resolve accounting discrepancies.
* **Month\-End \& Year\-End Closing:** 
  Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities, including provisions, accruals, reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and preparation of supporting schedules.
* **Accounting Software:** 
 Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks (Mandatory) and Tally ERP for accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial reporting.



  





**Required skills \& Qualifications:** 



* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, GST, and TDS.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial analysis, reporting, reconciliations, and data management.
* Working knowledge of MS Word and other Microsoft Office tools.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to identify and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounting activities and deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and accuracy while handling sensitive financial information.

title: Senior Associate - Indirect Tax
description:
Join our collaborative and global Indirect Tax team. This role offers exposure to EMEA indirect tax compliance, tax accounting, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement initiatives. You will work with tax professionals and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions, supporting the delivery of high\-quality tax compliance and reporting obligations while developing expertise in VAT and indirect tax matters..
   

  

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will support the management of indirect tax compliance and tax accounting activities across the EMEA region. You will assist in preparing indirect tax returns, performing VAT accounting and balance sheet reconciliations, supporting tax audits and registrations, and ensuring timely completion of compliance obligations.
   

  

 You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, finance teams, and external service providers across multiple jurisdictions to gather and validate tax data. You will also contribute to process improvement initiatives, support automation opportunities, and leverage technology and AI\-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency, controls, and reporting outcomes.
   

  

 A strong risk and collaboration mindset will be essential as you help identify, assess, and mitigate tax compliance risks while ensuring adherence to internal governance requirements and regulatory obligations.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* Chartered Accountant (CA) \- freshers
* Foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting concepts.
* Interest in indirect taxes, VAT compliance, tax accounting, and regulatory environments.
* Demonstrated risk awareness and ability to identify exceptions, control gaps, and process improvement opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across teams and geographies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a dynamic global environment.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
 Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
   

  

**Inclusion at Macquarie**
 We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
   

  

 We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: FS - RC - Actuarial - Pension - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
   

  

 Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

**On engagements, you will:**
* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


**Within the actuarial practice you will:**
* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

What is the work? Manage and grow existing customer accounts and build long-term client relationships. Identify up-selling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts. Handle international clients and leads across different countries, time zones, and geographies. Manage the complete sales cycle independently from initial interaction, qualification, estimation, negotiation, follow-up, and closure. Conduct client meetings, presentations, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution discussions. Understand client business needs and translate them into functional/project requirements for technical teams. Coordinate with technical and delivery teams to understand feasibility, prepare estimations, define timelines, and plan projects. Support project planning, scheduling, execution, monitoring, tracking, and deliverables. Maintain accurate records of client interactions, opportunities, proposals, estimates, and account activities. Coordinate between clients, sales, technology, and delivery teams to ensure smooth communication and project execution. Understand and communicate the value of web development, mobile application development, and open-source solutions. Monitor account performance, project progress, customer requirements, and opportunities for further business. Follow up on opportunities and leads to ensure timely movement toward closure. Work toward achieving sales, revenue, account growth, and customer retention targets. Work extended hours when required to support international clients. 
 What skills and experience are we looking for? 5+ years of experience in customer account management / sales. Mandatory experience in SME / small and medium enterprise business environments. Strong experience in international sales and client account management. Proven experience in up-selling and cross-selling. Experience handling the complete sales cycle, including lead qualification, estimation, negotiation, and closure. Strong consultative selling and customer relationship management skills. Experience conducting client meetings and requirement-gathering sessions. Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills. Strong negotiation, presentation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Good understanding of web development technologies. Good knowledge of open-source technologies and solutions. Good understanding of mobile application development and mobile solutions. Ability to understand technical requirements and coordinate with technical teams. Experience working with technical teams on project estimation and solutioning. Understanding of project planning, scheduling, execution, monitoring, and tracking. Ability to translate business/client requirements into functional requirements for technology teams. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Flexibility to work extended hours for international client interactions.

title: Senior Manager  Corporate Finance
description:
Position 
 Senior Manager Corporate Finance Department 
 Corporate Finance Location 
 Chennai Corporate Office Reports To 
 General Manager Corporate Finance Experience 
 5 to 8 years post qualification Qualification 
 CA / CMA mandatory; MBA Finance preferred 
 ABOUT THE ROLE Pricing, payer contracting and revenue governance at Apollo have largely been managed at the unit level. The group is now bringing these areas under a common corporate framework, and this position is responsible for building that framework and implementing it across the network. 
 Driving technology building and implementation is part of this role. The position works closely with the Technology team to co create and implement solutions at group level that will carry the pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes. 
 The position works closely with the General Manager to build the function, with a team added as the mandate scales. The initial period is hands on, and the work carries direct visibility to the CFO office. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Pricing and Tariff Governance Own the group pricing policy, and maintain version control of tariffs across specialities, service lines and units. Run the annual tariff revision cycle, including the revision model, cost inflation and case mix scenarios, and recommendations with quantified P&L impact. Build and maintain the package and procedure rate library, including package costing and floor prices. Review exception and non standard pricing requests within delegated authority, and escalate with a recommendation. 
 2. Revenue and Commercial Analytics Develop the group view of payer economics covering realisation, discounts and net yield by payer, plan, unit and speciality. Build service line and speciality profitability analytics, including contribution margin, ARPOB, ALOS and case mix. Identify and quantify revenue leakage across unbilled charges, off policy discounts, tariff mapping errors and claim deductions, and follow through on recovery. Prepare pricing models and business cases for new services, capacity additions and equipment proposals, along with competitor benchmarking. Publish the monthly commercial MIS pack for leadership review. 
 3. Payer and Institutional Commercials Maintain the central repository and commercial evaluation of insurer, TPA, corporate and government scheme arrangements, covering rates, terms, exclusions and the renewal calendar. Prepare the commercial case for renewals, including rate benchmarking, volume and margin analysis and deduction history, and participate in negotiations. Monitor contract performance after signature, covering realisation against contracted rates, deduction and denial trends, pre authorisation turnaround and receivable ageing. Standardise commercial terms across the network in coordination with Legal. 
 4. Technology, Systems and Master Data Drive the building and implementation of technology solutions for the function, working with the Technology team from design through to rollout at group level. Co create the solution by translating commercial and governance requirements into system requirements, and remain the finance owner through build, testing and go live. Ensure pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes are carried on system rather than run outside it, including the necessary integration with HIS, ERP and billing. Define and maintain the commercial master data standard for service, tariff, payer and package masters, along with the change control process. Drive adoption across units, and automate recurring analytics and reporting in Power BI or an equivalent tool. 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE Qualification and experience Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant. MBA in Finance preferred. 5 to 8 years of post qualification experience in corporate or commercial finance, FP&A, business finance, pricing or revenue management. Hands on experience in one or more of pricing, contracting, profitability analysis or revenue assurance, with scope that has grown over time. Candidates who have supported these areas and are ready to take ownership will be considered. Experience of working with technology teams to build or implement a system, including defining requirements and testing. Experience in multi location or multi entity organisations is an advantage. Healthcare, diagnostics or insurance and TPA sector experience is preferred but not essential. Technical skills Advanced Excel and financial modelling. This is the core requirement. Exposure to Power BI or an equivalent business intelligence tool, and to SAP or Oracle ERP. Familiarity with hospital information systems and the hospital revenue cycle is an advantage. Working understanding of data structures, master data management and system workflows. Competencies Willingness to set up processes and controls where practice is not yet standardised. Ability to translate a commercial requirement into a system requirement and see it through with a technology team. Effective engagement with unit finance teams, operations, technology and senior leadership without direct reporting authority. Sound commercial judgement, attention to detail and strong execution across concurrent priorities. Clear written and verbal communication, including at leadership forums.

Key Skills: Power BI,Commercial Finance,Corporate Finance,Business Finance,Pricing,SAP,Finance Transformation,Revenue Analytics

 Deloitte USI Consulting Services is looking for Workday Finance \& Supply Chain functional professionals with proven hands\-on experience in at least one full ERP implementation project.

**Experience: 2–8 years** 




**Locations: Delhi NCR \| Mumbai \| Bengaluru** 




  





*There are recruitment roles where you fill positions. And then there are search roles where you understand businesses, build markets, advise senior leaders, develop relationships and help organisations make important leadership decisions.* 




  





**We are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants** 
 for Vahura's Finance Recruitment Group.
 



 Our team works across
 **corporates, professional services firms, financial institutions and investment platforms** 
 on finance, tax and audit leadership and specialist mandates spanning CFO and finance leadership, tax partners, Controllership, FP\&A, Treasury, Audit \& Risk, Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, M\&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Fund \& Portfolio Operations, Finance Transformation and other specialist finance roles.
 



  





**What will you actually do?** 




  





 You will work across both sides of the market.
 



  





 You will understand an organisation, its business and the leadership problem it is trying to solve; map markets and identify high\-quality professionals; speak with and assess candidates rather than simply screen CVs; manage searches from mandate to closure; build trusted relationships with finance professionals and senior business leaders; and as you grow, originate conversations and develop client relationships of your own.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing search role rather than a pure sourcing position.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




  





*There are two kinds of people we would particularly like to meet.* 




  





**1\. Recruiters / search professionals** 




 You may already be working with an executive search firm, recruitment consultancy or specialist hiring business and want:
 


* greater ownership of mandates;
* stronger client interaction;
* the opportunity to build a market and relationships rather than just execute searches; and
* a clearer path towards becoming a trusted advisor to clients and professionals.

 This is an office\-first role. Working together in person supports close, real\-time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).
   

  

**What You Will Get**
* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* Opportunities to influence the future\-state architecture of Lonza's global Finance landscape.
* Exposure to enterprise\-wide digital transformation, ERP modernization, and business process optimization initiatives.
* Professional growth through architecture leadership, strategic planning, and cross\-functional transformation programs.
* Collaboration with Global Process Owners, Enterprise Architects, business stakeholders, and leading technology partners.
* Opportunities to contribute to M\&A, integration, and organizational growth initiatives.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.


 The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits .

* Define and maintain the architectural vision, principles, standards, and target\-state architecture for the Finance Record to Report (R2R) and Analyze to Decide (A2D) domain.
* Develop and govern domain architecture roadmaps that align business strategy, technology investments, and enterprise architecture objectives.
* Provide architecture leadership across finance processes including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Product Costing, Project Systems, Financial Reporting, Consolidation, and Intercompany Accounting.
* Coordinate and support the design, optimization, and evolution of end\-to\-end R2R and A2D business processes within SAP S/4HANA and ECC environments.

* Lead architecture reviews, design authority forums, and solution assessments to ensure architectural consistency and quality.
* Serve as the senior technical authority for complex architecture decisions, strategic initiatives, and cross\-functional transformation programs.
* Define future\-state business and technology capabilities required to support operational and strategic goals.
* Drive technology modernization, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction initiatives across the finance landscape.
* Develop and maintain architecture artifacts, process documentation, solution designs, functional specifications, and governance documentation.
* Ensure finance solutions support accurate financial reporting, consolidation, compliance, auditability, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with audit, risk, compliance, and control functions to maintain governance and process integrity across the domain.
* Work closely with Global Process Owners, business leaders, Enterprise Architects, and Value Stream Leads to translate strategic priorities into technology solutions and investment roadmaps.
* Provide architecture guidance and oversight for M\&A activities, business integrations, and enterprise growth initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, architecture patterns, and industry trends to enhance business value and domain capabilities.
* Provide architectural oversight to vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers to ensure alignment with target\-state architecture and technology standards.
* Support strategic technology evaluations, platform selection activities, and major architecture decisions across the Finance domain.


**What we are looking for**
* Proven experience in Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or senior SAP Finance architecture roles within complex global organizations.
* Deep expertise in Finance processes, particularly Record to Report (R2R) and Analyze to Decide (A2D).
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC Finance capabilities, including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Product Costing, Project Systems, Financial Reporting, Consolidation, and Intercompany Accounting.
* Experience designing and governing enterprise\-scale finance solutions, integrations, and business process transformations.
* Strong understanding of architecture frameworks, governance models, technology roadmaps, and enterprise architecture principles.
* Demonstrated experience defining future\-state business capabilities and translating business strategy into technology solutions.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, governance forums, and strategic technology decision\-making.
* Knowledge of financial governance, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and audit processes within global organizations.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data architecture, and cloud\-enabled enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting ERP transformation, SAP modernization, acquisition integrations, and business growth initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning capabilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working with external vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* SAP Finance certifications, TOGAF certification, or equivalent architecture credentials are advantageous.
