title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Position Title:** Accounts Executive / Senior Accounts Executive

**Department:** Finance \& Accounts

**Reports To:** Finance Manager / Senior Accountant / CFO

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated **Accounts Executive** with 2–3 years of experience to join our finance team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in managing day\-to\-day accounting functions, ensuring seamless revenue and payment gateway reconciliations, executing end\-to\-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, and maintaining statutory tax compliance.

This role requires strong numerical accuracy, proficiency in modern accounting software, and intermediate\-to\-advanced Excel skills to handle multi\-channel financial workflows efficiently.

**Detailed Responsibilities \& Operational Duties1\. General Ledger \& Day\-to\-Day Accounting**

* **Journal Entries \& Postings:** Accurately prepare and record daily accounting transactions, including sales, expenses, cash movements, accrued liabilities, prepaid expenses, and depreciation adjustments.
* **Ledger Hygiene:** Review and sanitize General Ledger (GL) accounts regularly to ensure correct account classifications and prevent misallocations across cost centers.
* **Bank Reconciliation:** Perform weekly and month\-end bank reconciliations across all operational, payroll, and collection accounts. Identify and resolve uncleared deposits, unpresented cheques, direct debits, and bank service charges.
* **Petty Cash Control:** Oversee petty cash disbursements, verify supporting physical vouchers and signatures, reconcile petty cash registers weekly, and process timely replenishment requests.

**2\. Multi\-Channel Sales \& Revenue Reconciliation**

* **Sales Verification:** Reconcile daily point\-of\-sale (POS) reports, billing summaries, and internal ERP sales reports against actual bank credit entries.
* **Payment Gateway \& Merchant Reconciliations:** Perform line\-item reconciliations for settlements received from payment gateways and merchant processors (e.g., Razorpay, Stripe, Paytm, UPI, EDC Card machines).
* **Fee \& Commission Auditing:** Audit and verify processing fees, MDR charges, platform commissions, chargebacks, and holdbacks deducted by financial intermediaries against contracted rate sheets.
* **Dispute Resolution:** Track and resolve un\-reconciled transactions, timing delays, customer chargeback requests, failed payment claims, and refund adjustments.

**3\. Accounts Payable (AP) \& Vendor Management**

* **Invoice Processing:** Receive, digitize, and log incoming vendor bills, utility invoices, service contracts, and material supply invoices.
* **3\-Way Matching:** Perform strict 3\-Way Matching by cross\-referencing Vendor Invoices against approved Purchase Orders (POs) and Goods Received Notes (GRNs) / Service Completion Certificates.
* **Vendor Ledger Maintenance:** Reconcile vendor account statements periodically, address billing discrepancies, track debit notes/credit notes for returned goods, and ensure vendor ledgers are audit\-ready.
* **Payout Management:** Prepare payment proposals and schedules based on agreed credit terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60\), executing payments via online banking channels (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS / Wire transfers).

**4\. Accounts Receivable (AR) \& Credit Management**

* **Invoicing:** Issue tax\-compliant invoices, proforma invoices, and debit/credit notes to B2B and institutional clients.
* **Ageing Analysis \& Follow\-ups:** Maintain and analyze Accounts Receivable ageing reports weekly. Coordinate with clients and internal team leads to secure prompt payments for overdue invoices.
* **Receipt Posting:** Record customer payments, match incoming receipts against outstanding invoice numbers, and process unallocated customer advances.

**5\. Statutory Compliance \& Tax Operations**

* **Tax Invoicing \& Rates:** Ensure accurate tax tagging (GST, Sales Tax, or VAT) on all outgoing invoices and verify tax applicability on incoming vendor bills.
* **GST \& Direct Tax Compliance:**
* Prepare input data, reconciliations (e.g., GSTR\-2B vs. Books comparison), and working sheets for monthly GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B).
* Calculate monthly Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) liabilities on vendor payments under relevant statutory sections.
* Prepare data for timely tax payments to government portals to avoid interest or penalty levies.
* **Audit Support:** Organize physical and digital document archives (invoices, receipts, tax certificates, bank statements) to assist internal and external auditors during annual financial audits.

**6\. Financial Reporting \& Payroll Support**

* **Month\-End Closing:** Assist senior finance personnel in executing month\-end closing tasks, including posting accrued revenue, prepaid expenses, and provision entries.
* **Trial Balance Finalization:** Help analyze variance in the Trial Balance and resolve unadjusted balances prior to closing monthly accounts.
* **Payroll \& Reimbursements:** Audit monthly employee attendance data, verify advance salary deductions, check employee expense reimbursement claims against receipts, and assist in payroll register posting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Focus Area**

**Performance Metric / Target**

**Reconciliation Timeliness**

All bank and payment gateway reconciliations completed within 3 business days of month\-end.

**AP Accuracy**

100% compliance with 3\-way matching prior to payment disbursement.

**AR Collections**

Keep overdue receivables (\>60 days) under 5% of total outstanding receivables.

**Tax Compliance**

Zero late fees, interest, or statutory penalty charges due to processing delays.

**Data Integrity**

Zero unallocated or unclassified entries in General Ledger beyond month\-end close.

**Candidate Profile \& Technical Requirements1\. Educational Background**

* **Degree:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or an equivalent discipline. *(Master's degree or partial qualification like Inter CA / CMA is a plus).*

**2\. Experience \& Technical Skills**

* **Core Experience:** Minimum 2 to 3 years of hands\-on experience handling general accounting, AP, AR, and bank reconciliations.
* **Accounting Software:** Advanced working knowledge of accounting software such as **Tally Prime, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or SAP/Oracle Financials**.
* **MS Excel Proficiency:** Intermediate to advanced capabilities in Microsoft Excel, including:
* Pivot Tables \& Data Aggregation
* VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH
* Conditional Formatting \& Data Validation
* Text manipulation and data cleanup tools for large datasets
* **Regulatory Understanding:** Strong understanding of double\-entry bookkeeping principles, basic concepts of revenue recognition, GST structures, and TDS deduction rules.

**3\. Behavioral \& Professional Attributes**

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to verifying numbers and resolving balance discrepancies.
* **Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to trace transaction errors across banking statements, billing tools, and ledger accounts.
* **Communication:** Clear oral and written communication for liaising with vendors, corporate customers, and banking partners.
* **Time Management:** Ability to prioritize time\-sensitive tasks during peak periods like month\-end closing and tax payment dates.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Yext is seeking a **Team Lead, International Accounting** to join its growing and dynamic International Accounting team. title: Head of Finance
description:
About the Job

Pragyan Impact Solutions works with governments, nonprofits, communities, and institutions across India to turn ambitious goals into measurable outcomes, through strategic advisory, program design, technology\-driven execution, and capacity building in governance and development.

Experience:

8–14 years, including demonstrated ownership of finance strategy (not just finance execution) for at least one growing organization or business unit. Note: Title will be calibrated to experience and demonstrated scope: Head of Finance, AVP/VP – Finance.

Role Description

We're looking for someone to own the financial strategy and capital planning function of the organization, effectively acting as the finance partner to the founder/CEO, across our consulting \& research division and our communications division (potentially extending to affiliated entities or sister ventures). You'll sit close to leadership, shape how the business allocates capital, and be the person the founder turns to before a strategic decision rather than after it.

Qualifications

**8\+ years in progressively senior finance roles, with at least 2\-3 years owning financial strategy, forecasting, or capital decisions, not just accounting execution**  Strong grounding in financial modeling, scenario planning, unit economics, and cash flow forecasting for a project/consulting\-revenue business **Experience managing statutory compliance, audits, and regulatory relationships (GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, income tax, ROC/company law basics)**  Working knowledge of contracts, MoUs, and commercial terms, able to review and negotiate, not just file **Demonstrated experience building or scaling a finance function: designing the systems, not just running them**  CA / MBA (Finance) strongly preferred; CFA or equivalent a plus **Prior exposure to consulting, government/development\-sector, or multi\-vertical service businesses is a strong plus**  Comfortable operating with founder\-level ambiguity; priorities will shift, and you're expected to bring structure to that, not wait for it

Key Responsibilities

1\. Financial Strategy \& Business Partnering **Own annual budgeting, financial planning, and multi\-year forecasting across divisions (and across entities, if scope extends to sister ventures)**  Build the financial case for new business lines, tenders, and pricing decisions: model margins on project bids before they're submitted, not after **Act as thought partner to the founder/CEO on capital allocation, hiring plans, and investment decisions**  Own cash flow strategy and working capital management across long\-cycle government/institutional payment timelines **Prepare board\-/founder\-level financial narratives, not just numbers, but what they mean and what to do about them 2\. Finance \& Accounting Oversight**  Own the finance function end\-to\-end: AP, AR, general ledger, monthly and annual close, reviewed and signed off by you **Own preparation and integrity of financial statements (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and present these to leadership**  Set and enforce financial controls, approval hierarchies, and delegation of authority across the org **Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors, and legal counsel; own the audit process end\-to\-end, not just coordinate it 3\. MIS, Reporting \& Decision Support**  Design and own the MIS architecture: what gets tracked, at what frequency, and for whom **Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews with budget\-vs\-actual analysis, variance drivers, and recommended actions**  Build project\-level and division\-level profitability views (a critical gap in most consulting businesses) so leadership knows which engagements actually make money **Build dashboards and reporting systems that scale, not one\-off Excel files that break when someone leaves 4\. Compliance, Risk \& Governance**  Own statutory compliance strategy across GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and any entity\-level regulatory requirements; team executes, you're accountable **Own contract review and risk flagging on client MoUs, vendor agreements, and consortium/JV arrangements (e.g., sub consultancy structures)**  Build and maintain a compliance calendar and risk register for the organization **Represent the organization in front of auditors, regulators, and institutional client finance teams when needed 5\. People \& Payroll Strategy**  Own payroll strategy and compensation structuring (not just processing) in coordination with HR/leadership **Build and lead the finance team: hire, train, and manage as the function scales 6\. Cross\-Entity / Multi\-Business Financial Oversight (if scope extends beyond one entity)**  Provide consolidated financial oversight across 2\-3 affiliated entities or business lines, with entity\-level P\&Ls rolling up to a consolidated view **Standardize financial processes and controls across entities so each isn't reinventing its own system**  Flag and manage inter\-entity transactions and shared cost allocation

What Success Looks Like

**Leadership makes capital and hiring decisions with real financial data in hand, not gut calls**  The org knows which projects and divisions are actually profitable **Compliance and audits run on a calendar, not on adrenaline**  Cash flow is forecast, not discovered **Finance is treated as a strategic function in the room, not a back\-office function reporting out of it**  The founder can hand you a hard financial problem and walk away, confident it'll be handled

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite) Experience: 2 - 4 years (Hands-on) 
 
 Job Summary 
 Were looking for a hands-on Accounts Executive who can independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping, compliance, and reporting for a growing consulting firm serving global clients. Youll work closely with leadership to keep the books accurate, compliance timelines met, and financial reporting audit-ready. Youll take ownership of the full accounting cycle-from transaction entry to PL and balance sheet reporting-while coordinating statutory filings and payroll-related compliance across multiple organizations/entities under our umbrella. If youre detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning numbers end-to-end, this role is for you. Were a firm thats constantly picking up new tools, so youll fit right in if you enjoy figuring out a better, faster way to do something rather than sticking to the same process out of habit. Given that youll be handling sensitive financials across multiple entities, this is a role built on trust - someone we can hand the numbers to and not have to double-check. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain books of accounts for multiple entities/organizations in parallel, keeping each set of records distinct and audit-ready. Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping and ledgers in Zoho Books . Perform regular expense reconciliations (bank, vendor, and credit card). Prepare and maintain the Chart of Accounts . Prepare PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets for management review. Track and report on cash flow , flagging shortfalls or timing gaps proactively. Process payroll accurately and on time, including statutory deductions. Maintain Asset Management records (fixed assets, depreciation schedules). Handle GST and TDS computation, payment, and return filing (including quarterly TDS filings). Ensure compliance with Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment registrations and renewals. Support Income Tax related filings and coordination with auditors/consultants. Manage client and vendor invoicing , including follow-up on outstanding receivables. Handle multi-currency transactions (USD billing) and reconcile FX conversions. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries. Keep records in Zoho Books clean and consistent, so reports and dashboards stay reliable. Use AI tools to improve accuracy and speed of recurring accounting tasks. Maintain clear, professional written communication with internal teams, vendors, and clients over email. 
 
 Early Impact 
 Weeks 1-2: Understand our accounting systems, chart of accounts, compliance calendar, and ongoing processes. By ~60 days: Independently manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, and routine compliance filings with minimal supervision. By ~90 days: Own the monthly close process end-to-end, including PL/Balance Sheet preparation, and proactively flag compliance deadlines, cash flow gaps, and budget variances before theyre asked about. 
 
 Must-haves 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Accounting and Bookkeeping. Proven experience managing books for multiple organizations/entities simultaneously , keeping each set of accounts separate and accurate. Strong working knowledge of Zoho Books (or equivalent accounting software). Proficiency in Excel (formulas, reconciliations, reporting). Practical experience with GST and TDS compliance, including quarterly TDS filings. Experience preparing PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets . Good understanding of cash flow - tracking inflows/outflows and anticipating shortfalls. Experience maintaining a Chart of Accounts . Experience with payroll processing and statutory deductions. Experience with Asset Management (fixed asset tracking, depreciation). Working knowledge of Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment compliance. Comfort using AI tools to support accounting workflows. Strong written communication skills, especially over email. Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through without needing reminders, and is comfortable being the person others can rely on when it matters. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a consulting or services firm billing international clients. Exposure to Income Tax filings and audit coordination. Experience working directly with external auditors, CAs, or compliance consultants. Experience handling client/vendor invoicing and receivables follow-up. Exposure to multi-currency accounting , particularly USD billing and FX reconciliation. 
 
 Skills 
 Zoho Books Excel AI Tools GST TDS Income Tax Bookkeeping Multi-Entity Accounting Expense Reconciliations PL Balance Sheets Cash Flow Projections Budgets Chart of Accounts Payroll Processing Asset Management Professional Tax PF Gratuity Shop Establishment Compliance Client Vendor Invoicing Multi-Currency Accounting Audit Support Written Communication 
 
 Educational Qualifications 
 We care more about the quality of your work and thinking than specific degrees. A strong track record in similar roles matters most.

description:
Job Description Finance Executive Company: Vibedu International Education Pvt. Ltd.
 Position: Finance Executive
 Location: Coimbatore
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Work from Office About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Finance Executive to manage and support the day-to-day financial and accounting operations of the organization. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, handling accounts-related activities, supporting statutory compliance, and coordinating with internal teams and external consultants. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting and financial transactions. Maintain accurate records of income, expenses, payments, receipts, and other financial transactions. Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable activities. Prepare and maintain invoices, vouchers, bills, and supporting financial documents. Perform bank reconciliations and monitor bank transactions. Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and management reports. Coordinate salary-related financial information and support payroll processes. Monitor petty cash and maintain proper expense records. Coordinate with vendors and internal departments regarding payments and financial documentation. Assist with GST-related documentation, filings, and compliance . Support TDS, PF, ESI, and other statutory compliance-related activities , wherever required. Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors, and other external consultants. Assist during internal and external audits and provide required financial documents. Maintain proper records and documentation for all financial transactions. Monitor outstanding payments and follow up where required. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of all financial information. Support management with financial data, reports, and other requirements. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field . 1–3 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance is preferred. Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes. Knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and statutory compliance will be an added advantage. Experience in using accounting software such as Tally or other ERP/accounting systems. Good knowledge of MS Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Strong numerical and analytical skills. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to handle confidential financial information responsibly. Ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and external consultants. Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for a proactive and responsible candidate who can independently manage routine finance and accounts activities while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting.

The Fund Accounting Manager will supervise and execute tasks related to maintaining the books and records, reporting, and auditing for a diverse portfolio of investment funds, including open-end funds, closed-end funds, collateralized loan obligation portfolios (CLOs), and risk retention vehicles. This role will ensure compliance with international accounting standards and regulatory requirements, while facilitating communication with internal teams and external service providers, such as third-party administrators, custodians, directors, legal and tax. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following activities: Portfolio Oversight and Reconciliation Supervise the monthly and quarterly closing process, including pricing, management fee calculations, expense accruals, and portfolio activity reconciliation with custodial and counterparty records. Conduct daily cash and position reconciliations, resolve discrepancies with custodians, administrators, and counterparties, and address complex corporate actions. Ensure books and records accurately reflect purchase and sale transactions, trade par, and cash reconciliations for CLOs. Compliance and Reporting Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with U.S. and U.K. GAAP, IFRS, and investment company accounting rules (when applicable). Coordinate regulatory filings, including AIFMD Annex IV, Form PF, ADV reporting, CRS, and corporate tax reporting. Evaluate fund and client-specific performance metrics (e.g., XIRR and TWR). Audit and Efficiency Execution Coordinate annual financial statement audits and fieldwork with external auditors. Support fund-related automation and efficiency initiatives, ensuring adherence to Sarbanes-Oxley compliance standards. Client Fund Activity Management Calculate income and expense allocations, update distribution waterfalls, and track cash forecasting for loan-to-value ratio and borrowing limits. Prepare borrowing notices and funding memos for corporate-related activity. Manage fund openings, closings, client drawdowns, and distributions, ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders. Cash and Expense Analysis Support expense analysis, corporate expense reimbursement tracking, waterfall invoice preparation, and wire payment execution. Oversee corporate actions related to delayed compensation, cost of carry, amendment fees, and PIK interest amongst others. Support and Collaboration Monitor work performed by third-party administrators and custodians, ensuring accuracy and quality control. Respond to ad-hoc queries from client services and internal teams and implement setups for new funds and CLOs across accounting, marketing, performance, and trading systems. Experience Required Minimum 2-6 years relevant accounting or audit experience within Big Four public accounting or a mix of public accounting and investment management industry experience; Strong knowledge of reconciliation and account analysis; Excellent understanding of accounting and the ability to apply relevant investment company accounting rules; Solid analytical skills and ability to understand and resolve complex problems; Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word; Experience with Geneva and/or Geneva World Investor accounting systems is a plus; Experience with PowerBI, Alteryx, or other data analytical tools is a plus; Working knowledge of CLOs and Risk Retention Vehicles a plus, including CLO lifecycle, including all aspects of the Warehouse Phase, Ramping of Portfolio, Pricing, Close, Drawdowns, Repayments, Day One S110 Test, 1st Loss Equity Tranche, Waterfall Schedule, Priority of Payments, Resets and Refinancing, Management and Incentive Fees, Par and Cash, Aggregate Principal/Collateral Balance Calculations Education Bachelor's degree is required, preferred in Accounting or Finance CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent qualification is a plus

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating with internal and external teams, driving account growth, and ensuring seamless execution of projects while meeting client expectations and business objectives. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders. Understand client briefs, business objectives, brand requirements, and project expectations. Ensure timely communication, follow-ups, approvals, and delivery across all accounts. Proactively identify client requirements and provide relevant solutions. Handle client escalations and ensure timely resolution of issues. 
 2. Campaign & Event Management Lead the planning and execution of BTL campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand experiences. Develop campaign approaches and execution plans in line with client objectives. Coordinate with creative, production, operations, and other internal teams for smooth project execution. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. Be actively involved in pre-event planning, on-ground execution, and post-event closure. Conduct post-project reviews and identify areas for improvement. 
 3. Business Development & Account Growth Identify opportunities for growth within existing accounts. Explore upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the agency's services. Support new business pitches, proposals, presentations, and client meetings. Develop a strong understanding of client businesses to identify potential opportunities. Contribute towards revenue growth and expansion of assigned accounts. 
 4. Team & Internal Coordination Lead and coordinate account servicing teams working across assigned accounts. Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Work closely with creative, production, operations, procurement, and finance teams. Ensure clear communication of client briefs and expectations to internal teams. Review team deliverables and provide necessary guidance and feedback. Support junior team members in managing client requirements and projects. 
 5. Creative & Strategic Collaboration Work closely with creative and strategy teams to develop relevant campaign concepts and solutions. Participate in brainstorming sessions, client presentations, and pitch discussions. Ensure creative solutions are aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives. Provide strategic inputs based on client requirements, market understanding, and campaign objectives. 
 6. Project & Operations Management Manage multiple projects simultaneously from briefing to execution and closure. Prepare and track project timelines, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies. Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential delays or challenges. Coordinate with vendors and external partners wherever required. Ensure smooth execution while maintaining quality and client expectations. 
 7. Budget & Commercial Management Support preparation and management of project budgets and estimates. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure cost-effective execution. Monitor project costs and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Support commercial negotiations with vendors and service partners. Ensure projects are executed efficiently without compromising quality. 
 8. Reporting & Documentation Prepare regular account updates, project status reports, presentations, and other client communication. Maintain proper documentation of briefs, approvals, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables. Track account activities and provide regular updates to senior management. Maintain accurate records of ongoing and completed projects. 
 9. Client Retention & Relationship Growth Understand client expectations and proactively address concerns. Maintain regular engagement with key client stakeholders. Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships and increase account engagement. Ensure a high level of client satisfaction across projects. Build trust with clients through consistent communication, ownership, and quality delivery. 
 10. Overall Ownership Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and projects. Ensure timely, high-quality, and commercially effective delivery. Demonstrate strong accountability and proactive problem-solving. Contribute to the overall growth, profitability, and reputation of the agency. Take greater responsibility for client relationships, team performance, and project outcomes.

title: Business Head
description:
Head Business Growth (ProfitNX ERP) 
 Lead the National Expansion of a Proven Accounting ERP Platform 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (PAN India Travel) 
 Employment Type: Full-Time | Leadership Position 
 Compensation: As per Industry Standard 
 About Dsoft Group & ProfitNX: 
 For over 35 years, Dsoft Group has been delivering innovative technology solutions that help businesses simplify operations, strengthen financial control, and drive sustainable growth. With a strong legacy of developing business software, Dsoft has earned the trust of thousands of customers across diverse industries. 
 ProfitNX is one of Dsoft's earliest and most established ERP platforms, purpose-built as a comprehensive Accounting & Business Management ERP for SMEs, manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and trading businesses. 
 Over the years, ProfitNX has built a strong reputation across Gujarat and has become a trusted accounting ERP solution for numerous businesses in Morbi and Savarkundla, particularly within the ceramic and tile industryone of India's most dynamic manufacturing ecosystems. The platform has consistently helped businesses improve financial management, inventory control, operational efficiency, and business visibility. 
 Building on its strong ERP expertise, Dsoft successfully expanded into specialized industry solutions with ORNATE ERP, now trusted by 5,000+ jewellery businesses across 23 states, along with innovative platforms such as SUVARNA SETU and ORNATE CRM. 
 Today, Dsoft is making a strategic investment to position ProfitNX as its flagship Accounting ERP solution for SMEs across India. With a mature product, an experienced technology team, and a clear national growth vision, ProfitNX is entering its most exciting phase of expansion. 
 To lead this journey, we are looking for an accomplished business leader who can transform a proven regional success into a nationally recognized ERP brand. 
 Why This Role is Different: 
 Unlike many leadership positions focused on managing mature businesses, this opportunity allows you to scale an established ERP platform with a proven market foundation. 
 You will inherit: 
 • A mature and market-tested Accounting ERP solution. • A loyal customer base with strong references across key industrial clusters. • A capable product development and implementation team. • The backing of a financially stable technology company with over three decades of industry experience. • The autonomy to define strategy, build teams, expand markets, and create a national business. 
 This is an opportunity to build a legacynot simply achieve quarterly targets. 
 Your Mission: 
 You will lead ProfitNX's national growth by: 
 • Developing and executing the national business expansion strategy. • Expanding ProfitNX beyond Gujarat into high-potential markets across India. • Building a scalable and high-performing business development unit. • Driving sustainable revenue growth across enterprise, SME, and channel sales. • Developing a nationwide ecosystem of channel partners, consultants, and implementation partners. • Strengthening relationships with key stakeholders, business owners, promoters, finance leaders, and strategic customers. • Building a predictable sales engine through structured pipeline management, CRM adoption, and sales governance. • Working closely with Product development, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to strengthen ProfitNX's market leadership. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Growth & Strategy • Define and execute the long-term business growth strategy. • Identify new industries, customer segments, and geographical opportunities. • Develop scalable go-to-market models for national expansion. Revenue Leadership • Own revenue, profitability, and business performance. • Deliver sustainable quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year growth. • Build a healthy sales pipeline and improve conversion performance. Market Expansion • Develop and execute state-wise expansion strategies. • Build ProfitNX's presence across emerging and high-potential business markets. • Establish strong regional sales capabilities. Channel Development • Build a nationwide partner ecosystem comprising resellers, implementation partners, consultants, and referral partners. • Enable partner-led business growth through structured engagement programs. Sales Leadership • Recruit, mentor, and inspire high-performing business development leaders. • Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Strategic Customer Engagement • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and key decision-makers. • Position ProfitNX as a strategic business solution through consultative selling. 
 Who You Are You are an entrepreneurial business leader who enjoys building organizations, creating markets, and delivering sustainable business growth. You think strategically, execute decisively, and lead by example. 
 You believe in developing people, creating customer value, and building businesses that stand the test of time. 
 What We're Looking For: 
 • 08-10 years of experience in ERP, SaaS, or Enterprise Software sales. • Minimum 5 years in a senior business leadership role. • Proven track record of building business across multiple Indian states. • Demonstrated ownership of revenue, profitability, and commercial growth. • Strong experience in enterprise sales and consultative solution selling. • Success in developing channel partner and distribution ecosystems. • Experience building and leading high-performing sales organizations. • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage CXOs and business owners. 
 Why Join ProfitNX: 
 Joining ProfitNX means more than taking on a leadership roleit means shaping the future of a proven ERP platform. 
 You will have the opportunity to: 
 • Lead the national expansion of a mature Accounting ERP solution. • Build a business with the backing of a trusted technology company. • Work directly with promoters who value ownership, agility, and innovation. • Influence business strategy and product direction. • Build high-performing teams and create a lasting market impact. • Be rewarded for creating sustainable business growth and long-term value. 
 Shape the Future with ProfitNX: 
 Great businesses are built by leaders who see opportunity where others see limitations. 
 If you are driven by the challenge of building markets, inspiring teams, and creating measurable business impact, we invite you to lead the next chapter of ProfitNX's journey. 
 Build Business. Build Markets. Build a Legacy

Job Summary We are looking for an Installation workforce Coordinator to coordinate and manage the day-to-day allocation of carpet installation workers across different customer locations. The role involves receiving confirmed work requirements from the Sales Manager, planning and assigning workers to different jobs, coordinating installation dates with customers, tracking completion of work, maintaining work records, and handling post-work billing and invoicing. The candidate should be highly organized, good at coordinating multiple people and jobs simultaneously, and comfortable communicating with both customers and field workers. title: Technical Product Manager  Finance Transformation AI
description:
Technical Product Manager (TPM) Finance Transformation & AI Role Summary We are looking for a Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the delivery of AI-powered solutions for finance and enterprise customers. This role sits at the intersection of Finance Transformation, Product, Technology, and Customer Delivery. You will work directly with customers to understand their business processes and challenges, translate those needs into clear product and technical requirements, and partner with Product, Engineering, FDE, QA, and Customer Success teams to deliver successful implementations. The ideal candidate is someone with strong finance process expertise and consulting experience, who is comfortable working with customers, navigating ambiguity, driving project execution, and translating business problems into technology solutions. You do not need to come from an AI background. We value process depth, client presence, structured thinking, and delivery ownership. Exposure to AI, automation, SaaS, or enterprise technology is an advantage, but AI expertise can be developed on the job. What You Will Do 1. Customer Discovery & Process Understanding Lead customer discovery sessions to understand business processes, requirements, pain points, and desired outcomes. Conduct process and product walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders. Understand current-state and future-state processes, including exceptions, controls, dependencies, and operational challenges. Identify opportunities where automation, AI, and technology can improve existing finance processes. Drive requirement discussions and clarify business decisions with customers. 2. Product & Solution Definition Translate customer business problems into clear use cases, requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Work closely with Product, Engineering, and FDE teams to convert business requirements into scalable technology solutions. Participate in solution design discussions and help evaluate functional and technical trade-offs. Prioritize requirements based on customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery timelines. Contribute customer insights and feedback to product improvement and roadmap discussions. Help bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams. 3. End-to-End Delivery Own customer projects from discovery through implementation, go-live, and closure. Create and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, deliverables, and dependencies. Coordinate across Product, Engineering, FDE, QA, Customer Success, and customer teams. Track progress against agreed scope, timelines, and quality expectations. Ensure deliverables are completed and milestones are achieved as committed. Maintain project documentation, decisions, action items, and delivery status. 4. Risk, Issue & Dependency Management Proactively identify project risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies. Maintain and manage the RAID log throughout the project lifecycle. Develop mitigation and resolution plans for delivery risks. Escalate blockers and critical decisions appropriately. Drive action items and dependencies to closure. Ensure risks are communicated proactively to customers and internal leadership. 5. Customer & Stakeholder Management Act as a key delivery and product-facing contact for customers. Independently lead customer meetings, discovery sessions, workshops, and project reviews. Communicate project progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and timelines clearly. Manage customer expectations and proactively address concerns. Build strong relationships with business, finance, technology, and leadership stakeholders. Drive customer decisions, approvals, and milestone sign-offs. Work effectively with international customers and stakeholders across time zones. 6. Testing & Go-Live Coordinate business validation, UAT, and readiness activities with customers and internal teams. Work with QA, Engineering, Product, and FDE teams to ensure solution readiness. Validate the go-live checklist and ensure all required approvals are secured. Coordinate production deployment and post-go-live stabilization. Support project closure and capture customer feedback and lessons learned. What We Are Looking For 1. Finance Process & Domain Expertise You should have hands-on understanding of one or more finance processes, such as: Accounts Payable (AP) Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Order-to-Cash (O2C) Record-to-Report (R2R) Financial Close Reconciliation FP&A You should be able to go beyond a high-level process map and understand how the process actually operates, including exceptions, dependencies, controls, handoffs, and operational challenges. 2. Client-Facing Consulting Experience Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders. Ability to conduct discovery sessions and process/product walkthroughs. Comfortable asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions. Ability to independently lead conversations with international customers. Strong executive and stakeholder communication skills. 3. Product Mindset Ability to take an ambiguous business problem and structure it into a clear use case. Ability to translate business needs into requirements and actionable deliverables. Comfortable working closely with Product, Engineering, and FDE teams. Strong understanding of the relationship between business processes, technology, and customer outcomes. Curiosity about AI and emerging technology and their application to enterprise processes. 4. Project & Stakeholder Management Experience managing projects, workstreams, dependencies, risks, and multiple stakeholders. Strong ownership of timelines and deliverables. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to drive execution without relying on formal authority. Required Skills Finance process understanding Business analysis and requirement gathering Client discovery and stakeholder management Product thinking and solution definition Project and delivery management Risk and dependency management Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) User stories and acceptance criteria Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Excellent written and verbal communication Good to Have Experience in finance transformation or enterprise technology consulting Experience implementing SaaS or enterprise software Exposure to AI, GenAI, intelligent automation, RPA, or workflow automation Experience with ERP or finance platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, or similar Experience working with Engineering, FDE, Product, or QA teams PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, or Agile certification AI experience is not mandatory. We are more interested in strong finance-process understanding, customer-facing capability, structured thinking, and the ability to learn and work with emerging technology. Qualifications & Experience CA, MBA, or Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business, or a related field. 3–6 years of relevant experience in Finance Transformation, Business Consulting, Technology Consulting, GBS Advisory, Enterprise Software Implementation, Finance Process Transformation, or Product/Technology Consulting. Hands-on experience with at least one core finance process such as AP, P2P, O2C, R2R, Close/Reconciliation, or FP&A. Why This Role? Work directly with global customers on complex finance transformation problems. Help translate real-world finance processes into AI-powered solutions. Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams. Gain hands-on exposure to AI and agentic technologies. Influence product and solution decisions based on customer needs. Own projects from discovery through successful implementation and go-live. Develop into a strong product and technology leader while leveraging your existing finance and consulting expertise.

title: Financial Accountant II - Blackline
description:
This role is responsible for the timely and accurate execution of general ledger accounting activities for Canada\-based entities (CO\_1000, CO\_1020\) within the scope of the India Finance Shared Services Center (FSSC), including payroll\-related journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and statutory tax filings support, in accordance with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. This role is also responsible for administering user access, workflows, and audit documentation on the BlackLine reconciliation platform
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Prepares and posts the recurring Canada Bi\-Weekly Payroll journal entry (CO\_1020\) from the auto\-load interface, verifying successful posting and manually correcting any rejected entries
* Prepares and posts the Canada Payroll \& APC Accrual, APC Charge/Expense, PTO Liability, and RRSP Clearing journal entries based on inputs provided by the payroll team
* Prepares and posts the Canada RSU Reclass journal entry (CO\_1000\) to reclass or write off RSU accrual to the appropriate expense account
* Prepares and posts the Canada Cash Clearing and Payroll Reclass journal entries for CO\_1020
* Prepares and posts the GRIR Reclass journal entry (CO\_1000\)
* Prepares and posts the Canada DPSP True\-Up, DPSP Clearing, Workers’ Compensation True\-Up, and Medical Burden True\-Up journal entries
* Prepares and posts the CRA and Quebec Tax Assessment entry, reclassifying sales tax receivables to prepaid expense
* Performs quarterly balance sheet reconciliations for 13 payroll\-related general ledger accounts under CO\_1020, including Prepaid Payroll, Salaries and Wages, Workers Compensation, Social Security, Profit Sharing, PTO, Payroll Tax Payable (Federal and State), Fringe Benefits, Medical/Dental/Vision Benefits, and 401(k) Payable


**BlackLine System Administration**
* Provisions BlackLine access for new users and deactivates access for terminated users, reviewing headcount reports to confirm timely deactivation
* Assigns and reassigns reconciliation accounts to the appropriate users and configures journal workflows in BlackLine
* Prepares ITGC 5 and ITGC 7A audit documentation and obtains approvals from the designated approvers
* Provides sample documentation to support ITGC 4A, ITGC 4B, and mitigation ticket audits
* Prepares the monthly SAP vs. BlackLine reconciliation to identify and resolve differences between the two systems, and sends reminders to team members for pending reconciliations and outstanding tasks
* Prepares and posts the Canada Employer Health Tax Expense and Employer Health Tax Accrual journal entries in line with annual statutory requirements


**What You Bring**
* Chartered Accountant or CPA or CMA
* 4\-6 years of relevant experience in payroll accounting, general ledger accounting, or reconciliations, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Finance Shared Services experience in a large multinational company with a high\-volume, performance\-driven environment preferred
* Large ERP system experience — SAP preferred
* Experience with BlackLine required
* Prior exposure to Canadian payroll and statutory tax filings is an advantage
* Determines the appropriate resolution of routine journal entry and reconciliation discrepancies within established policies and procedures
* Escalates significant reconciliation, control, or audit\-related matters to the Immediate Supervisor for review and decision
* Recommends process improvements to journal entry, reconciliation, and BlackLine administration workflows
* Strong working knowledge of the BlackLine reconciliation platform, including system administration, user access provisioning, and workflow configuration
* Solid understanding of US GAAP and general ledger accounting, including payroll accruals, reconciliations, and month\-end close processes
* Working exposure to Canadian payroll, tax, and statutory reporting requirements, including CRA, Quebec sales tax, and Employer Health Tax
* Strong working knowledge of SAP or an equivalent ERP system for journal entry preparation and posting
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines across monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills for interacting with team members, auditors, and business partners
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving background
* Fluent (both orally and in writing) in English


**Who We Are:** 
 For 70 years, Bio\-Rad has focused on advancing the discovery process and transforming the fields of science and healthcare. As one of the top five life science companies, we are a global leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of high\-quality research and clinical diagnostic products. We help people everywhere live longer, healthier lives. Recently voted a Best Place to Work, Bio\-Rad offers a unique employee experience with collaborative teams that span the globe. Here, you are supported by leadership to build your career and are empowered to drive change that makes an impact you can see.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Bio\-Rad's biggest asset is its people, and the reason why our Total Rewards deliver programs that provide value, quality, and inclusivity while satisfying the diverse needs of our evolving workforce. Our robust offerings serve to enrich the overall health, wealth, and wellbeing of our employees through the various stages of an employee’s work and life cycle. We’re proud to offer a variety of options, including competitive insurance plans for you and your immediate family, Annual Health checkup , Marriage Leave, Paternity Leave ,Employee Assistance Programme , extensive learning and development opportunities, and more.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Bio\-Rad is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and we welcome candidates of all backgrounds. Veterans, people with disabilities, and people of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, and orientations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Agency Non\-Solicitation:** 
 Bio\-Rad does not accept agency resumes, unless the agency has been authorized by a Bio\-Rad Recruiting Representative. Please do not submit resumes unless authorized to do so. Bio\-Rad will not pay for any fees related to unsolicited resume

description:

**Description \-**

**Job Summary**  

* This role is responsible for supporting financial management by analyzing, reporting, and reconciling financial and operational results, identifying and researching variances to plans, and providing recommendations to key stakeholders. The role engages in budgeting and forecasting processes while ensuring reporting compliance. The role supports priority projects and maintains strong relationships with internal stakeholders.

  

**Responsibilities**

title: Finance Manager
description:
The Finance Manager will be responsible for overseeing financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, compliance, taxation, and financial strategy for Teceze’s global business operations.
 



 The role requires a strong understanding of finance operations within IT services, managed services, cybersecurity, cloud, and technology\-driven business environments. The candidate should possess excellent analytical skills, commercial acumen, process orientation, and the ability to support leadership with strategic financial insights.
 



 This role will work closely with executive leadership, sales, operations, procurement, HR, legal, and global delivery teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)
 


* Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and financial planning processes.
* Develop business financial models, profitability analysis, and growth projections.
* Analyze revenue streams, gross margins, operational costs, and profitability by business unit.
* Provide strategic financial insights to leadership for business decision\-making.
* Monitor financial KPIs and prepare executive dashboards.



  





 Accounting \& Financial Operations
 


* Manage end\-to\-end accounting operations including:
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* General Ledger
* Bank Reconciliation
* Payroll coordination
* Cash flow management
* Ensure timely month\-end and year\-end financial closures.
* Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
* Supervise accounting teams and finance operations processes.



  





 Taxation \& Compliance
 


* Ensure compliance with:
* GST
* TDS
* Income Tax
* ROC filings
* Statutory audits
* International taxation requirements
* Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure adherence to financial regulations, internal controls, and corporate governance standards.
* Manage vendor compliance and contract financial validation.



  





 Global Finance Operations
 


* Handle multi\-country finance coordination and reporting.
* Support international invoicing, currency management, and global financial operations.
* Monitor overseas entity transactions and cross\-border financial activities.
* Ensure financial process standardization across global operations.



  





 Strategic Business Finance
 


* Partner with leadership teams on:
* Business expansion planning
* Investment analysis
* Cost optimization
* Commercial structuring
* Pricing strategy
* Revenue forecasting
* Support M\&A evaluation, strategic partnerships, and global expansion initiatives.
* Drive financial efficiency and automation initiatives.



  





 Procurement \& Vendor Financial Management
 


* Manage financial governance related to:
* OEM procurement
* Vendor payments
* Distribution finance
* Technology licensing costs
* Partner commercial agreements
* Work closely with strategic alliances and procurement teams to optimize commercial structures.



  





 MIS \& Reporting
 


* Prepare:
* Monthly MIS reports
* P\&L statements
* Balance Sheets
* Cash flow reports
* Variance analysis
* Revenue and expense forecasting
* Present financial performance reports to leadership and stakeholders.
* Develop automation and reporting improvements using ERP and BI tools.



  





 Required Experience
 



 Mandatory
 


* 7–15\+ years of experience in:
* Global Finance Experience
* Corporate Finance
* Accounting
* FP\&A
* Financial Operations
* Compliance \& Taxation
* Experience in IT services, technology, managed services, SaaS, or enterprise services environments.
* Strong understanding of Indian taxation and financial regulations.
* Experience managing financial operations for fast\-growing organizations.

* Provide companywide advice and technical expertise on matters related to complex financial analysis as well as economic research in support of management decision making functions

description:

As a standalone company, the Mobility business will be more focused and agile, creating exciting opportunities for employees to grow, innovate, and help shape the future of mobility. The separation reflects strong confidence in the Mobility team and positions the new company as an employer of choice in the automotive and commercial vehicle industry. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the spinoff closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
   

  

 The Finance Business Partner – EIIC (Mobility business) provides end‑to‑end financial support to MobilityBusiness group and program portfolios executed at the Eaton India Innovation Center (EIIC). The role serves as a key liaison between Mobility business stakeholders, EIIC engineering teams, and global finance, ensuring strong financial governance, accurate forecasting, cost control, and timely billing for Mobility programs and initiatives.
   

  

* Financial Planning \& Forecasting – Support annual Profit Plan (PP), monthly forecasts, and outlook cycles for the MObility business by analyzing financial data and assisting in alignment of headcount, OpEx, and project spend with approved plans in collaboration with Mobility and EIIC stakeholders.
* Cost Management \& Governance – Track and analyze OpEx, travel, flex costs, temporary staffing, and project expenses against business targets; highlight variances and support cost control activities.
* Project \& Program Financial Support – Provide financial analysis and ongoing support for Mobility NPI, NTI, and strategic programs executed through EIIC.
* Billing, Invoicing \& Timesheet Governance – Assist in ensuring accurate and timely billing and invoicing for Mobility programs, including validation of rates, hours, and charge codes, and support timesheet compliance.
* Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication – Prepare financial dashboards, management reports, and ad‑hoc analyses to support Mobility leadership discussions and EIIC finance reviews.
* Process Improvement \& Digitization – Support identification and implementation of improvements in finance processes, automation, and data accuracy (e.g., dashboards, analytics).
* Business partnering \- Support proposal management by participating in the development of financial analysis for new program business proposals, capital investments, and potential new product endeavors. (cost\\benefit, Go\\No Go, Make\\outsource etc.)


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Costing or Management Accounting. CA/CWA/CMA/MBA preferred
   

  

 7–10 years of experience in Finance Business Partnering, Project Accounting, or FP\&A, preferably in an engineerin/ R\&D
   

  

**Skills**
* Expertise in process and product costing and finance, Cost\-benefit, Techno commercial analysis, Strong proficiency in Excel and financial reporting tools, Power apps, Power BI, AI, other automation tools
* Experience with ERP / planning systems (e.g., Oracle) and timesheet tools (e.g., Tenrox).
* Ability to analyze large datasets and convert them into meaningful insights.i
* Demonstrated strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with ability to establish effective cross\-functional relationships in a matrix environment; detail‑oriented with proven ability to prioritize tasks and deliver results under tight timelines.

**At our manufacturing unit, we use only the best raw materials and employ advanced manufacturing processes to ensure that our products are of the highest quality. We also adhere to strict quality control measures to ensure that every product meets our rigorous standards. This starts with doing a rigorous vendor qualification as well as testing of all raw materials supplied by these vendors for every batch. We do in\-house stability studies to make sure our products last the full shelf life and give the best results to our customers.** 




  

**Our goal is to provide our customers with nutraceutical products that promote health and wellness, and we are committed to using science\-backed ingredients and formulations to achieve this goal. We are also committed to continuous innovation and improvement and are always looking for new ways to enhance our products and processes.** 




  
 



**Role will be based at E\-279, GIDC, Nr. Rasulpura Village, II, Bol, Sanand, Gujarat 382170, India** 




  
 



**Job Title: Assistant Finance Controller
   

 Department: Finance \& Accounts** 




  
 



 Employment Type:     Full Time, Permanent
   

 Education    As mentioned above
 



  

**Key Skills** 




 Agile, Self\-starter, Tech Savvy, Time management, Stakeholder Management.
   

 Candidate is preferable from Big 4 firms, having Audit expertise or Pharmaceutical / Nutraceutical industry, having FP\&A, Supply Chain Finance expertise.
 



  
 



**Role \& Responsibility** 




 A. Books closing and Balance Sheet Integrity
 


* Prepare standalone financials for MIS and statutory reporting on monthly basis within timelines provided by central team.
* Conduct budget vs actual variance analysis, coordinating with departments for explanations and closure.
* Review and approve all material journal entries, including:
	+ Accruals and provisions
	+ Reclassifications and corrections
	+ Estimates and judgment‑based entries
* Enforce month‑end book freeze after completion of all checks and reviews.
* Circulate accounting checklist confirming all the monthly activities.
* Prepare management review decks and discuss with Finance Controller.
* Provide details and coordinate with the 3rd party consultants for valuation reports.
* Own end‑to‑end balance sheet integrity, including:
	+ Periodic reconciliation of all balance‑sheet accounts
	+ Review of ageing, nature, and recoverability
* Proactively identify and resolve long‑outstanding, abnormal, or non‑business balances.
* Ensure implementation of accounting policies, changes in accounting standards and accounting interpretation.
* Support drafting and review of financial statement schedules and notes.
* Create GL code based ensuring underlying annexures are signed by relevant authority.



 B. Fixed Assets Accounting \& Capital Governance
 


* Create and alter asset codes.
* Capitalize all capital expenditures post validation of approvals, Capitalization criteria and supporting documentation
* Account for asset disposals, retirements, impairments, and transfers with complete audit trail.
* Identify and retire idle, obsolete, or fully depreciated assets as per policy.
* Execute and review monthly depreciation runs (book \& tax).
* Maintain and reconcile a complete Fixed Asset Register (FAR) with GL and physical assets.



 C. Inventory Control
 


* Review inventory movement, valuation, and consumption reports for accuracy and completeness.
* Ensure periodic third‑party physical verification and closure of discrepancies.
* Identify and escalate slow‑moving, non‑moving, and near‑expiry inventory to Operations, Commercial, and R\&D.
* Ensure appropriate provisioning for aged and obsolete inventory.
* Drive and track aged inventory liquidation plans, ensuring commercial action and accounting follow‑through.
* Review and validate yield loss computations, investigate variances, and partner with Operations for root causes.



 E. Costing, Overheads \& Profitability Analytics
 


* Own standard cost computation and monthly updates.
* Identify margin variance vs budget at product level and discuss action plan with respective departments.
* Coordinate with R\&D for:
	+ Cost validation of new products / SKUs
	+ Resolution of BOM or formulation discrepancies
* Prepare product margin forecasts, coordinating with Procurement for future price assumptions.
* Design and maintain overhead allocation methodologies across products and divisions.
* Review and analyze divisional, product, and customer profitability.
* Drive SKU rationalisation activity.
* Prepare Product cost reconciliation with Trial balance on monthly basis and identify reason for variances.
* Discuss with CFT to identify Productivity initiatives and track performance of productivity against plan.



 F. Subsidy Accounting \& Claims (Government Schemes)
 


* Prepare documentation and working papers for subsidy claims.
* Coordinate with consultants for timely filing, clarifications, and government interactions.
* Liaise with cross‑functional and Group (Glanbia) teams to gather and validate supporting documents.
* Ensure correct accounting recognition, tracking, and reconciliation of subsidies received or receivable.



 G. Contract \& Commercial Governance
 


* Review key legal and commercial contracts from a finance, accounting, and statutory impact perspective.
* Own and maintain a central contract repository linked to accounting and disclosures.
* Track and ensure timely renewal of critical contracts.



 H. Internal Financial Controls (IFC) \& Risk Management
 


* Drive IFC testing, walkthroughs, and sample verification.
* Identify control gaps and failures; define and track corrective action plans.
* Strengthen internal controls based on audit findings, Operational changes or System enhancements.



 I. Audit (Internal \& Statutory)
 


* Provide auditors with reconciliations, schedules, working papers, and explanations.
* Track and close audit observations and management action points, ensuring no repeat issues.
* Work towards zero qualification and zero repeat observation outcomes.



 J. Automation, Systems \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Identify opportunities for automation and control strengthening across systems and processes.
* Reduce manual, spreadsheet‑driven processes through systemization and standardization.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process flows, and control matrixs wherever required.



 K. Budgeting and Forecast
 


* Prepare supporting files and computations for budget and forecast.



 Provide support to Finance Controller for preparing budget deck.
 



  
 



**Benefits Provided:** 
  
 



 1 Free Air\-Conditioned Transportation to the Factory 
   

 2 Paid Leave
   

 3 Tea/Coffee \& Canteen Facility
   

 4 Accident Insurance
   

 5 Provision for Bonus \& Gratuity
   

 6 Training programs for professional advancement
   

 7 Progressive work environments conducive to personal and professional growth

The role oversees business\-critical finance platforms including regional eInvoicing solutions, Coupa, Concur, GetPaid, Kyriba, SnapPay, and the Pega platform for finance master data management, ensuring seamless integration, data integrity, and business value realization across the finance technology portfolio.
   

  

 As a key leader in Finance Transformation, the ERP Finance Modernization \& Transformation Lead will identify opportunities to automate manual processes, leverage artificial intelligence and predictive analytics, improve data quality, strengthen governance, and accelerate decision\-making through modern digital capabilities. The role will partner closely with Finance, IT, Shared Services, and business stakeholders to redesign processes, improve operational efficiency, and enable a best\-in\-class finance ecosystem.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in JD Edwards Financials with experience in ERP modernization, intelligent automation, systems integration, and digital finance transformation. This individual will champion the adoption of JDE Orchestrator, AI\-powered solutions, low\-code technologies, and modern integration frameworks to streamline financial operations, improve compliance, and enhance the user experience.
   

  

 As Vantive continues its evolution as a newly independent company, this role will play a critical part in establishing a modern and scalable finance technology foundation. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of a growing healthcare company by leveraging modern ERP technologies, AI, and intelligent automation to create a world\-class finance organization.

 Finance Transformation, Modernization \& Digital Innovation

* Define the future\-state integration architecture between JDE and strategic finance applications, ensuring scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
* Establish governance and best practices for finance automation, orchestration, and digital process execution across the enterprise.


 Finance Process Transformation \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Partner with Finance, Treasury, Shared Services, AP, AR, Tax, Compliance, and Operations leaders to design and implement modern, technology\-enabled finance processes.
* Lead initiatives focused on transforming Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Treasury, Tax, and Payment processes through automation and digital innovation.
* Provide strategic guidance on how emerging technologies and AI capabilities can improve finance operations, financial controls, and business outcomes.
* Promote a data\-driven decision\-making culture through improved finance analytics, automation, and process visibility.


 Enterprise Architecture \& Solution Delivery
   

  

* Lead the design, evaluation, and implementation of finance technology solutions, integrations, and transformation initiatives.
* Conduct business process assessments and identify opportunities for modernization, rationalization, and automation.
* Collaborate with technical teams to implement scalable solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization and technical debt.
* Lead solution architecture discussions ensuring alignment with enterprise integration, security, compliance, and data management standards.
* Drive implementation of cloud, API\-based, and event\-driven integration strategies supporting long\-term modernization goals.


 Application Modernization \& TSA Exit Leadership
   

  

* Lead efforts to assess, document, rationalize, and modernize inherited finance systems and integrations during Vantive's post\-separation journey.
* Drive technology transition initiatives supporting TSA exits while building sustainable, independent finance capabilities.
* Analyze legacy processes and applications to identify opportunities for transformation, automation, elimination, or consolidation.
* Develop future\-state process and technology roadmaps that reduce complexity and improve business agility.


 Operational Excellence, Support \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Provide leadership and governance for finance application performance, stability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead root\-cause analysis efforts for complex cross\-functional business and integration issues.
* Define and oversee end\-to\-end testing strategies, including integration, automation, regression, and business process validation.
* Drive improvements in operational controls, compliance monitoring, system performance, and user adoption.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and process excellence.


 What You'll Bring

title: Senior Product Manager- Aani, Open Finance & Payment Gateway
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Huru is a licensed financial services provider regulated by the Central Bank of the UAE, focused on smart, secure, and seamless money management. Designed for people living in the UAE and beyond, Huru offers quick account opening, a free digital Visa card, and convenient bill payments and transfers. The platform enables users to access micro finance for emergencies, send money home, and manage UAE transfers with ease. With features like saving pots and intuitive budgeting tools, Huru supports users in building better financial habits. The company is committed to making everyday financial life easier, safer, and smarter for a diverse customer base.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 





 Every Huru user — whether it's a construction worker sending money home or an employer paying a hundred staff on time — touches a payment rail at the moment that matters most to them. Aani, Open Finance, and our Payment Gateway aren't back\-office plumbing at Huru; they're the raw material for some of the most impactful, front\-facing features we can build.
 





 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take these rails and turn them into products people actually feel — instant transfers that land in seconds, bill payments that just work, and Open Finance\-powered experiences that make Huru smarter about the people it serves. You'll decide not just
 
*whether* 

 a rail works, but
 
*what it becomes* 

 in the hands of a blue\-collar worker checking their balance on a shared phone, or an HR manager processing payroll on a deadline.
 





 This role also includes turning payments into a real revenue line — local and international bill payments and recharges — built for a segment that's rarely offered anything this convenient before.
 





 Candidates with hands\-on UAE fintech experience (Aani, RPSCS, Open Finance) or India's UPI/BBPS ecosystem are strongly preferred — the rail concepts translate directly, and we want someone who's already seen what "exciting" looks like when a rail becomes a feature people love.
 




  





**What you'll Actually Build:** 




**Aani, reimagined as user experience** 



* Design how instant P2P and P2A payments feel inside the Huru app for retail users — split bills with roommates, pay a shopkeeper, send money to another worker, all settling in real time.
* On the employer side, explore how Aani can power same\-day salary top\-ups, urgent vendor payouts, or instant corporate\-to\-worker disbursements that don't wait for a batch cycle.
* Own the trade\-offs between speed, cost, and reliability — and translate those into UX decisions users never have to think about.



  





**Open Finance, as a workflow — not a compliance checkbox** 



* Prototype what Open Finance unlocks for a worker with thin credit history: consent\-based data sharing that could power faster salary advances, smarter savings nudges, or simpler onboarding.
* On the employer side, imagine how consented data\-sharing could streamline reconciliation, payroll funding checks, or credit decisions for corporate lending.
* Partner with Compliance to figure out what's possible within UAE's evolving Open Finance framework — and be the person translating "what's regulatorily allowed" into "what's genuinely useful"



  





**Bills, recharges \& payments as a business you build** 



* Own the end\-to\-end experience for local and international bill payments and mobile/data recharges — this segment pays these bills every week; make it the easiest and most trusted way to do it.
* Build revenue mechanics — auto\-pay, reminders, cashback, partner incentives — that turn a one\-time payment into a recurring, revenue\-generating habit.
* Source and manage biller/aggregator partnerships that expand what users can pay for, directly inside Huru.



  





**The rail underneath it all** 



* Own the Payment Gateway that quietly connects all of the above — retail spend, employer disbursement, bill settlement — making sure it's fast, reliable, and cost\-efficient enough to support everything you're building on top of it.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end Aani experience roadmap across both retail and employer surfaces — from network integration through to the feature the user actually taps.
* Prototype and validate Open Finance\-powered use cases (credit, savings, reconciliation, onboarding) ahead of and alongside the UAE's regulatory rollout.
* Build and own the bill\-payment/recharge business line — partner sourcing, pricing, and the engagement mechanics that drive repeat revenue.
* Own the underlying Payment Gateway relationship — uptime, cost, and reliability — as the infrastructure your front\-facing features depend on.
* Define and track the KPIs that matter for both sides of this role: feature adoption and repeat usage on the front end; transaction success rate, cost per transaction, and rail uptime on the back end.
* Partner with Legal/Compliance to stay within CBUAE's RPSCS and SVF frameworks while pushing what's possible for users.
* Work with the Retail and B2B Product Leads to sequence which user\-facing rail features ship first, given shared engineering capacity.



  





**﻿
 
 Requirements** 



* **5\+ years in Product Management** 

 , ideally with experience shipping user\-facing features built on a payment rail, PG, or UPI\-equivalent system — not just maintaining the rail itself.
* **UAE fintech experience strongly preferred** 

 — Aani, RPSCS, or UAE Open Finance exposure is a real advantage; India's UPI/BBPS ecosystem experience is equally relevant given the structural overlap.
* **A track record of turning infrastructure into a feature users notice** 

 — you can point to something you built that people actually talked about, not just a rail that worked.
* **Experience building a bill\-payment or recharge line as a revenue driver.**
* **Comfortable moving between two altitudes in the same week** 

 — a rail reliability conversation with engineering, and a UX conversation about how a payment confirmation screen should feel.
* **Data\-driven and curious about people:** 

 you're as interested in
 
*why* 

 a worker checks their balance five times a day as you are in the transaction success rate behind it.

description:
