title: Credit Analyst for Agency arrangements
description:
Job Title: Credit Analyst for Agency arrangements
   

  

 Department: FIC ICAT
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 Financial Institutions Coverage (FIC) is a department in charge of the relationship management of key Financial Institutions, building long\-term relationships and promoting the full portfolio of Business solutions BNPP can offer.
   

  

 Within FIC, the Institutional Credit Analyst Team (ICAT) is a key domain of the first line of defense of the Bank, in charge of the assessment of Institutional clients’ credit profile and recommendation to delegation holders of credit authorizations.
   

  

 The team covers all type of Financial Institutions: Banks, Insurances, Sovereign, Brokers, other non\-banks financial institutions, pensions funds, funds, hedge funds, regulated funds, funds of hedge funds, agency arrangements and asset managers.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 In the context of agency arrangements, BNPP gets exposed to principals through transactions dealt by Agents which are entitled to act on behalf of their clients for the conduct of specific financial activities or transactions.
   

  

 Principals covered by agents can be numerous and are often, but not exclusively, Investments Funds, Pensions Funds or Insurance Companies.
   

  

 The FIC ICAT position aims at covering the Credit management of principals under agency arrangements, worldwide.
   

  

 The position is part of a platform of Credit analysts incorporated into BNPP India Solutions, operating under the supervision of the Regional ICAT Teams for the counterparties incorporated in their respective Regions.
   

  

 The position plays a key role in the efficiency of clients’ onboarding and in the management of the credit risk of the Bank.
   

  

 It implies working in close partnership with the ICAT community, FIC bankers, Businesses (notably Global Market Client onboarding teams) and RISK.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* The credit analyst is responsible for completing credit analyses on a portfolio of Principals under agency arrangements to facilitate informed credit decisions.


 Such a responsibility implies to:
   

  

* Collect credit requests from Business lines, as well as former credit decisions if any
* Create a request in the Credit Process Administration tool
* Collect documentation, data points related to the principals to analyze
* Run the rating policy associated to the principal of consideration
* Produce and format reports for limits \& exposure monitoring and other regular or Ad Hoc reports
* Report requested limits and recommend limits as per policies
* Check Delegation Levels and type of analysis needed for all counterparties
* Prepare, compile and circulate books and committee packs


 The analyst must contribute to the Bank’s reactivity vis\-à\-vis clients’ expectations by prioritizing urgent requests, while ensuring the performance of Annual Reviews in due time.
   

  

 On a permanent basis, the analyst must also monitor the portfolio under coverage and report any possible credit warning signal as per market intelligence, available financial information.
   

  

 Technical \& Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Strong and proven analytical skills
* Adaptability and proactivity, multitasking
* Strong presentation and communication skills (verbal and written)
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Valid knowledge and understanding of banking and financial markets
* Self\-driven and organized
* Rigorous and reliable


**Specific Qualifications**
 Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Financial Markets or other relevant areas.
   

  

 0\-3 years experience in a similar function
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
   

  

* Ability to develop and adapt a process
* Analytical Ability
* Credit analysis of financial institutions


**Behavioral Skills**
* Adaptability and proactivity, multitasking
* Communication skills – Oral \& Written
* Self\-driven and with strong organizational skills
* Attention to detail and rigor


 Education Level: Masters/Bachelors degree or equivalent
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 As a Senior Analyst in Master Data Governance within our FP\&A organization, you will serve as the critical bridge between finance operations, commercial/supply chain teams, system architecture, and strategic planning. You will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining SAP Master Data Governance for both Financial and Enterprise Data. By ensuring absolute data integrity across financial structures, materials, and business partners, managing workflows, and acting as the centralized gatekeeper for data sanity, you will directly enable accurate financial reporting, profitability analysis, forecasting, and cross\-functional business transformation.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Governance \& Maintenance


 Process Design \& Implementation: Design and execute governance processes, data standards, and definitions for core financial and enterprise master data within systems like SAP S/4HANA. This includes:
   

  

 Financial Data: Cost Centers, Profit Centers, General Ledgers, and Chart of Accounts.
   

  

 Commercial \& Supply Chain Data: Material Codes, Business Partners (Vendor Names, Customer Names), and Sales Groups.
   

  

 Centralized Gatekeeping: Act as the central control point for all master data updates before they are released to controllership or procurement/sales, ensuring strict adherence to global financial and business standards.
   

  

 Workflow Management: Streamline request intake workflows, standardize templates, and refine exception\-handling procedures utilizing SAP MDG, S/4HANA, and internal IT ticketing systems.
   

  

 Execution: Execute complex master data creation, extension, and modification requests across all relevant domains within the MDG tool to support evolving business needs seamlessly.
   

  

* Data Quality \& Hygiene (Data Sanity)


 Business Partnership \& Pushback: Actively challenge business stakeholders on requests for new data creation (e.g., unnecessary Profit Centers, duplicate Vendor/Customer records, or redundant Material Codes) to prevent data bloat.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Alignment: Play a critical role in ensuring financial structures align perfectly with operational data. Guarantee accurate mapping of Material Codes and Sales Groups to the correct Profit Centers and financial dimensions to ensure flawless downstream profitability reporting.
   

  

 Audits \& Root Cause Analysis: Establish data quality KPIs and conduct regular data audits. Lead proactive data cleansing initiatives and execute root\-cause analyses for recurring data anomalies across the P2P (Procure\-to\-Pay), O2C (Order\-to\-Cash), and R2R (Record\-to\-Report) value chains.
   

  

* System Implementation \& Enhancements


 Technical Translation: Collaborate closely with IT and business stakeholders to translate complex financial and FP\&A requirements into technical MDG solutions spanning finance, material, and business partner domains.
   

  

 Project Leadership: Lead workshops, map future\-state data architectures, and support the testing and deployment of system enhancements.
   

  

 Automation \& Transformation: Continuously evaluate the MDG landscape to outline and champion areas for workflow automation and process transformation.
   

  

 User Empowerment: Develop training materials and conduct workshops to educate end\-users on new processes, governance standards, and system enhancements.
   

  

* Reporting \& Stakeholder Management


 Documentation: Maintain comprehensive, up\-to\-date documentation regarding data standards, workflow rules, process flows, and system configurations for all data objects.
   

  

 Subject Matter Expertise: Act as the primary SME for enterprise MDG, guiding end\-users, managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and resolving master data\-related escalations effectively.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA, CA, or CPA is highly preferred.
* Experience: \[Insert, e.g., 5–7] years of professional experience in master data governance.
* Deep, hands\-on experience utilizing SAP MDG, with exposure across multiple domains including SAP MDG\-F (Finance), MDG\-M (Material), and MDG\-BP/C/S (Business Partner/Customer/Supplier).
* Strong foundational understanding of FP\&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis) and how upstream data (materials, vendors, customers) impacts downstream financial reporting.
* Technical Skills:
* Expert proficiency in SAP S/4HANA Master Data frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, data quality management tools, and workflow configurations.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to push back on non\-compliant business requests across various departments (Finance, Sales, Procurement).
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, highly compliant, and matrixed environment.

Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. title: Apprentice WRB India 2026
description:
**Wealth \& Retail Banking Apprentice \- India**
 Our 12 Months Apprenticeship Programme is designed to give you real responsibility from day one, with the opportunity to build your skills in a function that helps individuals and businesses grow, manage and protect their wealth.
   

  

 In Wealth \& Retail Banking, we serve millions of clients across some of the world’s most dynamic markets. You’ll contribute to work that helps us deliver better experiences for our clients, develop innovative products and services, and use data and technology to shape the future of banking.
   

  

**Throughout The Programme, You’ll**
* Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to real client and business priorities
* Build your commercial awareness and understanding of how we serve, support, and build relationships with our clients
* Develop analytical and problem\-solving skills by working with data and business information
* Learn how digital tools and technology are shaping the way we deliver products, services and experiences
* Collaborate with colleagues across teams, functions and markets
* Strengthen your communication and stakeholder management skills
* Gain exposure to senior leaders and thought\-leadership sessions


 By the end of the year, you’ll have built practical skills, gained experience of working in a global business and developed a clearer understanding of where a career in Wealth \& Retail Banking could take you.
   

  

**Bring the skills \- we’ll help you build your career**
 We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
   

  

**We’re Looking For**
* Strong academic performance and extracurricular involvement
* Team players with agility and resilience
* Analytical thinkers with attention to detail
* Passion for dynamic, fast\-paced environments
* Excellent project management and communication skills
* For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance \& Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics.


**Eligibility**
 To be eligible for this apprenticeship programme, you need to have graduated from college in 2026\.
   

  

 You can only submit one application within a six\-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals. Your work location could be one of multiple cities including Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad among others.
   

  

**About Our Wealth \& Retail Banking Team**
 We serve more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment which encompasses Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium Banking. Within the mass retail sector, our strategic focus is on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us, forming the future pipeline of affluent clients.
   

  

 We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East, and our deep local presence and international network enables us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
   

  

**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.


**Recruitment Assessments**
 Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
   

  

 Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

title: Manager - Regulatory Reporting

 Identify and mitigate operational risks through effective processes, controls, and use of technology.

 Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and controls; support remediation efforts and regulatory/business\-led change initiatives.

 Conduct reconciliations, manage back\-reporting exercises, and contribute to the preparation of management information and KPIs.

 Apply strong technical skills and attention to detail in a data\-driven environment, ensuring high standards of accuracy and compliance.

 Demonstrate flexibility, strong communication, time management, and a proactive approach to learning and task ownership.

* In\-depth knowledge of EMIR and MAS Transaction Reporting is essential

* Exposure to platforms used for data processing and reconciliation (e.g., Kaizen)
* Ability to adapt to evolving regulatory and business requirements


**Education Qualification:**
* Graduate in any discipline.
* Masters in Finance / Economics / Any Certification like FRM / CFA will be a plus


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

 culture focuses on collaboration to achieve career growth. Innovation is highly encouraged, which is

We promote happy employees by making work/life balance a priority along with being actively involved in our communities. Our dedication to service can be seen through the Firm's decision to match charitable donations made by employees, as well as providing opportunities to volunteer throughout the year. Most importantly, we like to have fun! We offer a professional and fun work environment with frequent lunch and learns, socials, contests, outings and other events.
   

  

***Typical Day in the Life***
 A typical day in the life of a Financial Services Consulting Associate/Senior Associate may include the following:
   

  

* Effectively works and communicates with Eide Bailly Team in the financial institution industry to ensure processes and operations meet required regulations and industry best practices.
* Prepares and assists with planning and testing for financial institution clients, including reviewing internal processes and controls, regulatory examination issues, and corrective action.

title: Quantitative Research & Development Intern
description:
**Who We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a
 **Quantitative Research \& Development Intern** 
 to work with GreyOak’s quantitative research team on market data analysis, model development, backtesting and quantitative research.
 



 The role is suited for students with a strong foundation in
 **mathematics, probability, statistics, programming and data analysis** 
 , along with a genuine interest in financial markets and quantitative research.
 



 You will work with historical and live financial market datasets, explore market behaviour, test quantitative hypotheses and contribute to the development and validation of proprietary quantitative models.
 



  





**Internship Details** 



* We are looking for candidates who can commit to a
 **fixed internship period** 
 , either as a summer internship or semester\-long internship.
* Students in their
 **third year, fourth year or final semester** 
 are preferred.
* The internship is
 **paid** 
 and includes a monthly stipend.
* Candidates demonstrating strong performance and consistently meeting research and development expectations may be considered for a
 **full\-time role / PPO** 
 after completion of the internship.
* Internship certificates will be issued upon successful completion of the agreed internship period.
* We are looking for highly motivated candidates with strong academic and technical backgrounds.
* Strong academic performance is preferred; a
 **CGPA of 8\.0\+ / equivalent** 
 will be considered favourably.



**What You Will Be Responsible For** 




 As a Quantitative Research \& Development Intern, you will:
 


* Analyse historical and real\-time financial market data.
* Research statistical relationships, market patterns and quantitative behaviour across different instruments and timeframes.
* Develop, test and validate quantitative models using Python.
* Build systematic research pipelines for testing quantitative hypotheses.
* Perform statistical analysis and feature engineering on financial datasets.
* Conduct time\-series analysis and identify meaningful market structures and relationships.
* Backtest quantitative models across historical datasets.
* Evaluate model performance using appropriate statistical and quantitative metrics.
* Analyse model consistency across different market regimes and time periods.
* Research probability\-based approaches for measuring market behaviour and model confidence.
* Work with large OHLCV and other structured financial datasets.
* Develop data\-processing and research utilities to improve the quantitative research workflow.
* Identify model weaknesses, edge cases and potential overfitting.
* Document research methodology, assumptions, results and conclusions.
* Work closely with quantitative researchers and developers to convert research ideas into scalable models.
* Contribute to improving existing quantitative models through testing, validation and experimentation.



**What We Value** 




 These skills will help you succeed in this role:
 


* Strong understanding of
 **probability and statistics** 
 .
* Strong mathematical and analytical ability.
* Good Python programming skills.
* Experience working with NumPy, Pandas and similar data\-analysis libraries.
* Understanding of statistical modelling and hypothesis testing.
* Knowledge of time\-series analysis.
* Familiarity with machine learning concepts and techniques.
* Ability to analyse large datasets and identify meaningful patterns.
* Understanding of model validation and backtesting methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and attention to detail.
* Ability to independently investigate a research problem and present structured conclusions.



**Preferred Technical Experience** 



* Python for quantitative research and data analysis.
* NumPy, Pandas, SciPy and Scikit\-learn.
* Time\-series modelling and analysis.
* Machine learning and statistical learning.
* Feature engineering and pattern recognition.
* Experience working with financial or market datasets.
* Backtesting frameworks or experience building backtesting systems.
* SQL and database fundamentals.
* Git and version control.
* Linux environment.
* C\+\+ or R knowledge is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Knowledge of optimization techniques is an advantage.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications** 




 Students pursuing B.Tech, B.E., M.Tech, M.Sc. or equivalent degrees in areas such as:
 


* Mathematics and Computing
* Computer Science
* Mathematics
* Statistics
* Data Science
* Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Computational Finance
* Financial Engineering



 Candidates from other disciplines with a demonstrably strong background in mathematics, statistics and programming are also encouraged to apply.
 



 Prior trading experience is
 **not required** 
 . We care more about your ability to think quantitatively, work with data and rigorously test ideas.
 



  





**About GreyOak** 




 GreyOak Capital Intelligence is a fintech company building quantitative market intelligence products designed to make complex market data easier to interpret and use.
 



 Our quantitative research team works with historical and real\-time financial market data to develop proprietary models across market behaviour, price structures, expected ranges, opportunity discovery and quantitative intelligence.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
**Role:** 
 Quantitative Researcher (Contract)
 



**Company:** 
 Meridian Capital
 



**Location:** 
 100% Remote (India)
 



**Format:** 
 3\-Month Live Project
 


**About Meridian Capital** 

 Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm actively operating in the Indian stock market. We execute our strategies through a fully automated, end\-to\-end systematic trading platform designed to identify and exploit market inefficiencies with zero manual intervention required for trade execution.
 


**The Role \& Challenge** 

 We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and results\-driven Quantitative Researcher for a specialized 3\-month contract. Your primary objective will be to audit, stress\-test, and extensively optimize the mathematical and logical foundation of our current trading algorithm to maximize our market edge.
 



 This engagement is strictly performance\-oriented and structured around two core phases:
 


* **Phase 1 (The 2\-Week Sprint):** 
 Within the first 14 days of engagement, evaluate our existing quantitative logic and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust model that we can immediately deploy into live trading environments.
* **Phase 2 (Ongoing Optimization):** 
 For the remainder of the 3\-month contract, shift focus toward developing advanced quantitative metrics, refining statistical models, and continuously optimizing the system for peak performance and risk mitigation.


**Target Performance Metrics** 

 Optimization efforts must be engineered to achieve or exceed the following benchmarks:
 


* **Sharpe Ratio:** 
 \> 1\.5
* **Sortino Ratio:** 
 \> 1\.8
* **Win Rate:** 
 45% or greater
* **Monthly Return:** 
 Minimum 5% consistent growth


**Compensation \& Profit Sharing** 

 This role is highly leveraged toward performance, rewarding the specific alpha you generate directly.
 


* **Fixed Stipend:** 
 ₹5,000 per month (paid upon initial verification of a profitable, working algorithm).
* **Performance Share (30%):** 
 You will receive 30% of all trading profits generated by the firm. This profit share activates the moment your quantitative logic is deployed in our live algorithm and remains in effect for the entire duration of your engagement with Meridian Capital.


**Must\-Have Qualifications** 
* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative engineering discipline.
* Proven, hands\-on experience in statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks, and algorithmic trading logic.
* Deep, intuitive understanding of risk\-adjusted return metrics (e.g., Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Maximum Drawdown).
* Ability to rapidly prototype, stress\-test, and deploy mathematical logic tailored for financial markets under tight deadlines.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian stock market dynamics, market micro\-structure, and historical market data handling.


**Preferred Qualifications** 
* Proficiency in Python, R, or C\+\+ for extensive quantitative analysis and data manipulation.
* Prior experience building, auditing, or optimizing end\-to\-end systematic trading strategies from scratch.
* A pragmatic, objective mindset that prioritizes live\-market applicability and robust execution over theoretical perfection.

title: Structured Finance Analyst
description:
**Structured Finance Analyst** 




 Graystone Capital \| Global Enablement Centre, India
 



 www.graystone\-capital.com
 



  





**About Graystone Capital** 




 Graystone Capital arranges and structures debt financing for businesses across the GCC and wider region, trade finance, working capital, structured credit, and syndicated facilities, connecting clients with banks, private credit funds, and institutional investors.
 



  





 Our Global Enablement Centre in India is the analytical engine behind that work. This is not a back\-office support function. The Centre produces the credit and diligence work product that goes directly to investment committees, lenders, and investors.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own the analytical work that decides whether a transaction proceeds. Two distinct workstreams:
 



  





**Financial due diligence** 
 on borrowers and investment targets, testing whether reported earnings are repeatable, whether cash conversion is real, and what the balance sheet actually contains.
 



  





**Credit and investment memoranda** 
 for debt financing mandates and private equity opportunities, the documents on which capital is committed.
 



  





 You will see transactions end to end, from first data request to committee decision. The analysis is yours; you will be expected to defend it.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 




  





**Financial due diligence** 



* Build Quality of Earnings analyses: normalise reported EBITDA for one\-off, non\-recurring, out\-of\-period and owner\-related items, and construct a defensible adjusted earnings bridge
* Prepare working capital analyses, trailing twelve\-month averages, seasonality, and a normalised working capital peg
* Analyse cash conversion and free cash flow, distinguishing accounting profit from cash actually generated
* Identify debt\-like items and off\-balance\-sheet exposures that belong in the net debt calculation
* Perform revenue and customer concentration analysis, cohort retention, and pricing\-versus\-volume decomposition
* Review related\-party transactions, revenue recognition policies, and internal controls, flagging inconsistencies and red flags in the underlying data
* Produce clean supporting schedules that tie to source documents and survive external scrutiny



  





**Credit memoranda and investment analysis** 



* Draft full credit memoranda: business and promoter background, industry and competitive position, financial analysis, transaction structure, security package, risks and mitigants, and a clear recommendation
* Build and maintain three\-statement financial models with integrated debt schedules, covenant calculations, and cash sweep mechanics
* Calculate and interpret the ratios that drive decisions — Net Debt/EBITDA, Interest Coverage, DSCR, Fixed Charge Coverage, current and quick ratios, and working capital cycle
* Run base, management and downside stress cases, testing covenant headroom and refinancing capacity under adverse conditions
* Prepare LBO and returns analyses for private equity opportunities, including entry and exit multiple sensitivities and IRR/MOIC bridges
* Assess security structures, guarantees, and post\-dated instrument arrangements typical of GCC trade finance
* Support term sheet preparation and respond to lender and investor queries during syndication



  





**Ongoing** 



* Monitor portfolio covenant compliance and flag early warning indicators
* Maintain comparable company and precedent transaction databases across our sectors
* Work directly with the Dubai origination team, and with client finance teams during live diligence



  





**What we are looking for** 




  





**Essential** 



* 3–6 years in financial due diligence, credit analysis, leveraged or structured finance, transaction advisory, private credit, or investment banking
* CA, CFA (any level cleared), MBA (Finance), or equivalent
* Demonstrable Quality of Earnings and working capital experience, you should be able to walk us through an EBITDA bridge you built and defend every adjustment
* Advanced financial modelling in Excel, built from scratch rather than adapted from templates
* Genuine command of financial statement analysis under IFRS, including the ability to spot what is missing rather than only analyse what is presented
* Strong business writing. A credit memo is a piece of persuasive writing supported by numbers, and we will test this at interview
* Ability to work to transaction timelines, a mid\-market diligence typically runs four to six weeks and the deadline is set by the deal, not by us


- 


**Advantageous** 



* Exposure to GCC or wider MENA markets, or to Islamic finance structures such as Murabaha
* Big Four transaction services background
* Trade finance, supply chain finance, or asset\-based lending experience
* Familiarity with Capital IQ, Bloomberg, or comparable platforms
* Working knowledge of Power BI or Python for data\-heavy analysis



  





**What will make you successful here** 




 Intellectual honesty above all. We would rather hear that a deal does not work than receive an analysis engineered toward the answer someone wants. Judgement about which questions matter. And the confidence to escalate an inconsistency in a data room rather than reconcile around it.
 



  





**Why this role** 



* Direct exposure to live transactions and to the investment committee, not to a processing queue
* Work across both debt and equity, which few analyst roles offer at this stage
* A genuinely growing platform — you will help build how this function operates rather than inherit a fixed process
* Close working relationship with the Dubai team, with travel opportunity

**Location:**

**Minimum Qualifications** 



* 5 years of hands\-on accounting or finance operations experience, covering core day\-to\-day functions such as Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance across multiple entities.
* Practical proficiency with cloud accounting or ERP software (e.g. Xero, Zoho Books, Odoo, or equivalent) and strong Excel skills (e.g. pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data reconciliation, financial modeling).
* Solid foundational understanding of basic accounting principles, including accruals, prepayments, intercompany transactions and multi\-currency transaction handling.
* Proven track record of managing month\-end schedules across multiple operational entities, ensuring data accuracy and meeting closing deadlines.
* Clear written and spoken English communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, global vendors and external partners regarding invoices and settlements.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or progress toward a professional certification (ACCA, CPA, or equivalent).
* Prior exposure to a tech, SaaS, fintech, or marketplace business with multi\-entity books and cross\-border payment flows.
* Working awareness of Indian statutory compliance requirements — EPF, ESIC, TDS, GST, Professional Tax — sufficient to review filings and liaise with consultants, even if not personally executing them.
* Experience supporting statutory and tax audits, including exposure to transfer pricing documentation.



  





**About the Job** 




 Bakuun is building the technology that moves global travel forward: a connected platform spanning hospitality distribution, marketplace operations, payment infrastructure, and property management that helps operators worldwide work smarter, scale faster, and serve guests better. We are at an early and consequential stage of that journey. As Finance Manager, you are the operational foundation of our global finance function. Operating across a multi\-entity international footprint, you will ensure that all transactions, reconciliations and ledgers are maintained with accuracy and audit\-readiness. This role offers direct exposure to cross\-border cash flows, multi\-currency settlements and global statutory environments ideal for a finance professional who takes pride in data accuracy and wants hands\-on experience in an expanding international platform.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Own and manage day\-to\-day accounting across multiple global entities, overseeing vendor invoice processing (AP), client billings and collections (AR), and intercompany transaction recording in the ERP, ensuring accuracy and consistency across the team.
* Review and manage bank, payment gateway, and general ledger reconciliations across multi\-currency accounts, identifying and resolving settlement variances and escalations.
* Lead month\-end and year\-end closing cycles across assigned entities, preparing and reviewing balance sheet schedules, prepayment/accrual schedules, and fixed asset registers within stipulated deadlines.
* Prepare and present recurring financial reports and management schedules, including cash position, AR/AP aging, operating expenses, entity\-level performance, and multi\-entity consolidation inputs, to leadership.
* Maintain and oversee organized financial documentation across all operating jurisdictions, ensuring records remain fully audit\-ready for statutory and tax filings.
* Liaise directly with global vendors, banking partners, and external auditors to resolve cross\-border billing, payment processing, and transaction discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Maintain working oversight of India statutory compliance (EPF, ESIC, TDS, GST, Professional Tax), coordinating with internal resources and/or external consultants to ensure timely filings, without necessarily executing the filings personally.
* Drive process improvements and controls across the finance function to strengthen accuracy, reduce turnaround time, and support scalability as the company grows.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis inputs for leadership review, as required.

title: Accountant R2R
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Role Title:** 
 Accountant R2R (Intercompany)
   

  





**Reports to:** 
 Sr. Accountant R2R
   

  





**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor
   

  





**Location:** 
 Chinchwad, Pune
   

  





**Purpose of the role:**




 The R2R Intercompany (ICP) Reconciliation Analyst is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reconciliation of intercompany transactions and balances across group entities. The role involves maintaining the integrity of General Ledger accounts, identifying and resolving reconciliation differences, supporting month\-end and year\-end close activities, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across Finance, O2C, P2P, Treasury, and Business teams.
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




* Intercompany Reconciliation \& General Ledger Management
* Perform timely and accurate reconciliation of intercompany balances and transactions across legal entities.
* Monitor and maintain Intercompany (ICP) and General Ledger accounts, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately and completely.
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences, mismatches, aging items, and out\-of\-balance conditions within agreed timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of reconciliations, supporting schedules, and exception reporting.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities related to intercompany accounting.
* Reconciliation and Issue Resolution
* Complete periodic reconciliations of assigned balance sheet and P\&L accounts in compliance with company policies.
* Identify root causes of reconciling items and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely closure.
* Track open items, monitor aging, and drive resolution through regular follow\-ups with counterparties and business teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports and provide status updates to management.
* Compliance and Financial Controls
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal control requirements, company policies, and statutory regulations.
* Maintain adequate audit trails and supporting documentation for all reconciliation activities.
* Support control testing and remediation activities related to Intercompany processes.
* Audit Support
* Provide reconciliation reports, supporting schedules, transaction details, and explanations to internal and external auditors.
* Assist during statutory audits, internal audits, and corporate reviews.
* Address audit queries accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Stakeholder Management and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Liaise with business stakeholders, finance controllers, and shared service teams to resolve intercompany discrepancies.
* Collaborate closely with O2C, P2P, Treasury, Tax, and accounting teams to resolve transaction and posting issues impacting GL and ICP accounts.
* Support management with timely financial information and analysis for decision\-making.
* Participate in regular governance meetings and reconciliation review calls with global counterparts.
* Process Improvement and Continuous Excellence
* Identify opportunities to enhance reconciliation efficiency, standardization, automation, and control effectiveness.
* Drive reduction of aged reconciling items and recurring exceptions through process improvements.
* Support implementation of process optimization initiatives, system enhancements, and automation solutions.
* Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.






**Academic \& Work Profile:**




* CA/CA\- Inter., MBA, CMA – Inter. 3 – 8 yrs. exp. in accounting
* Strong in Accounting and intercompany Reconciliation process
* Relevant Experience/ Knowledge in reputed Captive/Outsourcing RTR Ops.
* Good Written/Verbal Communication
* Ms Excel Knowledge.
* Preferred someone with exposure of SAP for 1\+ years
* Stakeholder Management experience
* Quality Lean/Process Improvement knowledge






 Interested candidate/s can share their resume to
 **Margaret.Hirekerur@skf.com**




****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: ESG Research Analyst
description:
A global bank that is standing up its India technology and operations centre is now building its India ESG and sustainability research desk, the small team that will feed numbers into every disclosure the bank's investors ask about. It has partnered with Flexiple, a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and centres in India, to hire the first analyst into that desk.
 



**Why this desk exists** 




 Right now, ESG data for this bank's India operations gets pulled together once a year, by whichever analyst has time, from spreadsheets that do not talk to each other. The desk exists to make that a continuous process instead of an annual scramble, and to start answering questions the bank's clients and regulators are asking more often, from emissions data to governance scoring on the companies it lends to.
 



**What the analyst role covers** 



* Research and score counterparties and portfolio companies against standard ESG frameworks
* Track regulatory and disclosure requirements across the markets the bank operates in and flag what changes
* Build and maintain the datasets and dashboards the desk reports from, instead of rebuilding them each quarter
* Draft sections of client\-facing and regulatory ESG reporting for review by the desk lead
* Work with credit and risk teams to fold ESG scoring into how they already assess a counterparty



**What you would need to bring** 



* 2 to 7 years in ESG research, sustainability reporting, credit research, or a closely related analytical role
* Working knowledge of at least one major ESG framework, such as GRI, SASB, or TCFD
* Strong Excel and data skills, and comfort pulling a defensible number out of a messy dataset
* Clear written English, since a lot of this work ends up quoted directly in a report
* A finance, economics, environmental science, or related background



 The role is based in Mumbai, Chennai, or Hyderabad, hybrid, alongside the wider operations centre.
 



**What the hiring process looks like** 




 A recruiter screen, a data exercise built around a real, anonymised counterparty file, a round with the desk lead, and a final conversation with the risk function it reports into.
 



 One application here also puts you forward for other research mandates Flexiple is placing across its banking and financial\-services clients this quarter.

title: Sr. Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 




 Goyal Gourav \& Co. is a premier Chartered Accountancy firm providing comprehensive financial, taxation, audit, and business advisory services. Founded by Gourav Goyal, who brings over 14 years of experience in Taxation, Finance, and International Business Consulting, the firm focuses on tailored, growth\-oriented, and compliance\-driven solutions. Its services span direct and indirect taxation, GST, international taxation, transfer pricing, audit and assurance, valuation, due diligence, M\&A advisory, and business restructuring. The firm also supports regulatory and compliance matters, including FEMA, RBI, FDI policy, and cross\-border transactions, as well as startup and MSME needs such as business setup, fundraising assistance, and CFO services. Headquartered in India and serving clients globally, Goyal Gourav \& Co. partners with MNCs, Indian business houses, startups, and SMEs to navigate complex financial and regulatory landscapes.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Sr. Accountant will manage end\-to\-end accounting and taxation activities, including ledger maintenance, journal entries, ledger reconciliations, GST filings, TDS filings, advance tax computation, tax\-related reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements in compliance with applicable standards. Responsibilities include overseeing accounts payable and receivable, reviewing transaction documentation, and ensuring timely month\-end and year\-end closing. The role involves coordinating with auditors, supporting tax computations and filings, and maintaining accurate records for regulatory and statutory compliance. The Sr. Accountant will also analyze financial data, prepare periodic reports for management, and help streamline accounting processes and internal controls. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi, requiring close collaboration with partners, team members, and clients.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger management, financial statement preparation, reconciliations, and knowledge of accounting standards.
* Candidates should possess taxation and compliance skills, such as experience with direct and indirect taxes, GST, TDS, and regulatory filings.
* Candidates should possess audit\-related skills, including support for statutory audits, internal audits, and documentation for audit trails.
* Candidates should possess financial analysis and reporting skills, including MIS reporting, budgeting support, variance analysis, and data interpretation.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, along with strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Candidates should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, client\-handling abilities, and a collaborative working style.
* Relevant professional qualifications such as CA Inter, CA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent are preferred; prior experience in a CA firm or similar environment will be an advantage.

 Automation implementation. As the company scales its operations, this role will be pivotal in ensuring accurate, compliant, and insightful financial reporting while driving process excellence and establishing robust internal controls across SEA/MEA regions.

**Financial Reporting \& Consolidation**

 compliance.

 automation.

**Business Partnering \& Growth Support** 




 • Collaborate with global finance teams to harmonize accounting policies and reporting practices.
 



 • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Tax, and Treasury teams to ensure accurate cost reporting,

**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 • Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent qualification.
 



 • 5–6 years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, consolidation, and accounting, preferably within the manufacturing sector.
 



 • Strong knowledge of IFRS / Ind AS, consolidation principles
 



 • Hands\-on experience with ERP systems and reporting tools
 



 • Demonstrated ability to build processes and teams from the ground up.

title: Sustainability - Lead Consultant
description:
**Role Overview** 
  

  

 The candidate should be well versed in GHG accounting, corporate decarbonisation, carbon markets and carbon pricing, with demonstrated experience of working with clients to develop emissions inventories, identify and quantify decarbonisation opportunities, assess carbon market implications and evaluate the financial viability of low\-carbon interventions.
   

  

 The role requires a combination of technical sustainability expertise, quantitative analysis and financial modelling capabilities to support clients in translating climate ambitions into practical and financially viable decarbonisation programmes.
   

  

 Candidates with a background in sustainability/climate consulting, energy and decarbonisation advisory, carbon markets or climate finance would be preferred.
   

  

**Job Requirements** 
  

  

 \* Strong understanding of GHG accounting principles and methodologies, including the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Scope 2 Guidance and Scope 3 Standard.
   

 \* Hands\-on experience in developing and reviewing Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 GHG inventories, including activity data assessment, emission factor selection, calculation methodologies, data validation and development of emissions baselines.
   

 \* Experience in developing corporate and sector\-specific decarbonisation / Net Zero roadmaps, including identification, prioritisation and quantification of emission reduction opportunities.
   

 \* Good understanding of Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) requirements, target\-setting methodologies, absolute and intensity\-based reduction pathways and Net Zero principles.
   

 \* Ability to identify and assess decarbonisation interventions across areas such as energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, fuel switching, alternative fuels, process improvements, waste and circularity, logistics and supply\-chain decarbonisation.
   

 \* Ability to quantify energy, GHG and cost reduction potential associated with individual decarbonisation interventions.
   

 \* Strong understanding of India’s Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), Indian Carbon Market and compliance carbon market architecture, including emerging sectoral trajectories, obligated entities, GHG emission intensity targets, credit generation and compliance requirements.
   

 \* Understanding of voluntary carbon markets, carbon credit project development and major carbon standards / methodologies.
   

 \* Knowledge of Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, corresponding adjustments and international carbon market developments would be an advantage.
   

 \* Ability to assess the implications of internal and external carbon pricing on business operations, investment decisions and decarbonisation strategies.
   

 \* Experience in developing carbon price scenarios and incorporating carbon costs into investment and business\-case assessments.
   

 \* Strong financial modelling capabilities for evaluating decarbonisation investments, including:
   

    \* CAPEX and OPEX assessment
   

    \* Energy and operating cost savings
   

    \* Simple and discounted payback
   

    \* NPV
   

    \* IRR
   

    \* Cash\-flow modelling
   

    \* Sensitivity and scenario analysis
   

    \* Carbon\-price impact
   

    \* Marginal Abatement Cost / Marginal Abatement Cost Curve (MACC)
   

 \* Ability to develop business cases for decarbonisation interventions by integrating technical emission\-reduction potential with financial attractiveness.
   

 \* Understanding of financing mechanisms for decarbonisation projects, including green loans, sustainability\-linked loans, green bonds, sustainability\-linked bonds, blended finance, concessional finance, ESCO/RESCO models and other relevant financing structures.
   

 \* Ability to assess different decarbonisation financing options based on project characteristics, technology maturity, investment requirement, payback period, risk allocation and potential funding sources.
   

 \* Understanding of green and sustainable finance frameworks, taxonomies and eligibility considerations relevant to financing low\-carbon investments.
   

 \* Experience in undertaking sector research and benchmarking on emissions intensity, decarbonisation technologies, carbon prices, regulatory developments and low\-carbon transition pathways.
   

 \* Exposure to sectors such as Power, Manufacturing, Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Cement, Steel, Metals \& Mining, Oil \& Gas, Automotive, Infrastructure and Financial Services would be preferred.
   

 \* Ability to develop robust Excel\-based analytical and financial models and translate complex analysis into clear management insights.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage client workstreams, conduct stakeholder discussions, coordinate data collection and deliver assignments within agreed timelines.
   

 \* Ability to prepare and deliver high\-impact presentations, technical reports and recommendations to clients and internal committees.
   

 \* Support preparation of proposals, technical approaches, pitch presentations and client discussions for decarbonisation, carbon markets and climate finance opportunities.
   

 \* Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge reports, articles and sector insights on decarbonisation, CCTS, carbon markets and climate finance.
   

  

**Experience** 
 :  At least 5–6 years of relevant experience in sustainability, climate change, energy or related consulting/advisory roles.
   

  

 Candidates should preferably have hands\-on experience in at least 4–5 of the following areas:
   

  

 \* Scope 1, 2 \& 3 GHG Accounting
   

 \* Net Zero / Decarbonisation Roadmaps
   

 \* SBTi
   

 \* Energy and Emission Reduction Assessment
   

 \* Indian CCTS / Carbon Markets
   

 \* Carbon Pricing
   

 \* Carbon Credit Assessment
   

 \* Financial Modelling
   

 \* MACC Development
   

 \* Climate / Green Finance
   

 \* Decarbonisation Project Financing
   

  

**Qualification** 
 :
   

  

 \* MBA / Master’s degree in Energy, Sustainability, Environmental Management, Climate Change, Finance, Economics or related discipline; or
   

 \* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Energy or another relevant discipline.
   

  

 Certifications / qualifications in GHG accounting, carbon markets, energy management, climate finance or financial modelling would be an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skill Set** 
 :
   

  

**Technical:** 
 GHG Accounting \| Scope 1, 2 \& 3 \| SBTi \| Net Zero \| Decarbonisation \| CCTS \| Indian Carbon Market \| Carbon Credits \| Carbon Pricing \| MACC
   

  

**Financial:** 
 Financial Modelling \| CAPEX/OPEX \| NPV \| IRR \| Payback \| Sensitivity Analysis \| Green Finance \| Sustainable Finance \| Decarbonisation Financing
   

  

**Consulting:** 
 Client Management \| Research \& Analysis \| Project Management \| Stakeholder Engagement \| Report Writing \| Business Development \| Presentation Skills
   

  

**Tools:**

title: Solution Cost Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 GE Vernova is seeking a Solution Cost Manager to join our HVDC team. This role is responsible for managing the cost baselines for all the HVDC reference solutions to ensure a concise, accurate and competitive cost basis is available and can be applied consistently across regions and tenders/projects. The Solution Cost Manager sits at the intersection of solution strategy, sourcing excellence, design improvement and cost competitiveness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user\-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end\-to\-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up\-to\-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost\-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi\-project or multi\-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry\-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross\-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross\-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return\-on\-experience integration into standard offerings

title: Assistant Manager- Accounts Payable
description:
**Assistant Manager – Accounts Payable**
 Finance
   

  

* Accounts Payable


**About Us**
 At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Finance Operations team at OakNorth manages end\-to\-end financial processes across our India, UK, and US entities. The Accounts Payable function sits within this team and is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant processing of vendor, intercompany, and tax payments — working closely with Procurement, Treasury, Tax, and the wider business to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Assistant Manager – Accounts Payable with 5 years of experience to take ownership of our AP operations across India, the UK, and the US. You'll manage the full AP cycle — from invoice processing through to payments and reconciliations — while ensuring compliance with GST, TDS, UK VAT, and US sales/use tax requirements. This is a process\-driven role for someone who combines strong technical AP knowledge with a passion for automation, accuracy, and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Payable operations including invoice processing, approvals, reconciliations, and vendor, intercompany, and tax payments across India, UK, and US entities.
* Ensure accurate accounting and tax compliance for all invoices, including GST, TDS, UK VAT, and US sales/use tax requirements.
* Complete payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and resolve supplier escalations, ensuring timely and accurate payments at all times.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close processes, AP reporting to internal and external stakeholders, and statutory and government reporting requirements.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, company policies, and regulatory standards.
* Drive process standardisation and automation using AP automation tools and AI\-enabled solutions for invoice processing, exception management, and analytics.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, Treasury, and business stakeholders to improve operational efficiency and vendor experience.
* Coordinate with Treasury to ensure timely domestic and international supplier payments; support cash flow forecasting, working capital management, payment reconciliation, and banking issue resolution.


**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**
* 5 \- 9 years of Accounts Payable experience, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.
* Strong knowledge of AP operations across India, the UK, and the US, including GST, TDS, UK VAT, and US sales/use tax compliance.
* Proficiency in ERP platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, Power Pivot, dashboards, and data analysis.
* A detail\-oriented, process\-driven mindset with a genuine commitment to accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.


**Nice to Have**
* CA, CA Inter, CMA, ACCA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience implementing AP automation tools or AI\-enabled invoice processing solutions.
* Exposure to cash flow forecasting and working capital management in a treasury context.


**What we offer**
* Health \& Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth \& Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. You will be expected to work closely with front office analysts to assess corporate credit quality and iterate on financial models in a timely manner. Additionally, you will be required to monitor companies under coverage for earnings and other material developments. Other ad hoc projects may include preparing relative value tables, compiling data, and similar analyses. Over time, these responsibilities will expand to include industry coverage and providing due diligent insights to the front office team.

 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* An MBA in Finance or an equivalent professional qualification (CFA/CA), together with at least 5 years of relevant investment research experience and excellent fundamental corporate credit analysis skills
* Demonstrated financial modeling and valuation skills
* Analytical prowess and keen attention to detail
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

* Exposure to high yield, stressed, and distressed credits
* Prior experience covering Industrials or Energy sector

title: CA Article Trainee and Paid up Assistant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bhatter Singhania \& Associates, founded in 2016, is a Chartered Accountancy firm focused on delivering reliable and personalized financial solutions. With its registered office in Kolkata and a branch in Varanasi, the firm serves clients across diverse sectors with strong professional standards and integrity. The team emphasizes building long\-term relationships based on trust and a thorough understanding of each client’s specific requirements. Bhatter Singhania \& Associates positions itself as a strategic partner in clients’ growth journeys, rather than just a service provider. Key service areas include accounting and financial reporting, income tax and GST advisory, ROC and corporate compliance, and international and NRI taxation.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kolkata for a CA Article Trainee and Paid up Assistant. The role involves assisting in accounting and financial reporting, preparing and reviewing working papers, and supporting statutory and tax audits under supervision. Responsibilities include drafting and filing income tax and GST returns, supporting ROC filings and corporate compliance documentation, and helping with basic research on tax and regulatory matters. The trainee and assistant will interact with clients for data collection and clarification, maintain organized records and workpapers, and contribute to the timely completion of assignments. The role also includes learning and applying professional standards, participating in internal training, and supporting senior team members in day\-to\-day firm operations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess a strong foundation in accounting and financial reporting, including familiarity with basic standards and ledger maintenance.
* Candidates should possess skills in direct and indirect taxation, including income tax computation, GST concepts, and basic knowledge of ROC and corporate compliance.
* Candidates should possess analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and refer to relevant tax and regulatory materials.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word), basic accounting software, and the ability to prepare clear working papers and documentation.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills, professional ethics, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
* CA Article Trainee: Should be registered or eligible to register for articleship under ICAI; Paid up Assistant: Commerce graduate or equivalent with a strong accounting background.
* Prior internship or experience in a CA firm, familiarity with Indian tax laws and compliance procedures, and willingness to learn and take responsibility are beneficial.

title: Executive - Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**FP\&A – Financial Planning \& Analysis**
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\- 2 years
   

  

**Function:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**About Smytten**
 Smytten is one of India’s leading product discovery and trial platforms, helping consumers discover products across Beauty, Personal Care, Food \& Beverage, Health \& Wellness, and other categories.
   

  

 As we continue to scale, we are looking for an
 **FP\&A professional** 
 who can go beyond numbers and help the business understand
 **what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next.**
**About The Role**
 As part of the FP\&A team, you will work closely with business and finance stakeholders to drive
 **financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance tracking, and business decision\-making** 
 .
   

  

 You will own key financial analyses, build meaningful business dashboards/models, identify trends and risks, and provide actionable insights to leadership.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role suited for someone who enjoys working with numbers but is equally comfortable understanding the
 **business behind the numbers.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**
* Support the annual budgeting and financial planning process.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly forecasts and track performance against budgets.
* Develop financial models to support business plans, growth initiatives, and strategic decisions.
* Identify key business drivers and assess their impact on revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.


**Business Performance Analysis**
* Prepare and present monthly business performance reports for leadership.
* Analyse actuals vs. budget vs. forecast and identify key variances.
* Deep dive into revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses, and other business KPIs.
* Translate financial data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.


**Business Partnering**
* Work closely with Business, Marketing, Category, Supply Chain, Retail, and other teams to understand financial performance.
* Partner with stakeholders to evaluate business proposals, investments, campaigns, and new initiatives.
* Support leadership with data\-backed recommendations for business decisions.
* Develop a strong understanding of Smytten's business model, revenue streams, cost structures, and unit economics.


**MIS \& Management Reporting**
* Build and maintain management dashboards and financial reports.
* Streamline recurring reports and improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.
* Establish and track relevant financial and business KPIs.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for monthly and quarterly reviews.


**Ad\-hoc Analysis**
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analysis for key business decisions.
* Evaluate ROI and profitability of new initiatives and investments.
* Support pricing, cost optimisation, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Take up strategic financial analysis and projects as required by the leadership team.


**What We're Looking For**
* 1\-2 years of experience in FP\&A, Financial Planning, Business Finance, Corporate Finance, or Management Reporting.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modelling.
* Excellent command of Advanced Excel; experience with financial modelling is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a sharp eye for detail.
* Ability to work with large datasets and convert them into meaningful insights.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial insights to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen and curiosity to understand the "why" behind the numbers.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Experience in a consumer, e\-commerce, D2C, FMCG, retail, or startup environment would be an advantage.


**Good to Have**
* Experience working with Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio or similar BI tools.
* Exposure to SQL or data analytics.
* Experience with ERP/accounting systems.
* CA / CFA / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience in consumer internet, D2C, e\-commerce, FMCG, or retail businesses.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, success means:
   

  

* Leadership has clear visibility into business performance and financial health.
* Budgets and forecasts are accurate, timely, and actionable.
* Variances are identified early, with clear reasons and corrective actions.
* Business teams use financial insights to make better decisions.
* Reporting becomes more automated, efficient, and insightful.
* FP\&A is seen as a business partner, not just a reporting function.


**Why Smytten?**
* Work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth consumer business.
* Get exposure to multiple functions and business verticals.
* Work closely with senior leadership and influence business decisions.
* Opportunity to build and own financial planning and business performance processes.
* Be part of a team that is shaping the next phase of Smytten's growth.
