title: Finance Manager
description:
Job Summary
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced and strategic Finance Manager to lead the organization's overall financial strategy, financial planning, capital allocation, taxation, treasury, and financial governance. The Finance Manager will play a key role in driving profitability, financial sustainability, business expansion, and strategic decision\-making.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in financial leadership, corporate finance, taxation, treasury management, fundraising, financial planning, and multi\-country financial transactions. The Finance Manager will oversee the finance and accounts function while serving as a trusted advisor to the Finance Manager and senior leadership team.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategic Financial Leadership
 



  





 \- Develop and execute the organization's financial strategy in alignment with business objectives.
 



 \- Act as a strategic financial advisor to the CEO and senior management on business and commercial decisions.
 



 \- Evaluate business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and expansion initiatives from a financial perspective.
 



 \- Drive sustainable growth, profitability, and financial performance.
 



  





 Capital Allocation \& Investment Management
 



  





 \- Oversee capital allocation and investment decisions to optimize financial returns.
 



 \- Evaluate major expenditures, investments, partnerships, and strategic business opportunities.
 



 \- Conduct financial analysis, valuation, and ROI assessment for key business initiatives.
 



 \- Support expansion and investment planning across domestic and international markets.
 



  





 Financial Planning \& Performance Management
 



  





 \- Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
 



 \- Monitor financial performance and establish financial KPIs across business functions.
 



 \- Drive profitability improvement, cost optimization, and financial efficiency initiatives.
 



 \- Prepare financial analysis, forecasts, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
 



  





 Treasury \& Cash Flow Management

 Ahmedabad (remote to start)

 3–8 years

 Full\-time

 We're a small, founder\-led group of related companies based in the USA. We're looking for an experienced accountant to take genuine ownership of the books across those entities — not just process transactions, but maintain a clean, defensible set of records that stands up to a CPA’s review and a tax filing.
 



 You will be the finance function. There is no one above you doing the work — we need someone who catches problems before we do and tells us about them.
 



 As entity count and transaction volume increase, so does the scope — including standardizing processes across companies and eventually building and overseeing a small team. We're hiring for the long term, not for a gap.

* Full\-cycle bookkeeping across multiple related entities — AP, AR, bank and credit\-card reconciliations

 recording transfers, maintaining due\-to / due\-from balances between entities, and keeping both sides reconciled and documented
* Bill pay execution through our approval workflow (you prepare and code; the founder approves and releases)
* Receivables tracking and follow\-up on ageing
* Month\-end close and financial statement preparation for each entity
* Flagging what looks wrong — mis\-codings, missing documentation, balances that don't tie — rather than just closing the month
* Coordinating with our US CPA at close and at year\-end
* Over time: writing SOPs, standardizing the chart of accounts across entities, and training junior support



**What We're Looking For** 




**Essential** 



* 3\+ years doing bookkeeping or accounting for
 **US\-based clients or entities** 
 — this is the primary requirement
* Hands\-on
 **QuickBooks Online** 
 experience (not just Tally)
* Working knowledge of
 **US GAAP** 
 and US small\-business accounting practice
* Experience with
 **multi\-entity or group structures** 
 — you've maintained intercompany balances before and can explain how
* CA, CA Inter (semi\-qualified), CMA, or B.Com/M.Com with equivalent practical experience —
 **we care more about your US client experience than your credential**
* Genuinely self\-directed; comfortable owning the close calendar without being chased
* Clear written English — most of our communication is asynchronous



**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience at a US\-focused accounting KPO or outsourcing firm
* Bill.com, Ramp, Gusto, or similar workflow tools
* Payroll experience
* US: 1099 preparation, sales tax nexus, S\-corp / partnership basics
* Familiarity with agency/marketing services, financial services, or real\-estate holding entities



**What's on Offer** 



* ₹7,00,000 – ₹10,00,000 PA, reviewed as scope grows
* Direct access to the founder — no layers, no bureaucracy
* Real growth path: this role expands into a senior finance position with team responsibility as the group grows
* Fully remote to start, then Hybrid from Ahmedabad



**How to Apply** 




 We receive a high volume of applications and want to spend our time on people who are actually a fit.
 **Instead of a cover letter, please answer both questions below.** 




**1\.** 
 You're handling the books for three related companies and notice a $12,000 expense was booked under the wrong company. Walk us through how you'd fix it, and what you'd put in place to prevent it from happening again.
 



**2\.** 
 Briefly describe one thing about US accounting practice that differs from Indian practice and that you had to learn on the job.
 



 3–5 sentences each is plenty.
 



 Email your answers with your CV to
 **Shawn@compoundventures.ai** 
 with the subject line
 **Accountant Application** 
 .
 



 Applications without answers to both questions, or without the subject line code, will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Economist
description:
**About the Role** 


 Brickwork Ratings is looking for a Senior Economist to lead its macroeconomic and financial research function. You will lead and mentor a team of economists and financial analysts, build econometric and credit\-risk models, author high\-impact research for investors, policymakers, and markets, and advise senior management and regulators. The role sits at the intersection of research, credit ratings, and regulatory engagement.
   





**Key Responsibilities**

 1\. Team Leadership
 
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of economists and financial analysts; set research priorities, assign and review deliverables, and manage timelines and quality.
* Build team capability in econometrics, statistical and machine\-learning modeling (R/Python), and research writing.



 2\. Research \& Modeling
 
* Conduct in\-depth macroeconomic and financial research across sectors and geographies, with a focus on implications for Indian credit markets.
* Develop and maintain econometric models for forecasting, scenario analysis, policy evaluation, and credit risk; continuously enhance model accuracy and efficiency using advanced statistical and machine\-learning techniques.
* Monitor global economic developments, monetary and fiscal policy, and market trends, translating them into actionable insights for ratings and research.



 3\. Publications \& Stakeholder Engagement
 
* Author high\-quality research reports, presentations, and briefing notes for internal and external audiences.
* Present findings with clarity and confidence to senior leadership, clients, rating committees, and external partners.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (ratings, structured finance, sales, and compliance) to support strategic initiatives and client engagements.



 4\. Regulatory, ESG \& Climate Risk
 
* Track and interpret credit\-rating regulations, RBI/SEBI guidelines, and related supervisory expectations; support senior management with research and analysis for day\-to\-day regulatory requirements.
* Analyse climate risk and ESG trends — drawing on frameworks such as TCFD and NGFS — and integrate them into economic, credit, and financial analysis.
* Stay current with global regulatory changes and evolving ESG standards, and assess their impact on BWR's research and rating methodologies.


**Qualifications \& Experience** 
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in analytical roles within the financial services industry — spanning macroeconomic research, econometrics, credit research, industry research, or financial research.
* Minimum 2 years of team leadership experience managing economists and financial analysts.
* Proven expertise in developing sectoral forecasting models, credit risk models, and authoring high\-quality research outputs.
* Working knowledge of R and/or Python for statistical modeling and data analysis (preferred).
* Advanced proficiency in the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).


**Other Competencies \& Skillsets** 
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels — from analysts to senior leadership, regulators, and clients.
* Prior exposure to rating agencies, think tanks, or financial institutions.
* Familiarity with climate risk frameworks (e.g., TCFD, NGFS) and ESG rating methodologies.
* Understanding of model risk management principles and governance requirements.



  




**About Brickwork Ratings** 


 Brickwork Ratings (BWR) is one of India's leading credit rating agencies, committed to providing the investment community with the products and services needed to make informed investment decisions. Established in 2007, BWR is a SEBI\-registered and RBI\-accredited credit rating agency, with Canara Bank — a leading public sector bank — as its promoter and strategic partner.
 




  






 BWR is headquartered in Bengaluru with a pan\-India presence. Its rating team is led by some of the industry's most experienced credit analysts, bankers, and regulators, while the Research team brings deep global expertise and a strong track record of delivering outstanding proprietary research, econometric models, and analytical frameworks that inform investors, policymakers, and markets.
 




  






 BWR offers rating services for bank loans, non\-convertible debentures (NCDs), commercial paper, bonds, mutual funds, PPMLDs, and security receipts, and has rated over 100,000 large corporates, banks, financial institutions, state and local governments, and small businesses. BWR provides investors and lenders with timely, in\-depth research across structured finance, public finance, financial institutions, project finance, and corporate sectors.

title: SAP FI Functional Architect - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position: SAP FI Functional Architect – Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **SAP FI Functional Architect** 
 to lead the design, solutioning, and delivery of SAP Finance solutions for large\-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs. The candidate will be responsible for defining the overall Finance solution architecture, driving business process design, managing integrations with upstream and downstream modules, and ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP Financial Accounting, SAP S/4HANA Finance, global finance processes, solution design, stakeholder management, and implementation governance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead SAP FI solution architecture for SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Design end\-to\-end Finance processes aligned to business requirements and SAP best practices.
* Define Finance target\-state architecture, including enterprise structure and financial reporting framework.
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis and recommend optimal SAP standard solutions.
* Drive SAP Activate methodology deliverables across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.


**SAP FI Functional Areas**
* General Ledger (GL)

* Accounts Receivable (AR)

* Bank Accounting and Cash Management
* Closing Cockpit and Financial Close Processes
* Tax Configuration
* Intercompany Accounting
* Document Splitting
* Parallel Accounting
* New GL / Universal Journal (ACDOCA)


**SAP S/4HANA Finance**
* Lead SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation initiatives.
* Design Universal Journal architecture.
* Define migration strategy from ECC FI to S/4HANA Finance.
* Support Finance simplification item assessment and readiness activities.
* Evaluate and recommend SAP best practices and innovations.


**Integration Management**
* Drive integration design with:
+ SAP CO
+ SAP MM
+ SAP SD
+ SAP Project Systems (PS)
+ SAP EPPM
+ SAP Treasury
+ SAP SuccessFactors Payroll
+ SAP Ariba
+ Third\-party banking and tax systems


**Data Migration \& Testing**
* Support Finance data migration strategy and execution.
* Define migration scope for master and transactional data.
* Lead data validation and reconciliation activities.
* Support SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Cutover activities.
* Ensure audit readiness and financial data integrity.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Work closely with CFO organization, Finance Controllers, Accounting teams, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops and design sessions.
* Present solution options and recommendations to leadership teams.
* Manage client escalations and issue resolution.


**Governance \& Delivery**
* Review functional specifications and development objects.
* Guide offshore delivery teams.
* Ensure compliance with project governance and quality standards.
* Support cutover planning, hypercare, and stabilization activities.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* SAP FI Configuration and Design
* General Ledger
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Asset Accounting
* Bank Accounting
* Tax Management
* Financial Closing \& Reporting
* Intercompany Accounting
* SAP S/4HANA Finance


**Technical \& Integration Knowledge**
* SAP Fiori Applications
* SAP BTP Integration Awareness
* SAP Central Finance (Preferred)
* SAP Group Reporting (Preferred)
* SAP Data Migration Cockpit
* SAP Integration Suite
* Understanding of ABAP Enhancements and Interfaces


**Business Knowledge**
* Financial Accounting
* Corporate Finance
* Management Reporting
* Compliance and Audit Requirements
* IFRS / US GAAP Knowledge
* Internal Controls and Financial Governance


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field.
* CA / CMA / CPA qualification is an added advantage.
* SAP FI/FIN certification preferred.
* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification preferred.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ Years hands\-on experience in SAP Finance (FI) with at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementation programs
* Experience in large\-scale global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Experience in Manufacturing, Aerospace, MRO, Oil \& Gas, Utilities, Retail, or Consumer Products industries.
* Experience leading global template design and rollout programs.
* Experience working with multinational clients and distributed teams.
* Exposure to SAP RISE and Cloud transformation programs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Zen Tax Clinic is a specialized online platform focused on comprehensive GST litigation solutions in India. As the country’s first exclusive online service for GST\-related disputes, the clinic supports clients through every stage of litigation.  The Expert – GST role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The Expert – GST will draft representations, appeals, and other documentation, while staying updated on GST laws, rules, notifications, and relevant case law. The role includes coordinating with clients to gather information, advising on litigation strategy, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate case handling. The Expert – GST is expected to maintain high professional standards, adhere to compliance requirements, and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes and resources.

* Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, procedures, and recent amendments, with practical experience in GST litigation and dispute resolution.

* Integrity, professional ethics, and willingness to stay updated through continuous learning in indirect tax and GST jurisprudence.

title: Key Accounts Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Account Manager Department: Sales & Business Development
 Position: Key Account Manager - HORECA
 Location: Mira Road (Mumbai) 
 Reporting To: Head B2B Sales / Business Head
 Experience: 2 - 5 years
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Account Manager HORECA to manage and grow our B2B customer portfolio for our fresh cold-pressed juice business. 
 The role will be responsible for developing strong relationships with B2B customers, driving repeat sales, managing orders and deliveries, ensuring timely collections, resolving customer issues, and identifying opportunities to increase business from existing and new accounts. The ideal candidate should understand the requirements of fresh/FMCG products , have strong commercial and relationship-management skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, operationally intensive environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. B2B Account Management Manage a portfolio of B2B customers and act as the primary point of contact. Build strong, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers. Understand customer requirements, consumption patterns, pricing expectations, and business needs. Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct regular account reviews and identify opportunities for business expansion. 
 2. Sales & Business Development Achieve monthly and quarterly B2B sales targets. Generate new business from potential B2B customers. Develop accounts across segments such as: Hotels, Restaurants & Cafs (HoReCa) Corporate offices Gyms and fitness centres Hospitals and healthcare institutions Schools, colleges and institutions Cloud kitchens and caterers Modern trade and retail chains Corporate gifting and wellness programs Distributors and resellers Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and close orders. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio. 
 3. Order & Delivery Coordination Coordinate with the production, dispatch and logistics teams to ensure timely fulfilment of customer orders. Monitor daily/weekly order requirements and communicate customer forecasts to the production team. Ensure correct SKU, quantity, pricing and delivery schedules. Proactively communicate any supply or delivery issues to customers. Monitor product returns, damages, shortages and delivery discrepancies. 
 4. Fresh Product & Inventory Coordination Understand the operational challenges associated with fresh cold-pressed juices, including limited shelf life, production planning and demand fluctuations. Work closely with production and planning teams to minimize product wastage. Track customer-wise demand and consumption trends. Support demand forecasting and advance order planning. Coordinate with the team to optimize production against confirmed and forecasted B2B demand. 
 5. Collections & Commercial Management Monitor customer outstanding balances and ensure timely collections. Follow up on overdue invoices and credit-limit issues. Maintain accurate customer-wise payment and outstanding records. Coordinate with the accounts team regarding invoices, credit notes, debit notes and payment reconciliation. Ensure adherence to approved customer credit terms. 
 6. Customer Service & Issue Resolution Handle customer queries and complaints promptly. Coordinate internally to resolve issues related to product quality, delivery, packaging, billing or service. Track complaints until closure and maintain proper documentation. Gather customer feedback and communicate actionable insights to management and the quality/production teams. 
 7. Reporting & MIS Maintain updated customer and sales records. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly B2B sales reports. Track: Customer-wise sales SKU-wise sales Order frequency Average order value Customer retention Outstanding payments New customer acquisition Customer complaints and returns Sales target vs. achievement Provide management with regular updates on account performance and market opportunities. 
 Education: Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related field. MBA/PGDM in Sales/Marketing is an advantage. Experience: 25 years of experience in B2B sales/account management. Experience in FMCG, food & beverage, beverages, fresh food, dairy, hospitality supply or related industries is preferred. Candidates with experience managing institutional/HoReCa accounts will be preferred. Required Skills Strong B2B sales and account-management skills. Excellent communication and negotiation abilities. Strong customer relationship management. Good commercial and numerical understanding. Ability to manage multiple customers simultaneously. Strong follow-up and collection skills. Good Excel/MIS reporting skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with production, logistics, quality and accounts teams. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Target-oriented and self-motivated approach. Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required. Preferred Knowledge The candidate should have a basic understanding of: Fresh/cold-pressed juice products FMCG distribution and B2B sales Shelf-life and freshness considerations Food-service/HoReCa operations Pricing, margins and trade discounts Credit terms and collections Demand forecasting Order fulfilment and logistics Basic food-quality and customer-service requirements Personal Attributes Customer-centric mindset High ownership and accountability Strong interpersonal skills Energetic and proactive Commercially aware Detail-oriented Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup/growth environment Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams Compensation Salary: [XX,XXX – XX,XXX] per month / CTC [X – X] LPA Incentives: Performance-linked incentives based on sales achievement, collections, new customer acquisition and account growth. Career Growth The successful candidate can progress into roles such as: Account Manager Senior Account Manager B2B Sales Manager Head – B2B Sales / Key Accounts Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who can win new B2B customers, build lasting relationships, grow existing accounts, ensure timely collections, and coordinate internally to deliver a consistently excellent customer experience while understanding the unique challenges of selling and distributing fresh products.

Key Skills: Client Servicing,Account Management,Financial Management,Client Success,Upsell,Customer Relationship,Customer Support,Customer Service

title: Application Developement Sr Analyst
description:
Role Purpose The Application Development Senior Analyst designs, builds, tests and supports secure, reliable digital solutions that meet business and customer needs. Working within an Agile delivery team, the role provides hands-on development expertise, takes ownership of moderately complex work, contributes to technical decisions and helps improve engineering quality, delivery flow and operational resilience.
 Key Responsibilities Analyse user stories and technical requirements, identify dependencies and translate them into maintainable solution designs. Develop, configure, test and document application features using approved engineering standards, patterns and platforms. Own assigned work from refinement through deployment and early-life support, providing clear progress, risk and dependency updates. Produce clean, reusable and secure code or configuration, with appropriate unit tests and evidence of quality. Participate actively in peer reviews and respond constructively to feedback; support less-experienced developers through knowledge sharing and practical guidance. Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Quality Engineering, Architecture, Security, Platform and Production Support colleagues. Use source control and CI/CD practices effectively, supporting automated quality gates and reliable, traceable releases. Troubleshoot defects and production issues using logs, monitoring and diagnostic tools; contribute to root-cause analysis and preventive actions. Create and maintain concise technical documentation, including solution notes, support guidance and operational runbooks. Contribute to sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives, and act on agreed continuous-improvement actions. Protect customer and company data by following privacy, security, access-control and change-management requirements. Keep skills current and apply relevant new capabilities where they improve quality, efficiency, reliability or customer outcomes.
 Required Experience and Capabilities Practical experience delivering application development or configuration within an enterprise environment. Strong hands-on capability in the core technologies required by the requisition, with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently. Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, testing, debugging, version control and secure coding. Experience working in Agile teams and managing work through tools such as Jira and Confluence or equivalent. Experience with code review, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Sound judgement, attention to detail, ownership and a continuous-learning mindset. Ability to balance delivery pace with quality, security, maintainability and operational support needs.
 Role-Specific Technical Skills The requisition should identify the mandatory stack. For a Salesforce / OmniStudio vacancy, the following are relevant: Salesforce platform development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and platform security concepts. OmniStudio capabilities such as OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors and Integration Procedures. Integration patterns and APIs, including REST/SOAP services, authentication and error handling. Salesforce deployment and release practices, preferably using Git-based source control and Copado or a comparable CI/CD tool. Automated and unit testing, static analysis and code-quality controls. Application monitoring and log analysis using relevant observability tools.
 Nice to Have Relevant platform certification or equivalent demonstrable experience. Experience in healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry. Experience with SAFe or delivery across multiple dependent teams. Awareness of accessibility, performance engineering and resilient integration design. Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools to support activities such as code generation, refactoring, unit-test creation, documentation, debugging or code explanation, while applying human review, secure-coding practices and data-handling controls. Experience using approved generative AI tools in day-to-day work to summarise information, improve written communication, prepare meeting outputs, explore options or streamline repeatable tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs. An interest in evaluating AI use cases based on measurable value, quality, risk and responsible-use considerations.
 What Good Performance Looks Like Delivery: Completes agreed work predictably, surfaces risks early and follows through to a stable outcome. Engineering quality: Produces maintainable, tested and secure solutions that meet agreed standards. Ownership: Handles moderately complex work with limited oversight and takes responsibility for follow-up. Collaboration: Works constructively across disciplines, contributes to reviews and shares knowledge. Improvement: Identifies practical ways to reduce rework, strengthen controls and improve team effectiveness. Responsible AI use: Uses AI as an assistive tool where permitted, validates outputs and never substitutes generated content for engineering accountability.
 Education and Professional Development Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Commitment to ongoing technical learning, including platform, security, cloud, automation and responsible AI capabilities relevant to the role. title: Finance Partner - NVB Campus
description:
Be part of something bigger! 
As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy. As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world! I. Purpose of the Role This position will focus on timely and accurate calculation and reporting of financial result of NVB (NV Bekaert) Campus in Belgium to have accurate reflection of campus costs. The candidate will also support financial reporting for the Sales / Trading entities in EMEA. The Candidate must be a team player and self-starter too as the position needs working in cross functional teams to resolve issues having impact on multiple functions. The Candidate should also be able to handle the Projects its management independently, while maintaining Confidentiality of the Project wherever required. II. Roles and Responsibilities Monthly Closing Reporting 
- Drive monthly activities, perform necessary analysis, checks and provide insights on Campus Costs.
- Ensures the timely execution of reports with data integrity in collaboration with Campus Management team and understand the build-up of the figures and be ready to concisely reply on questions; drive corrective actions when needed.
- Timely reporting of accurate campus result, including comment letter. All follow up reports are updated in time, in good quality and reported to campus management.
- Support the Campus Management by providing financial metrics reports on critical topics Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
- Analyze all variances related to campus cost centers and reports to management.
- Support team in transforming reporting requirements on new reporting platform.
- Ad hoc financial analysis.
- Preparation of Management reports, checking of upload in consolidation tool.
- Purchase Price Variance (PPV) analysis provisioning.
- Material Price update in System.
- Calculating updating tariffs. 
- Execution of assessment cycles for cost recharge.
- Transfer Price - calculation, review, update.
- Reports - Sales reports, Inventory reports., etc. Budgeting Forecasting - Drive annual planning cycles (X+1) for Campus (cost centers), Trading businesses. - Prepare annual budget for the different campus cost centers and calculate the new rates for utilities, waste, maintenance hours.
- Maintains the master data and allocation rules to reflect correct campus costs in the budget of the plant.
- Co-ordinate with various departments for Budget data gathering and preparation.
- Presents the annual campus budget to campus management. Campus Cost Analysis Allocation - Coordinates and monitors the timely cost bookings. 
- Collect, analyze, and report on ad hoc questions about costs, and allocations.
- Monitors the different allocation keys to make sure all campus related costs are allocated to the plant by using the correct driver.
- Safeguard the accuracy of the costs booked on the campus cost centers and set up accruals if needed. 
- Check and define in cooperation with Procurement team on a monthly basis, the new prices for utilities. Adjust the master data accordingly so correct utility costs are allocated to the production plants.
- Make sure the actual rates for utilities and waste are reflected in the allocations towards the production plants.
- Partnering with local plant management to answer to ad hoc questions. Internal Control Compliance - Monitor the financial procedures to ensure that systems and internal controls within the plant meet the needs of management and ensure that financial activities comply with applicable group rules.
- Supporting in various internal / external audits. III. Skills Competencies Educational Qualifications:

title: Financial Controller
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Title: Finance Controller Location: Gurgaon, India Job type: Full time Reports To: Country Head Role Overview This is a key role in driving the future success of the Trek brand in India. As Finance Controller, you will lead the finance function end-to-end, building a high-performance culture that does the basics brilliantly while adding real value to your business partners through expense management, compelling storytelling, and data-led commercial decision-making. Beyond this core finance mandate, we are looking for someone excited to stretch into a broader leadership opportunity. This is a chance to build cross-functional leadership experience as you help scale and strengthen Trek India's Shared Services organization, with a clear path to take on full leadership of this function in the future. Objectives of the role Help ensure financial reporting is accurate and stays compliant with accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies. Maintain strong internal controls and sound risk management practices. Bring insightful analysis on margins, profitability, working capital, and overall business performance. Support leadership with the insights they need to make informed decisions. Lead the budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning process. Keep track of performance against plans and help drive accountability for results. Oversee statutory audits, internal audits, and regulatory compliance. Help ensure audit observations are closed out on time, with corrective actions followed through. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting, Transaction Processing & Control Governance Own the monthly close process, reporting to Group under US GAAP within 3 days of month-end. All balance sheet accounts reconciled and clean. All income statement accounts analyzed and explained. Present monthly results and financial & non-financial KPIs to the US Headquarters. Lead the finance department. Oversee credit control, working to minimize past dues and DSO. Build and maintain a strong internal control environment. 2. Compliance, Taxations & Audit Stay on top of local financial and regulatory compliance, keeping a close eye on the environment to ensure we remain compliant. Maintain strong internal controls, including safeguarding of assets and compliance with external regulations and internal policies/delegation of authority. Own direct and indirect tax reporting and compliance, ensuring payments are accurate and on time. Serve as the key point of contact for internal audits, building close, cooperative working relationships. 3. Working Capital and Cash flow management Oversee dealer/customer credit management processes. Work to minimize overdue receivables and improve Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). Monitor customer risk exposure and recommend corrective actions where needed. Support effective cash flow planning and liquidity management. Partner with customers and stakeholders to establish practices that support sustainable growth and healthy cash flow. 4. Commercial Finance & Business Partnering Own the budgeting and monthly reforecasting process, delivering high accuracy with fully explained results and on-time deadlines. Analyze sales and gross margin, identifying opportunities for improvement. Monitor and build awareness of expenses, leading efforts to manage these down when needed. Support the India Country Manager in shaping strategy and long-range business plans. Provide routine and ad-hoc analysis to support sales and management. Partner closely with all departments to deliver financial support and informed decision-making. As part of the global senior finance group, liaise with functional leaders at US Headquarters. Work with customers to establish best-practice benchmarks and help them manage cash flow and grow profitably. Lead projects and ad-hoc initiatives as needed. 5. Shared Service Business Play a role in shaping and executing Trek India Shared Services strategy, in line with business objectives and global priorities. Support Trek Indias Shared Services Business / Teams to help deliver high-quality, cost-effective, customer-centric services across supported functions to global Trek subsidiaries & businesses Help set and track service delivery standards, SLAs, KPIs, and customer satisfaction metrics. Support compliance with the Income Tax Act, particularly Transfer Pricing provisions. Required Skills and Qualifications – 12-14 years of overall experience, including 5+ years in a direct leadership capacity within an accounting, auditing, or finance function. Bachelor's degree in Accounting; CA, CWA, or CPA qualification. Advanced spreadsheet skills able to turn large amounts of data into simple, workable processes with built-in sense checks. Familiarity with JD Edwards or similar ERP systems, with a proven ability to learn new systems quickly. Brings a flexible, positive attitude and energy to the team. Strong financial qualifications and demonstrable knowledge of the regulatory environment in India. Comfortable diving into the details to solve complex issues, while still seeing the bigger picture. Able to provide clear, fact-based analysis to support a recommended course of action. A natural leader and team player who holds the team to high standards. Combines empathy with assertiveness and strong influencing skills. Excellent attention to detail; tenacious and methodical. Committed to continuous improvement - always looking for a better way of doing things. Why Trek? title: Manager-Revenue Accountant
description:
We are seeking an analytically driven Manager, Revenue Operations & Process Excellence to oversee and optimize global revenue accounting, billing, accounts receivable, and finance processes. This senior individual contributor role focuses on advanced process management, data analytics, systems, reporting, and operational excellence rather than people management. The ideal candidate will have strong accounting and analytical experience, preferably gained within a multinational organization and with direct exposure to accounting and financial operations outside India. The role requires strong understanding of revenue operations, billing processes, reconciliations, financial reporting, ERP data flows, and process improvement within a U.S.-backed or global services environment. 
 Key Responsibilities Strategic Process Management & Architecture Own, design, and continuously optimize the end-to-end global revenue accounting, billing, and accounts receivable operational framework. Architect and implement scalable standard operating procedures (SOPs) and robust internal controls for revenue workflows, reducing systemic leakage and billing exceptions. Lead transformation initiatives to automate recurring billing schedules, revenue recognition protocols, and complex data flows between CRM, ERP (NetSuite), and billing platforms. 
 Advanced Analytics & Revenue Reporting Build and maintain sophisticated analytical models, dashboards, and KPI scorecards tracking revenue trends, DSO, aging cohorts, leakage points, and cash flow forecasts. • Conduct deep-dive root-cause analyses on complex billing discrepancies, revenue variances, and deferred revenue movements, presenting strategic insights to U.S. leadership. • Oversee high-level monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue-related account reconciliations and variance analyses. 
 Compliance, Controls & Technical Accounting Support compliance with applicable revenue recognition and accounting standards, including an understanding of ASC 606. Detailed or deep ASC 606 expertise is not required; familiarity with the standard and willingness to learn and apply it in day-to-day revenue operations is recommended. Partner closely with the U.S. finance and accounting teams during month-end/year-end close processes, audit requests, and technical accounting memoranda drafting. • Ensure absolute data integrity and governance across interconnected financial systems (NetSuite, Salesforce/CRM, automated billing layers). 
 Required Qualifications Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field. A Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Data Analytics is preferred. Experience: 5–7 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance, revenue operations, financial process management, revenue accounting, billing, or accounts receivable. Must have experience working with a multinational organization and handling accounting or financial operations for businesses/entities outside India. • Technical Expertise: Strong experience with enterprise ERP systems (NetSuite highly preferred), financial systems, billing environments, and data flows. Experience working with multiple financial systems and process automation is a strong advantage. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and data-management capabilities with advanced Excel experience, including complex formulas, lookups, PivotTables, Power Query, data analysis, and financial reporting. Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI is a plus. Accounting Knowledge: Strong understanding of accounting principles and U.S. GAAP. Working familiarity with ASC 606 revenue recognition is recommended, but deep expertise is not required. Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial data, identify issues, communicate insights, and work effectively with U.S. and international finance teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications • Professional certification (CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced qualification). • Direct operational exposure to professional services, SaaS, TPA, financial services, or complex contract-based billing environments is preferred. • Demonstrated portfolio of process automation or digital transformation projects within a finance operations function.

title: Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant \& Tax Specialist (India)
 



 We are looking for a Senior Accountant \& Tax Specialist (India) will be responsible for managing the full spectrum of accounting, statutory compliance, direct and indirect taxation, financial reporting, and financial controls for a US based Oil \& Gas company company’s India entity.
 



  





 The role will work closely with senior management and key internal and external stakeholders, providing timely financial information, technical guidance, and strategic support. The position requires exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills to ensure effective coordination with the Dubai headquarters, global finance teams, auditors, tax consultants, banks, government authorities, and other business partners.
 



 The role will ensure accurate accounting, timely statutory filings, compliance with Indian regulatory requirements, and alignment of India’s financial processes with Company’s policies and reporting standards.
 



  





 Reporting Status
 



 This position reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





 Supervisor Responsibility
 


* This position will not initially have direct reports. However, the role may be required to guide and coordinate with external consultants, service providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Position Responsibilities \& Accountabilities: Accounting \& Financial Operations
* Manage the day\-to\-day accounting and financial operations of the India entity in accordance with Indian GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Lead the month\-end and year\-end closing processes, including general ledger review, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Ensure the accurate and timely posting of journals, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and adjustments.
* Manage accounts receivable and accounts payable and follow up with customers and vendors as required.
* Review financial transactions and reports to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company policies.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, HR, Operations, and global finance teams to ensure seamless financial operations.
* Monitor and reconcile intercompany transactions and ensure timely settlement.
* Oversee employee expense claims, reimbursements, and petty cash.
* Provide financial guidance and support to management for operational and commercial decisions.
* Ensure strict confidentiality and security of financial records.



  





 Taxation \& Regulatory Compliance
 



 Manage and oversee all  statutory and  tax compliance requirements, including:
 


* GST registrations, monthly and quarterly returns, reconciliations, audits, and refund claims.
* TDS deductions, payments, returns, and Form 26AS reconciliations.
* Corporate income tax, advance tax, tax audit support, assessments, and responses to notices.
* PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Companies Act and ROC filings, including annual returns, in coordination with the Company Secretary.
* Liaise with external tax consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities to ensure accurate and timely statutory filings.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar and ensure all submissions are completed within prescribed deadlines.
* Support transfer\-pricing documentation and intercompany compliance requirements.
* Monitor changes in Indian tax and regulatory requirements and advise management on their potential impact.
* Represent or support the company during tax assessments, audits, and regulatory queries.



  





 Audit, Controls \& Risk Management
 


* Coordinate internal audits, statutory audits, tax audits, and group audits.
* Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation and respond to auditor queries.
* Work closely with auditors, consultants, and senior management to ensure the timely completion of audits.
* Implement and maintain effective internal controls and SOX\-aligned practices, where applicable.
* Identify financial and compliance risks and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Maintain the fixed assets register and depreciation schedules and ensure timely capitalization and disposal recording.



  





 Financial Planning, Reporting \& Analysis
 



  




* Prepare monthly MIS packs, including financial statements, variance reports, cost analyses, forecasts, and management commentary.
* Present financial information, key risks, and performance insights to the CFO and senior management.
* Support annual budget preparation, forecasting, and mid\-year reviews for the India entity.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Description – Manager (Accounts Payable \& Receivable)** 




**Department:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
 



**Designation:** 
 Manager – Accounts Payable \& Receivable (AP \& AR)
 



**Experience:** 
 4–10 Years
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Finance / Financial Controller
 



**Location:** 
 Corporate Office
 



**Job Purpose** 




 To lead and manage the end\-to\-end
 **Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable functions** 
 , ensuring accurate and timely accounting of sales, collections, vendor invoices, payments, reconciliations, statutory compliance, financial closing, and management reporting.
 



 The role will be responsible for strengthening financial controls, optimizing working capital, minimizing revenue and cost leakage, improving reconciliation and settlement processes, and driving automation across AP and AR operations for all retail and business channels.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Accounts Receivable \& Sales Accounting** 



* Lead the Accounts Receivable function across retail stores and other business channels.
* Ensure accurate accounting of retail sales through POS and ERP integration.
* Review daily sales accounting, customer receipts, credit notes, debit notes, returns, exchanges, and promotional adjustments.
* Ensure timely closure of daily sales and revenue accounting.
* Monitor customer, franchise, and institutional receivables.
* Review receivable ageing and drive timely recovery of overdue balances.
* Monitor revenue leakage and implement corrective actions.



**2\. Accounts Payable \& Invoice Processing** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end AP function covering OPEX, CAPEX, commercial transactions, and other business expenditures.
* Ensure timely verification, accounting, and processing of vendor invoices in SAP/ERP.
* Validate PO, GRN, contracts, rate approvals, and supporting documents before invoice booking.
* Review non\-PO invoices and ensure approvals as per DOA.
* Ensure appropriate GL mapping, cost centre allocation, and expense classification.
* Monitor vendor advances, security deposits, recoveries, and adjustments.



**3\. Collection, Settlement \& Payment Management** 



* Monitor collections across Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, UPI, QR Code, Digital Wallets, Payment Gateways, E\-commerce Marketplaces, and other payment modes.
* Ensure timely settlement and reconciliation of collections from banks and payment partners.
* Prepare and review vendor payment proposals based on agreed credit terms and cash\-flow priorities.
* Ensure timely vendor payments while optimizing working capital.
* Monitor urgent payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals.
* Oversee employee reimbursements, travel expenses, and petty cash settlements.
* Resolve long\-pending collection, settlement, and payment issues.



**4\. Bank, Vendor \& Payment Gateway Reconciliation** 



* Ensure timely reconciliation of bank accounts, payment gateways, card acquirers, wallet providers, UPI collections, and marketplace settlements.
* Review periodic vendor ledger reconciliations.
* Ensure timely resolution of unmatched invoices, debit notes, credit notes, deductions, and ageing balances.
* Identify and resolve duplicate invoices, duplicate payments, and unreconciled transactions.
* Coordinate with banks, payment partners, vendors, and internal teams to resolve discrepancies.



**5\. Commercial \& Vendor Accounting** 



* Manage accounting for vendor rebates, trade discounts, incentive schemes, marketing support, logistics charges, warehousing costs, rent, utilities, and other commercial expenses.
* Review commercial agreements and ensure accurate accounting and settlement.
* Resolve vendor disputes relating to invoices, deductions, claims, and payment settlements.
* Ensure appropriate accounting of vendor recoveries, provisions, and adjustments.



**6\. Financial Closing \& Accounting** 



* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual AP \& AR closing activities.
* Ensure timely accounting and review of:
* Accruals
* Provisions
* Prepaid expenses
* Revenue adjustments
* Bad debts
* Write\-offs
* Capitalization entries
* Vendor/customer reconciliations
* Review outstanding liabilities and receivable ageing.
* Ensure timely reversal of provisions and reconciliation of suspense accounts.
* Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.



**7\. Statutory Compliance \& Internal Controls** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable:
* GST requirements
* TDS provisions and return requirements
* MSME payment provisions
* Companies Act requirements
* Ind AS / Accounting Standards
* Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
* Company SOPs and Delegation of Authority (DOA)
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for financial transactions.
* Coordinate with Taxation, Internal Audit, Statutory Auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Support statutory, internal, GST, tax, and forensic audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and control deficiencies.



**8\. MIS, Reporting \& Financial Analysis** 




 Prepare, review, and present:
 


* Daily Collection MIS
* Store\-wise Collection Reports
* Sales \& Collection Dashboards
* Receivable Ageing Reports
* Vendor Ageing Reports
* Outstanding Liability Reports
* Payment Due Reports
* Bank Reconciliation Status
* Payment Gateway Reconciliation Reports
* Vendor Reconciliation Reports
* Revenue Variance Analysis
* Expense Analysis
* Budget vs Actual Expenditure
* Provision \& Accrual Reports
* Working Capital Reports
* Collection Efficiency Reports
* Cash Flow Forecasts
* Commercial Settlement Reports
* Exception and KPI Reports



 Provide actionable insights to senior management for improving collection efficiency, cost control, working capital, and financial performance.
 



**9\. Process Improvement \& Automation** 



* Drive automation of AP and AR processes through
 **SAP S/4HANA and related finance systems** 
 .
* Improve reconciliation efficiency through ERP integration, workflow automation, OCR, dashboards, and digital payment integrations.
* Develop and implement SOPs for AP, AR, reconciliation, collection, and payment processes.
* Reduce manual interventions and improve transaction turnaround time.
* Strengthen controls to prevent revenue leakage, duplicate accounting, duplicate payments, and financial fraud.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization and continuous improvement.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives across finance operations.



**10\. Stakeholder Management** 




 Work closely with:
 


* Retail Operations
* Procurement \& Sourcing
* Commercial \& Merchandising
* Supply Chain \& Logistics
* Treasury
* Taxation
* Business Finance
* IT \& ERP Teams
* Banking Partners
* Payment Gateway Providers
* Vendors and Customers
* Internal Audit
* Statutory Auditors
* Senior Management



 Ensure timely resolution of cross\-functional issues impacting collections, payments, accounting, and financial closure.
 



**11\. Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the AP \& AR team.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor productivity and SLA adherence.
* Establish team KPIs and performance standards.
* Review team performance and identify training and development requirements.
* Promote a culture of accuracy, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adequate segregation of duties and effective team\-level controls.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Timely AP \& AR month\-end closure
* Collection and settlement efficiency
* Reduction in receivable ageing and overdue balances
* Vendor payment cycle adherence
* Reduction in unreconciled bank/payment gateway items
* Vendor/customer reconciliation accuracy
* Reduction in duplicate invoices/payments
* Invoice processing turnaround time
* Reduction in revenue and cost leakage
* Compliance and audit observation closure
* Working capital improvement
* Automation and process improvement initiatives
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reporting



**Candidate Profile** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate in
 **Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline** 
 .
* CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance qualification will be an added advantage.
* **4–10 years of relevant experience** 
 in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Operations, or General Accounting.
* Strong experience in both
 **P2P (Procure\-to\-Pay) and O2C (Order\-to\-Cash)** 
 processes preferred.
* Experience in
 **retail, e\-commerce, FMCG, consumer goods, or multi\-location businesses** 
 will be preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of
 **SAP S/4HANA or other ERP systems** 
 .
* Good understanding of GST, TDS, MSME provisions, reconciliations, financial closing, and internal controls.
* Strong Excel and MIS/reporting skills.
* Experience in managing teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and process\-management skills.

title: R&D Finance
description:
1\. Purpose of the Job
 



 To provide
 **financial planning, analysis, budgeting and commercial support to the Research \& Development (R\&D) function** 
 , ensuring effective control and utilization of R\&D expenditure and providing management with meaningful financial insights for R\&D projects, product development and commercialization decisions.
 



 The role will partner closely with R\&D and F\&D leadership to evaluate project economics, monitor development costs, identify cost optimization opportunities and ensure adherence to approved budgets and financial controls.
 



  





 2\. Principal Accountabilities
 



  





 Lead a 2\-member Accounting team in performing the below tasks:
 



 A. R\&D Budgeting \& Planning
 


* Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process for R\&D and F\&D functions.
* Prepare detailed budgets for R\&D projects, trials, development activities, manpower, materials, equipment and external services.
* Develop project\-wise and department\-wise cost estimates.
* Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets and identify variances.
* Analyze actual vs standard yield, perform root cause analysis and come up with mitigation plan in consultation with R\&D scientists
* 
* Support preparation of annual operating plans and long\-term financial plans for R\&D.



 B. R\&D Project Costing
 


* Develop financial models and detailed costing for new product development projects.
* Evaluate development costs from laboratory trials through scale\-up, registration and commercialization.
* Track project\-wise expenditure and committed costs.
* Analyze cost per development project/product and identify cost drivers.
* Provide financial inputs for prioritization of R\&D projects.



 C. R\&D Financial Analysis \& Business Partnering
 


* Act as a
 **finance business partner to R\&D/F\&D leadership** 
 .
* Provide financial insights to support R\&D investment and resource allocation decisions.
* Evaluate project economics, expected investment, cost\-to\-develop and potential commercial benefits.
* Prepare financial scenarios for management decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities for improving R\&D cost efficiency and return on investment.



 D. Cost Control \& Optimization
 


* Monitor R\&D expenditure and ensure effective utilization of approved budgets.
* Identify cost overruns and develop corrective action plans with R\&D stakeholders.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives across raw materials, development batches, analytical activities, external testing, consultants and other R\&D expenses.
* Analyze major cost drivers and recommend opportunities for savings.
* Establish appropriate cost benchmarks for R\&D activities.



 E. Capex \& Asset Management
 


* Support R\&D teams in preparation and evaluation of
 **Capex proposals** 
 for laboratories, equipment and infrastructure.
* Evaluate business justification and financial viability of major R\&D investments.
* Monitor Capex utilization against approved budgets.
* Track project timelines, capitalization and asset utilization.
* Support ROI analysis for major R\&D capital investments.



 F. R\&D Procurement \& Commercial Support
 


* Partner with SCM and Procurement for R\&D\-related sourcing and cost optimization.
* Review commercial proposals from suppliers and service providers from a financial perspectiveC



  




* Customer agreement to be finalised once quotes are approved. Finalisation of payment terms based on milestones agreed with Customers. Getting Senior management approval for the agreement.
* Clinical Trial Projects \- Project base Clinical Trial Agreement verification and approval of Draft \+ Actual CTA of Sites (Hospitals) with its decision note as compared to budget. Site Invoice verification on receipt to be done as per agreed rates in CTA.
* Pre\-clinical Clients \- Approval of quotation and agreements: Analyze raw material, laboratory consumable, analytical service and external testing costs.
* Support negotiation strategies through cost analysis and benchmarking.
* Monitor purchase commitments and outstanding liabilities related to R\&D.



 G. Management Reporting \& MIS
 


* Prepare monthly R\&D financial MIS for senior management.
* Provide reports covering:
* Budget vs. Actual
* Project\-wise expenditure
* Cost per product/project
* Capex utilization
* Cost savings
* Forecast expenditure
* Open commitments
* Key financial variances
* Present financial performance and key insights to R\&D and Finance leadership.
* Develop dashboards for monitoring R\&D financial performance.



 H. Forecasting
 


* Prepare monthly/quarterly forecasts for R\&D expenditure.
* Review project timelines and their financial impact.
* Update forecasts based on changes in development plans, project priorities and resource requirements.
* Identify potential future cost overruns and highlight them proactively to management.



 I. Financial Controls \& Compliance
 


* Ensure R\&D expenses are incurred within approved budgets and authorization limits.
* Strengthen financial controls over R\&D procurement, projects and expenditure.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment and documentation for R\&D expenses.
* Coordinate with Internal Audit, Statutory Audit and Corporate Finance during R\&D\-related reviews.
* Ensure compliance with Company finance policies, approval matrices and applicable accounting standards.



 J. R\&D Portfolio Analysis
 


* Support management in evaluating the financial attractiveness of the R\&D portfolio.
* Analyze investment requirements and potential commercial outcomes for major projects.
* Develop project\-level financial models covering development investment, timelines and expected returns.
* Provide financial inputs for
 **Go / No\-Go** 
 decisions on selected projects.
* Support prioritization of R\&D projects based on financial and strategic considerations.



 K. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Work closely with R\&D, F\&D, QA, QC, RA, SCM, Procurement, Manufacturing and Commercial teams.
* Translate technical/project information into meaningful financial analysis.
* Establish strong financial awareness within R\&D teams.
* Support R\&D leadership in understanding budget implications and financial trade\-offs.



  





 3\. Essential Skills \& Competencies
 



 Functional
 


* Strong understanding of
 **financial planning, budgeting and cost control** 
 .
* Experience in project costing and financial modelling.
* Strong management reporting and MIS skills.
* Understanding of Capex evaluation and asset management.
* Strong analytical and variance\-analysis skills.
* Experience in cost optimization and commercial analysis.
* Knowledge of ERP/SAP and advanced MS Excel.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical R\&D/F\&D processes will be preferred.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development economics will be an advantage.



 Behavioral
 


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Business\-oriented mindset.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with technical and non\-finance teams.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to challenge assumptions with data and logic.
* Proactive approach and strong ownership.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Strong commercial acumen.



  





 4\. Qualification \& Experience
 



**Qualification:** 
 CA / CMA / MBA Finance /equivalent qualification.
 



**Experience:** 
 12\-15 years of relevant experience in
 **Finance / FP\&A / Business Finance / Project Finance** 
 , preferably within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, chemicals or manufacturing industry.
 



 Experience in supporting
 **R\&D/F\&D, product development, project costing or pharmaceutical business finance** 
 would be highly preferred.

title: Lead Java Software Engineer - Prime Finance Risk - Vice President
description:
**The Opportunity: Shape the Future of Financial Risk Analysis**
 Join our team at the forefront of financial technology, where we build and maintain the critical platform for Prime Services Risk and Business Intelligence. Our systems are the analytical engine that empowers the firm to manage risk, serve our clients, and make data\-driven decisions in a complex, fast\-paced market.
   

  

 We are a global team of innovators and problem\-solvers who design and operate sophisticated, computing\-intensive solutions to analyze the risk profiles of our clients. This is not just another development role; this is a chance to work on a platform that is fundamental to the firm's stability and success. You will tackle challenging problems in distributed systems, real\-time data processing, and financial analytics at scale.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate and experienced Lead Java Engineer to not only contribute to our codebase but also to drive technical direction, mentor our team, and own the delivery of robust, scalable solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 As a Lead Engineer, you will be at the heart of our technical decision\-making and delivery process.
   

  

* Architect \& Build: Design, develop, and own end\-to\-end software solutions using Java and the Spring ecosystem. You will be responsible for creating services that are not only functional but also resilient, performant, and scalable.
* Lead \& Mentor: Act as a technical leader within the team. Guide architectural discussions, lead sub\-teams on complex projects, and actively mentor junior engineers through constructive code reviews and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Drive Performance: Engineer high\-throughput, low\-latency systems. You will optimize applications for maximum speed, design efficient data models in Microsoft SQL Server, and implement intelligent caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to ensure our platform operates at peak performance.
* Embrace Real\-Time Data: Harness the power of our message\-driven architecture using Kafka. You will build and maintain data pipelines that feed our real\-time analytics engine, powered by Apache Pinot, to deliver instantaneous insights to our business users.
* Champion DevOps \& Automation: Contribute to and enhance our CI/CD pipelines, leveraging internal platforms and Git for seamless integration and deployment. You will deploy and manage applications on our OpenShift container platform, embracing a true DevOps culture.
* Integrate \& Collaborate: Work across teams to integrate with a wide array of upstream data sources and downstream consumers. You will collaborate closely with project managers, business analysts, and senior stakeholders to translate complex requirements into well\-architected technical solutions.
* Own \& Support: Take ownership of the full application lifecycle, including providing critical application support. You will leverage your growing knowledge of margin methodology and risk analytics to troubleshoot and resolve production issues effectively.


**Qualifications:**
* Extensive Backend Experience: 8\+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying enterprise\-scale, distributed backend systems.
* Java Expertise: Deep, hands\-on knowledge of modern Java (11\+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Security, etc.).
* Database Proficiency: Strong command of SQL and experience with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server. You should be adept at writing optimized queries and designing efficient schemas.
* Messaging \& Asynchronous Systems: Proven experience working in message\-driven architectures with technologies like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.
* Leadership \& Mentorship: A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives, making architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers. Your experience should show that you are a force multiplier for your team.
* DevOps Mindset: Solid experience with CI/CD principles and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton), and version control with Git. Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift) is essential.
* Strong Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications (The "Wow" Factor):**
* Financial Domain Knowledge: Experience or a strong interest in the Finance Sector, especially concepts related to Prime Finance, Counterparty Risk, or Market Risk.
* Advanced Education: An advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* Real\-Time Analytics Experience: Hands\-on experience with OLAP datastores like Apache Pinot.
* Scripting \& Automation: Proficiency in Unix/Linux environments and shell scripting.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in a fast\-paced, Agile/Scrum environment, managing priorities, and delivering under tight deadlines.


**What We Offer:**
* Impactful Work: The opportunity to work on a business\-critical platform that has a direct and measurable impact on the firm's bottom line and risk posture.
* Technical Challenges: A continuous stream of complex and intellectually stimulating challenges in the realms of distributed computing, big data, and financial modeling.
* Modern Tech Stack: Access to a modern, evolving tech stack with the freedom to innovate and introduce new technologies and patterns.
* Career Growth: A commitment to your professional development with a clear path for growth into senior technical leadership or management roles.
* Collaborative Culture: A supportive and collaborative global team that values diversity of thought, continuous learning, and mutual respect.
* Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary, performance\-based bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package \- details below.


 Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

The role requires a commercially aware, proactive and responsible finance professional who can manage accounting operations while supporting management with financial planning, cash\-flow management, fund allocation, cost control and financial decision\-making.**

**The candidate will act as a Finance Business Partner to Management by providing accurate financial information, identifying financial risks, monitoring cash flow and recommending appropriate financial actions.**

Accounting \& Financial Management

Daily Finance \& Management Reporting

* Provide daily financial status updates to Management.
* Monitor bank balances, cash position, receivables and collections.
* Track payables, vendor/contractor outstanding and upcoming payment commitments.
* Monitor project\-wise financial requirements.
* Highlight fund shortages, cash\-flow gaps and critical financial issues.
* Recommend actions for effective utilization of available funds.

Fund \& Cash Flow Management

* Prepare and maintain short\- and medium\-term cash\-flow projections.
* Monitor daily cash inflow and outflow.
* Identify upcoming fund requirements in advance.
* Prioritize payments based on business and project requirements.
* Recommend fund allocation and payment priorities.
* Monitor project\-wise fund utilization.
* Identify potential cash\-flow shortages and working\-capital issues.
* Suggest measures to improve working capital and reduce financial blockage.

Financial Decision Support

* Analyze financial data and provide recommendations to Management.
* Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor payments and project expenditures.
* Identify unnecessary expenses and recommend cost\-control measures.
* Highlight financial risks, discrepancies and unusual transactions.
* Support project profitability and financial viability analysis.
* Provide financial inputs for business planning and strategic decisions.

Project \& Cost Accounting

* Maintain project\-wise financial records.
* Monitor project budgets against actual expenditure.
* Track project advances and collections.
* Monitor vendor and contractor bills.
* Verify project\-related expenses and supporting documents.
* Identify project cost overruns and financial deviations.
* Prepare project\-wise profitability reports.
* Coordinate with Project, Purchase, Execution and Commercial teams.

Receivables \& Payables Management

* Monitor client/customer outstanding on a daily basis.
* Prepare receivable ageing reports and collection forecasts.
* Track committed collection dates and overdue payments.
* Maintain vendor and contractor outstanding reports.
* Prepare payment schedules based on priority and available funds.
* Verify invoices, approvals and supporting documents before payment processing.

MIS \& Financial Analysis
