title: Senior Manager/AVP – US Bookkeeping & Accounting Practice
description:
**The Opportunity** 





 Qualicentric runs an established US bookkeeping and accounting delivery practice — a team of roughly ten accountants handling bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting for US small and mid\-market clients. The practice works, and now we want to level it up: tighten the operating engine, raise the quality bar, and build the structure to scale it several times over.
 





 We are also moving the wider firm toward an outcome\-based, fixed\-fee model powered by automation and AI — a shift away from the headcount\-based offshore norm. This role sits at the centre of both: stabilise and strengthen what exists today, then build the bigger, smarter practice of tomorrow.
 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 





 Someone who has personally run a comparable US bookkeeping / accounting delivery practice in a KPO or outsourcing environment — not just managed a team, but owned the quality, economics, and growth of a book of US clients. You bring deep, hands\-on US accounting expertise, the operational instinct to run a tight delivery engine, and the leadership to build one that scales.
 





 Four things matter most in this role: strong communication and client presence, sharp accounting fundamentals, an uncompromising quality bar, and the flexibility to adapt across clients, priorities, and US time zones. If those are your strengths, this is a role you will thrive in.
 




  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Delivery \& Quality** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the US bookkeeping \& accounting book — quality, accuracy, timeliness, and SLA adherence across bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting.
* Run delivery governance: capacity planning, resource allocation, utilization, WIP, and quality reviews, with clear performance metrics.
* Surface and resolve delivery risks, dependencies, and scope issues early — maintaining a zero\-surprise culture with clients and internally.
* Own the practice's operational economics — utilization, realization, and profitability, not just output.



  





**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team — accountants, seniors, and managers — setting clear expectations and holding accountability for outcomes.
* Build leadership depth and succession by growing managers into owners, and close capability gaps through targeted coaching and training.
* Design the team structure and hiring plan to scale the practice as the client base grows.



  





**Client Partnership** 



* Work closely with clients day to day — interacting regularly, building trust, and taking complete, end\-to\-end ownership of every deliverable.
* Support clients on the FP\&A and strategy side — budgeting, forecasting, and the analysis that shapes their business decisions — not just the books.
* Partner with clients as a trusted advisor, presenting month\-end results, cash flow, and operational insight in clear, confident communication.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex delivery and accounting matters, with proactive updates on risks, delays, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Business Development on onboarding, solutioning, account expansion, and cross\-sell.



  





**Process, Technology \& AI** 



* Standardise SOPs, quality controls, and delivery processes across accounts so quality is repeatable, not personality\-dependent.
* Champion automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and data\-driven dashboards to lift efficiency, quality, and client experience.
* Help drive the firm's transition to an outcome\-based delivery model.

* 10\+ years in Finance \& Accounting, with 4–5\+ years leading teams — ideally in outsourcing, KPO, or a CA/CPA environment.

As our ‘voice’ of Finance, you’ll quickly understand and guide on the best solutions that will achieve business objectives, add value and drive effective risk management. With an ever\-changing business environment, your insight and experience will be essential to prioritise activities according to opportunity and risk.
   

  

 More specific duties might include:
   

  

* Providing expert accounting advice to project teams to ensure that transactions are appropriately reported and understood
* Responsibility for a number of key corporate areas of subject matter expertise
* Providing expert functional input and review of Group Financing Proposals to support quality decision making.
* Supervision and delivery of accurate and timely Corporate segment reporting, working closely with a small team in R\&A, Group Reporting and Investor Relations to deliver accurate, transparent reporting and associated business performance interventions.
* Ensuring an appropriate control framework is in place for risk management
* Appropriately involving other teams to support financial activities, whilst building overall accountability.
* Providing expert Finance Advisor support across a wide range of connected areas such as risk management and group structuring.
* Support and coaching, as a more senior member of the controllers team, to other more junior team members through projects and other initiatives.


**What You Bring**
* You’ll be an expert on technical accounting, supporting direction on a range of technical issues, and helping to implement new financial structures and reporting standards. Your excellent communication skills will be vital to the role, ensuring you effectively articulate value and risks to influence decision making and drive performance whilst also playing an important part in training and giving context to a wide range of stakeholders.
* You will be a qualified Chartered Accountant (or equivalent) with 10\-12 years post qualification experience.
* Expertise across the spectrum of Finance competences.
* Experience in risk management and corporate structuring would be an advantage
* A proven record of continuous improvement.
* An ability to use analytics and insights to resolve problems, with a view to influencing and supporting the decision\-making process and risk management.
* Skills within project management.


**Functional Skills**
* Technical Accounting and Reporting \- SME on multiple technical issues; reviews financing proposals; ensures accurate corporate reporting.
* Treasury and Financing expertise \- Guides on financing proposals; supports entity structuring and optimisation.
* Risk management and Controls \- Designs and ensures strong control frameworks; manages entity\-specific risks.
* Corporate Reporting \- Supervises segment reporting; liaises within R\&A and with Group Reporting.
* Business Partnering \- Advises on multiple financing initiatives; influences senior stakeholders.
* Process Improvement \- Leads continuous improvement and capability uplift within the team


**Technical Skills**
* IFRS Mastery \- Sets IFRS accounting direction across HaT; handles highly complex arrangements.
* Treasury and Capital Structure knowledge \- Advanced understanding; reviews financing proposals; works across businesses.
* Data and Analytics \- Strong analytics capability; uses insights for decision‑making and risk assessments.
* Finance Systems (SAP, Reporting Tools) \- Advanced user; ensures accuracy across reporting and consolidation.
* Project management \- Ability to lead cross\-functional finance projects


**Personal Effectiveness**
* Problem Solving and Judgement \- Addresses complex issues independently; prioritizes based on value and risk.
* Influencing and Communication \- Executive\-level communicator; frames decisions for senior leadership and the Board.
* Collaboration \- Coordinates across multiple functions; builds strong networks.
* Resilience and Adaptability \- Handles dynamic priorities; maintains high performance during change.
* Leadership mindset \- Coaches junior staff; leads discreet workstreams. Accountability \- Ownership of functional areas and outputs.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.


**An Inclusive \& Progressive Place to Work**
* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.


**Shell in India**
 Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R\&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
   

  

 Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net\-zero emissions energy business by 2050\. As India moves towards its target of net\-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
   

  

 Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end\-to\-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world\-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350\-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
   

  

 Shell owns and operates a LNG re\-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck\-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1\.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
   

  

 Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting\-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
   

  

 We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco\-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: VP - Senior Business Credit Advisor
description:
**Job Title:** 
 VP \- Senior Business Credit Advisor
   

  

**Department** 
 : Client Lines, CIB – Securities Services
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 Securities Services is a leading global custodian and securities services specialist that provides multi\-asset post\-trade and asset servicing solutions for buy and sell\-side market participants, corporates and issuers.
   

  

 CIB2S Business Credit Advisors (BCA) Team is positioned within SBD\&T, reporting to the Head of 2S APAC Strategy and centrally to the Global Head of CIB2S Business Credit Risk Office in Paris. The team’s mandate is cross Clients Lines. The team works with various stakeholders and with all CIB2S locations and interacts with different Business Lines and Functions.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 CIB2S BCA team is a team of experts in credit risk in relation to post trade services for CIB2S. As experts, the team provides risk assessment for these activities to CIB2S Business, FIC ICAT and RISK credit delegation holders in the context of credit requests and credit annual reviews. The team members also contribute to raise risk awareness across CIB2S and in particular CIB2S APAC Territory.
   

  

 BCA provides globally comprehensive coverage of all CIB2S counterparties/clients. BCA APAC covers APAC Geography and other locations as determined by the Global Head of BCA. The senior role may handle more sophisticated and complex deals (e.g. clients with weak ratings, complex activity or large risks).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

**Credit Risk Approval Process**
* Review credit requests prepared by the Coverage/Front and challenge them when proposed activity set\-up and/or risk mitigants do not seem appropriate or not in line with BNPP Credit Policies.
* Calibrate amount of credit limit to be requested.
* Provide credit analysts and credit officers with a risk opinion on the request
* Participating in credit committees representing Business in partnership with Client Development.
* Follow\-up post committee with the relevant stakeholders on any pending conditions
* Participate to client due diligences when deemed appropriate.
* Analyze the impacts from a credit risk standpoint of amendments to legal agreements and provide recommendations to decision makers.
* Lead or contribute to projects related to CIB2S credit risk topics and portfolio analysis.
* CIB2S activities, its environment and credit risk methodologies are constantly evolving. Maintain a proactive awareness of these evolutions and share with the team, Management and/or other Business partners when needed.


 Reinforcing 2S risk awareness across the organization
   

  

* Enhance the understanding of CIB2S activities and associated risks across ICAT and RISK MFI organizations.
* Develop and reinforce credit risk awareness within the Client Development community by performing training sessions.


 Strategic risk analysis \& anticipation
   

  

* Keep abreast of macro\-economic developments and on those impacting individual credit perimeter.
* Represent BCA in the APAC regional governance bodies to present results of risk monitoring and escalate any relevant risk topics (credit, counterparty, framework).
* Country risk monitoring: use existing frameworks (country envelope) and help develop new methods to monitor holistically risk exposures to sensitive countries.


 Advisory on product risk framework evolutions
   

  

* Advise Products teams of potential credit risk impacts during TAC/NACs preparation phase.
* Provide 2S Business input to transversal projects concerning evolutions of risk. methodologies; ensure implementation of risk methodology reviews in the APAC perimeter (Note: BCA team's involvement is not systematic, only when requested by Products team).


**Key Internal Stakeholders**
* Sales / Relationship Managers
* FIC credit analysts (ICAT team)
* Group RISK (primarily Credit Officers/Senior Credit Officers)
* RISK MFI monitoring teams
* CIB2S Product Teams
* Legal


 Technical \& Behavioral Competencies
   

  

**Essential**
* Credit / counterparty risk management within a financial institution or a risk consultancy
* Securities Services business Product team
* Good knowledge of credit risk management techniques and risk measures
* Detailed knowledge of specific Finance principles and processes with a full understanding of the area of specialism, and able to translate knowledge and experience into recommendations to improve team operating practices. Good working knowledge of a wide range of BNPP policies, procedures, regulations and legislation. Excellent written and oral English skills to articulate technical issues and to be able to take the complex and make them simple to enable effective communication with individuals across the business.
* Very strong analytical skills, with the ability to challenge internal stakeholders
* Autonomy, rigor, and ability to manipulate large datasets
* Excellent communication and IT skills


**Preferred**
* Regulatory knowledge


**Education Level:** 
 Master’s degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.  The Regulatory Reporting function within Investment \& Distribution Services is responsible for the timely and accurate distribution of reports and marketing collaterals to global clients and regulators. The team is committed to delivering high\-quality service through disciplined operational practices and responsive support for distribution processes, new product launches, and evolving instruments. Operating in a dynamic environment shaped by economic, regulatory, and risk\-related changes, the team ensures the delivery of reliable and consistent data aligned with the “SMART” data principles—ensuring data is Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time\-bound.
   

  

**Your Role**
 The Regulatory Reporting Specialist is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and submitting various regulatory reports to relevant authorities. This position requires a strong understanding of regulatory requirements, excellent data analysis skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively, with focus on accuracy and timeliness. In addition to BAU reporting the Specialist is responsible for quality assurance of data, analysis and resolution of non\-standard exceptions, queries and issues raised by clients and internal teams, and providing expert input regarding Trade \& Transaction regulations. The role is for a Specialist in reporting, competent at analyzing and interpreting reporting requirements and prioritizing a demanding and diverse workload.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Produce daily reporting to agreed timescales for regulatory Trade \& Transaction Reporting. Ensure that all regulatory reporting is performed to the highest quality and in line with the Regulatory Reporting Standards.
* Develop and maintain Subject Matter Expertise in the following areas of regulatory reporting as defined in the annual goal setting and review process (EMIR, MiFID Trade and Transaction Reporting, SFTR reporting.
* Independently resolve complex queries from internal and external stakeholders. Present findings effectively and provide solutions to any issues or risks identified.
* Ensure the process for end\-to\-end delivery of selected areas of regulatory reporting is robust and controlled. Maintain Operating Model documentation, process, procedure risk and control documentation and KPIs to support.
* Review policies and new business initiatives to determine impacts on Reporting
* Strictly adhere to policies \& procedures while producing reports and due diligence in completing with highest standards and accuracy.


**Key proficiencies**
* Strong Financial Industry Experience with focus on Regulatory Reporting
* Conceptual and Strong understanding of financial instruments
* Effective team player and Excellent interpersonal skills
* Attention to detail, Flexibility, adaptability, and strong coordination/collaboration
* Basic knowledge of MS Office Suite; proficiency in MS Excel is desired
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to identify and develop key professional working relationships
* Excellent research and analytical skills


**The Experience You Bring**
* 5 years of prior experience in the financial services industry, specifically within regulatory reporting (EMIR/MIFID).
* Specialist: 6\+ years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding of financial industry fundamentals and various asset classes
* Familiarity with mutual fund structures, investment life cycle, and key market participants
* Working knowledge of ESG principles and regulatory frameworks including SFTR, MiFID, and EMIR
* Ability to understand and navigate data flows and system architecture within investment platforms
* Experience with data integration, reporting tools, and operational workflows


**Academic Requirements**
* MBA or any professional qualification (CFA, CMA) with Finance as the major

 Full time

 At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full\-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.

 In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. title: Sr Associate - Contracts & Pricing
description:
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**
 If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
   

  

**Live**
**What You Will Do**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. Amgen has a robust portfolio and pipeline of biosimilars which target some of the most complex and important oncology and inflammation antibody biologics. Furthermore, many of the Amgen innovative medicines face biosimilar competition. In this role, you will drive a competitive edge for the team as we compete with this portfolio.
   

  

**The Team**
* Part of Amgen’s Global Contracts and Pricing Operations (Global CPO) organization sitting in the Global Operational Pricing Team
* Located mainly across Breda (Netherlands) and Lisbon (Portugal)
* Comprised of 15\+ nationalities, fostering an inclusive and diverse environment
* Values include: Collaboration, Innovation, Continuous learning and growth, Delivering operational excellence, Embracing challenges, Having fun at work, Supporting one another as one global team
* Focused on enabling accurate, reliable contract and pricing execution to support Amgen’s mission of serving patients.


**The Role**
* This role manages pricing and contracting operations for JAPAC while supporting ex\-US countries through comprehensive compliance, monitoring, reporting, system access, and automation activities.
* It safeguards data integrity, enhances operational oversight, and drives process efficiency through streamlined reporting and automation solutions.
* Eligible location for applicants: India


**Accountabilities**
* Accurate and timely execution of contracts, pricing, payments, and accruals for JAPAC
* Ensuring SOX and IICC control compliance
* Maintaining data integrity and monitoring system outcomes
* Supporting and validating changes in SAP Vistex and related systems
* Providing reporting, dashboards, and automation solutions


**Responsibilities**
* Operational Support: Manage and execute pricing, contracts, accruals, and payments for JAPAC countries within timelines and accuracy requirements.
* Compliance \& Control:
* Collect and document data for SOX controls ; conduct data integrity checks
* Prepare and deliver reports supporting IICC controls
* Execute IICC controls for JAPAC countries
* Perform unit, regression, and integration testing following system changes
* Support integration testing with product or country team oversight
* Maintain Tableau dashboards and run related validations
* Conduct automated testing checks and follow up with Product Team AIN resources
* Monitoring Activities:
* Monitor data flows; identify and escalate issues to resolution
* Run audit and follow\-on bots; investigate discrepancies
* Design and implement bots to improve monitoring of system outcomes
* Track and follow up on outstanding documents (PP, revisions, settlement deletions)
* Systems Access \& Pricing Conditions:
* Support user access and workflow linkages in Vistex and Tableau
* Develop bots to improve user access processing where appropriate
* Execute pricing conditions (e.g., VK11\) and ensure VAT compliance in SAP
* Other Contributions:
* Execute repetitive, well\-documented tasks for the Breda and Portugal teams (reports, statistics, data archiving)
* Coordinate administrative activities (meeting scheduling, MoM, Smartsheet, action trackers)
* Deliver self\-service re
* porting (dashboards, data extracts, report simplification)
* Analyze process mining data in Celonis and prepare reports for management
* Implement automation solutions and bots to improve efficiency


**Win**
**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek has the following qualifications:
   

  

 Essential Qualifications/Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree \+ minimum 3\-5 years experience OR Associate’s degree \+ minimum 5\+ years experience.
* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Contract and pricing operations
* Compliance
* Functional IT support
* Business administration


 Preferred Experience:
   

  

* Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication
* Experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology environments
* Hands\-on experience with SAP, Vistex, and/or Tableau
* Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, and tools such as Jira
* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
* Cultural awareness and ability to operate effectively in global environments
* Ability to thrive in matrixed and international teams
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end business processes
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and balance competing demands


**Preferred Soft Skills**
* Proactive “can\-do” mindset and ownership mentality
* Strong planning, alignment, and follow\-through
* High attention to detail with commitment to compliance and quality
* Positive, collaborative team orientation
* Results\-driven, dependable, and consistent in delivering commitments
* Clear and confident communicator


**Thrive**
**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

* Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization
* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act
* Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits


**Apply now**
**for a career that defies imagination**
 In our quest to serve patients above all else, Amgen is the first to imagine, and the last to doubt. Join us.

title: Citi Community Capital - Real Estate Underwriting - Officer
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on\-the\-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
   

  

 The Analyst will hold a critical role within the Structured Credit and Real Estate Underwriting (RESCU) team, supporting the management of a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio of real estate assets primarily in the affordable housing space (Citi Community Capital) across North America. The Analyst will gain broad exposure across the full credit lifecycle, covering Construction Financing, Guarantor Analysis, and Permanent Financing.
   

  

**In this role, you’re expected to:**
* Work proactively with the Underwriting team/ Asset Manager to ensure timely information flow/ communications among all internal stakeholders.
* Review property\-level financials (operating statements, rent rolls, NOI) and borrower/guarantor financial statements including REO exposure, to identify deteriorating trends and support portfolio reviews.
* Monitor the ongoing compliance of assigned deals with the documented financing terms and conditions, portfolio performance and financial triggers with the aim of identifying and mitigating credit risks. Assist with classification and risk rating processes, decisions and monitoring.
* Monitor projects under development, including oversight of construction progress, budget tracking, draw reviews, execution risks, risk ratings, and annual reviews through completion and stabilization.
* Prepare annual credit approval and quarterly memos in a timely manner.
* Assist with stress testing, concentration analysis, audits, risk ratings, and credit policy initiatives
* Maintain audit\-ready credit files in line with WCR policies.


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
* 1 to 3 years of credit, portfolio management or structuring experience in a financial institution, rating agency, financial guarantor, or asset management firm
* Strong Microsoft Office skills. Modelling experience is a plus
* 
+ Strong organizational skills with ability and willingness to work under pressure and manages time and priorities effectively
+ The ability to work independently to meet tight deadlines and initiate ideas with other members of the SCREU team and Independent Risk to mitigate risk.
+ Real estate or structured credit experience preferred

**Education:**+ Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
+ MBA or CFA or CA preferred

title: Senior Manager - Capital Modelling
description:
**About M\&G India**
 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

 At M\&G our purpose is
 **to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work.** 
 As an international savings and investments business with roots stretching back more than 170 years, we offer a range of financial products and services through Asset Management, Life and Wealth. All three operating segments work together to deliver attractive financial outcomes for our clients, and superior shareholder returns.
   

  

 Through our behaviours of
 **telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together** 
 with
 **care and integrity;** 
 we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

**The Role:**
 The role sits in the With\-profits Capital Valuation Team, which oversees the end\-to\-end production and analysis of the capital requirements for PAC’s with\-profits balance sheet. Responsible for the production of the capital models and the explanation of the capital requirements, working in this team will offer the opportunity to:
   

  

* develop a deep understanding of the management of the company’s with\-profits balance sheet, including the significant book of with\-profits business and its asset\-liability management strategies;
* develop and deliver of complex actuarial models to support valuations, covering the modelling (and calibration) of both assets and liabilities;
* develop communications skills across a range of stakeholders across the business, ensuring that capital impacts are clearly explained and understood. In particular, working with colleagues in the Actuarial Consolidation team to ensure that the analysis of change in the capital requirements and risk margin are clearly explained and communicated to senior stakeholders;
* work with colleagues in the AM\&V Business Development and the Investment Office to ensure that new propositions are accurately reflected into the reported results; and
* engage with colleagues involved in the oversight and review of the capital valuation processes in our Risk department and the Chief Actuary’s Team.


**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**
* Accountable for providing a quality service or products to customers and stakeholders, using skills/experience built through significant practical experience.
* Works within established frameworks and procedures, with the freedom to interpret them to solve a range of problems
* Delivers outputs that are clearly defined, using discretion over how to achieve them
* Makes suggestions for improvements to the work of the team, based on previous experience and knowledge of similar situations.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* To produce and be accountable for understanding and explaining the change in Capital to key stakeholders with clear controls.
* To provide specialist technical advice and guidance on the application of actuarial principles and tools to support business objectives, coaching and guiding less experienced members of the team
* To provide technical expertise to design technical solutions as part of change projects within M\&G UK Finance Reporting where required.
* Mentoring\-
+ Provide support and guidance to junior members of the team
+ Mentor new resources


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Senior Consultant - TAX - TMT - TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing - Mumbai
description:
Requisition Id: 1737753
   

  

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Senior Consultant\-TMT\-TAX\-TAX \- ITTS \- Transfer Pricing \- Mumbai
   

  

**TMT :**
 Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media \& Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M\&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future – building a better working world for all.
   

  

**TAX \- ITTS \- Transfer Pricing :**
 Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
   

  

 We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* The opportunity EY is looking for Senior Consultant in the Transfer Pricing Tax team with the main objective to help the core Tax teams deliver quality deliverables / solutions using general tax knowledge gained from training or education and assistance from more experienced tax professionals and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner. Your key responsibilities
* Preparing transfer pricing documentation reports
* Develop specialized competence and begin to attract recognition within own service line as a technical resource for that specialization.
* Identification of international transactions, computation of arm’s length price, selection of the most appropriate method, documentation and preparation of transfer pricing study reports.
* Complete Transfer Pricing assignments which include benchmarking studies for various multinational clients.
* Managing a team of Consultants and Interns who would be working on specific clients related to the industry.
* Should have worked on large scale and complex Transfer Pricing projects – for both Inbound and outbound companies
* Assisting clients in transfer pricing/supply chain planning
* Expands opportunities with existing clients, identifies and acts on referrals in relation to the Service Line
* Conducting economic analysis/ comparability analysis. Should be well versed in using Indian and foreign databases
* Preparing technical submissions for assessments \& appellate level
* Should be well versed with technical concepts of evolving Transfer Pricing law in India
* Representing the client's case before the Tax Officer/ Appellate level Skills and attributes for success
* Should be well versed with OECD TP Guidelines and transfer pricing regulations of developed countries
* Should be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PPT) To qualify for the role you must have
* A qualified Chartered Accountant
* 2\-4 years of core transfer pricing experience Ideally you’ll also have
* Strong communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
* Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Commerce
* chartered accountant


**Experience**
* Transfer Pricing Experience of 2\+ years


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Associate - CIB Consulting & Transformation (CIBC&T) India
description:
**Job Title: Associate – Junior Consultant\- CIB Consulting \& Transformation (CIBC\&T) India**
**Department** 
 :
 **CIB Consulting \& Transformation (CIBC\&T) India**
**About Business Line/Function**
 Created in 2009, BNP Paribas CIB Consulting \& Transformation (CIBC\&T) is an in\-house management consultancy with a strong presence in EMEA (\~100 consultants in Paris, Lisbon, and London) and a global reach thanks to an integrated network in APAC \& Americas (\~100 consultants).
   

  

 The team works on strategic initiatives defined by CIB Senior Management. It has a strong track\-record with 600\+ projects accomplished to date. CIBC\&T is a competitive alternative to leading, external consulting firms, covering the full consulting value chain: from framing, diagnosis, and delivery of actionable recommendations, to designing effective implementation and enabling change.
   

  

 BNP Paribas CIB Consulting \& Transformation (CIBC\&T) India is a newly created team, globally part of CIB Consulting \& Transformation based in Paris and locally linked to the business management scope of BNP Paribas’ center of expertise India Solutions Private Limited (ISPL). Its goal is to advise BNP Paribas’ Management, participating in the framing, design and implementation of high\-impact projects and operating models’ transformations aimed at supporting global Functions \& CIB Business lines and notably the development of the local territory and (global) center of expertise (India Solutions Private Limited – ISPL).
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Consultants within CIBC\&T contribute to provide strategic support to Senior Management in the transformation of BNP Paribas India (territory), its global center of expertise, India Solutions Private Limited (ISPL), and BNP Paribas CIB globally, in collaboration with BNP Paribas CIB Consulting \& Transformation as well as CIB Consulting APAC and CIB Transformation APAC. Junior consultants participate in the framing, design, and follow\-up phases of strategic projects. Some travel might be required on an ad\-hoc basis.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Project management:

title: Head of Finance and Accounting
description:
Qualitia Software Pvt. Ltd. is a profitable, AI\-driven test automation company headquartered in Pune, India, with offices in San Jose, California and Sydney (Australia). The company's flagship product, Qualitia Boson, is a patented Salesforce automation testing platform trusted by marquee enterprise clients including HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, MetLife, GE Healthcare, Philips, PwC, and BSE. Qualitia is ISO\-certified, a Great Place to Work, and a recognized Salesforce AppExchange partner.
 



  





 As the company scales its international footprint and deepens enterprise relationships, it seeks a senior finance leader who can bring rigor, strategic insight, and operational excellence to the finance function.
 



  





**About The Role:**




 The Head of Finance \& Accounts will function as the de\-facto CFO of Qualitia, assuming full ownership of the company's financial management, compliance infrastructure, and strategic financial planning. This is a critical leadership role that will partner directly with the Founder \& CEO and the Executive team to support Qualitia's continued growth, profitability, and international expansion.
 



  





**What You'll Do:**




  





**A. Financial Strategy \& Planning** 



* Act as the primary financial advisor to the Founder \& CEO; provide data\-driven financial guidance for strategic decisions.
* Lead the annual budgeting and multi\-year financial planning process, including revenue forecasting, cost modelling, and scenario analysis.
* Drive profitability management — monitor margins, identify cost efficiencies, and ensure the company remains sustainably cash\-generative.
* Build and maintain Board\-ready financial dashboards, MIS packs, and performance reports on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Evaluate and recommend investment strategies, capital allocation decisions, and liquidity management approaches.



  





**B. Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 



* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end accounting operations: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and month\-end/year\-end close.
* Prepare and present standalone and consolidated financial statements for the India entity and subsidiaries (USA, Australia) in accordance with Ind AS / IFRS.
* Manage revenue recognition under Ind AS 115, including multi\-element arrangements and SaaS subscription contracts.
* Liaise with Statutory Auditors and Internal Auditors to ensure timely completion of audits and resolution of observations.
* Maintain and enforce robust financial controls, accounting policies, and SOPs across all entities.



  





**C. Taxation \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure full compliance with all direct tax obligations — advance tax, TDS, income tax returns, and assessments.
* Manage GST compliance: monthly/annual filings, ITC reconciliation, audits, and notices.
* Handle Transfer Pricing documentation and filings for cross\-border transactions with USA and Australia entities.
* Oversee FEMA / RBI compliance for foreign remittances, export of services, and overseas subsidiary management.
* Minimize tax outgo through proactive tax planning within the framework of applicable laws, in consultation with tax advisors.
* Monitor and ensure compliance with Companies Act 2013 requirements, ROC filings, and statutory registers.



  





**D. Banking, Treasury \& Working Capital** 



* Build and manage banking relationships; negotiate terms for credit facilities, working capital lines, and banking products.
* Oversee treasury operations: cash flow forecasting, FX risk management, and optimization of idle cash.
* Administer loan agreements and ensure compliance with financial covenants and reporting requirements.
* Manage multi\-currency cash flows across India, USA, and Australian entities, including hedging strategies where appropriate.



  





**E. Investor Relations \& Governance** 



* Prepare and present financial performance updates to the Board and shareholders; support investor queries with accurate financial data.
* Maintain investor\-grade financial hygiene and documentation in anticipation of future fundraising, M\&A, or liquidity events.
* Assist with ESOP plan administration and accounting; advise management on equity\-linked compensation structures.
* Support due\-diligence processes for any strategic partnerships, acquisitions, or investments.



  





**F. Team Leadership \& Process Excellence** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the Finance \& Accounts team; build capability within the function.
* Drive ERP/accounting system improvements and automation to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial operations.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for the finance function; foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the financial interface with legal, HR, sales, and operations teams for cross\-functional business support.



  





**What We're Looking For:**




  





**Educational Qualification** 



* Chartered Accountant (CA) from ICAI — mandatory
* MBA in Finance from a reputed institution will be an added advantage.



**Work Experience** 



* Minimum 8–12 years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role (Head of Finance, Finance Controller, or CFO).
* Prior experience in a technology, SaaS, or software product company is strongly preferred; familiarity with subscription revenue models and SaaS\-specific financial metrics (ARR, NRR, CAC) is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-entity, multi\-currency consolidation — particularly India \+ US \+ Australia structures.
* Hands\-on exposure to Transfer Pricing, FEMA/RBI compliance, and international taxation.
* Track record of independently managing statutory audits, tax assessments, and regulatory interactions.



**Technical Skills** 



* Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Excel modelling is essential).
* Working knowledge of ERP systems; ability to evaluate and upgrade financial systems.
* Strong command of Ind AS / IFRS, Companies Act 2013, Income Tax Act, and GST law.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into financial plans.
* High integrity and confidentiality — essential for a role with access to all financial and board\-level data.
* Strong analytical and conceptual abilities; comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Result\-oriented and self\-motivated; able to operate independently with minimal supervision.
* Collaborative leader who can work effectively across functions and geographies.



  





**Why Join Qualitia:**



* A high\-impact, senior leadership role with direct access to the Founder \& CEO and the Board.
* Opportunity to shape the finance function of a profitable, growing global software company.
* A collaborative, performance\-driven culture recognized as a Great Place to Work.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* Pune\-based role with exposure to international business operations (USA \& Australia).

title: Operations - Portfolio Monitoring Unit (Private Markets)- Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

 KKR's Gurugram office provides best\-in\-class business operations services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization\-wide process efficiency and transformation, and reflects KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR. The office was established with an initial concentration of finance, operations, and technology personnel, followed by the expansion of additional functions and capabilities. KKR’s creation of a Gurugram office builds upon the firm's momentum in India and bolsters its existing presence in Mumbai.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 In 2016 KKR set up a dedicated portfolio team to help monitor and manage its global Private Credit portfolio. The Portfolio Monitoring Unit (PMU) is responsible for the analysis of company financial statements, asset valuation, financial modelling, and ongoing asset and portfolio risk analysis.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Analyst/Senior Analyst will be tasked with monitoring KKR’s revolving credit portfolio and will partner closely with management, investment team members and senior leadership to track portfolio company performance, monitor liquidity levels, and assess performance against credit KPIs. The individual will be expected to deliver quarterly Investment Committee reviews, build and maintain financial models, and engage directly with portfolio companies to inform strategic decisions on portfolio management including refinancings, restructurings, and exits.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Assessment of underlying portfolio company performance, through detailed financial statement
* Financial and commercial risk assessment of companies, feeding into portfolio risks assessments
* Ongoing valuation analysis, including Discounted Cash Flow, Relative Value, Enterprise Value Waterfall assessment
* Monitoring the delivery of financial updates from portfolio companies
* Support the portfolio company data collection process
* Preparation of quarterly reviews
* Engaging with third party advisors as required


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years relevant experience (i.e. investment banking, private equity, corporate / leveraged lending, corporate finance, transaction services, restructuring, corporate audit and valuations). Portfolio and credit risk experience highly valued
* Excellent investing and financial acumen, with the ability to quickly disseminate and analyse financial reporting
* Financial modeling experience and capable of building and interpreting financial models
* Analytical and inquiring mindset, with a willingness to develop new skills
* Commercial awareness and a good understanding of financial statements and deal structures
* Strong academic background with graduate degree preferred
* Relevant professional qualification (ACA, CFA, ACCA or similar)
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to deliver impactful presentations to internal and external stakeholders
* The ability to multi\-task and execute a wide range of assignments, with competing deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Financial modelling experience
* Strong communication, report writing and organisation skills
* Ability to evaluate AI solutions for risk, bias, data governance, and Responsible AI compliance to ensure ethical, secure, and effective deployment.

title: Content Manager - Research (Real Estate)
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Content Manager serves as the Real Estate subject matter expert within the Real Estate pod and owns its expert research content coverage. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human\-moderated one\-to\-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The Content Manager reviews content for research quality and relevance and works with Associates and Compliance through publication.
   

  

 The role requires an investor mindset and deep knowledge of Real Estate, including its major property types, companies, value chain, financial statements, operating drivers, market cycles and current debates. The Content Manager must also understand relevant credit, private\-market and other investor perspectives well enough to assess the category broadly; ask incisive questions; challenge superficial answers; and produce content that leaves investors materially better informed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Coverage ownership and research agenda**
* Set and maintain the research agenda for Real Estate, including priority companies, themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
* Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro, sector and sub\-sector developments to company\-level implications.
* Translate earnings calls, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring content programs for Real Estate.
* Use a shared research foundation to develop several distinct conversations on the same company or topic without producing repetitive content.


**Network Member strategy and interview leadership**
* Build and maintain a map of the roles, organizations, value\-chain positions and geographies needed to answer priority research questions.
* Define and validate Network Member profiles, screening criteria and briefing context that distinguish direct visibility from nominal seniority.
* Design investor\-focused interview agendas and questions that go beyond public commentary and generate original insight.
* Lead human\-moderated one\-to\-one interviews, listening actively, probing inconsistencies and redirecting the conversation toward material investor questions.


**Structured programs, quality and collaboration**
* Define the research objective, respondent criteria, question sets and cadence for channel checks and other recurring structured programs within Real Estate.
* Brief Associates executing those programs, review representative output and determine whether it meets substantive research and quality standards.
* Work with Associates and Compliance to resolve substantive questions and carry approved content through publication.
* Capture company briefs, Network Member knowledge, question frameworks and findings in reusable form to strengthen future coverage of Real Estate.
* Collaborate across the sector pod when sub\-sector, asset\-class, regional or thematic perspectives would materially improve the research, and contribute to team ideation, knowledge sharing and quality calibration.
* Use AI\-enabled research and moderation tools to deepen preparation and improve efficiency, applying judgment to validate outputs.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity or credit research, buy\-side or sell\-side analysis, research services, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, primary research or an expert network.
* Deep expertise across real estate property types and markets, preferably developed through public\-equity, commercial real estate or comparable fundamental research, with sufficient familiarity across credit, private\-market and other relevant investor perspectives to assess the category broadly.
* Experience producing research or insight for institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and the performance indicators relevant to Real Estate.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the intellectual curiosity and discipline to maintain deep expertise within Real Estate.
* Demonstrated ability to translate research objectives into incisive, investor\-relevant questions designed to generate differentiated insight.
* Excellent verbal communication and live\-interviewing skills, including the ability to probe beyond surface\-level responses and challenge senior operators in real time.
* Strong written English and research judgment, with the ability to distinguish incremental insight from general commentary.
* Ability to own Real Estate independently, collaborate effectively within the Financials \& Real Estate pod, and deliver high\-quality work at speed in a high\-volume, deadline\-driven environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Independent ownership of company, industry or thematic research within Real Estate that informed an investment, strategy or operating decision.
* Direct exposure to expert interviews, earnings or market\-event analysis, or senior\-level research discussions.
* Relevant language skills, local\-market knowledge, transaction experience or technical credentials for specialist mandates.
* MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant graduate or technical qualification.

title: US Payroll Tax
description:
Why UKG:   At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. Thats what we do. 
 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, youll get flexibility thats real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work mattersand so do you. 
 Position Summary UKG is seeking a detail-oriented and client-focused Tax Analyst to join the Payment Services Tax Team. This role is responsible for supporting tax filing, amendments, reconciliations, and notice resolution activities to ensure accurate and timely payroll tax compliance across federal, state, and local jurisdictions. 
 The Tax Data Filing I role focuses on executing tax filings, processing amendments, reconciling tax liabilities, and supporting client inquiries. The position requires strong attention to detail, ability to manage deadlines, and foundational knowledge of payroll tax compliance. 
 What Youll Do Tax Filing & Amendment Processing Prepare and file quarterly and annual payroll tax returns using tax filing systems (e.g., Master Tax) in accordance with agency guidelines. Assist in processing tax amendments, including reviewing client requests and generating corrected returns. Support electronic filings and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements. Prepare and submit agency registrations, EFT setups, and reporting agent authorizations. Reconciliation & Tax Balancing Perform daily, quarterly, and annual reconciliation of tax liabilities between payroll systems and tax filing systems. Identify and resolve out-of-balance conditions between payroll data, filings, and payments. Analyze tax variances and prepare supporting documentation for client communication. Support onboarding activities by reconciling new client balances and validating historical data. Tax Notice & Issue Resolution Research and respond to payroll tax notices submitted by clients. Communicate with tax agencies and internal teams to resolve discrepancies. Assist in resolving issues related to filings, payments, and account setup. Escalate complex issues to senior team members as needed. Case Management & Client Support Manage and update cases in Salesforce, ensuring accurate documentation and timely communication. Respond to client and internal inquiries related to tax filings, amendments, and notices. Provide support to internal business units on payroll tax-related questions. title: Finance Technology Analyst
company: Sanjay Saraf Educational Institute Pvt Ltd (SSEI)
description:
**ABOUT US:** 




  





 Sanjay Saraf Educational Institute has taught finance for over three decades. Founded by Sanjay Saraf Sir, who started teaching in 1994 and has since mentored more than 10 lakh students, SSEI prepares candidates for CFA, FRM, CA, and ACCA, and is an Approved Prep Provider for the CFA Institute, GARP, and ACCA. Founder led, bootstrapped, headquartered in Kolkata.
 



  





**THE ROLE:** 




  





 SSEI is building an internal quant trading simulation. It is a new vertical for us, and one of our most exciting projects. It builds on what we are strongest at (markets, derivatives, and risk) but it is genuinely new territory: systematic, data driven, and built in code. You would be spearheading the engineering behind it.
 



  





 The role has two parts. The quant simulation is the headline. Alongside it, you will be SSEI's in house technology owner: our website and LMS are built by external vendors, and you will own that code.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON:** 




  





**The quant trading simulation** 




 • The simulation engine: how strategies receive data, place trades, get filled, and are marked to market.
 



 • Large market datasets: sourcing, cleaning, storing, and querying years of intraday and end of day data.
 



 • Time series modelling: returns, volatility, correlation, regime behaviour.
 



 • Honest backtesting: out of sample testing, costs, slippage, and the risk metrics that show whether a strategy is real.
 



 • Using AI tooling to move faster through research and development.
 



  





**In house technology for SSEI** 




 • Owning the code behind our vendor built website and LMS, and being the technical counterpart our vendors work with.
 



 • Updates, maintenance, fixes, and keeping things running.
 



 • Building and shipping landing pages for campaigns and launches.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:** 




  





 • A strong coder. Python first, including pandas and NumPy. SQL. Git. Enough HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to work in a codebase someone else wrote and ship a landing page.
 



 • Into quant investing. Systematic trading is something you follow and have tested ideas in, not just read about.
 



 • Good with numbers, and analytical. Strong statistics and probability. Sceptical of a result until it survives scrutiny.
 



 • Time series and large datasets. Hands on modelling experience, and comfort with data big enough that naive code falls over.
 



 • AI fluency. Hands on with LLM APIs and AI coding tools.
 



 • Projects to show. Quant, data, or code work you have actually built.
 



  





 This is not a fundamentals or valuation role. Experience counts, and so does intent. If you are early in your career but have built serious things on your own, apply. If you have years in a quant, trading, data, or engineering role, apply.
 



  





**WORK MODEL** 




  






 Either based out of:
 




 • Kolkata: on site, six days a week.
 



 • Mumbai: hybrid. Two days a week in office, the rest remote.
 



 • Full time only.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




  





 Put links to at least two projects at the top of your CV, ideally one quant or data project and one thing you have built and shipped. For each, add three or four lines: the problem, what you built, and what it does now.
 



  





 Applications without project links will not be shortlisted.
 



  





 Compensation is as per industry standards.

About the Company

ForYour Resque Private Limited is engaged in the manufacture, import, supply and marketing of specialised firefighting, rescue, disaster\-management and emergency\-response equipment. The company serves government departments, defence establishments, fire services, public\-sector organisations and major private industries across India.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management \& Reporting

* Manage the company’s complete finance and accounting functions.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports, profit\-and\-loss statements, balance sheets and cash\-flow reports.
* Monitor budgets, expenses, profitability, receivables and working\-capital requirements.
* Prepare product\-wise, order\-wise and project\-wise costing and profitability analysis.
* Assist management with financial planning, budgeting and commercial decision\-making.
* Establish and maintain effective financial controls and accounting procedures.

Banking \& Fund Management

* Manage daily cash flow, banking transactions and fund planning.
* Coordinate with banks for working\-capital facilities, bank guarantees, letters of credit, foreign remittances and other banking requirements.
* Monitor BG limits, expiry dates, extensions, margin requirements and releases.
* Plan vendor payments, statutory payments and other financial commitments.
* Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments from customers.

Taxation \& Statutory Compliance

* Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Review GST returns, TDS returns and reconciliations before filing.
* Handle GST input\-credit reconciliation and resolve mismatches.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, company secretary and government authorities.
* Support assessments, audits and responses to statutory notices.
* Ensure proper maintenance of all financial and statutory records.

Imports \& Foreign Transactions

* Manage import\-related payments, foreign remittances and documentation.
* Coordinate with banks, customs brokers, freight forwarders and suppliers regarding financial documentation.
* Verify landed costs, customs duties, freight, exchange\-rate differences and import expenses.
* Maintain records of purchase orders, supplier advances and outstanding foreign payments.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FEMA and banking requirements.

Accounts Supervision

* Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, payroll and ledger reconciliation.
* Review purchase, sales, expense, journal and bank entries.
* Ensure timely bank, customer, supplier and inter\-branch reconciliations.
* Monitor inventory valuation and coordinate physical stock verification.
* Guide and supervise the accounts team and allocate responsibilities.
* Maintain accurate records in Tally or the company’s accounting software.

Candidate Requirements

* Chartered Accountant, CMA, CA Inter, MBA Finance or M.Com with relevant experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in finance, accounts and taxation, preferably in a manufacturing, importing, engineering or government\-supply company.
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax, accounting standards and statutory compliance.
* Experience in bank guarantees, letters of credit, working\-capital management and foreign remittances.
* Knowledge of GeM contracts, government tenders and public\-sector billing will be highly preferred.
* Proficiency in Tally, MS Excel and financial\-reporting tools.
* Strong analytical, leadership and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality and attention to detail.

Preferred Attributes

* Commercially aware and capable of supporting management decisions.
* Proactive in identifying financial risks, cost\-saving opportunities and compliance issues.
* Able to manage multiple deadlines and coordinate with different departments.
* Comfortable dealing with banks, auditors, consultants, suppliers and government customers.
* Capable of independently managing the finance and accounts department.

Salary: Commensurate with qualifications, experience and capabilities.

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with their current salary, expected salary and notice period to : info@foryourresque.in
