title: Expense Analyst
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if youre ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. Job Summary As an Expense Analyst at Everpure, you will safeguard company resources and deliver an exceptional employee experience by modernizing our global Travel & Expense (T&E) operations. Operating at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and policy governance, you will partner cross-functionally across global business units to optimize expense auditing, minimize financial risk, and drive process automation. This role offers the opportunity to leverage cutting-edge platforms like Concur and AppZen to transform routine audits into strategic operational insights. Responsibilities Drive Global Audit Excellence: Execute comprehensive expense report reviews using Concur Expense and AppZen AI tools, auditing expenditures, foreign exchange rates, and itemized costs to guarantee adherence to Everpure's Global T&E policies. Optimize Processes & Automation: Utilize data analytics and Intelligence Reporting to identify operational bottlenecks, streamline auditing workflows, and scale process efficiency across global business units. Mitigate Financial Risk & Enhance Controls: Proactively evaluate expense patterns to strengthen internal controls, preventing duplicate reimbursements, identifying system inconsistencies, and reducing fraud risk. Deliver High-Touch Stakeholder Support: Serve as a subject matter expert for global employees, resolving complex T&E queries promptly while delivering high-quality customer service. Standardize Operational Documentation: Maintain robust departmental documentation and collaborate across finance teams to establish standardized reporting and continuous T&E process improvements. What You Bring 4+ years of professional experience in global expense auditing, financial analysis, and corporate expense policy enforcement. In-depth expertise using modern expense management and analytics technologies, specifically Concur Expense, AppZen, Concur Intelligence Reporting, and Google Workspace tools. Strong analytical, data-driven, and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to evaluate complex expense data, apply sound corporate judgment, and handle sensitive information confidentially. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a customer-centric mindset focused on collaborating effectively across diverse, cross-functional teams. We are primarily an in-office environment, and therefore you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Description: Footer Overall Purpose of The Job The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day-to-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India u2014 booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end booking-to-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds. Oversee high-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release. Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms. Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees. Own the month-end and year-end close for the Finance Operations sub-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger. Prepare and review unit-level and product-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan. Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership. Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs). Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team. Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR-2B mismatches with vendors. Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations. Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross-border settlements. Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection. Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle Key Metrics / Success Measures Timely and accurate operational close: sub-ledger close completed within 4-5 business days of month-end with zero material post-close adjustments. Payment discipline: on-time payment rate of [u2265 98%] and DPO within targeted range. BSP, gateway and agent-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month. Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations. Accurate and timely unit-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence. Job Profile Requirements 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team. Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools. Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage. Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross-border payments). Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes. Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners. Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics. Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles. Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience. Chartered Accountant (Mandatory). Required Languages: Good spoken and written English language skills Travel Requirements: Not applicable / minimal.

title: Account Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced accounting professional to manage daily accounts, Tally entries, invoicing, banking, GST and TDS compliance, financial documentation and management reports. The candidate should independently maintain accurate books and coordinate with management and the companys Chartered Accountant. 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Accounting & Tally Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses and journal entries in Tally. Maintain ledgers, reconcile balances and ensure accurate supporting documents. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, petty cash and expense reimbursements. Complete monthly closing entries, including provisions, accruals and depreciation. 2. Profit & Loss and Financial Reports Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, balance sheet schedules and cash-flow reports. Review income, expenses and margins; highlight unusual entries or cost increases. Prepare reports on outstanding payments, collections, sales, purchases and expenses. Submit accurate monthly MIS reports to management within agreed timelines. 3. GST & TDS Prepare GST workings, reconcile purchase records with GSTR-2B and coordinate return filing. Check GST details on sales and purchase invoices and maintain input tax credit records. Calculate applicable TDS, prepare payment workings and coordinate returns and certificates. Maintain compliance records and follow up with the CA on discrepancies and pending matters. 4. Banking & Payments Perform bank reconciliations and track receipts, payments and bank charges. Prepare vendor payment schedules and banking instructions for authorised approval. Maintain banking documents and coordinate routine queries with banks. Monitor cash and bank balances and report upcoming payment requirements. 5. Invoicing & Commercial Documents Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes as required. Verify invoices against purchase orders, agreed prices, payment terms and delivery records. Prepare or coordinate e-invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans and supporting documents where applicable. Coordinate with sales, purchase and dispatch teams for accurate and timely billing. 6. Receivables, Payables & Documentation Follow up on customer payments and reconcile customer and vendor accounts. Maintain ageing reports and highlight overdue balances. Organise invoices, vouchers, purchase orders, bank records and statutory documents. Provide records and schedules for audits, assessments and CA reviews. Maintain confidentiality and follow company approval procedures. 
 Preferred candidate profile Strong practical knowledge of Tally Prime and MS Excel. Hands-on experience in GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and monthly accounts closing. Ability to prepare and explain P&L statements and accounting reports. Good attention to detail, communication and follow-up skills. Ability to manage deadlines and work independently. Experience in manufacturing, trading or export businesses is an advantage. Performance Expectations Accurate, up-to-date books with complete supporting documents. Timely monthly closing and management reporting. Regular reconciliation of banks, customers and vendors. Timely compliance preparation and escalation of pending issues. Properly approved payments and prompt reporting of discrepancies.

title: Manager, Finance Operations
description:
Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Description: Footer Overall Purpose of The Job The Manager, Finance Operations oversees the day-to-day financial transaction cycle of Aspire Lifestyles India u2014 booking settlements, vendor payables, receivables, refunds, agent commissions, payment gateway operations, and the associated reconciliations. The role owns the operational close for the transaction cycle, ensures alignment of financial operations with corporate goals, safeguards controls and compliance, and partners with Operations, Sales, Technology and the wider Finance team (Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to enable accurate, timely and well-controlled financial outcomes. The role leads a team of Reconciliation Specialists and is a key contributor to process automation and continuous improvement across the Finance Operations function. Key RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end booking-to-settlement cycle: airline Billing and Settlement Plan reconciliations, GDS feeds, hotel and DMC payouts, aggregator settlements and traveller refunds. Oversee high-volume accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring accurate matching against booking inventories and supplier statements before release. Manage global agent commissions, incentive payouts and B2B ledger positions; ensure timely and accurate settlement in line with contractual terms. Oversee payment gateway operations, including reconciliation and monitoring of Pass-through and Merchant of Record transactions, chargebacks and gateway fees. Own the month-end and year-end close for the Finance Operations sub-ledgers (AP, AR, gateway, agent commissions), including accruals, provisions and reconciliations to the general ledger. Prepare and review unit-level and product-level profitability analyses for leadership; explain movements, margins and variances against plan. Deliver operational MIS, payment forecasts, aging analyses, settlement dashboards, gateway performance to the Head of Finance and business leadership. Coordinate closely with the Manager, Financial Reporting and the Tax function to ensure timely statutory reporting, tax compliance and consolidation inputs Design, operate and continuously improve internal controls over the transaction cycle (segregation of duties, approval matrices, exception reviews, reconciliation signoffs). Ensure compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS), company policies and Standard Operating Procedures across the operations team. Support GST, TDS and other statutory workings for AP/AR transactions in coordination with the Tax function; oversee resolution of GSTR-2B mismatches with vendors. Serve as the primary Finance Operations interface for internal, statutory and tax auditors; own timely closure of audit observations. Monitor and forecast cash outflows and inflows arising from the transaction cycle; partner with Treasury on funding requirements and FX exposures on cross-border settlements. Optimise working capital through disciplined payment runs, refund cycles, dispute resolution and receivables collection. Drive automation and simplification across the transaction cycle (invoice capture, reconciliation, workflow approvals, payment file generation, gateway reconciliation Standardise SOPs and drive measurable improvement in turnaround time, accuracy and control effectiveness Lead, develop and mentor a team of Reconciliation Specialists responsible for BSP, GDS, gateway, vendor and agent-commission reconciliations across the transaction cycle Key Metrics / Success Measures Timely and accurate operational close: sub-ledger close completed within 4-5 business days of month-end with zero material post-close adjustments. Payment discipline: on-time payment rate of [u2265 98%] and DPO within targeted range. BSP, gateway and agent-commission reconciliations completed monthly with all breaks investigated and cleared within the following month. Zero missed statutory due dates for AP/AR-related tax filings; clean statutory, internal and tax audits with no significant Finance Operations observations. Accurate and timely unit-level profitability reporting to leadership within agreed cadence. Job Profile Requirements 9 to 12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, including at least 3 years leading a team. Prior experience in the travel, hospitality or aviation sector strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to BSP settlements, GDS environments, DMC/aggregator payouts and payment gateway operations Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO); comfort with finance systems integrations and reconciliation tools. Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query); familiarity with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau) an advantage. Sound knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Indian tax laws (GST, TDS, withholding on cross-border payments). Understanding of payment gateway mechanics, Pass-through vs Merchant of Record models, and card scheme / chargeback processes. Strong leadership presence with the ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills; able to engage confidently with leadership and external partners. Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment in applying policy and controls while resolving exceptions pragmatically. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and ethics. Effective under time pressure and shifting priorities; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across close, audit and business cycles. Qualifications Bachelors degree in accounting/finance or equivalent experience. Chartered Accountant (Mandatory). Required Languages: Good spoken and written English language skills Travel Requirements: Not applicable / minimal.

title: Finance Controller/Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Head of Finance / Finance Controller to take ownership of the finance function at Habanero Foods. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can independently manage the core finance function while partnering closely with the founder and the CFO. The role will cover accounting, financial reporting, MIS, AR/AP, inventory, cash flow forecasting, cash management, compliance, controls and commercial finance. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to build and lead a finance team as the business scales. 
 Role & responsibilities : 1.Finance & Accounting Own day-to-day finance and accounting operations. Drive timely monthly book closure and ensure accuracy of accounting records. Prepare monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and management MIS. Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, inventory, receivables and payables. Improve accounting processes and finance systems. Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors and external stakeholders. 2. MIS & Business Reporting Own the monthly MIS and management reporting process. Prepare variance analysis against budgets, forecasts and prior periods. Develop business dashboards and management KPIs. Provide insights on revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating costs and profitability. Partner with the CFO and Founder on financial and business analysis. Develop reporting to enable faster and informed business decisions. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Own weekly and monthly cash flow forecasting. Maintain rolling cash flow forecasts and proactively identify funding requirements and cash gaps. Monitor collections, vendor payments, inventory and overall working capital. Drive improvements in the cash conversion cycle. Support cash management, banking and treasury activities. Partner with the Founder and CFO on working capital strategy and funding requirements. 4. Accounts Receivable & Payable Own the AR and AP function. Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve deductions, claims and disputes. Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments. Establish effective credit, collection and payment processes. Track ageing and working capital metrics and proactively escalate issues. 5. Quick Commerce & Marketplace Finance Own financial reconciliations across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms. Reconcile platform sales, settlements, commissions, discounts, claims, deductions, marketing spends and other charges. Identify and recover incorrect deductions, claims and short payments. Track platform-wise revenue, gross margin and contribution margin. Partner with sales and operations teams to improve channel profitability. Establish robust marketplace reconciliation and settlement tracking processes. Prior experience with quick-commerce or marketplace platforms will be an advantage. 6. Inventory & Cost Management Own inventory accounting and stock reconciliation. Monitor inventory levels, ageing, stock movement and holding periods. Analyse product-level gross margins and manufacturing costs. Track wastage, expiry, write-offs and inventory variances. Support costing and financial evaluation of new product launches. Partner with operations and supply chain teams to identify cost optimisation opportunities. 7. Budgeting & Financial Planning Support annual budgeting and business planning. Prepare rolling forecasts and periodic reforecasts. Build financial models for new products, channels and growth initiatives. Analyse profitability across products, channels and customers. Support decisions on pricing, promotions, marketing spends and channel expansion. 8. Compliance & Financial Controls Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate statutory and tax audits. Strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs. Establish controls across procurement, inventory, sales, collections and payments. Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes. 9. Team Building & Finance Function Development Build and develop the finance team as the business scales. Define roles, responsibilities and processes within the finance function. Mentor and develop finance team members. Establish scalable finance processes and controls. Build a finance function that supports the companys transition from an entrepreneurial setup to a larger, professionally managed organisation Qualification CA preferred CMA / MBA (Finance) with strong relevant experience may also be considered. Strong accounting and finance fundamentals are essential. Experience 46 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts / Financial Controllership. Experience in D2C, FMCG, Food & Beverage, e-commerce, consumer brands or quick commerce strongly preferred. Experience managing a finance function independently will be an advantage. Experience with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplace platforms is highly desirable. Strong experience in AR/AP, inventory accounting, working capital and cash flow management . Experience in a high-growth entrepreneurial environment preferred. Technical Skills Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Experience with Zoho Books, Tally or similar ERP/accounting systems . Strong understanding of GST, TDS and statutory compliance. Experience in MIS preparation, budgeting and financial analysis. Strong understanding of inventory and cost accounting. Ability to build and maintain cash flow forecasts. 





 Preferred candidate profile

Key Skills: Financial Statements,Financial Reporting,Financial Reconciliation,financial planning,Inventory Management,Accounts Receivable,Budget Forecasting,Working Capital Management

title: Audit & Accounts Executive (UK Audit + Year-End Accounts)
description:
We are seeking a ACCA or part-qualified, detail-oriented Audit & Accounts Semi-Senior (ACCA preferred) to join Ark India (Support) Pvt Ltd , a subsidiary of Ark & Co Ltd (UK) . This is a dual-focus role covering UK statutory audits and preparation of year-end financial statements under FRS 102 / FRS 105. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to UK audit methodology, strong technical accounting knowledge, and the ability to take ownership of sections of an audit file and a set of year-end accounts from planning through to completion. Working from our Pitampura, Delhi office as part of an international cross-border team. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Statutory Audit (UK GAAP / ISA (UK)): Execute planning, fieldwork, and completion procedures on UK statutory audits under ISA (UK) , working under the direction of UK-based managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Prepare audit working papers on areas such as revenue, purchases, payroll, fixed assets, cash & bank, debtors, creditors, accruals, prepayments, and related party transactions. Perform risk assessment, walkthroughs, tests of controls, substantive analytical procedures, and detailed substantive testing with appropriate sampling. Draft and refine audit file sections on CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS, or similar audit software, ensuring documentation meets ISA (UK) evidence and cross-referencing standards. Identify and escalate audit issues, control weaknesses, misstatements, and potential adjusting journal entries; draft management letter points. Support completion procedures analytical review, going concern assessment, subsequent events, and management representation letters. 
 Year-End Accounts Preparation: Prepare statutory financial statements for UK limited companies under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105 , in accordance with the Companies Act 2006. Post year-end adjustments depreciation, accruals, prepayments, deferred/current tax, dividends, directors' loans, corporation tax provisions and roll forward trial balances. Draft primary statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss / Income Statement, Cash Flow where applicable) with supporting notes and required disclosures. Assist in preparing corporation tax computations (CT600) and iXBRL tagging where required, coordinating with the tax team. Reconcile prior-year comparatives, ensure consistency with statutory filings, and prepare files for RI/manager review. 
 Compliance & Coordination: Support VAT return reviews, HMRC filings, and confirm all engagements meet UK accounting, auditing, and tax standards. Liaise with UK-based managers, partners, and clients (via email/calls under supervision) to resolve queries and request supporting information. Ensure secure, confidential handling of client data in line with GDPR and firm-wide information security policies. 
 Continuous Improvement & Client Service: Identify and propose incremental improvements to audit and accounts preparation processes, checklists, and templates. Support the UK team in delivering excellent client service through clear communication, sound time management, and proactive follow-up. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Educational Background: ACCA (qualified or part-qualified), CA Inter (IPCC / Intermediate cleared) . Sound working knowledge of FRS 102, FRS 105, and ISA (UK) ; familiarity with the Companies Act 2006 disclosure framework. 
 Experience: 1 - 4 years of relevant experience in a UK-based accounting or audit practice (in-house UK firm or Indian GDC/KPO servicing UK clients). Demonstrable exposure to UK statutory audits and year-end accounts preparation candidates with pure bookkeeping backgrounds only will not be suitable. Prior experience across sectors such as owner-managed businesses, property/SPVs, professional services, or financial services will be an advantage. 
 Technical Skills: Proficient in CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS Accounts Production, ProAudit, or similar audit and accounts production software. Working knowledge of Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, and IRIS bookkeeping modules for extracting trial balances and reviewing underlying records. Strong Excel skills lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations, and audit sampling. Understanding of UK corporation tax, VAT, and HMRC filing processes at a supporting level. 
 Soft Skills: Strong written and verbal English communication comfortable drafting audit queries and client-facing emails. High attention to detail, professional scepticism, and ownership of assigned sections. Ability to collaborate across UKIndia time zones and meet tight statutory deadlines. Integrity, punctuality, and reliability; open to feedback and continuous learning. Awareness of UK business culture and firm-facing professionalism is a plus. 
 What to Expect in This Role Mentorship: Direct guidance from experienced UK-based Audit Managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Technical Growth: Exposure to a broad portfolio of UK statutory audits and year-end accounts across multiple industries. Integration: A genuine cross-border team seat – not siloed back-office work – with visibility on end-to-end engagement delivery. Impact: Your work will feed directly into signed audit opinions and filed statutory accounts for UK clients. Compensation: Competitive salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

title: Finance & MIS Associate / Assistant Manager
description:
Back to all roles Finance Finance & MIS Associate / Assistant Manager Bengaluru Experience: 1-3 years Reports to: Head of Finance About the Role We are looking for a Finance & MIS Associate / Assistant Manager to work closely with our Head of Finance. The role will support accounting, compliance, MIS, audits, vendor payments, receivables, inventory tracking, documentation and business reporting. This is a good opportunity for someone early in their finance career who wants to work closely with leadership in a fast-growing deep-tech company. You should be detail-oriented, comfortable with numbers and documentation, and willing to build systems rather than only maintain existing ones. Key Responsibilities Support day-to-day accounting and finance operations. Assist in vendor invoice processing, payment documentation and expense tracking. Support GST, TDS, payroll and statutory compliance preparation. Assist with bank reconciliations and accounting entries. Support monthly MIS preparation and budget-versus-actual tracking. Maintain trackers for receivables, payables, purchase orders and collections. Coordinate with operations and manufacturing teams for inventory and production-related finance records. Support audit schedules, due diligence data, investor reporting and documentation. Help maintain financial records in Tally, Zoho, ERP or other company systems. Assist in preparing cash-flow reports, department-wise expense reports and working capital dashboards. Coordinate with vendors, consultants, auditors and internal teams for finance-related documentation. Requirements 1-3 years of experience in finance, accounting, audit, MIS or business finance. B.Com, M.Com, CA Inter, MBA Finance or equivalent background. Good understanding of accounting basics. Familiarity with GST, TDS, invoices, reconciliations and financial documentation. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills. Good attention to detail and documentation discipline. Ability to follow up across teams and close pending items. Comfortable working in a startup environment. Good to Have Experience in a startup, manufacturing, hardware, drone, robotics or technology company. Experience with Tally, Zoho Books, ERPNext, Odoo or similar systems. Exposure to inventory accounting or project-based cost tracking. Experience supporting audits, due diligence or investor MIS. Who Will Succeed in This Role You will do well if you are accurate, organised and curious about how business numbers connect with real operations. This is not just a bookkeeping role. You will help build the finance systems that support SUINDs next stage of growth. Why Join SUIND At SUIND, you will work on technology that leaves the lab and operates in the real world. Our drones are designed for environments that are complex, messy and high-value - farms, plantations, infrastructure sites, industrial assets, remote areas, security-sensitive zones and other places where reliable autonomous aerial systems can make a meaningful difference. You will be part of a team building core autonomy, aerial robotics, embedded systems, field operations, manufacturing capability and commercial platforms from India for global-scale markets. The work is hard, interdisciplinary and deeply hands-on - but it is also meaningful.

title: Assistant Manager - Finance
description:
Assistant Manager Finance 
 The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As Indias first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build whats next. If youre driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, youll feel right at home here. 
 About the Role This is a high-impact role within the finance function of one of India’s fastest-scaling fintech and crypto platforms. You will play a key role in driving revenue assurance for the core business, building meaningful MIS and reporting frameworks, managing entity-level accounting and reporting, and leading automation initiatives across finance operations. The role offers hands-on exposure to VDA accounting across multiple entities and the opportunity to solve complex finance challenges across crypto, treasury, banking, and global operations while building scalable processes and controls for the future of digital finance. 
 What You’ll Do Manage financial accounting, reporting, and support consolidation activities for multiple global entities while ensuring timely and accurate closures.  Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes including preparation and review of financial statements, schedules, and disclosures.  Drive MIS-to-financial statement reconciliations to ensure accuracy and consistency across group reporting.  Support revenue assurance for the core business by validating revenue reporting, reconciliations, and maintaining proper audit-ready documentation.  Work closely with auditors, tax consultants, and regulators to ensure compliance with IGAAP/Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and other applicable requirements.  Improve finance processes, internal controls, and reporting frameworks to build scalable and efficient operations.  Lead finance automation and ERP enhancement initiatives, including Oracle NetSuite optimization and reporting improvements.  Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Tax, and Operations on business and regulatory initiatives.  Assist in preparing quarterly employee engagement and spend reports for business unit heads to provide visibility into budget utilization. 
 You’ll Excel in This Role If You Think like an owner and operate with high accountability in fast-moving environments.  Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to complex operational and accounting challenges.  Have strong technical depth across financial reporting, audits, and compliance frameworks.  Bring exceptional attention to detail while balancing speed, accuracy, and execution.  Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across business, finance, and technology teams.  Continuously look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve systems and workflows.  Are comfortable working in high-growth environments where priorities evolve rapidly. 
 You’ll Know You’re Winning When Financial close processes are running smoothly with timely and accurate reporting across entities.  MIS and financial statement reconciliations are consistent, reliable, and provide clear visibility to leadership.  Revenue assurance processes are strengthened with minimal reconciliation gaps and audit-ready documentation always available.  Audit cycles are completed efficiently with reduced observations and stronger compliance readiness.  Finance processes and reporting workflows are becoming more automated, scalable, and operationally efficient.  Cross-functional stakeholders rely on you for accurate reporting, timely insights, and dependable execution.  ERP and reporting enhancements are improving data accuracy, turnaround time, and overall finance productivity. 
 Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You This is an opportunity to be part of the finance function at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech and crypto platforms. You’ll work on high-impact areas such as VDA accounting, revenue assurance, global reporting, and finance automation while partnering closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. It’s a chance to solve complex finance challenges at scale and contribute to building the future of digital finance. 
 Hiring Process Here’s what your journey with us looks like: Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – (If Required) A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios (If Required) Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit 
 Where We Work We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office , where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 
 Perks That Empower You We believe great people deserve great experiences. Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities 
 Ready to Build What’s Next? If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Finance Manager - Shared Services,  Pune
description:
Position Title 
 Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) Department 
 Financial Control Reporting Line 
 Head of Shared Services/Country Head Direct Reports 
 AP/AR Manager Location 
 Pune DBG HEALTH PURPOSE 
 Our vision at DBG Health is to enhance the health and well-being of all patients and consumers, by providing affordable access to health, wellness, and beauty products that improve the quality of their lives. 
 DBG HEALTH VALUES 
 All employees are expected to demonstrate the DBG Health PACT Values of Pioneering , Accountability , Collaboration and Tenacity when carrying out the accountabilities and responsibilities of their role. Further details about DBG Health PACT Values and Behaviours can be found on People Hub. 
 POSITION PURPOSE 
 The Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and delivery of the Pune Finance Shared Services team, ensuring AP and AR activities are executed accurately, efficiently and within agreed service levels. The role will manage daily priorities, workload and performance across the Pune team, while building capability, accountability and a high-performance culture. The role will work closely with the Head of Shared Services to continuously improve processes, strengthen controls and ensure consistent service delivery to the Group 
 ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Finance Operations & Daily Execution - Role - 25% 
 Lead the day-to-day operation of the Pune AP and AR function, ensuring all activities are completed accurately, efficiently and within agreed timelines. Set and manage daily priorities across the team, ensuring critical activities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements are clearly understood and delivered. Monitor workload and capacity across the team and appropriately allocate work to ensure balanced and effective execution. Maintain strong oversight of AP and AR processing, including invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliations, settlements and other transactional finance activities. Ensure month-end activities are completed accurately and on time, with appropriate preparation and planning across the team. Proactively identify operational issues, bottlenecks and risks and take action to resolve them before they impact service delivery. Act as the key escalation point for complex operational matters within the Pune Shared Services team. Ensure high standards of accuracy, timeliness and customer service are maintained every day. 2. Team Leadership & Capability - Role 25% 
 Lead, manage and develop the Pune Shared Services team of approximately 12 AP and AR team members. Establish clear expectations around performance, accountability, quality and service delivery. Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews to ensure priorities, issues and expectations are understood. Develop team capability through coaching, training, knowledge sharing and on-the-job development. Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate development plans to build a strong and sustainable team. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and customer focus. Identify and develop high-performing team members and support succession planning within the Pune function. Manage performance issues proactively and in accordance with company policies and processes. Build strong engagement across the Pune team and create an environment where team members understand how their work contributes to the broader Finance function. 3. Financial Controls, Quality & Compliance - Role 25% 
 Ensure AP and AR activities are completed in accordance with Group policies, procedures, controls and accounting requirements. Maintain strong oversight of transactional controls and ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval processes are followed. Review and monitor reconciliations, exception reports and other key control activities. Identify control weaknesses, recurring errors and process risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. Ensure audit requests and supporting documentation are completed accurately and within required timeframes. Work closely with Financial Control and other Finance stakeholders to resolve accounting, reconciliation and transactional issues. Ensure a strong control and compliance mindset is embedded within the Pune team. 4. Continuous Improvement & Efficiency - Role 10% Work closely with the Head of Shared Services and Continuous Improvement & Efficiency Lead to identify and implement process improvements.
 • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing, improve productivity, eliminate duplication and simplify ways of working.
 • Support the implementation of automation, system enhancements and standardised processes across the Pune team.
 • Ensure process improvements are effectively implemented and embedded into BAU operations.
 • Encourage team members to identify and raise opportunities for improvement.
 • Monitor the impact of process improvements on productivity, quality and service delivery. 
 5. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery - Role 10% 
 Build strong working relationships with Australian Finance teams and key business stakeholders.
 • Act as a key point of contact between the Pune Shared Services team and onshore Finance stakeholders.
 • Ensure stakeholder requests and escalations are appropriately prioritised and resolved.
 • Communicate proactively where deadlines, service levels or deliverables may be impacted.
 • Establish a strong customer service mindset within the Pune team.
 • Support the Head of Shared Services and AP/AR Manager in monitoring service levels and identifying opportunities to improve the Finance customer experience. 
 6. Engagement / Health, Safety and Wellbeing - Role - 5% 

 Adhere to and undertake duties in accordance with DBG Health's Health, Safety and Wellbeing policies, procedures and systems.
 • Act as an influential leader and business partner, collaborating across functions and constructively challenging existing practices to deliver better outcomes.
 • Lead by example and contribute to a positive, inclusive and high-performing team environment.
 • Embrace change and demonstrate agility when working through ambiguity and competing priorities.
 • Build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
 • Ensure confidentiality is respected and maintained at all times.
 • Participate in health and safety training and comply with relevant workplace safety requirements.
 • Identify and report hazards and incidents in accordance with DBG Health policies and procedures. 

 POSITION REQUIREMENTS Skills and Knowledge 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of financial controls. Demonstrated ability to manage daily finance operations in a high-volume Shared Services environment. Strong ability to prioritise competing workloads and ensure critical deadlines are consistently met. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve operational issues. Strong people leadership and team management capability. Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and motivate a team. Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly across offshore/nearshore and onshore operating environments. Ability to work effectively with senior Finance stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly. Strong understanding of month-end finance processes and transactional controls. Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify and implement process efficiencies. Strong systems aptitude and experience working with ERP and finance systems. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to analyse data, identify trends and develop reporting. Strong Microsoft Office 365 capability. 

 Desirable 
 Experience with Business Central, NetSuite or other ERP platforms. Experience working with offshore or nearshore Shared Services models. Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other reporting and automation tools. 
 Experience 
 Minimum 7-10 years' experience in finance, accounting or Shared Services, including significant experience in AP and/or AR. Demonstrated experience managing a finance team and delivering high-quality operational outcomes. Proven experience leading a team in a high-volume, deadline-driven finance environment. Demonstrated experience managing month-end and other critical finance deadlines. Experience working with Australian or multinational Finance teams desirable. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and maintain high standards of execution. Demonstrated experience implementing process improvements and driving operational efficiencies. Experience managing performance, developing team capability and building high-performing teams. Ability to operate autonomously while maintaining strong alignment with the broader Finance leadership team. Strong commercial and service-oriented mindset. 
 Qualifications 
 CA qualified required. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or related discipline Licences 
 N/A Travel 
 Domestic and international travel as required. KEY RELATIONSHIPS / STAKEHOLDERS Internal Stakeholders 
 Chief Financial Officer / Executive Finance Leadership Financial Control Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Tax Treasury Head of Shared Services Shared Services Continuous Improvement & Efficiency Lead Finance Shared Services Team Pune Finance Business Partners IT / ERP Team Supply Chain Australian Finance Teams People, Performance & Culture 
 External Stakeholders 
 External auditors External advisors and consultants 

 DECISION MAKING Decisions this role makes alone 
 Determine and allocate the daily workload and priorities across the Pune Shared Services team. Determine appropriate operational responses to routine AP and AR issues. Manage team performance, coaching, development and day-to-day people matters within delegated authority. Determine the appropriate approach to resolving routine stakeholder and transactional issues. Implement approved process improvements and changes within the Pune team. Prioritise resources to ensure critical Finance deadlines and service levels are achieved. 
 Decisions this role makes under guidance 
 Significant changes to AP or AR processes, controls or operating procedures. Changes that may materially impact financial reporting or Group Finance policies. Significant system changes or automation initiatives. Material changes to team structure, capability or resourcing. Complex accounting matters requiring technical finance input. Decisions this role escalates 
 Material financial, operational, compliance or control risks. Significant or recurring service delivery failures. Material issues impacting month-end close or financial reporting. Significant people or performance matters requiring escalation. Issues that cannot be resolved within the Pune team or require intervention from the Head of Shared Services or broader Finance leadership. Any matter that may have a material impact on the financial performance, reputation, legal compliance or strategic objectives of DBG Health. Direct financial accountability 
 N/A

Key Skills: Accounts Receivable,Accounts Payable,Payables,Accounting,Sharing,Financial management,Shared services,Management

title: Delivery Manager Operations - Finance ( O2C or R2R)
description:
Pay Band : 6 Country/Location: Noida, India Department: GSS English & Exams (IELTS Operations) Contract Type : 1 Year Fixed term contract  
 Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week  
 Training & Assessment Requirement 
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable. 
 Role Description/Purpose The Delivery Manager Operations is responsible for leading and managing end-to-end Finance Operations service delivery to ensure it is efficient, scalable, and consistently meets business and customer expectations. The role focuses on designing and implementing robust service delivery frameworks, including workforce planning, utilisation, and process optimisation, while ensuring adherence to defined service level agreements and quality standards. It plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and operational excellence across shared services, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure business continuity. The role also ensures strong governance, reporting, and compliance practices, enabling reliable and high-quality outcomes for stakeholders and customers in a global operating environment. 
 Qualifications & Experience Graduation in Commerce Written and verbal proficiency in English (British Council systems and global processes operate in English) 7+ years of experience in Finance Operations (O2C / R2R) / Shared Services 4+ years of people management experience Strong understanding of finance governance and controls Experience in reporting, dashboards, and MIS Experience in operational delivery in a global/shared services environment Strong understanding of Finance Operations & Shared Services delivery Expertise in financial governance and compliance frameworks Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills Desirable: Lean / Six Sigma certification Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) Experience in transitions / migrations Exposure to global capability centres 
 Role Accountabilities The role operates within the English & Examinations business, a key strategic and revenue-generating unit of the organisation, delivering services across a global network of over 100 countries. It functions in a shared services environment that supports multi-country operations, requiring high levels of standardisation, automation, and efficiency in processes. The Delivery Manager must balance ongoing service delivery with transformation and digital initiatives in a cost-conscious and resource-constrained setting, working closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business priorities, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements, while maintaining uninterrupted service delivery. 
 You will lead end-to-end delivery of Finance Operations services, defining and implementing service delivery frameworks covering staffing, scheduling and utilisation, and ensuring SLA compliance and high-quality customer interactions. You will establish escalation mechanisms and helpdesk structures, monitor risks and ensure mitigation and business continuity planning, and drive process standardisation to reduce operational inefficiencies. You will also ensure adherence to information security policies (ISO 27001/22301), monitor access controls and compliance within your teams, drive a security awareness and incident reporting culture, and ensure immediate action is taken in case of non-compliance or risks. 
 You will maintain strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders, communicating performance, issues and insights to leadership, managing MIS reporting on a daily, weekly and monthly basis, aligning service delivery with stakeholder expectations, and facilitating stakeholder reviews, governance forums and visits. On people and resource management, you will manage recruitment, onboarding and training of teams, drive performance management and productivity improvements, implement engagement and retention initiatives, and build a high-performing, motivated operations team. 
 On quality, you will ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards, deliver against KPIs and quality benchmarks, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and manage customer feedback and complaint resolution. On governance and reporting, you will provide insights through dashboards, reports and analytics, ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory and legal requirements, identify, assess and manage operational risks, and strengthen governance frameworks and reporting accuracy. 
 Further Information Right to Work: Locally recruited Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work.   
 Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role.  Relocation support is also not provided.

Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week. 
 Training & Assessment Requirement 
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable. 
 Role Description/Purpose To provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and operational supervision for the Operations team within Shared Services, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant processing of finance activities such as refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, vendor/customer queries, reporting and month-end support. The role holder will act as the first level escalation point for finance process queries, monitor SLA adherence, ensure required evidence is maintained, and contribute to continuous improvement activities led by Operations leadership so that finance services remain reliable, audit-ready and aligned to stakeholder expectations. 
 Qualifications & Experience Essential: Graduate (Mandatory) 5 years or more experience in finance operations (O2C, P2P & R2R), shared services, BPO/back-office operations, accounting support or transaction processing environment At least 2 years of team leading experience, preferably managing a finance operations team of more than 10 people Working knowledge of refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, month-end support, reporting or similar finance processes Understanding of finance operations, shared services, BPO/back-office service delivery and transaction processing controls Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel; ability to maintain trackers, reports, reconciliations and dashboards accurately Knowledge of SLA management, queue management, ageing analysis, quality checks, audit evidence and process documentation Good people and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with team members, managers and finance stakeholders Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle financial, personal and commercially sensitive information appropriately 
 Desirable: Experience in finance shared services, global operations, transition/hypercare support or multi-country finance processes Working knowledge of ERP/finance systems, workflow tools, Power BI, Power Query or advanced Excel reporting Lean/Six Sigma, accounting, finance or process improvement certification would be an advantage 
 Role Accountabilities The British Council Shared Services Centre supports English & Exams operations by delivering standardised, scalable and controlled back-office services across regions and countries. Finance Operations is a critical support function that enables timely and accurate processing of financial transactions, reconciliation activities, refunds, accruals, payroll inputs, reporting and query resolution. The Team Leader Operations will play a key role in managing daily workload, coaching team members, following agreed process controls, supporting month-end and audit requirements, and ensuring consistent team-level service delivery for internal stakeholders and regional finance/business teams. 
 You may be required to work extended hours during month-end, quarter-end, year-end, audit support, transition, training or hiring activities, and will manage high-volume and time-sensitive finance activities while maintaining accuracy, compliance, evidence logs and SLA monitoring within agreed procedures. 
 You will lead and coach Finance Operations team members to deliver accurate, timely and compliant processing of assigned finance activities, identifying risks, bottlenecks and potential SLA breaches early, taking corrective action within agreed procedures, and escalating higher-risk matters to the Delivery Manager using logical analysis and evidence-based information. You will support continuous improvement and process standardisation initiatives led by Operations leadership. You will supervise daily finance operations including refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, customer/vendor query handling and reporting activities as applicable to the process, ensuring work allocation, queue management, ageing review, prioritisation and timely closure of finance transactions within agreed SLAs and quality standards. You will act as the first level escalation point within agreed procedures for process queries, exceptions, pending approvals, reconciliation differences, payment/refund issues and stakeholder follow-ups, maintain SOPs, process maps, trackers, workflow notes and knowledge articles, and ensure team members are trained on process updates through a structured knowledge transfer approach. You will prepare shift plans, workload plans, handover notes and contingency support for peak finance cycles and critical business deadlines.  Senior Manager Accounts & Finance Experience: 5-6+ Years 
Qualification: CA / CA Inter / CMA / CMA Inter

 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager Accounts & Finance to manage accounting, financial reporting, banking, taxation, MIS and compliance functions across multiple family office entities and a not-for-profit Foundation. The role will work closely with the Founders Office. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Accounts & Financial Reporting Oversee accounting, books of accounts and financial records across multiple entities. Ensure accuracy, completeness and audit readiness of financial statements. Coordinate with statutory auditors and internal stakeholders for audits and financial closures. 
 MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare and oversee monthly MIS for the Founder. Consolidate financial performance, cash position and key financial metrics across entities. Improve MIS formats and reporting processes for timely financial visibility. 
 Banking & Treasury Manage banking relationships, account operations, documentation and coordination with relationship managers. Monitor fund flows, liquidity and treasury operations across entities. Support efficient utilisation and movement of funds. 
 Costing & Budgeting Manage programme/project-wise costing for the Foundation. Prepare budgets, track costs and conduct variance analysis. Support donor and grant-related financial reporting.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Job Title: Senior Accountant** 




  





**About Revata Engineering** 




 Revata Engineering was established in 2009 and is a part of the Revata Group of Companies. Revata Engineering is a well\-recognized manufacturer and supplier of equipment for the Oil \& Gas industry. The company's head office and manufacturing facility is in M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune. Revata is focused on the export market and has customers in over 30 countries. Revata's success is a result of competitiveness, efficiency, fast service, solid technical know\-how but above all a sincere and committed workforce.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a Senior Accountant with a minimum of 8–10 years of hands\-on experience in the
 **accounts department of a manufacturing company** 
 , with independent working knowledge of GST, TDS/TCS, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and import–export compliances as they apply to a manufacturing and exporting business.
 



 The role begins as a hands\-on position covering the complete accounting cycle. As the team grows, one or two junior accounts staff will be added under this position to handle routine transactional work. The Senior Accountant will supervise and review their work and will remain fully accountable for the compliance, accuracy, and timeliness of everything produced by the accounts team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounting Operations** 




 •   Carry out day\-to\-day general accounting: verifying, allocating, posting, and reconciling business transactions in Tally.
 



 •   Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable; monitor customer payments and follow up on overdue receivables.
 



 •   Prepare cheques / NEFT / RTGS transfers for suppliers and service providers.
 



 •   Handle and account petty cash disbursements.
 



**Banking and Treasury** 




 •   Manage multi\-currency transactions, inward and outward remittances, and USD\-to\-INR funds conversion when required.
 



 •   Coordinate daily with banks; prepare and update daily bank balances and coordinate with management for arrangement of required funds.
 



 •   Effectively resolve queries and discrepancies raised by customers, suppliers, or banks.
 



**GST and Direct Tax Compliance** 




 •   Prepare and file GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B monthly and GSTR\-9/9C annually; reconcile input tax credit with GSTR\-2B and follow up with vendors on mismatches.
 



 •   Manage e\-invoicing, e\-way bills, RCM liabilities, HSN classification, and job\-work documentation (delivery challans, ITC\-04\).
 



 •   Compute, deduct, and deposit TDS/TCS on time; file quarterly returns (24Q, 26Q, 27EQ); issue Form 16/16A; reconcile with TRACES, 26AS, and AIS.
 



 •   Support income tax return preparation and assessments in coordination with the company's tax advisors.
 



**Payroll and Statutory Contributions (PF / ESIC / PT)** 




 •   Prepare monthly payroll after considering leaves, loans, advances, and TDS, and process salary transfers to employee accounts.
 



 •   Compute and deposit PF and ESIC contributions, upload ECR, maintain UAN/KYC records, and file the related returns.
 



 •   Ensure Maharashtra Professional Tax (PTRC/PTEC) compliance.
 



**Export–Import Compliance** 




 •   Prepare export invoices, packing lists, e\-invoices, and e\-way bills; coordinate shipping bills and dispatches with CHAs, transporters, and freight forwarders.
 



 •   Ensure annual LUT renewal, e\-BRC closure against shipping bills, FIRC collection, and realization of export proceeds within FEMA timelines.
 



 •   Process duty drawback and RoDTEP claims; account for import bills of entry, customs duty, and IGST on imports.
 



 •   Maintain IEC, AD Code, and other export–import registrations and ensure all related compliances.
 



**Closing, Audit, and Reporting** 




 •   Lead the month\-end and year\-end closing process; coordinate inventory valuation with stores; assist statutory, tax, and GST auditors.
 



 •   Produce error\-free accounting reports and MIS and present results to management.
 



 •   Ensure integrity of accounting information through regulatory compliance and quality control over financial transactions and financial reporting.
 



**Team Supervision and Review** 




 •   Supervise the one or two junior accounts staff planned under this position; allocate and schedule their daily transactional work.
 



 •   Review vouchers, entries, reconciliations, and statutory workings prepared by the team before any payment is released or return is filed (maker–checker control).
 



 •   Remain personally accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and statutory correctness of all work done by the accounts team.
 



 •   Train junior staff on accounting discipline, documentation, and the statutory compliance calendar.
 



**General** 




 •   Ensure confidentiality of all information gathered during work.
 



 •   Diligently carry out any other work assigned by the management.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 •   Inter\-CA / M.Com / B.Com in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent.
 



 •   Minimum 8–10 years of proven accounts experience in a manufacturing company, with independent handling of GST, TDS, PF, ESIC, and import–export compliances in a manufacturing environment. Experience in an export\-oriented manufacturer is preferred.
 



 •   Must have personally prepared and filed (or reviewed and approved) GST, TDS, PF, and ESIC returns; working familiarity with the GST, TRACES, EPFO, and ESIC portals.
 



 •   Hands\-on experience with export and import documentation, remittances, and related banking compliance (LUT, e\-BRC, FIRC).
 



 •   Sound knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word).
 



 •   Knowledge of accounting for multi\-currency transactions.
 



 •   Experience supervising or reviewing the work of junior accounts staff is an advantage.
 



 •   Languages essential: fluent English, Hindi, and Marathi.
 



  





**This Role Is Not a Fit If** 




 •   Your experience is only in trading, services, banking, or a CA\-firm audit role, without in\-house accounts experience in a manufacturing company.
 



 •   You have less than 8 years of total accounting experience, or you are a CA fresher.
 



 •   You have not personally handled GST, TDS, PF, and ESIC filings.
 



 •   You have no exposure to export–import documentation and compliance.
 



  





**Location:** 
 M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune – 411026
 



**Office Timings:** 
 Monday – Saturday (9:30 AM to 6:30 PM)
 



**Remuneration:** 
 CTC will be as per industry standards.
 



 Interested candidates, please email your resume to
 **revata.hr@gmail.com** 
 .
 



 Please do not call the company as no recruitment\-related calls will be entertained.

* Flexible, collaborative, and innovative mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement through technology.
* Professional interpersonal skills; effective communicator and team player in a technology\-driven environment.
* Comfortable achieving results against quantitative and qualitative performance metrics, utilizing automation where possible.
* Advanced IT skills, including Excel and Outlook, plus experience in AI and analytics platforms.
* Experience in a large multinational company preferred.
* **Preferred:** CPA certification and demonstrated proficiency in AI\-driven Record\-to\-Report (R2R) activities.

This opportunity is tailored for visionary professionals eager to transform finance through **AI, automation, advanced analytics, and audit innovation** , setting new standards in accounting excellence.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**ABOUT SMARTFIN CONSULTING** 




 SmartFin Consulting is a fractional CFO and finance advisory firm that partners with founders and leadership teams to bring structure, clarity, and financial discipline to growing businesses. We work closely with startups and mid\-sized companies across IT/ITeS, FMCG, e\-commerce, services, and tech — supporting them through scaling, investor readiness, and stronger financial decision\-making.
 



 Collaboration, ownership, and execution excellence sit at the core of how we work. As we grow, we're looking for people who are comfortable working in dynamic, client\-facing environments, enjoy solving real business problems, and want to build deep, hands\-on finance expertise across multiple businesses.
 



 THE ROLE
 



 We're hiring a Financial Analyst with 1–2 years of experience to support our fractional CFO engagements. This role suits someone with a strong accounting and analysis foundation who wants exposure to multiple clients, industries, and business models.
 



 You'll work closely with SmartFin's leadership and client teams to support financial reporting, MIS, analysis, and process improvement; helping clients gain better visibility and control over their finances.
 



 You'll play a key role supporting financial operations and reporting across multiple client engagements: hands\-on accounting support, MIS preparation, analysis, and coordination with client teams, ensuring accuracy, discipline, and actionable insight. The ideal candidate has experience with Zoho Books / Tally, is comfortable working with imperfect data, and is eager to learn how finance supports real business decisions.
 



  





**CORE SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES WE'RE ASSESSING FOR** 




 Across the hiring process, we look for strength across six attributes:
 



**Core Finance \& Accounting Capability** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field, with 2–3 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting.
 



 • CA Intermediate, CMA\-qualified, or ACCA candidates are also eligible.
 



 • Strong accounting fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Zoho Books and/or Tally, along with working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian accounting standards.
 



**Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills** 




 • Comfortable analyzing revenue, costs, and margins to surface meaningful business insight, not just producing numbers.
 



 • Works confidently with imperfect or messy client data, and brings structure to it.
 



**Advisory \& Client\-Facing Skills** 




 • Explains financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
 



 • Coordinates comfortably with client accountants, auditors, and operations/sales teams.
 



**Fractional Model Fit** 




 • Enjoys exposure to multiple clients, industries, and business models rather than a single in\-house context.
 



 • Adapts quickly to different systems (Zoho Books, Tally, or similar) and client ways of working.
 



 SmartFin Culture \& Values Fit
 



 • Curious and proactive — keen to learn how finance drives real business decisions.
 



 • Collaborative and ownership\-driven; comfortable in a dynamic, client\-facing environment.
 



**Practical Execution** 




 • High accuracy and discipline: month\-end close, reconciliations, and data validation done right the first time.
 



 • Hands\-on with MIS preparation, budgeting support, cash flow tracking, and audit/compliance documentation.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\.Financial Reporting \& MIS** 




 • Prepare and review monthly MIS, financial statements, and management reports for clients.
 



 • Analyze revenue, costs, margins, and trends to highlight key business insights.
 



 • Support month\-end close activities, reconciliations, and data validation.
 



 • Assist in presenting clear, decision\-oriented financial insights to internal teams and clients.
 



**2\.Budgeting \& Forecasting Support** 




 • Assist in preparing budgets and financial forecasts for clients.
 



 • Track actual performance against budgets and identify variances.
 



 • Support scenario analysis and basic financial models as required.
 



**3\.Accounting \& Controls** 




 • Ensure accuracy of the general ledger and supporting schedules.
 



 • Help implement and maintain basic financial controls and documentation.
 



**4\.Cash Flow \& Working Capital Analysis** 




 • Track receivables, payables, and cash positions for clients.
 



 • Support cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis.
 



 • Assist with bank reconciliations and payment tracking.
 



**5\.Compliance \& Audit Support** 




 • Support GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance activities.
 



 • Coordinate with client accountants, auditors, and consultants as needed.
 



 • Help prepare schedules and documentation for audits and filings.
 



**6\.Systems \& Process Improvement** 




 • Work with Zoho Books, Tally, or similar accounting systems across clients.
 



 • Assist in improving templates, MIS formats, and reporting processes.
 



 • Support automation and process standardisation initiatives within SmartFin.
 



**7\.Client \& Internal Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with SmartFin's senior team and client stakeholders.
 



 • Coordinate with operations, sales, and external vendors to ensure financial data accuracy.
 



 • Build an understanding of different business models and operating structures.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS** 




**Education** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
 



 • CA Intermediate, CMA\-qualified, or ACCA candidates are also eligible.
 



**Experience** 




 • 1–2 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting roles.
 



 • Freshers with relevant qualifications and a strong foundation in accounting and finance are also encouraged to apply.
 



**Accounting Skills** 




 • Strong fundamentals, with hands\-on experience in Zoho Books and/or Tally.
 



 Compliance Knowledge
 



 • Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian accounting standards.
 



**Analytical Skills** 




 • Ability to analyze numbers and draw meaningful insights.
 



**Communication** 




 • Comfortable explaining financial information to non\-finance stakeholders.
 



**Mindset** 




 • Curious, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple clients.
 



**Attention to Detail** 




 • High accuracy and discipline in financial work.
 



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 




 • Exposure to multiple businesses and industries.
 



 • Hands\-on learning in a fractional CFO and advisory environment.
 



 • Opportunity to work closely with founders and senior leadership.
 



 • Structured learning and professional development.
 



 • A collaborative, ownership\-driven work culture.
 


* • Competitive compensation aligned with growth and performance.

 Our Finance teams work closely with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and other cross\-functional organizations. The ideal candidate will bring strong controllership fundamentals along with experience in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, process improvement, automation, and stakeholder management.
