title: Assistant Manager –  Founder’s Office
description:
**Assistant Manager – Operations, Founder’s Office** 




**Location:** 
 Whitefield, Bangalore
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹3\.6–4\.8 LPA
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  




 About CertifyMe
 
 CertifyMe is a global SaaS company building trusted digital credential infrastructure for universities, enterprises, certification bodies and training organisations. Our platform enables organisations to issue, manage, verify and share digital credentials and connect achievements with skills and career opportunities.
 



 We are a growing technology company with an international customer base and an ambitious mission:
 **to make achievements and skills more trusted, portable and meaningful in the digital world.** 




  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an
 **Assistant Manager – Operations, Founder’s Office** 
 to work closely with the founders and support the smooth running of day\-to\-day business operations.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on, cross\-functional role** 
 covering Founder’s Office, finance coordination, customer collections, compliance coordination, HR operations, vendor management and general administration.
 



 You will work with the founders, internal team and external professionals including our
 **CA, CS, lawyers, auditors and other advisors** 
 .
 



 This is not a role where you will be restricted to one function. You will get broad exposure to how a growing SaaS company is built and operated.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
**Founder’s Office \& Business Operations** 



* Work directly with founders on business and operational priorities.
* Convert decisions into action items, track deadlines and drive closure.
* Maintain trackers and provide regular updates on pending activities.
* Identify operational gaps and proactively escalate issues.



**Finance \& Collections** 



* Coordinate with the CA/accounting team on invoices, payments, expenses, GST, TDS, payroll and financial documentation.
* Maintain accounts receivable and payable trackers.
* Track customer invoices, ageing and overdue payments.
* Follow up professionally with customers for outstanding payments and track commitments.
* Coordinate with Sales/Customer Success to resolve billing or documentation issues.
* Support basic financial reporting and cash\-flow visibility.



**CA, CS, Legal \& Compliance** 



* Coordinate with CA, CS, lawyers, auditors and other advisors.
* Track statutory, legal and corporate deadlines.
* Collect required information and documents and ensure timely submission.
* Track agreements, filings, certificates, renewals and other important documentation.



**HR \& People Operations** 



* Manage basic HR operations for the internal team.
* Coordinate onboarding, offboarding, attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee records.
* Support recruitment, interview coordination and joining formalities.
* Coordinate employee reimbursements and HR documentation.



**Administration \& Vendors** 



* Coordinate vendors, subscriptions, procurement and recurring business requirements.
* Track contracts, renewals and payment obligations.
* Maintain organised company records and documentation.
* Support other administrative requirements of the founders and company.



  




 Who We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **proactive, dependable, organised and highly execution\-oriented** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who:
 


* Takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded.
* Follows up until a task is actually completed.
* Is comfortable making calls and sending follow\-up emails.
* Can coordinate with customers, CA, CS, lawyers, vendors and employees professionally.
* Is comfortable working with numbers, invoices and Excel/Google Sheets.
* Can manage several different priorities during the same day.
* Notices small details but also understands the bigger business objective.
* Is comfortable working directly with founders in a fast\-moving startup.
* Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
* Has high integrity and understands the importance of confidentiality.



  




 Who We Are NOT Looking For
 
 This role may not be suitable if you:
 


* Prefer a narrowly defined job with responsibilities limited to one function.
* Need frequent instructions or reminders to complete tasks.
* Are uncomfortable with customer payment follow\-ups and collections.
* Prefer only desk\-based administrative work.
* Are looking purely for an HR, accounting or receptionist role.

title: Quant Model Risk Analyst/Associate - Counterparty Credit Risk
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view. As part of the firm's model risk management function, the Model Risk Governance and Review group is charged with developing model risk policy and control procedures, performing model validation activities, providing guidance on a model's appropriate usage in the business context, evaluating ongoing model performance testing, and ensuring that model users are aware of the model strengths and limitations.


As a Quant Modelling Analyst/Associate you will be a member of the Model Risk Governance and Review group in Bengaluru covering Counterparty Credit Risk models where you will have exposure to multiple assets classes, collateral modelling, advanced modelling methodologies as wells as day\-to\-day interaction with Quantitative Research teams, Risk functions and trading desks. Your position will focus on the following activities:

**Job responsibilities:**

* Model validation of trading models/pricers used in XVA, Counterparty Credit Exposure and IMM/Capital calculations and regulatory stress testing.
* Perform assessments of the conceptual soundness of model specification, the appropriateness of the methodology for its intended purpose, reasonableness of assumptions and reliability of inputs and assessment of model limitations
* Assess completeness of testing performed to support the correctness of the implementation
* Perform ongoing performance monitoring tests and regulatory/non\-regulatory back testing to ascertain that models are relevant and fit for purpose.
* Assist with model governance processes, model inventory and issue management and help to devise new model governance policies as and when required.
* Work closely with model developers, trading desks, and controls functions across the firm to understand methodology, usage and establish transparency around model controls, model limitations and performance

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Quantitative background with at least a bachelors degree in Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quant Finance, or similar.
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills; knowledge of probability theory, statistics, mathematical finance, econometrics, numerical methods and stochastic calculus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently, with remote supervision
* Risk and control mindset: ability to ask incisive questions, assess materiality and escalate issue

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Knowledge and interest in Python programming
* Understanding of finance industry, particularly in modeling\- valuation, risk, capital, forecasting, investment management


**ABOUT US**

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Underwriting & Analysis - Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Summary:**  

Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.  

In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.  

Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.

 **Major Duties:**  

* Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
* Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
* Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
* Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
* Contributes to division\-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
* Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
* Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process\-related guidelines, and controls.
* Consistently adheres to established QUALITY \& QUANTITY SLAs.
* Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
* Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
* Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.

  

**Qualifications:**  

* Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
* Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.
**Experience \& Skills:**  

* 2 \- 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution\-based’ approach
* Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
* Self\-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
* Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
* Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.
 **Shift Coverage:** EMEA \- 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST

 **About the Team**  

This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long\-term organizational resilience.  

The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
* The Bank Reconciliation Specialist is responsible for performing the initial steps in the payment posting process. Daily assignments are provided by the supervisor, and the specialist must develop a plan to complete assigned worklists by the end of each day. The Bank Reconciliation Specialist must comply with applicable billing standards and operate effectively in a team\-oriented environment, delivering superior service to providers across the country.


**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Create monthly reconciliations for individual clients. (Monthly)
* Log into bank portals to download bank statements using Month\-to\-Date filtering and save them to the designated client folder for the current month. (Daily)
* Download Lockbox and Correspondence files. (Daily)
* Rename Lockbox and Correspondence files according to standard file naming conventions and upload them to the document management system. (Daily)
* Input new daily deposit totals from the previous business day for dashboard reporting. (Daily)
* Place prior day deposits on the client's monthly reconciliation log. (Daily)
* Update post logs daily for current and prior month reconciliations to ensure alignment with the bank statements. (Daily)
* Research and upload any missing remits for posting. (Daily)
* Investigate and resolve posting variances found in the bank statement. (Daily/Weekly)
* Perform daily checks to identify any remits not posted within 3 days and coordinate with the posting team for timely completion. (Daily/Weekly)
* Investigate and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve any variances identified in the reconciliation logs. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Monitor daily ERA checks to ensure they are posting automatically; notify the supervisor if any ERAs are not being received. (Daily/Weekly)
* Provide insurance and check details for ERA setups when necessary. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Review and compare reported deposits against Bank Statement totals to verify that all data is accurate, reconciled, and up\-to\-date. (Weekly)
* Identify Ventra and Non\-Ventra payments.
* Ensure all daily, weekly, and monthly tasks are completed accurately and do not require rework or cross\-checking. (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1\) year of experience reconciling bank account deposits.
* Knowledge of payor portals is preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .


**Ventra Health**

 Ventra Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culturally diverse organization. We strive for inclusiveness and a workplace where mutual respect is paramount. We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. title: T24 Test Analyst – Derivatives / Structured Products / Credit
description:
As a **T24 Test Analyst – Derivatives, Structured Products \& Credit**, you will validate T24 functionality, execute end‑to‑end testing, analyse business requirements, prepare test scenarios, and ensure successful delivery of complex financial product implementations and enhancements. You will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to support SIT, UAT, regression, and integration testing across capital markets and credit products.

 **What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed**

**Requirement Analysis \& Test Design**

* Analyse business and functional requirements related to derivatives, structured products, and credit.
* Design, prepare, and execute test cases, scenarios, and scripts for T24 implementations.
* Validate trade lifecycle processing, product setup, pricing, settlements, accounting entries, and reporting.

**Testing Execution \& Support**

* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and UAT testing.
* Validate interfaces between T24 and upstream/downstream systems.
* Identify, log, track, and retest defects using defect management tools.
* Participate in test planning, execution reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Support production deployments and post‑implementation validation.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers, and Business Users.
* Clarify requirements and resolve defects with stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with banking regulations, risk controls, and operational processes.

 **We'd Love to Hear From You If...**

**Experience**

* You have 5–10 years of experience in T24 testing.
* You have strong knowledge of Temenos T24/Transact modules relevant to Treasury, Credit, and Capital Markets.
* You have validated T24 configurations, workflows, accounting, and interfaces.
* You understand derivatives products such as interest rate swaps, FX forwards, currency swaps, options, and futures.
* You have experience with structured products, corporate and investment banking products, and credit/lending products.
* You are familiar with trade lifecycle management and treasury operations.
* You have experience in core banking transformation or T24 migration programmes.
* You have exposure to capital markets and treasury platforms.
* You understand Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

**Technical Expertise**

* You are experienced in functional, SIT, UAT, integration, and regression testing.
* You have validated APIs and interfaces.
* You are proficient in defect management and test documentation.
* You have experience with JIRA, HP ALM/Quality Center, Confluence, and SQL.
* You are familiar with test management tools.

**Ways of Working**

* You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills.
* You manage stakeholders effectively and communicate clearly.
* You pay close attention to detail and risk controls.
* You collaborate well in team environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* You hold a bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* You have ISTQB certification (preferred).

**Assignment Details**

* Location: Chennai
* Employment Type: Full‑time

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
 **Financial Analyst** 
 with strong expertise in core financial focus areas. The ideal candidate will analyze financial performance, identify key business drivers and variances, develop forecasts and scenario analyses, and provide actionable insights to support informed decision\-making.
   

  

 This role will partner closely with internal stakeholders and business teams to strengthen financial controls, improve reporting processes, maintain KPI dashboards, support month\-end close and audit requirements, and enhance overall financial visibility and operational efficiency.
   

  

 MTX is a global technology consulting firm that enables organisations to modernise through digital transformation. With data as the new currency, MTX helps transform long\-term strategy with outcomes in mind around happiness, health and the economy. MTX improves decision\-making with speed and quality by partnering with leading cloud technologies. MTX provides expertise across various platforms and technologies, including Microsoft, Google Cloud, Salesforce, artificial intelligence/machine learning, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, visualization, and mobile technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 The Financial Analyst is expected to execute the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Financial Planning, Analysis \& Forecasting:
* Lead and support monthly financial planning and analysis, including revenue accruals, forecasting, and project profitability analysis.
* Analyze actual performance versus budget and forecast, identify key variances, and provide clear explanations of business drivers, trends, and performance gaps.
* Develop and evaluate financial forecasts, budgets, and scenario analyses based on changing business conditions and management requirements.
* Internal Controls \& Process Improvement:
* Identify opportunities to strengthen internal controls, financial reporting, and business processes, and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and mitigate financial risk.
* Support the communication and implementation of changes to business practices, financial processes, and procedures, including training internal employees where required.
* Management Reporting \& Dashboards:
* Support the development and maintenance of financial dashboards and management reports, including key performance indicators (KPIs) and critical balance sheet metrics.
* Prepare, analyze, and review financial information and management presentations for periodic Executive Leadership Team reviews.
* Perform ad\-hoc financial and business analysis and provide actionable insights to improve the quality and effectiveness of management decision\-making.
* Month\-End Close, Audit \& Compliance:
* Provide support for month\-end close and financial reporting activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial information.
* Liaise with relevant teams to support audit, compliance, and statutory requirements, ensuring timely availability and accuracy of required financial information.
* Business Partnering \& Strategic Communication:
* Collaborate proactively with internal stakeholders and business partners to understand financial requirements, manage expectations, and deliver relevant insights and solutions.
* Identify emerging financial and operational trends and proactively communicate potential risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders.
* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**What you will bring:**
* Qualification Options:
+ Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1–2 years of experience in Financial Planning \& Analysis, OR
+ CA Inter with 6–8 years of experience in Financial Planning \& Analysis.

* Strong expertise in core financial focus areas: Financial Planning \& Analysis, Forecasting \& Budgeting, Revenue Accruals, Project Profitability, Management Reporting, Variance Analysis, Internal Controls, KPI Dashboards, Audit \& Compliance, and Business Partnering.
* Proven capability in analyzing financial performance variances, developing scenario analyses, and delivering actionable financial insights.
* Strong communication, presentation, and business partnering skills to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and Executive Leadership.
* Ability to identify operational risks/opportunities, support change management, and drive process improvements.

* Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan \- Self \+ Spouse \+ 4 Dependent Children)
+ Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/\-
+ Maternity cover upto two children
+ Cashless \& Reimbursement facility
+ Access to free online doctor consultation

* Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) \-
+ Sum Insured: INR. 25,00,000/\- Per Employee
+ Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
+ Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
+ Temporary Total Disability is covered

**Job Title – Senior Financial Analyst**
**About The Role**
 The employee will be responsible for managing end to end cash, banking, and related financial operations, ensuring strong governance, accuracy, and compliance across all processes. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, process excellence, and effective collaboration with cross functional teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage daily banking operations, including cash/bank reconciliations, expense allocation, and revenue allocation.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Payments, Banking, Treasury, Service Desk, OTC, Project teams, and other internal stakeholders.
* Perform reconciliation of revenue and expenses across systems, bank statements, and the general ledger.
* Ensure full compliance with SOX requirements, loss prevention practices, and always maintain audit readiness.
* Minimize unreconciled items and ensure aged open items from bank reconciliations are addressed promptly.
* Process, review, and approve journals and requests with 100% accuracy and in accordance with Best in Class (BIC) standards.
* Involve in Balance Sheet reconciliation preparations and reviews and ensure account reconciliations are prepared and completed with 100% accuracy and high\-quality standards.
* Execute month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end closing activities, demonstrating a commitment to exceptional delivery.
* Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and complete related reporting activities adhering to BIC standards.

* Proficiency in English, including strong verbal and business writing skills.

 Vantrock is an Operator led real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain — first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space — vertical industries, where our expertise transfers; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Reports to: Head \- Land \& Investments
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain the investment models — land acquisition, development cost, leasing, financing, operating cash flows and exit — with project and equity IRR, MOIC, yield on cost and development margin, documented and consistent with the team's standard.
* Own the market database. Micro\-market demand drivers, competing supply, rentals, land values, vacancy, absorption and infrastructure; comparable\-transaction and land\-value benchmarks; occupier movements across 3PL, manufacturing, e\-commerce, corporate office, hyperscaler and colocation.
* Run the diligence tracker and the data room. Coordinate the platform's partners, read their reports, summarise the findings and their impact, and track conditions precedent to closing.
* Prepare first\-cut screening notes and support the Associate on Investment Committee memoranda.
* Prepare the data for the monthly Asset Review with the Financial Controller \& Head of Asset Management — actuals against underwriting, cost against spend, leasing, drawdowns and returns — and the investment inputs to periodic investor reports.
* Support pipeline, track\-record and case\-study material for asset\-level capital, and site\-visit notes and location assessments for the Principal.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Warehousing, logistics and industrial at the core – required; office alongside; data\-centre exposure valued; residential as background only.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience with real exposure to live transactions — modelling, valuation, diligence support, IC materials or closing.
* Not a research\-only or reporting\-only seat. The Analyst works live deals to closing.
* A Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, commerce, engineering, real estate or a related discipline.
* CA / CFA preferred



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong financial\-modelling and analytical capability; advanced Excel and PowerPoint; fluent with AI tools for research and analysis.
* Clear writing, high attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams at once.
* Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, or relocating before joining. Willing to travel for site visits and diligence.
* Strong financial\-modelling, valuation and analytical capability.
* Sound understanding of real\-estate cash flows, development economics, capital structures and return metrics.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
* Fluency with AI tools and comfort building on dashboards.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to run several workstreams to tight timelines.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* CULTURAL FIT We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
* AI proficiency and partner command are standing requirements in every Vantrock seat: you work fluently with AI tools and build on the platform's dashboards, and you command the institutional partners who execute the transactional work.

description:
**Company Description** 
 The ArthAum Group is a privately held firm specializing in discretionary venture capital investments and advisory services. The organization partners with venture\-backed companies and investors to identify, evaluate, and grow high\-potential opportunities. ArthAum Group combines capital, strategic guidance, and industry insight to help portfolio companies scale responsibly and sustainably. The firm operates with a strong focus on analytical rigor, long\-term value creation, and collaborative partnerships. More information is available at www.arthaum.com.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Venture Partnership Analyst will support the evaluation, execution, and monitoring of venture investments and strategic partnerships. This full\-time hybrid role is based in Mumbai, with a mix of on\-site collaboration and some work\-from\-home flexibility. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting market and financial research, preparing investment memos, building and maintaining financial models, and assisting in due diligence on prospective investments. The role also involves tracking portfolio performance, preparing internal and external reports, and coordinating with founders, investors, and internal stakeholders. The analyst will contribute to strategic advisory initiatives, support partner meetings with data\-driven insights, and help refine the firm’s venture theses and sourcing strategies.

* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including financial modeling, valuation, and data analysis.
* Experience with market research, competitive analysis, and industry benchmarking in venture or related domains.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear memos, presentations, and reports.
* Solid understanding of venture capital, startup ecosystems, and investment processes.
* Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant research tools; familiarity with CRM or deal\-tracking software is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees or relevant certifications (e.g., CFA, CAIA) are a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment in Mumbai, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines with attention to detail.
* Demonstrated interest in technology, innovation, and early\-stage companies; prior internship or work experience in investment banking, consulting, or VC/PE is beneficial.

**Citi Wealth** 
 is a global leader in wealth management, dedicated to serving the world's most affluent individuals and families. Our mission is to provide unparalleled financial guidance, sophisticated products, and exceptional service to help our clients achieve their financial ambitions.
   

  

 The
 **Wealth Risk Management**

 Within this organization, the
 **Wealth Product and Portfolio Management (WPPM)**

WPPM is responsible for the ongoing management and oversight of credit portfolios, developing strategies to optimize risk and return, and ensuring our product offerings are aligned with the firm's risk appetite. We are increasingly focused on leveraging cutting\-edge technology and advanced analytics to drive decision\-making and foster sustainable business growth.

 This Senior Vice President role is a key position focused on revolutionizing our credit risk portfolio management capabilities through advancing key analytical skills, execution skills and development and integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools. The ideal candidate will be a forward\-thinking leader with a strong track record of execution, who can pivot our traditional risk management practices towards a more dynamic, data\-driven, and predictive approach.
   

  

 You will lead strategic high impact initiatives across the Wealth Wholesale Product organisation (Wealth Risk), partnering with First Line businesses, Product, Finance, Technology, and Operations to deliver portfolio transformation, risk management enhancements, process improvements, and regulatory commitments.

* Strategic Initiative Execution Across Credit: Drive and execute high\-impact strategic initiatives across the Wealth Wholesale Product organisation, partnering with Credit Risk, Enterprise Risk, First Line businesses, Product, Finance, Technology, and Operations to deliver portfolio transformation, risk management enhancements, process improvements, and regulatory commitments.
* Credit Portfolio Management \& Optimization: Lead the ongoing monitoring, analysis, and management of Wealth credit portfolios, identifying portfolio trends, concentrations, emerging risks, and opportunities to optimize risk\-adjusted returns while operating within approved risk appetite. * Risk Identification \& Mitigation: Proactively use advanced analytical techniques to identify potential and emerging risks in the portfolio and develop innovative, effective mitigation strategies.
* Change Leadership: Act as a change catalyst and an enthusiastic early adopter of new technologies. Take ownership for helping others understand the benefits of AI in risk management and maintain a positive outlook during the transition.

title: Procurement & MIS Executive
description:
We are a Mumbai\-based boutique real estate development company executing residential standalone and cluster redevelopment projects across Mumbai, with a backward integration into construction.
 



 We are looking for someone to work directly with the Partner on procurement and reporting. You will assist on four fronts:
 


1. **Procurement** 
 — floating enquiries, building comparatives, negotiating rates, and keeping the numbers in a form that supports decisions.
2. **Vendor coordination** 
 — ongoing liaison with vendors, contractors and consultants through award, delivery, execution and billing.
3. **Construction reporting** 
 — day\-to\-day reporting of site activity: progress against programme, material movement and consumption, manpower deployment, and the approvals and clearances sitting on the critical path.
4. **Inventory and general support** 
 — maintaining flat inventory across projects, coordinating with channel partners on availability, pricing and booking status, and handling the documentation, follow\-ups and day\-to\-day tasks that come with a small team.



  





**Responsibilities** 




***Procurement***



* Float enquiries and collect quotations from vendors, contractors and suppliers across civil, MEP, finishing and consultancy scopes
* Prepare comparative statements with rate analysis, technical parity checks and landed cost including GST, freight and taxes
* Negotiate commercial terms, payment schedules and delivery timelines; flag deviations from budget
* Draft and track work orders, purchase orders and vendor agreements; maintain approved vendor lists and rate history



***Vendor and consultant coordination***



* Follow up on material deliveries, mobilisation and execution timelines
* Coordinate with architects, RCC and MEP consultants, PMC, site teams and accounts on drawings, approvals and billing
* Process vendor bills — verify against PO and GRN, route for certification, track payment status and resolve disputes



***Construction reporting and MIS***



* Track site progress against construction programme: activity\-wise status, planned vs achieved, slippages and reasons
* Compile weekly and monthly project reports covering physical progress, manpower deployment, material consumption and procurement status
* Maintain budget vs actual, cash outflow schedules and cost\-to\-complete workings
* Maintain records of RA bills, measurements and certified quantities in coordination with site and PMC
* Report critical\-path delays, material shortages and pending approvals to management with supporting data



***Inventory and general support***



* Maintain flat inventory across projects — availability, pricing, allotment and booking status
* Coordinate with channel partners on inventory updates, site visits and documentation
* Maintain site stock records: material receipts, issue registers, physical verification and reconciliation against consumption
* Prepare presentation material and data packs for society meetings, lender discussions and internal reviews
* Maintain project documentation, correspondence records and statutory filing trackers



**Requirements** 



* **Attitude over CV** 
 — chasing answers, flagging problems before they surface, and picking up whatever is needed. No room for passengers.
* **Strong Excel** 
 — comparatives, lookups, pivots, clean formatting
* **Comfortable with AI tools** 
 — able to use them to build comparatives and reports faster, and to sense\-check the output
* **Able to read BOQs, drawings and specifications** 
 well enough to compare like with like
* **Fluent English with strong written grammar** 
 — reports and vendor correspondence go out in your words
* **Civil Engineering graduate preferred** 
 ; B.Com / BMS considered on the strength of the interview
* Work Experience is
 **NOT** 
 mandatory
* Located in Greater Mumbai



**Good to have** 



* Marathi and Hindi



**What you get** 




**Direct reporting to the Partner, visibility across the full development cycle from acquisition to handover, and real ownership.** 




**Compensation** 




 ₹50,000 – ₹85,000 per annum, based on experience.
 



**Apply with your CV and current CTC.**

 You will distinguish urgent decisions from hurried ones, protect controls that work, and make the cost of every exception visible.

title: Head - Portfolio Acquisitions & Collection Services
description:
**Job description** 




  





**Job Title: Head – Portfolio Acquisitions \& Collection Services** 




**Experience: 10\+ Years** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Function: Financial Services / Debt Acquisition and Resolution** 




  





**Kindly share your resume at careers@fatakpay.com** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Fatakpay is a technology\-led platform for the distribution of financial products, making credit and everyday financial services accessible to Indian consumers. Through its digital platform, the Group offers a range of products spanning consumer credit, personal loans, insurance and other embedded financial solutions, delivered in partnership with leading banks, NBFCs and insurers. Backed by an RBI\-registered NBFC, Fatakpay Group is now extending into alternative investments through Fatakpay Growth Ventures, a SEBI\-registered Category II AIF.
 



  





**About Fatakcollect** 




 Fatakcollect is a new initiate within the Fatakpay group (www.fatakpay.com), focused on retail debt acquisition and resolution. The business runs on two tracks:
 



  





 1\. Acquiring retail loan portfolios from banks, NBFCs and ARCs and collecting on them for our own account or in partnership with other FIs 
 



 2\. Providing collection services to other lenders on a fee / success basis, without deploying capital.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior professional to build and drive both the ides of this business. On one side, you will source, evaluate and acquire retail loan portfolios \- assessed on both valuation and collectability aspect. On the other, you will pitch to and win fee\-based collection mandates from banks, NBFCs, and other lenders. This is a hands\-on, front\-ended role for someone who understands the retail loan purchase / sell\-off process end to end and can independently take transactions and mandates from origination to closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Portfolio Acquisition (Principal)** 



* Source retail loan portfolios available for sale from banks, NBFCs and ARCs — across DPD buckets, written\-off pools and stressed assets.
* Evaluate portfolios from both a valuation and collectability standpoint — analysing vintage, bucket / DPD movement, historical resolution and roll rates, ticket size, geography, product mix and prior collection efforts.
* Build acquisition pricing and expected\-recovery models; recommend bid levels and deal structures.
* Manage the full acquisition lifecycle — data room / due diligence, bidding, negotiation, documentation and closure — coordinating with credit, risk, finance, legal and collections.
* Structure transactions across direct purchase / assignment and ARC\-led structures, as applicable.



  





**B. Collection Service Mandates (Fee\-based)** 



* Identify and pitch to banks, NBFCs and other lenders for third\-party collection mandates on a fee / contingency basis.
* Structure commercials (fee %, success\-linked slabs, SLAs) and negotiate mandate terms.
* Build and grow a pipeline of mandate opportunities; convert relationships into recurring, capital\-light revenue.
* Work with internal collections and ops teams to ensure mandates are deliverable and margins are protected.



  





**C. Relationships, Market \& Governance** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships across Banks, NBFCs, ARCs and other lenders.
* Track market pricing, buyer / seller appetite and fee benchmarks across retail asset classes.
* Ensure all acquisitions and mandates comply with applicable RBI and internal requirements.
* Support smooth portfolio handover, onboarding and post\-deal / post\-mandate monitoring.



  





**Required Experience \& Skills** 



* More than 10 years of experience in retail loan portfolio purchase / sale, distressed assets, collections or a related function.
* Direct, hands\-on experience at an ARC, bank or NBFC on retail loan purchase / sell\-off, with a clear understanding of the end\-to\-end process.
* Proven ability to evaluate portfolios on valuation and collectability and to build recovery / pricing assumptions.
* Existing relationships across banks, NBFCs, ARCs and institutional lenders.
* Good grasp of retail asset classes \- personal loans, consumer / BNPL, credit cards, business loans, LAP, home and vehicle loans.
* Strong commercial, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills; able to run transactions and mandates independently.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.

 Books should be properly reconciled and able to produce an accurate

 Our objective is to maintain our accounts and tax position

**accounting and taxation** 
**experience** 
 ,

 handling a small portfolio of clients

 The person does

 . Practical experience and the ability to independently produce accurate accounts and tax computations are more important.
 



  





**Essential Skills** 




  





 The candidate must have:

 **Tally**
* Good working knowledge of

* Experience preparing
 **Computation of Income**

**Job Description**
 The MiniMed Corporate Treasury Department manages the company’s cash and investments to ensure adequate liquidity for operating entities around the world, builds and maintains bank relationships, and seeks to reduce the financial risk arising from foreign currency exposures.
   

  

 Treasury works closely with internal stakeholders across finance, accounting, tax, HR, IT, legal and others, as well as external stakeholders including banks, investment firms, and other financial counterparties to achieve its objectives.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled Treasury Analyst to help execute our global treasury operations and help design and build our expanding treasury infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings an understanding of cash management operations and financial risk management with experience in a multinational firm with a global presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Work closely with banks on integrating banking systems with MiniMed financial systems for efficient payment processing and financial reporting.
* Monitor daily cash positions across multiple currencies and legal entities to ensure adequate operational liquidity for our global business.
* Execute wire transfers, intercompany funding, and other cash transfer activities.
* Create BI dashboards to drive actionable insights to inform process improvements and reduce financial risks.
* Identify, track, and analyze FX exposure, and assist in designing FX hedging strategies to mitigate currency risk.
* Perform financial analyses to help drive global treasury decision\-making.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to drive business performance.
* Perform SOX control reporting requirements
* Act as system administrator in bank portals and Treasury systems
* Global bank account administration

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field of study and experience working in a multinational company
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Ability to develop solutions and/or innovative ideas to problems and ensure that solutions are consistent with the organization’s objectives.

 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

title: Investment Banking Associate
description:
ABOUT CAPITAL CONNECT ADVISORS
 



  





 Capital Connect Advisors (CCA) is one of the most active tech\-focused boutique investment banks operating in SE Asia, India and Australia. We provide private placement, M\&A, and strategic advice to leading growth\-stage technology, AI, and digital infrastructure companies.
 



  





 CCA is growing and is looking to hire an Associate to support the execution of our transactions.
 



  





 This Delhi, India\-based role covers SE Asia and India. It is for exceptionally motivated and smart individuals to build a career in technology investment banking in two of the world’s largest and fastest\-growing technology markets.
 



  





 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 As an Associate, you will be a key member of the Corporate Finance team and involved in projects across the APAC region that may include, but are not limited to:
 



  




1. Support the VPs and Partners on deal execution for our private placement, M\&A, and/or strategic financial advisory mandates.
2. Build Financial Models including integrated three\-statement model, valuation, and cash flow modeling
3. Prepare key documentation including Pitch Decks, Information Memorandums, Management Presentations, etc.
4. Manage due diligence workflows, including data\-room organisation, coordination with service providers, and preparation of clients for investor Q\&A.
5. Drive project timelines, coordinate internal and external stakeholders, and ensure deliverables align with client expectations.
6. Provide background work for research and industry analysis with a focus on technology and the internet in SE Asia and India.
7. Contribute to internal process improvements, CRM enhancement, and tech\-led project management tools to scale execution efficiency.



  





 KEY COMPETENCIES
 



  




1. Mandatory requirement of 3\-6 years full\-time experience working in a boutique or mid\-market investment bank with a prior deal execution track record.
2. Good academic credentials from top institutions \- undergraduate or masters program.
3. Strong accounting and corporate finance knowledge.
4. Methodical, meticulous, and possess strong quantitative and analytical skills.
5. Excellent communication, business writing, and research skills.
6. Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines.
7. Ability to manage projects independently and be ready to assume a high level of responsibility as a member of a team.
8. Committed to excellence on assigned deliverables with high professional and ethical standards.
9. Familiarity with research databases and financial tools is a plus (e.g., Capital IQ, Tracxn, CB Insights, Crunchbase, Bloomberg, etc.).
10. Preference for candidates with demonstrated exposure to the startup ecosystem.



  





 CULTURE
 



  




1. We love our work – a demonstrable passion for the technology and start\-up space
2. Founders are the centre of our universe – optimize for our main client (the founder) to build long\-term relationships and trust

description:

 Real Jobs Consulting Services is a Gurgaon\-based placement firm known for delivering reliable and tailored talent solutions to businesses and professionals.  The Finance Manager (Real Estate) will manage the financial operations, planning, and reporting for real estate projects and portfolios. title: Assistant Manager, UAE Corporate Tax & Transfer Pricing
description:
We are looking for a Chartered Accountant with around 1–2 years of post\-qualification experience to join our Noida team supporting the UAE Corporate Tax and Transfer Pricing practice.
 



  





 The role will involve supporting the Dubai\-based Corporate Tax Practice Head on UAE and international client assignments across Corporate Tax compliance, advisory, Free Zone and QFZP assessments, Transfer Pricing documentation, benchmarking and technical research.
 



  





 This is primarily a technical delivery role. The candidate will be expected to prepare high\-quality analyses, working papers and client deliverables, coordinate assignments and support the Practice Head on execution and review.
 



  




 What you'll do
   


 UAE Corporate Tax
 


* Assist with UAE Corporate Tax computations, returns, registrations and related compliance requirements.
* Analyse income, expenses, deductions, exemptions, reliefs and other tax adjustments while preparing Corporate Tax workings.
* Assist with Free Zone and Qualifying Free Zone Person assessments, including qualifying income and related conditions.
* Conduct research on UAE Corporate Tax legislation, Cabinet and Ministerial Decisions, FTA guidance and emerging tax developments.
* Prepare technical notes, tax memos, working papers and client deliverables for review by the Corporate Tax Practice Head.
* Support preparation of responses and documentation required for FTA queries and other tax\-related correspondence.



  





 Transfer Pricing
 


* Conduct Transfer Pricing benchmarking and comparability analyses.
* Assist with preparation of Local Files, Master Files and Transfer Pricing Disclosure Forms.
* Perform FAR analyses and Related Party / Connected Person analyses.
* Assist with Transfer Pricing method selection, arm's\-length range calculations and related adjustments.
* Review intercompany agreements and analyse related\-party transaction structures.
* Support preparation of Transfer Pricing policies and technical responses relating to client transactions.



  





 Research and Delivery Support
 


* Conduct technical research on Corporate Tax, Transfer Pricing, International Tax and emerging UAE tax matters.
* Prepare technical summaries, presentations and client deliverables in a clear and professional manner.
* Support the Dubai Practice Head in managing assignment timelines, information requests and completion of client deliverables.
* Review financial information and identify inconsistencies, tax implications and areas requiring further clarification.
* Coordinate with team members across Noida and Dubai to ensure assignments are completed within agreed timelines.
* Translate complex tax concepts into clear, practical and well\-supported conclusions.



  




 What we're looking for
   

* Qualified Chartered Accountant is mandatory. Additional UAE Corporate Tax, Transfer Pricing or international tax certifications will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate is technically strong, research oriented and confident with both numbers and written tax analysis. The person should be able to explain a tax conclusion clearly, review junior work critically, manage multiple clients and take ownership of deadlines without becoming dependent on checklists.
* 1 to 2 years of post qualification experience in Corporate Tax, Transfer Pricing, International Tax or Direct Tax, preferably in a consulting firm, tax advisory practice or a strong CA firm. UAE tax exposure is highly preferred.



  





 Technical Skills
 


* Strong working knowledge of UAE Corporate Tax legislation and practical compliance requirements.
* Hands on experience with Transfer Pricing documentation, FAR analysis, benchmarking and intercompany transaction review.
* Good understanding of QFZP, Free Zone taxation, related party and connected person provisions.
* Ability to prepare technical tax memos and translate law into practical client advice.
* Familiarity with TP databases such as S\&P Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat, LoanConnector or similar tools.
* Strong Excel, financial statement analysis and working paper review skills.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* UAE Corporate Tax / Transfer Pricing experience.
* Exposure to Local/Master Files, benchmarking or FAR analysis.
* UAE Free Zone/QFZP experience.
* Professional services / Big 4 experience.
* Knowledge of OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines and TP databases.

title: Assistant Manager - Procurement
description:
**About Us**
 At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Procurement team at OakNorth manages supplier relationships, contract lifecycle activities, and purchasing operations across our India, UK, and US entities. We work closely with Finance, Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure every supplier engagement is commercially sound, compliant, and well\-governed — while continuously improving the processes and tools that underpin our procurement function.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Associate to join our Procurement and Supplier Management team, supporting end\-to\-end procurement activities from sourcing and contracting through to supplier due diligence, invoice processing, and performance management. You'll be hands\-on across both strategic and operational procurement, working closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers while supporting our UK and US teams. This role suits someone who is detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a regulated, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead sourcing and tendering activities for new and renewing supplier engagements, including RFx preparation and evaluation; benchmark supplier pricing and commercial terms to support value\-for\-money assessments.
* Manage contract lifecycle activities — drafting, negotiation support, execution, amendments, and renewals — in collaboration with Legal; maintain and update the contract register, tracking key dates and milestones.
* Support category management across key spend areas, identifying consolidation opportunities and preferred supplier strategies; ensure all procurement activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Create and process purchase requisitions (PRs) in NetSuite, ensuring accurate coding, approvals, and budget alignment; upload vendor invoices, match against POs, and coordinate with Accounts Payable to resolve discrepancies and payment conflicts.
* Manage end\-to\-end supplier due diligence across OakNorth, including risk assessments (sanctions, background, and creditworthiness checks), payment reconciliations, and banking detail verification.
* Manage vendor onboarding and offboarding, maintain records in Salesforce, and support supplier governance and performance review meetings; resolve exceptions, process risks, and in\-life issues as they arise.
* Maintain trackers (DD tracker, Charity tracker, spend file) for both ONB and ONGPL; support brand monitoring across the supplier base.
* Support preparation of procurement dashboards and management reports; build data models and visualisations using Excel, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
* Serve as the key liaison between internal stakeholders (Finance, Legal, IT, Compliance) and external suppliers; available to support UK and US teams during critical periods including month\-end, year\-end, audit cycles, and major contract renewals.


**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**
* 3–5 years of experience in procurement operations or supplier management, preferably in financial services or a regulated environment.
* Hands\-on experience with NetSuite (PRs, invoicing, vendor management) and Salesforce (vendor records).
* Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and data analysis; familiarity with Power BI or Tableau desirable.
* Understanding of third\-party risk management, procurement compliance frameworks, and ESG principles.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities independently across geographies and time zones.


**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with AI/ML tools and a demonstrable ability to apply them in day\-to\-day procurement workflows.
* Experience with supplier due diligence processes including sanctions and creditworthiness checks.
* Exposure to category management or preferred supplier strategy development.


**What We Offer**
* Health \& Protection: Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* Wellbeing: Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* Time Off: Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* Life Milestones: Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* Flexible Benefits: Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* Growth \& Development: Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* Our Workplace: Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

description:

 Polar Quality India is the Indian arm of Polar Quality AS, a Norwegian sales company based in Bodø in northern Norway and established in 2002 by salmon and trout producers. The company is a leading supplier of premium Norwegian salmon and trout, farmed in the pristine Arctic waters of Norway. Polar Quality is the first Norwegian seafood company to set up a dedicated presence in India, with products stored at its office in Gurugram and at major cold chain facilities in Mumbai, Bengaluru, and New Delhi. The portfolio includes “Salmon from Arctic Waters” as fresh and frozen fillets, as well as smoked salmon in various sizes and flavors. * Prior experience in FMCG, food, or import/export sectors is beneficial but not mandatory.

title: Delhi/NCR Sr Manager, Pricing Strategy Consulting
description:
**Company Description** 
 Monetizely is a pricing strategy consultancy built by experienced operators with nearly three decades of combined leadership in Product Management, Product Marketing, and Pricing at companies such as Zoom, Twilio, LinkedIn, Squarespace, Medallia, and Microsoft. The team brings deep product and go\-to\-market expertise to every engagement and is known for authoring “Price to Scale” and teaching a top\-rated course on SaaS, Agentic \& AI Pricing Strategy \& Monetization. Monetizely partners with software companies from Seed stage through post\-IPO to transform how they package, price, and monetize their products. Its 5\-step pricing transformation framework blends design thinking, rigorous market research (including Van Westendorp, Conjoint, MaxDiff, and qualitative validation), and strong operationalization to ensure strategies align with GTM motions. The firm has delivered measurable impact, such as significant customer growth, higher average deal sizes, expanded customer bases, and substantial increases in validated willingness to pay across multiple clients.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, remote role for a Sr Manager, Pricing Strategy Consulting at Monetizely. The Sr Manager will lead end\-to\-end pricing and packaging engagements for software clients, from diagnostic discovery through recommendation, experimentation, and rollout. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting market and customer research, structuring and analyzing pricing studies, and translating findings into clear, actionable pricing strategies. The role will collaborate closely with client stakeholders in Product, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to align pricing with product strategy and GTM motions, and to support implementation, enablement, and change management. The Sr Manager will also contribute to Monetizely’s thought leadership, methodologies, and internal tooling, helping scale best practices across client engagements.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong expertise in pricing strategy, packaging design, and monetization for B2B SaaS or software businesses.
* Experience with quantitative and qualitative market research methods, including survey design, pricing research frameworks (e.g., Van Westendorp, Conjoint, MaxDiff), and customer interviews.
* Proficiency in data analysis, financial modeling, and scenario planning to evaluate pricing options and revenue impact.
* Background in Product Management, Product Marketing, Management Consulting, or a related strategic role working with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently, manage multiple client workstreams, and deliver outcomes in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Comfort working in a fully remote, distributed team and collaborating asynchronously across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering

title: Senior Associate, IT Asset Management Procurement and Operations Specialist, GESS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The IT Asset Management Procurement and Operations Specialist supports the end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle — procurement, budget support, financial reconciliation, inventory planning, request fulfillment, and vendor coordination — working across business, Finance, engineering, operations, and external partners to ensure hardware purchases and assignments are accurate, timely, compliant, and aligned with organizational standards. The role requires day\-to\-day, real\-time collaboration with vendors, resellers, fulfillment partners, and internal teams during core U.S. business hours.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 This position is expected to be available and working during core U.S. business hours, generally 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. The work depends on real\-time conversation rather than asynchronous updates — calls and video meetings with vendors and fulfillment partners, instant messages from business, Finance, engineering, and operations stakeholders, and issues worked live to closure. Overlap with the U.S. workday is a requirement of the role, not a preference, with flexibility outside those hours when escalations or order deadlines require it.
   

  

 Procurement
   

  

* Manage standard and non\-standard hardware procurement requests end to end — queue triage, required information and approvals, stakeholder coordination, and fulfillment tracking — aligned with organizational standards.
* Execute bulk laptop and peripheral orders and coordinate related business\-unit reclassification activities.
* Source exceptions and specialized configurations that fall outside the standard catalog, including custom peripherals and engineering\-specific builds.
* Monitor pricing, order status, and vendor issue resolution.
* Serve as backup for order execution and vendor follow\-up during team absences and peak demand cycles.


 Financial Operations and Reconciliation
   

  

* Request and reconcile monthly statements of account, validating invoice line items against allocations and approvals. Coordinate with business management, Finance, and Accounts Payable to process payments on schedule and track invoices through closure.
* Prepare freight charge summaries and submit reclassification and allocation details to ensure expenses are posted to the correct business units and cost centers, and support invoice acceptance.
* Administer business\-unit chargebacks for hardware and peripheral purchases and prepare monthly chargeback reporting for business management and Finance.
* Serve as the point of contact for chargeback disputes, researching questioned charges and driving them through to correction with the affected business units and Finance.
* Maintain a working understanding of spend by vendor and provide spend detail, run\-rate analysis, and variance explanations to business management and Finance during budget cycles and periodic forecast updates.


 Governance and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Monitor operational dashboards and support timely resolution of IT asset management incidents, requests, and enhancement items.
* Serve as the administrative liaison for hardware proofs of concept by confirming configurations, coordinating equipment delivery, supporting testing and validation, and documenting actions and decisions.
* Manage relationships with manufacturers, resellers, and fulfillment partners, and track service\-level and quality performance across fulfillment and support activities.
* Maintain approved laptop catalog content aligned with current standards and availability, and ensure request and incident records accurately reflect approved models, assignments, and fulfillment status.
* Oversee asset assignment governance and reconcile asset records against operational inventory data to maintain accurate ownership, status, and lifecycle information.


 Planning and Inventory Management
   

  

* Support hardware demand and replenishment planning — monitoring reseller and vendor inventory, lead times, stock levels, and supply chain health — and report regularly on laptop inventory, adjusting plans as demand or supply conditions change.
* Track leased hardware against lease schedules and terms, coordinating end\-of\-lease refresh, returns, and buyouts with vendors, Finance, and the affected business units.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of five years of procurement experience, including IT hardware procurement, with working knowledge of hardware lifecycle, fulfillment, and asset assignment, and exposure to IT asset management, finance operations, or inventory management.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, orders, invoices, and stakeholder dependencies and drive issues through to documented resolution.
* Advanced Excel skills — pivot tables, lookups, and large\-volume data reconciliation — applied with demonstrated attention to detail across spend, inventory, chargeback, and asset reporting.
* Working knowledge of the procure\-to\-pay (P2P) cycle and invoice processing, including requisitions, purchase orders, three\-way match, invoice coding and approval routing, and coordination with Accounts Payable.
* Strong financial understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable, including accruals, cost\-center allocations, and how vendor spend flows to budgets and forecasts.
* Effective communication and relationship\-management skills across internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to work core U.S. business hours and engage vendors and internal teams in real time.
* Comfort using AI tools to accelerate routine work — summarizing vendor and invoice data, drafting communications, and spotting anomalies in spend or inventory reporting — with sound judgment on reviewing output and handling sensitive data.
* Experience with IT hardware leasing, including lease schedules and terms, end\-of\-lease returns and buyouts, and lease invoice reconciliation.
* Hands\-on systems experience with ServiceNow (requests, incidents, asset records, dashboards) and Amazon Business ordering, plus the ability to learn new procurement and asset platforms quickly.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
