**ABOUT US:**  

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

Reporting to the Head of Third\-Party Risk Management, the Third\-Party Risk Management Officer will be responsible for owning and running the onboarding and life cycle management of Alter Domus’ third\-parties. In doing so you will balance meeting the commercial, technology and operational needs of the business at pace with ensuring the risk and regulatory requirements of the Group are met and evidencable.
  
This is a hands\-on, second\-line role requiring proactivity, an ability to multi\-task, logical thinking, strong attention to detail, and the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  
  

JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  

* Own and drive the completion of the Alter Domus third\-party risk management due diligence process in support of the 1st Line during the initiation of a new internal or external third\-party arrangement.
* Own and drive the completion of the Alter Domus regulatory assessments and determinations (e.g. DORA, EBA, CSSF, CIF \& Outsourcing) in support of the 1st Line during the initiation of a new internal or external third\-party arrangement.
* Escalate any issues identified during the due diligence and regulatory assessments in relation to a new third\-party arrangement for evaluation and satisfactory resolution, prior to the onboarding of that arrangement.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders on the progress of the due diligence and regulatory assessments and determinations in line with their priorities and ensure those stakeholders are aware of the actions or regulatory obligations resulting from those exercises.
* Ensure there is a complete, structured and accessible record of the due diligence and regulatory assessment undertaken prior to the onboarding of a new third\-party relationship.
* Undertake lifecycle reviews of those third\-party arrangements in a timely fashion.
* Where necessary prepare the materials required for mandatory regulatory notifications in relation to new internal or external third\-party arrangements.
* Maintain the outsourcing registers for our regulated entities ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely submissions.
* Provide 2nd Line support to the 1st Line in the ongoing life cycle management of Alter Domus third\-party arrangements.
* Manage 2nd Line responses to 1st Line, audit and regulator questions and queries about new or existing third\-party arrangements.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Third\-Party Risk Management function and broader Risk and Compliance department.


PROFILE
  
  

* Solid knowledge of the third\-party onboarding process for regulated entities in the financial services sector.
* Demonstrable risk management awareness and expertise.
* Have an awareness of the regulatory environment and requirements in relation to third\-party arrangements, particularly in Luxembourg, Ireland and the EEA.


LEADERSHIP \& BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES
  
  

* You will demonstrate business insight and commercial acumen combined with strong risk mindset.
* Hands\-on subject matter expert capable of providing leadership to stakeholders in the execution of the third\-party risk management processes.
* You will have a strong completer\-finisher mindset that you use to ensure tasks and actions are delivered, and records are accurate, complete and logically structured.
* You will possess strong interpersonal skills – influencing and building trust quickly with stakeholders, navigating complexity and ambiguity with confidence and focus.
* You will have a proven track\-record of working autonomously in a matrixed organisation and demonstrate good partnering skills.
* You will have an intellectual curiosity and a global mind\-set, allowing you to partner effectively across your region and beyond with agility and flexibility.
* You will have high energy, avoid complacency and strive for the business to succeed, acting quickly to tackle any issues.
* You will be adept at managing competing demands on your time, actively prioritising and remaining calm under pressure while navigating complexity and challenges with confidence and resilience.
* Possess personal learning agility and an ability to adopt and champion new skills and ways of working to role model and inspire others.
* You will demonstrate a strong commitment to high integrity and ethics.


KEY RELATIONSHIPS
  
  

* Supervisory Board / Audit and Risk Committee, Group Executive Board.

title: Commercial Finance Controller
description:
We are looking for a Commercial Finance Controller to join our Finance team.
 



 The position is based in
 **Pune, Maharashtra, India** 
 where you'll join an international company that values people, embraces diversity, and promotes employee well\-being.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\.** 
**Commercial Governance, Controls \& Spend Management** 



* Establish, enforce, and audit approval matrices, SOPs, and governance frameworks for all commercial spends, trade promotions, and marketing budgets.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end Gross\-to\-Net (G2N) structure, ensuring accurate accruals, timely trade claim settlements, discount reconciliations, and elimination of revenue leakages.
* Act as the finance process owner for commercial ERP modules, Sales Force Automation (SFA), and Trade Spend Management tools to ensure pricing and discount master data integrity.
* Procuremnet process and Logistics costs control : end to end process governance
* Expiry and damage policy governance



**2\. Commercial Business Partnering \& RGM Strategy** 



* Partner closely with the Sales, Trade Marketing, and Marketing leads to drive Revenue Growth Management (RGM) initiatives—including pricing strategy, price\-pack architecture, and promotional discount depth.
* Evaluate financial business cases for New Product Developments (NPDs), line extensions, new channel entry (e.g., Airlines, Institutional, Quick\-Commerce), and distributor margin structures.



**3\. Multi\-Channel Profitability \& Decision Support** 



* Deliver granular P\&L analysis across channels (General Trade, Modern Trade, E\-Commerce, Alternate Channels), customer accounts, and SKU levels.
* Develop dynamic financial dashboards, forward\-looking insights, and scenario planning models to advise senior leadership on margin optimization and growth opportunities.
* Monitor competitor pricing dynamics, input cost pressures, and trade terms to maintain market competitiveness without compromising company profitability.



**4\. Credit Control \& Distributor Financial Health** 



* Implement credit policies, set customer credit limits, and monitor accounts receivable aging to mitigate credit default risk.
* Oversee distributor financial health, claim reconciliation disputes, and credit memo issuance processes.
* Lead the annual commercial budgeting process, quarterly re\-forecasts, and monthly trade spend alignment.
* Track and present monthly commercial performance, highlighting variances against budget/forecast, risks, and proposed corrective actions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 The Commercial Finance Controller will serve as the strategic co\-pilot to the commercial team, providing total financial visibility and rigorous governance over in\-market spends.
 



 This role bridges commercial ambitions with financial discipline ensuring that trade schemes, pricing policies, channel investments, and marketing initiatives deliver optimal ROI, protect gross margins, and support sustainable, profitable growth.
 



  





**Experience Range** 




 7\-15 Yrs

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Executive Vice President - Account Receivable
description:
**Role description**

**About the Department:**
 The Finance Operations department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long\-term and short\-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.
 


  


**The Role \& Responsibilities**
 The Executive Vice President \- Order to Cash / Accounts Receivable will lead TresVista’s end\-to\-end revenue\-to\-cash agenda, with ownership across invoicing, collections, credit risk, revenue assurance, pricing insights, customer contract inputs, cash forecasting, and O2C transformation. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing leadership role requiring strong commercial judgement, business acumen, analytical depth, and the ability to partner with stakeholders across Commercial, Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Product, and business leadership.
   

 Beyond traditional AR accounting, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, statutory audit support, DSO calculation, and transaction governance, the role will be expected to create measurable business value by anticipating risks, solving structural issues, improving cash predictability, and using technology, dashboards, automation, AI/RPA, and analytics to build a scalable O2C operating model.
 


  


**Key Role Deliverables:** 



  

  
* Commercial Finance, Revenue Insights \& Pricing Governance
  
* Partner with business and commercial teams to evaluate pricing models, cost inflators, customer discounts, sales commissions, CAC, customer lifetime value, ARR, and revenue added by channel/product
  
* Provide analytical insights on churn, customer loyalty, customer profitability, customer behavior, and revenue leakage to support strategic decision\-making
  
* Act as a core member of the pricing committee and provide inputs on price structuring, discount governance, customer viability, renewal economics, and commercial risk.
   

 Customer Contracts, Churn Mitigation \& Legal Partnership
  
* Participate in the customer contract committee and advise on payment terms, collection enforceability, contract risk, churn triggers, discounting terms, and revenue protection clauses
  
* Work closely with Legal to resolve overdue accounts, contract disputes, collection challenges, and escalations requiring formal recovery or negotiation
  
* Develop mitigation practices to reduce churn, improve customer stickiness, and strengthen contract hygiene across new and existing client relationships.
   

 Collections, International Banking \& Treasury Partnership
  
* Lead timely collections across geographies by addressing customer\-side issues, banking delays, failed payment flows, international remittance challenges, and process bottlenecks
  
* Partner with Treasury for cash forecasting, liquidity visibility, collection predictability, auto\-collection mechanisms, and banking process improvements
  
* Own DSO, CEI, ageing movement, overdue reduction, unapplied cash, and collection\-risk reporting with clear governance and escalation rhythm
  
* Digital Transformation, AI/RPA \& Control Tower
  
* Build a digital\-first O2C operating model through dashboards, RPA workflows, AI\-enabled anomaly detection, auto\-matching, cash application automation, and revenue/cash forecasting models
  
* Create exception\-based control towers for invoice accuracy, collections risk, pricing exceptions, contract\-related disputes, write\-offs, credit memos, and customer\-level exposure
  
* Drive business cases and ROI for collections platforms, EIPP/portals, cash application ML/IDP, workflow automation, and analytics\-led decision support
  
* O2C Operations, Revenue Accounting \& Controls
  
* Own end\-to\-end AR/O2C operations including billing accuracy, client invoicing, collections, cash application, credit notes, write\-off governance, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, and statutory audit support
  
* Strengthen controls around onboarding, KYC, credit limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, billing accuracy, tax/e\-invoicing readiness, and revenue handoffs
  
* Establish process discipline across customer master data, payment terms, dispute SLAs, credit governance, closing activities, and audit evidence readiness

title: Sr Estimator
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Senior Estimator
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control \& Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end\-to\-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post\-bid support.
   

  

 Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Proposal Leadership and Strategy**
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
* Own the end\-to\-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid support.
* Participate in bid/no\-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Lead the preparation and successful submission of large\-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi\-country and international projects.


**Technical Solution Development**
* Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
* Analyze, design, and develop end\-to\-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
* Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.


**Estimating and Commercial Management**
* Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
* Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
* Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.


**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third\-party vendors.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.


**Proposal Governance and Compliance**
* Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
* Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
* Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.


**Post\-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement**
* Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
* Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skills and Qualifications** 
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
* Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
* Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.


**Leadership and Commercial Skills**
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer\-focused solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.


**We Value**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
* Strong technical aptitude and systems\-thinking capability.
* Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
* Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
* Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
 This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
   

  

**About Lowe’s**
 Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86\.3 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com
   

  

 Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Finance Decision Support \& Analytics (FDS\&A)
 **Shared Services** 
 team partners with HR, Finance and Legal to provide financial planning, forecasting, reporting and decision support for complex enterprise expense areas. The team combines financial analysis, business acumen and analytics to improve forecast accuracy, identify risks and opportunities, and enable informed business decisions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Lead Analyst will own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex enterprise and non\-departmental expense lines supporting HR, Finance and Legal, with a significant focus on healthcare and related employee benefit costs. The role will develop and strengthen driver\-based forecasts, evaluate scenarios and sensitivities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate financial and operational inputs into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders. This role requires strong FP\&A judgment, the ability to understand and challenge key business, vendor and actuarial assumptions, and the independence to drive complex workstreams across Lowe's India and U.S. teams. The Lead Analyst will also mentor team members and lead process, automation and forecasting improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency and decision support.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex expense lines across HR, Finance and Legal, including healthcare, risk \& casualty and other non\-departmental expenses.
* Develop and continuously improve driver\-based forecasting approaches, incorporating key cost drivers, historical trends, business changes and relevant vendor or actuarial assumptions.
* Lead variance, scenario and sensitivity analysis; quantify risks and opportunities, explain underlying drivers and recommend forecast or business actions.
* Build, enhance and maintain robust financial models and forecasting tools with clear assumptions, validation checks and documentation.
* Partner with business and Finance stakeholders across Lowe's India and U.S. teams to challenge assumptions, reconcile inputs and align on forecast changes and key business updates.
* Prepare executive\-ready reporting, commentary and insights that clearly communicate performance, drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Lead process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives to improve forecast accuracy, efficiency, scalability and controls.
* Mentor and review the work of team members, providing guidance on forecasting logic, model structure, assumptions and analytical quality.
* Independently manage multiple workstreams and deliver high\-quality outputs with strong attention to detail, ownership and follow\-through.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Finance, FP\&A or financial decision support, with demonstrated ownership of complex planning and forecasting processes.
* Significant experience in planning, forecasting and analyzing expense lines; experience with healthcare, employee benefits or other complex driver\-based expenses is preferred.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional business and Finance stakeholders; experience in a GCC, shared services or global operating model is preferred.


**Education Qualification \& Certifications (preferable)**
* Qualified finance professional i.e. CA, CMA, CIMA, CFA or equivalent
* MBA with Finance specialization


**Skill Set Required**
* Strong Finance and FP\&A acumen, including driver\-based forecasting, variance analysis, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and risk \& opportunity assessment.
* Ability to understand complex expense drivers and translate business, operational, vendor and actuarial inputs into reliable forecasts and insights.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with strong attention to model structure, data validation and accuracy.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and reach sound conclusions.
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities, including the ability to challenge assumptions and influence without authority.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive\-level commentary, insights and recommendations.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, work independently and maintain high standards of quality and follow\-through.
* Ability to mentor and review others' work, strengthening analytical rigor and team capability.


**Secondary Skills (desired)**
* SQL – basic/ intermediate knowledge
* Experience in Financial Planning tools e.g. IBM Planning Analytics (TM1\)

title: Associate Manager, Business Operations FP&A
description:
**About Astellas**
 Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
   

  

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
 We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
   

  

**Purpose And Scope**
 This position executes FP\&A operations for its FBP and business customers. This role heavily collaborates with business operations members, the COE, Systems and Reporting teams to deliver high quality, on time services.
   

  

 It provides high quality reporting results effectively for all FBPs with insights and recommended actions from FBPs. Meanwhile, it provides systematic variance analysis \& additional fundamental analysis support to FBPs \& Business, which are relevant to the sustainability of the operation.
   

  

 It operates the execution of the financial planning process, supporting the business to input their planning information, coordinating with the FBPs to review plans with business leaders and make necessary adjustments to the plan based on feedback.
   

  

 It supports accounting operations collaborating with GBS e.g., accruals entries etc to ensure monthly/quarterly/yearly closing is complying with financial and fiscal requirements, in line with relevant control frameworks.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
**Month\-end Close:**
* Collaborate with GBS to ensure accurate reporting of management accounts, timely and in compliance with corporate policies and statutory requirements.
* In collaboration with the COE systems team validate data in financial systems for accuracy and compliance.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs to analyse variances between actual results and budget/forecasts, providing insights and recommendations, which includes detailed review and analysis of OPEX and headcounts.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs through conducting monthly and ad\-hoc financial analyses – provide key highlights on costs, headcounts tracking and cost efficiency analysis.
* Prepare financial reports and dashboards for management.


**Forecasting \& Budgeting**
* Responsible for the development of various forecasting \& budgeting templates / consolidation templates and management reporting.
* Support the implementation and roll out of financial reporting tool and system, as \& when applicable.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in the development of annual budget, quarter forecasting as well as mid\-term plan.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in analysing financial trends and performance metrics to allow FBPs to provide actionable insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Assist business and FBPs in the creation of various financial scenarios model to support the development of business case to support strategic decision\-making and risk management.
* Work closely with COE system team to ensure data accuracy and integrity in the financial systems.


**Compliance**
* Embed Compliance Culture, ensuring Integrity in Action is actively applied in all initiatives, and proactively address non\-compliance.
* Ensure a culture of Ethics and Compliance; lead by example and incorporate cross\-cultural perspectives when addressing challenging situations.


**Others**
* Support Coordination with relevant stakeholders to validate financial calendar and required system adjustments before official release.


**Required Qualifications**
* BS/BA in Finance / Accounting / Economics or related discipline
* MBA and / or CPA / CIMA and / or equivalent certificates (or qualified by experience)
* English conversational and business English Preferred Qualifications:
* Profound work experience in planning and budgeting in Pharma industry
* Solid working knowledge of accounting and internal control standards
* Experience with ERP systems
* Experience with planning tools
* Strong Microsoft word, PowerPoint skills and Advanced Excel
* Solid experience in matrix environment
* Solid organization, project, and change management skills
* Demonstrated initiative and creativity in pioneering new approaches and ways of working.
* Experience and demonstrated aptitude leveraging enterprise\-grade finance data / reporting systems.
* Solid communication skills and ability to influence with various management levels.
* Profound financial analysis skills, coupled with ability to communicate meaning from data.
* Profound teamwork and partner behaviours


**Working Environment**
 At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility
   

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**
* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real\-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.


**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**
**Values:** 
 Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.
   

  

**Behaviors:** 
 We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.
   

  

 Category VALUE Delivery Finance
   

  

 Astellas is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.
   

  

 EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans

 : GDS Alliances Investments Senior Analyst

 : GDS ES G\&I \- Alliances
   

  

**Skill Level:** 
 High

 : Alliances Partner Ops CoE
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The GDS Alliance Market Development Funds Supervisor will function out of the RA CoE function within the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and will be responsible for providing ongoing Market Development Funds support for one or more alliances as part of the broader global Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will provide INVESTMENTS support delivery model for a single Alliance or a combination of Alliances, ensuring seamless service delivery for ongoing initiatives and will also be responsible for executing special projects that are assigned from time to time. On successful deployment of the INVESTMENTS support model, the incumbent will administer the INVESTMENTSs for each designated Alliances in compliance with organizational mandates and policies.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Track alliance investment activities and ensure the timely, accurate submission and reporting of claims for reimbursement through designated partner platforms, including e342Claims where applicable.
* Apply defined internal controls and maintain supporting documentation to ensure a robust, audit\-ready process that meets internal and external audit requirements.
* Liaise with onshore Alliance BMC teams, Alliance Operations, Finance and alliance leaders to provide investment data, analysis and status updates.
* Review and refresh alliance investment reference materials, standard operating procedures and process documentation, and facilitate access through SharePoint and other approved tools.
* Support initiatives involving processes and tools provided by alliance partners, including access\-request tracking, access\-issue resolution and administration of alliance investment platforms.
* Reconcile alliance investment codes, claims and expense bookings to confirm completeness, accuracy and appropriate allocation.
* Maintain reports and dashboards for alliance leadership, including budget\-versus\-utilization analysis, forecasts, claim status and other key investment metrics.
* Work with the GDS Alliances Investments Ops Lead and relevant stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, timely and appropriately cascaded.
* Ensure compliance with established tracking tools, workflows and approval mechanisms for alliance investments.

* Exposure to continuous process improvement, simplification, automation and emerging technologies, with experience in process mapping, process documentation, control design and audit preparation.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI skills are an added advantage.
* Ability to work effectively with senior onshore stakeholders and build trusted business\-advisor relationships through strong stakeholder and relationship management skills.

* Good project\-management and organizational skills, including budget tracking, execution monitoring, reviews, prioritization and delivery across multiple assignments with demanding deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to independently develop clear business content with limited initial guidance.
* Experience supporting alliance or partner investment programs in a professional services or technology company is preferred.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, including organizational structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts, is preferred for internal
* candidates; Big Four consulting exposure in a leadership\-support or strategic environment is preferred for external candidates.


**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Management or Business Administration.
* Master’s degree in Commerce, MBA in Finance, or a postgraduate qualification in Accounting or Finance is preferred.


**Experience:**
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in finance operations, investment or budget administration, reporting, controls, alliance operations or a related field.

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Underwriting & Analysis - Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.
   

  

 In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.
   

  

 Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.
   

  

**Major Duties**
* Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
* Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
* Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
* Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
* Contributes to division\-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
* Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
* Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process\-related guidelines, and controls.
* Consistently adheres to established QUALITY \& QUANTITY SLAs.
* Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
* Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
* Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
* Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.


**Experience \& Skills**
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution\-based’ approach
* Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
* Self\-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
* Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
* Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.


**Shift Coverage:** 
 EMEA \- 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST
   

  

**About The Team**
 This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long\-term organizational resilience.
   

  

 The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.
   

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Role Description** 




 We are looking for an experienced Finance Controller to take ownership of the company's
 



 financial planning, reporting, controls, cash flow, and accounting operations.
 



 The role will work closely with the Founder/Management, Operations, Sales, Procurement,
 



 and Project Teams to ensure strong financial controls, healthy cash flows, accurate project
 



 profitability, timely collections, and disciplined vendor payments.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in a project\-based or
 



 construction/interiors/real\-estate environment, where financial management involves
 



 multiple ongoing projects, customer collections, vendor payments, material procurement,
 



 project\-level costing, and working\-capital management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Financial Planning \& MIS
 



 • Own weekly, monthly, and annual financial reporting and MIS.
 



 • Prepare and present financial dashboards covering revenue, collections, expenses,
 



 margins, cash flow, and profitability.
 



 • Develop project\-wise and company\-level P\&L reporting.
 



 • Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts and highlight key variances.
 



 • Provide management with actionable financial insights for business decisions.
 



 • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
 



 2\. Project Finance \& Profitability
 



 • Establish and monitor project\-wise financial performance and profitability.
 



 • Track project revenue, material costs, labour costs, subcontractor costs, overheads,
 



 and other project expenses.
 



 • Monitor project budgets against actual expenditure and identify cost overruns early.
 



 • Work with Project Managers and Operations to improve project margins and cost
 



 controls.
 



 • Ensure revenue recognition, project billing, and cost allocation are accurate and
 



 timely.
 



 • Develop mechanisms to track contribution margins across projects and locations.
 



 3\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital
 



 • Take ownership of the company's cash\-flow planning and working\-capital
 



 management.
 



 • Prepare weekly and monthly cash\-flow forecasts.
 



 • Closely monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables.
 



 • Work with Sales and Project teams to ensure collections happen as per agreed
 



 payment milestones.
 



 • Plan vendor payments based on cash\-flow requirements and business priorities.
 



 • Maintain healthy working capital while ensuring critical vendors and projects are
 



 adequately supported.
 



 • Identify potential cash\-flow gaps and proactively flag them to management.
 



 4\. Accounts Receivable \& Collections
 



 • Monitor customer receivables, ageing, and overdue payments.
 



 • Establish clear collection processes and escalation mechanisms.
 



 • Track project\-wise billing and collection milestones.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales and Project teams on pending customer payments.
 



 • Ensure customer advances and project payments are accurately accounted for and
 



 reconciled.
 



 5\. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management
 



 • Oversee vendor and contractor payments and ensure proper documentation and
 



 approvals.
 



 • Establish financial controls around purchase orders, invoices, goods receipts, and
 



 payment approvals.
 



 • Monitor vendor outstanding and ageing.
 



 • Ensure payments are aligned with contractual terms and project cash flows.
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve payment terms and working capital.
 



 6\. Accounting, Compliance \& Controls
 



 • Oversee day\-to\-day accounting and ensure books are maintained accurately and on
 



 time.
 



 • Ensure timely GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and other statutory compliance.
 



 • Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and external advisors.
 



 • Manage monthly and annual financial closures.
 



 • Ensure timely bank, ledger, customer, and vendor reconciliations.
 



 • Strengthen internal financial controls and approval processes.
 



 • Identify financial risks, control gaps, and potential leakages and recommend
 



 corrective measures.
 



 7\. Internal Controls \& Process Improvement
 



 • Build robust SOPs and approval workflows for finance\-related processes.
 



 • Establish controls around procurement, project expenses, reimbursements, petty
 



 cash, and payments.
 



 • Implement systems to minimise financial leakages, errors, and unauthorised
 



 expenditure.
 



 • Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes wherever possible.
 



 • Ensure financial data is accurate, timely, and accessible to management.
 



 8\. Business Partnership
 



 • Act as a strategic finance partner to the management team.
 



 • Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Sales, and Project teams to improve
 



 financial performance.
 



 • Evaluate the financial impact of new business initiatives, pricing decisions, vendor
 



 contracts, and operational changes.
 



 • Support management with financial modelling and scenario planning.
 



 • Translate financial data into clear business recommendations.
 



 Qualifications
 



 • CA/CMA preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience and qualifications in
 



 Finance/Accounting may also be considered.
 



 • 1 to 4 years of relevant experience, preferably in interiors, construction, real estate,
 



 architecture, or another project\-based business.
 



 • Strong understanding of project costing and project\-level profitability.
 



 • Strong experience in cash\-flow management, receivables, payables, and working
 



 capital.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems/ERP and advanced Excel.
 



 • Strong understanding of GST, TDS, statutory compliance, and financial controls.
 



 • Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Ability to work independently and build processes in a growing organisation.
 



 • High level of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and commercial awareness.
 



  





 Compensation: 3\.6 \- 4\.8 LPA
 



  





**Company Description** 




 Reminiscent Interior Design is a fast\-growing interior design start\-up based in Bengaluru,
 



 India, dedicated to transforming client ideas into customized, cost\-effective design solutions.
 



  





 The team combines strong design expertise with cutting\-edge technology to deliver end\-to\-
 



 end interior design and execution for both residential and commercial spaces. The company
 



  





 focuses on tailoring every project to specific client needs through meticulous attention to
 



 detail, even under tight deadlines and limited budgets. Customer experience and satisfaction
 



 are central, with a commitment to exceptional quality at competitive prices. Reminiscent
 



 Interior Design aims to simplify the interior design journey and has successfully completed
 



 numerous projects in a short time.

title: Revenue Analyst - Hilton Bengaluru Embassy Manyata Business Park

**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for monitoring, managing, and maintaining group and transient inventories to ensure the most effective and efficient balance between demand and availability in the hotel; continuing efforts to deliver outstanding guest service and financial profitability. As a
 **Revenue Manager / Assistant Revenue Manager** 
 , you’re not just analyzing pricing and demand to maximize revenue – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Manage inventory and pricing: Review and adjust room accommodations, rate inventory, and group cut\-off dates based on demand trends
* Optimize sellout strategies: Collaborate with Front Office leadership to implement sellout strategies and ensure daily inventory balance
* Lead revenue management meetings: Conduct weekly meetings to evaluate booking trends, pricing strategies, and market opportunities
* Analyze performance and adjust strategies: Monitor key revenue reports, analyze booking pace, and refine strategies based on performance insights
* Develop pricing strategies: Establish and maintain annual transient pricing to ensure consistency across all booking channels
* Forecast revenue and demand: Prepare and refine weekly, monthly, and annual revenue forecasts to anticipate demand and maximize revenue
* Monitor market trends: Track competitor pricing, demand indicators, and market events to inform pricing and inventory decisions


**Qualifications**
 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**
* At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality revenue analyst role is preferred.
* Degree in Hospitality, Business, Finance, or related field.
* Strong ability to analyze data, forecast demand, and optimize pricing strategies.
* Skilled in revenue management systems (RMS), Excel, and hotel property management systems (PMS).
* Understanding of market trends, competitor analysis, and distribution channels.
* Clear and effective communication with stakeholders across departments.
* Making: Strategic thinker with a results\-driven mindset.
* Prior experience in revenue management or hotel operations preferred.


**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

**Job Summary**

title: Senior Analyst, Pricing Operations
description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
   

  

**About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, Pricing Programs \& Analytics
 **,** 
 you will sit at the intersection of commercial program execution and applied pricing analytics. You will own the operational mechanics that keep the Flex program running, the feedback loops and documentation that connect field reality to program design, and the deal\-level intelligence — performance reporting, price realization analysis, and trend identification — that translates data into decisions. You will work closely with Advanced Analytics, Deal Desk, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems to ensure pricing programs are well\-run, well\-documented, and continuously improving.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 Primary responsibilities include
 **:**
* Flex Program Operations \& Administration
* Maintain and administer the day\-to\-day mechanics of the Flex program — including rule documentation, eligibility criteria, CPQ floor configurations, and Deal Desk guidance — ensuring program parameters are accurately reflected in systems and field\-facing materials.
* Own the Flex enhancement roadmap tracker: documenting Fast Follow and Future Enhancement items, tracking owner accountability, sequencing dependencies, and flagging items at risk of slipping across quarters.
* Coordinate cross\-functional follow\-through on approved enhancement items — tracking progress with IT, CPQ, Deal Desk, and Enablement without driving senior stakeholder conversations directly.
* Produce and maintain requirements documentation for CPQ and system changes — translating approved program changes into clear, executable specifications and coordinating Deal Desk validation once changes are built.
* Program Analytics \& Commercial Intelligence
* Consume outputs from the Pricing Guidance Engine to produce program\-level adoption and compliance reporting — tracking how Flex deals align to guidance corridors, where discounting concentrates, and how program participation correlates with deal outcomes such as win rates, deal velocity, and expansion rates.
* Build and maintain program\-specific performance views on top of Advanced Analytics' strategic baselines — including Flex attach rates, deal size distributions, remix frequency, and platform expansion patterns.
* Own price waterfall interpretation at the Flex program level — surfacing how Flex deals flow from list to net pocket price, identifying program\-specific margin leakage patterns, and feeding findings back to Advanced Analytics.
* Produce deal behavior analysis that connects Flex and commercial program participation to measurable field outcomes — equipping leadership with a clear picture of what the program is doing to deal quality, not just deal volume.
* Participate in the price realization process — measuring the gap between intended list pricing and what is actually collected after discounts, concessions, and program incentives are applied.
* Analyze transactional data to identify price realization trends and anomalies — by segment, route to market, geography, or deal type — and produce structured findings that distinguish systematic execution gaps from one\-off exceptions.
* Surface price realization insights that connect to program behavior — identifying how Flex participation and commercial program structures are influencing the spread between list and realized price.
* Field Feedback \& Program Intelligence
* Own the seller and partner feedback collection process — designing and distributing surveys, compiling results, and synthesizing field sentiment into organized summaries that leadership can act on.
* Maintain a running tracker of field feedback across Slack threads, Deal Desk escalations, and stakeholder calls — ensuring patterns are captured and recurring friction points are surfaced with supporting evidence.
* Build and maintain QBR materials for the Pricing Programs team, translating performance data and deal behavior analysis into structured, presentation\-ready assets for leadership review.
* Process Documentation \& Enablement Content
* Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of internal Flex process documentation — including step\-by\-step flows for remixes, debook/rebook migrations, and common field scenarios — published via Highspot with version control.
* Maintain the comprehensive internal Flex guide as the single source of truth for AEs, CSMs, Deal Desk, channel sellers, and new hires — keeping it current as program rules evolve.
* Maintain and refresh field\-facing program materials — including the seller cheat sheet, program one\-pagers, FAQs, and eligibility summaries — as pricing rules, thresholds, and features change.
* Support the development of sales motion\-specific enablement assets — including ICP materials, success story compilations, and deal structuring reference guides — working alongside Enablement and Product Marketing.


**What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**
 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* 4\+ years in pricing programs, revenue operations, sales operations, or a commercial analytics role within a SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain performance datasets, interpret deal behavior data, and translate outputs into structured, actionable summaries.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational documentation — process flows, program guides, enablement materials — with a track record of keeping content current, version\-controlled, and well\-organized.
* Familiarity with CPQ systems and commercial program mechanics — including eligibility logic, quoting rules, and discount structures — sufficient to write clear system requirements and validate changes.
* Understanding of SaaS commercial models, including subscription, consumption, and hybrid structures, and how commercial vehicles like Flex operate in a field selling context.
* Proficiency with data tools (Excel, SQL, or BI platforms such as Looker or Tableau) to build program scorecards, deal behavior reports, and performance views on top of existing analytical baselines.
* Comfortable working within an established analytical framework — applying and extending existing models and baselines rather than building the intelligence layer independently.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and coordination skills; able to work effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Enablement, Advanced Analytics, IT, and Partner teams.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without items falling through the cracks.
* Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or platform pricing is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce or Highspot is a plus.


**Why SentinelOne?**
 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
   

  

 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**Lead, Enterprise Onboarding** 




  





**ABOUT SHESHI** 




**Bringing Sanctity to Numbers** 




  





 Sheshi is a Financial Operating System, the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period\-locked, and traceable to the source.
 



  





 We are headquartered in Bangalore, building an enterprise\-grade product for the global market.
 



  





 Bringing an enterprise customer onto Sheshi is a complete undertaking, their entities need to be structured correctly, their chart of accounts and reporting hierarchies configured, their consolidation and multi\-currency setup built out, and their financial history brought in accurately where required. Every one of these has to be right, because everything the customer sees afterward is built on this foundation.
 



  





 As Lead, Enterprise Onboarding, you own this foundation end to end. You build the methodology this team runs on, stay hands\-on enough to solve the hardest configuration, consolidation, and reconciliation problems yourself, and lead a team of finance professionals who bring customers live with speed and precision.
 



  





**WHY SHESHI** 




  





**What Makes This Role Worth Doing** 




**Real ownership from day one.** 
 You design the methodology, own the portfolio, and are the final authority on go\-live readiness.
 



**Work that shapes how the customer experiences Sheshi.** 
 How an account is structured and configured determines whether the customer trusts what they see from day one.
 



**A team you build.** 
 You hire, coach, and grow a team of finance professionals, with real say in who joins and how they develop.
 



**Player\-coach by design.** 
 You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, not just in the management of people who solve them.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**What You Will Own** 




  





**Account Structuring and Configuration** 



* Own how every enterprise account is structured on Sheshi, entity hierarchies, chart of accounts, reporting structures, and close settings.
* Design and own the configuration methodology for multi\-entity, multi\-GAAP, and multi\-currency customers, ensuring it is built correctly the first time.
* Personally lead structuring and configuration for the largest, most complex, or highest\-risk customer accounts.



**Consolidation Setup** 



* Own the approach to consolidation configuration, intercompany relationships, elimination rules, and group\-level reporting structure.
* Step in directly when a consolidation structure is genuinely complex or a customer's group structure does not fit standard patterns.



**Historical Data Migration and Validation** 



* Own the methodology for migrating historical MIS and statutory financials where a customer requires it — run as a real closing exercise, not a data dump.
* Own final sign\-off on historical data accuracy, entity configuration, and consolidation setup before any customer goes live.



**Portfolio Ownership and Reporting** 



* Maintain visibility across every customer currently onboarding , status, risk, and timeline for each, and report this honestly to the Customer Success Head.
* Decide where the team's effort goes when multiple customers are onboarding simultaneously and priorities compete.



**Team Building and Development** 



* Own hiring for the team, define what you are looking for, run interviews, and make the call on who joins.
* Run direct feedback and coaching with each team member on functional quality, customer handling, and pace.
* Give team members increasing ownership as they demonstrate readiness, there is no fixed ceiling on what a strong team member can grow into.



**Relationship Ownership Across Functions** 



* Be the primary point of contact for Sales and Presales when a deal being scoped will affect onboarding complexity or timeline.
* Own the relationship with Product and Engineering for platform gaps discovered during configuration or migration.
* Ensure a clean, well\-timed handover to Customer Success once a customer is fully live and validated.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Your Background and Strengths** 




  





**Experience** 



* 6\-8 years in financial reporting, accounting, or financial systems implementation, with at least 3 years leading a team.
* Proven experience configuring and structuring financial systems for enterprise customers, chart of accounts, entity hierarchies, and reporting frameworks.
* Strong track record with multi\-entity consolidation and group reporting structures, hands\-on, not just oversight.
* Experience leading complex enterprise customer onboarding or implementation in a B2B SaaS or financial systems environment.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a team of finance professionals.



**Functional Depth** 



* Strong command of Indian and international accounting standards — IndAS, IFRS, and multi\-GAAP reporting.
* Deep experience with multi\-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, group reporting structures, and multi\-currency translation.
* Comfortable configuring financial system, chart of accounts, reporting hierarchies, and close settings, for complex organisational structures.
* Ability to reconcile complex historical financial data with rigour and precision where migration is required.



**How You Work** 



* You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, your team and your customers can count on you to solve what others cannot.
* You build systems and methodology, not just manage people through ad hoc work.
* You report honestly and early, no surprises for the Customer Success Head.
* You move at pace, bureaucracy and unnecessary delay have no place in how you run onboarding.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with SaaS implementation for enterprise financial or ERP systems.
* Exposure to multiple accounting frameworks across different customer geographies.
* Prior experience building a team or function from an early stage.

title: Specialist, Offer Lifecycle Procurement
description:
**Job Summary**
 As Offer Procurement Leader (Specialist, Offer Lifecycle Procurement), you streamline procurement processes to create competitive offers aligned with business objectives. You work closely with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs, source materials and services for new offers, and negotiate cost\-effective contracts with suppliers. Your mission is to ensure the efficient and timely procurement of resources essential for developing compelling offers.
   

  

 The core of the role is fact\-based cost ownership. You develop should\-cost models and detailed cost breakdowns for mechanical components — sheet metal parts, steel tubes, copper tubes, fabricated assemblies, machined parts and welded structures — and use them to support commercial negotiations, supplier cost analysis, value engineering and cost reduction across the offer lifecycle. You give the sourcing team data\-driven insight into manufacturing cost, material cost, labour content and conversion cost.
   

  

 You work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing and Suppliers to identify cost optimisation opportunities and improve overall supply chain competitiveness.
   

  

 As an individual contributor you execute operational and functional strategies within the procurement discipline, applying specialised knowledge to deliver results that directly impact offer creation. You decide on your own work and priorities within established policies and procedures, guide other professionals on non\-routine procurement issues, and your work is occasionally reviewed for quality against organisational standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Should Costing \& Cost Modelling


 Develop detailed should\-cost models for:
   

  

* Sheet metal components
* Steel tube assemblies
* Copper tube components
* Fabricated and welded structures
* Machined components
* Powder\-coated parts
* Mechanical assemblies
* Manufacturing Process Analysis


 Analyse manufacturing processes and their cost drivers, including:
   

  

* Laser cutting, turret punching and bending
* Welding and brazing
* Tube bending and tube forming
* Machining
* Powder coating
* Cost Estimation


 Build up and estimate:
   

  

* Raw material cost
* Conversion cost
* Labour cost
* Overheads and profit
* Machine hour rates
* Packing and freight cost
* Procurement Support
* Support sourcing teams during supplier negotiations through fact\-based cost analysis.
