* Design\-to\-cost initiatives
* Material optimisation
* Manufacturing process improvements
* Standardisation
* Participation in QVE (Quality Value Engineering) workshops
* Offer Lifecycle Ownership
* Collaborate with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs for new offers at the earliest project stage.
* Source and procure the materials and services required to develop new offers, and secure supplier selection against project gates.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure cost\-effective offer creation.
* Ensure the target cost committed at project launch is achieved and maintained through the offer lifecycle.

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production or Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Strategic sourcing

* Understanding of material standards, sheet metal fabrication, tube forming, welding and machining processes.

title: Senior Pre-Sales & AI Solutions | Finance (AP & AR)
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for someone who has genuinely been in the room — with CFOs, Controllers, and VP Finance buyers — and knows how to navigate those conversations. This is a pre\-Sales leadership role embedded within EXL's Finance AI practice, focused on Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable. You'll own the pipeline, lead solutioning, and be the person clients want to call when they're thinking through their next Finance transformation.
 



  





 This isn't a role for someone who hands off to technical teams once a deal gets interesting. You'll stay involved from first conversation through proof\-of\-concept, and you'll be the one shaping how EXL's AI capabilities are positioned in the market.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  




* **Pipeline \& Revenue**



 You'll carry real pipeline responsibility — not just support it. That means building and managing a healthy funnel of AP and AR opportunities, working closely with account teams and industry leaders to identify where EXL's Finance AI solutions can land and expand. You'll track deal progress, flag risks early, and know when to escalate or pivot.
 



  




* **CFO Org Engagement**



 You've sold into Finance before. You understand that a CFO's priorities aren't the same as an IT buyer, and you know how to translate AI capability into business value — cycle time, working capital, exception rates, straight\-through processing. You'll lead client conversations at the VP, Controller, and CFO level and build the kind of relationships that turn a first engagement into a long\-term partnership.
 



  




* **Solutioning \& Deal Shaping**



 You'll take the lead on scoping and structuring deals — defining what we're solving, how we'd solve it, and what success looks like. This includes running discovery sessions, building business cases, and architecting proof\-of\-concepts that are credible and deliverable. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's under the hood well enough to have an honest conversation about it.
 



  




* **Proposals \& RFPs**



 You'll own the quality of EXL's responses to RFIs and RFPs in the Finance AI space. That means writing clearly, making smart choices about what to emphasize, and ensuring we're not just answering the question but positioning EXL to win.
 



  




* **Thought Leadership \& Market Presence**



 You'll represent EXL in the market — at industry events, in analyst conversations (Gartner, Everest, ISG), and through content like point\-of\-view papers and client workshops. The goal is to make EXL the name that Finance leaders think of when AI\-powered P2P or O2C comes up.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




  





***Domain Knowledge — AP \& AR***



* Deep, working familiarity with Procure\-to\-Pay and Order\-to\-Cash processes — not surface\-level, but enough to lead a discovery session with a Controller without preparation
* Direct exposure to common AP/AR pain points: invoice exception volumes, supplier onboarding delays, cash application complexity, and ERP integration challenges
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise ERP environments — SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Coupa, or Ariba — in a client\-facing or implementation context
* Ability to speak to Finance KPIs naturally: DPO, DSO, STP rates, three\-way match accuracy, and working capital impact



***AI Product Fluency***



* Prior involvement in selling or solutioning AI\-powered Finance products — intelligent document processing, ML\-based matching, agentic workflows, or exception management automation
* Enough technical grounding to have an honest conversation about what an AI solution can and cannot do — without relying on a solutions architect to field every hard question
* Familiarity with how AI capabilities are packaged and positioned in the Finance technology market, including awareness of key vendors and platform players



***Communication \& Executive Presence***



* Proven comfort engaging at the CFO, VP Finance, and Controller level — building credibility through specificity, not just enthusiasm
* Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for a Finance audience without losing accuracy
* Strong written communication skills — capable of producing sharp proposals, executive summaries, and point\-of\-view content independently
* Knows when to listen, when to push back, and when to bring in support — reads a room well



***Pre\-Sales Track Record***



* Has owned pipeline before, not just supported it — with accountability for forecasting, deal progression, and close
* Experience leading multi\-stakeholder sales cycles in Finance technology or BPS, from qualification through commercial agreement
* Comfortable working in a matrixed environment — able to align delivery, product, and account teams toward a shared outcome
* Track record of converting first engagements into longer\-term client relationships



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* 12–15 years of total experience, with a meaningful portion in Finance technology pre\-sales, solutioning, or consulting
* Demonstrated experience selling to or advising CFO\-org stakeholders (CFO, VP Finance, Controller, Treasurer)
* Strong functional knowledge of AP and/or AR processes; direct experience with P2P or O2C transformation programs is a strong plus
* Familiarity with AI solutions in Finance — IDP, intelligent matching, exception management, cash application automation
* Experience with ERP platforms commonly found in enterprise Finance environments (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Coupa, or similar)
* Proven ability to build and manage a sales pipeline, including forecasting and opportunity management
* Excellent written and verbal communication; strong proposal and presentation skills
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, or a related field; MBA or CA is an advantage



  





  





**Why This Role** 




 EXL's Finance Agentic practice is growing, and the market is moving fast. There's genuine greenfield opportunity here — clients are actively looking for partners who understand both the Finance domain and what AI/Agentic can realistically deliver. This role puts you at the front of that conversation, with the backing of a strong delivery organization and a real product platform behind you.
 



  





 If you've spent years building domain credibility in Finance and you're ready to apply it in a market\-facing role with real commercial accountability, this is worth a conversation.

actionable insights for business stakeholders.

behind the numbers, identify inconsistencies and independently drive assigned activities
  

to closure.

Financial Reporting and Analysis

Technology business.

reviews.

Technical Skills

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.

title: Manager Operations - Traditional Fund Accounting
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Manager Operations – Traditional Fund Accounting.****In this role, you will:*** The traditional Accounting \& Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly \& Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex‑Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory \& Client Reporting. The Accounting \& Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Bangalore. Manage 7 to 8 direct reports, whilst overseeing 15 \-16 headcount of indirect reports, as and when deemed required by business or it can be a manager individual contributor role as well.
* The role will require technical excellence to achieve target deliverables combined with the ability to get work done from administrators and / or Subject Matter Experts to achieve target Key Performance Indicators. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering an excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies. The role would also require the individual to ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved, and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal control and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Set a high standard of continuous staff motivation and leadership to ensure a good work environment. Responsible for performance relating to completion of valuations packs of fund portfolios as per Performance Level Agreement on timeliness \& quality and Business Partner’s contact on all process related issues resolution. Effectively mitigate identified Operational Risks. Comply with Group’s Statutory Audit standards. Proactively identify and reduce manual processes for enhanced operational control. Support and implement technology upgradation. Lead User Acceptance Testing for the business (as and when required). Lead Projects for both business partners and Markets and Securities Services Bangalore (based on business objectives, targets and requirements).
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the Traditional Net Asset Value processes and keep abreast with the latest developments in the assigned markets on the rules and regulations by the regulators, stock exchange etc. that may have implication to the daily Net Asset Value processes. Devise and analyses Management Information requirements/processes to ensure the tracking mechanism is reflective of the current business activities and its ability to measure the team’s performance across different market with different level of experience. Ensure that business data requirements are completed accurately and supporting statistics/reports/returns are presented to business/management within agreed timescales. To plan for standardization of processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness.
* Responsible for reviewing Net Asset Value packs. Process productivity and quality targets are set, monitored and achieved to ensure optimum resource utilization and achievement of business objectives and customer Service Level Agreement’s. Drive the delivery of rigorous and customer centric Quality Campaigns and initiatives to increase Quality awareness in the team. Proactively identify and resolve problem situations to give maximum customer satisfaction and escalated where necessary and take appropriate measures to improve quality and prevent recurrence. Establish and maintain effective relationship with customer business areas and identify areas of service improvements. Act as a key escalation point in resolving issues with the Business Partner on a timely \& ongoing basis.
* Ensure packs are delivered with quality and within set deadlines with additional focus on priority clients and strategic approach on valuations should be done keeping the priority clients in mind. To plan for allocation/reallocation of resources to smoothen workflows/volumes and ensure that robust cross training plan is in place to multi skill operation teams. Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, agreed with the business areas, fully communicated to staff and implemented. Drive staff development through soft skill training, personal development plans and performance management reviews. Reward and recognize service excellence and keep high staff morale through ‘Celebrating Success’. Create an environment where skills and knowledge are openly shared to achieve department and business goals. Create a strong succession planning / effective cross training to eliminate key person risk associated with self / team members.
* Ensure control measures/checkpoints are established to scrutinize exceptions/errors to prevent any operational losses and reviews on these measures are constantly performed. Procedural changes/new initiatives are reviewed, fully communicated to and implemented. Review Contingency requirements on a periodic basis and invoke relevant business recovery measures as necessary. Carry out effective Operational Risk Assessment by monitoring and implementing risk mitigating plans. Maintains HSBC internal control standards, overseeing the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
* Maintain a proactive awareness of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role, ensuring that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring while also Ensuring escalation process is in place and is effective. Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any). Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Ensure governance on all daily/weekly tracker updated by team. Update all Management Information by the stipulated deadlines. Additional review of Job\-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedures, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically

**To be successful, you will:*** Bachelor’s degree in accounting or qualifications in the accounting/finance industry. Excellent knowledge in Net Asset Value Calculation process with clear understanding of end\-to\-end Fund Accounting Model. Understanding of Gross Asset Value and Net Asset Value Activities. Previous experience in performing \& reviewing funds in Accounting \& Valuations working areas.
* 5\+ years of relevant Funds administration experience. Ability to monitor and meet operational goals. Should have an eye for detail and a strong analytical mind. Excellent knowledge of Capital Markets and Financial instruments. Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Ability to update, manage and analyses Management Information related activities. Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Effective communication skills. Proactive in implementing and driving solutions.
* Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationship with other departments and jurisdiction, thus ensuring smooth operations. Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on Microsoft Office. Ability to speak and understand English fluently, writes business letters and reports, good conversational / telephone skills. Ability to learn quickly, transfers knowledge appropriately, understand and interpret numeric data. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements.
* Strong leadership skills evidenced by achievement of objectives together with a track record of development of individuals with strong organization and planning skills along with the ability to handle capacity and Management Information reporting. Initiate cost control measures by achieving resource efficiency and managing overheads. Evidence of process management skills with an ability to initiate process improvements
* Evidence of very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills. Ability to effectively communicate and implement group policies and procedures. Ability to comprehend and minimize operational risks including wide understanding of audit controls and compliance requirements.
* Ability to manage and develop a team staff across a diverse range of processes within an operational environment. Ability to maintain control, direction and motivation of staff in an ever\-changing environment. Proven experience in change and problem\-solving management. Evidence of good analytical, statistical and data mining skills to study trends and make projections. Production management skills and ability to initiate process improvements and recognize areas for development. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* A positive self\-starter. Ability to manage resources to continually improve customer service and achieve productivity targets. Good communication skills and enjoys working with people in relation to role. Ability to plan \& organize effectively as well as adopt a flexible approach to change. Will need to possess good multi\-tasking skills and be flexible, as operations will cover multiple teams and time zones
* Working knowledge on Multifonds, Pcontrol, ICON, Bloomberg, etc. Good knowledge in investment accounting and investment valuations. Knowledge in the use of Bloomberg and/or Reuters. Strong Accounting Concepts with a clear understanding of financial statements. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.

title: Quant Model Risk Analyst/Associate - Counterparty Credit Risk
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view. As part of the firm's model risk management function, the Model Risk Governance and Review group is charged with developing model risk policy and control procedures, performing model validation activities, providing guidance on a model's appropriate usage in the business context, evaluating ongoing model performance testing, and ensuring that model users are aware of the model strengths and limitations.


As a Quant Modelling Analyst/Associate you will be a member of the Model Risk Governance and Review group in Bengaluru covering Counterparty Credit Risk models where you will have exposure to multiple assets classes, collateral modelling, advanced modelling methodologies as wells as day\-to\-day interaction with Quantitative Research teams, Risk functions and trading desks. Your position will focus on the following activities:

**Job responsibilities:**

* Model validation of trading models/pricers used in XVA, Counterparty Credit Exposure and IMM/Capital calculations and regulatory stress testing.
* Perform assessments of the conceptual soundness of model specification, the appropriateness of the methodology for its intended purpose, reasonableness of assumptions and reliability of inputs and assessment of model limitations
* Assess completeness of testing performed to support the correctness of the implementation
* Perform ongoing performance monitoring tests and regulatory/non\-regulatory back testing to ascertain that models are relevant and fit for purpose.
* Assist with model governance processes, model inventory and issue management and help to devise new model governance policies as and when required.
* Work closely with model developers, trading desks, and controls functions across the firm to understand methodology, usage and establish transparency around model controls, model limitations and performance

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Quantitative background with at least a bachelors degree in Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Statistics, Quant Finance, or similar.
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills; knowledge of probability theory, statistics, mathematical finance, econometrics, numerical methods and stochastic calculus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills; ability to multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently, with remote supervision
* Risk and control mindset: ability to ask incisive questions, assess materiality and escalate issue

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Knowledge and interest in Python programming
* Understanding of finance industry, particularly in modeling\- valuation, risk, capital, forecasting, investment management


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as evaluating country\-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.

Senior Manager / AVP — Embedded Finance \& Strategic Partnerships

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

 Partner \& Enterprise Relationship Management

* Support and independently lead select CXO\-level partner conversations, contributing to bespoke commercial and

 business fit before escalating recommendations to the VP.
   

  

 Credit, Risk \& Product Co\-design

 cost bands, and portfolio quality across partner cohorts.

 Technology, and Collections to keep partner deliverables on track.

 Market \& Regulatory Awareness

 What We're Looking For

* Demonstrated experience owning partner relationships end\-to\-end, including some exposure to CXO\-level or


 senior stakeholder conversations.
   

  

* Working fluency in credit and risk concepts — approval rates, credit cost, portfolio quality — and comfort

* Structured communicator, comfortable preparing content for senior leadership and Board\-level audiences.

title: Assistant Manager Finance Account
description:
WE’RE HIRING: ASST. MANAGER – ACCOUNTS \& FINANCE
 



  





 Location: Seawoods, Navi Mumbai
 



 Experience: 6–9 years
 



 Employment: Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 Company: Accordible Integrated Facility Solutions
 



  





 Accordible is looking for a strong Accounts \& Finance Manager who can build financial discipline, improve cash\-flow visibility and provide management with reliable information for decision\-making.
 



  





 This is a managerial role, not a bookkeeping\-only position.
 



  





 ROLE MANDATE
 



  





 The Finance Manager will take ownership of the complete finance cycle:
 



  





 Accounting → Compliance → Billing → Collections → Cash Flow → MIS → Profitability → Financial Controls
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 • Lead monthly books closure and ensure accurate accounting
 



 • Review bank, customer and vendor reconciliations
 



 • Control billing and prevent unbilled revenue
 



 • Own receivable ageing, collections and overdue recovery
 



 • Manage payables, vendor reconciliations and payment cycles
 



 • Maintain a rolling 13\-week cash\-flow forecast
 



 • Ensure timely GST, TDS, PF, ESIC, PT and other statutory compliance
 



 • Review payroll inputs, deductions, advances and reimbursements
 



 • Prepare monthly P\&L, Balance Sheet summaries and Management MIS
 



 • Monitor budgets, overheads, direct costs and margin performance
 



 • Develop client\-wise, service\-wise and job\-wise profitability reporting
 



 • Strengthen maker\-checker controls and prevent financial leakage
 



 • Lead, allocate and review the work of the Accounts \& Finance team
 



  





 MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 



  





 The Finance Manager will provide clear visibility of:
 



  





 Booked → Executed → Invoiced → Collected
 



  





 The monthly Finance Dashboard will also cover:
 



  





 • Cash position and forecast
 



 • Receivable and payable ageing
 



 • Gross profit and gross margin
 



 • EBITDA and PAT
 



 • Budget vs Actual
 



 • Client, service and job profitability
 



 • Financial risks and corrective actions
 



  





 KEY KRAs AND KPIs
 



  





 Financial Accuracy \& Compliance
 



  





 • Monthly books closure by the 7th working day
 



 • Accounting accuracy of at least 99%
 



 • 100% on\-time statutory compliance
 



  





 Cash Flow, Billing \& Collections
 



  





 • At least 95% of eligible executed revenue invoiced within three working days
 



 • At least 90% of due collections received within agreed credit terms
 



 • Immediate 30\-day cash\-flow forecast variance maintained within ±10%
 



  





 Profitability, MIS \& Financial Controls
 



  





 • Monthly Management MIS submitted by the 10th
 



 • At least 95% of material revenue mapped to identifiable direct costs
 



 • Zero material financial leakage resulting from control failure
 



  





 CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



  





 • 6–9 years of relevant Accounts \& Finance experience
 



 • Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounts receivable and accounts payable
 



 • Experience managing monthly closure and Balance Sheet schedules
 



 • Strong understanding of cash flow and working\-capital management
 



 • Experience preparing P\&L, MIS and Budget vs Actual reports
 



 • Strong Excel and financial\-analysis skills
 



 • Experience managing a small finance team
 



 • Strong follow\-up, ownership and problem\-solving ability
 



 • Comfortable working directly with the CEO and senior management
 



  





 PREFERRED BACKGROUND
 



  





 • B.Com or M.Com
 



 • CA Inter, CMA Inter or MBA Finance is desirable
 



 • Experience with Tally, Zoho Books or an equivalent accounting system
 



 • Experience in facility management, manpower, projects, contracting, hospitality services or another B2B service business
 



 • Exposure to job costing and project profitability
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 We need a finance professional who can move beyond transaction processing and convert financial data into business insight.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to:
 



  





 • Explain the key drivers behind financial performance
 



 • Provide reliable visibility of cash flow and working capital
 



 • Identify margin leakage and cost\-control opportunities
 



 • Anticipate financial risks before they affect operations
 



 • Recommend practical and commercially sound corrective actions
 



 • Establish financial accountability across departments
 



  





 This role will not suit candidates whose experience is limited to data entry, voucher posting, GST filing, payroll processing or operating Tally without financial analysis and management reporting.
 



  





 If you have the experience and ownership mindset to make a growing company’s finances more visible, predictable and controlled, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





 Apply directly through LinkedIn.
 



  





 Candidates must be comfortable working full\-time from our Seawoods, Navi Mumbai office.

title: Category Finance Manager
description:
**JOB ROLE:** 
 Category Finance Manager – Fans and Consumer Lighting
 



**REPORTING TO:** 
 Head – FP\&A
 



**TYPE OF ROLE:** 
 Individual Contributor Role
 



**LOCATION:** 
 Prabhadevi, Mumbai.
 



**BU/ DIVISION:** 
 Finance
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 To be the finance co\-pilot to the Fans and Consumer Lighting business — owning the business P\&L, driving profitable growth through disciplined investment decisions, portfolio and pricing management, innovation governance and marketing ROI, so that every rupee invested behind the portfolio creates long term value.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\.** 
**Business P\&L ownership** 



* Own the Fans and Consumer Lighting P\&L end to end — from gross sales to business contribution and business EBITDA.
* Act as the single finance point of accountability for the portfolio; co\-sign every commercial decision that moves the P\&L.
* Publish a monthly business performance review with drivers, risks and corrective actions — not just numbers.



**2\. Rolling forecasts \& AOP** 



* Build and maintain a rolling 12\-month forecast for volume, revenue, margin and A\&P at business and category level.
* Lead the Annual Operating Plan for Fans and Consumer Lighting — bottom\-up build by category, channel and SKU.
* Flag forecast\-to\-actual gaps early with a quantified bridge and a recovery plan agreed with the business.



**3\. Margin by SKU \& category P\&L** 



* Maintain SKU\-level gross margin, contribution and profitability rankings; refresh with every cost or price change.
* Build product category P\&Ls (Fans, Consumer Lighting, Lamps, Luminaires, Decorative and Functional Lighting, etc.) with fully allocated costs.
* Identify and drive margin\-accretive mix shifts; escalate loss\-making and sub\-threshold SKUs with an exit or fix plan.



**4\. Variance** 



* Deliver disciplined price–volume–mix–cost (PVM) bridges versus AOP, forecast and prior year at business and category level.
* Explain the business reason behind every variance — category mix, channel mix, promo intensity, input cost, operating leverage.
* Convert variance insight into named actions with owners and timelines; track closure to completion.



**5\.** 
**Pricing \& revenue growth management** 



* Partner on MOP/MRP architecture, price laddering and premiumization across the Fans and Consumer Lighting portfolio.
* Evaluate price elasticity, competitive positioning versus peers, and the price–pack architecture (PPA) opportunity.
* Govern trade schemes, discounts and gross\-to\-net leakage; quantify the ROI of every scheme before and after launch.



**6\. PPA \& premiumization** 



* Lead price–pack architecture work — identify white spaces, entry price points and premium tiers by channel.
* Model the margin and mix impact of PPA interventions and track realization against the approved business case.
* Support portfolio simplification and SKU rationalization to reduce complexity, working capital, and supply chain cost.



**7\. A\&P investment \& marketing ROI** 



* Own planning, tracking and governance of Fans and Consumer Lighting A\&P spend — media, digital, e\-commerce, activation and visibility.
* Measure ROI on media, consumer promotions and platform spends; recommend reallocation towards the highest\-return levers.
* Ensure spends follow the DOA process and stay within the approved plan; no unbudgeted commitments.



**8\.** 
**Innovation \& NPD finance** 



* Build and challenge business cases for new launches — costing, pricing, payback, breakeven volumes and cannibalization.
* Prioritize the innovation pipeline on the basis of value creation, not activity.
* Conduct post\-launch reviews at 6 and 12 months; report benefit realisation versus the approved case.



**9\. Channel \& customer profitability** 



* Track profitability by channel — general trade, modern trade, e\-commerce, quick commerce and alternate — and by key account.
* Quantify the true cost to serve, including placement fees, returns, damages and platform commissions.
* Support channel mix decisions that protect category margins while defending share.



**10\. Controls, working capital \& governance** 



* Ensure the integrity of business financials — provisions, rebates, claims, price protection and inventory valuation.
* Partner supply chain on inventory health, ageing, non\-moving stock and working capital release for the business.
* Uphold internal financial controls, the RACM and statutory/audit requirements within the business commercial processes.



  





**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Chartered Accountant / MBA (Finance) from a reputed institute. CMA with strong commercial exposure will also be considered.



  





**WORK EXPERIENCE** 



* 6\-10 years post\-qualification, with at least 2 years in category or commercial finance in consumer durables, FMEG, electricals, fans, lighting, FMCG or appliances.



  





**PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT** 



* Strong costing and margin analytics
* PVM bridging
* Price elasticity and scenario modelling
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling
* SAP (FI/CO, COPA), Power BI or equivalent visualization, planning tools such as Anaplan / TM1 / SAP BPC. Familiarity with e\-commerce and secondary sales data platforms is an advantage.

title: Sr Analyst - Trade Finance
description:
**Company**
 Puma Energy is a leading global energy business which supplies, stores and distributes petroleum products in 47 countries across six continents. Founded in 1997, Puma Energy has its headquarters in Singapore and Geneva and employs over 8,000 people globally with regional hubs in South Africa, Puerto Rico and Estonia and have recently setup a Global Delivery Centre in Mumbai (India).
   

  

**Puma Processing Services LLP (PEPS) established in Year 2018, represents Puma Energy’s first captive offshoring unit and is based in Mumbai, India with over 200 employees.**
**Main Purpose:**
 To provide efficient finance operations and risk management for our international oil trading activities.
   

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Issuance of L/C’s or Bank Guarantees for our purchases of Crude and Oil Products including negotiation with banks in order to place transactions under bilateral facilities.
* Review of contracts for all transactions in accordance with company policy and procedure
* To check and approve cargo loadings and discharges whilst ensuring contractual obligations are met without exposing the company to risk or loss.
* Risk covering sales where necessary with Banks and/or Insurance.
* Release and stock management, exposure monitoring and weekly m2m of any storage positions.
* Close co\-operation with our Deals Desk personnel to ensure any costs agreed by Trade Finance are allocated correctly to the separately maintained deal Profit and Loss accounts.
* Close co\-operation with our Oil Operations team to ensure that our physical logistical requirements are in alignment with financial and risk considerations
* Preparation and despatch of Invoices and Letters of Indemnity (or shipping documents) for payment under Documentary Letters of Credit received from our buyers.
* The reception / recording and distribution of shipping documents – including the allocation and despatch of such documents to our trading counter\-parts / financing banks enabling the prompt cancellation of outstanding LOI’s
* The regular chasing of any shipping documents not received in a timely manner from our trading counter\-parts / financing banks – thus ensuring that our credit facilities are used to an optimum level.
* Ensuring timely processing of Cargo payments together with managing cash positions with the Banks.
* Closely liaising with teams in Singapore/ Geneva/ Johannesburg and other onshore Puma locations


**Experience**
* 5\-8 years within a Trading Company / Financial institution having gained a basic understanding of the principals surrounding Trade Finance instruments and their pitfalls would be desirable
* Desirable knowledge on PEPS trading business, Finance, Inco Terms, Basics of LCs etc.
* Well\-organized and pro\-active, excellent communication skills, strong coordinating skills, able to demonstrate exceptional problem solving and the ability to think in a highly logical and critical fashion
* Highly diligent and sharp eye for attention to details
* Able to take initiative and not only work to, but also set their own quickly changing deadlines
* A team player, who is able to confidentially adapt their interpersonal approach as the situation demands, able to build strong relations both inter\-departmentally and with external stakeholders
* An individual who is not only comfortable but thrives in a high pressure environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel
* Excellent spoken and written English


**Key Relationships**
* External – Banks, Insurance, Counterparties.
* Internal – Ops, Traders, Contracts, Treasury, Credit, Accounting \& Deals Desk

title: AVP/Business Head - Execution for Asset Reconstruction
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 AVP – ARC Business – Execution
 



**Department:** 
 ARC Business / Asset Resolution
 



**Reports To:** 
 Senior Management
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience Required:** 
 10–15 Years
 



**Educational Qualification:** 
 MBA in Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent postgraduate qualification
 



 ABOUT THE ORGANISATION
 



 A leading
 **RBI\-registered Asset Reconstruction Company (ARC)** 
 engaged in the acquisition and resolution of stressed assets from banks and financial institutions.
 



 The organisation focuses on structured and efficient resolution strategies, including restructuring, enforcement and asset monetisation, with an emphasis on value maximisation and timely recovery.
 



 ROLE OVERVIEW
 



 The
 **AVP – ARC Business – Execution** 
 will be responsible for managing the
 **end\-to\-end execution of stressed\-asset transactions and resolution initiatives** 
 .
 



 The role will involve transaction evaluation, financial analysis, due diligence, structuring, bidding, documentation, transaction closure, asset onboarding and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
 



 This is a
 **purely execution\-oriented role** 
 and does
 **not** 
 involve Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Origination or Asset Acquisition.
 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



**1\. Transaction Evaluation \& Execution** 



* Evaluate stressed\-asset opportunities referred for execution.
* Analyse borrower exposures, outstanding debt, security, recovery prospects and available information.
* Coordinate financial, legal, technical and commercial due diligence.
* Review valuations, cash flows, security cover and potential resolution scenarios.
* Prepare transaction evaluation notes and management presentations.



**2\. Deal Structuring \& Bidding** 



* Support structuring of stressed\-asset transactions within applicable regulatory and internal frameworks.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of bids under Swiss Challenge, bilateral and competitive processes.
* Review transaction structures, pricing assumptions and financial models.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bidding processes.



**3\. Transaction Closure \& Asset Onboarding** 



* Drive post\-bid execution and transaction closure activities.
* Coordinate documentation, conditions precedent and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and transfer of assets following transaction closure.
* Track and resolve outstanding transaction\-related matters.



**4\. Resolution Execution Support** 



* Work closely with the Asset Resolution team in implementing approved resolution strategies.
* Support restructuring, enforcement, settlement and asset monetisation initiatives.
* Monitor resolution milestones, recovery actions and execution timelines.
* Provide periodic transaction and resolution updates to senior management.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Coordinate with internal teams and external legal, valuation, diligence and advisory professionals.
* Ensure timely exchange and validation of transaction information.
* Identify execution issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Escalate material transaction risks, delays and dependencies to senior management.



**6\. MIS, Governance \& Compliance** 



* Maintain transaction\-level MIS and execution trackers.
* Monitor transaction timelines, documentation and closure milestones.
* Ensure adherence to applicable RBI guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and records.
* Identify opportunities to improve transaction execution processes.



 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
 


* Timely execution and closure of transactions.
* Transaction evaluation quality and accuracy.
* Due diligence and documentation turnaround.
* Bidding\-process efficiency.
* Successful asset onboarding following transaction closure.
* Timely implementation of approved resolution strategies.
* Regulatory and process compliance.
* Effective cross\-functional stakeholder coordination.



 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS
 


* 10–15 years of relevant experience in
 **ARC, Banking, NBFC, Special Situations, Stressed Assets, Corporate Credit, Debt Resolution or Private Debt** 
 .
* Demonstrated experience in
 **transaction execution, stressed\-asset resolution or distressed\-debt processes** 
 .
* Experience in due diligence, transaction structuring, bidding, documentation and closure.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA / CS / LLB or equivalent qualification preferred.



 REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 


* Strong understanding of
 **SARFAESI, IBC 2016, RBI regulations relating to transfer of loan exposures and debt restructuring mechanisms** 
 .
* Strong financial analysis and modelling skills.
* Experience in stressed\-asset transaction execution and resolution.
* Strong understanding of bidding and transaction\-closure processes.
* Excellent project and transaction management skills.
* Strong documentation and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance and Resolution teams.
* Strong communication and management\-presentation skills.



 ROLE EXCLUSIONS
 



 This position is
 **strictly execution\-focused** 
 and does
 **not** 
 carry responsibility for:
 


* Business Development / Sales
* Marketing / Brand Building
* Asset Origination
* Asset Sourcing / Acquisition
* Lead Generation
* Investor Acquisition
* Capital Raising
* Relationship\-led Business Generation



**Primary focus: Transaction Evaluation → Due Diligence → Structuring → Bidding → Closure → Asset Onboarding → Resolution Execution.**

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

title: Head of Corporate Finance
description:
**About the Company** 




  





**Head \- Corporate Finance and Investor Relations \|**
 Vantrock Real Assets \| MumbaiThis seat builds the capital structure of the platform, structures the transactions that grow it \- acquisitions, joint ventures, joint developments and platform deals \- and owns the institutions that fund it. We are looking for someone from the principal's side of the table, not from an advisory bench.
 



  





 ABOUT VANTROCKVantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.The platform is founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti, and the platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.The current pipeline is 10 million sq ft. Ground breaks on the first 2 million sq ft in January 2027\.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 This seat builds the capital structure of the platform, structures the transactions that grow it \- acquisitions, joint ventures, joint developments and platform deals \- and owns the institutions that fund it. We are looking for someone from the principal's side of the table, not from an advisory bench.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities \=** 
 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





  




* The function. A General Manager for Debt Raising and Treasury and a Manager for Corporate Finance. You set the strategy they execute and you are accountable for the whole capital position, not either half.
* The capital structure. How each asset is funded across the founder's equity, co\-investment, asset\-level debt and platform facilities, and how that changes from land to delivery to stabilisation.
* Mergers, acquisitions and platform transactions. Entities, portfolios, part\-built assets, and the share\-versus\-asset question that decides the tax and the risk. Valuation, the offer, diligence across legal, technical, financial and tax, the share purchase and shareholders' agreements, escrows, indemnities, earn\-outs, and the integration after signing.
* Joint venture and joint development structuring, and the vehicles under everything. Special purpose vehicle design, forward sale and built\-to\-suit structures, and the tax and regulatory shape beneath them. Vantrock works with landowners four ways \- outright purchase, joint venture, joint development on the owner's land, and a long lease where the owner keeps title. You build the structure under each: contribution, waterfall, exit, the protections on both sides, and the model that says which of the four a parcel should take.
* The institutional relationships on the capital side. Lenders, co\-investors, forward buyers, and strategic partners, at asset and platform level, built from zero and owned for the life of the platform.
* The underwriting model and the capital case. The model that goes in front of an institution, built by you, defended by you, tied back to what the operating team can actually deliver.
* Investor reporting and the institutional voice. Quarterly reporting, the data room, diligence responses, and a live dashboard our partners see rather than a pack assembled under pressure.
* Rating agency and lender\-facing narrative. CRISIL, ICRA and CARE, the information memorandum, and the credit story the platform tells every counterparty consistently.
* Readiness for what comes next. The reporting discipline, governance and structures needed before an InvIT or a REIT is a real conversation rather than a slide.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* CA, MBA in Finance . An engineering first degree alongside any of those is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.



  





**Required Skills \-** 
 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





  




* 14\+ years, the recent part of it in corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, capital markets or institutional investment inside real estate, infrastructure or a comparable capital\-intensive sector.
* Principal\-side experience is essential. Time at a developer, platform, institutional investor or lender where you carried the outcome. Pure advisory or pure research careers do not clear this seat alone; advisory followed by a principal chapter does.
* Mergers and acquisitions carried as a principal, not advised on from outside. At least two closed transactions where you ran or co\-ran the commercial structuring \- valuation, diligence, the share purchase or business transfer agreement, and what you negotiated into the warranties and indemnities.
* Joint ventures and joint development agreements structured with landowners or partners, with the waterfall, the exit and the protections you personally argued for. That is what separates a deal that survives year seven from one that does not.
* Fluency on the debt side as well as the equity side, including the public sector and development finance channel \- NaBFID under its Transport and Logistics mandate, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI, NABARD and the project finance desks of the public sector banks \- because on a platform this size the two conversations are one conversation.
* Modelling you do yourself. Advanced Excel, a model built from a blank sheet, and the confidence to be cross\-examined on any cell.
* SAP, Oracle or equivalent, and weekly use of AI tools with the judgement to know when they are wrong.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* An engineering first degree alongside CA or MBA in Finance is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 


* It is not fund raising from limited partners. Fund\-side relationships sit with the investment manager.
* It is not accounting

title: Assistant Vice President Finance
description:
**Assistant Vice President Finance \&
 
 Debt Raising**




  





 You report to the Head of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations Or CFO who sets the capital strategy you raise against. This is the seat that goes to the lenders.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 \- The debt strategy and the lender map. Which lender for which asset, at which stage, at what tenor and what cost. Construction finance, term loans, lease rental discounting, structured and mezzanine debt, non\-convertible debentures, and the refinancing that follows.
 



 \- The public sector and development finance channel. NaBFID under its Transport and Logistics mandate, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI and NABARD where the asset qualifies, and the project finance and infrastructure desks of the public sector banks. This channel is long\-tenor, lower\-cost and under\-used by developers of our size, and building it is a stated objective of the seat rather than an afterthought.
 



 \- The private channel alongside it. Private and foreign banks, housing finance companies, infrastructure finance companies and NBFCs, insurance and pension money for long\-tenor paper, private credit and alternative investment funds, and offshore and development finance institution lines where they price better than domestic.
 



 \- Every term sheet, from first approach to disbursement. Structuring, negotiation, security creation, covenants, conditions precedent and subsequent, inter\-creditor arrangements, and the discipline of never signing a covenant the asset cannot live with.
 



 \- Treasury. Cash flow forecasting across special purpose vehicles, drawdown scheduling against construction progress, surplus deployment, banking relationships and mandates, interest rate and currency exposure, and the controls that keep all of it clean.
 



 \- The credit story. Rating agency engagement with CRISIL, ICRA and CARE, the information memorandum, the lender pack, and the quarterly reporting that keeps a lender comfortable between drawdowns.
 



 \- Lender diligence and covenant compliance, run as a discipline rather than a scramble. Technical, legal and financial diligence coordinated by you, with the answers ready before the question.
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 \- 12 \+ years, with the recent part of it raising debt for real estate, warehousing, industrial or infrastructure assets.
 



 \- Borrower\-side experience is essential. A lender\-side career alone does not qualify, and a career that has only ever been lender\-side will not clear this seat. If you have been both \- credit or project finance at a bank or an NBFC, then corporate finance at a developer or a platform \- that is the profile we want most.
 



 \- Closed transactions you can name and size. Construction finance, lease rental discounting, structured debt or NCDs, with the tenor, the pricing and what you negotiated out of the term sheet.
 



 \- Direct experience with at least one public sector or development finance institution \- NaBFID, IIFCL, HUDCO, SIDBI, NABARD, or a public sector bank's project finance or infrastructure group. This is the channel we intend to build and we would rather hire someone who has already walked into those rooms.
 



 \- Treasury run in practice, not in theory: cash flow forecasting across multiple entities, drawdown discipline against construction milestones, and banking mandates you owned.
 



 \- CA, MBA in Finance, or CFA. An engineering first degree alongside any of those is an advantage in this sector, not a requirement.
 



 \- Advanced Microsoft Excel, and financial models you built yourself rather than inherited. Experience with SAP, Oracle or an equivalent treasury or ERP platform.
 



 \- Weekly use of AI tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong.
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 \- It is not fund raising from limited partners. Institutional capital and investor relations sit with the Head of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations, this seat's reporting line, and fund\-side relationships sit with the investment manager.
 



 \- It is not accounting or controllership. The books, the close and project accounting sit in finance and accounts.
 



 \- It is not a relationship\-management seat at a bank in a developer's clothing. You are on the borrower's side and you are expected to argue.

title: Finance Manager II - Payroll Payments & Audits, Payroll

**Description**
 Finance Manager II – Global Payroll Payments \| APAC \& North America
   

  

 Make Payroll Payments Work at Global Scale
   

  

 How do you ensure that millions of employees across multiple countries are paid accurately, securely, and on time?
   

  

 Join Amazon's Global Payroll Payments team as a Finance Manager II, where you will lead the critical payment layer that connects payroll operations, banking partners, technology teams, and financial controls across APAC and North America.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact leadership role at the intersection of Finance, Payments, Banking, Technology, Risk, and Operations. You will own the end\-to\-end payroll payment lifecycle across multiple markets, lead a team responsible for critical payment controls and audits, manage strategic relationships with banking partners, and drive the modernization of payment infrastructure.
   

  

 You will also play a key role in enabling new country and entity launches, adopting modern payment standards such as ISO 20022 and API\-based integrations, strengthening controls, and using automation and AI\-enabled solutions to simplify and scale payment operations.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving complex problems, operating at scale, building high\-performing teams, and transforming finance processes through technology, this role offers an opportunity to make a direct impact on the employee payment experience across multiple geographies.
   

  

 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 Global ownership: Lead payroll payment operations across APAC and North America.
   

  

 High\-impact infrastructure: Influence payment mechanisms that support employee payroll at significant scale.
   

  

 Banking exposure: Build strategic relationships with major banking partners and payment service providers.
   

  

 Transformation mandate: Drive automation, API\-based integrations, ISO 20022 adoption, and process modernization.
   

  

 Leadership opportunity: Develop a team responsible for critical audits, controls, reconciliations, and payment operations.
   

  

 New market launches: Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new entities and geographic expansions.
   

  

 Cross\-functional influence: Partner with Finance, Payroll, Treasury, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and external banking partners.
   

  

 Problem\-solving at scale: Own complex payment incidents and build mechanisms that prevent recurring failures.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global Payroll Payments team sits at the intersection of Payroll, Finance, Banking, Technology, and Operations.
   

  

 We are responsible for ensuring that payroll payments move securely, accurately, and reliably from payroll processing through banking networks to employees across multiple countries.
   

  

 Our work spans payment operations, banking relationships, financial controls, compliance, payment infrastructure, automation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Because payroll is a critical employee experience, the team's work requires a strong combination of operational discipline, financial ownership, technology awareness, and customer obsession.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related field.
   

  

 Experience leading finance, payments, banking operations, payroll, controllership, or related financial operations teams.
   

  

 Experience managing and developing people.
   

  

 Experience working with banking partners, payment service providers, financial institutions, or payment technology teams.
   

  

 Experience managing operational controls, audits, reconciliations, risk, or compliance mechanisms.
   

  

 Experience using data and metrics to identify operational issues and drive process improvements.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience working across multiple teams, geographies, or business functions.
   

  

 Experience with payroll payments, payment operations, treasury, banking infrastructure, or financial technology.
   

  

 Experience managing payment infrastructure or banking setup for new countries, entities, or business launches.
   

  

 Knowledge of ISO 20022, payment file formats, APIs, banking connectivity, or payment modernization.
   

  

 Experience driving automation, digital transformation, or AI\-enabled process improvements.
   

  

 Experience managing relationships with global banking partners and third\-party service providers.
   

  

 Experience operating in complex, highly regulated, or multi\-country environments.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 Experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**In This Role, Success Means**
 Reliable payments. Strong controls. Scalable infrastructure. Fewer recurring defects. Better automation. Strong banking partnerships. And a team that can operate confidently at global scale.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to shape how payroll payments evolve across multiple markets while building mechanisms that make the experience more reliable for the employees who depend on them.
   

  

 If you are a finance leader who enjoys solving complex payment problems, working with banks and technology teams, and building scalable operations, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key Job Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead Global Payroll Payment Operations
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end payroll payment lifecycle across APAC and North America, including payment file generation, bank submission, transaction monitoring, exception management, and reconciliation.
   

  

 Establish operational mechanisms to monitor payment health, service levels, control performance, and critical payment risks.
   

  

 Review operational dashboards and metrics to identify emerging issues, prioritize actions, and maintain high standards of payment accuracy and timeliness.
   

  

 Lead resolution of payment batch failures, rejected transactions, bank exceptions, and other payment\-related issues.
   

  

 Build and Develop High\-Performing Teams
   

  

 Lead and develop a team responsible for payroll payment audits, banking controls, reconciliations, operational monitoring, and issue resolution.
   

  

 Establish clear goals, performance mechanisms, operating rhythms, and development plans for the team.
   

  

 Create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, data\-driven decision\-making, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Build strong technical and business capabilities within the team to support increasingly complex global payment operations.
   

  

 Drive Banking \& Payment Partnerships
   

  

 Build and manage strategic relationships with banking institutions, payment service providers, third\-party vendors, and internal technology teams.
   

  

 Partner with banks to manage service levels, payment requirements, file specifications, format changes, connectivity, and issue resolution.
   

  

 Coordinate payment format migrations and changes while ensuring business continuity and operational readiness.
   

  

 Represent Amazon's payroll payment requirements in discussions with external banking and technology partners.
   

  

 Enable New Market \& Entity Launches
   

  

 Lead payment infrastructure readiness for new Amazon entities, countries, and market expansions.
   

  

 Coordinate bank account onboarding, payment file specifications, connectivity requirements, testing, user acceptance testing, and go\-live readiness.
   

  

 Partner with Payroll, Treasury, Finance, Technology, Compliance, and other stakeholders to identify dependencies and manage launch risks.
   

  

 Establish scalable mechanisms that enable new markets to onboard efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls.
   

  

 Strengthen Controls, Audit \& Compliance
   

  

 Own mechanisms supporting audit readiness across multiple markets and regulatory environments.
   

  

 Lead reviews of banking audits, account changes, payment controls, reconciliations, and operational exceptions.
   

  

 Analyze audit findings and recurring defects to identify root causes and drive permanent corrective actions.
   

  

 Eliminate redundant or manual audit activities by addressing issues upstream and strengthening preventive controls.
   

  

 Maintain appropriate documentation, evidence, and control mechanisms to support internal and external audit requirements.
   

  

 Drive Automation \& Payment Modernization
   

  

 Identify opportunities to eliminate manual activities and improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of payment operations.
   

  

 Partner with technology teams to implement automation, API\-based integrations, modern payment capabilities, and data\-driven operational mechanisms.
   

  

 Drive adoption of modern payment standards, including ISO 20022, where applicable.
   

  

 Explore and implement AI\-enabled solutions to improve exception management, operational monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and process efficiency.
   

  

 Develop scalable solutions that reduce operational risk while improving the overall employee payment experience.
   

  

 Own Critical Escalations \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Serve as a senior escalation point for critical payroll payment incidents, bank\-side failures, batch rejections, and service disruptions.
   

  

 Lead structured root\-cause analysis and coordinate cross\-functional resolution of high\-impact issues.
   

  

 Build mechanisms to prevent recurrence and improve payment resilience.
   

  

 Use data, operational metrics, and customer impact to prioritize improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Drive continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve service quality across markets.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 A Day in the Life
   

  

 Your day may start with a review of payment health, critical exceptions, audit status, and operational metrics across the APAC and North America region.
   

  

 You may then work with your team to investigate a recurring banking exception, partner with a technology team on an API or payment\-file change, or engage a banking partner to resolve a service issue.
   

  

 You could also spend time reviewing the readiness of a new market launch, challenging an existing control, reviewing audit findings, or identifying opportunities to automate a manual process.
   

  

 As a people leader, you will also invest time in coaching your team, reviewing performance and priorities, removing blockers, and creating mechanisms that help the organization operate more effectively at scale.
   

  

 The role combines strategic thinking with operational execution—you will need to move comfortably between executive\-level discussions, banking\-partner negotiations, technology conversations, operational deep dives, and team leadership.

* Proficiency in English, including strong verbal and business writing skills.
* Effective communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with management across Finance and Business teams.

 Provides leadership and technical oversight for corporate accounting operations, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of financial reporting, compliance requirements, client service activities, and team performance while driving process improvements, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* You'll oversee the preparation and review of complex accounting deliverables, including financial statements, bookkeeping activities, general ledger reconciliations, management company accounts, intercompany accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, record\-to\-report processes, tax\-related activities, and corporate accounting deliverables for allocated clients.
* You'll lead, coach, and develop Accountants, Senior Accountants, and new team members by providing technical guidance, performance feedback, training, and support to ensure high\-quality deliverables, continuous learning, and strong team performance.
* You'll manage client relationships and stakeholder interactions by resolving complex accounting queries, responding to client and cluster requests, monitoring service levels, ensuring timely delivery of assignments, and maintaining high standards of client service.
* You'll drive operational excellence by monitoring team KPIs, reviewing quality and compliance standards, implementing process improvements, leading small projects, supporting technology and system enhancements, and ensuring adherence to regulatory and internal control requirements.
* You'll contribute to team leadership and business success through performance evaluations, resource coordination, problem\-solving, cross\-functional collaboration, and the independent resolution of complex technical accounting and operational issues.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health \& Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances \& Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.


**Qualifications**
**About You**
* You hold an MBA and are a qualified or semi\-qualified CA or CMA, with strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge.
* You possess extensive experience in corporate accounting, financial statement preparation, bookkeeping, tax accounting, general ledger reconciliations, management company accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, record\-to\-report processes, and intercompany accounting.
* You demonstrate strong knowledge of US GAAP and have experience applying accounting principles and standards within a corporate or professional services environment.
* You are proficient in accounting systems and ERP platforms, preferably NetSuite, Sage, QuickBooks, or similar financial management applications.
* You have strong leadership, analytical, stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex deliverables, develop team capability, improve processes, and consistently deliver high\-quality results in a fast\-paced environment.


**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
 Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long\-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
   

  

 There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
   

  

 Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

* Timely completion of reconciliation tasks as per defined schedules.

* Compliance with audit requirements and regulatory standards.
* Contribution to process improvements and operational efficiency.

* Strong numerical and analytical abilities.

 The Risk Measurement Team owns and manages a global portfolio risk data platform (MSCI RiskMetrics) that provides ex\-ante market risk measurement, stress\-testing and liquidity risk data to a plethora of stakeholders (Investment Risk Management, Risk Oversight, Product Development, Legal and Compliance, Client Reporting). Risk Measurement is a 2nd line of defence function owning the ex\-ante market and liquidity risk models for Regulatory Risk.
