 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

 and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. The team is also responsible for running valuation controls to ensure fair value of balance sheet in accordance with internal valuation methodology and regulatory requirements. This includes independent price verification of both vanilla securities/derivatives and complex/illiquid assets such as exotic derivatives and distressed assets. Additionally, the team also calculates relevant valuation adjustments including adjustments for illiquidity, concentration, model limitations etc. as applicable. The team is also responsible for calculating and reporting prudential valuation adjustments on a quarterly basis.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, valuation control and methodology (GVG) teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 IPV Center of Excellence forms part of the GBAM CFO Group and is a control and business advisory function. The team’s work primarily covers valuation controls for various asset classes across Global Banking and Markets, with a dynamic book of work providing opportunities to centralize, enhance and implement best practices for global valuation routines.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the valuations control area for one or a group of asset classes within FICC Macro (Rates/FX/Commodities) / FICC Micro (Credit/Mortgages/Munis) / XVA / Equities businesses in Global Markets. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to functionally lead and deliver Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments, Prudent Valuations and Fair Value Hierarchy assessment, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation.
   

  

 The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Finance and Global Valuations Group (GVG) teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job. The candidate should have extensive experience of functionally leading high performing teams that deliver valuation control capabilities. The candidate will be expected to leverage her/his extensive knowledge of processes and best practices within Finance, operations, risk management and talent management to ensure that the GBS team operates effectively as a key strategic component of the global GBAM Finance organization.
   

  

 The team is also encouraged to take part in employee engagement and diversity and inclusion initiatives to help continue to make Bank of America a great place to work.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Performing the calculation and analysis of valuation controls including IPV, valuation adjustments and prudent valuation adjustments, as well as ownership for Fair Value Hierarchy levelling.
* Demonstrate strong SME knowledge with the ability to operate with end\-to\-end accountability.
* Working with the Global Valuation Group to ensure ongoing review \& enhancement of valuation control methodologies and practices.
* Provide strong technical leadership on independent valuation principles.
* Strong understanding of trader’s risk positions and valuation principles, own the end\-to\-end desk communication and challenge process for GBAM Finance.
* Timely identification and escalation of red flags to Business Finance and Control leads and other independent stakeholders.
* Drive solid supervisory reviews and governance around implementation of the valuation framework.
* Work closely with the trading desks on valuation issues and valuation differences.
* Lead conversations with Front office with respect to IPV variances, changes in valuation adjustments etc.
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls and supervisory review routines pertaining to valuation control.
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves.
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries and enable the business and be “Accurate \& well controlled” across deliverables.
* Ensure audit readiness and compliance for the function as required by business finance policies, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Active participation and collaboration with global teams on regulatory topics pertaining to valuation of assets.
* Act as a catalyst in the execution of global strategic technology projects impacting valuations.
* Develop, standardize \& continuous improvement of existing processes \& workflow.
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk.
* Be pro\-active and engage control partners/ technology to identify and mitigate operational risks.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Valuation Control or Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale with US GAAP, IFRS, IAS reporting framework with an interest and aptitude for derivative products
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred.
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus.
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly.

 12 to 16 years with at least 8\+ years’ experience in Global Markets Valuation Control role

title: SAP Senior Functional Expert – Treasury (Digital Treasury)
description:
Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally.
 



 Our mission: to bring health in people's hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.
 



 At the core of this mission is our 100\+ loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.
 



 Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
 



 B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.
 



 Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com.
 



  





 You've built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we're challenging how self\-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what's next. As an SAP Functional Expert – Treasury, you'll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human.
 



  





**About the job** 




 The SAP Treasury functional expert role is a pivotal, senior position within the digital business solution team for Opella. Acting as an internal SAP consultant and design authority, you will own the functional integrity of the global Treasury application landscape — from SAP TRM and Polaris deployments through to day\-to\-day run and support — and ensure treasury processes, systems and business requirements stay aligned.
 



  





 This is a role with a long horizon. Beyond deployment and continuous enhancement, you will help shape and deliver Opella's 2027–2030 transformation roadmap as the company moves towards a single global ERP strategy, setting the direction for Treasury within it rather than only executing against it.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




**Business partnership \& governance** 




 \* Act as the senior liaison to global Treasury and Finance stakeholders, working within defined governance frameworks and proactively recommending process and system improvements.
 



 \* Build and maintain a deep understanding of Treasury business processes — cash management, liquidity planning, bank account management, financial risk management, payments and in\-house banking — and assess the application landscape for strengths, gaps and integration opportunities.
 



 \* Provide consultative support on business\-led technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with Digital, Finance and enterprise standards.
 



 \* Challenge constructively: translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable functional designs rather than one\-off fixes.
 



  





  





**Solution design \& technical authority** 




 \* Lead solution design and fit\-gap analysis for SAP TRM and Polaris deployments across the global landscape.
 



 \* Validate and approve solution designs delivered by project teams and external partners, ensuring consistency, compliance, auditability and end\-to\-end financial integration.
 



 \* Provide deep functional and technical expertise across SAP Treasury and Finance modules — TRM, Cash \& Liquidity Management, In\-House Cash, Bank Account Management, Bank Communication Management, Multi\-Bank Connectivity and FSCM.
 



 \* Ensure successful implementation and integration of SAP Treasury modules on S/4HANA, and seamless integration with SAP FI/CO and adjacent financial systems.
 



  





**Transformation \& project delivery** 




 \* Contribute to and drive the 2027–2030 ERP transformation roadmap for Treasury as Opella converges on a single global ERP.
 



 \* Lead or support end\-to\-end delivery of Business Value Projects, from business case creation through implementation and KPI monitoring.
 



 \* Develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies (Unit, SIT, UAT), define test cases and follow through to sign\-off.
 



 \* Oversee data migration and cut\-over planning for go\-live readiness, and steer Hypercare until projects transition cleanly to BAU.
 



 \* Surface issues and risks early, identify the right stakeholders, and keep delivery decisions transparent.
 



  





**Run, support \& continuous improvement** 




 \* Ensure business continuity and effective ways of working with the ERP Support and Platform teams on incident management.
 



 \* Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting and optimization across the Treasury domain (cash, payments, risk, investments, bank interfaces); ensure incidents are resolved within SLA and drive root cause analysis on recurring or critical issues.
 



 \* Partner with Product Owners and Business Owners to prioritize the enhancement backlog, reducing incident volume and improving stability and user experience.
 



 \* Ensure the system is well documented and that documentation stays current.
 



  





**Collaboration, change \& adoption** 




 \* Engage with Architecture, Integration and Data teams so Treasury applications follow best practice in design, integration patterns, security and data management; contribute to the evolution of those enterprise standards.
 



 \* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define master data, analytics, authorizations and UX strategies.
 



 \* Drive change management and training initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new systems.
 



 \* Act as key liaison with SAP development teams and external partners for incident resolution and co\-innovation.
 



  





**About You** 




**SAP expertise (core requirement)** 




 \* 8\+ years of strong functional experience across SAP Treasury and Finance modules, including:
 



 \* SAP Treasury \& Risk Management (TRM) — Transaction Manager, Market Risk Analyzer, Hedge Management
 



 \* SAP CLM (Cash \& Liquidity Management)
 



 \* SAP IHC (In\-House Cash / in\-house banking)
 



 \* SAP BAM (Bank Account Management)
 



 \* SAP BCM (Bank Communication Management)
 



 \* SAP MBC (Multi\-Bank Connectivity)
 



 \* Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA implementations and international roll\-out of a core model.
 



 \* Skilled in integration with SAP FI/CO and related financial systems.
 



  





**Treasury and delivery experience** 




 \* Proven, end\-to\-end command of corporate treasury processes: cash management, liquidity planning, financial risk management, FX/MM instruments, payments, bank connectivity and in\-house banking.
 



 \* Solid understanding of compliance (IFRS/GAAP), risk management and audit expectations.
 



 \* Track record of managing complex projects, full testing cycles and stakeholder coordination across a global, multi\-landscape environment.
 



 \* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable functional designs.
 



 \* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



  





**Qualifications and languages** 




 \* Degree in Finance, Economics or a related field; project management or treasury certifications are a plus.
 



 \* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
 



 \* Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a global, multicultural environment.
 



  





**Preferred** 




 \* Experience with integration platforms (SAP CPI, APIs, middleware).
 



 \* Familiarity with Agile ways of working and tooling (Jira, Confluence).
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with incident, problem and change management processes.
 



 \* Exposure to data governance, master data concepts and reporting tools.
 



  





**How you work**

 \* Proactive and solution\-oriented, balancing strategic thinking with operational execution.
 



 \* Able to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.
 



 \* Continuous improvement mindset with a clear focus on delivering business value.

title: Vice President Finance
description:
**Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation** 




  





**Location:** 
 Delhi and Hyderabad, India
 



**Experience:** 
 15–23 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Mastermindnetwork is the hiring organization for this Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation opportunity. The available company brief does not include additional information about its industry, operating scale, culture, products, customers, milestones, or market position, so no unsupported claims have been added. This role is defined around enterprise finance transformation ownership across Record to Report, Order to Cash, and Procure to Pay. The successful leader will connect finance process redesign, ERP implementation, technology decisions, and measurable business outcomes. The position is based in Delhi or Hyderabad and requires working from the office. Candidates should bring substantial experience leading complex transformation programs, preferably from a consulting background, with mandatory end\-to\-end implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise resource planning platform. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory for consideration. The role is intended for an operator who can combine executive stakeholder leadership with practical techno\-functional delivery depth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the finance transformation agenda across R2R, O2C, and P2P, converting business priorities into scalable process, technology, and operating\-model outcomes. Lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation programs across discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization. Act as the senior techno\-functional bridge between finance leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, system integrators, and executive sponsors. Establish governance, architecture alignment, delivery controls, and benefits tracking across the portfolio. The role requires practical hands\-on understanding rather than advisory\-only exposure, with the ability to challenge designs, resolve complex dependencies, and make implementation decisions. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory, while consulting experience is preferred. Success will be measured through adoption, process standardization, controls, reporting quality, cycle\-time improvement, and sustained business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the integrated transformation roadmap across R2R, O2C, and P2P, aligning process, data, controls, and ERP decisions with enterprise finance outcomes and measurable value realization.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP, Oracle, or comparable ERP implementation delivery from requirements and solution design through testing, cutover, stabilization, and post\-go\-live performance improvement.
* Govern system integrators, functional workstreams, and senior stakeholders through structured decision forums, risk controls, dependency management, and transparent executive reporting.
* Translate finance operating\-model requirements into practical techno\-functional solutions, challenging process designs and configuration choices that create standardization, control, scalability, and user adoption.
* Build transformation benefits tracking across close, collections, payables, working capital, compliance, reporting quality, and process cycle times to demonstrate sustained business impact.
* Apply FMCG or CPG project experience to address high\-volume, multi\-entity, customer, supplier, inventory, and commercial finance complexities within transformation programs.
* Lead change adoption across finance and business teams by establishing ownership, capability building, communication, and operating discipline required for new processes and systems.
* Resolve cross\-tower issues decisively, balancing business continuity, implementation timelines, risk exposure, architecture integrity, and long\-term maintainability.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Mandatory hands\-on, end\-to\-end implementation experience with SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise ERP platform, covering design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Strong techno\-functional command of R2R, O2C, and P2P processes, including controls, master data, integrations, reporting, close, collections, procurement, and payables outcomes.
* Proven transformation governance capability across system integrators, cross\-functional teams, executive stakeholders, delivery risks, dependencies, benefits, and adoption measures.
* Mandatory experience delivering FMCG or CPG\-related transformation projects involving complex, high\-volume, multi\-entity finance and commercial operating environments.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, communication, and executive influencing skills, with the ability to convert ambiguity into implementable decisions and measurable outcomes.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience managing global or multi\-country ERP transformation programs with common templates, localization requirements, shared services, and complex integration landscapes.
* Exposure to finance data, analytics, automation, controls, process mining, or adjacent technologies that improve transparency, decision quality, and operational performance.
* Experience leading post\-go\-live optimization, value realization, and continuous improvement beyond initial implementation delivery.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 15–23 years of experience in finance transformation, ERP delivery, enterprise technology, consulting, or related leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex programs and business outcomes.
* Mandatory end\-to\-end ERP implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform, combining executive\-level leadership with sufficient hands\-on techno\-functional depth to guide critical design and delivery decisions.
* Mandatory FMCG or CPG project experience, including an understanding of high\-volume transactions, multi\-entity operations, commercial finance interfaces, supply\-chain dependencies, and the control environment required for scalable transformation.
* A consulting background is preferred, particularly experience advising senior finance and business leaders while also driving implementation execution, issue resolution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable value realization.
* B.Tech or another technical educational background, supported by strong understanding of finance processes across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
* An outcome\-led leadership style that creates accountability across internal teams, system integrators, business owners, and technology partners while maintaining delivery momentum and implementation quality.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a high\-impact enterprise finance transformation mandate spanning R2R, O2C, and P2P, with direct influence over process, technology, governance, and measurable business outcomes.
* Shape ERP\-led operating\-model change from strategy through implementation and value realization, working at the intersection of finance, technology, and business leadership.
* Bring consulting expertise and FMCG or CPG transformation experience into a senior role where practical delivery judgment and sustained adoption matter as much as strategic vision.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A Vice President\-level mandate with broad ownership of finance transformation across the core R2R, O2C, and P2P towers.
* The opportunity to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation and measurable operating improvement from either the Delhi or Hyderabad office, with a CTC range of ₹50–75 LPA.

title: Manager / Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to join our Sell\-Side Investment Banking team, focused on helping companies raise capital and prepare for their next stage of growth.
   

  

 The role will primarily involve working with IPO\-bound, pre\-IPO and high\-growth companies on fundraising, capital structuring, investor positioning and transaction execution.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in investment banking, equity fundraising, IPO/pre\-IPO transactions, corporate finance, valuation and client acquisition, along with the ability to independently manage relationships with promoters, founders, investors and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Origination \& Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop relationships with companies that are potential pre\-IPO or IPO candidates.
* Source new mandates through promoter/founder relationships, professional networks, intermediaries and industry relationships.
* Develop a strong pipeline of potential fundraising and IPO mandates.
* Understand the company’s business, capital requirements, growth plans and fundraising objectives.
* Pitch and present investment banking solutions to promoters, founders and senior management.
* Fundraising \& Transaction Execution
* Lead and support equity fundraising transactions, including pre\-IPO/private placements and other structured equity transactions.
* Work with companies to determine appropriate fundraising size, valuation, transaction structure and investor positioning.
* Coordinate the complete transaction process from mandate acquisition through successful closure.
* Prepare transaction timelines, investor lists, deal structures and execution plans.
* Coordinate with legal, secretarial, accounting, merchant banking, due\-diligence and other professional advisors.
* IPO \& Pre\-IPO Advisory
* Evaluate companies for IPO readiness and identify gaps that need to be addressed before listing.
* Assist companies in developing an appropriate roadmap from private/pre\-IPO stage to IPO.
* Work closely with management on business positioning, equity story and investor communication.
* Support preparation of investor presentations, information memoranda, financial analysis and other transaction\-related materials.
* Assist in valuation analysis and benchmarking against listed and comparable companies.
* Investor \& Institutional Relationships
* Develop and maintain relationships with HNI, family office, institutional and strategic investors.
* Build and maintain an investor database across sectors.
* Match suitable companies and transactions with relevant investors.
* Coordinate investor meetings, management presentations, conference calls and due\-diligence discussions.
* Understand investor requirements and communicate transaction opportunities effectively.
* Financial Analysis \& Valuation
* Build and review financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct comparable\-company, precedent\-transaction and other relevant valuation analyses.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth prospects and key operating metrics.
* Assist management in understanding valuation expectations and capital\-market positioning.
* Deal Management
* Take ownership of assigned mandates and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple transactions simultaneously and maintain transaction trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Identify transaction risks, bottlenecks and execution issues and proactively resolve them.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and transaction discipline.


 Business Development Expectations
   

  

 For the Manager/AVP level, this is not intended to be a purely execution\-oriented role.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Build a meaningful company/promoter pipeline.
* Develop independent relationships with founders, promoters and senior management.
* Generate new investment\-banking mandates.
* Convert opportunities into signed mandates and successfully executed transactions.
* Build long\-term relationships with companies beyond a single fundraising transaction.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of Investment Banking and Sell\-Side transactions.
* Experience in equity fundraising, pre\-IPO, IPO or corporate finance.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and capital structures.
* Strong business\-development and relationship\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with promoters, CXOs, investors and senior stakeholders.
* Strong transaction\-management and execution capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-growth, entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
 Candidates from the following backgrounds would be relevant:
   

  

* Investment Banking
* CFA (Mandatory)
* Equity Capital Markets
* Merchant Banking
* Corporate Finance
* M\&A / Transaction Advisory
* Private Equity / Venture Capital with strong transaction exposure
* Big 4 Transaction Advisory / Deals
* Securities / Capital Markets


 Experience specifically involving IPO, pre\-IPO or equity fundraising transactions will be an advantage.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to build and manage a strong pipeline of IPO\-bound and pre\-IPO companies, originate high\-quality mandates, execute fundraising transactions efficiently and develop long\-term relationships with promoters and investors.
   

  

 In short: Originate → Advise → Structure → Raise Capital → Execute → Build Long\-Term Client Relationships.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As an experienced techno\-commercial and development professional and member of an in\-house team of expert techno\-commercial experts, this role is responsible for highlighting, for the GE Vernova Financial Services (FS) business, the development, technical, operational, cost and schedule risks associated with equity investment in development, construction and operating power \& renewable assets and projects – all for supporting investment decisions;
   

  

 This individual will be responsible for identifying early to mid stage development techno\-commercial risk and proposing mitigants in support of underwriting, leading due diligence and support formation and implementation of strategies within new investment platforms and portfolio reporting and management.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Specialize in assessing early to mid stage development, technical, operational, construction and development risks in the energy industry.
* Support deal execution teams through front end and customer facing involvement in development deals exhibiting deep domain knowledge and expertise in projects from inception to a “ready to build” / financial close stage.
* Support the efforts of EFS underwriting and portfolio groups in identification and mitigation of risks and in execution of investment objectives. Perform techno\-commercial due diligence for both underwriting and portfolio holdings.
* Review and instructively comment on technical and construction specifications as outlined in key project documents such as interconnection, power off\-take, permits, land agreements, and equipment, construction, operations and maintenance contracts, in some cases even leading / supporting the negotiations of these documents.
* Ensure that technical and business\-related issues are communicated within EFS and provide techno\-commercial risk assessments for credit requests
* Interact with EFS customers and partners and internal GE Power and GE Renewables teams in the completion of due diligence and negotiation of financing terms related to technical issues.
* Possess understanding of the risk appetite, and portfolio management philosophy of EFS.
* Lead due diligence processes into new investment platforms.
* Develop and structure development budgets, schedules and reporting frameworks for new investment platforms.
* Be familiar with the GE industrial product offerings and maintain contacts within GE Power and GE Renewables.
* For assigned investment platforms, manage development progress, reporting and alignment with project budgets and schedules.
* Actively monitor portfolio (e.g. regulatory requirements, development progress, construction, physical plant optimization, and contractual performance). Possess in\-depth understanding of how specific sub\-function interacts with the broader business, as well as a good understanding of the industry and commercial awareness.
* For assigned projects, develop and supervise construction management teams and ensure construction safety, environmental compliance, cost and schedule performance. Provide internal reporting on construction status.
* Support EFS efforts to sell equity positions through assembly of technical project information and responding to buyer’s technical questions.
* Develop and Support investment strategies into other carbon neutral GE Technologies within new markets. Specifically development into blue power and the Small Modular Reactor (SMR) space.
* Must be able to travel within India and APAC for about 40% of the time.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree Civil or Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and Construction Management.
* Masters post\-graduation either in engineering or management strongly preferred.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to identify, analyze and resolve technical development issues. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.


******Additional Information******

 No

This role is responsible for translating ambiguous business questions from business stakeholders into clear, actionable analytical projects. Those projects will allow your team to deliver insights that drive different and more profitable decisions across Ecolab.
   

  

 This individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day\-to\-day may include rapidly prototyping, refining solutions with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
   

  

 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, and scalable data solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into data\-driven solutions
+ Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
+ Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value


* Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools
+ Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
+ Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools.
+ Iterate based on feedback to refine solutions.

* Apply the appropriate analytical approach
+ Work with stakeholders to determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
+ Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).

* Perform data transformation and analysis
+ Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage Databricks or Python to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.

* Design meaningful metrics and outputs
+ Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
+ Ensure outputs are interpretable and relevant to business needs.

* Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions
+ Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
+ Partner cross\-functionally to scale solutions into production

* Operate flexibly between guiding team and execution
+ Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
+ Contribute hands\-on development when needed in resource\-constrained environments

* Drive insight\-led decision\-making
+ Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
+ Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Strong problem\-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Databricks or Python for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using Python.
* Experience with AI\-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product\-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

title: Manager / Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to join our Sell\-Side Investment Banking team, focused on helping companies raise capital and prepare for their next stage of growth.
   

  

 The role will primarily involve working with IPO\-bound, pre\-IPO and high\-growth companies on fundraising, capital structuring, investor positioning and transaction execution.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in investment banking, equity fundraising, IPO/pre\-IPO transactions, corporate finance, valuation and client acquisition, along with the ability to independently manage relationships with promoters, founders, investors and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Origination \& Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop relationships with companies that are potential pre\-IPO or IPO candidates.
* Source new mandates through promoter/founder relationships, professional networks, intermediaries and industry relationships.
* Develop a strong pipeline of potential fundraising and IPO mandates.
* Understand the company’s business, capital requirements, growth plans and fundraising objectives.
* Pitch and present investment banking solutions to promoters, founders and senior management.
* Fundraising \& Transaction Execution
* Lead and support equity fundraising transactions, including pre\-IPO/private placements and other structured equity transactions.
* Work with companies to determine appropriate fundraising size, valuation, transaction structure and investor positioning.
* Coordinate the complete transaction process from mandate acquisition through successful closure.
* Prepare transaction timelines, investor lists, deal structures and execution plans.
* Coordinate with legal, secretarial, accounting, merchant banking, due\-diligence and other professional advisors.
* IPO \& Pre\-IPO Advisory
* Evaluate companies for IPO readiness and identify gaps that need to be addressed before listing.
* Assist companies in developing an appropriate roadmap from private/pre\-IPO stage to IPO.
* Work closely with management on business positioning, equity story and investor communication.
* Support preparation of investor presentations, information memoranda, financial analysis and other transaction\-related materials.
* Assist in valuation analysis and benchmarking against listed and comparable companies.
* Investor \& Institutional Relationships
* Develop and maintain relationships with HNI, family office, institutional and strategic investors.
* Build and maintain an investor database across sectors.
* Match suitable companies and transactions with relevant investors.
* Coordinate investor meetings, management presentations, conference calls and due\-diligence discussions.
* Understand investor requirements and communicate transaction opportunities effectively.
* Financial Analysis \& Valuation
* Build and review financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct comparable\-company, precedent\-transaction and other relevant valuation analyses.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth prospects and key operating metrics.
* Assist management in understanding valuation expectations and capital\-market positioning.
* Deal Management
* Take ownership of assigned mandates and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple transactions simultaneously and maintain transaction trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Identify transaction risks, bottlenecks and execution issues and proactively resolve them.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and transaction discipline.


 Business Development Expectations
   

  

 For the Manager/AVP level, this is not intended to be a purely execution\-oriented role.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Build a meaningful company/promoter pipeline.
* Develop independent relationships with founders, promoters and senior management.
* Generate new investment\-banking mandates.
* Convert opportunities into signed mandates and successfully executed transactions.
* Build long\-term relationships with companies beyond a single fundraising transaction.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of Investment Banking and Sell\-Side transactions.
* Experience in equity fundraising, pre\-IPO, IPO or corporate finance.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and capital structures.
* Strong business\-development and relationship\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with promoters, CXOs, investors and senior stakeholders.
* Strong transaction\-management and execution capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-growth, entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
 Candidates from the following backgrounds would be relevant:
   

  

* Investment Banking
* CFA (Mandatory)
* Equity Capital Markets
* Merchant Banking
* Corporate Finance
* M\&A / Transaction Advisory
* Private Equity / Venture Capital with strong transaction exposure
* Big 4 Transaction Advisory / Deals
* Securities / Capital Markets


 Experience specifically involving IPO, pre\-IPO or equity fundraising transactions will be an advantage.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to build and manage a strong pipeline of IPO\-bound and pre\-IPO companies, originate high\-quality mandates, execute fundraising transactions efficiently and develop long\-term relationships with promoters and investors.
   

  

 In short: Originate → Advise → Structure → Raise Capital → Execute → Build Long\-Term Client Relationships.
   

  

 Skills: management,investment banking,capital,ipo,pre\-ipo,investors

**Job Description:**
**ROLE PURPOSE:**
 As Market Access Manager, you will be responsible for enabling access across the company’s portfolio by developing and implementing market access strategies that address pricing, reimbursement, funding pathways, policy shaping, and stakeholder engagement. The role will support portfolio\-wide access objectives across relevant therapeutic areas, with a specific focus on public accounts, national and sub\-national health authorities, public procurement bodies, and public health programs. Your work will help ensure timely, sustainable, and equitable access to medicines and vaccines by aligning evidence, value communication, and partnership strategies with public\-sector priorities and patient needs.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Portfolio Market Access Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute integrated market access strategies across the portfolio, ensuring each product has a clear access pathway that reflects its value proposition, patient need, public health relevance, affordability considerations, and local healthcare system dynamics.
 **Evidence Generation and Value Demonstration:** 
 Collaborate with medical, HEOR, policy, and cross\-functional teams to generate and translate evidence that demonstrates clinical, economic, budgetary, and public health value across the portfolio, supporting access discussions with public stakeholders and payers.
 **Pricing, Reimbursement, and Funding Pathways:** 
 Support pricing and reimbursement strategies by analyzing market dynamics, public funding mechanisms, procurement models, affordability barriers, and competitor benchmarks, while ensuring alignment with portfolio value, patient access objectives, and compliance requirements.
 **Public Account Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with public accounts, including government health authorities, public payers, national and sub\-national institutions, procurement agencies, public hospitals, and public health program stakeholders, to understand priorities and shape sustainable access solutions.
 **Value Communication:** 
 Communicate product and portfolio value propositions to policymakers, public payers, procurement stakeholders, healthcare providers, and internal teams, clearly articulating clinical value, public health impact, economic considerations, and relevance to public\-sector priorities.
 **Public Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor healthcare policy, public funding priorities, reimbursement trends, procurement processes, tender opportunities, competitor activity, and stakeholder dynamics to identify access opportunities, risks, and implications for the portfolio.
 **Access Planning and Execution:** 
 Partner with cross\-functional teams to integrate market access considerations into brand planning, launch planning, lifecycle management, reimbursement planning, public account plans, and private\-channel access initiatives, ensuring timely execution of activities that support access across the portfolio.
 **Compliance:** 
**and Governance:**

 Ensure all market access and public account activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and ethical standards, maintaining transparency and integrity in all interactions with external stakeholders.
   

  

**Critical leadership capabilities:**
 As a Market Access Manager responsible for portfolio\-wide access with a focus on public accounts, strong leadership capabilities are essential to navigate complex healthcare systems, align internal and external stakeholders, and deliver sustainable access outcomes. The following capabilities are critical for success in this role
   

  

**Strategic Vision:** 
 A Market Access Manager should have a clear and compelling strategic vision for market access initiatives. They must be able to align with the organization's overall goals and craft a well\-defined roadmap to achieve market access objectives.

The Market Access Manager should foster alignment across functions to support portfolio planning, public account execution, and sustainable access outcomes.

 The healthcare landscape and regulatory environment can be dynamic and unpredictable. Effective leaders in market access must be adaptable to changes, able to navigate challenges, and pivot strategies as needed to achieve objectives.

 Market access involves engaging with public health stakeholders, and ethical conduct is critical. A Market Access Manager should uphold high ethical standards and ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations throughout all interactions.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Asia Pacific Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 This position is an integral part of the Asia\-Pacific (AP) Regional Finance Team and works very closely with our regional Specialty Business Units (SBUs), particularly TDA and Platinion business and leadership. The role primarily provides business partnering support to Platinion in the areas of commercial, analysis, decision support, planning, closing review and reporting. It could evolve into further SBU financial support over time.
   

  

 This position is built around teamwork and meeting customer needs which provides the opportunity to work with senior stakeholders in the AP region. The role teams with the local Finance teams, other regional and cross\-functional teams, and the global Finance community. The individual must be a team player and capable of working flexibly, virtually and across different cultures.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Platinion business finance support
* Developing and presenting insightful financial analysis for Platinion and regional leadership to support business decisions; both recurring weekly / monthly reporting as well as ad\-hoc analysis and reporting as required
* Providing in\-depth commercial support to Platinion involved cases, such as, but not limited to evaluating pricing of projects, and its implications on Platinion financials, along with project end\-to\-end management and keeping track of estimated project position to avoid surprises on any overruns/premium adjustment etc
* Supporting the plan and estimate processes for the Platinion business covering financial modelling, capacity planning, revenue projections, reporting and functional cost estimates as well as the preparation of related presentations
* Monitoring and analysing performance against plan and pro\-actively highlighting issues and opportunities for improvements (including but not restricted to revenue, capacity, billability, staffing\- and pricing trends)
* Responsible for the monthly and annual closing of Platinion AP books in coordination with Global Accounting \& Control and local offices.


**Functional Practice Finance Support**
* Supporting the Planning, analysis and reporting on broader functional areas for the TDA Practice Area in AP
* Supporting the coordination and alignment of Platinion reporting units across BCG with other regions, the global team and TDA Practice Area


**AP Regional Finance support**
* Acting as back\-up to the other AP Regional Finance team members as required
* Supporting the broader global finance function in its transformation efforts including roll\-out of new systems, policies, processes, and initiatives.
* Providing support to \& sharing best practices with local Finance teams as required
* Building networks with other regional finance teams, liaising with Global services, Global finance and other Regional Functions as required


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance
* Work experience:
* Internal: Significant experience in BCG Finance preferred, with deep knowledge of BCG accounting, planning, commercial and systems
* External: of around 5\-10 years in handling the Finance planning \& analysis, commercial \& stakeholder management. Experience in service industry and more specifically consulting firms preferred
* Advanced computer literacy:
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Financial Systems, HFM, FIM and BCG’s BIR tool preferred. SAP experience helpful
* At minimum, strong Excel skills required. Affinity with more advanced analytics tools like Tableau \& Power BI is a preference

 A screening call, a technical interview, a case study, and a conversation with the Transaction Services lead you will be working with. We will tell you where you stand after each stage.

**Passion drives success:**

* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

description:

 A screening call, a technical interview, a case study, and a conversation with the Transaction Services lead you will be working with. We will tell you where you stand after each stage.

 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

**Job Description:**
 Lead/Assistant Manager – ICFR (Business Controls)
   

  

 Location: Sector\- 62, Gurugram
   

  

 Shift timings: 3:30 pm\- 12 am
   

  

 Mode: Hybrid
   

  

 Department: ICFR
   

  

 Reports To: Associate Director
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Financial Control Analyst – ICFR (2nd Line of Defense) plays a vital role in validating the integrity of Sun Life’s financial and actuarial processes, and external reporting. Reporting to the Director, ICFR in the Financial Controls department, this role supports management and assurance activities by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of key financial and actuarial controls, which underpin CEO/CFO certifications and regulatory compliance requirements.
   

  

 The analyst partners with Finance, Actuarial, and underlying Operational process owners and external auditors to plan and execute control walkthroughs, testing, and deficiency evaluation. The position offers broad exposure to ICFR across the end\-to\-end financial close and actuarial reporting lifecycle and provides meaningful opportunities to deepen expertise in financial and actuarial control frameworks within a digitally transforming organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Execute ICFR Control Evaluation Program
   

  

* Coordinate and lead internal control walkthroughs with Finance, Actuarial, and Operational process owners (and external auditors as applicable) to confirm process understanding, key risks, and control points across the end\-to\-end lifecycle.
* Perform testing of operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls (e.g., policy set\-up, data activity reviews, reconciliations, journal entry controls, management review controls, reserve review controls, and assumption governance) in accordance with professional audit standards and established deadlines.
* Evaluate control deficiencies, support root cause analysis, and perform remediation validation testing to confirm corrective actions are effectively implemented.


 Support Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Assess control effectiveness across operational processes, the financial close, and actuarial reporting; identify gaps and opportunities to strengthen the control environment.
* Partner with process and control owners to enhance the sustainability of controls through clearer procedures, evidence standards, and consistent execution across the close and actuarial reporting cycle.
* Remain informed about emerging risks, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices relevant to ICFR, financial reporting, and actuarial governance.


 Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Liaise with external auditors to coordinate walkthroughs, testing, and evidence requests related to operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Build strong working relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and Actuarial to drive timely walkthroughs, testing, and issue resolution.
* Communicate testing results, deficiencies, and observations clearly and professionally to team management, including recommended remediation actions.


 Quality and Professional Development
   

  

* Maintain high standards for walkthrough and testing documentation, including clear testing narratives, risk/control mappings, and sufficient audit evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and standardization of walkthrough and testing approaches for operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Proactively develop technical and professional skills in financial and actuarial control evaluation, including ICFR requirements, deficiency evaluation, and effective remediation practices.


**What You Bring**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CA, CPA, CISA, or progress toward a relevant professional certification.
* Typically, 2\.5\- 8 years of experience in audit, controls, or risk management, with exposure to ICFR/SOX environments.
* Public accounting experience is strongly preferred.


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Working knowledge of ICFR/SOX and COSO frameworks.
* Familiarity with control walkthroughs, testing techniques, and audit documentation standards.


 Core Skills
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze control designs, identify risks, and assess operating effectiveness.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain control concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Execution Focus: Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple testing activities, and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working as part of a team and engaging constructively with stakeholders at various levels.


 Valued Assets
   

  

* Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.
* Experience with actuarial concepts and evaluating actuarial internal controls.
* Prior experience supporting external audit engagements.


**About Sun Life**
 Sun Life is a leading international financial services organization providing insurance, wealth, and asset management solutions to individual and corporate Clients. title: Senior Underwriter
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
 



 The candidate will be responsible for supporting initial loan sizing and underwriting tasks for commercial real estate (CRE). This includes providing due diligence and real estate analysis for CMBS, agency, securitization, and other CRE loan underwriting and debt consulting services. The role involves managing multiple transactions with various clients under tight deadlines.
 








 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
 


* Provide analytical support in underwriting and closing commercial real estate loans, securitizations, or affordable housing loans for our clients
* Review, analyze, and interpret financial operating statements, rent rolls, third\-party reports, tenant lease agreements, surveys, title reports, zoning reports, property insurance policies, credit reports, and other due diligence documents
* Assist with loan closings and procure necessary closing items
* Research, analyze, and summarize tenant\-level information, including financial trends, and credit ratings
* Research, analyze, and summarize market and submarket information, including inventory, absorption, new/proposed developments, and rent and vacancy trends
* Extract pertinent data from appraisal, engineering, environmental, and other third\-party reports
* Write property, market, borrower/sponsor descriptions, and third\-party report summaries for inclusion in credit memos and asset summary reports
* Assist in developing value conclusions for all property types
* Monitor loan covenants and perform quarterly reviews to ensure compliance with loan terms and conditions, identifying and addressing any potential issues promptly
* Perform other activities as assigned by your manager
* Provide support in the delivery of due diligence and real estate analysis for CMBS, agency multifamily, securitization, and other commercial real estate loan underwriting and debt consulting services
* Participate in managing multiple transactions with various clients under tight deadlines
* Support initial loan sizing and underwriting tasks for commercial real estate (CRE)



  





 SKILL SETS REQUIRED:
 


* Comprehensive knowledge of the U.S. Commercial Real Estate (CRE) industry across all property types, including Multifamily, Office, Retail, Industrial, Lodging, and Healthcare
* Proficiency in analyzing Property Operating Statements and Rent Rolls
* Experience in evaluating CRE loan originations, reviewing third\-party reports (appraisal, environmental, and engineering), and preparing Asset Summary Reports
* Expertise in underwriting commercial properties through financial, lease, and rent roll analysis
* Proven track record in end\-to\-end CRE Portfolio Monitoring for Commercial Banks
* Strong knowledge in CRE Multifamily loan underwriting, including CMBS guidelines and standards, as well as covenants to protect lenders’ exposure in transactions
* Ability to perform complex tasks independently with minimal supervision
* Strong self\-learning skills and the ability to share best practices
* Familiarity with various data sources such as REIS and CoStar
* Ability to work independently and complete assignments within prescribed routines and standard accepted practices
* Ability to see the big picture and implement at a high level of detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate with both internal and external customers
* Proficiency in MS Office Suites
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service
* Strong time management skills to meet deadlines and accommodate ad\-hoc requests








 QUALIFICATIONS/ REQUIREMENTS:
 


* Any graduation/ postgraduate in any discipline
* Preferred fields of study include Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, and Business
* 8\-10 years’ experience in real estate related or financial services industry, such as appraisal, brokerage, or banking primarily focused on commercial properties and/or master’s degree in business, accounting, finance or real estate

title: Finance Manager, Trilogy (Remote) - $100,000/year USD
description:
Most finance managers gradually stop doing finance. Their calendars fill with status meetings, task chasing, and people administration while their technical skills go stale. This role takes the opposite path.
   

  

 You will run global finance operations through a team of Senior Accountants while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is actually right. You'll inspect invoices, payments, reconciliations, allocations, and other finance outputs; diagnose the accounting or process failures behind errors; and turn those findings into written coaching that prevents the same mistakes from happening again. When a critical deadline or difficult finance problem demands it, you will still be capable of getting hands\-on yourself.
   

  

 Trilogy's Central Finance team operates differently from a traditional accounting organization. We automate routine coordination and continuously look for ways AI and automation can eliminate manual work, leaving finance professionals focused on judgment, quality, and improvement. You'll get exposure to complex global finance operations while retaining the technical edge that many managers lose as they advance. If you want management responsibility without becoming a professional meeting\-attendee, this is where your accounting expertise becomes leverage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Keep finance operations moving through Senior Accountants, continuously prioritizing work based on deadlines, business impact, dependencies, and financial risk.
* Inspect finance dashboards and completed work to ensure bills, invoices, payments, bank transactions, reconciliations, control accounts, revenue, and spend allocations are accurate and current.
* Diagnose quality failures using your own accounting expertise, identifying whether the root cause is incorrect data, system configuration, accounting treatment, or process execution.
* Write evidence\-based coaching that explains what went wrong, how to correct it, and how to prevent it from happening again.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, LLMs, and automation to eliminate manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of finance operations.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Spending your week chasing status updates, assigning routine tasks, or sitting in project\-management meetings.
* Personally processing every transaction because delegating is easier than developing a strong accounting team.
* Giving generic performance feedback disconnected from actual invoices, payments, reconciliations, reports, or other finance outputs.
* Accepting recurring errors and inefficient manual processes as “just how finance works.”


**Finance Manager Key Responsibilities**
 Build a high\-performing finance operations team that consistently produces accurate, timely finance deliverables while continuously improving quality and reducing unnecessary manual work.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* A degree in Accounting or Finance.
* A recognized professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Experience on at least five audits involving a Big 4 accounting firm, either as the auditor or the client.
* Accounting or finance experience within an organization with at least $100M USD in revenue.
* People\-management experience with direct responsibility for finance or accounting professionals.
* Hands\-on experience across AP, AR/customer invoicing, bank and control\-account reconciliations, and revenue and spend allocation.
* Experience prioritizing and allocating operational finance work across a team while managing deadlines and resolving blockers.
* Experience embedding AI or LLM tools into a recurring, high\-volume finance transaction\-processing workflow, beyond ad hoc prompting or reporting\-only analysis, with a clear impact on efficiency or accuracy.
* Ability to work US business hours.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* Experience designing or building finance workflow automations using tools such as n8n, Lovable, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business lines or international entities.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $50 USD/hour, which equates to $100,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.
