title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI\-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Leadership As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward\-looking strategic advisor, using AI\-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision\-making and identify growth opportunities.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Architecture**
* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


 What we’re looking for…
   

  

 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.
* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).
* Hands on experience in Qlik Sense \& Tableau.
* Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero\-touch reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.
* Experience in Essbase, SQL, and SQL performance tuning.
* Knowledge of Google Suite, database management systems, and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).
* Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.

title: Specialist, Procurement Controlling
description:
*At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.*



**Job Description**

 Konecranes Procurement Controlling enables professional measurement, analysis and reporting for the Procurement Function and Konecranes’ global spend. The team develops processes and practices that strengthen transparency, support decision\-making and maintain an effective financial control environment across approximately EUR 2 billion of annual procurement spend across all Business Areas and Group Functions.
   

  





 We are looking for a proactive and self\-motivated Procurement Analyst to turn external market signals and internal procurement data into forward\-looking insights. The primary ownership of this role is Konecranes’ inflation pressure simulation and the related market intelligence service for strategic decisions, helping the organization understand how cost drivers may affect Konecranes direct and indirect external spend.
   

  





 You will combine structured analysis with active stakeholder engagement across businesses, regions and purchasing categories. In addition, you will own the governance of supplier payment\-term decrease requests and contribute to Procurement Controlling priorities, savings validation, spend reporting and the continued development of Sievo.
   

  





 This role is a strong fit for someone who is curious about global markets, confident working with complex data and able to translate analysis into clear, actionable messages for procurement and business stakeholders. The location is in Chennai, India. The role is hybrid and involves approximately 15% business travel.
   

  





**Your key responsibilities**



* **Own the global inflation pressure simulation:** 
 Lead the outlook prepared for Annual Planning purposes as well as quarterly three\-month updates throughout the year, including impact analysis against the original annual forecast, across direct and indirect procurement spend.
* **Deliver procurement market intelligence:** 
 Monitor relevant direct and indirect material commodities such as labour, energy, logistics, steel, copper and other cost drivers; use AI\-enabled research to scale insight collection across market research, internal experts, external service providers and supplier\-facing stakeholders; and translate external market movements into quantified procurement\-spend impacts.
* **Maintain the simulation methodology and data model:** 
 Extract historical category spend, maintain the category\-to\-commodity correlation matrix, develop scenarios and ensure assumptions, calculation logic and outcomes are transparent and documented.
* **Analyse, communicate and document results:** 
 Use complementary sources such as Purchase Price Variance and PIR analyses to challenge outcomes, explain key drivers and delay effects, and provide concise updates, presentations and decision support to relevant stakeholders.
* **Maintain reporting and enable users:** 
 Own the functional maintenance and content of the inflation Power BI report and related Procurement House documentation and provide practical user guidance and training.
* **Govern supplier payment\-term decrease requests:** 
 Validate requests through spend and business rationale reviews, apply defined thresholds and approval routes, coordinate execution support where applicable and safeguard alignment with policy, working\-capital objectives and cost control.
* **Contribute to Procurement Controlling priorities:** 
 Support agreed strategic deliverables, the global savings validation process, harmonised reporting and the standardisation and productisation of recurring analyses and reports.
* **Develop procurement analytics capabilities:** 
 Support continuous improvement of Sievo and selected modules as a super user, strengthen data quality and adoption, provide stakeholder training, and further develop standards, guidelines and policies within the responsibility area.
* Awareness of ISO 14001 \& 45001 standard


**Qualifications**

**What You Should Bring**




  

  





**Educational Qualification \- Graduation/Post graduation in** 
 business, procurement, supply chain management, finance, economics, data analytics or a comparable field.
   

  





**Experience\- 8\-10 Years**



* Relevant experience in procurement analytics, market intelligence, procurement controlling, business controlling or a similar analytical role in an international environment.
* A strong analytical mindset and the ability to build and explain forecasts, scenarios, spend\-based models and impact analyses.
* Understanding procurement economics and the way commodities, supplier, contract and timing effects can influence cost development and business performance.
* A proactive, structured and accountable way of working, with the curiosity to investigate signals, challenge assumptions and improve established approaches


**Additional Information**

 Skills \& Knowledge
   

  




* Strong research and analytical capability for monitoring and interpretation of global commodities, macroeconomic indicators, markets and cost trends.
* Ability to summarize complex topics into clear conclusions, recommendations and executive\-ready communication
* Confident stakeholder management and collaboration skills across functions, business areas, regions, Category Managers, Supplier Managers and Category Specialists
* Advanced data\-handling skills; practical Power BI experience is expected, while experience with Sievo, SAP or comparable procurement and ERP platforms is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.
* A service\-oriented, collaborative mindset and willingness to travel internationally when required.



**Why join us?**




*We are a global company with history dating back to 1910 \- with future looking attitude that has brought us here today. Now together, we are shaping the next generation of material handling for smarter and safer world.*




*We believe in creating a workplace that is built on trust, flexibility, friendliness and inclusivity towards each other and culture with open communication and low hierarchy. We are a strong expert organisation where you are able to use modern tools and technologies \- while embracing agile methodologies and continuous learning and development.*




**What we offer?**



* *Competitive Salary.*
* *Work\-Life balance.*
* *Innovative and dynamic working environment.*
* *Support of an excellent Team.*
* *Possibility to work in leading crane building company with leading technology.*



**Interested?**
  

 If this role sparked your interest, please submit your application as soonest, on our career site. Please note that position will be filled when we find a suitable person. For any additional query feel free to write at \- harshita.agrahari@konecranes.com
   

  





  

  

****Konecranes moves what matters***
*. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000\+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.
   

  

  

  

 Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination.**

title: Credit Underwriter - Associate/ Sr. Associate
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Roc360 is a financial services and asset management platform for residential property investors in the United States. The company connects fragmented loan markets with institutional capital through a branchless network of third\-party originators, brokers, and in\-house sales teams to originate loans to property investors who buy, rehab, resell, and/or rent properties.
 



 The company originates and services multiple business\-purpose loan products (“BPLs”), via various sales channels which, together with ancillary service offerings, provide an end\-to\-end experience that drives repeat customer transactions and profitability. The company’s loan products include residential transitional bridge loans (“RTLs”) (including single and multi\-family properties) and Rental Loans (including single property rentals and rental portfolios).
 



 Founded in 2014, Roc360 is headquartered in NYC and has over 400 team members globally across three continents and five countries. Roc360 can originate loans in 45\+ states and Washington, D.C. The company’s founders have worked together for over 20 years, and most of its senior management teams have also enjoyed a long tenure at the company. Through its proprietary technology\-enabled Third\-Party Originator and Direct\-to\-Borrower lending channels and strong brand recognition, the company has funded over $18bn in loans since its inception.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 Roc enables investors, brokers and lenders to scale their businesses through innovative products in the real estate space. We want to make it easy for everyone to renovate, own, or invest in homes. Our various business units along with the real estate value chain are geared towards fulfilling this objective.
 



  





 Our core business unit Roc Capital is focused on capital lending for real estate investment
 



 Finance of America Commercial is our direct to borrower sales channel
 



 Tamarisk is our in\-house AMC providing property appraisal services
 



 Elmsure provides Insurance solutions for real estate investors
 



  





 We have grown significantly since inception, and we have managed to do this with a commitment to superior underwriting and risk management practices.
 



 Our India office is a captive offshore unit based in Chennai and provides analytical and operational support to all our business units globally.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 We offer a dynamic and global workspace with ample opportunities to excel and grow in a variety of financial risk and analytical roles. You will be interacting extensively with teams across the globe, and with clients from different parts of the US – an opportunity that many Indian offices of global companies are unable to provide.
 



 As a young and fast\-growing organization, your career growth will be influenced solely by your performance and self\-drive. We invest significantly in training people at all levels and actively work with them to plan their career growth.
 



 We are looking for young energetic professionals with excellent aptitude and attitude, and very good verbal and written communications skills. A qualification in finance is a big advantage, but we are open to considering candidates from other streams who have an inclination to learn and grow in this industry.
 



  





 Role:
 **Credit Risk Underwriter** 




 Designation: Associate / Senior Associate
 



 Location: Chennai
 



 Timing : 6\.30pm\-3\.30am IST
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● Evaluate loan applications, assess creditworthiness and
 



 managing portfolio risk
 



 ● Interact with clients to seek clarifications and help structure deals
 



 ● Interact with Data Science team to help embed the latest in
 



 AI and machine learning into our underwriting processes
 



 ● Interact with Trading team to ensure that loans are
 



 properly structured to be placed on warehouse lines and
 



 into securitizations
 



 ● High degree of loan discretion to present hand\-selected
 



 deals to investment committee for final approval
 



**Background/Experience:** 




 ● PG/Master’s degree from a premier college with a
 



 specialization in finance, economics or a related field
 



 ● Minimum CFA Level 1
 



 ● Strong written and oral communication skills
 



 ● Ability to work independently and as part of a team
 



 ● Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask

title: Senior Executive – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 1–3 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Assistant Manager – India Control
description:
Management Level
   

  

 G
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Assistant Manager – India Control**
 The Assistant Manager – India Control is responsible for supporting the maintenance of a robust financial control, compliance, and governance framework across the India Finance organisation. Working under the leadership of the Head of Shared Services, the role ensures effective execution of statutory compliance, tax filings, payroll controls, balance sheet governance, audit activities, and entity\-level financial controls.
   

  

 The role acts as a key coordinator between Finance, Shared Services, external auditors, tax authorities, regulatory bodies, payroll providers, and business stakeholders to ensure that the organisation meets its statutory, financial, and compliance obligations. The position also supports accurate financial reporting, strengthens internal controls, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance governance, reduce risk, and improve operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical accounting and compliance knowledge, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a controlled and timely manner. They will be proactive, analytical, and committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy, integrity, and compliance.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Financial Controls \& Compliance**
* Support the Head of Shared Services in maintaining a robust financial control and governance framework across India operations.
* Perform control monitoring, compliance reviews, and risk assessments, supporting remediation of identified control gaps.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, accounting standards, delegated authorities, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to governance, business continuity, and risk management initiatives.


**Tax \& Statutory Compliance \- India**
* Ensure compliance with IFRS and local statutory accounting requirements, supporting accurate financial reporting and governance.
* Manage GST refund claims and export incentive submissions, ensuring timely recovery of eligible benefits.
* Oversee TDS and GST payments, ensuring accurate calculations and timely remittance to authorities, as well filing of returns.
* Manage SEZ and STPI compliance filings, ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and reporting obligations.
* Coordinate secretarial compliance\-related payments and statutory filings in partnership with Company Secretaries and external advisors.
* Maintain controls over MSME reporting requirements, including preparation, validation, and timely filing of MSME returns.
* Support tax audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments, ensuring timely resolution of queries and findings.
* Monitor regulatory developments and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of local accounting, tax, and statutory requirements.


**Audit \& Regulatory Management**
* Coordinate internal and external audits, including preparation of supporting documentation and management of audit actions.
* Support compliance reviews, regulatory inspections, and governance assessments.
* Liaise with auditors, advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of audit and compliance matters.


**Balance Sheet Controls \& Financial Integrity**
* Perform balance sheet reviews, reconciliations, and control account monitoring to ensure financial integrity.
* Support Month\-End, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities, including intercompany and cost allocation processes.
* Investigate and resolve accounting exceptions, reconciliation issues, and control weaknesses.


**Budget, MIS \& Treasury Support**
* Support budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Monitor and analyse cash variances and treasury\-related transactions.
* Provide financial analysis and management information reporting.
* Partner with FP\&A and business teams to support decision\-making through accurate financial insights.


**Payroll Accounting \& Controls**
* Review payroll calculations and related accounting entries for India region.
* Perform payroll reconciliations and balance sheet substantiation.
* Investigate and resolve payroll\-related queries and exceptions.
* Ensure payroll processes comply with company policies and statutory requirements.


**Continuous Improvement \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive process improvements, control enhancements, standardisation, and automation initiatives.
* Support Finance transformation and Shared Services improvement programmes.
* Promote a culture of compliance, accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* 5\-8 years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, Controls, Audit, Compliance, Payroll, or Shared Services operations.
* Proven experience managing statutory audits, tax compliance, regulatory filings, and financial controls.
* Experience in payroll accounting, reconciliations, journal preparation, and Month\-End close activities.
* Demonstrated ability to identify risks, strengthen controls, and drive process improvements within a finance environment.
* Experience working within a multinational organisation or Shared Services environment would be advantageous.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Strong working knowledge of Indian accounting standards, taxation, statutory compliance, payroll accounting, and financial controls.


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.

**Global Business Services**

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

**Process Overview**
 Building out Strategies, Analytics \& Process Integration team in India driving improved fraud detection \& loss reduction

 This position/role requires interaction across multiple business partners to aide in determining key priorities and project direction for their team. Key functions involve working with the Transformation pillar teams to setup the data infrastructure, data mart designs and maps, maintain repository of centralized data definitions and methodologies, working with other partners within Client protection group to understand data needs, share reporting with leadership, and establish routines with various stakeholders for data reviews and make recommendations where gaps exist. Integrates the analysis with other corporate units to ensure alignment with business and corporate objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities \-**
 The role will be responsible for several key areas:
   

  

* Development of new fraud strategies using statistical and analytical techniques including decision trees, random forests and other quantitative methods. Goal will be to identify and mitigate new and emerging fraud threats.
* Identifying new sources of data (internal or vendor\-provided) that can enrich our existing fraud detection processes, be added to our decision systems, and allow for new detection strategies to be developed. Will require close coordination with partners in Fraud Technology.
* Optimization of existing detection strategies to determine areas where rules can be adjusted to decline fewer false positives and improve the ROI and overall performance of our fraud strategies
* Development of both ad\-hoc and more standardized reporting (MIS).
* Candidate will be part of check fraud detection team and will be working on designing financial center strategies leveraging internal and external data sources
* Collaborate with business, operations, and technology teams across geo\-locations to align with strategic goals

 Advanced degree, preferably in Statistics/Mathematics, Computer Sciences, Engineering from a premier institute

 Technical certifications in SAS, SQL preferred

 5\-8 years of relevant experience using SAS, SQL, Data analytics

 Experience in U.S. financial services is preferred.
   

  

* The candidate must be at an advanced to expert level in SAS and SQL.
* Familiarity with other programming languages such as Python, R or Java.
* The candidate must have 5\-8 years of relevant experience in analytics.
* Strong preference working in financial services, particularly fraud or cyber security.


**Desired Skills –**
* Candidate must have a proven track record of building and deploying analytical solutions that have resulted in material financial results.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment is critical. Must have exceptional organizational, project management and communications skills.
* Bachelor’s degree is desired, preferably in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, finance or business. Post graduate degree is a plus.
* Familiarity with other programming languages such as Python, R or Java will be preferred.
* Knowledge of data extraction tools such as Hive or HUE will be preferred.

 11:30 AM to 8:30 pm/12:30 PM to 9:30 PM

Puma Energy is a leading global energy business which supplies, stores and distributes petroleum products in 47 countries across six continents. Founded in 1997, Puma Energy has its headquarters in Singapore and Geneva and employs over 8,000 people globally with regional hubs in South Africa, Puerto Rico and Estonia and have recently setup a Global Delivery Centre in Mumbai (India).


**Puma Processing Services LLP (PEPS) established in Year 2018, represents Puma Energy’s first captive offshoring unit and is based in Mumbai, India with over 200 employees.**

To provide efficient finance operations and risk management for our international oil trading activities.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Senior, MG\-ALFA/Integrate user, tester or modeler, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

 Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
   

  

 Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry
   

  

 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering MG\-ALFA/Integrate user level, testing and modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
   

  

 You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* As a Senior within the Life MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands\-on valuation or modeling experience in a senior capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant
description:
**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Role:** 
 Oracle Fusion Financials Functional Consultant
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for an
 **Oracle Fusion Financials Functional Consultant** 
 with
 **2–4 years of experience** 
 in Oracle Fusion Applications support and implementation projects.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for providing functional support, participating in implementation activities, configuring Oracle ERP modules, supporting testing cycles, preparing functional documentation, and working closely with business users and technical teams to ensure smooth system operations and successful project delivery.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Configure and support Oracle Fusion Financials modules, including:
* **General Ledger (GL)**
* **Accounts Payable (AP)**
* **Accounts Receivable (AR)**
* **Cash Management (CM)**
* **Fixed Assets (FA)**
* Participate in various phases of Oracle Fusion ERP implementation and support projects.
* Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into functional solutions.
* Prepare functional and configuration documentation, including:
* **BR\-100 – Application Setup Documentation**
* **MD.50 – Functional Specifications**
* Support
 **CRP, SIT, UAT, and regression testing** 
 activities.
* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts.
* Analyze and resolve functional issues reported by business users and testing teams.
* Raise
 **Technical Assistance Requests (TARs)** 
 with Oracle and follow up through resolution.
* Coordinate with client managers, key users, technical teams, and other stakeholders for issue resolution.
* Support production deployment and obtain necessary production release sign\-offs.
* Provide post\-implementation and production support as required.
* Maintain proper documentation of configurations, issues, solutions, and functional processes.



 Required Skills
 


* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience with
 **Oracle Fusion Financials** 
 .
* Good functional knowledge of:
* Oracle Fusion GL
* Oracle Fusion AP
* Oracle Fusion AR
* Oracle Fusion Cash Management
* Oracle Fusion Fixed Assets
* Understanding of the
 **Oracle Fusion ERP implementation lifecycle** 
 .
* Experience in Oracle Fusion support and/or implementation projects.
* Knowledge of functional configuration and business processes.
* Experience supporting CRP, SIT, UAT, and regression testing.
* Ability to prepare BR\-100, MD.50, test scripts, and other functional documentation.
* Experience working with Oracle Support/TARs is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong documentation skills.



 Educational Qualification
 


* **CA / CA Inter**
* **B.Com / M.Com**
* **MBA – Finance**
* Or an equivalent qualification in Finance/Accounting.



 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The ideal candidate should have a good combination of
 **Oracle Fusion Financials functional expertise and finance/accounting knowledge** 
 . Candidates with hands\-on experience in
 **Oracle Fusion support, configuration, testing, implementation, and interaction with business users** 
 will be preferred.

* Collaborate with technical and project teams to create innovative reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms
* Guide and mentor team members to foster their professional growth
* Develop a thorough understanding of business contexts to enhance client interactions

* Analyze data to provide insights that inform project direction

* 5 years of experience

* Exceptional problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to design and enhance stored procedures

* Exceptional interpersonal and written communication skills

title: Security Valuations, Officer
description:
State Street provides Pricing Services for Asset Managers and Pension Funds. The primary service revolves under running control reports Missing, Variance and Stale as per client instruction and resolving all the exceptions. In the process, team will apply price for missing price securities, Validate variance and stale with alternate vendor, Research Corporate Action Securities, Perform portfolio level pricing and Generate \& Publish Client Specific Reports. The Clients’ portfolios include products like Equity, Fixed Income, OTC and Exchange\-traded Derivatives, FX, Bank Loans, Futures forwards and Option products. The teams perform the control checks for Daily, Weekly, and Monthly.
   

  

**Job Responsibility**
 Manage Pricing / Valuations operations process, activities, timelines Oversee the day\-to\-day activities of the Security Valuations team and ensure that the processes are run in accordance to the laid down procedures and process Ensure execution of appropriate controls supported by documented policies and procedures across the relevant groups Handle client calls – daily , weekly and governance, escalations Validate Attendance Allowance, Incentive and Overtime for the Associates on monthly basis Ensure Process documents SOP’s, Metrics and Checklist are timely reviewed and approved by onshore counterparts. Coordinate and conduct Call tree test and Annual BCP test Ensure coordination which includes coordination of various locations Provide timely data, reporting and needed analytics to senior management and other key stakeholders Work towards encouraging the team to identify opportunities to stream\-line and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the process and lead the team through the implementation of the process enhancements
   

  

**Education And Experience**
 Masters in Finance and Management Minimum of 8\-12 years’ experience in Security Valuations or Pricing for Hedge Fund , Reference Data Setup or Capital Market Experience Preference will be given to candidates with exposure to Pricing or Valuations
   

  

**Skills \& Other Requirements**
 Should have managed a team of 10\-15 members First or second level management expertise required Candidate should demonstrate problem solving skills, conducting specialized research and analysis of complex securities pricing issues Must have considerable domain knowledge preferably in areas of Pricing or Valuations with good product knowledge across Equity, Fixed Income, and Derivatives. Senior\-level communication skills, presentation skills, prior experience of interacting with multiple stakeholders Highly organized with ability to multi\-task and work under high pressure deadlines Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word) Strong working knowledge of Bloomberg , Reuters and IDC The candidate must have well\-developed analytical skills. Candidate must exhibit excellent attention to detail, high degree of accuracy and the ability to meet deadlines Discover training needs and provide coaching; Require ability to envision and improve current processes and achieve efficiencies; Strong experience in setting clear team goals; Strong proficiency in MIS and report preparations; Experience in conducting appraisals for team members; Creating an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture; Monitor team performance and report on metrics Lead and motivate team to facilitate achievement of SLA Listen to team members’ feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts; Suggest and organize team building activities; Ready to work in shifts
   

  

**Application Knowledge**
 MS Office Bloomberg Reuters IDC

* Strong understanding of financial instruments (equities, fixed income, derivatives preferred)
* Experience with reconciliation tools and accounting systems


**Key Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Good understanding of financial markets and investment operations
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work under tight deadlines in a dynamic environment

description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Reporting Specialist to own the build and ongoing maintenance of our GTM reporting. This is a focused, execution\-oriented role: the Specialist produces and maintains reports and dashboards in Salesforce (SFDC) and other sources to defined specifications, keeps the existing reporting library accurate and current, and works from a structured request queue.
   

  

 The role is designed to be delivered by an offshore resource working in close, documented coordination with our onshore Revenue Operations team. The Salesforce Reporting Specialist does the hands\-on building, refreshing, and quality\-checking of the reports.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role with overall accountability to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations \& Analytics.
   

  

***Preferred Location and Expected Work Hours***
 This role is based in Kochi, India. Given the need for real\-time collaboration with Dodge's US\-based GTM team, candidates should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US time zones, generally 12:00\-8:00 PM IST.
   

  

***Travel Requirements***
 Expected travel is less than 5% of the time but may occasionally be required for team meetings.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build new Salesforce reports, custom report types, and dashboards to written specifications provided by the onshore Revenue Operations team
* Maintain, update, and troubleshoot the existing library of Salesforce reports and dashboards, keeping filters, groupings, and data sources accurate and current
* Build and refresh Business Intelligence dashboards and their underlying data extracts to defined specifications
* Perform routine quality assurance on reports and dashboards—verifying accuracy, checking for broken filters or stale data, and confirming figures reconcile to source
* Manage the report and dashboard catalog, including folder structure, naming conventions, and sharing and visibility settings
* Execute and monitor scheduled report refreshes and recurring distributions, confirming successful delivery
* Document report logic, field definitions, and change history so that reporting is transparent and reproducible
* Work a structured request/ticket queue, delivering standard reporting changes within agreed service\-level timeframes
* Log and escalate data discrepancies and suspected upstream data issues to the onshore team for root\-cause resolution
* Regression\-test reports and dashboards following Salesforce releases, additional Dodge hiring and role changes, or configuration changes, and flag anything that breaks


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 2\+ years building and maintaining reports and dashboards in Salesforce
* Proficiency with the Salesforce report builder, custom report types, and dashboards
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards in Tableau, QuickSight or other comparable Business Intelligence tool
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables
* Excellent written English and clear, asynchronous communication for documented coordination across time zones
* Highly detail\-oriented, with comfort working from specifications, queues, and service\-level expectations
* Reliable availability to overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM\-201\) or equivalent
* Exposure to Salesforce CPQ reporting
* Familiarity with SQL or other data\-preparation tools
* Prior experience working as part of a distributed or offshore delivery team

 Operational Support

* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands\-on or Advance level experience in MG\-ALFA/Integrate actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In\-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of the US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3\-6 years of MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on MG\-ALFA/ INTEGRATE) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Finance Controller
description:
Position Summary: AKRSP(I) is seeking a Finance Controller to bridge the strategic direction of the Chief Finance Officer (CFO) with the on-ground financial execution teams, including Finance teams in regions/SHTs. The Finance Controller will ensure financial accuracy, compliance, timely reporting, Budgeting & Forecasting, oversee internal and external audits, and robust internal controls across all states/SHTs and programmes. He/She will lead the accounting and finalization of books. He/She will also take forward the implementation of new systems and changes in the existing systems and processes. This is a senior leadership role that enhances alignment, strengthens coordination across SHTs/states, validates all major financial processes, and provides decision-support to the CFO. The position reports to CFO. Key responsibilities: Financial Governance & Controls Establish, implement, and monitor strong internal control systems across the organisation and all state offices. Review and validate key financial processes: payments, receivables, Payables, Advances, reconciliations etc. Ensure adherence to AKRSP(I) Finance Policy, FCRA regulations, donor rules, and statutory requirements. Coordination and Oversight of Finance Teams Ensure that the work of SHT/State Finance is reviewed and validated on regular basis/ Benchmark and Standardise processes, reporting formats, and documentation practices across states to ensure uniformity. Review all financial reports and requests before submission to external stakeholders. Ensure consistent and policy-compliant processes and practices across all SHT/states. Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and capacity-building support to Finance teams. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis Support the CFO in formulation of annual organisational budget, multi-year financial planning, and mid-term budget revisions. Review project and SHT/state budgets submitted by program teams at SHT for accuracy, consistency, and donor compliance. Monitor budget utilisation, variances, and financial progress of SHT/state programmes. Provide financial insights to project/programme heads and the CFO for better planning and decision-making. Review, validation & reporting Review and validate monthly MISconductand utilisation reports from all SHT/states. Conduct Ledger Scrutiny and Ensure timely closing of monthly and quarterly books across SHT/states Audit coordination & compliance Lead and coordinate statutory audits, internal audits, donor audits, and special audits across states. Ensure that Statustory, Internal, Donor and other audits are properly coordinated and queries responded. He will also supervise the ensure closure of all the audit observations. Supervise, Track and ensure compliance with statutory filings FCRA returns, Income Tax filings, PF/ESIC, GST (if applicable), CSR reporting, etc. Financial systems & process improvement Strengthen and streamline SOPs, workflows, and control mechanisms across the organisation. Shall steer the digital transformation of finance processes (ERP/Accounting/HRIS systems). Identify and reduce process inefficiencies, manual work, and error-prone tasks. Build competencies of finance teams on ERP/Software, donor compliance, and documentation. Cross team coordination & strategic support Serve as the key operational link between the CFO, SHT/State Finance Officers, Project/Programme Heads, Thematic experts, Procurement and HR team. Advise project/programme teams/thematic experts on budgeting, fund management, documentation, donor requirements, and financial protocols. Facilitate data accuracy for organisational dashboards, donor reporting, and internal performance reviews. Qualifications: Essential: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant (CMA) OR MBA (Finance) with strong accounting and compliance experience. 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in financial management; at least 4 years in a supervisory role in NGO/development sector preferred. Strong understanding of statutory requirements, FCRA rules, Income Tax for NGOs, and donor compliance. Demonstrated experience in managing or reviewing multi-location/state finance teams. Desirable: Experience in financial oversight of large-scale, multi-state programmes. Experience with ERP systems and financial digitalisation initiatives. Ability to develop and standardise processes. Preferred Attributes: Strong analytical ability and financial acumen. Leadership, people management, and mentoring capability. Excellent coordination and communication skills. High attention to detail and process orientation. Strong integrity, professionalism, and ownership mindset. Ability to work effectively with diverse teams across multiple states. Key Benefits: Work with one of Indias most respected rural development organisations. Play a critical role in shaping financial governance and operational efficiency. Engage with multi-state teams and high-impact programmes. Mission-driven, collaborative work culture. 5-day work week. Comprehensive medical insurance for employee, spouse, and children. Maternity and paternity leave as per organizational policy. 15 General Leaves and 16.5 earned leaves annually (earned leaves can be encashed if not utilized). 10 declared public holidays and 3 optional holidays. Diwali break every year. We strongly encourage women, LGBTQ+ individuals, and specially abled candidates to apply

title: Director _ U.S. TAX & Accounting _GLOBAL Operations
description:
DIRECTOR U.S. TAX, ACCOUNTING & GLOBAL OPERATIONS Location Ahmedabad or Cochin
Position Type: Full-Time | Senior Leadership Work Time : 8.30PM to 5.30AM (nightshift) 
Reports To: President & CEO 
 ABOUT THE POSITION We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic leader to oversee our Tax, Accounting and overall business operations across our United States, Ahmedabad and Cochin offices. This is a senior leadership position with significant responsibility and authority. The selected candidate will work directly with the President & CEO and will be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the organization across all three locations. We are specifically looking for someone who combines deep practical U.S. Tax and Accounting expertise with exceptional leadership, people management and operational capabilities. The successful candidate must be comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, managing managers and driving results. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide overall leadership for operations across the United States, Ahmedabad and Cochin offices. Lead and oversee Tax, Accounting, Client Relations, Human Resources, Recruitment, Administration and related operational functions. Manage department heads, managers and senior professionals. Take responsibility for hiring, staffing, employee development, performance management, promotions, corrective actions and terminations in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements. Build and maintain high-performing professional teams. Establish accountability, KPIs and measurable performance standards. Ensure appropriate staffing and capacity across departments. Oversee workflow, assignments, deadlines, productivity and quality. Ensure smooth coordination between the U.S. and India offices. Establish, improve and enforce SOPs, internal controls and quality-review procedures. Resolve operational, employee, departmental and client-service issues. Identify problems proactively and implement solutions without requiring continuous involvement from the President & CEO. U.S. TAX EXPERIENCE The candidate must possess extensive practical U.S. tax experience, including: Individual and business taxation. Forms 1040, 1120-S, 1120 and 1065. Federal and state taxation. S Corporations, C Corporations and Partnerships. K-1s, shareholder and partner basis. Capital accounts, contributions and distributions. Depreciation and fixed assets. Book-to-tax adjustments. Tax return review and quality control. Ability to analyze and resolve complex tax matters. U.S. ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE The candidate must also have strong practical accounting experience, including: Bookkeeping and accounting review. Bank and credit-card reconciliations. General Ledger review. Adjusting and closing journal entries. Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss review. Month-end and year-end closing. Fixed assets and depreciation. Loans and shareholder/partner transactions. Review and correction of accounting records prior to tax preparation. Ability to identify accounting errors and provide appropriate technical guidance. LEADERSHIP & OPERATIONS The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of independence and ownership. The candidate should be capable of: Managing multiple offices and departments. Managing and developing managers. Recruiting high-quality professionals. Building and restructuring teams when necessary. Making difficult personnel and operational decisions. Creating accountability throughout the organization. Improving productivity and turnaround time. Developing training and technical-development programs. Maintaining high standards of client service. Improving processes and operational efficiency. Ensuring that decisions are properly implemented and followed through to completion. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 1015+ years of relevant professional experience. Extensive hands-on U.S. Tax and Accounting experience is mandatory. Senior management experience within a U.S. CPA firm, tax/accounting practice, or established U.S. Tax and Accounting outsourcing/KPO organization is highly preferred. Experience managing managers and professional teams. Strong technical, analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent leadership and decision-making ability. Excellent written and verbal English communication. Strong client-facing and interpersonal skills. CA, CPA, EA or similar professional qualification preferred. Experience building or scaling professional-services teams is highly desirable. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for more than a technical professional and more than an operations manager. We are looking for a leader who combines: Deep U.S. Tax Expertise Strong Accounting Expertise Leadership People Management Operational Excellence Client Service Business Thinking Complete Ownership The successful candidate will become a key member of the organization's senior leadership and will work directly with the President & CEO. This is an opportunity for an experienced professional to take substantial responsibility for a growing U.S. Tax and Accounting organization and play an important role in its continued expansion. The right candidate should have the capability and ambition to RUN THE OPERATION, BUILD THE TEAM, DEVELOP LEADERS, MAINTAIN QUALITY AND DELIVER RESULTS.
