title: Finance Controller/Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a Head of Finance / Finance Controller to take ownership of the finance function at Habanero Foods. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and can independently manage the core finance function while partnering closely with the founder and the CFO. The role will cover accounting, financial reporting, MIS, AR/AP, inventory, cash flow forecasting, cash management, compliance, controls and commercial finance. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to build and lead a finance team as the business scales. 
 Role & responsibilities : 1.Finance & Accounting Own day-to-day finance and accounting operations. Drive timely monthly book closure and ensure accuracy of accounting records. Prepare monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and management MIS. Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, inventory, receivables and payables. Improve accounting processes and finance systems. Coordinate with auditors, tax advisors and external stakeholders. 2. MIS & Business Reporting Own the monthly MIS and management reporting process. Prepare variance analysis against budgets, forecasts and prior periods. Develop business dashboards and management KPIs. Provide insights on revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating costs and profitability. Partner with the CFO and Founder on financial and business analysis. Develop reporting to enable faster and informed business decisions. 3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Own weekly and monthly cash flow forecasting. Maintain rolling cash flow forecasts and proactively identify funding requirements and cash gaps. Monitor collections, vendor payments, inventory and overall working capital. Drive improvements in the cash conversion cycle. Support cash management, banking and treasury activities. Partner with the Founder and CFO on working capital strategy and funding requirements. 4. Accounts Receivable & Payable Own the AR and AP function. Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve deductions, claims and disputes. Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments. Establish effective credit, collection and payment processes. Track ageing and working capital metrics and proactively escalate issues. 5. Quick Commerce & Marketplace Finance Own financial reconciliations across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart and other platforms. Reconcile platform sales, settlements, commissions, discounts, claims, deductions, marketing spends and other charges. Identify and recover incorrect deductions, claims and short payments. Track platform-wise revenue, gross margin and contribution margin. Partner with sales and operations teams to improve channel profitability. Establish robust marketplace reconciliation and settlement tracking processes. Prior experience with quick-commerce or marketplace platforms will be an advantage. 6. Inventory & Cost Management Own inventory accounting and stock reconciliation. Monitor inventory levels, ageing, stock movement and holding periods. Analyse product-level gross margins and manufacturing costs. Track wastage, expiry, write-offs and inventory variances. Support costing and financial evaluation of new product launches. Partner with operations and supply chain teams to identify cost optimisation opportunities. 7. Budgeting & Financial Planning Support annual budgeting and business planning. Prepare rolling forecasts and periodic reforecasts. Build financial models for new products, channels and growth initiatives. Analyse profitability across products, channels and customers. Support decisions on pricing, promotions, marketing spends and channel expansion. 8. Compliance & Financial Controls Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate statutory and tax audits. Strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs. Establish controls across procurement, inventory, sales, collections and payments. Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes. 9. Team Building & Finance Function Development Build and develop the finance team as the business scales. Define roles, responsibilities and processes within the finance function. Mentor and develop finance team members. Establish scalable finance processes and controls. Build a finance function that supports the companys transition from an entrepreneurial setup to a larger, professionally managed organisation Qualification CA preferred CMA / MBA (Finance) with strong relevant experience may also be considered. Strong accounting and finance fundamentals are essential. Experience 46 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts / Financial Controllership. Experience in D2C, FMCG, Food & Beverage, e-commerce, consumer brands or quick commerce strongly preferred. Experience managing a finance function independently will be an advantage. Experience with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplace platforms is highly desirable. Strong experience in AR/AP, inventory accounting, working capital and cash flow management . Experience in a high-growth entrepreneurial environment preferred. Technical Skills Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills. Experience with Zoho Books, Tally or similar ERP/accounting systems . Strong understanding of GST, TDS and statutory compliance. Experience in MIS preparation, budgeting and financial analysis. Strong understanding of inventory and cost accounting. Ability to build and maintain cash flow forecasts.

title: Finance Officer
description:
Role Overview: The Finance Officer is responsible for managing Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and Payroll operations while ensuring accurate and timely financial processing. The role ensures compliance with company policies and statutory regulations, supports month-end closing, tax reporting, and reconciliations, and maintains strong financial controls. The ideal candidate will have solid accounting knowledge, ERP proficiency, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Job Structure: Mode of Work: Onsite (5 days a week) Work Location: Bangalore. Job Type: Fulltime Shift timings: 9-5 (M-F) Roles & Responsibilities. Accounts Payable: Manage and supervise all aspects of the payable accounts function at the station and for other regional countries if relevant, ensuring that the Company's books are updated on a daily basis and that payments are processed accurately and within guidelines laid down by company procedures. Ensure supplier contracts are valid and where they are nearing expiry, ensure that revised contracts are in place in good time. Take active measures to update contracts in the required systems. Proactively switch from paper invoices to EDI format with suppliers to streamline process. Perform rate verification in DMS diligently and timely. Ensure that suppliers without contracts are reviewed and approved by HO accordingly. Take the lead in ensuring that suppliers are paid on time and ideally by EFT. Review various AP reports to ensure that errors are corrected timely to facilitate a smoother month end process. Respond to supplier queries in an efficient manner. Accounts Receivable: Manage and supervisor all dedicated ongoing Finance receivable activities from business to ensure all receivables are correctly accounted for in a timely manner and in compliance with local regulations. Ensure receipts are processed timely for the entire region and allocated accurately to customer invoices. Ensure receipts are banked within specified time limits or as per agreement with cash collection provider. Reconcile BSP/ credit card party accounts and highlight short settlements immediately to line manager. Review bank reconciliations daily and account for transactions in AR/ GL module as appropriate immediately. Closely monitor under-collections and work efficiently with Commercial to ensure action is taken timely. Ensure outstanding debt from credit parties is collected timely as per Group Policy. General Ledger: Process journals in accurately in timely manner so that monthly timetable is met. Prepare data in order to conduct reconciliations for appropriate nominals. Prepare standard reports for monthly file which is reviewed by Internal Audit and OF&RM Finance Review Team. Prepare reports for local tax filing. Prepare data for monthly KPI submission. Prepare bank reconciliations for review. Assist with repatriation process to ensure that surplus funds are remitted to HO and working capital is maintained as per Group Policy. Assist Financial Controller where necessary in ad hoc projects. Payroll: To compile and process all payroll elements including basic salaries, allowances, overtime, shift pay, pension contributions, employer and employee social security contributions and relevant taxation in compliance with local regulations to all staff on payroll within required time limits. Ensure the relevant payments are submitted to local authorities in a timely manner and all payments are in line with individual terms and conditions of employment. Compile and provide all payroll information, including the reconciliation of tax and social security and pension on a monthly basis and send payments to the appropriate parties so that this can be computed in accordance within the specified time frame. Prepare payroll data entry into Finance software so that all relevant reports are completed in a timely manner. Seek clarification with external legal advisors on taxation, payroll or any other upcoming issues to ensure that all year end returns are submitted on a timely basis. Scrutinise all staff expenses, process salary advances, medical expenses and any other staff loans to ensure correct payment or recovery of same through payroll; and reconcile the related ledger account. Maintain and reconcile Petty Cash account where appropriate, and analyse and reimburse Petty Cash returns from other stations from within the country as appropriate. Ensure charges from personal telephone calls are recovered from staff on a monthly basis and mobile telephone bills are paid in line with the company guidelines. Reconcile the pension account and assist with various pension and other queries from staff, department heads and various external parties. Assist FAM and undertake various administrative duties together with other relevant finance personnel as necessary. Qualifications: MCOM/MBA in Finance / BCOM or degree in related field of study Experience: Min 6 to 8 years of professional experience, of which 2 years must be in a supervisory capacity. Knowledge/skills: Knowledge of rules and procedures under the local laws to take care of statutory requirements as necessary. Ability to function independently within an established framework and to be practical and innovative. Proven experience in both supervising a finance function and in coaching and developing staff as well as experience in working in a large multinational and dealing with stakeholders from different countries. Proven ability to organize a busy work schedule, working under pressure and ensuring adherence to deadlines. Knowledge of local payroll, taxation, statutory and compliance requirements. Proficient in the use of MS Office, in particular spreadsheets and ERP systems.

title: Executive Assistant To Group Chief Financial Officer
description:
Executive Assistant to Group CFO Position: Executive Assistant to Group CFO
 Function: Finance / CFO Office
 Reporting to: Group Chief Financial Officer
 Location: Hyderabad
 Employment Type: Full-time Role Purpose The Executive Assistant to the Group CFO will provide high-quality executive, analytical and coordination support to the CFO and help ensure effective functioning of the CFO Office. The role goes beyond calendar and administrative management. The incumbent will work closely with the CFO on business priorities, management reviews, financial information, cross-functional initiatives and follow-ups with senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate should be highly organised, commercially aware, comfortable working with numbers and presentations, discreet with confidential information, and capable of independently driving matters to closure. Key Responsibilities 1. CFO Office Management Manage the CFO's calendar, meetings, appointments and key commitments. Prioritise meetings and requests based on business importance and urgency. Prepare meeting agendas, background material and briefing notes. Maintain a structured tracker of key decisions, commitments and action items. Follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely closure of agreed actions. Anticipate upcoming requirements and ensure the CFO is adequately prepared. 2. Management Information & Analytical Support Assist the CFO in reviewing and consolidating financial and business information. Coordinate preparation of MIS, dashboards, management reports and presentations. Analyse information and highlight important trends, exceptions, risks and pending decisions. Support preparation for monthly/quarterly business reviews, Board/Audit Committee meetings and other senior management forums. Undertake research and prepare concise summaries on specific business, financial or strategic matters as required. 3. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as a coordination point between the CFO Office and Finance, Accounts, Treasury, Taxation, FP&A, Secretarial, Legal, HR, Business and other functions. Coordinate information and responses required from various teams. Track important projects and initiatives sponsored or monitored by the CFO. Ensure deadlines, deliverables and commitments are followed through without requiring repeated intervention from the CFO. Facilitate effective communication between the CFO and internal/external stakeholders. 4. Meetings & Governance Coordinate CFO-led reviews and important management meetings. Prepare agendas and collate relevant material in advance. Record key decisions and action points where required. Maintain action trackers with clear ownership and timelines. Follow up proactively until actions are completed. Maintain appropriate records of important CFO Office discussions and decisions. 5. Presentations & Communication Prepare and refine PowerPoint presentations, briefing documents, reports and executive summaries. Assist in drafting internal communications, meeting notes and correspondence. Convert detailed information into concise, management-level summaries. Ensure accuracy and consistency of information presented to senior management. 6. Confidential & Sensitive Matters Handle highly confidential financial, commercial, organisational and personnel information with complete discretion. Maintain appropriate confidentiality of discussions, documents and correspondence handled through the CFO Office. Exercise sound judgement regarding information sharing and stakeholder communication. 7. Executive & Administrative Support Manage travel planning, itineraries and related coordination. Organise internal and external meetings, including logistics where required. Manage correspondence, documentation and important records. Screen and prioritise requests requiring the CFO's attention. Provide other executive support necessary for efficient functioning of the CFO Office. Candidate Profile Education Graduate/Postgraduate from a recognised institution. MBA/PGDM in Finance or related discipline would be preferred. Candidates with CA Inter/CMA Inter or a strong finance/accounting background may have an advantage. Experience Approximately 48 years of relevant experience , preferably supporting a CFO, CEO, Business Head or other senior executive. Experience in a large corporate, listed company, manufacturing organisation or professionally managed business would be preferred. Prior exposure to Finance, MIS, FP&A, business analysis, management reporting or a CFO Office would be an advantage. Required Skills Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word . Good numerical and analytical ability. Ability to understand financial and business information. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong planning, organisation and follow-through. Ability to prepare concise executive summaries and presentations. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines. Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in dealing with senior stakeholders. High degree of ownership and reliability. Personal Attributes The successful candidate should demonstrate: Discretion trusted with sensitive and confidential information. Ownership takes responsibility for matters through completion. Proactiveness – anticipates requirements rather than waiting for instructions. Structured thinking – brings order and clarity to multiple simultaneous priorities. Persistence – follows up firmly and professionally to achieve closure. Judgement – understands what requires escalation and what can be handled independently. Maturity – comfortable interacting with senior executives and external stakeholders. Learning agility – quickly develops an understanding of the business and the CFO's priorities. Composure – remains effective in a fast-paced and demanding environment. What Success Looks Like The EA to CFO should progressively become a trusted extension of the CFO Office—someone who ensures that the CFO's time is focused on the highest-value priorities, important matters do not fall through the cracks, meetings translate into action, and relevant information reaches the CFO in a concise and decision-ready form. The role offers significant exposure to senior management, financial decision-making, business strategy and corporate governance and can provide a strong development path for a high-potential professional.

Perform monthly financial analysis, including variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year. Prepare executive-level financial reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and recommend improvement opportunities. Financial Modeling Build and maintain sophisticated financial models supporting revenue, profitability, cash flow, headcount, and strategic initiatives. Develop scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and what-if models to evaluate business decisions. Support pricing analyses, investment decisions, capital allocation, and business case development. Create models to evaluate acquisitions, new service offerings, and strategic investments as needed. Business Partnership Partner with business leaders to understand operational drivers and financial impacts. Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives and operational improvement projects. Assist department leaders in managing budgets and identifying opportunities to improve financial performance. Reporting & Analytics Produce monthly management reporting packages and KPI dashboards. Analyze trends in revenue, margins, operating expenses, and cash flow. Develop automated reporting solutions using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. Ensure data integrity across financial systems and reporting platforms. Process Improvement Improve budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes through automation and standardization. Support implementation and enhancement of FP&A tools and financial systems. Identify opportunities to streamline reporting and improve analytical capabilities. AI-Enabled ways of working Actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate modelling, variance analysis, deck creation and reporting workflows Identify and pilot opportunities to automate manual FP&A process (data pulls, recurring reports, first-draft commentary) using AI and scripting. Bring an experimenters mindset- comfortable evaluating new tools and pushing the team towards modern, efficient workflows rather than legacy spreadsheet grind. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. Minimum 6 years of experience in Corporate FP&A, Financial Analysis, or Corporate Finance. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and financial modeling. Experience building integrated three-statement financial models. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP/FP&A systems. Strong understanding of financial statements and corporate finance principles. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.

title: Finance Accounts Executive
description:
Dear Sir, 
 We are Looking for Finance & Accounts Executive 
 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Responsible for day-to-day accounting and maintenance of books of accounts. Record and review purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries. Maintain general ledger, vendor ledger and customer ledger. Ensure accurate and timely accounting in Far vision / ERP. Responsible for monthly preparation of financial statements and management financial reports, including Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and other MIS reports. Prepare monthly management reports with comparison against the previous period, budget and/or previous year. Perform monthly ledger scrutiny, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and other closing adjustments. 2. Investment Management Assist in managing the companys investment portfolio, including mutual funds, fixed-income instruments and other approved investments. Maintain investment records, maturity schedules and transaction statements. Process investment purchases, redemptions, switches and other investment transactions. Monitor investment income, interest, dividend and capital gains. Reconcile investment statements with books of accounts. Prepare investment portfolio and valuation reports for management. Coordinate with banks, mutual fund houses, brokers, wealth managers and other investment institutions. Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all investment transactions. 3. Treasury & Cash Management Monitor daily cash and bank positions and prepare cash-flow requirements. Assist in short-term and medium-term cash-flow planning. Ensure availability of funds for operational and investment requirements. Manage fund transfers between bank accounts based on business requirements. Monitor utilisation of surplus funds and deployment of excess liquidity. Prepare regular treasury reports and cash-flow forecasts for management. Monitor interest income, bank charges and other treasury-related transactions. 4. Banking Activities Handle day-to-day banking activities and coordinate with banks. Prepare and process fund transfers, payments and other banking instructions. Maintain bank account records and authorised signatory documentation. Prepare and review Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS). Coordinate with banks for account-related matters, confirmations, statements and documentation. Monitor bank balances, deposits, interest receipts and other banking transactions. Assist in opening/closing bank accounts and other banking formalities as required. 5. Month-End & Year-End Closing Responsible for timely completion of monthly accounting closure. Pass necessary provisions, accruals, depreciation and adjustment entries. Reconcile major balance sheet accounts. Ensure completeness and accuracy of monthly financial data. Coordinate with auditors during statutory, tax and internal audits. 6. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly financial performance reports for management. Prepare business/division-wise and account-head-wise MIS. Analyse revenue, expenses, operating profit, PBT and cash flow. Prepare variance analysis against budget/previous year. Provide financial information and analysis to management for decision-making. Key Skills Required Strong knowledge of accounting and financial reporting. Good understanding of treasury, investments and banking operations. Knowledge of GST, TDS and basic statutory compliance. Strong MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and financial formulas. Experience in SAP/ERP/Microsoft Business Central preferred. Good analytical and reconciliation skills. Ability to prepare and present monthly financials and MIS to management. Strong coordination skills with banks, auditors, investment institutions and internal departments. High level of accuracy, confidentiality and attention to detail. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely and accurate monthly financial statements and management reports. Timely completion of monthly and annual closing. Accuracy of cash-flow and treasury forecasts. Proper monitoring and reconciliation of investment portfolio. Timely execution and reconciliation of banking transactions. Timely vendor/customer and bank reconciliations. Accuracy and timeliness of GST/TDS compliance. Proper documentation and audit readiness. Effective utilisation of surplus funds and treasury management. Timely submission of MIS and financial analysis to management

title: Financial Controller
description:
Key Stakeholders: CMD, Finance Leadership, AR, AP, Tax & Compliance, Treasury/Funding, FP&A, Operations, Procurement, Projects and External Auditors 
 Role Purpose The Finance Controller Closing & Reporting will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete and timely financial closure and reporting across Redbrick Offices pan-India operations. The role will own the monthly, quarterly and annual book-closing process, maintain the integrity of the General Ledger and Balance Sheet, ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, and provide reliable financial statements and management reports to senior leadership. The incumbent will work closely with AR, AP, Taxation, Treasury, FP&A and business teams to ensure that all financial information is accurately captured, reconciled and reported within defined timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Closing & General Ledger Own the monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing process across entities, centres and cost centres. Establish and manage a detailed month-end closure calendar with clear ownership and timelines. Target completion of monthly financial closure within T+5 to T+7 working days. Review the General Ledger and ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting entries. Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, depreciation, revenue recognition and other closing adjustments. Ensure all material income and expenses are accounted for in the appropriate reporting period. Review unusual, exceptional and manual journal entries before closure. Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures for revenue, expenses, purchases and liabilities. Identify and resolve long-outstanding or incorrectly classified GL balances. Maintain appropriate maker-checker controls throughout the closure process. 2. Financial Statements & Reporting Ensure timely and accurate preparation of: Profit & Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Statement Trial Balance Supporting schedules and reconciliations Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting packs for senior management. Ensure consistency between books of accounts, financial statements, MIS and other management reports. Review Month-on-Month, Quarter-on-Quarter and Year-on-Year movements and investigate material variations. Provide clear explanations for significant accounting and financial movements. Support management reporting on revenue, EBITDA, operating costs, working capital and other key financial indicators. Ensure financial information presented to management is complete, accurate and supported by underlying records. 3. Balance Sheet Reconciliation & Control Own and review the monthly Balance Sheet reconciliation process. Ensure reconciliation of: Banks Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Client and landlord security deposits Vendor advances Employee advances Inter-company/inter-unit accounts Fixed assets Statutory liabilities Accruals and provisions Other control and suspense accounts Ensure 100% monthly reconciliation of material Balance Sheet accounts. Investigate ageing and long-outstanding balances and drive closure with responsible teams. Ensure no unsupported or unexplained balances are carried forward without appropriate review and approval. 4. Revenue & Expense Accounting Review revenue recognition for licence fees/rent, managed-service charges, utilities, parking, ancillary services and other operating revenue relevant to the managed-office business. Ensure appropriate accounting of billed, unbilled, accrued and deferred revenue. Review major expense accruals and provisions to ensure completeness of liabilities. Ensure correct accounting treatment of security deposits, rent, CAM, utilities, fit-out/project expenditure and centre operating expenses. Review significant credit notes, write-offs, waivers and accounting adjustments from a financial-reporting perspective. Coordinate with AR and AP teams to ensure sub-ledgers are fully reconciled with the General Ledger before closure. 5. Fixed Assets & Capitalisation Review the Fixed Asset Register and ensure reconciliation with the General Ledger. Ensure correct accounting for asset additions, capitalisation, transfers, depreciation, impairment, disposal and retirement. Review accounting and capitalisation of new-centre fit-out and refurbishment expenditure. Ensure appropriate classification between capital expenditure and operating expenditure. Coordinate with Projects, Procurement and AP for timely financial closure and capitalisation of completed projects. 6. Accounting Standards & Policies Ensure financial reporting complies with applicable Ind AS, Companies Act requirements and company accounting policies. Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across entities and operating centres. Review accounting treatment for complex or non-routine transactions. Prepare and maintain accounting position papers and supporting documentation wherever required. Keep the organisation updated on relevant changes in accounting standards and their financial impact. 7. Audit & Statutory Reporting Act as a key finance coordinator for statutory audit, internal audit and other financial reviews. Prepare financial statements, schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents required by auditors. Ensure audit queries are responded to accurately and within agreed timelines. Coordinate with AR, AP, Tax, Treasury and other finance teams for audit requirements. Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of accounting and reporting-related observations. Minimise post-closure and post-audit adjustments through stronger monthly review processes. 8. Internal Financial Controls Strengthen financial controls relating to book closure, GL accounting, journal entries, reconciliations and financial reporting. Ensure material transactions are appropriately supported, authorised and recorded. Identify accounting/control gaps and recommend corrective actions. Conduct periodic GL scrutiny and exception-based reviews. Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails supporting financial transactions. Ensure adherence to approved finance SOPs, accounting policies and delegated authority matrices. 9. ERP, Automation & Process Improvement Drive standardisation of closing and reporting processes across centres and entities. Improve ERP-based accounting and reduce dependence on manual workings. Automate repetitive reconciliations, schedules and financial reports wherever feasible. Improve the accuracy and turnaround time of financial information. Strengthen controls over chart of accounts, cost centres and accounting masters. Support ERP/system enhancements impacting accounting, closure and reporting. 10. Team & Cross-Functional Coordination Lead and develop the Closing, GL & Reporting team. Define clear KRAs, closing responsibilities and review mechanisms. Work closely with AR, AP, Tax & Compliance, Treasury/Funding and FP&A teams to ensure timely availability of closure inputs. Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, Projects and other business functions for accounting and reconciliation matters. Drive accountability for delays or incomplete information impacting financial closure. Build a culture of accuracy, timeliness, ownership and financial discipline. 
 Key Deliverables / KPIs KPI 
 Expected Outcome Monthly Book Closure 
 T+5 to T+7 working days Balance Sheet Reconciliation 
 100% of material accounts every month Financial Reporting 
 Accurate and within agreed timelines GL Quality 
 Minimum unreconciled/unsupported balances Post-Closure Adjustments 
 Minimal Audit Completion 
 Within agreed timelines Audit Observations 
 Timely closure; no repeat observations Inter-company Reconciliation 
 100% monthly Financial Statements 
 Accurate and compliant with applicable Ind AS Process Improvement 
 Progressive automation and faster closure Candidate Profile Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory. Approximately 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience. Strong hands-on experience in financial controllership, General Ledger, book closure, consolidation and financial reporting. Experience working in an organisation with approximately 500–1,000+ Cr turnover or comparable scale/complexity preferred. Experience handling multi-location, multi-entity or multi-cost-centre operations. Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Companies Act requirements, financial statements, revenue recognition and internal financial controls. Strong experience in Balance Sheet reviews and reconciliations. Demonstrated experience managing monthly/quarterly/year-end closing under stringent timelines. Experience leading statutory audits and working directly with external auditors. Advanced knowledge of ERP/accounting systems and MS Excel; exposure to BI/reporting tools would be advantageous. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with an ability to identify accounting inconsistencies and control gaps. Strong stakeholder-management skills and ability to coordinate across multiple finance and business functions. Preferred Industry Background Candidates from Managed Offices / Co-working, Commercial Real Estate, Hospitality, Facilities Management, Retail, Infrastructure or other multi-location/high-transaction service businesses will be preferred. This aligns with the broader industry profile specified in the existing Financial Controller JD. Preferred Leadership Attributes Strong hands-on controllership mindset rather than only supervisory experience. Detail-oriented with strong command over financial numbers. Able to challenge incomplete or unsupported accounting entries. Strong ownership of deadlines and closure quality. Proactive in identifying financial and control issues before reporting deadlines. Capable of working effectively in a fast-growing, multi-location environment. Comfortable escalating material accounting issues and financial risks to senior management. High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional judgement. Please note - Job location will be at Kalina.

title: Equity Research Analyst
company: Old Rice Assets Management And Advisors Private Li Mited
description:
Equity Research Analyst Job Description Location: Mumbai
 Department: Investments / Equity Research
 Reporting to: Fund Manager / CIO / Head of Research Role Objective Identify high-quality, mispriced investment opportunities in Indian equities through rigorous fundamental research, financial modelling, primary research and continuous monitoring. The analyst is expected to develop an independent investment view , clearly articulate upside/downside and actively track whether the original investment thesis is playing out. Key Responsibilities Company & Sector Research Conduct deep fundamental research on assigned companies/sectors. Understand business model, industry structure, competitive advantages, market size, growth drivers and key risks. Analyse annual reports, financial statements, investor presentations, exchange filings, credit-rating reports and other relevant information. Study competitors, customers, suppliers and the broader value chain. Conduct channel checks and primary research wherever useful. Financial Analysis & Modelling Build and maintain detailed P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow models . Forecast revenue, margins, working capital, capex, cash flows, ROCE/ROE and earnings. Identify the 35 operating KPIs that actually drive each company's earnings. Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis Bull / Base / Bear . Reconcile reported profits with cash generation and balance-sheet movement. Valuation Apply appropriate valuation methodologies including P/E, EV/EBITDA, DCF, SOTP, P/B, FCF yield, EV/Sales , etc. Compare valuations against history, peers and underlying business quality. Establish fair value, expected return and downside risk rather than merely assigning a target price. Investment Idea Generation Continuously screen the listed universe for new opportunities. Generate differentiated investment ideas rather than depending only on broker recommendations. Prepare concise investment notes covering:
 Thesis Why Now Earnings Drivers Valuation Catalysts Risks What Can Go Wrong. Present recommendations to the Fund Manager / Investment Committee. Management & Industry Interaction Attend management meetings, earnings calls, analyst meets, AGMs and industry conferences. Interact with suppliers, distributors, customers, competitors and industry experts where appropriate. Assess management quality, integrity, capital allocation and corporate governance . Maintain a structured question bank before management interactions. Portfolio Monitoring Continuously track portfolio companies and watchlist names. Review quarterly results against our estimates rather than consensus alone . Immediately identify material changes in earnings, industry structure, regulation, management commentary or competitive intensity. Maintain a clear thesis tracker : what has changed, what has not, and what would invalidate the investment case. Research Documentation & Discipline Maintain updated financial models, valuation sheets, investment notes and research databases. Document investment assumptions and subsequent changes. Maintain historical management guidance versus actual delivery. Follow applicable compliance, confidentiality and research standards. Where the role falls within SEBI's Research Analyst regulatory framework, applicable qualification/certification and conduct requirements must also be followed. 
 Preferred candidate profile MBA (Finance) with minimum 5 years of equity research experience at SEBI registered institutions. 
 Perks and benefits As per Company Policy

description:
Assistant Manager Finance 
 The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As Indias first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build whats next. If youre driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, youll feel right at home here. 
 About the Role This is a high-impact role within the finance function of one of India’s fastest-scaling fintech and crypto platforms. You will play a key role in driving revenue assurance for the core business, building meaningful MIS and reporting frameworks, managing entity-level accounting and reporting, and leading automation initiatives across finance operations. The role offers hands-on exposure to VDA accounting across multiple entities and the opportunity to solve complex finance challenges across crypto, treasury, banking, and global operations while building scalable processes and controls for the future of digital finance. 
 What You’ll Do Manage financial accounting, reporting, and support consolidation activities for multiple global entities while ensuring timely and accurate closures.  Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes including preparation and review of financial statements, schedules, and disclosures.  Drive MIS-to-financial statement reconciliations to ensure accuracy and consistency across group reporting.  Support revenue assurance for the core business by validating revenue reporting, reconciliations, and maintaining proper audit-ready documentation.  Work closely with auditors, tax consultants, and regulators to ensure compliance with IGAAP/Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and other applicable requirements.  Improve finance processes, internal controls, and reporting frameworks to build scalable and efficient operations.  Lead finance automation and ERP enhancement initiatives, including Oracle NetSuite optimization and reporting improvements.  Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Tax, and Operations on business and regulatory initiatives.  Assist in preparing quarterly employee engagement and spend reports for business unit heads to provide visibility into budget utilization. 
 You’ll Excel in This Role If You Think like an owner and operate with high accountability in fast-moving environments.  Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to complex operational and accounting challenges.  Have strong technical depth across financial reporting, audits, and compliance frameworks.  Bring exceptional attention to detail while balancing speed, accuracy, and execution.  Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across business, finance, and technology teams.  Continuously look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve systems and workflows.  Are comfortable working in high-growth environments where priorities evolve rapidly. 
 You’ll Know You’re Winning When Financial close processes are running smoothly with timely and accurate reporting across entities.  MIS and financial statement reconciliations are consistent, reliable, and provide clear visibility to leadership.  Revenue assurance processes are strengthened with minimal reconciliation gaps and audit-ready documentation always available.  Audit cycles are completed efficiently with reduced observations and stronger compliance readiness.  Finance processes and reporting workflows are becoming more automated, scalable, and operationally efficient.  Cross-functional stakeholders rely on you for accurate reporting, timely insights, and dependable execution.  ERP and reporting enhancements are improving data accuracy, turnaround time, and overall finance productivity. 
 Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You This is an opportunity to be part of the finance function at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech and crypto platforms. You’ll work on high-impact areas such as VDA accounting, revenue assurance, global reporting, and finance automation while partnering closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. It’s a chance to solve complex finance challenges at scale and contribute to building the future of digital finance. 
 Hiring Process Here’s what your journey with us looks like: Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – (If Required) A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios (If Required) Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit 
 Where We Work We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office , where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 
 Perks That Empower You We believe great people deserve great experiences. Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities 
 Ready to Build What’s Next? If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Role & responsibilities Core Responsibilities: 1 
 Financial Accounting & Reporting: Oversee accurate accounting and reporting of all financial transactions in compliance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and company policies. Ensure timely and reliable financial statements and reports to support strategic decision-making. 2 
 Day-to-Day Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting functions including Accounts Receivable (AR) , Accounts Payable (AP) , general ledger, journal entries, and bank reconciliations to ensure data integrity and adherence to internal controls. 3 
 AR & AP Review: Review Accounts Receivable for timely billing, collections, and credit management; oversee Accounts Payable for vendor payments, reconciliations, and compliance with internal authorization processes. Conduct periodic aging and working capital analysis. 4 
 Treasury and Cash Flow Management: Monitor customer receipts and vendor payments to maintain efficient cash flow and working capital. Prepare and review cash flow statements (actual vs forecast) to ensure optimal liquidity planning. Maintain strong banking relationships , manage fund movements, and ensure optimal utilization of banking facilities. 5 
 Capex Monitoring and Capitalization: Review and track Capex projects , ensuring correct classification and capitalization as per Ind AS 16. Maintain fixed asset registers, monitor CWIP, and ensure accurate depreciation accounting. 6 
 Month-End and Year-End Closing: Lead monthly and annual closing activities including reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and preparation of financial reports within strict timelines. 7 
 MIS, Forecasting, and Budget Reporting: Prepare and consolidate MIS reports , budgets , and financial forecasts using Oracle HFM (Hyperion Financial Management) and Excel-based tools. Perform detailed variance analysis (Actual vs Budget vs Forecast) and provide actionable insights for management decision-making. 8 
 Management Reporting & Performance Review: Prepare and deliver monthly performance presentations to the Engineering Director and Group Engineering Head , highlighting key financial results, cost trends, and operational variances. Present analysis with improvement recommendations to drive business and engineering efficiency. 9 
 Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management: Interact with the global management team on all finance-related topics including reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and compliance. Collaborate closely with plant finance and cross-functional engineering teams to support financial planning, cost control, and performance improvement initiatives. 10 
 Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting process. Track performance, analyze deviations, and support strategic planning and target setting. 11 
 Taxation: Manage Direct Tax and Indirect Tax (GST) compliance, return filing, reconciliations, and assessments. Ensure adherence to statutory deadlines and effective tax planning within the regulatory framework. 12 
 Audit Management: Coordinate and manage Statutory Audit , Tax Audit , Transfer Pricing Audit , and Internal Audit . Partner with auditors to ensure effective audit execution, timely completion, and implementation of recommendations. 13 
 SAP and Oracle Expertise: Proficient in SAP (FI/CO module) for financial accounting, cost center reporting, and asset management, and Oracle HFM for financial consolidation, MIS, budgeting, and forecasting. Drive process automation, accuracy, and system-based financial control. 14 
 Costing and Engineering Rate Analysis: Perform cost analysis and engineering hourly rate calculations to support pricing, project costing, and profitability assessment. Presentations for rate and discussion at various stages, Hours booking reminders and follow up, 15 
 Knowledge of SEZ compliance

description:
Position Title 
 Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) Department 
 Financial Control Reporting Line 
 Head of Shared Services/Country Head Direct Reports 
 AP/AR Manager Location 
 Pune DBG HEALTH PURPOSE 
 Our vision at DBG Health is to enhance the health and well-being of all patients and consumers, by providing affordable access to health, wellness, and beauty products that improve the quality of their lives. 
 DBG HEALTH VALUES 
 All employees are expected to demonstrate the DBG Health PACT Values of Pioneering , Accountability , Collaboration and Tenacity when carrying out the accountabilities and responsibilities of their role. Further details about DBG Health PACT Values and Behaviours can be found on People Hub. 
 POSITION PURPOSE 
 The Finance Manager Shared Services (Pune) is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and delivery of the Pune Finance Shared Services team, ensuring AP and AR activities are executed accurately, efficiently and within agreed service levels. The role will manage daily priorities, workload and performance across the Pune team, while building capability, accountability and a high-performance culture. The role will work closely with the Head of Shared Services to continuously improve processes, strengthen controls and ensure consistent service delivery to the Group 
 ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Finance Operations & Daily Execution - Role - 25% 
 Lead the day-to-day operation of the Pune AP and AR function, ensuring all activities are completed accurately, efficiently and within agreed timelines. Set and manage daily priorities across the team, ensuring critical activities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements are clearly understood and delivered. Monitor workload and capacity across the team and appropriately allocate work to ensure balanced and effective execution. Maintain strong oversight of AP and AR processing, including invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliations, settlements and other transactional finance activities. Ensure month-end activities are completed accurately and on time, with appropriate preparation and planning across the team. Proactively identify operational issues, bottlenecks and risks and take action to resolve them before they impact service delivery. Act as the key escalation point for complex operational matters within the Pune Shared Services team. Ensure high standards of accuracy, timeliness and customer service are maintained every day. 2. Team Leadership & Capability - Role 25% 
 Lead, manage and develop the Pune Shared Services team of approximately 12 AP and AR team members. Establish clear expectations around performance, accountability, quality and service delivery. Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews to ensure priorities, issues and expectations are understood. Develop team capability through coaching, training, knowledge sharing and on-the-job development. Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate development plans to build a strong and sustainable team. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and customer focus. Identify and develop high-performing team members and support succession planning within the Pune function. Manage performance issues proactively and in accordance with company policies and processes. Build strong engagement across the Pune team and create an environment where team members understand how their work contributes to the broader Finance function. 3. Financial Controls, Quality & Compliance - Role 25% 
 Ensure AP and AR activities are completed in accordance with Group policies, procedures, controls and accounting requirements. Maintain strong oversight of transactional controls and ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval processes are followed. Review and monitor reconciliations, exception reports and other key control activities. Identify control weaknesses, recurring errors and process risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. Ensure audit requests and supporting documentation are completed accurately and within required timeframes. Work closely with Financial Control and other Finance stakeholders to resolve accounting, reconciliation and transactional issues. Ensure a strong control and compliance mindset is embedded within the Pune team. 4. Continuous Improvement & Efficiency - Role 10% Work closely with the Head of Shared Services and Continuous Improvement & Efficiency Lead to identify and implement process improvements.
 • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing, improve productivity, eliminate duplication and simplify ways of working.
 • Support the implementation of automation, system enhancements and standardised processes across the Pune team.
 • Ensure process improvements are effectively implemented and embedded into BAU operations.
 • Encourage team members to identify and raise opportunities for improvement.
 • Monitor the impact of process improvements on productivity, quality and service delivery. 
 5. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery - Role 10% 
 Build strong working relationships with Australian Finance teams and key business stakeholders.
 • Act as a key point of contact between the Pune Shared Services team and onshore Finance stakeholders.
 • Ensure stakeholder requests and escalations are appropriately prioritised and resolved.
 • Communicate proactively where deadlines, service levels or deliverables may be impacted.
 • Establish a strong customer service mindset within the Pune team.
 • Support the Head of Shared Services and AP/AR Manager in monitoring service levels and identifying opportunities to improve the Finance customer experience. 
 6. Engagement / Health, Safety and Wellbeing - Role - 5% 

 Adhere to and undertake duties in accordance with DBG Health's Health, Safety and Wellbeing policies, procedures and systems.
 • Act as an influential leader and business partner, collaborating across functions and constructively challenging existing practices to deliver better outcomes.
 • Lead by example and contribute to a positive, inclusive and high-performing team environment.
 • Embrace change and demonstrate agility when working through ambiguity and competing priorities.
 • Build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
 • Ensure confidentiality is respected and maintained at all times.
 • Participate in health and safety training and comply with relevant workplace safety requirements.
 • Identify and report hazards and incidents in accordance with DBG Health policies and procedures. 

 POSITION REQUIREMENTS Skills and Knowledge 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Strong technical accounting knowledge and understanding of financial controls. Demonstrated ability to manage daily finance operations in a high-volume Shared Services environment. Strong ability to prioritise competing workloads and ensure critical deadlines are consistently met. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality. title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Purpose / Summary   The Manager / Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts is responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant execution of core finance operations — including month-end close, reconciliations, taxation, and accounts payable/receivable — for their area of responsibility. This is a hands-on leadership role: the incumbent supervises a team of accountants and finance executives, ensures day-to-day processes run smoothly and controls are consistently followed, and provides the leadership team with reliable, well-supported financial information. Working closely with the GM – Finance & Accounts, the role holder translates group finance policy into consistent day-to-day practice, resolves operational issues as they arise, and drives continuous improvement in accuracy, compliance and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant (CA/CPA) with strong, hands-on experience across core accounting functions, who is equally comfortable managing a team and staying close to the detail. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Reporting & Accounting 
  Execute the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close process for assigned entities/functions, meeting agreed deadlines and accuracy standards.
 Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions and intercompany postings ahead of GM sign-off.
 Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring open items are aged, tracked and resolved in a timely manner.
 Prepare accurate P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statements with supporting schedules for management review.
 Support the GM – Finance & Accounts in preparing leadership and management reporting packs.
 Ensure accounting entries and documentation comply with applicable accounting standards and group policy. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Support the annual budgeting and periodic reforecasting process, coordinating inputs from department and cost-centre owners.
 Prepare monthly budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance reports, with clear root-cause commentary.
 Track key financial and operational metrics, flagging risks, cost overruns and opportunities to the GM in a timely manner.
 Assist with cash flow monitoring and working capital tracking, escalating funding requirements as needed.

 Taxation & Compliance 
 Manage timely preparation, review and filing of direct and indirect tax returns (income tax, GST/VAT, TDS/withholding tax) in coordination with external advisors.
 Ensure accurate tax provisioning, reconciliation of tax accounts, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
 Support statutory and regulatory compliance activity, including statutory filings, registers and the compliance calendar.
 Respond to routine tax queries, notices and audit requests, escalating complex matters to the GM/CFO.
 Stay current on changes in tax and regulatory requirements relevant to the entity's operations.

 Accounts Payable & Receivable 
 Oversee end-to-end AP operations — vendor invoice processing, three-way matching, approvals and payment runs — ensuring adherence to delegated authority.
 Oversee AR operations including invoicing, collections and cash application, driving improvement in DSO and reduction of overdue balances.
 Maintain accurate AP/AR ageing and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and disputes.
 Monitor vendor and customer master data integrity, including controls over changes to banking details.

 Audit & Internal Controls 
 Coordinate with statutory and internal auditors — preparing schedules, responding to queries and closing out action points on time.
 Support the GM in maintaining and testing internal controls, the risk and controls matrix, and segregation of duties.
 Ensure a clean, well-documented audit trail from source data through to reported results.
 Identify and remediate control gaps within own area of responsibility, escalating systemic issues to the GM.

 Team Management & Process Improvement 
 Supervise, coach and develop a team of accountants/finance executives, setting clear priorities and reviewing quality of output.
 Allocate work, monitor performance and build team capability to support growing business needs.
 Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of finance processes and SOPs.
 Ensure finance policies and procedures are correctly understood and consistently applied across the team.
 Act as a key point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on day-to-day finance matters.

 Key Skills & Competencies 

 Technical Skills 
 Strong working knowledge of accounting standards and their practical application.
 Hands-on experience with month-end close, reconciliations and financial statement preparation.
 Working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation and statutory compliance requirements.
 Proficiency with ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel; exposure to BI/reporting tools is an advantage.
 Sound understanding of internal controls, audit processes and revenue/cost reconciliation.

 Soft Skills & Behavioural Competencies 
 Strong people management and coaching skills, with the ability to lead and develop a small-to-mid-sized team.
 High attention to detail and accuracy, with a structured, process-driven approach to work.
 A strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently within defined policy.
 Effective communicator, able to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
 Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing organisation with evolving processes.
 Sound judgement in escalating issues to senior management at the right time.

 Qualifications & Experience 

 MANDATORY PREREQUISITE – NON-NEGOTIABLE 
Candidates must hold a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification. This is a strict must-have for this role — applications without CA/CPA qualification will not be considered.

 Required Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) — mandatory (see prerequisite above).

 Experience 
 6–9 years of post-qualification experience in core accounting/finance roles.
 Demonstrated experience supervising and developing a finance team.
 Hands-on experience across month-end close, taxation, compliance, and AP/AR operations.
 Prior experience in a multi-entity, fast-growing, or dynamic organisation is preferred.
 Working exposure to ERP systems and statutory audit processes required.

This is a dual-focus role covering UK statutory audits and preparation of year-end financial statements under FRS 102 / FRS 105. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to UK audit methodology, strong technical accounting knowledge, and the ability to take ownership of sections of an audit file and a set of year-end accounts from planning through to completion. Working from our Pitampura, Delhi office as part of an international cross-border team. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Statutory Audit (UK GAAP / ISA (UK)): Execute planning, fieldwork, and completion procedures on UK statutory audits under ISA (UK) , working under the direction of UK-based managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Prepare audit working papers on areas such as revenue, purchases, payroll, fixed assets, cash & bank, debtors, creditors, accruals, prepayments, and related party transactions. Perform risk assessment, walkthroughs, tests of controls, substantive analytical procedures, and detailed substantive testing with appropriate sampling. Draft and refine audit file sections on CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS, or similar audit software, ensuring documentation meets ISA (UK) evidence and cross-referencing standards. Identify and escalate audit issues, control weaknesses, misstatements, and potential adjusting journal entries; draft management letter points. Support completion procedures analytical review, going concern assessment, subsequent events, and management representation letters. 
 Year-End Accounts Preparation: Prepare statutory financial statements for UK limited companies under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105 , in accordance with the Companies Act 2006. Post year-end adjustments depreciation, accruals, prepayments, deferred/current tax, dividends, directors' loans, corporation tax provisions and roll forward trial balances. Draft primary statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss / Income Statement, Cash Flow where applicable) with supporting notes and required disclosures. Assist in preparing corporation tax computations (CT600) and iXBRL tagging where required, coordinating with the tax team. Reconcile prior-year comparatives, ensure consistency with statutory filings, and prepare files for RI/manager review. 
 Compliance & Coordination: Support VAT return reviews, HMRC filings, and confirm all engagements meet UK accounting, auditing, and tax standards. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine: Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains Polished technical communications Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time. The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs. This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB. Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Cool things you'll do 
 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem What you need 
 You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes: Communicator: Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations) Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability Collaborator: Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts Problem Solver: Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos Technical Expert: Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP Builder: Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers Product evangelism: The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL) Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures Microservices/Serverless architectures CI/CD tools and approaches Containerization, orchestration and management tools Enterprise Identity platforms Experience using or managing MongoDB Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering 

 Success Measures 
 In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

title: E&E FP&A CoE Insights Senior Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
 Provides financial data preparation, reconciliations, variance analysis, and process consistency support for the E&E FP&A CoE. Ensures accurate, reliable financial information, strengthens data integrity and processes, and enables Business Decision Support teams and stakeholders to make informed financial decisions. 
 
 Accountabilities 
 
 Data Quality & Reconciliation Oversight 
 Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across SAP, Anaplan, and market datasets, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and consistency for planning, forecasting, and reporting while identifying and escalating discrepancies. Maintain audit-ready documentation, version control, and standardized data repositories, while partnering with BDS teams to align financial data inputs with business-facing outputs and reporting requirements. 
 
 Financial Data Preparation 
 Prepare standardized financial data packs, extracts, and variance analyses, highlighting trends and anomalies while supporting consistent sector-level datasets and market summaries for informed business decision-making. 
 
 Process Execution & Standardisation & Efficiency 
 Execute standardised financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data governance standards, ensuring consistent data structures, process compliance, and continuous improvement through identification of inefficiencies and enhancement opportunities. 
 
 Support to BDS Teams 
 Provide reconciled and accurate datasets to support performance reviews, resolve data discrepancies with finance and systems teams, and respond promptly to business reporting and data requests. 
 
 Role specific knowledge and experience: 
 
 Essential 
 Significant experience in financial data analysis, FP&A, management accounting or similar. Experience completing reconciliations and supporting monthly reporting cycles. Ability to work with complex financial datasets across multiple markets or business units. Experience with Anaplan or similar EPM platforms. Capability in financial modelling, forecasting and analytics, as well as strong data literacy (Power BI, dashboard creation, and data modelling). 
 
 Desirable 
 Track record of delivering accurate financial reporting and analysis to tight deadlines. Experience with SAP or similar ERP platforms. Experience working with multiple stakeholders in a matrix or multi-country organisational context. 
 
 Role specific skills 
 Data accuracy & reconciliation skills - ability to identify errors and inconsistencies across multiple datasets. Process discipline - reliable execution of standardised processes, templates and workflows. EPM systems proficiency - strong working knowledge of Anaplan, and experience working with SAP and associated reporting tools. Attention to detail - consistently high levels of accuracy and completeness. Clear communication - able to summarise financial data simply for internal stakeholders. Time management - ability to prioritise across multiple countries and reporting deadlines. 
 
 Language Requirements 
 The British Council systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required.
