title: USA Properties Business Manager
description:
**PRIME DEVELOPERS US** 




*Job Description* 




**Property Business Manager** 




*(Based at Hyderabad Office, India \| Managing One US Commercial Property)* 




**Company** 





 Prime Developers – Texas\-based commercial real estate developer/owner\-operator (est. 2017\), managing retail, flex, and office plaza properties across Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, and Lewisville, TX.
 




**Location** 





 Hyderabad Office, India – in\-office role
 




**Scope** 





 One assigned US commercial property
 




**Reports To** 





 Company Leadership / Ownership
 




**Direct Reports** 





 On\-site Property Manager and ground staff at the assigned property
 




**Work Hours** 





 Overlap with US business hours (Central Time) required
 




**Reporting Cadence** 





 Regular reports to leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance
 




**About Prime Developers** 





 Prime Developers has offered real estate development and investment services since 2017, specializing in iconic commercial and residential properties across the Texas market. The company owns and operates a growing portfolio of multi\-tenant retail, flex, and office plazas, and is actively acquiring additional commercial spaces — creating an expanding need for hands\-on, accountable operational oversight across the portfolio.
 




**Role Overview** 





 Prime Developers is looking for a Property Business Manager, based at the company's Hyderabad office, to take full ownership of the day\-to\-day wellbeing, performance, and growth of one assigned US commercial property. This is not a ground\-up development role — the focus is on operating, maintaining, and growing an established building/commercial space after acquisition or completion.
 





 The person in this role will act as the single point of accountability for the assigned property, directing and coordinating an on\-site Property Manager and ground staff based in the US, while personally owning leasing/bookings, maintenance oversight, marketing, accounting coordination, and overall growth of the asset. Regular reports will be shared with leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end performance of the assigned commercial property — treat it like a business unit with full accountability for its upkeep and growth.
 



 • Exercise decision\-making authority on growth\-oriented initiatives for the property — leasing terms, budget allocation, capex, vendor contracts — and be able to justify each decision with clear financial and operational reasoning.
 **(This will discuss with client)** 




 • Direct and coordinate the on\-site Property Manager and ground staff (maintenance, leasing/front\-desk, vendors) from the Hyderabad office.
 



 • Oversee bookings, leasing, and occupancy — track vacancies, tenant renewals, and new leasing opportunities to maximize occupancy and revenue.
 



 • Manage maintenance operations — schedule repairs and preventive maintenance, track work orders, and ensure ground staff/vendors resolve issues promptly.
 



 • Coordinate accounting and financial oversight — track rent collection, operating expenses, budgets, and P\&L for each property in partnership with accounting/finance resources.
 **(If Applicable)** 




 • Drive marketing and growth initiatives — improve property visibility, tenant mix, and occupancy through marketing efforts and local partnerships.
 



 • Manage vendor and contractor relationships — sourcing, negotiating, and overseeing US\-based vendors for repairs, landscaping, security, and other services.
 **(Client Decision)** 




 • Ensure compliance with US property regulations, local codes, licensing, and insurance requirements applicable to each property.
 **(If applicable/required)** 




 • Provide regular reporting to leadership on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and growth initiatives for the property.
 



 • Be ready to take on additional properties and support onboarding/operational setup as the company's portfolio grows.
 



**Requirements** 




 • MBA in Finance (or equivalent) with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including a demonstrated track record of making business/financial decisions and justifying them with sound reasoning and data.
 



 • Prior experience in property management, facilities management, or commercial real estate operations (US market experience strongly preferred but not mandate).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage a team remotely and hold on\-site staff accountable without being physically present at the property.
 



 • Working knowledge of leasing/occupancy management, basic accounting/P\&L, and vendor management.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable working significant overlap with US business hours.
 



 • Familiarity with property management or leasing software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, or similar) is a plus.
 **(These are software’s recommended but its client decision)** 



* • Highly organized, ownership\-driven mindset — comfortable being the accountable owner of an asset's outcomes rather than just a coordinator.

title: Senior Manager,  International Controllership
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 








 The Senior Manager, Record to Report for Controllership will provide end\-to\-end leadership for the Record\-to\-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for leading a large controllership team, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements.
   

 This is a critical leadership role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in building, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Director will partner closely with Controllership, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality financial outcomes at scale.
   

 The role requires a strong controllership mindset, deep technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance.
   

 This role will manage \~ 2 Manager level accounting positions in Hyderabad and will oversee a broader team of \~10 accounting positions, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you
   

 Your Role Accountabilities…
   

 Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership
   

 • Lead and oversee RTR accounting and controllership activities
   

 • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
   

 • Supervise intercompany reconciliations and resolve out\-of\-balance items with WBD counterparts.
   

 • Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
   

 • Review and analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.
   

 • Review and sign\-off monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements, including footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
   

 • Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely, including coordination with Technical Accounting teams where required.
   

 • Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy
   

 • Continuously identify, design, and implement process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This includes special projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) as needed.
   

 Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness
   

 • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
   

 • Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
   

 • Drive discipline around documentation, evidence retention, review controls, issue tracking, and remediation.
   

 • Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.
   

 Transition and Operating Model Buildout
   

 • Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being insourced from other regions into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
   

 • Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms.
   

 • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes.
   

 • Build sustainable team capacity and capability to support the future\-state controllership operating model.
   

 Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership
   

 • Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and Controllership, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, GBS, and other business stakeholders.
   

 • Develop strong relationships with global and regional finance leaders and provide responsive, practical, and technically sound accounting support.
   

 • Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
   

 • Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision\-making.
   

 • Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
   

 Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems
   

 • Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
   

 • Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
   

 • Support system implementations, ERP\-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
   

 • Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams.
   

 People Leadership and Talent Development
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals.
   

 • Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
   

 • Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
   

 • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high\-quality execution.
   

 • Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
   

 Qualifications \& Experience…
   

 Required
   

 ● Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
   

 ● 15\+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, financial reporting , with at least 5 years of supervisory role.
   

 ● Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
   

 • Deep understanding of US GAAP, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
   

 ● Proven experience leading large accounting teams, including leaders/managers.
   

 ● Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
   

 ● Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
   

 ● Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
   

 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, present solution, and decision\-making skills.
   

 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
   

 ● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
   

 ● Able to work effectively across various time zones.
   

  

  

 Desired
   

 • Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
   

 • Experience with
 
 remote transition.
 

  


 • Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
   

 • Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.
   

 • MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred.
   

  

 Leadership Attributes
   

 • Strong controllership leader with sound judgment and high integrity.
   

 • Comfortable building structure in a changing environment.
   

 • Able to balance technical accounting depth with practical business partnership.
   

 • A leader who can build capability, coach teams, and create accountability.
   

 • A transformation\-minded leader who can simplify, standardize, and scale processes.
   

 • Confident working with senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
   

 • Proactive in identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving closure.
 















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

title: Accounts Payable Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 A leading global organization is seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to oversee end\-to\-end payables operations across multiple legal entities. Reporting to the Finance Controller, this role leads a team of AP specialists, acts as the primary liaison between Finance, Procurement, and external vendors, and drives automation, process standardization, and strong internal controls — all in alignment with US GAAP and company policies.
 



 This is a great opportunity for an experienced AP leader who wants to shape a high\-performing team, modernize the P2P process, and partner across the business in a fast\-paced, multi\-entity environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





**Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Build, mentor, and manage a team of AP Specialists and Senior Associates — setting clear KPIs, conducting regular reviews, and enabling continuous skill development
* Allocate workloads effectively to ensure metric adherence across invoice processing, vendor master maintenance, payment runs, T\&E expense management, and period\-end close.



  





**Invoice \& Payment Processing** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) cycle including PO creation and approval monitoring, 2\-way/3\-way matching (PO–Invoice–Receipt), invoice processing with business\-level approval, and payment execution via banking platform
* Ensure accurate and timely processing of vendor invoices across multiple business units; monitor AP aging to maintain optimal DPO
* Review and approve high\-value payment batches; manage escalation of exceptions and discrepancies in coordination with Procurement and business stakeholders
* Monitor and maintain direct debit payment tracking
* Oversee employee expense reimbursements in compliance with company policies.



  





**Month\-End Close \& Reporting** 



* Lead AP month\-end and year\-end close — ensure all invoices are posted, accruals are raised for open POs and uninvoiced services, and AP accounts are reconciled to the GL
* Prepare and review AP sub\-ledger aging reports, vendor reconciliation statements, and balance sheet schedules; present variance analyses and KPI dashboards to the Finance Controller
* Coordinate with the GL/Reporting team to ensure AP transactions are correctly reflected in financial statements in line with US GAAP and company accounting policies.



  





**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Maintain strong working relationships with key vendors and business stakeholders to promptly resolve payment disputes, debit balances, and aged credits
* Collaborate closely with Procurement to streamline the P2P process, onboard new vendors, and maintain accurate vendor master data
* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on AP\-related queries, providing schedules and reconciliations as required.



  





**Systems, Automation \& Process Improvement** 



* Leverage ERP platforms (NetSuite, Oracle, Dayforce, SAP, or MS Dynamics) and travel management platforms (Concur, Navan) to drive automation of invoice capture, approval workflows, and payment processing
* Identify and champion process improvement initiatives — reducing manual touchpoints, improving straight\-through processing (STP) rates, and implementing e\-invoicing solutions
* Support Finance and ERP upgrades, system migrations, and integration of new entities or business units into the AP platform
* Define and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Risk and Control Matrix (RACM), and Delegation of Authority (DoA) for all AP processes; ensure SOX controls are operating effectively.



  





**Decision\-Making \& Scope** 



* Approve vendor payments within defined Delegation of Authority (DoA) limits
* Partner with Procurement on vendor onboarding, PO lifecycle management, and exception handling
* Collaborate with Finance\-IT and ERP teams on system enhancements, integrations, and upgrades
* Engage with external auditors and tax authorities to resolve queries and provide audit support



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




  




* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance); CA Inter or CMA Inter is a strong plus
* 7–10 years of progressive Finance \& Accounting experience; minimum 3 years in a supervisory AP or P2P role
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end AP operations including invoice processing, payment runs, and period\-close activities
* Proficiency in at least one major ERP — NetSuite, SAP, Oracle Financials, Dayforce, or MS Dynamics
* Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query; Power BI or similar reporting tools a plus
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; able to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, vendors, and global counterparts
* Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to identify root causes and implement lasting process fixes
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working in a Global Business Services / Shared Services environment supporting global clients
* Exposure to multi\-currency transactions, intercompany AP settlements, and foreign vendor payments
* Prior experience with SAP Concur or similar travel \& expense / procurement platforms

title: Capacity Planner
description:
We are looking for an experienced and analytical
 **Capacity Planner** 
 to oversee workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource management functions. The ideal candidate will have strong Workforce Management (WFM) experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to optimize staffing levels, ensure accurate forecasting, and manage real\-time operations to meet service level agreements (SLAs) and operational goals.
 



 The role involves working closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to analyze performance metrics, mitigate staffing risks, and drive continuous improvement across team operations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Capacity Planning \& Forecasting** 



* Develop accurate short\-term and long\-term volume forecasts and staffing models based on historical trends, business growth projections, and operational requirements.
* Analyze call, chat, and ticket patterns to identify workload trends and optimize capacity planning across teams and shifts.
* Determine staffing requirements based on forecasted workload, service level targets, shrinkage, and operational KPIs.
* Identify potential staffing gaps, capacity risks, and resource constraints.
* Partner with business and operations leadership to align workforce plans with business objectives.



**2\. Scheduling \& Resource Allocation** 



* Create, maintain, and publish optimal staff schedules that balance business requirements, agent preferences, and statutory compliance.
* Manage shift trades, time\-off requests, overtime, and offline activities to ensure adequate operational coverage.
* Optimize resource allocation across teams, shifts, and operational queues.
* Ensure staffing plans support service level commitments and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with Operations and HR teams to address scheduling and workforce requirements.



**3\. Real\-Time Management \& Operations** 



* Monitor intra\-day volume, staffing levels, and schedule adherence in real time.
* Execute timely staffing adjustments to mitigate unexpected volume spikes, outages, and operational disruptions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for operational escalations related to staffing shortages, outage management, and SLA risks.
* Monitor real\-time performance against forecasted volumes and staffing plans.
* Recommend corrective actions to maintain service levels and operational continuity.
* Collaborate with Operations and leadership teams during critical staffing or service disruptions.



**4\. Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Build and present daily, weekly, and monthly workforce management reports.
* Track and analyze key workforce metrics, including:
* Shrinkage
* Occupancy
* SLA Compliance
* Utilization
* Schedule Adherence
* Staffing Variance
* Forecast Accuracy
* Identify root causes for SLA misses, staffing variances, and operational inefficiencies.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve workforce efficiency and service delivery.
* Develop dashboards and reporting solutions to support operational and leadership decision\-making.
* Drive continuous improvement through data\-driven workforce analytics.



**5\. Stakeholder \& Team Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Operations, Workforce Management, HR, and senior leadership teams.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support staffing, scheduling, and capacity decisions.
* Communicate staffing risks, operational challenges, and performance trends to relevant stakeholders.
* Support workforce planning initiatives, process improvements, and operational transformation projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment between business demand and workforce availability.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM), Capacity Planning, or Resource Planning.
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Strong experience in workforce forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Proficiency in WFM tools such as NICE IEX, Aspect, Teleopti, and Verint
* Experience working with CRM platforms and contact center operations.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in Excel/Google Sheets, forecasting models, and data visualization tools.
* In\-depth understanding of contact center dynamics, staffing requirements, shrinkage, occupancy, and workforce KPIs.
* Strong knowledge of Erlang C models and their application in workforce planning.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional leadership skills.



**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)** 



* Experience with SQL, Python, or advanced reporting frameworks for automated workforce analytics.
* Experience developing automated dashboards and workforce reporting solutions.
* Certifications in Workforce Management, Project Management, or related fields, such as:
* PMP (Project Management Professional)
* COPC certification or relevant COPC experience
* Workforce Management certifications
* Experience in large\-scale contact center operations or multi\-team workforce planning.
* Exposure to advanced forecasting, scenario modeling, and workforce optimization techniques.



**Personal Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage operational escalations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in forecasting and reporting.
* Proactive approach to identifying staffing risks and operational challenges.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and leadership.
* Strong decision\-making skills with a data\-driven mindset.
* Adaptability to changing business requirements and operational priorities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.



**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to lead workforce planning and capacity optimization initiatives.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Drive operational efficiency through data\-driven decision\-making.
* Exposure to advanced workforce management tools, analytics, and automation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and service delivery excellence.



**Apply Now** 




 If you are an experienced Workforce Management professional with strong forecasting, scheduling, and capacity planning expertise, we invite you to apply for the Capacity Planner role in Hyderabad and become part of our growing team.

title: Associate, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a
 **Senior Associate, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will support the execution of U.S. pharmaceutical Membership operations by managing customer eligibility, GPO alignments, membership validations, customer setup, contract alignment, and membership maintenance activities. You will serve as a critical link between Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, MDM, Government Pricing, wholesalers, GPOs, and customers to ensure accurate customer eligibility and contract execution across the Amgen commercial contracting landscape. The role supports the end\-to\-end Membership process from receipt of customer requests through validation, setup, system alignment, and ongoing maintenance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations \& Customer Eligibility*
* Support the end\-to\-end membership process including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, membership maintenance, GPO alignments, and customer relationship updates.
* Review and triage incoming membership requests received through the Membership mailbox from GPOs, wholesalers, Key Account Managers (KAMs), Contracting teams, and other stakeholders.
* Validate customer information submitted through Declaration (DEC) Forms, rosters, and customer requests to ensure completeness and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Determine customer eligibility based on contract terms, class of trade (COT), GPO participation, and business\-specific membership requirements.
* Support execution against established service level agreements (SLAs) and communicate status updates or delays to stakeholders as needed.


*Customer Validation \& Membership Maintenance*
* Perform customer validation activities utilizing HIN, DEA, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, HCM, GCPS, and other approved reference sources.
* Review Declaration (DEC) Forms for accuracy, completeness, valid signatures, proper customer identifiers, and current forms before processing.
* Validate parent\-child relationships, legal entity hierarchies (LEH), customer attributes, and customer master data prior to customer setup.
* Maintain membership records, customer alignments, contract affiliations, and GPO relationships within approved systems.
* Support customer adds, drops, strategy realignments, and membership updates resulting from acquisitions, organizational changes, roster updates, and contract transitions.


*Customer Setup \& Systems Management*
* Create and maintain customer records within HCM, GCPS, SAP, and related systems supporting commercial contract operations.
* Support customer onboarding activities including customer setup, LEH creation, customer attribute maintenance, and contract alignment.
* Coordinate with MDM teams to support customer record creation, updates, master data corrections, and hierarchy management.
* Monitor and validate system interfaces between HCM, SAP, GCPS, and related applications to ensure successful data synchronization.
* Investigate and resolve customer setup, interface, and data integrity issues impacting contract eligibility and pricing access.


*Membership Reporting \& Eligibility Management*
* Develop, validate, and distribute eligibility reports supporting GPOs, wholesalers, Market Access teams, and other stakeholders.
* Perform ongoing review of dispute reports and customer listings to identify missing, misaligned, or new customers requiring setup or updates.
* Support customer eligibility validations related to contract participation, GPO membership, specialty pharmacy programs, hospital coalitions, and other business\-specific arrangements
* Analyze membership trends, customer changes, roster updates, and operational metrics to support business decisions and improve data quality.


*Rebuttals, Dispute Resolution \& Stakeholder Support*
* Investigate customer eligibility disputes and support rebuttal activities with GPOs and external stakeholders.
* Review denial requests, perform customer eligibility research, prepare supporting rationale, and maintain appropriate documentation of decisions.
* Collaborate with Membership leadership, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, Government Pricing, and external customers to resolve membership\-related inquiries and issues.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails supporting membership decisions, customer alignments, and eligibility determinations.


*PHS, 340B \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Support quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility updates, customer validation activities, and contract maintenance processes.
* Review OPA extracts and support additions, removals, and maintenance of 340B eligibility indicators and customer attributes
* Support hospital coalition pricing reviews, validation of coalition participation, and eligibility assessments.
* Assist with specialty pharmacy, Kaiser, IBU, OBU, Tezspire, and other membership program\-specific processes and customer validations.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations


*Compliance, Controls \& Continuous Improvement*
* Execute work in accordance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and pharmaceutical contracting expectations.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer setup, eligibility reviews, approvals, and membership updates.
* Support audit requests, control testing, operational reviews, and compliance activities.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, reduce cycle times, and enhance customer setup efficiency.
* Participate in UAT, system enhancements, reporting improvements, and process optimization initiatives.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail\-oriented commercial operations professional with experience supporting customer master data, membership operations, customer eligibility, contract administration, pricing operations, or related pharmaceutical business processes. This individual should bring strong analytical skills, customer focus, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to ensure accurate and compliant membership execution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, membership operations, contracts \& pricing, customer master data, managed markets, market access, revenue management, or related business functions
* Experience supporting customer validation, contract administration, data management, reporting, or operational processes.
* Strong Excel, analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience.
* Knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, membership operations, GPO contracting, market access, and reimbursement processes.
* Experience with HCM, GCPS, SAP, Tableau, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA, Model N, or similar commercial operations platforms.
* Understanding of customer master data management, legal entity hierarchies, parent\-child relationships, class of trade management, and contract eligibility processes.
* Experience supporting customer onboarding, data governance, compliance controls, and audit activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with U.S.\-based stakeholders in a global operating model.

description:
Become part of Barclays as AVP \- Loans COE where purpose of the role is perform Analytical review of securities, fees and investment income for investment banking business. This includes understanding the nature of each business, explaining the movements in Balance sheet/P\&L, identifying the control gaps. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating.
   

  

**To Be Successful, In This Role You Should Have**
* Product control experience in Investment bank.
* In\-depth knowledge of Financial product and markets of the relevant governance control.
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end processes of an IB (Investment Banking) and associated controls.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings and the ability to interact.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* CFA / Masters in Finance / Financial Engineering.
* Good control awareness and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently with a spectrum of people from junior finance staff to front office business heads.
* Mature and able to negotiate through difficult situations.
* Good influencing and negotiation skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Pune/Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P\&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P\&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

* Familiarization with the process of project control procedures
* Understanding Contract vis\-à\-vis project scope of work
* Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.
* Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.
* Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.
* Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.
* Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.
* Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status
* Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.
* Set\-up, monitor \& report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads
* Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.
* Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.
* Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.
* Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects
* Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.
* Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.
* Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.
* Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes
* Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.
* Develop change management and maintaining change log.
* Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.
* Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.
* Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program
* Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.
* Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.
* Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.
* Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.
* Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines
* Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.
* Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation.  At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

 Delhi
 



  





**Experience** 




 Minimum 7 years of experience in Investment Research, Equity Research, Venture Capital, Private Equity, Family Office, Investment Banking, Asset Management, PMS, AIFs, or Corporate Investments.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Investment Analyst will support investment decision\-making across the Group's Family Office and AIF/ PMS portfolios through comprehensive financial and business analysis. The role involves evaluating investment opportunities, conducting market research, building financial models, monitoring portfolio performance, and preparing investment recommendations for management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Investment Evaluation \& Research:** 




 o Evaluate investment opportunities across listed equities, mutual funds, PMS, AIFs, private companies, startups, venture capital, private equity, and alternative investments.
 



 o Conduct investment research, sector analysis, competitive benchmarking, and market screening to identify attractive investment opportunities.
 



 o Analyze business models, revenue drivers, unit economics, competitive positioning, scalability, and growth prospects.
 



  





**Portfolio Monitoring \& Management:** 




 o Monitor listed equity portfolios, including quarterly results, corporate actions, earnings calls, management commentary, and sector developments.
 



 o Track portfolio performance, investment returns, risk metrics, and valuation movements.
 



 o Maintain investment MIS, databases, watchlists, and portfolio dashboards.

 o Build, maintain, and validate financial and valuation models (DCF, Comparable Companies, Trading Multiples, Precedent Transactions).
 



 o Conduct return analysis, scenario analysis, and sensitivity assessments.
 



 o Review financial statements, profitability metrics, cash flows, working capital, and key financial ratios.
 



  





**Due Diligence \& Risk Assessment:** 




 o Support financial, legal, tax, commercial, and operational due diligence processes.
 



 o Identify investment risks and evaluate mitigation strategies.
 



 o Assist in investment execution, transaction documentation, governance, compliance, and post\-investment monitoring.
 



  





**Reporting \& Communication:** 




 o Prepare investment notes, Investment Committee (IC) memos, presentations, portfolio review reports, and management updates.

 ➢ Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.

 ➢ Quantitative analysis, scenario modelling, and return evaluation skills.
 



 ➢ Strong communication, presentation, and report\-writing abilities.
 



 ➢ Strong ownership mindset, integrity, and confidentiality.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 ➢ MBA (Finance), CA, and/or CFA preferred.
 



 ➢ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Commerce or Business Administration.
 



 ➢ Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 ➢ Exposure to financial databases, research platforms, \& data visualization/BI tools is an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 ➢ Strong foundation in investments with experience evaluating listed and unlisted companies.
 



 ➢ Familiarity with Family Office, PMS, AIF, Venture Capital, and Private Equity investment frameworks.
 



 ➢ Ability to independently assess valuation, returns, and investment risks.

title: Senior Manager, Finance
description:
**Role Summary**
 IORA Ecological Solutions is seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant with a minimum of 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience to lead and strengthen the organisation’s finance and accounting function. The Senior Manager, Finance will provide leadership across financial management, accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, budgeting, financial reporting, project finance, internal controls, systems and financial planning. The role will work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and will be an important finance partner in supporting IORA’s organisational growth and project portfolio.
   

  

 The position combines strong technical finance and accounting responsibilities with systems strengthening, process improvement and an important external\-facing role. The Senior Manager, Finance will serve as the primary finance interface with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders, and will be expected to represent IORA with credibility and professionalism.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Accounting
* Lead end\-to\-end accounting operations and ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closure.
* Review financial statements, ledgers, bank reconciliations and statutory records to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking transactions, advances and other routine financial operations.
* Ensure effective cash management and timely availability of funds for organisational and project requirements.
* Provide financial oversight across IORA’s projects and programmes.
* Statutory Compliance, Taxation \& Audit
* Oversee TDS, GST, Income Tax and other applicable statutory compliances, filings and reconciliations.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, tax, donor and other audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable financial and tax regulations and advise management on their implications.
* Ensure robust financial documentation, audit trails and compliance with applicable requirements.
* Financial Planning, Budgeting \& MIS
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting and cash\-flow planning.
* Prepare and review monthly MIS, budget\-versus\-actual analysis, variance analysis and management reports.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decision\-making.
* Work with programme and project teams to prepare project budgets, monitor expenditure and manage financial performance.
* Support financial modelling and analysis for new projects, partnerships and funding opportunities.
* Internal Controls, Systems \& Process Improvement
* Strengthen IORA’s internal financial controls, SOPs, approval workflows and financial governance systems.
* Oversee accounting records in Tally/ERP and play a key role in the development and implementation of IORA’s new ERP and finance systems.
* Drive process improvements, automation and standardisation across finance operations.
* Ensure proper financial documentation and controls for procurement, payments, expenses, advances and project accounting.
* Identify financial risks and strengthen systems for risk mitigation and compliance.
* Project, Donor \& Grant Finance
* Provide financial oversight for externally funded projects, grants and partnerships, including budgeting, fund utilisation, financial reporting and compliance.
* Ensure compliance with donor\-specific financial requirements, contractual obligations and reporting timelines.
* Work closely with project teams and external partners to resolve financial issues and ensure effective financial management.
* Support preparation of financial components of project proposals, budgets, funding applications and partnership agreements.
* External Donor \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all finance\-related matters with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders.
* Lead financial discussions with donors and partners on budgets, fund utilisation, financial reporting, audits, forecasts, amendments and financial queries.
* Prepare and deliver clear, compelling and decision\-oriented financial presentations and reports for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Represent IORA in finance\-related discussions with donors, funders, auditors, financial institutions and partners.
* Support senior management in engagement with prospective funders and partners, including financial due diligence, financial modelling, proposals and negotiations.
* Serve as a strong external face of IORA on financial matters, building confidence in IORA’s financial systems, controls and stewardship of funds.
* Team Leadership \& Organisational Support
* Lead, mentor and develop the finance team and promote a culture of accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted finance partner to the CEO, senior management and project leads.
* Build financial management capacity across non\-finance teams.
* Work closely with internal teams and external consultants on finance\-related matters.


**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is essential.
* Minimum 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in finance and accounts, with experience in a role involving ownership of core finance functions.
* Strong experience in financial management, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, financial reporting, audit management and internal controls.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or mentoring finance teams and working directly with senior management.
* Experience in managing donor\-funded projects, grants or partnerships, particularly with international donors or development agencies, is highly desirable.
* Experience in a consulting firm, professional services organisation, research organisation, NGO/development organisation or sustainability\-focused organisation is preferred.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong working knowledge of accounting, TDS, GST, Income Tax, statutory compliance and audit requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in budgeting, financial forecasting, cash\-flow management, MIS, variance analysis and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable management insights.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, including the ability to develop clear, compelling financial presentations for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and advanced formulas; Power Query is a plus.
* Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems or other accounting software, with an interest in process automation and digital finance systems.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


**What The Role Offers**
* A leadership role with direct exposure to the CEO and senior management and the opportunity to shape IORA’s finance function as the organisation grows.
* An opportunity to contribute beyond accounting and compliance, including financial planning, project and donor finance, financial analysis, systems strengthening and organisational decision\-making.
* Significant external exposure to international donors, funding agencies, development partners, auditors and other stakeholders.
* Exposure to diverse projects and partnerships spanning climate action, nature conservation, sustainable livelihoods, carbon markets and innovative finance.
* An opportunity to build robust, scalable finance systems and processes in a dynamic, mission\-driven organisation.


**Application Process**
 To apply, please submit your resume and a one\-page letter to careers@ioraecological.com stating your understanding of IORA, why you are interested in joining IORA, and where you see yourself after five years in collaboration with IORA.
   

  

 Subject Line: Application for Senior Manager, Finance
   

  

 To know more about IORA, please visit: https://ioraecological.com

 **Investment Operations professional**

 This is a critical financial\-control role responsible for ensuring that investor transactions are
 **executed accurately, accounted for correctly, reconciled completely and supported by proper documentation**

* Manage
 **Bank, AMC/RTA, AUM and Commission/Brokerage reconciliations** 
 .
* Identify, investigate and resolve mismatches and discrepancies.
* Maintain daily transaction control and ensure all exceptions are appropriately tracked and closed.
* Coordinate with Accounts for payment, receipt, revenue and ledger reconciliation.



**Team \& Operational Controls**

* Maintain transaction records, audit trails and supporting documentation.
* Ensure operational processes meet applicable KYC, documentation, audit and compliance requirements.



**Exception \& Risk Management** 



* Maintain an exception and pending transaction register.
* Investigate root causes of operational discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
* Identify potential operational risks and escalate critical issues appropriately.
* Ensure investor\-facing records are supported by accurate and reconciled source data.



**Technology \& Process Improvement** 



* Strengthen operational controls through Excel, CRM and transaction\-management systems.
* Develop MIS, dashboards and exception reports.
* Identify opportunities for automation and reduction of manual processes.
* Contribute to SOP development and continuous improvement of investment operations.


 What We’re Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **highly analytical, detail\-oriented and comfortable working with numbers, systems and financial data** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should:
 


* Have strong reconciliation and accounting\-control skills.
* Be meticulous about transaction accuracy and documentation.
* Be comfortable investigating discrepancies and identifying root causes.
* Have a structured approach to problem\-solving and exception management.
* Be capable of supervising a team while maintaining strong individual ownership.
* Be comfortable working in a deadline\-driven investment operations environment.

 in mutual fund operations, wealth management, AMC/RTA operations, brokerage, banking or investment\-platform operations.

 **CAMS, KFintech, NSE NMF, BSE StAR MF, AMC portals or similar platforms**

 **Advanced Excel** 
 and reconciliation/MIS reporting.

* AMC/RTA Reconciliation

1. Investment/mutual fund transaction platforms handled

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.

* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.

title: Senior Analyst/Lead Analyst/Principal Analyst – Private Credit (Asset Management)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates to join the Asset Management function within our Private Credit team in the Financial Research group, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Gurugram. The Private Credit team underwrites investment opportunities across public and private corporate credit, commercial real estate, loan portfolios, and special situations in Europe and North America. The Asset Management function sits within this team, monitoring investment performance and dealing cash flows, and managing key commercial aspects of the portfolio including exit strategies, servicer effectiveness, and pricing.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you will oversee deal onboarding into proprietary platforms and develop comprehensive end\-to\-end reporting frameworks. You will review borrower business models, cash flow forecasts, debt capacity, and collateral, and perform detailed financial modeling, including ROI, IRR, and discounted cash flow analysis to support portfolio oversight and investment decisions. The role involves regular engagement with borrowers, lenders, and other stakeholders across calls and meetings. You will develop cash management strategies for future funding needs, oversee capital allocation and funding processes, and monitor company developments, competitor actions, and industry trends to inform strategic decisions. You will track covenant compliance, monitor portfolio investments, and contribute to the development of asset exit strategies. A critical function of this role is to identify and escalate early signs of asset distress or underperformance and lead restructuring, amendment, or workout processes for distressed assets. You will also support valuations, portfolio reviews, and business plan deviation analysis on monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles.
   

  

 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* An MBA or equivalent in Finance, with 2 to 13 years of experience in corporate credit analysis and asset management, with a robust grounding in financial concepts and advanced quantitative modeling capabilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with trading desks and stakeholders
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with keen attention to detail
* Proven experience leading complex projects


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with structured finance asset classes


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/SLAnlPCAMFinresMay2026

* Perform database and literature searches to provide a situational review and analysis, in the form of comprehensive and structured reports, on the available evidence related to various health economics and outcomes aspects, such as clinical data, epidemiology, burden of disease, treatment patterns, unmet needs, etc.

* Support the development of Global Value Dossiers (GVDs), Reimbursement Dossiers, and Manuscripts, ensuring high\-quality content that aligns with payer and publication standards
* Support in the development of impactful slide decks to effectively translate complex health economic evidence into clear, visually compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders
* Manage your own workload to ensure delivery according to agreed milestones and timelines
* Support project leads in day\-to\-day project activities, ensuring assigned tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Collaborate closely with project team members, contributing to discussions and sharing ideas.
* Provide guidance and quality oversight to Analysts and Junior Associates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-building initiatives, training, and process improvement activities.


**Essential Requirements:**
* Postgraduate degree (M.pharm or equivalent) or PhD with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in scientific discipline including HEOR, epidemiology, or market access
* Good oral/written communication skills along with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of office applications, e.g. MS Word/ PowerPoint/ Excel/EndNote


**Desired Requirements:**
* Hands\-on experience in Literature Review Reports, Value Dossiers and Manuscript writing

title: Finance Cost Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as a Finance Cost Analyst, where to provide financial expertise and support to various departments and business units within the organisation by the gathering, analysis and interpretation of financial data to inform investment decisions, assess financial risks, and support strategic planning.
   

  

**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**
* Deliver end\-to\-end Finance reporting that enables management to proactively shape strategy.
* Support full set of forward looking Financial projections (MTP), Outlook,
* Transfers, scenario analytics \& Change the Bank (CTB) portfolio analytics.
* Management of Profit Centres hierarchy and submission of Billing rules.
* Close monitoring of monthly financials at various levels and variance analysis with drafting commentaries for reviews with Senior FBPs and stakeholders.
* Supporting cost allocation understanding and risks \& opportunities management.
* Providing the analysis to support business decisions and financial strategy for the Transaction Cycle/Function, ensuring delivery is to plan and budget, supporting the bank’s overall business strategy and cost base objectives.
* Work with FBPs, BMs, PMs and Business to deliver the monthly financials.
* Working directly with the Cost Ledger CoE \& Project CoE to understand the GL postings each month and to ensure the month end is done in a timely manner.
* Work with the Centres of Excellence to ensure full alignment to BX operating model.
* Provide the analysis and support the drafting of insights \& commentary of current \& Outlook financials (including Capacity Creation) with clear linkages to drivers (Inc. weekly, Finance surgeries \& QBR).
* Provide extensive support in managing the Monthly and Quarterly Business reviews including MI preparation and walkthrough.
* Provide analysis and insights including WF, Cost, fully loaded services costs and managed.
* Prepare any reporting requirements.
* Support the creation of the annual plan and be responsible for making updates during the regular RAF cycles including.
* Support in updating the central planning tool during the annual plan and updates to RAF.
* High quality, consistent and standardised offering with complete ownership of the numbers.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**
* Month End Management.
* Variance Analysis.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Financial reporting – Managed and Consumed.
* Planning \& Outlook.
* Identification and quantification of risks \& opportunities.
* Flash financials/commentaries submission.
* Business Rules set up and changes.
* Projects financials reporting and management.
* Queries management\-Audit, FC \& others.
* Coordination with various CoEs.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Gurugram/Noida office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide financial expertise and support to specific business units or departments within the organisation, and act as a liaison between the finance function and various business units, helping to bridge the gap between financial data and business decisions.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of business unit financial strategies, plans and budgets, using insights to evaluate the financial implications of strategic initiatives and recommend appropriate actions.
* Development of financial models to forecast future performance, assess investment opportunities, and evaluate financial risks for business units, and to analyse the impact of business decisions on financial performance and provision of recommendations. .
* Cross functional collaboration to provide financial insights and guidance to business unit stakeholders.
* Identification of opportunities and implementation of financial process improvements that streamline financial operations.
* Support to business units in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, including provision of training and guidance to business units on financial risk management and compliance practices.
* Analysis and presentation of financial data to provide insights into business performance, identify trends, and support decision\-making.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right.
