* Own the standard costing process, manufacturing variances, and conversion cost optimization
* Evaluate make vs. buy decisions, co\-packing arrangements, and capacity investment proposals


**Innovation \& Portfolio Management**
* Provide financial leadership on New Product Development (NPD) — from business case creation to post\-launch evaluation
* Assess portfolio health through SKU rationalization, margin analysis, and contribution mapping
* Build robust financial models for brand extensions, premiumization strategies, and adjacency plays


**Marketing \& Brand Investment**
* Partner with Marketing to evaluate A\&P (Advertising \& Promotion) spend effectiveness and ROI
* Ensure optimal allocation of brand investment across sub\-brands, campaigns, and media channels
* Track and report on brand P\&L performance with actionable insights


**Financial Planning, Reporting \& Controls**
* Lead the Monthly Business Review (MBR) process with variance analysis, risk/opportunity identification, and rolling forecasts
* Ensure robust internal controls, compliance, and governance across all financial processes
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting quality, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Influence and challenge business decisions with a "Finance with a Point of View" mindset
* Represent Finance in S\&OP / IBP (Integrated Business Planning) meetings
* Mentor and develop junior finance team members embedded in the category


**Career Experience \& Qualifications**

* Strong experience in Category Finance is highly preferred. We are also open to candidates with diversified Business Finance experience, demonstrated through multiple stints across areas such as Commercial Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FP\&A, Marketing Finance or other business partnering roles, bringing a well\-rounded understanding of the end\-to\-end P\&L and value chain.
* Proven track record of business partnering at a category or BU level — not limited to reporting or controllership
* Deep understanding of end\-to\-end value chain economics — from raw material to shelf
* Experience in Chocolate, Confectionery, or Snacking categories is strongly preferred


 Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

 Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth\-watering and well\-loved local and global brands such as

 chocolates,

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
IMC is looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop trading signals and predictive models for our Options business. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with large datasets, and building models that drive trading performance, this role could be a great fit.
   

  

 You will focus on researching and developing statistically robust signals and models to better understand and predict options market behaviour. Your work will directly inform trading strategies and have a measurable impact on performance. You will also help shape the research direction by exploring new approaches and improving existing methodologies.
   

  

 IMC has strong advantages across market access, technology, and execution, and you will work in a collaborative environment alongside traders and engineers to translate research into production.
   

  

 Your Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and test alpha signals and predictive models for Indian options markets
* Perform large\-scale data analysis to uncover patterns and trading opportunities
* Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure robustness and reliability of results
* Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
* Collaborate with traders and engineers to translate research into production strategies
* Continuously improve models and identify new areas of research


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in quantitative research in NSE/BSE, ideally within derivatives or options
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
* Proven track record of developing impactful trading signals or models
* Experience working with large datasets and time\-series data
* Strong programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
* Curious, analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and innovation


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.


**Work Timings: 04:00 PM – 01:00 AM IST**
 (WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Cost Manager
description:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  





 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  





 Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  





 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Role Overview
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cost Manager** 
 to lead cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control activities across projects and business operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project cost management, commercial controls, financial analysis, and stakeholder management, with proven experience in delivering projects within budget while maximizing value and minimizing risks.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Cost Planning \& Budget Management
   

  




* Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, and financial forecasts.
* Establish cost control procedures, standards, and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses and recommend cost optimization strategies.



 Cost Control \& Reporting
   

  




* Track actual costs against budget and forecast variances.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, and performance metrics for senior management.
* Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities impacting project costs.
* Ensure timely identification and escalation of cost overruns and mitigation measures.



 Contract \& Commercial Management
   

  




* Review contracts, change orders, claims, and commercial implications.
* Evaluate contractor invoices, variations, and payment applications.
* Support procurement and vendor negotiations from a cost management perspective.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and financial obligations.



 Forecasting \& Risk Management
   

  




* Lead monthly forecasting and cash flow projections.
* Identify financial risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support project teams in scenario analysis and decision\-making processes.
* Maintain contingency planning and risk adjustment mechanisms.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Partner with project managers, finance teams, procurement teams, and external stakeholders.
* Present cost performance updates to leadership and clients.
* Provide commercial guidance throughout project lifecycle phases.



 Process Improvement
   

  




* Drive continuous improvements in cost management methodologies and systems.
* Implement best practices, automation tools, and reporting efficiencies.
* Mentor and guide junior cost engineers/analysts.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 10–15 years of experience in Cost Management, Project Controls, Commercial Management, or related functions.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial reporting.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale projects and complex budgets.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and project management tools.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/
   

  





  

  





 Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner \& Townsend and our exciting future projects:

title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant* 
***post MBA***
*experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands\-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high\-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem\-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Senior Associate will own high\-impact workstreams for Energy\-sector clients, combining deep sub\-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O\&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub\-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client\-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time\-sensitive engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
* Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem\-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value\-creation opportunities.
* Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
* Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
* Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy\-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
* Adapt across adjacent Energy sub\-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub\-sector, such as O\&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
* Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
* Advanced problem\-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
* Exposure to multiple Energy sub\-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
* Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
* A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
* Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub\-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O\&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
* A record of owning analytical and problem\-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
* The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
* A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast\-paced, high\-expectation environments.
* Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands\-on delivery.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on consequential Energy\-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
* Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub\-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
* Join a performance\-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
* Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy\-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.



  





**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to work on high\-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
* A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross\-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
* A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

 SK Finance Limited is a Middle Layer NBFC with over three decades of experience in vehicle finance and small business lending, primarily serving rural and semi\-urban customers across North, West, and Central India. * Knowledge of local markets and customer segments in North India will be beneficial.

description:

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst in BCG X Product Delivery, you will support the delivery of projects and digital solutions for clients across the oil \& gas, refining, chemicals, and broader energy value chain. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, operations, and technology, helping clients translate complex operational challenges into practical, high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 You will help structure client problems, identify value pools, define improvement opportunities, and support the design of use cases across areas such as refining performance, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, emissions reduction, turnaround management, maintenance, reliability, and operational excellence.
   

  

 You will work closely with BCG case teams, BCG X product and technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure that Ekons solutions are grounded in real business needs. You will support client interviews, workshops, diagnostics, value sizing, business case development, roadmap definition, and change management activities.
   

  

 You will also help translate strategic and operational priorities into clear solution requirements, ensuring that digital tools are not developed in isolation but are directly linked to measurable business outcomes. Over time, you will contribute to building reusable assets, industry perspectives, commercial materials, and delivery playbooks for Ekons.
   

  

**You Are Good At**
* Structuring complex and ambiguous oil \& gas business problems into clear hypotheses, value opportunities, workplans, and executive\-ready recommendations.
* Leading client\-facing problem solving across oil \& gas, refining, chemicals, energy, and asset\-intensive operations topics.
* Engaging senior client stakeholders, BCG case teams, and technical teams to align priorities, decisions, trade\-offs, and next steps.
* Translating operational challenges into digital solution requirements, ensuring use cases are linked to tangible business value.
* Identifying and sizing value pools across areas such as margin optimization, planning and scheduling, maintenance, reliability, emissions, operational excellence, and performance management.
* Synthesizing complex analyses, interviews, workshops, and technical inputs into clear storylines, decision materials, and implementation roadmaps.
* Coaching junior team members and coordinating multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality work in fast\-paced client environments.


 \#BCGXjob
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 7–9 years of relevant experience in consulting, oil \& gas, energy, refining, chemicals, industrial goods, operations, digital transformation, or performance improvement required; candidates with top\-tier strategy consulting experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing workstreams, managing senior stakeholders, developing executive\-ready materials, and translating complex business problems into actionable recommendations.
* Strong energy sector experience, ideally across areas such as refining economics, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, maintenance, reliability, emissions, operational excellence, or asset performance.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in engineering, business, economics, energy, operations, or related field preferred.
* Strong business acumen, analytical rigor, communication skills, and leadership maturity, with the ability to connect industry expertise, digital solutions, and measurable business impact.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Client, Case, \& Knowledge team members
* Product Engineering, Product Management, and Infrastructure Support team

title: National Billing Administrator - Associate 2
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration.  As a National Billing Administrator \- Associate 2, you will play a crucial role in managing financial records, analyzing data, and assisting in compliance with accounting standards. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will focus on providing accurate financial information and insights to support decision\-making. As an Associate, you will be driven by curiosity and contribute to projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will engage with different stakeholders, learn how to build meaningful connections, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will handle financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and risk management. You will be expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting unique challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow, taking ownership and consistently delivering work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. Embrace the chance to build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities within the firm.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Managing financial records and conducting data analysis to support compliance with accounting standards
* Client Service
* Maintain and build internal and external client relationships by providing exceptional client service
* Commit to proactively connecting and building rapport with both internal and external clients
* Assist with resolving complex client issues and suggest favourable solutions


**Invoicing**
* Maintain client codes in the firm’s proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/or manager .
* Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required


 Confirm invoicing arrangements with the client representative prior to issuing the first invoice to ensure high accuracy
   

  

* Monitor WIPs, review engagement letters to determine fees to be charged, and liaise with practice managers to capture out of pocket expenses
* Draft, finalize, and issue invoices to clients on a timely basis to support achievement of partners’ monthly billing targets
* Reconcile and relieve related time and expense charges in the firm’s proprietary accounting software
* Liaise with practice managers to ensure internal revenue allocations are agreed in advance and billed as part of the progress billing cycle where applicable
* Respond to client queries regarding invoices, including preparation of analyses and preparation of amended invoices when required (as directed by the partner/manager)
* Prepare, finalize and issue credit notes
* Prepare bad debt request forms or cash transfer request forms with partner approval
* Update and manage billing schedules


**WIP Management**
* Prepare monthly detailed analysis of WIP (as required by the partner/manager) to ensure the WIP value reflects what is expected to be recovered in fees from the client. Prepare month\-end WIP provisions for review with partner/manager to properly value WIP
* Monitor the partner’s overall financial investment, including WIP, A/R and cash collection actuals to target and develop action items to achieve these
* Track fees against budget to confirm proper WIP valuation
* Generate reports using the firm’s proprietary accounting software to help monitor a partner’s engagement economics Advise on unusual WIP activities or budget rates that fall outside of the normal thresholds
* Update and maintain billing schedules
* Respond to queries in relation to engagement financial performance
* Prepare and maintain Year\-to\-Date fee summaries as required


**Accounts Receivables**
* Monitor partners’ monthly cash collection target and actual cash to support achievement of target
* Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
* Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner
* Pull monthly aged A/R reports and review with partner to determine actions required for aging accounts
* Work with your manager to escalate outstanding collections with Third Party Collections, as directed by partner
* Maintain A/R notes against the bill record to describe any follow up activities performed
* Review the Electronic Funds Transfer database and post dated cheques log regularly, and action tickets as required
* Assisting in the preparation and presentation of financial reports to provide insights for decision\-making
* Engaging in financial budgeting and forecasting to optimize financial performance
* Supporting risk management initiatives by analyzing financial transactions and identifying potential issues
* Collaborating with team members to gather and analyze information from various sources
* Applying accounting and financial reporting standards to maintain accuracy in financial documentation
* Utilizing financial statement analysis to discern patterns and inform strategic guidance
* Participating in stakeholder management to address diverse perspectives and needs
* Contributing to the development of financial policies and procedures to enhance operational efficiency
* Adapting to a fast\-paced environment and taking ownership of tasks to deliver quality work
* Building a personal brand by consistently delivering value and opening doors to new opportunities


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
* At least 1 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for a Bachelor's degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting \& Finance, Accounting \& Technology, Management Information Systems
* At least one of the following: Certified Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
* Demonstrating proficiency in Accounting and Financial Reporting Standards
* Utilizing skills in Financial Statement Analysis and Preparation
* Applying knowledge of Financial Budgeting and Forecasting
* Engaging in Account Reconciliation and Financial Transactions
* Excelling in Presenting Financial Reports and Stakeholder Management


 Shift Time : 6:30pm\-3:30am IST

title: Manager - Strategic Buyer (L09)
description:
**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.

 As a Manager within the Actuarial AXIS modelling team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary with at least 8\+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, IFRS17 or LDTI)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)

 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements. 
 D. Prevention & Analytics: Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS). Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload. 
 Required Qualifications: Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred. Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes.

As a Purchase Professional, you will exhibit a strong work ethic and demonstrate exceptional proficiency in ensuring detailed and efficient procurement processes, enabling us to challenge in the global market. 
 In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Research and identify suitable suppliers to meet the part specification needs. Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, and delivery reliability. Compare quotes from multiple suppliers to ensure pricing and negotiate at each stage like Item activation and project base order before fixing the sourcing rule. Ensuring all invoices are sent to accounts for payment process after good receipt. Resolve issues such as delays, defective products, or incorrect shipments. Maintenance of purchase records and vendor performance records/data. Ensure accuracy and timely Attribute study and setting in Oracle system. Effective co-ordination with Global Supply Chain (GSC) team across the world and align to their vendor management policies and consistent vendor performance. Align materials as per Oracle Demand date, synchronized receipt of materials & in turn support in meeting customer delivery dates. To review and set purchase policies on requirements of material from time to time and develop and maintain good buyer-seller (Vendor) relationship. Loading the foundry based on the RCCP tonnage allocated to each foundry as per GSC Guidelines. Analysis on Loading pattern based on Supplier performance of each vendor and surge loading of vendor based upon the project order flow in previous month. Submitting all transporter bills on time to Payable team and Tracking all transport payment, the NSDJ progress which is created to stock transfer of D-excess parts. Maintaining all Purchase metrics data - OTD, PPM and spent analysis report. Identifying the D-excess parts and allocating them to the current demand with approval from QC. Review and clearance of Vendor invoices for on time payment processing.

title: Risk Officer
description:
Risk Officer 
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Risk Officer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks that could potentially impact the organization. This role requires a deep understanding of risk management principles, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. The Risk Officer will work closely with different departments to ensure that risk management strategies are integrated into all aspects of the organizations operations. Key responsibilities include developing risk management policies, conducting risk assessments, and implementing risk mitigation strategies. The successful candidate will also be responsible for monitoring and reporting on risk exposure, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and providing training and support to staff on risk management practices. This is a critical role that requires a proactive approach to risk management and the ability to think strategically about potential risks and their impact on the organization.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and implement risk management policies and procedures. Conduct regular risk assessments and identify potential risks. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies. Monitor and report on risk exposure. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Provide training and support to staff on risk management practices. Work closely with different departments to integrate risk management strategies. Prepare risk management reports for senior management. Conduct internal audits to ensure compliance with risk management policies. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in risk management. Collaborate with external auditors and regulatory bodies. Develop and maintain a risk register. Analyze risk data and provide insights to senior management. Develop contingency plans for potential risks. Review and update risk management policies regularly. Ensure that risk management practices are aligned with organizational goals. Communicate risk management strategies to stakeholders. Identify and assess emerging risks. Develop and implement risk awareness programs. Support the development of a risk-aware culture within the organization. Attend and make presentation before Roak Management Committee 
 Requirements 
 Bachelors degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certification in risk management (e.g., CRM, FRM) is preferred. Minimum of 6 - 10 years of experience in risk management or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Proficiency in risk management software and tools. Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards. Experience in conducting risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies. Ability to think strategically and proactively about potential risks. Strong project management skills. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Experience in developing and delivering training programs. Strong report writing and presentation skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Strong negotiation and influencing skills. Ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders. Knowledge of financial analysis and modeling.

Key Skills: Internal Audit,Operational Risk,Risk Analysis,Risk Compliance,Risk Based Audits,Risk Management,Management,Analysis

title: Executive/Sr.Executive- Accounts & Finance
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 To strengthen plant-level financial governance by driving standardization, accuracy, and control across all manufacturing locations. The role will act as a central anchor between Plant Accountants, Operations, and Corporate Finance, with a key focus on balance sheet integrity, CWIP management, asset capitalization, and provisions , while ensuring disciplined and timely financial closure. 
 1. Inventory & Plant Accounting Controls Oversee inventory accounting from a control and reconciliation perspective : RM, PM, WIP, and Finished Goods balances Review: Inventory reconciliations (book vs physical) Stock adjustments and their justifications Ensure proper accounting of: Stock transfers Job work transactions Flag anomalies without getting into costing determination. 
 2. Month-End Closing & Finalisation Support Anchor plant closure timelines and discipline across locations Ensure: Cut-off procedures are followed All key provisions and adjustments are recorded Review plant Trial Balances and schedules before consolidation Support finalisation of accounts with accurate plant-level inputs Coordinate with auditors for plant-related schedules and queries. 
 3. CWIP Monitoring & Asset Capitalisation Maintain and monitor CWIP register at HO level for all plants Track project-wise CWIP ageing and ensure timely capitalization Validate: Supporting documents Put-to-use criteria before capitalization Ensure accurate classification between capital and revenue expenditure Compute Interest Cost Capitalisation and Deferred Finance Expenses Pass/review capitalization entries and ensure alignment with Ind AS Monitor CWIP ageing and escalate delays in capitalization. 
 4. Provisions & Accrual Management Drive centralized control over provisions and accruals : Expense provisions (utilities, freight, contractors, etc.) GR/IR and unbilled liabilities Ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency in provisioning Monitor reversals, utilization, and ageing of provisions Standardize provision templates and timelines across plants Review Head Office Expenses and Month End Provision Booking. 
 5. Compliance & Internal Controls Strengthen controls around Asset accounting, Provisioning and Plant accounting entries Monitor plant-level compliance GST (ITC, stock transfers, job work) and TDS applicability in plant transactions Ensure audit readiness and closure of audit observations. 
 6. Audit & Assurance Readiness Act as a single point of ownership for audit queries relating to Opex and current balance sheet items. Ensure audit-ready documentation, reconciliations, and schedules with proper backups and explanations for Inventory and Assets. Drive timely closure of audit observations and implement corrective actions. 
 7. Controls, Process Improvement & Discipline Strengthen internal controls over inventory and asset booking, provisioning, and liability recognition. Identify and plug process gaps leading to leakages, delays, or inaccuracies in Inventory and Assets reporting. Drive standardization, automation, and documentation (SOP adherence) across processes handled. Ensure strict adherence to timelines, maker-checker discipline, and review mechanisms. 
 8. Stakeholder Coordination & Behavioural Expectations Work closely with plant teams, HO Project Team, procurement, and other functions to ensure completeness and accuracy of expense and liability capture. Demonstrate high ownership mindset proactively resolve issues rather than escalating incomplete work. Bring analytical thinking and questioning mindset to challenge unusual trends or balances. Ensure clear communication, accountability, and closure orientation in all deliverables. Actively contribute to building a robust, disciplined, and IPO-ready finance function.

title: Finance & Accounts Manager
description:
To lead the financial accounting, reporting, planning, costing, working capital management and financial control functions of the organization. The role will be responsible for providing accurate and timely financial information to management and investors, driving profitability improvement, strengthening financial controls, supporting business decisions and ensuring compliance with applicable taxation, accounting and regulatory requirements. The position will also play a key role in ERP enhancement, process automation, product costing, inventory control, MIS and product/unit-wise profitability analysis. 
 Role & responsibilities A. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting Drive the annual budgeting and financial planning process in coordination with business and functional heads. Support management in strategic financial decisions and business expansion plans. 
 B. Financial Accounting & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely accounting and monthly/quarterly/yearly financial closing. Prepare and review Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and other financial statements. Ensure proper accounting treatment in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies. Prepare and review detailed Balance Sheet schedules and reconciliations. Monitor provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, loans, advances, deposits and other balance sheet items. Ensure timely closure of books and maintain strong financial controls. C. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare comprehensive monthly MIS and management dashboards. Develop and monitor: Product-wise & Unit-wise profitability Working capital Inventory ageing Receivable ageing Provide meaningful financial analysis and recommendations to management. Prepare periodic reports for investors, management and other stakeholders. 
 D. Product Costing & Pricing Analyze raw material, labour, power, overhead, packing, freight and other conversion costs. Support the commercial/sales team in pricing decisions and quotation analysis. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and margin improvement. 
 E. Working Capital Management Effectively manage receivables, inventory and payables. Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements. Prepare cash flow forecasts and funding requirements.
