 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 To support the land acquisition team in screening, analysing, and tracking real estate transactions from lead stage to decision stage, with strong focus on development potential, underwriting accuracy, regulatory diligence, and management\-note preparation.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Evaluate land, redevelopment, JV/JDA, DM, and plotted development opportunities from first cut to management recommendation.
 



 • Prepare detailed area and yield workings covering plot area, deductions, FSI/TDR/premium FSI, ancillary areas, parking, amenities, carpet, built\-up, and saleable area assumptions.
 



 • Build and update financial models covering land cost, deal structure, approval costs, construction cost, revenue, taxes, cash flows, sensitivities, margin, and IRR.
 



 • Review title, sanction, DP, zoning, road width, access, reservation, TOD / IT\-ITES / local regulation applicability, and other diligence inputs with internal and external teams.
 



 • Prepare Go / No\-Go notes, transaction snapshots, risk registers, assumption trackers, meeting notes, and board / management discussion material.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales, Design, Liaison, Legal, Finance, Records, consultants, brokers, and landowners to close data gaps and move transactions forward.
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 • Background in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Planning, Commerce, Finance, Real Estate, or Management; MBA / PGDM / Masters preferred but not mandatory.
 



 • Strong comfort with Excel, financial modelling, area statements, document structuring, and transaction analysis in residential / commercial / redevelopment projects.
 



 • Ability to spot data gaps, challenge weak assumptions, maintain version discipline, and work accurately under fast deal timelines.
 



 • Clear written communication, structured thinking, and confidence in converting scattered inputs into clean, decision\-ready outputs.
 



  





**TOOLS / SUCCESS MEASURES** 




 • Strong Excel and PowerPoint are mandatory; working familiarity with Google Earth / GIS, AutoCAD / drawings, and document trackers is desirable.
 



 • Success will be measured by quality of underwriting.

title: Finance Lead - Evora Service Partner
description:
**Who We Are**
 Evora is an international system integrator with focus on mobile and user experience (UX). We are a trusted partner for innovative digital maintenance and service solutions for global and regional customers in Europe, North America, Asia \& Pacific. As SAP Gold Partner, Service Now Specialist and Click partner (by Salesforce), we offer consulting services, software development, quality assurance services and system integration based on standard components and products, as well as support \& application management. By implementing best\-practice solutions while optimizing their processes, we help our customers to be successful in tomorrow's world.
   

  

 The wisdom, knowledge, and experience of Evora employees at implementing complex workforce management solutions is what sets us apart. We look for the best to hire and to keep. The attractive combination of high\-value consulting services with a competitively priced remote development team has proven to be successful in projects worldwide. With a solid growth, currently 450\+ Evorians are working in offices in India, US, Brazil, Germany, Austria and Spain.
   

  

 As a trusted partner for data\-driven transformation, we help enterprise customers design, build, and operate modern data platforms, business intelligence solutions, and AI\-powered applications across the Microsoft ecosystem. Our team of experienced consultants and engineers delivers end\-to\-end solutions spanning Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Power BI, Azure AI Foundry, and Power Platform. With a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and customer proximity, Evora (Connect) combines deep technical expertise with strategic advisory to empower organisations on their digital journey.
   

  

**About Evora IT Solutions \& Evora Service Partner**
 Evora IT Solutions Group is a global SAP partner delivering innovative IT services and solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing the Evora Service Partner Centre (“Evora Service Partner”) — an unified, centralised function supporting all Evora entities globally under a single operating model. Phase 1 of Evora Service Partner will serve our Germany and USA entities, with a clear expansion roadmap to additional regions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Finance Lead – Evora Service Partner is a senior individual contributor and team lead role based in India, forming part of Evora Group's shared finance delivery model. The role sits within the Evora Service Partner (ESP) organisation in India and operates as a dedicated finance function supporting Evora Group's global entities.
   

  

 You will lead a team of finance professionals in India who provide shared finance services — including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and process operations — to Evora Group entities globally. While your day\-to\-day employment and people management are with the ESP Head in India, your finance work is directed by and closely aligned with the Global Finance Lead, ensuring full integration with Evora Group's global finance function.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role for a finance professional who combines technical depth in accounting with a service\-delivery mindset, the ability to build trusted cross\-cultural working relationships, and the drive to lead a team delivering excellence from India to the world.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in accounting/finance, with strong exposure to multi\-entity international environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a team lead or managerial capacity within a Shared Services Centre (SSC).
* Strong expertise in accounting standards: IFRS and HGB; local GAAP knowledge a plus.
* Deep understanding of month\-end close, balance sheet management, and consolidated financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP (S/4HANA or SAP Cloud ERP an advantage).
* Proven track record collaborating with senior global stakeholders and cross\-border teams.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* Fluent English (written and spoken) essential; German language skills a strong advantage.
* Practical experience applying AI tools in a finance or shared services context.
* Proven ability to coach teams on new ways of working; comfortable as an informal AI champion.
* Grounded understanding of responsible AI use: data sensitivity, compliance boundaries, and appropriate human oversight.


**What You Bring**
**Shared Finance Service Delivery**
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality, SLA\-driven finance services from the India team to Evora Group global entities.
* Ensure all deliverables — reporting, reconciliations, close activities — are completed accurately, on time, and to the standard set by the Global Finance Lead.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the India\-based finance team and the global finance function.
* Monitor service quality, proactively flag issues, and drive resolution in coordination with the Global Finance Lead.


**General Ledger Ownership \& Accounting Excellence**
* End\-to\-end ownership of GL processes for Evora Group international entities supported from India.
* Ensure accurate and timely month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close (HGB, IFRS, applicable local GAAPs).
* Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive strong accounting practices across AP, AR, fixed assets, and intercompany accounting.
* Maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and ongoing audit readiness across all entities served.


**Financial Reporting \& Compliance**
* Prepare and review financial statements in line with HGB, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Support group consolidation and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Global Finance Lead.
* Act as a key liaison for internal and external audits across entities served from India.

description:
Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.

 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

description:

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Assistant Vice President – Stress Testing.**
**Purpose Of The Role**
 This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and well\-governed stress testing results and management information end\-to\-end, including running/consolidating balance sheet and P\&L outputs, coordinating stakeholder submissions and regulatory responses, maintaining data and systems and strengthening the control environment through robust documentation, evidence, issue/risk management, and continuous process automation/improvement.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Support end\-to\-end production of management information and consolidated stress\-testing results. Execute and/or support model runs and results production for balance sheet and P\&L components including loans, deposits, revenue etc. and produce consolidated results.
* Submitting overlays, journals into TM1, CART etc. and ensure the MI is accurate, robust and aligned with the latest management hierarchies. Collaborate with Group to ensure any PRA submissions are completed timely, liaise on Bank of England queries, prepare draft responses relating to unstructured data requests.
* Perform analysis of stress test outputs including movement/variance analysis, sensitivities, trend reviews, and identification of key drivers. Managing stakeholders to ensure timely and complete submissions. Tracking actions, recording key decision points, distributing meeting materials and minutes.
* Support T\-zero data preparation for entity returns, coordinate with Group and ensure data quality throughout the process. Support R\&C and coordination of various stress test exercises and related approvals/governance, including coordination of inputs and evidence packs for exercises such as GIST/GRP/RST and relevant UK/Group regulatory requests (e.g., PRA\-related).
* Partner with model owners and accountable executives in Business, Risk, Finance to analyse, review and challenge stress test submissions. Support the impact assessment and change implementation for various stress\-testing data and systems, including CART, TM1 and maintain key mappings for products, global businesses, MICA etc.
* Implement new models, tools, processes or automated solutions to support any changes in the process or requirements. Build accurate, validated datasets for each stress\-testing cycle, with no critical data\-quality issues, and develop and maintain validation tools to support review activities.
* Improve efficiency, convert manual spreadsheets to automated solutions by leveraging HSBC artificial intelligence tools and other methods of automation. Ensuring processes are run in accordance with the Control framework and agreed procedures.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality stress testing documentation (methodology narratives, process/run books, evidence packs, control checklists, assumptions logs, and decision logs). Providing accurate information status reporting, risk and update on issues.
* Develop and actively manage delivery plans covering key milestones and interdependencies and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure timely delivery. title: Veg Oil Trader
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.
   

  

 This position is in our Ag \& Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions.
   

  

 Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

 The Vege Oil Trader will be responsible for Merchandising Imported Edible Oil such as CPO, RBD Oln and SFO into the local Indian market from various port location but mainly pertaining to the East coast of India (KP/Kaki/Chennai/Haldia). In this role, you will monitor a supplier base and fulfill transactions, delivering commodities that meet production requirements and specifications in terms of timing, volume, quantity and cost.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**Trading \& Commercial Strategy**
* Develop and execute profitable trading strategies for imported edible oils across Indian markets.
* Manage physical trading positions, inventory exposure, and pricing risk to optimize portfolio profitability.
* Identify and capture arbitrage opportunities between origins, ports, customer segments, and competing oils.
* Monitor global vegetable oil markets, including Palm Oil, Soybean Oil, Sunflower Oil, and related feedstocks, and translate market intelligence into actionable trading decisions.
* Build and maintain trading books to achieve volume, margin, and P\&L targets.


**Market Analysis \& Price Risk Management**
* Analyze domestic and international market fundamentals including supply\-demand balances, crop outlooks, import parity, crush economics, stock levels, and government policies.
* Monitor futures markets, basis relationships, currency movements, freight rates, and competitor activity to support trading decisions.
* Recommend pricing, hedging, and risk\-management strategies to manage market volatility and protect margins.
* Work closely with Risk Management and Trade Analytics teams to manage position exposure and portfolio performance.


**Customer \& Supplier Development**
* Build strategic relationships with refiners, food manufacturers, distributors, and trade houses across India.
* Identify new customer opportunities and develop trading solutions tailored to customer requirements.
* Negotiate commercial contracts involving pricing, volume, delivery terms, and payment structures.
* Collaborate with international trading desks and suppliers to optimize sourcing and trade flows.


**Portfolio Optimization \& Execution**
* Manage inventory and sales liquidation across bonded, high\-seas, and ex\-tank positions to maximize returns.
* Optimize freight, storage, and logistics economics to enhance trade margins.
* Ensure effective coordination with logistics, execution, finance, quality, credit, and operations teams to support seamless trade execution.
* Evaluate inventory holding strategies and working capital impacts to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.


**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration**
* Partner closely with TDA and Market Intelligence teams to assess:
+ Domestic crushing margins and crush economics.
+ Import parity and export competitiveness.
+ Port stock positions and inventory trends.
+ Regional demand patterns and substitution dynamics between edible oils.

* Provide market insights and trade recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Contribute to regional and global market outlook discussions and commercial strategy development.


**Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of vegetable oil fundamentals, futures markets, risk management, and physical commodity trading.
* Proven ability to interpret market data and convert insights into profitable trading decisions.
* Experience managing physical positions, customer portfolios, and price\-risk exposure.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and relationship management capabilities.
* Ability to make decisions in fast\-moving and volatile commodity markets.
* P\&L\-driven mindset with a strong focus on value creation and margin optimization.

 As a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations that help tax departments maximize the strategic value to the organization. You will deliver services for companies that are implementing tax solutions related to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and tax applications.
   

  

 As a Senior you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of ways, including:
   

  

* Client Management: Participate in the day\-to\-day interactions with client’s project team members and Deloitte project leadership members

 Required:

 The team
   

  

 At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Tax Management Consulting (TMC) practice helps tax departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient tax function that enhances the core responsibilities of compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning tax as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements and obligations. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled Treasury Cash Operations Senior to support the execution and optimization of end\-to\-end treasury operations for global clients. This role focuses on hands\-on cash management, payment execution, reporting, and supporting transformation initiatives.
   

  

 You will work closely with Managers and client stakeholders to ensure efficient cash operations, accurate reporting, and compliance with controls in a dynamic consulting environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cash \& Liquidity Management**
* Support daily cash position tracking across bank accounts and geographies
* Assist in short\-term cash flow forecasting and liquidity analysis
* Monitor client inflows (receivables) and outflows (payments, payroll, vendors)
* Identify and escalate cash gaps or funding requirements


**Treasury Operations**
* Execute domestic and international payments (wire, ACH, etc.)
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of treasury transactions
* Support bank account management activities (documentation, updates, tracking)
* Maintain treasury systems and ensure data accuracy


**Forecasting \& Reporting**
* Prepare periodic cash flow forecasts (weekly/monthly)
* Track actual vs forecast variances and highlight key drivers
* Generate standard treasury reports for internal and client stakeholders
* Support working capital analysis


**Banking \& Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with banking partners for operational queries
* Work with internal teams (AP, AR, FP\&A, Tax) to support cash requirements
* Escalate issues related to payments, liquidity, or bank operations


**Process Improvement \& Transformation**
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives
* Assist in implementing treasury management systems (TMS) enhancements
* Identify operational inefficiencies and suggest improvements
* Demonstrate a good understanding of accounting concepts; stay informed of professional standards and firm policies (e.g., guidelines of the EY GDS FAAS Policy Manual); and effectively apply this knowledge to moderately difficult and/or complex client situations
* Receive direction from the Manager, Senior Managers.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* CA / bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field
* 4–7 years of relevant experience in treasury, cash operations, or finance
* Experience in consulting, shared services, or multinational environments preferred
* Basic understanding of treasury processes and banking systems
* Working Experience in at least one leading Treasury management system (TMS)


**What we look for:**
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, client\-serving environment
* Strong execution and delivery focus
* Willingness to learn and grow in treasury operations and consulting
* Team player with proactive approach
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good understanding of cash forecasting and liquidity management
* Familiarity with Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba, SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Proficiency in Excel and financial reporting tools
* Effective communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Attention to detail and strong control mindset


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Lead Controller \- Financial Reporting, Close and Audit will serve as the primary accounting lead for the Company's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes. This individual will coordinate and review the close, prepare consolidated financial information, oversee audit support, and ensure that accounting work is complete, accurate, well documented, and delivered on schedule. The role is hands\-on and requires an experienced accounting professional who can review detailed work, identify unsupported or unusual balances, resolve issues, and communicate clearly with the Chief Financial Officer, accounting personnel, and external auditors. Final accounting judgments, SEC accountability, treasury strategy, tax strategy, and executive\-level communications remain with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Close and Consolidation** 




 • Own and administer the monthly, quarterly, and annual close calendar, including deadlines, dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation points.
 



 • Coordinate close activities across the Company's legal entities, business units, and accounting resources.
 



 • Review journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and supporting schedules.
 



 • Ensure all material balance\-sheet accounts are reconciled, supported, and reviewed each reporting period.
 



 • Identify and resolve unexplained balances, aged reconciling items, classification errors, duplicate entries, and other accounting discrepancies.
 



 • Maintain discipline over period close, reopening periods, late entries, and post\-close adjustments.
 



 • Maintain a complete, organized, and audit\-ready electronic close binder.
 



**Financial Reporting** 




 • Prepare and review consolidated balance sheets, statements of operations, statements of cash flows, and related supporting schedules.
 



 • Prepare monthly management reporting packages and clear explanations of material financial\-statement variances.
 



 • Review reported results for unusual trends, period\-over\-period inconsistencies, margin anomalies, and potential accounting errors.
 



 • Maintain the chart of accounts, financial\-statement mapping, consolidation structure, and reporting hierarchy.
 



 • Prepare financial\-statement and footnote support for quarterly and annual SEC filings.
 



 • Perform or coordinate financial\-statement, disclosure, and XBRL tie\-outs and maintain supporting workpapers.
 



**Technical Accounting Support** 




 • Research U.S. GAAP requirements applicable to Company transactions and accounting matters.
 



 • Prepare initial technical accounting analyses and memorandum drafts for Chief Financial Officer review.
 



 • Identify transactions requiring additional accounting analysis, documentation, or external consultation.
 



 • Support accounting for revenue recognition, leases, inventory, stock\-based compensation, discontinued operations, impairments, contingencies, acquisitions, divestitures, and other relevant matters.
 



 • Assist with implementation of new accounting standards and updates to accounting policies.
 



 • Escalate material, unusual, or judgmental accounting matters promptly.
 



**Audit and Quarterly Review Support** 




 • Manage detailed coordination of the annual audit and quarterly review processes.
 



 • Maintain the auditor request list, assign responsibility for requested items, and monitor completion.
 



 • Review schedules and supporting documentation before submission to the external auditors.
 



 • Coordinate responses among accounting personnel, operating teams, and external service providers.
 



 • Track proposed adjustments, passed adjustments, control observations, and unresolved audit matters.
 



 • Identify recurring audit issues and coordinate corrective actions with responsible personnel.
 



 • Escalate potential reporting delays or unresolved audit matters to the Chief Financial Officer.
 



**Internal Controls and Team Coordination** 




 • Maintain financial\-close and financial\-reporting controls, including evidence of preparation and review.
 



 • Maintain accounting policies, close procedures, review checklists, control documentation, and reporting workpapers.
 



 • Identify control failures, documentation deficiencies, and recurring process breakdowns and coordinate remediation.
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day coordination and review of the Accounting Operations Controller and other outsourced accounting resources.
 



 • Maintain an open\-items list covering unresolved accounting, reporting, audit, and control matters.
 



 • Establish clear expectations, review work for quality and completeness, and escalate issues early with recommended solutions.
 



 • Improve documentation and cross\-training to reduce key\-person dependency.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a closely related field.
 



 • CPA, Chartered Accountant, ACCA, or comparable professional accounting designation.
 



 • At least 10 years of progressive accounting and financial\-reporting experience.
 



 • Prior experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Financial Reporting Director, Audit Manager, or comparable accounting leader.
 



 • Direct experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company and working within a public\-company reporting calendar.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and experience preparing or reviewing consolidated financial statements.
 



 • Experience with multi\-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany eliminations.
 



 • Experience supporting Forms 10\-Q and 10\-K, including financial\-statement and disclosure support.
 



 • Experience working directly with external auditors in a PCAOB audit environment.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to review reconciliations, identify accounting problems, and drive issues to resolution.
 



 • Strong technical accounting research, written documentation, and English communication skills.
 



 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with ERP and financial\-reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to supervise and review the work of remote accounting personnel.
 



 • Ability to provide meaningful recurring work\-hour overlap with U.S. Central Time, with expanded availability during close and reporting periods.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Prior public accounting experience with a national or regional accounting firm.
 



 • Experience in inventory\-intensive distribution, foodservice, retail, e\-commerce, logistics, or a related industry.
 



 • Experience remediating audit findings, significant deficiencies, material weaknesses, or other internal\-control issues.
 



 • Demonstrated success improving the accuracy, timeliness, or predictability of a financial close.
 



 • Experience implementing or optimizing an ERP, consolidation platform, close\-management system, or financial\-reporting tool.
 



 • Experience supporting acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, discontinued operations, or other complex

title: US Tax Analyst- Business
description:
The US Tax Analyst will be responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and ensuring the accuracy of US tax returns prepared by associates. The role involves applying in\-depth knowledge of US federal and state tax laws, ensuring compliance with IRS regulations, and providing feedback to preparers to maintain high\-quality deliverables. This position requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to guide junior team members.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Review US Individual, Partnership, Corporate, and Trust tax returns for accuracy and compliance with IRS and state regulations.
* Ensure that all returns are prepared in accordance with the latest US tax laws and filing requirements.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or missing information and provide clear review notes for correction.
* Perform tax research and resolve complex tax issues as required.
* Monitor E\-filing processes and ensure timely submission of returns.
* Maintain updated knowledge of US tax laws, IRS guidelines, and changes in compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with tax preparers and provide guidance to improve accuracy and efficiency in tax return preparation.
* Assist in tax planning strategies and advisory tasks, when required.
* Ensure confidentiality and compliance with company policies regarding client data and documents.
* Support the training and development of junior associates in US tax concepts and return preparation.



  





  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:** 



* **Education \& Certification:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. CPA/EA certification (added advantage).
* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of experience in US tax preparation and review. Experience with multiple tax software platforms is an advantage.
* **Technical Knowledge:** 
 Strong understanding of US federal and state tax regulations, tax forms (1040, 1065, 1120, 1120S, 1041, etc.), and filing procedures.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Ability to analyze tax data, identify discrepancies, and provide accurate solutions.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for effective review notes and client communication.
* **Technology Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with tax software (Drake, ProSystem, UltraTax, Lacerte, etc.) and MS Office.
* **Leadership:** 
 Ability to guide and mentor team members, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 Strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and deadlines.
* **Problem\-Solving:** 
 Aptitude for handling complex tax scenarios and providing practical solutions.

title: Power BI and Executive Insights Lead

The successful candidate will understand the EY reporting environment and collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners and Global Analytics teams to deliver trusted, scalable and decision\-ready reporting.

**Dashboard Development \& Reporting**

title: Project Finance - Fund Raising & Commercial
description:
**Finance Manager / Senior Manager – Project Finance, Fund Raising & Commercial**

Stemz Group | Mumbai

**Location:**
Mumbai, with travel as required

**Reporting:**
Global Head of Finance

**Industry:**
Healthcare and Infrastructure

**About Stemz Group**

Stemz Group is a multinational healthcare group headquartered in Dubai, with operations across India, the Middle East, South and Southeast Asia and Europe. The Group is expanding into new healthcare and infrastructure projects in India, including projects under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a finance professional who can raise and structure capital for new projects, and bring strong commercial and financial discipline to their execution.

The role will lead fund raising for the Group’s projects, with a focus on structures that rely on project cash flows and contract strength rather than promoter support or hard collateral. It will also own commercial finance, contract negotiation and financial control for projects under development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Fund Raising & Project Structuring**

* Lead fund raising for Group projects end to end: funding strategy, lender and investor outreach, due diligence, sanction, documentation and disbursement.
* Structure project funding on a non-recourse or limited-recourse basis, using appropriate security and credit enhancement mechanisms.
* Put together the right mix of debt, structured finance, equity, grants and bridge finance for each project.
* Arrange EPC and equipment-linked funding, including vendor financing, leasing and export-credit-backed options.
* Build bankable financial models and lender-ready information memoranda and term sheets.
* Evaluate PPP bid and concession economics, and access government support schemes where eligible.
* Manage lender and investor relationships after funding, including drawdowns, covenant compliance and reporting.

**2. Funding Network & Global Capital**

* Build and use strong relationships with financial institutions, leading banks and NBFCs.
* Access startup and innovation capital, including incubators, venture debt funds and government schemes.
* Engage development finance institutions, international banks and private credit funds for short-term and long-term capital.
* Work with Group Finance, Tax and Legal to structure cross-border funding efficiently, using the Group’s international presence where it adds value.
* Maintain a Group funding pipeline and lender / investor tracker.

**3. Commercial Finance & Controls**

* Lead the financial and commercial evaluation of vendor, EPC, equipment and service-provider proposals, and take part in commercial negotiations.
* Manage project budgets, CAPEX / OPEX tracking, cash-flow planning and commitments; flag cost overruns and commercial risks early.
* Ensure accurate accounting, monthly closing, MIS and audit support for project entities, in line with Group policies.
* Prepare regular management dashboards on project finances, funding status and key risks.
* Act as finance SPOC for assigned projects with internal teams, lenders, investors and government authorities.

**Candidate Profile**

**Must have**

* Chartered Accountant (CA); CFA or MBA (Finance) an advantage.
* 8–12 years of post-qualification experience, with significant experience in project finance, infrastructure finance or fund raising.
* A proven track record of raising working capital and project funding, with details of deals personally led and the structures used.
* Experience raising funding on a cash-flow basis with limited promoter support.
* Strong relationships with financial institutions and leading banks.
* Strong financial modelling and commercial negotiation skills.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to PPP / EPC projects in infrastructure or healthcare.
* Experience with an infrastructure developer, EPC company, lender’s project finance team or a project finance advisory practice.
* Links with venture debt funds, incubators, DFIs or international lenders, and working knowledge of cross-border funding regulations.
* Healthcare sector exposure.

**Personal attributes:**
clear communicator, confident with senior bankers, investors and government authorities; self-driven and comfortable in a fast-moving project environment while staying within Group finance governance.

**What We Are Looking For**

This is not an accounting role. We want someone who can open doors with lenders and investors, structure deals that work, negotiate well on commercials, and help take projects from concept to financial closure and operations.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, technical roadmap, and delivery of our innovative tax product suite. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and subject matter experts, to translate complex tax requirements into robust, scalable, and secure software solutions and ensure our products meet the evolving needs of our customers and comply with complex tax regulations.  
  
Join our team and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values excellence, collaboration, and a passion for leveraging technology to simplify the complexities of tax.

As a Principal Product Manager - Tech, you will lead new, large product initiatives to define the long-term strategy and vision to meet emerging customer needs and tax regulations. You will handle complex product development and business management scenarios, proactively identifying gaps/opportunities to then develop a suite of products to solve the problems.  
  

* Define product strategy, roadmap, and vision for tax product portfolio, while contributing to the technical design of new product features.

We build systems to enable our customers to perform tax functions including, calculations, payments, filing, tax audits, and recovery at the scale demanded by Amazon’s business operations. We prioritize solutions based on our ability to deliver exponential value in the following four dimensions: 1) supporting business growth while reducing cost to serve 2) ensuring compliance and reducing risk 3) improving customer experience, and 4) providing accurate, complete, and timely data.

title: Finance Systems Functional Lead
description:
D365 Finance & Operations

**Role - Finance Systems Functional Lead**

Permanent Role Description | India

**Role purpose:** Build permanent in-house D365 functional ownership within Finance Systems, reducing dependency on external delivery partners while strengthening platform control, continuous improvement and future deployment capability.

1. Role Overview

**Role Title**

Finance Systems Functional Lead- Finance & Operations

**Employment Type**

Permanent, full-time employee of FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited

**Reports To**

Head of Finance Systems

**Team / Pillar**

FNZ Finance Systems - D365 Finance & Operations

**Location**

India - Gurugram

**Working Pattern**

India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration

**Start Date**

At the earliest opportunity, subject to notice period and pre-employment checks

**Travel**

Occasional domestic or international travel may be required

**Priority**

High - required to strengthen post-go-live ownership, stabilisation and future D365 delivery

2. Purpose and Context

**FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform.** Following global go-live, the priority is to stabilise the platform, embed robust operational ownership, support close and control activities, deliver agreed enhancements, and prepare for future modules and deployments.

This is a senior, hands-on permanent role within the Finance Systems team. The role holder will act as FNZ Finance's internal D365 functional authority, owning functional design and configuration across core finance processes, leading issue resolution and continuous improvement, and ensuring that changes are controlled, documented, supportable and aligned to Finance requirements.

The position is not a general business analyst role. It requires a practitioner who can work directly in D365, translate finance requirements into sustainable solutions, challenge implementation-partner proposals, and take enduring accountability for platform health and business outcomes.

3. Key Responsibilities

D365 Functional Ownership

* Own the functional integrity of D365 Finance & Operations across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Provide end-to-end functional leadership from requirement and design through configuration, testing, deployment, support and adoption.
* Act as the senior FNZ-side functional reference point for Finance Controllers, process owners, technology teams and delivery partners.
* Maintain solution design, configuration and process documentation so that knowledge remains within FNZ.

Platform Stabilisation and Support

* Lead functional triage and root-cause analysis for production issues, coordinating resolution through the agreed incident, problem and change processes.
* Support month-end and year-end close, reconciliations and resolution of finance-system issues without compromising financial control or data integrity.
* Own the functional backlog, prioritising defects, control gaps, user pain points and enhancements based on risk, value, urgency and capacity.
* Provide guidance, coaching and knowledge transfer to Finance Systems colleagues and business users.

Change, Release and Continuous Improvement

* Translate finance and regulatory requirements into clear solution options, functional specifications, acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
* Assess proposed changes for cross-module, integration, reporting, data and control impacts before approval.
* Partner with technical teams and vendors on configuration, integrations and extensions, ensuring solutions follow D365 standard capability wherever practical.
* Support release planning, regression testing, deployment readiness, post-release validation and benefits realisation.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Protect the integrity of finance master data, dimensions, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Support D365 integrations including banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and downstream reporting platforms.
* Partner with Data and Reporting teams on D365 financial reporting, Power BI and Workiva outputs, ensuring consistent definitions and reconciliation to the ledger.

Controls, Audit and Governance

* Embed segregation of duties, access controls, change evidence, configuration governance and audit-ready documentation into day-to-day platform ownership.
* Support ITGC and financial-controls evidence, remediation activity and audit requests relating to D365.
* Operate within the Finance Systems governance framework, including demand intake, design authority, environment management, release control and capacity planning.

Future Roadmap and Team Leadership

* Provide functional leadership for future D365 capabilities such as Consolidation, advanced Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting and other agreed modules.
* Support future entity onboarding, acquisitions and migrations from legacy finance platforms into D365.
* Help shape the D365 roadmap and operating model, reducing avoidable external dependency and building a sustainable internal capability.
* Lead the D365 pillar through influence and subject-matter authority; line-management responsibilities may be added as the team develops.

4. Required Skills and Experience

Essential

* 10+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, including significant responsibility for finance modules.
* Demonstrable experience delivering and supporting complex, multi-entity and multi-currency D365 implementations.
* Deep understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, with strong knowledge of financial controls and close activities.
* Hands-on functional configuration capability across core D365 finance modules, including dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, intercompany and financial reporting.
* Experience of data migration and validation covering master data, general-ledger balances and sub-ledger open items.
* Experience of integrations, testing, cutover, hypercare, release management and production support.
* Ability to diagnose complex functional issues, evaluate trade-offs and drive decisions through to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the credibility to work with senior Finance stakeholders, regional teams, auditors and external partners.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment while maintaining disciplined documentation, governance and knowledge sharing.

Preferred

* Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant, MBA Finance or equivalent finance qualification.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-jurisdiction environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting and audit / ITGC control requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Project Accounting, Treasury and Cash Management, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps and finance-data integrations.
* Previous experience as a solution architect, functional lead, platform owner or capability lead.

5. Success Measures

* Stable and controlled D365 operations through month-end, year-end and business-critical processing.
* Clear ownership and timely resolution of functional incidents, problems and enhancement requests.
* High-quality functional designs, test evidence, release documentation and audit artefacts.
* Reduced reliance on external partners for routine functional decisions and platform knowledge.
* A prioritised improvement roadmap aligned to Finance outcomes, risk and available capacity.
* Effective partnership with Finance stakeholders and measurable improvement in user confidence and platform adoption.

6. Employment Terms and Ways of Working

* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Head of Finance Systems and full integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.
* Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening.
* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

  

#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a driven Junior Finance Associate to join our Finance team, with a primary focus on Accounts Payable and Management Reporting. We’re looking for someone who is hands-on, eager to learn and motivated to take ownership and continuously improve how things are done.

On the Accounts Payable side, you will support day-to-day invoice and expense processing to ensure accurate recording, timely payments, and a smooth experience for vendors and internal stakeholders. On the Management Reporting side, you will support and further develop the Bank’s key management reports, including revenue and KPI reporting, while also contributing to the budgeting and forecasting process. You will work closely with business owners and the wider Finance team to resolve queries, improve reporting, maintain clean documentation and support compliance with internal policies and audit requirements.

  

#### **Your AMINA To-Do List**

**Accounts Payable & Finance Operations:**

* Process supplier invoices and employee expenses accurately and on time in our finance systems.
* Ensure invoices are correctly coded, approved, and aligned with internal policies.
* Support payment runs across multiple payment systems and coordinate with relevant internal teams.
* Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, expense, and vendor queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with audit and compliance requirements.
* Support AP-related month-end close activities.

**Management Reporting & Budgeting:**

* Support the preparation of the Bank’s key management reports, including revenue and KPI reporting.
* Develop an understanding of how key metrics are calculated, where the underlying data comes from and how it flows into Finance reporting.
* Support data mapping and validation to help ensure reporting remains accurate, consistent, and reliable.
* Look at our reports with a curious mindset: understand whether the numbers make sense and help identify gaps or areas that could be improved
* Work with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to understand what information is useful to them and how our reporting can continue to evolve
* Support the budgeting and forecasting process, building an understanding of the Bank’s key revenue streams, cost areas, and business drivers

**Ownership & Growth:**

* Bring a proactive, hands-on attitude, take ownership of your work and be comfortable asking questions and learning as you go.
* Work closely with the wider Finance team and business stakeholders, with plenty of opportunity to build your knowledge and gradually take on broader responsibilities.

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

**Essential:**

* Basic understanding of accounting or finance principles (through education, self‑study, or practical exposure)
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with high volumes of data
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to concentrate for extended periods and take pride in delivering high‑quality, reliable work
* Proactive, positive attitude with a willingness to learn and take feedback onboard
* Comfortable working with systems and technology (prior experience with expense or invoice tools is a plus, but not required)
* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related fields.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience in an operational, administrative, or finance‑related role
* Pursuing advanced qualifications in Finance, especially the CFA Program. Exposure to Accounts Payable, Expense Processing or Budgeting.

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

+ Assessment scores
+ Training completion rates
+ Certification results
+ Quality scores
+ Productivity improvement
+ Error reduction metrics
+ Employee readiness indicators

* Leverage automation, AI, and digital learning platforms to improve training effectiveness.

* Lead and mentor a team of Trainers, Learning Specialists, and SMEs.
* Manage performance, development, and succession planning for the training team.

+ AR

**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an Opex & Capex Financial Analyst to support the Vodafone Business International (VBI) function in managing opex and capex budgets. The individual will play a critical role in delivering high-quality financial reporting, analysis, forecasting and insights by partnering with regional finance teams and cross-functional stakeholders. This position suits someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data across a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage, review and report monthly opex and capex within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and adherence to financial controls
* Partner with FinOps teams to deliver timely and accurate month-end results
* Provide variance analysis, commentary and insights to explain performance and inform business decision‑making
* Act as a financial translator for business leads by presenting clear commercial and analytical narratives
* Deliver baseline forecasting, working closely with regional teams such as HR and Sales
* Support annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, gap tracking and performance challenge discussions with business leads
* Handle large data sets from multiple systems, ensuring accuracy while meeting tight deadlines
* Independently manage multiple priorities and maintain strong stakeholder engagement across levels

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in operating within a multi-functional, complex matrix environment
* Curious, collaborative and someone who challenges traditional approaches to drive better ways of working
* Skilled at engaging with senior and non-financial stakeholders, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts
* Proactive with experience driving change and implementing process improvements or complex financial projects
* Strong analytical thinker with financial modelling experience and exceptional attention to detail
* CA/CWA qualified (or equivalent) with 5–10 years of experience in Finance or Commercial analysis
* Proficient in Advanced Excel, SAP, Power BI and financial planning systems
* Clear and articulate communicator, both in writing and verbally

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to collaborate with global finance teams across APAC and the Americas
* Exposure to international business operations and end‑to‑end financial planning cycles
* Scope to contribute to process transformation and efficiency improvements
* A role that strengthens stakeholder management, analytical reasoning, and strategic thinking capabilities

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced financial modelling and forecasting techniques
* Cross-regional stakeholder engagement and business partnering
* Use of enterprise finance tools such as SAP and Power BI in complex environments
* Enhanced skills in articulating financial insights for non-finance audiences
* Experience driving process excellence and influencing business outcomes

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
