title: Analyst
description:
Join us as an Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful as we deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**

* Strong understanding of Capital Markets products, particularly Credit Markets, Bonds, Fixed Income Securities, FX products, and Fixed Income Derivatives.
* Understanding of trade lifecycle, valuation methodologies, and market conventions across credit products.
* Good understanding of financial accounting principles, ledger impacts, accruals, reserves, and financial statement reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail and control mindset.
* Working with large datasets and proficiency in Excel and O365 applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly to traders, risk teams, finance, and senior management.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong alignment with Barclays Values and Mindset, demonstrating integrity, accountability, collaboration, and the confidence to challenge constructively while driving excellence.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Knowledge of Product Control functions, including daily P&L production, attribution, reconciliation, valuation controls, and balance sheet substantiation.
* Knowledge of regulatory capital, market risk, counterparty credit risk, and valuation adjustments (XVA).
* Ability to analyze and explain P&L movements, risk exposures, and valuation changes to trading desks and senior stakeholders.
* Experience in Front Office support, Product Control, Valuations, Market Risk, or Financial Control functions within an investment bank.
* Familiarity with financial reporting, Global Accounting Standards, regulatory reporting, and audit requirements.
* Knowledge of LLMs, VBA, Python, or data visualization tools is advantageous.
* Ability to challenge and investigate valuation, booking, or P&L discrepancies independently.
* Project management and process improvement experience, including automation and control enhancement initiatives.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Ensure the maintenance of a strong internal control environment. Review key controls, adjustment substantiation and New, Amends & Cancels trades review, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr Controllership Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Banking & Treasury professional will be responsible for managing the company’s banking relationships, daily liquidity, cash flow forecasting, Banking & treasury operations, trade finance and financial risk controls. The role supports efficient fund management, timely payment processes, foreign exchange exposure management, debt and working capital coordination, and compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. This position requires close collaboration with business finance, controllership, Shared service centre, tax, legal, and external banking partners to ensure smooth treasury execution in a multinational and listed-company environment.
  
  
Responsibilities for Internal Candidates
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily treasury operations including cash positioning, bank balances, fund management, payment planning, Fixed deposits placement (incl renewals) and liquidity monitoring.
* Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts and support working capital optimization initiatives.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with domestic and international banks, financial institutions, and other treasury service providers.
* Coordinate banking documentation, account opening/closure, KYC updates, mandates, authorized signatories, certain filings like UFCE, Annexure I, OPI etc.
* Dividend account creation and its distribution for private and listed companies and banking system administration
* Monitor utilization of credit facilities, non-fund based limits, bank guarantees, letters of credit, and short-term borrowing lines.
* Support foreign exchange operations, hedging execution, and exposure tracking in line with approved treasury policies.
* Ensure timely execution of treasury transactions and accurate accounting interface with finance and controllership teams.
* Ensure monthly bank reconciliation statements for all banking relations e.g. current account, deposits, hedges, bank guarantees, LC etc.
* Drive FEMA compliances on w.r.t. EDPMS, IDPMS and MTT records, timely filing of closure
* Prepare treasury MIS, dashboards, and management reports covering cash, deposits, borrowings, investments, bank charges, and FX exposures.
* Drive process improvement, automation, and standardization across banking and treasury activities, including ERP/TMS utilization.
* Support internal and external audits by providing treasury schedules, reconciliations, confirmations, and policy documentation.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, corporate governance requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks such as FEMA, RBI, Companies Act, SEBI listing obligations, and other relevant statutory guidelines.
* Partner with tax, legal, secretarial, and business finance teams for cross-border transactions, dividend/remittance matters, and treasury-related compliance.
* Review bank fees, optimize banking structures, and identify opportunities for cost savings and improved treasury efficiency.
* Partner /support in-country business teams for driving issuances and closures of bank guarantees/ letter of credits timely.
* Drive reduction of open-ended bank guarantees through addressing customer needs and leveraging global banking relations
* Support/lead working capital financing initiatives as necessary (e.g. Channel Financing, Supplier Financing etc)

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, or a related discipline.
* MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in banking, corporate treasury, cash management, or finance operations, preferably in a multinational and/or listed company environment.
* Strong understanding of cash flow management, banking products, trade finance instruments, FX operations, and treasury controls.
* Exposure to working capital financing, and banking negotiations will be an advantage.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Knowledge of treasury management systems and digital banking platforms preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Banking relationship management
* Cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning
* Foreign exchange and hedging exposure management
* Working capital and debt monitoring
* Trade finance instruments and documentation
* Treasury reporting and MIS
* Internal controls and compliance orientation
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Process improvement and automation mindset
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multinational environment

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely cash visibility and forecasting.
* Efficient management of banking operations and treasury transactions.
* Strong compliance record with minimal control exceptions.
* Effective management of liquidity, FX exposure, and borrowing utilization.
* Improved treasury processes, reporting quality, and banking cost optimization.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Associate Director – Investments (Defined Benefit Portfolio Management)**
We are seeking a highly motivated individual to support the growth of our DB (Defined Benefit) fiduciary investment management business (commonly referred to as OCIO or Outsourced Chief Investment Officer). This is a rewarding position within a dynamic and expanding team.

* Prior experience in fiduciary management, asset management, and/or investment consulting with a strong understanding of financial instruments and statistical/financial modeling.
* Advanced Excel and coding skills (VBA, Python).

* Familiarity with standard risk measurement and management metrics for investment portfolios.
* Excellent analytical and investment skills.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and lead processes to achieve targets in a timely manner.
* Self-development mindset, able to identify personal knowledge and skill gaps.
* BE/B Tech from a top-tier college and/or Masters in Finance, Financial Engineering, Econometrics, or Quantitative Finance.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* Previous experience with US-based fixed income investments and/or US-based defined benefit investment strategies
* Actuarial training, credentials, and/or experience
* Good/excellent communication and content writing skills
* High attention to detail

**The Opportunity**
Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and business teams.
  
  
The role will also be responsible for creating, Managing, monitoring and reviewing Alteryx based Finance Processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.
  
  
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced Assistant Manager.
  
  
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Pune office.
  
  
Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and business teams.
  
  
The role will also be responsible for creating, Managing, monitoring and reviewing Alteryx based Finance Processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Accounting & Reporting**

* Manage and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of general ledger accounting, journal entries, provisions, accruals, and account reconciliations.
* Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting packs.
* Perform balance sheet reviews and ensure timely resolution of aged or unreconciled items.
* Analyze financial results, identify significant movements and variances, and provide appropriate explanations.
* Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, including US GAAP / IFRS, as relevant to the organization.
* Support consolidation and group reporting requirements, where applicable.
* Review financial information and accounting outputs received from other ABC teams to ensure consistency with controllership and reporting requirements.

**Financial Controllership & Internal Controls**

* Maintain a strong financial control environment and ensure compliance with established finance policies and procedures.
* Review key financial processes and controls to identify control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and supporting evidence for accounting transactions.
* Support internal control testing, risk assessments, and remediation of identified control deficiencies.
* Provide indirect oversight of key finance outputs from ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, and other relevant processes, ensuring that risks, exceptions, and variances are appropriately identified and addressed.
* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across controllership processes.

**Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory, internal, and other auditors and ensure timely completion of audit requirements.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documentation, and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of agreed corrective actions.
* Support statutory and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Coordinate with tax and compliance teams on matters relating to GST, TDS, corporate tax, and other statutory requirements, as applicable.

**Month-End & Year-End Closing**

* Drive timely completion of month-end and year-end closing activities in accordance with the finance calendar.
* Review accruals, provisions, prepayments and other key accounting areas.
* Ensure accurate cut-off and appropriate accounting treatment of transactions.
* Monitor open items and ensure timely resolution before reporting deadlines.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, Commercial, Operations, and other functions to resolve finance and accounting matters.
* Provide accounting guidance to business stakeholders on complex or non-routine transactions.
* Work closely with shared service/finance operations teams to ensure adherence to accounting and reporting requirements.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management based on accounting and financial analysis.
* Establish effective review mechanisms with ABC teams to monitor the quality and timeliness of process outputs.

**Process Improvement, Automation & Alteryx Solutions**

* Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of finance processes.
* Create, Manage, Review & Monitor Alteryx workflows supporting finance and controllership processes.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Alteryx outputs used for accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and reserve calculations.
* Support finance transformation, ERP, reporting, and automation initiatives.
* Develop and monitor appropriate financial controls, SOPs, checklists, and process documentation.
* Promote standardization and best practices across finance processes.

**Team Management**

* Review work performed by team members and provide guidance on accounting and controllership matters.
* Support the development and mentoring of junior finance team members.
* Ensure effective prioritization of activities to meet reporting and compliance deadlines.
* Coordinate with process owners across ABC teams and provide guidance to support consistent and accurate deliverables.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
* Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience, preferably in Finance Controllership, Financial Reporting, Accounting, or Audit.
* Experience in a multinational organization, large corporate, Big 4, or similar professional environment would be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP / IFRS and financial reporting principles.
* Good understanding of statutory audit, internal controls, and financial compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Alteryx, including creation of workflow, workflow review, output validation, issue resolution, and process documentation.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working in a global or shared-services environment would be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong technical accounting and financial reporting knowledge.
* Experience in process automation and Alteryx-based finance solutions.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and financial controls.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight reporting deadlines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently identify issues and drive them to closure.
* Process-improvement and automation mindset.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work collaboratively across functions.
* Ability to exercise effective indirect oversight over cross-functional finance outputs.
* Ability to review and guide the work of junior team members.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
A qualified Chartered Accountant with at least 5 years of post-qualification experience who combines strong technical accounting expertise with a practical business mindset. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in financial closing, reporting, balance-sheet governance, audits, compliance, internal controls & process automation using Alteryx.
  
  
The candidate should also be capable of reviewing and validating outputs from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and Rebates, identifying risks and variances, and ensuring timely resolution through effective stakeholder management. The ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, while guiding junior team members and supporting continuous improvement, will be essential.

description:

**Job Description**
**Specialist – Global Controllership / Accounting**
**Role Overview**
This role is responsible for executing and supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities for assigned legal entities. The role ensures accurate and timely financial reporting in compliance with US GAAP, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements, and company accounting policies. The Junior Controller will own balance sheet account reconciliations, journal entry processing, variance analysis, and financial control activities while partnering with regional finance teams, accounting teams and external auditors to maintain high standards of financial integrity and compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for EU entities, including Preparation and posting of necessary Journal Entries along with proper documentation and Analysis & Reporting of the management reports.
* Review trial balances and investigate/ explain unusual transactions or balances.
* Perform accrual, prepayment, and reclassification entries.
* Ensure timely completion of tasks and adherence to reporting deadlines.
* Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts. Identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation differences in a timely manner. Monitor aged reconciling items and drive timely resolution.
* Maintain reconciliation documentation in accordance with company policies and audit requirements.
* Execute and monitor SOX controls, ensuring compliance with internal control frameworks
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure timely receipt of inputs and reporting deliverables
* Preparation, Coordination and Review of Flux analysis performed by Onshore and offshore team members
* Coordination with auditors for timely audit completion
* Deliver routine accounting tasks within agreed timelines, with a focus on standardization and process efficiency
* Perform analytical reviews and financial analysis to identify anomalies and ensure accuracy of reported numbers
* Supporting all the finance projects and closing as per agreed timelines
* Identify and drive process improvement opportunities, including automation of the processes
* Ensure financial data integrity and readiness for audit and compliance requirements

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* CA / CPA
* 5–8 years of relevant accounting experience

**Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in:

+ SOX compliance and control execution
+ Financial statement review and reporting
+ Month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

* Experience working with In-scope (IS) entities / US accounting environment
* Exposure to SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, or similar.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
* Good to have: Blackline, Alteryx
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Fluent in English

**Impact of the Role**

* Drive accuracy and integrity of financial reporting by ensuring robust reconciliations, flux analysis, and timely closure, thereby enhancing confidence in reported numbers across stakeholders
* Strengthen the control environment and SOX compliance through disciplined execution of internal controls and proactive identification of process gaps
* Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering timely and insightful flux analysis, supporting leadership in understanding key business drivers and variances
* Act as a key bridge between onshore and offshore teams, ensuring seamless coordination, standardization, and consistency in financial reporting outputs
* Support efficient audit and regulatory processes by ensuring audit readiness, timely documentation, and resolution of audit queries with minimal escalations
* Contribute to tax compliance and regulatory reporting by partnering with consultants for tax return filings and supporting assessment processes with accurate financial data
* Improve operational efficiency by driving automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives, reducing manual effort and enhancing turnaround time
* Enhance financial governance by identifying accounting anomalies and driving corrective actions, minimizing risk of misstatement at month, quarter, and year end
* Foster stakeholder confidence and collaboration through proactive communication, strong ownership, and ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical skills
* Ability to identify and resolve accounting anomalies
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to influence without authority across teams
* Continuous improvement mindset with focus on automation and process optimization

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience in global controllership / shared services environment
* Track record of driving process improvements and standardization initiatives
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

**Job Description**

Periodically report work progress to the Head of RTR AMDS SSF. Manage a team of 15+ members. Provide guidance and support to team members to ensure quality and timely delivery. General Ledger Management Supervise general ledger account maintenance and reconciliations. Ensure discrepancies are resolved promptly. Support timely and accurate updates during financial close cycles. Account Review and Analysis Lead regular reviews of balance sheet reconciliations and variance analyses. Guide the team in identifying Profit and Loss (P&L) exposures. Ensure root causes are investigated and addressed. Period-End Close Coordinate and drive month-end and year-end closing activities. Ensure the team meets deadlines and delivers complete and accurate financial data. Intercompany Accounting Oversee intercompany processes and reconciliations. Ensure discrepancies are resolved in line with regulatory and transfer pricing requirements. Financial Reporting Review and validate internal and external reports prepared by the team in accordance with IFRS. Ensure the quality and accuracy of insights, footnotes, and commentary. Fixed Asset Accounting Supervise fixed asset accounting activities, including additions, disposals, transfers, and depreciation. Ensure compliance with applicable policies and accuracy in reporting. Controls, Compliance, and Audit Ensure adherence to internal controls and SOX requirements. Coordinate the timely execution of SOX and relevant internal controls. Ensure timely submission of required evidence and accurate supporting documentation for audits. Documentation Management Ensure comprehensive documentation of all R2R activities to support audit readiness and data integrity. Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as a point of contact for cross-functional teams. Facilitate collaboration, resolve escalated queries, and support communication with other business units. Process Improvement and Automation Support process improvement and automation initiatives across the R2R cycle. Encourage process harmonization and identification of opportunities for process improvement and automation. Team Coaching and Development Provide ongoing coaching, guidance, and performance feedback to team members. Support professional development and ensure clarity of roles and responsibilities. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture. Conduct regular check-ins, recognize achievements, and maintain team motivation during high-volume periods. 3. Required Competencies Behavioural Competencies Learning and Development: Take accountability for continuous self-development and support the development of others. Teamwork: Work collaboratively while respecting the skills and views of others to achieve organizational goals. Decision Making: Understand situations and challenges, analyse available information, and make well-informed decisions. Inspire Trust: Demonstrate honesty, transparency, accountability, and openness to constructive feedback. **Job Description**
Job Description:
  
  
Medline is growing its operations in Pune and is seeking an Vendor Contract Analyst to oversee the implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of contract pricing for both prime and non-prime vendor accounts for branded products. This role also involves managing communication regarding the fulfillment of contractual commitments with contracting parties.

title: Business Outcome Lead - Sub Value Stream
description:
**Job title:**
**Business Outcome Lead - Sub Value Stream**

* The Business Outcome Lead (GCB4) is accountable for defining, driving, and evidencing measurable outcomes across the IWPB Contact Centre within the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking Valuestream. Operating across AMH, EMEA and US markets, the role owns a balanced scorecard that delivers sustainable improvements in cost/capacity, customer experience (CX) and risk/control uplift.
* This role leads cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, Digital, Technology, Data, Finance, Risk/Compliance and Change—focusing teams on outcomes and benefits realisation rather than outputs.

**Opening a world of opportunity**

* HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations. In this role, you’ll help shape and deliver change that improves how customers are served and supported, strengthening resilience and experience across our Contact Centres—work that impacts customers’ everyday lives.
* HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and we’re proud to support an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

**In This Role, You Will**
**Key accountabilities**
**Own the multi-market outcomes framework and balanced scorecard**

* Define the outcomes framework across Cost/Capacity, CX, Risk/Control with standardised KPI definitions, baselines, targets, and tolerance thresholds.
* Ensure comparability across markets while allowing calibrated local targets based on regulatory, operating model and customer behaviour differences.
* Establish clear ownership for each KPI and benefit line (global vs market).

**Build and govern the outcome roadmap for Voice & Conversational Banking**

* Create and maintain a prioritised 12–18 month outcomes roadmap across all in-scope SVS channels.
* Run quarterly planning and prioritisation, explicitly managing trade-offs between automation, service levels, customer outcomes and control obligations.
* Identify “build once, leverage many” opportunities and drive replication across AMH/EMEA/US.

**Benefits Definition, Tracking And Sustained Realisation**

* Develop robust business cases for initiatives (capacity release, cost-to-serve reduction, demand reduction, conversion/retention where applicable, and risk reduction).
* Implement benefits governance: baselines, benefit methodology, assumptions register, dependency mapping, and post-go-live sustainability checks.
* Partner with Finance to ensure benefits are measurable, credible, and audit-ready (including clear distinction between capacity release and cash savings).

**Channel performance optimisation across SVS scope**

* Accountable for outcome oversight and optimisation across:
* Voice SVS
* AI Enabled Voice & Chat Services SVS
* Chat Platforms SVS
* Chatbot & Voicebot SVS
* Including:
* Define channel-specific KPIs (FCR, AHT/handle time, service level/ASA, chat response times, abandon/timeout, transfer rates, containment/deflection, repeat contacts, rework).
* Drive demand and driver analysis (avoidable contacts, failure demand, bot-to-agent transfers, chat-to-voice escalation).
* Improve end-to-end journeys and handovers (bot → agent, chat → voice) to reduce customer effort and repeat contact.
* Ensure outcomes support customers requiring human assistance, including vulnerable customers, with appropriate guardrails.

**Insight-led performance governance and decision support**

* Establish a multi-time-zone governance cadence (weekly performance pulse, monthly outcomes review, quarterly business reviews).
* Produce executive-ready reporting: narrative, insights, trend drivers, benefits status, risks/issues, and decisions required.
* Promote consistent data definitions and measurement standards across markets and partners.

**Embed risk, conduct and controls into outcome delivery**

* Work with Risk/Compliance to ensure initiatives strengthen controls (QA, complaints, vulnerability handling, record-keeping, data privacy; AI governance where relevant).
* Track risk/control uplift alongside efficiency and CX to prevent single-metric optimisation.
* Ensure evidence is maintained to support audit, regulatory and internal assurance needs.

**Senior stakeholder management and influence (no direct authority)**

* Influence senior stakeholders across the ValueStream and markets to align priorities, secure commitments, and remove blockers.
* Proactively manage dependencies between Operations, Technology, Digital, Data and Change teams; escalate with options, impact assessment and recommendations.

**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge, skills and experience**
**Essential**

* Strong experience in Contact Centre / servicing operations and/or transformation, preferably within financial services.
* Proven outcomes and benefits management capability: KPI design, baselining, benefit sizing, tracking, and sustainability.
* Strong analytical skills: demand/call-driver analysis, root cause investigation, insight-to-action prioritisation.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multi-market, matrixed organisations and lead through influence.
* Excellent executive communication: concise, decision-oriented reporting and governance leadership.

**Desirable**

* Experience with conversational banking, chat platforms, chatbots/voicebots, and AI-enabled servicing.
* Genesys experience/working knowledge (desirable).
* Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, Agile delivery, OKRs/outcome-based planning.

**Role level / complexity**

* Significant autonomy with accountability for multi-market outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Shapes priorities and performance management across the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking ValueStream.
* Drives cross-functional alignment and sustained adoption without direct people management authority.

**Key stakeholders**

* Voice Channels & Conversational Banking ValueStream leadership
* IWPB Contact Centre leadership across AMH, EMEA, US
* Workforce Management, Training, Quality Assurance, Complaints
* Digital Channels, Product, CX/VoC, Data & Analytics
* Technology/Engineering (voice/chat/bot platforms), vendors/partners as relevant
* Finance, Risk, Compliance, Change/PMO

description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Risk Management Department at Mizuho International is responsible for delivering an independent assessment of the risks taken across all the trading and origination activities of the Company, and the revenue generated in relation to these risks. It is also responsible for implementing a risk management framework consistent with the Company’s risk appetite and capacity of resources, in agreement with the Company’s Board and Mizuho Securities. The department is led by the Chief Risk Officer and is made up of the following teams:

* Market Risk Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Operational Risk Management
* Regulatory & Liquidity Risk Management
* Model Risk Management
* Risk Analytics
* Risk Reporting

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Implement new reporting requirements

* Support the Team Lead to maintain existing application framework
* Assist with testing the application Framework for impact of upstream changes
* Maintain documentation
* Liaise with Strategic IT and Support departments to resolve issues
* Use SQL, Python, and analytics tools to identify and resolve market risk data quality issues across VaR, SVaR, FRTB, stress testing, and regulatory reporting.
* Develop automated controls, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions to detect data anomalies, reporting exceptions, and reconciliation breaks.
* Partner with Market Risk Managers to communicate risk reporting issues, root causes, and remediation plans, ensuring timely resolution.

* Experience of Excel and VBA
* Experience with version control
* Experience within financial services, risk or another controlled environment
* Experience working with data pipelines, automation or large datasets

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
  
  
Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
As our FP&A Analyst you will own Cinch’s budget and forecast. You will build the plan by market, track performance against it every month, and work with stakeholders across the region to keep us on plan. A subscription device business has a lot moving at once: device cost, financing, collections, churn and residual value. Your job is to know which levers matter, show where we are ahead or behind, and drive the actions that close the gap.
  
  
You will work directly with the Corporate Finance Director, the founders, and country and functional leads across our markets. Investors and lenders will see your work.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Budget ownership. Build and own the annual budget by market and function. Hold budget holders to it, challenge spend against it, and lead re-forecasts when the plan changes.
* Forecasting and planning. Run a rolling, driver-based forecast by market across revenue, margin, opex and cash. Keep it accurate enough that leadership uses it to make decisions.
* Variance tracking. Track actuals against budget and forecast every month, by market. Explain the drivers in plain English and recommend the actions needed to get back on plan.
* Key levers. Identify and track the operating levers that drive results in each market, such as new subscriptions, yield, churn, collections, device cost and residual value. Build a KPI view that shows leaders early when a lever is off track.
* Regional business partnering. Work with country leads, Growth, Operations and Asset Operations across markets to agree targets, own the numbers together and drive outcomes against the budget.
* Monthly reporting. Produce the monthly management pack with variance analysis against budget and prior periods, and explain the drivers in plain English.
* Unit economics. Track and model contribution margin per device, per subscriber and per channel, including cost of funds, acquisition cost, collections losses and residual value.
* Cash and funding. Maintain the cash flow forecast and support the borrowing base and covenant reporting that lenders require.
* Investor and board reporting. Prepare the financial sections of investor updates and board packs, with the Controller.
* Scenario and business-case modelling. Model new markets, products and partnership deals so decisions are made with numbers on the table.
* Data quality. Work with the Data team and RevOps to make sure the numbers you report tie back to source systems.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 4 years in FP&A, finance business partnering, or investment banking / consulting with a finance focus.
* Hands-on experience running a budget and forecast cycle, including variance analysis and re-forecasting.
* Strong stakeholder management. You can hold budget holders to account, push back with data and build trust with teams in different countries.
* Strong financial modelling skills in Excel or Google Sheets: three-statement thinking, driver-based forecasts and sensitivity analysis.
* Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals and how they flow into a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow.
* Clear communicator, able to turn a model into a one-page answer for a non-finance audience.
* Degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience in subscription, leasing, lending, fintech or hardware businesses.
* SQL or BI tool experience (for example Looker, Metabase or Power BI).
* Exposure to lender or investor reporting, covenant tracking or borrowing base models.
* Experience in a startup or scale-up where the finance function was being built.
* Experience in a multi-country or regional finance role, ideally across Southeast Asia.
* CFA, ACCA, CPA or progress towards one.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
  
  
Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
Pricing decides whether a subscription device makes money. As our Pricing Analyst you will be the protector of yield and margin: you will measure what our fleet actually earns by market, segment and product type, price new launches, drive our residual value analysis, and make sure every special deal and promotion still makes money.
  
  
You will work closely with Commercial, Growth, Marketing and Asset Operations, and with the Corporate Finance Director, who owns pricing strategy.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Yield analysis. Track gross yield across the portfolio by market, product type, tenure and customer segment, comparing old versus new pricing and first versus subsequent lease cycles. Explain what moved yield and recommend what to do about it.
* New launch pricing. Price new devices and product launches by market, reset the price ladder for prior generations, and track post-launch performance against the original pricing case.
* Residual value analysis. Drive residual value analysis by market, device and age. Compare realised resale and re-let values against our assumptions and feed the results back into pricing.
* Residual value counterparties. Work with Asset Operations on discussions with buy-back, trade-in and resale counterparties, bringing the residual value benchmarks and economics behind each negotiation.
* Special deal and promotion pricing. Partner with Growth and Marketing on campaigns, partner offers and special deals. Find the structure that hits the commercial goal while protecting margin, and set clear guardrails on what can be discounted and by how much.
* Pricing models. Build and maintain the models that set subscription rates by device, tenure, market and channel. Inputs include device cost, financing cost, expected residual value, refurbishment, logistics, credit loss and servicing cost.
* Deal pricing support. Turn around pricing and margin analysis for B2B, partner and enterprise deals quickly, with a clear recommendation and the trade-offs.
* Margin tracking. Monitor realised yield and margin against plan by product, channel and cohort. Flag leakage from discounts, promos, early returns and write-offs.
* Market and competitor benchmarking. Track competitor and market pricing in each country we operate in, including local currency and tax effects.
* Experiments. Design and read price tests and promotion results, and recommend what to keep.
* Pricing governance. Keep one price book, a clear discount approval matrix and a log of every price change and why it was made.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 4 years in pricing, FP&A, commercial finance, strategy or consulting, with real financial modelling experience.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and working SQL or willingness to learn it quickly.
* Comfortable with margin maths: contribution margin, cost of funds, breakeven and sensitivity analysis.
* Curious and analytical. You enjoy digging into data to find out why a number moved, and you keep going until you have the answer.
* Commercial instinct with discipline. You can work with Growth and Marketing to get a deal done, and say no, with numbers, when it gives away margin.
* Degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering or a related field.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience in subscription, leasing, rental, lending, BNPL or consumer electronics.
* Exposure to residual value, used-device or secondary-market pricing.
* Experience with price testing, elasticity analysis or demand modelling.
* Familiarity with BI tools and basic Python or R.
* Exposure to more than one Southeast Asian market, or to the Middle East.

title: Associate (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:

The Lead – Leasing & Warehousing will be responsible for driving leasing growth, optimizing warehouse occupancy, and supporting investment decisions across existing and prospective warehousing assets. Leasing & Business Development

Drive end-to-end leasing transactions, including lead generation, negotiations, LOI finalization, term sheet preparation, and execution of lease agreements. Collaborate with legal, finance, and operational teams to ensure timely closure of leasing opportunities. Support occupancy enhancement initiatives and maximize revenue realization across warehousing assets. Identify and develop relationships with prospective clients across diversified industry segments.

Investment Analysis & Commercial Evaluation

Evaluate new warehousing and leasing opportunities through financial modeling, IRR calculations, feasibility assessments, and business case preparation. Support investment decision-making by conducting techno-commercial evaluations and market viability studies. Monitor and analyze project financial performance against planned investment objectives.

Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

Act as a key point of contact for customers to address operational and commercial concerns. Drive superior customer experience through proactive engagement, issue resolution, and service excellence.

Market Intelligence & Business Insights

Track market trends, warehousing demand-supply dynamics, rental benchmarks, and competitor activities. Generate actionable market intelligence to support pricing strategies, leasing decisions, and business expansion initiatives. Strengthen direct customer engagement to understand evolving market requirements and identify growth opportunities.

Budgeting & Cost Management

Support annual budgeting exercises, leasing forecasts, and capital expenditure planning. Monitor leasing-related expenditures and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Contribute to cost optimization initiatives while maintaining operational effectiveness.

Contract & Compliance Management

Coordinate preparation, review, and execution of lease-related documentation. Ensure compliance with approved commercial terms, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements. Maintain contract records and monitor key lease obligations and milestones.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards to track leasing pipeline, occupancy levels, warehouse utilization, revenue performance, and turnaround timelines. Generate periodic management reports and present insights to business leadership for decision-making. Leverage CRM systems and digital tools to improve pipeline visibility and reporting accuracy.

Digital Transformation & Innovation

Drive adoption of digital platforms and automation tools across leasing and warehousing processes. Stay updated on emerging technologies, digital solutions, and AI-driven capabilities to improve business efficiency and competitiveness. Identify opportunities for process improvements through data analytics and technology enablement.

People Leadership

Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Mentor and guide team members to enhance capabilities and professional growth. Build high-performing teams focused on achieving business and customer-centric objectives.

Key Stakeholders

Internal Stakeholders: Business Head – Agri Logistics & Warehousing, Head – Warehousing, Functional Heads and Cross-Functional Teams, Operations, Finance, Legal, Projects, and Commercial Teams, Direct and Indirect Reportees. External Stakeholders: Customers across diverse industry sectors, Government and Regulatory Authorities, Industry Associations, Trade Bodies, and Federations, Consultants, Channel Partners, and Service Providers, Market Competitors and Industry Networks.

Educational Qualifications

Full-time Graduate from a recognized institution. MBA / PGDM in Business Administration, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline preferred.

Experience

10–15 years of relevant experience in Leasing, Warehousing, Industrial/Logistics Real Estate, Business Development, and Investment Analysis. Proven track record in leasing closures, commercial negotiations, client relationship management, and warehousing

**About Central Square Foundation**
Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working to ensure quality school education for all children in India. We believe strong foundational learning outcomes are critical for lifelong learning and equity. CSF focuses on four core areas: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN), EdTech, Early Childhood Education (ECE), and School Governance.
  
  
**About RMEAL At CSF**
The Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment & Learning (RMEAL) function at CSF serves as the organization's central evidence and learning spine. RMEAL partners closely with program verticals—including EdTech—to design, execute, quality-assure, and translate rigorous evidence into actionable insights for decision-making at scale.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Project Lead (Consultant) – RMEAL, you will drive the design, quality assurance, and learning agenda for evidence generation across CSF's EdTech and AI-enabled initiatives. You will work in close partnership with the EdTech vertical to ensure evaluations are methodologically robust, decision-relevant, and embedded into program and ecosystem strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Evidence Design & Methodological Execution:
  
  

* Design and review rigorous evaluation approaches (RCTs, quasi-experimental, mixed-methods).
* Review SAPs, tools, and analytical outputs.

**Evaluation Quality Assurance & Process Stewardship**

* Guide end-to-end evaluation processes.
* Use structured QA tools and templates.

**Learning, Insights & Translation**

* Translate findings into actionable insights and learning products.

**Technical Skills Required**

title: Treasury Dealer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Treasury Dealer (Front Office) to manage the Bank’s foreign exchange, money market, and government securities transactions within approved limits. The role will handle customer-related spot FX dealing, liquidity management, G-Sec/T-Bill transactions, ALM support, counterparty management, reporting, and treasury controls.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Execute interbank spot FX transactions arising from customer deals and cover positions within approved limits.
* Set daily card rates using FBIL rates and approved margins and price large transactions at live market rates.
* Record customer, base, and cover rates accurately on deal tickets.
* Execute call, notice, term money, interbank deposits, and TREPS transactions within approved limits.
* Purchase G-Secs and T-Bills for the HTM portfolio, including SLR holdings, through NDS-OM and RBI auctions.
* Project daily funds position and ensure CRR and SLR requirements are maintained.
* Prepare liquidity positions, cash-flow projections, and inputs for ALM statements.
* Prepare ALCO papers covering liquidity gaps, rate sensitivity, limits, and market outlook.
* Manage and develop approved banking counterparties, including onboarding, annual reviews, and SSIs.
* Prepare daily treasury position, profit reports, and market commentary.
* Submit required Head Office and regulatory reports accurately and within deadlines.
* Support drafting and revision of treasury policies and procedures in line with RBI and Head Office requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are conducted only through approved lines and platforms; report breaches and errors immediately.
* Prepare Legal Compliance Certificates where required and maintain strict separation between front-office dealing and settlement activities.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* Master's/MBA in Finance, FRM/CFA, and Refinitiv/Bloomberg experience preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in a Bank Treasury Front Office in India.
* Hands-on experience in Interbank Spot FX and G-Sec/T-Bill (HTM) dealing.
* Strong knowledge of FEMA, FEDAI rules, RBI inter-bank dealing directions, CRR, SLR, and RBI ALM requirements.
* Working knowledge of CCIL platforms, including FX-CLEAR, NDS-OM, NDS-Call, and TREPS.
* Ability to work accurately under pressure with strong written and spoken English.
* Experience with foreign bank branches, ALM/ALCO, or treasury policy drafting preferred.

**Job Opportunity: Senior Financial Analyst**
**Company Overview**
**Gallagher & Mohan**
is a distinguished firm specializing in delivering world-class financial analysis, marketing expertise, and accounting support tailored to the real estate sector. We serve an exclusive clientele of private equity investors, developers, fund managers, brokers, and other industry leaders. Renowned for our commitment to excellence, clear communication, and strong work ethic, we seamlessly integrate with our clients’ teams to create long-term value. Our portfolio spans diverse real estate transactions—from multifamily apartment communities to large-scale office towers across the United States and European markets, with deal sizes typically ranging from $25 million to over $500 million USD.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Financial Analyst at Gallagher & Mohan, you will play a pivotal role in driving insightful financial analysis and modeling. Utilizing your expertise in Microsoft Excel and adept modeling capabilities, you will craft comprehensive models from scratch and enhance existing client frameworks. Your responsibilities will extend to meticulous tracking and analysis of commercial real estate markets, preparing detailed reports on market trends and economic indicators, and serving as a trusted advisor with a profound understanding of macro and micro factors influencing the industry.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Argus Enterprise Mastery: Utilize Argus Enterprise extensively to develop, maintain, and enhance comprehensive financial models for real estate assets. Ensure accuracy and efficiency in cash-flow projections and asset valuations.
* DCF Modeling: Construct and refine Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) models to evaluate investment opportunities, asset performance, and future cash flows. Provide in-depth analysis and interpretation of model outputs.
* Model Optimization: Optimize and update Argus models to reflect changing market conditions, investment strategies, and financial structures. Ensure models are aligned with current financial practices and industry standards.
* Market Analysis: Conduct detailed market research and analysis to support Argus , Multi family assets and DCF modeling, including assessing property comparables and evaluating market trends.
* Reporting & Insights: Prepare and present detailed financial reports and insights based on Argus and DCF analyses. Communicate findings and strategic recommendations to senior management and clients.
* Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams during acquisitions, dispositions, and development projects, providing specialized Argus and DCF analysis to support strategic decision-making.
* Performance Evaluation: Assess and report on the performance of investments using key performance indicators (KPIs) such as IRR and Cash-on-Cash returns, integrating these metrics into Argus and DCF models.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Requirements – Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
* Argus Expertise: Extensive experience with Argus Enterprise software, including developing and managing detailed financial models for real estate assets.
* DCF Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) modeling, with the ability to create and analyze complex financial models and scenarios.
* Experience: 4-7 years of experience in financial modeling with a focus on Argus and DCF methodologies and Multi family assets . Background in equity research, investment banking, or real estate finance is advantageous.
* Analytical Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on deriving actionable insights from Argus and DCF analyses.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial concepts and findings effectively to diverse stakeholders.
* Organization: Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Principal Analyst (Physical AI Semiconductors, IOT, Market Intelligence, Forecast/ Market Sizing models)
description:
**About this Role :**
Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
  
  
As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders across the semiconductor and Physical AI ecosystems with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the MCUs, sensors and edge AI SoCs enabling Physical AI and convert system adoption, semiconductor content and architecture shifts into decision-useful forecasts, market shares and competitive intelligence.
  
  
**What You’ll do:**

* Develop and maintain global forecasts for MCUs, AI-enabled MCUs, edge AI SoCs, embedded AI accelerators and selected sensor semiconductor markets, including units, revenue, ASPs and vendor market share.
* Quantify semiconductor demand across industrial automation, robotics, automotive, drones, machine vision, smart cameras, intelligent edge systems and other major Physical AI applications.
* Build bottom-up semiconductor-content models linking Physical AI system shipments to MCU, edge processor, sensor, memory, connectivity and power-semiconductor content.
* Develop adoption and penetration models distinguishing total device shipments, AI-capable devices, devices actively running AI workloads and Physical AI deployments.
* Track MCU and embedded processor transitions including 32-bit MCUs, MCU + NPU architectures, real-time processors and heterogeneous CPU/GPU/NPU SoCs.
* Track perception and sensing semiconductor markets including CMOS image sensors, MEMS/IMUs, time-of-flight/depth sensing, radar semiconductor content, intelligent sensors and sensor-fusion processors.
* Analyze architecture transitions, design wins, ASP/content growth, competitive positioning and vendor market-share shifts driven by edge AI and Physical AI adoption.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases, vendor-share analysis and scenario models.
* Provide evidence-based written responses and support VP/market-intelligence-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering robotics, automotive, AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging, memory, networking and power semiconductors to quantify cross-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in-formal knowledge sharing sessions.

**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
  
  

* MCUs / Edge AI SoCs: units, revenue, ASPs, vendor market share, architecture mix, end-market mix, AI-enabled penetration, TOPS/device, power envelope and adoption of MCU + NPU and heterogeneous CPU/GPU/NPU architectures.
* Sensors / Physical AI Content: units, revenue, ASPs, vendor share and application penetration for relevant perception sensors, plus semiconductor content per robot, drone, autonomous machine, smart camera and other Physical AI system.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the quantitative semiconductor-market truth layer for Physical AI, focused on MCUs, sensors and edge AI processors. It does not own robotics or automotive system strategy, AI software/platform strategy, data-center accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging, memory, networking systems or power-semiconductor markets. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect Physical AI semiconductor demand, content and competitive dynamics.

**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**

* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate + MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A & B-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 5-7+ years minimum experience in semiconductor market intelligence, MCU/embedded processors, sensors, edge AI, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Strong expertise in one or more of MCUs, embedded processors, sensors or edge AI SoCs, with the ability to develop credible quantitative coverage across the broader Physical AI semiconductor stack.
* Strong understanding of embedded and edge AI architectures, end-market demand, semiconductor content, technology transitions and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models, market-share analysis and forecasts.
* Experience with semiconductor vendors, market-research firms, industrial/robotics ecosystems, automotive suppliers or relevant electronics supply-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting embedded AI and Physical AI markets, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:
* Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
* Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must - ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners).
* Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers.
* Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance.

**Who You Are**
To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as
**THE**
experts. This means that:
  
  

* You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees.
* You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
* You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus).
* You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
* You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

title: Financial Control Accountant
description:
**Job Description**
We’re looking for a Financial Control Accountant, FP&A Lead to join our FP&A team within the
**North America**
business. The primary purpose of this role is to lead forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis activity, with ownership of the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, forecast models, management reporting and the communication of financial conclusions to senior stakeholders.
  
  
You’ll report into the FP&A Manager and work closely with the
**Head of Finance - North America Markets**
and senior stakeholders across the business. Responsible for coordinating planning inputs, setting timetables, reviewing outputs, challenging assumptions and providing clear conclusions on performance, risks and opportunities. The role also supports relevant month-end activity and works closely with Finance Control, while retaining FP&A leadership as its principal focus.
  
  
**The responsibilities will include:**

* Lead the annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes, setting timetables, coordinating inputs across the business and taking ownership of delivery to agreed deadlines.
* Own and maintain Excel forecast models, ensuring assumptions, methodologies and data inputs from multiple sources are robust, consistent and appropriately documented.
* Review budget and forecast submissions, challenge assumptions and outputs, and resolve gaps or inconsistencies with relevant stakeholders.
* Analyse monthly ledger data and performance against budget and forecast to identify underlying drivers, trends, variances, risks and opportunities.
* Produce clear, accurate and timely management reporting, translating financial analysis into conclusions and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate North America regional inputs for ExCo and stakeholder presentations, ensuring outputs are complete, consistent and supported by appropriate analysis.
* Act as the primary FP&A point of contact for budget, forecast and performance queries from the wider business.
* Partner with senior stakeholders across the Markets business, providing constructive challenge and communicating the financial implications of business decisions.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports and analysis to support decision-making and respond to emerging business priorities.
* Support relevant month-end tasks, investigate variances and work with the Finance Control Team to ensure actuals are understood and reflected appropriately in planning and reporting.

**What are we ideally looking for in a successful candidate:**

* CA/CFA qualified or equivalent (preferred), with established experience in financial planning and analysis, management reporting or a closely related finance discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles, including setting timetables, coordinating contributors, reviewing submissions and delivering consolidated outputs.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, SUMIFS, charts and pivot tables, with proven experience building, maintaining and reviewing forecast models.
* Strong analytical capability, with a track record of interpreting ledger and operational data, explaining variances and identifying material risks and opportunities.
* Experience producing management reporting and presenting clear financial conclusions, implications and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and build effective relationships across all levels.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-orientated environment and managing competing priorities to agreed deadlines.
* Commercial mindset, sound judgement and a proactive approach to resolving issues and improving planning and reporting processes.
* Background in public practice or corporate.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple regions, including North America and global teams.
* Ability to operate autonomously, coordinate cross-functional inputs and make logical, evidence-based decisions.

**What is in it for you?**

* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing global business that is leading the delivery of financial services and partners with some of the world’s largest companies.
* Remuneration and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority.
* We provide significant financial rewards for high performing individuals.
* Global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the US, Canada, UK, Czech Republic, Australia, New Zealand, or China.

**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Analyze and interpret entity, portfolio, and property-level financial data, including historical performance and forecasts, to support valuation and advisory engagements.
* Develop and review Argus Enterprise models and Excel-based valuation models for commercial real estate assets including office, industrial, retail, multifamily, hospitality, self-storage, medical office, senior housing, and data center properties.
* Conduct economic, market, industry, and property-level research to assess factors impacting real estate values and investment decisions. Utilize market research databases including CoStar, Green Street, RCA Analytics, REIS, and other industry resources to support valuation conclusions and market analyses.
* Develop, customize, and maintain valuation models using methodologies such as discounted cash flow, direct capitalization, sales comparison, and cost approaches.

Perform fair value analyses under ASC 820, including assessment of market participant assumptions, highest and best use considerations, and application of income, market, and cost approaches.
* Prepare and review valuation analyses, supporting workpapers, and client deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with professional standards.
