Provide technical observations, recommendations, and audit support documentation to engagement teams.
* Review work performed by Associates, provide technical guidance and coaching, assist with onboarding and training initiatives, support quality control processes, and contribute to the professional development of junior team members.
* Stay current on valuation methodologies, accounting guidance, and real estate market trends through continuing education, professional development, and independent research.
* Prepare and review audit review memoranda, valuation reports, technical summaries, and client deliverables ensuring consistency between valuation models, supporting documentation, and final conclusions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in real estate valuation, appraisal, audit support reviews, financial reporting valuations, transaction advisory services, real estate consulting, or related valuation disciplines.
* Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills required
* Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required, along with preferred strong writing abilities and availability to travel for client-related work.
* Experience performing real estate valuations, appraisal reviews, audit support engagements, purchase price allocations, ASC 820 fair value analyses, or real estate advisory engagements preferred.
* Experience with Argus Enterprise, CoStar, and other commercial real estate research and valuation platforms preferred. Ability to develop, review, and analyze property-level cash flow models is highly desirable.

The role will provide strategic financial leadership across business planning, system economics, value-chain management, Revenue Growth Management (RGM), margin optimization, marketing investments, governance and business performance. The role will work closely with the Operations Finance Lead and is an individual contributor position.

+ Optimize business models and system top-line growth by bottler and geography, balancing Company and bottler economics.
+ Develop and implement margin optimization strategies across the end-to-end value chain; set and track margin objectives across bottlers, categories, brands and packs.
+ Embed margin discipline into operational decisions and execute global margin strategies locally by leveraging the broader network.
+ Monitor commodity prices, product formulations, productivity, mix and pricing levers to mitigate inflation and improve system economics.

+ Provide end-to-end finance partnership for RGM, including pricing strategy, commercial assumptions, bottler alignment and financialization of agreed RGM plans.
+ Partner on new product and service development, including concentrate pricing and financial alignment with bottlers.
+ Partner with Franchise, Commercial and Marketing teams on new products and business models, including concentrate pricing and financial alignment with bottlers.

+ Lead financial stewardship of Direct Marketing Expense (DME) budgets across SWA markets.
+ Partner with the business to support frontline marketing execution and evaluate initiative effectiveness.
+ Establish quarterly and annual spend objectives jointly with bottlers; establish rebate and deduction strategies and lead related external negotiations.

* Governance, controls & operational stewardship

+ Ensure Company policies, procedures, regulatory requirements and financial controls are consistently followed by the team and bottler partners.
+ Provide oversight of bottler support processes and Purchase Order workflows, ensuring appropriate governance and controls are in place.

* Insights & strategic business partnership

+ Partner with Franchise, Strategy, Customer & Commercial, Marketing and other cross-functional teams to develop quantitative and qualitative insights on business issues.
+ Integrate financial, consumer, customer, competitive and macroeconomic insights to support fact-based decisions with bottling partners.
+ Bring together financial and commercial perspectives to challenge assumptions, shape choices and influence decisions across the SWA system.

+ Country franchise leads and marketing teams
+ 5 countries bottling teams (Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Bhutan)
+ Partnering internally and externally to effectively drive financial outcomes, as well as to build alignment on key initiatives and metrics, with a focus on communication to: Franchise GM, Franchise Units + Key Regional Stakeholders and Other OU leadership teams, platform services team and supply chain team.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* 12 years of leadership experience in senior financial planning, commercial finance, Business partnering for sales, supply chain, or financial accounting roles.
* Extensive management experience, with ability to work in a diverse cultural environment as a highly efficient communicator and influencer at all levels.
* Mastery of Influence and Communication, Knowledge and Insights, People Leadership, Strategic Thinking, Advanced Technical Skills.

* Fast/Agile: Removes barriers to move faster. Experiments and adapts. Thrives under pressure and at a fast pace.
* Empowered: Brings solutions instead of problems. Challenges the status quo. Has the courage to take an unpopular stance.

**What We Can Do For You**

title: Decision Analyst
description:

**Role Overview**

Communication & Reporting: Present complex or sensitive information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior management.

* Strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Build effective cross-functional relationships and influence business outcomes.

title: Sr. Executive  Finance & Accounts
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Executive / Sr. Executive — Finance & Accounts will be responsible for managing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, Tax / cost accounting, inventory reconciliation, inter-division purchase allocations, and statutory compliance (VAT/GST/Sales Tax filings) across domestic and international entities. The role demands strong hands-on experience in tax compliance, reconciliation, GL accounting, ERP operations and an eye for detail in multi-entity environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Inventory Allocation: Inventory allocation from one entity to multiple entities; maintain opening, movement and closing inventory (accounting for transit time gaps).

COGS: Prepare and allocate COGS as per purchase / inventory movement / closing inventory.

VAT / Sales Tax Return Filing: File all applicable VAT / GST / Sales Tax returns as per the statutory due date calendar for US, EU, UAE, Brazil, Mexico, Australia, Canada, Cyprus and New Zealand; maintain filing / compliance tracker.

Input / Output Credit: Track and maintain records of all input and output credit taken.

Reconciliation: Reconcile all input / output credit factors against financial numbers (revenue/sales, expenses, customs duty/BOE based input credit).

Accounts Payable: Support international divisions with booking of expenses and bank / Amex transactions.

ELIGIBILITY & REQUIREMENTS

Education: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; semi-qualified CA / CMA preferred.

Experience: Executive — 2 to 4 years in international tax / accounts payable / cost accounting / GL. Sr. Executive — 4 to 7 years with hands-on multi-entity or international accounting exposure.

Technical Skills: ERP experience with Perfect Fit / Odoo preferred; proficiency in MS Excel including advanced reconciliation and pivot tables; working knowledge of VAT / GST / Sales Tax compliance across US states, Canada, UAE, EU, Brazil, Mexico, Australia and New Zealand; experience in inventory accounting and inter-company / inter-division transactions.

Soft Skills: High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data; ability to handle multiple deadlines and monthly closing pressures; strong written and verbal communication for inter-team coordination; self-driven with the ability to work independently and escalate issues proactively.

title: Vice President - Finance Control
description:
Join us as a Vice President - Finance Control at Barclays, where you'll manage the financial operations of the Corporate Banking business, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.. You'll harness cutting edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experience.
  
  
To be successful as a Vice President - Finance Control, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Qualified CA / CPA / ACCA / MBA preferred.
* Finance technology familiarity.
* Experience in sub‑ledger implementations and modern Finance platforms & regulatory awareness.
* Understanding of evolving regulatory expectations relating to data quality, governance, and reporting.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset.
* Ability to bring innovation, challenge status‑quo, and drive automation.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Strong understanding of Finance Control and Banking processes, including ledger and sub-ledger.
* Knowledge of multi‑GAAP accounting principles, IFRS, financial reporting, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ability to resolve complex accounting and data issues across Finance systems and products.
* Strong knowledge of governance frameworks such as SOX, audit readiness, and control design.
* Ability to embed risk management principles in Finance processes and ensure compliance with Barclays’ Policy & Controls standards.
* Experience leading Finance transformation or large‑scale process redesign initiatives.
* Capability to modernize legacy processes and reduce manual interventions/EUDA usage.
* Ability to influence, align, and communicate with senior stakeholders across Finance, Tech, Transformation, and Operations.
* Experience running governance forums, SME working groups, and driving decisions through complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Strong leadership behaviors aligned to Barclays LEAD model (Listen, Energize, Align, Develop).
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret data, identify issues, and drive structured solutions.
* Ability to troubleshoot reconciliation, variance analysis, and data‑quality challenges.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for articulating requirements, risks, and outcomes.
* Ability to simplify complex topics for senior management consumption.
* Ability to partner with Business partners, Operations, Technology teams, and Finance teams across Corporate Bank and other business of the bank.
* Strong collaboration working within matrix organization.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To manage the financial operations of the organisation, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of financial reporting.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial statements, and other accounting records in accordance with the relevant accounting standards, rules and regulations.
* Support in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Development and maintenance of a robust system of internal controls to safeguard assets, ensure that there is no fraudulent misreporting, and ensure the accuracy of financial data, including regular assessment of the effectiveness of internal controls addressing any weaknesses or gaps. .
* Development and implementation of up-to-date financial policies and procedures to ensure consistent and effective financial practices across the organisation.
* Management of the selection, implementation, and maintenance of financial systems and software applications, including collaboration with IT colleagues to integrate financial systems with other enterprise systems.
* Preparation and submission of statutory and regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to other departments in their preparation and review of regulatory reports.
* Coordination with external auditors and regulatory authorities in support of audits and examinations.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Assistant Manager - Operations, Investment
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL Investments manages approx. Euro 38 billion investment portfolio. AXA XL Investment has three strategic locations for its operations. New York, Bermuda and India. Investment Operations is responsible for maintaining a high degree of data integrity, multiple system maintenance, and high-end reporting delivery along with other operational tasks for AXA XL Investment Management. Consumers of this data include Fixed Income, Investment reporting, Investment Compliance, and Risk management teams.
  
  
The Data Integrity Team is a part of Global Investment Operation’s Group, It is a dedicated group of professionals who ensure that all AXA XL cash & positions data are accurate for critical processes including investment management, analytics, compliance, and regulatory reporting. Cash & Position types include, but are not limited to, equities, fixed income, OTC derivative positions (swaps, swaptions, FXs, and) and collateral. The roles and responsibilities will include actively executing data validation controls and related reconciliations by ensuring the Investment book of record is reconciled with the custodian, manager.
  
  
The position will be responsible for carrying out other controls including some specific to cash, position reconciliations and exception management processes ensuring that AXA XL Portfolio data is in line with custodians, counterparties and other prime record holders every day. The team member will Laise with data vendors, other internal investment functions like Fixed Income, Risk and Strategy team, Investment Accounting and Treasury to resolve data related issues. Your primary upward interaction will be with a direct supervisor or team lead and other Investment Functions across various geographical locations. In this role, you need to analyze and solve moderately complex problems.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Review reference data attributes of Fixed Income Bonds (ABS, MBS, Corporate Bonds Term loans, Sovereign Bonds), Listed Equity, Private Credit and Private Equity and work with data vendors & accounting team to record accurate data points across systems.

You will report to Delivery Leader, Data Integrity Group (India).
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance/economics.
* Relevant years of experience in back-office operations in financial services industry.
* Working knowledge of financial markets & asset management related processes and data.
* Good understanding of data management processes including like defining Data validations rules, Data exceptions monitoring and handling.
* Ability to understand and work with data, including creating alignment among various data sources.
* Excellent communication skills require interacting with internal colleagues and external vendors to resolve queries or complete a task in hand.
* Experience of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Good knowledge about capital market and Investment instruments with the respect to global financial environment.
* Must have robust analytical skills with technical bent of mind.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Prior experience in working on systems like Bloomberg would be an advantage.
* Knowledge of Power BI, proficiency in Power queries.
* Knowledge of Blackrock Aladdin or Simcorp would be added advantage.
* CFA / FRM (Level -1) preferable (not mandatory).

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Requires minimal supervision and being able to work self supportedly to complete the given task and proactively reach out to respective team to seek solutions when required.
* Must be detail conscious, technically motivated, creative, and user oriented.
* Ability to work with huge volume data.
* The collective player with the ability to engage with multiple teams in a large organization.
* Professional outlook towards work.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

title: Auditor
description:
The role is responsible for conducting
**independent, risk-based audits of the Bank’s Retail Assets portfolio**
to assess the effectiveness of credit underwriting, approval, documentation, monitoring and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role provides independent assurance on the
**quality of retail credit decisions, adherence to the Bank’s credit policies and regulatory requirements, effectiveness of internal controls, and identification of emerging credit risks**
across retail lending products. It also recommends corrective actions to strengthen the overall credit risk and control environment.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Credit Audit & Assurance
* Conduct periodic and risk-based audits of the Bank’s Retail Assets portfolio.
* Independently evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of credit underwriting, sanctioning, documentation and monitoring processes.
* Assess adherence to approved credit policies, product programmes, delegation of authority and internal risk frameworks.
* Review credit files and customer accounts using appropriate sampling methodologies.
* Identify material deviations, control weaknesses and potential areas of credit risk.
* Evaluate whether identified risks are appropriately recognised, classified, monitored and mitigated.
* Retail Asset Portfolio Review

**Audit Credit Processes Across Applicable Retail Lending Portfolios, Including**

* Home Loans / Mortgages
* Loan Against Property
* Personal Loans
* Auto / Vehicle Loans
* Education Loans
* Credit Cards
* Consumer Finance
* Other secured and unsecured retail lending products

Assess portfolio-level indicators to identify
**concentration risk, underwriting trends, delinquency patterns, early warning signals and deterioration in portfolio quality**
.
  
  

* Underwriting & Credit Decision Review
* Assess the quality and consistency of underwriting decisions.
* Review borrower eligibility, income assessment, repayment capacity and creditworthiness.
* Evaluate adherence to product-specific underwriting parameters and approval conditions.
* Review bureau reports, banking behaviour, collateral and other applicable credit assessment inputs.
* Examine policy deviations and exceptions to determine whether these have been appropriately justified and approved.
* Identify patterns that could indicate weaknesses in sourcing, underwriting or credit decision-making.
* Credit Controls & Risk Management
* Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls across the retail credit lifecycle.
* Review maker-checker controls and delegated lending authorities.
* Assess controls relating to customer onboarding, credit assessment, documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement monitoring.
* Identify process gaps that may expose the Bank to credit, operational, fraud, compliance or reputational risks.
* Assess the effectiveness of Early Warning Signals and other credit monitoring mechanisms.
* Regulatory & Policy Compliance
* Assess compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and internal policies governing retail credit.
* Evaluate adherence to KYC/AML requirements where relevant to the credit audit scope.
* Highlight regulatory or policy breaches and assess their risk implications.
* Keep abreast of changes in the regulatory environment, credit policies and industry practices relevant to retail lending.
* Audit Reporting & Issue Closure
* Prepare clear, evidence-based audit observations and reports covering findings, root causes, risk implications and recommendations.
* Assign appropriate risk significance to audit observations based on impact and control weakness.
* Discuss findings with Credit, Business, Operations and Risk stakeholders.
* Agree appropriate management actions and timelines for closure.
* Track outstanding audit observations and independently validate remediation and closure.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue issues to appropriate senior stakeholders.
* Data Analytics & Thematic Reviews
* Use portfolio data and analytics to identify unusual trends, outliers and high-risk segments.
* Conduct thematic reviews across products, locations, channels or segments.
* Identify systemic issues beyond individual credit files and recommend portfolio-level interventions.
* Support increasing use of data-led and technology-enabled auditing within Credit Audit.
* Stakeholder Management

**Partner Effectively, While Maintaining Audit Independence, With**

* Retail Credit
* Retail Assets Business
* Credit Risk
* Operations
* Collections
* Fraud Risk
* Compliance
* Internal Audit
* Senior Management

Communicate complex credit risks and audit findings in a clear and commercially relevant manner.
  
  

* Key Deliverables
* Completion of assigned credit audits as per the approved audit plan.
* High-quality and timely credit audit reports.
* Identification of material and emerging credit risks.
* Effective tracking and validation of remediation actions.
* Identification of systemic and recurring control weaknesses.
* Actionable recommendations that strengthen the Retail Assets credit control environment.
* Timely escalation of significant credit and control concerns.
* Key Skills & Competencies

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong understanding of retail credit underwriting and credit risk management.
* Knowledge of secured and unsecured retail lending products.
* Understanding of the end-to-end retail credit lifecycle.
* Credit appraisal and financial assessment capabilities.
* Understanding of credit policies, product programmes and approval authorities.
* Knowledge of portfolio monitoring, delinquency and asset-quality indicators.
* Understanding of internal controls and risk-based auditing.
* Ability to interpret portfolio MIS and undertake data-driven credit reviews.
* Sound understanding of applicable banking and credit regulations.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking ability.
* Independent judgement and professional scepticism.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to identify root causes rather than only transactional exceptions.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Integrity and objectivity.
* Effective stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit assignments.

**Education**
CA / MBA Finance / CFA / FRM / CIA or other relevant professional qualification would be advantageous.
  
  
**Experience**

* Relevant 2-8 experience in Retail Credit, Credit Risk, Credit Audit, Internal Audit or Retail Assets underwriting within a bank or financial institution.
* Experience across multiple retail lending products would be preferred.
* Prior exposure to credit portfolio analytics, risk assessment or regulatory reviews would be advantageous.
* Role Success Measures

**Success In The Role Would Be Measured Through**

* Quality and timeliness of audit execution.
* Effectiveness in identifying significant credit and control risks.
* Quality and practical relevance of audit recommendations.
* Timely closure and validation of audit observations.
* Reduction in repeat observations.
* Effectiveness of thematic and portfolio-level risk identification.
* Quality of engagement with Credit, Risk, Business and senior stakeholders.

**About The Role**
Commure's finance team is rebuilding revenue accounting from the ground up, and this role is the architect of that rebuild. We're creating a brand-new Manager, Revenue Accounting & Deal Operations position to do two things at once: stand up our deal desk function from scratch, and modernize the technical infrastructure that supports revenue recognition across a fast-growing, multi-product healthcare technology business.
  
  
This isn't a maintain-the-status-quo role. Building the process, the playbooks, and the cross-functional muscle memory with Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations that doesn't yet exist at scale. In parallel, you'll partner with our broader revenue accounting team on close, reconciliations, and audit support, and you'll have real influence over which tools and automation we adopt to get there. Our finance team invests aggressively in emerging finance technology, and you'll have the opportunity to engage in the debate and build out around how AI and automation should change the way revenue accounting and deal desk work gets done.
  
  
If you want to build something from a blank page rather than inherit a finished process, and you want a direct hand in shaping how a scaling, IPO-track company runs deal desk and revenue accounting, this is that seat.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Revenue Accounting Transformation & Technical Accounting-**
**Modernize revenue accounting processes**
: Transform the revenue accounting lifecycle, from contract review through revenue recognition, with a focus on scalability, automation, and IPO-ready internal controls.
  
  
**Lead technical accounting assessments:**
Research complex accounting matters and prepare technical accounting memos under ASC 606, covering multi-element arrangements, complex contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
  
  
**Develop and maintain accounting policies:**
Establish, maintain, and enhance revenue recognition policies to ensure consistent application across an expanding and diversifying product portfolio.
  
  
**Technology & Automation-**
**Drive technology adoption**
: Evaluate and implement revenue automation solutions and AI-enabled finance tools to reduce manual effort, and revenue accounting workflows, and improve accuracy and efficiency.
  
  
**Operational Revenue Accounting**
**Support monthly and quarterly close:**
Collaborate on revenue close activities, including account reconciliations, journal entries, deferred revenue analysis, and account-level reviews, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
  
  
**Strengthen financial controls**
: Support external audits and develop scalable, SOX-compliant processes that promote accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Partnership**
**Partner with FP&A**
: Support revenue forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis by providing accurate, well-documented accounting inputs and clear explanations of revenue trends.
  
  
**Compliance & Audit-**
**Support external financial audits:**
Prepare schedules and supporting documentation requested by auditors (PBC schedules), respond to revenue-related inquiries, and ensure audit requirements are met accurately and on time.
  
  
**Drive IPO readiness**
: Strengthen revenue recognition policies, process documentation, and internal controls to align with public-company reporting and compliance expectations.
  
  
**What You Have-**

* 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience specifically in Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, or Technical Accounting within a high-growth or complex business environment.
* Strong expertise in US GAAP and ASC 606, with the ability to independently interpret and apply revenue recognition guidance to complex accounting scenarios.
* Proven experience reviewing and assessing complex customer contracts, including multi-element arrangements, non-standard commercial terms, contract modifications, variable consideration, and performance obligations to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
* Hands-on experience managing revenue accounting activities, including contract assessments, revenue recognition analysis, deferred revenue, journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end or quarter-end close.
* Experience preparing technical accounting memos, documenting accounting judgments, and establishing consistent revenue recognition policies and procedures.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or CA preferred.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and revenue automation tools, with an interest in AI-enabled finance technology.
* Experience supporting external financial audits and developing or maintaining SOX-compliant processes and internal controls.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex accounting matters to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership of ambiguous situations, and drive process improvements in a fast-paced, scaling private-company environment.
* Experience working with US-based businesses, customers, or Finance teams and applying US GAAP in a US-market business environment is highly desirable.

IQ-EQ is seeking a Senior Officer – Financial Reporting to lead the delivery of high-quality financial reporting services for private equity, hedge fund, real estate, and other alternative investment clients. * Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You hold a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline and bring at least 6 years of accounting experience, including 2–3 years in a supervisory or team leadership role.

* You possess strong financial reporting expertise, with hands-on experience preparing and reviewing working papers, financial statements, and disclosures for private equity, hedge funds, real estate, and other alternative investment structures across IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP, Lux GAAP, and Canadian GAAP.
* You are highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel (including pivot tables, lookups, and IF functions), and have experience using accounting platforms such as Investran or Paxus, supported by excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language skills are an advantage.
* You ideally hold or are working towards a professional qualification such as CA, CPA, or ACCA and have experience in financial services, shared services, or multinational environments, with the flexibility to travel and undertake international secondment opportunities when required.

title: Treasurer
description:
**Job Description: Treasurer - Cash Management, Systems & Back Office**

INETUM is an agile IT service provider, an international group certified Top Employer Europe 2025. In the post-digital transformation era, we are committed to ensuring that each of our 28,000 digital athletes can continuously renew themselves, positively experiencing their own digital flow.

Each of our talents can shape their career path according to their preferences, pragmatically engage with their clients for a world with a positive impact, innovate locally in 28 countries, and harmonize their professional investment and personal well-being.

**Job Description:**

As part of the Group Treasury team’s development, we are looking for a Treasurer to support cash management, back-office activities and treasury systems administration within the Group Financing and Treasury Department.

Reporting to the Head of Cash Management, Systems & Back Office, this role is part of a lean Group Treasury team of five people and offers broad exposure to day-to-day treasury operations, internal controls and treasury tools in an international environment.

The successful candidate will contribute to the smooth execution of treasury processes, support subsidiaries on operational topics, and participate in the continuous improvement of treasury systems and procedures.

Cash Management:

* Manage daily cash flow with a target of zero cash balance and minimize financial and banking fees.
* Establish the Group Treasury's liquidity position in different currencies.
* Ensure the proper execution of payments and management of bank balances.
* Optimize and improve intra-Group liquidity management performance.
* Liaise with subsidiaries on cash management (cash management, foreign exchange) and assist them in optimizing their daily liquidity management.
* Monitor and control banking fees across the Group to ensure continuous rationalization.
* Participate in the daily cash forecasting process in coordination with Front, Middle Office, and subsidiaries.

Back Office:

* Control, validate, and follow up on financial operations initiated by the Front Office.
* Systematically document market operations.
* Ensure the security and proper execution of all group payment operations.
* Maintain and update procedures and controls related to Cash Management and Back Office.
* Contribute to the implementation of best practices in internal control, task segregation, and fraud prevention.
* Participate in team projects: bank tenders, process optimization, inclusion of new companies, etc.
* Review and update guides, operating procedures, and documentation.

Treasury IT Systems Administration:

* Support the administration of the treasury IT systems (treasury software, banking communication platform, market data management software).
* Provide support to treasury system users.
* Train users (FTD and subsidiaries) on treasury IT systems.
* Participate in treasury IT system development projects.
* Gather user needs (FTD, Accounting), implement functional changes internally or with software vendors.
* Maintain daily contact with the IT department and software vendors.
* Draft specifications, procedures, and operating manuals.
* Provide functional support for testing and validating system changes.

Required Skills:

* Master's degree in finance and/or treasury
* 3–6 years of experience in an international company or an audit/consulting firm specializing in treasury
* The ideal candidate combines rigor, reliability and autonomy, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to perform effectively in a demanding international environment
* A strong understanding of cash management, cash pooling techniques, payment processes and treasury systems is required. Experience with Kyriba would be a plus. Exposure to project-based environments would also be appreciated
* Strong communication skills are also important for success in the role (written and verbal) in English (Spanish would be a plus)

Working Conditions:

* Full-time position based in India
* Opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment

title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Rates Researcher to support a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project.
  
  
The role involves evaluating AI-generated quantitative research and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in quantitative finance, rates markets, statistical modeling, and backtesting methodologies to assess research quality, validate assumptions, and identify methodological flaws.
  
  
Prior experience with AI systems is not required. Strong domain expertise in quantitative finance and interest rate markets is the primary requirement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and evaluate quantitative research outputs and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets.
* Identify research and backtesting issues, including lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
* Evaluate backtesting frameworks, including rates-specific mechanics such as carry, roll-down analytics, and contract roll conventions.
* Assess the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Review yield curve models, relative value strategies, and interest rate trading instruments.
* Validate model assumptions, implementation accuracy, and research methodologies.
* Evaluate strategies under realistic market conditions, accounting for transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and execution assumptions.
* Provide detailed written feedback with actionable recommendations to improve research quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators to clarify findings and communicate technical insights.
* Contribute to improving quantitative research evaluation methodologies.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in quantitative research, quantitative analysis, or quantitative finance.
* Strong expertise in fixed income analysis and interest rate markets.
* Advanced proficiency in Python or R for quantitative research and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy.
* Strong understanding of systematic trading strategy development and backtesting.
* Experience with yield curve modeling and carry/roll-down analytics.
* Knowledge of relative value trading strategies and interest rate market instruments.
* Familiarity with SOFR and Eurodollar instruments, as well as Treasury futures.
* Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Understanding of transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and realistic trading assumptions.
* Ability to identify lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and other research methodology flaws.
* Excellent analytical, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, or Consultant specializing in fixed income or interest rate markets.
* Experience developing and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset management firm, or investment bank.
* Strong practical knowledge of rates trading, yield curve dynamics, and quantitative modeling.
* Experience reviewing and validating quantitative models against established quantitative finance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to assess research quality, implementation fidelity, model assumptions, and statistical robustness.

title: Analyst- Accounts Payable
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Houston, Portland and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented AP professional to join our Finance Operations team in Hyderabad. You will be a key member of a lean, high-trust AP function supporting DESRI's US entities, working closely with colleagues across Hyderabad and the United States. This role requires strong ownership, US AP expertise and commitment to control and accuracy.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will manage the end-to-end accounts payable cycle for DESRI's US entities across the following areas:
  
  

* Vendor Setup & US Tax Compliance- Set up domestic and foreign vendors in Workday using W-9 and W-8 series forms (W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E); administer year-end 1099 filings (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC); enforce banking verification protocols via AVS portal to prevent fraud.
* Invoice Processing- Process supplier invoices in Workday with accurate GL coding, cost-centre allocation and payment terms; perform three-way matching against POs and contracts; review invoices for Sales & Use Tax accuracy; prevent duplicate payments; support ACH, wire, and cheque payment execution.
* Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination. Liaise with suppliers and asset managers to obtain missing invoices and resolve payment queries; perform periodic vendor statement reconciliations; collaborate closely with Hyderabad and US teams on accurate invoice processing.
* Reporting, Contracts & Draw Support. Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly AP reports in Workday (aging analysis, on-hold trackers); set up supplier contracts (SC) and POs; support the Asset Management and Construction Finance teams on monthly draw payments, including WTCs, retainage tracking and lien waiver documentation.
* Expense & Card Program Management- Manage monthly American Express payments and site visit reimbursements for US employees; audit expense reports for T&E policy compliance, ensuring receipts, business purpose and approvals are in place before reimbursement.
* Month-End Close & Treasury. Clean the AP aging report monthly; initiate payment requests with the treasury team; support month-end close; coordinate financial settlement runs and reconciliation with treasury and accounting teams.
* Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement- Support internal and external audit requests (sample selections, walkthroughs, evidence packs); monitor stale-dated cheques for escheatment reporting; identify and implement efficiency improvements including AP automation platforms (e.g., Auditoria).

**Qualifications-**
The ideal candidate should hold –
  
  

* Education: Degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field
* Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on Accounts Payable experience, preferably supporting US-based entities
* Skills: Working knowledge of US AP practices: 1099 reporting, W-9 / W-8 form handling, Sales and Use Tax review, Hands-on experience with Workday Financials or a comparable enterprise ERP, Strong Excel skills for aging analysis, reconciliations and reporting; keen attention to detail, Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Work Style: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment both autonomously and collaboratively with teams located across different time zones and jurisdictions.

**Preferred Qualifications (if Any)**

* Prior experience in the renewable energy sector, infrastructure/EPC or project-based finance
* Familiarity with construction AP concepts: retainage, lien waivers, milestone-based draws
* Exposure to AP automation platforms (e.g., Auditoria, Tipalti); experience supporting SOX audits or controls-intensive finance functions.

The Article Trainee will collaborate with senior team members, maintain accurate records, adhere to professional standards, and continuously develop technical and professional skills through on-the-job learning.

* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and comfort working with accounting or ERP software and online compliance portals.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear workpapers, reports, and client correspondence.
* Attention to detail, integrity, and a disciplined work ethic, with the ability to manage time, meet deadlines, and follow professional standards.
* Willingness to learn, take feedback, and adapt to diverse assignments across industries and service lines.
* Prior internship or practical exposure in audit, accounting, or taxation is an advantage but not mandatory.

This role will support invoice gathering, claim loading, validation checks, CLD processing, dispute documentation, payment package preparation, reporting, reconciliation support, SOP documentation, controls, and operational improvement activities.
  
  
The role will partner with the Medicaid Manager, AIN team members, ATO Medicaid process owners, Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Information Systems, and other U.S.-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Medicaid operations. The Associate will be expected to learn Medicaid processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution before taking on broader independent responsibilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Medicaid Processing & Operational Execution*

* Support day-to-day execution of Medicaid rebate operations including invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, claim processing, payment package support, and documentation maintenance.
* Execute assigned standard-state activities in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for invoice status, CLD receipt, validation outcomes, open items, dispute status, payment package readiness, and evidence retention.
* Flag risks, missing information, aged items, access issues, or process exceptions to the Medicaid Manager and ATO retained owners.

*Invoice Validation & CLD Support*

* Perform first-pass invoice validation checks for assigned Medicaid states, including unit, NDC, reimbursement, URA, invoice, and source data reasonableness checks.
* Support CLD formatting, control checks, historical utilization comparison, duplicate discount screening support, and preparation of analysis files for review.
* Document validation findings, assumptions, supporting evidence, and required follow-up actions clearly and consistently.
* Escalate complex state nuances, high-risk exceptions, unusual utilization trends, or ambiguous payment/dispute issues for manager or ATO review.

*Dispute, Adjustment & Payment Package Support*

* Prepare dispute documentation, dispute tracking updates, response support, and evidence files for disputed units and rebate amounts.
* Support preparation of ROSI, PQAS, remittance, payment package, and SharePoint archival documentation in accordance with SOP requirements.
* Assist with prior quarter adjustments, supplemental claim support, interest calculation evidence, and payment reconciliation support as assigned.
* Maintain clean audit trails, decision logs, and supporting workpapers for Medicaid invoice and payment activities.

*Systems, Documentation & Continuous Improvement*

* Use Model N / PbN, SAP, Validata, SharePoint, state portals, reporting tools, and Microsoft 365 applications to support Medicaid workflow execution.
* Assist with UAT, defect documentation, access readiness tracking, SOP updates, work instruction drafting, training material preparation, and knowledge repository maintenance.
* Participate in KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution activities to build Medicaid process proficiency.
* Identify process gaps, manual effort reduction opportunities, recurring exceptions, documentation gaps, and quality improvement ideas.

*Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness*

* Execute work in accordance with internal policies, Medicaid SOPs, controlled process requirements, documentation standards, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain accurate evidence for invoice receipt, validation, disputes, payment support, approvals, reconciliations, and archival steps.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, financial, or operational risks promptly and support remediation activities as assigned.
* Support audit, SOX, and control review activities by providing complete workpapers and organized documentation.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Medicaid / managed markets operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should bring ownership, accuracy, curiosity, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to support compliant and timely Medicaid rebate execution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebates, finance operations, revenue management, claims operations, analytics, or related controlled business operations.
* Strong Excel, documentation, reporting, analytical, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet timelines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a deadline-driven and highly controlled environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Medicaid rebate operations, payer rebates, managed markets finance, claims validation, CLD processing, dispute tracking, rebate adjudication, Gross-to-Net, or pharmaceutical revenue management.
* Experience with Model N / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of NDC, AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, ROSI, PQAS, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, and compliance documentation is desirable.
* Experience supporting SOPs, WSIs, audit-ready workpapers, issue trackers, UAT, system implementation, automation, or process improvement activities.
* Strong collaboration, communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work with U.S.-based stakeholders in a distributed global operating model.

title: Mars Transfer Pricing Transformation Manager

description:

**About the Organization**

We are an international non-profit organization dedicated to equipping adolescent girls with the skills, agency, and support required to access economic opportunities and break intergenerational cycles of poverty and inequality. Through our flagship initiatives, we support young women in carving out their own paths across entrepreneurship, formal employment, and higher education. Operating across multiple countries with a diverse network of local partners, our programs impact thousands of adolescent girls globally.

**Role Summary**

As our organization expands across South Asia and Africa, we are seeking a dynamic Senior Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) to drive our overarching MEL function. In this role, you will shape our strategic approach to measuring impact, generating actionable insights, and leveraging evidence to refine program design and operations.

Working closely with internal Program and Operations teams, you will strengthen measurement frameworks, build partner and team capacities, and cultivate a strong organizational culture of continuous learning, reflection, and accountability. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking with hands-on expertise in evaluation design, data systems, analysis, and evidence application within the development or education sectors.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Monitoring, Evaluation & Research**

* Lead the design, refinement, and rollout of comprehensive monitoring frameworks, logical frameworks, and outcome/output indicators.
* Design and oversee qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods evaluation approaches and measurement tools.
* Drive MEL strategies for program pilots and experimentation to enable iterative learning, adaptation, and scale.
* Lead and oversee priority research initiatives focusing on women's and adolescent girls' economic agency.

**2. Data Management, Analysis & Evidence**

* Strengthen data management, quality assurance, and tech-enabled monitoring tools (including digital dashboards integrated with internal and government platforms).
* Lead quantitative and qualitative data analysis, translating complex metrics into actionable insights for leadership and program teams.
* Establish organizational standards for data quality, consistency, accessibility, and ethical usage.

**3. Team Capacity & Data Culture**

* Foster an organizational culture where data and evidence actively inform day-to-day program decisions and operations.
* Build and lead the internal MEL team structure, defining clear roles and responsibilities to achieve functional goals.
* Enhance MEL capabilities among program staff, operations teams, and implementation partners through targeted training and mentoring.

**4. Stakeholder Engagement**

* Prepare high-quality, credible impact reports and evidence summaries for executive leadership, donors, government bodies, and external partners.
* Collaborate with Communications and Fundraising units to translate MEL insights into donor proposals, impact stories, and external communications.
* Represent the organization at relevant sector forums, research conferences, and MEL networks.

**5. Government Reporting, Systems & Accountability**

* Design and maintain systems for accurate, timely, and compliant reporting aligned with government frameworks and platforms.
* Harmonize internal indicator definitions and tools with public sector reporting formats and data quality requirements.
* Coordinate across regional and field teams to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and maintain rigorous documentation.
* Develop government-facing dashboards, evidence briefs, and progress reports detailing implementation, challenges, and corrective actions.
* Utilize government administrative data to optimize targeting, delivery quality, and scale decisions.

**Qualifications & Relevant Experience**

**Required:**

* **Education:**
  Master's degree in Development Studies, Economics, Statistics, Social Research, Public Policy, Education, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  6–8 years of experience in MEL within the development or education sector, including leadership of MEL functions or major evaluation/research projects.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Hands-on experience with data software and platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, SurveyCTO, KoboToolbox, ODK, SPSS, Stata, or R.
* **Research & Evaluation:**
  Demonstrated experience designing and executing end-to-end evaluations using quantitative, qualitative, experimental, or quasi-experimental methodologies.
* **Data Systems:**
  Deep expertise in MIS, data visualization, digital monitoring systems, and end-to-end data pipelines.
* **Government Alignment:**
  Experience developing reporting, compliance documentation, or dashboards for government bodies or public systems.
* **Data Ethics & Governance:**
  Practical understanding of data safeguarding, informed consent, confidentiality, and responsible handling of adolescent girls' data.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Strong track record of distilling technical findings into decision-oriented communications for non-technical stakeholders, donors, and leadership.
* **Values Alignment:**
  Strong commitment to gender equality, youth agency, and social inclusion.

**Good to Have:**

* Prior experience working with public education systems, government MIS, or EdTech ecosystems (specifically in India).
* Advanced Excel capabilities (pivot tables, data cleaning/reconciliation, automated visualization).
* Fluency in Telugu or Kannada.
* Project management experience coordinating complex reporting cycles across multiple partners and geographies.
* Experience managing external research agencies, evaluators, or technical consultants.

**Key Benefits**

* High ownership and strategic impact in a values-driven, collaborative work culture.
* Generous leave package, including parental leave.
* Mentorship and professional growth opportunities with executive leadership.
* Opportunity to shape high-impact initiatives that define economic participation for adolescent girls.

title: Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

  

**Reports To**

Senior Manager, Revenue Operations

**Role Summary**

ChargePoint is looking for a Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst to champion our end-to-end revenue lifecycle. In this critical role, you will bridge the gap between accounting execution and strategic revenue operations, ensuring the financial integrity of our SaaS, hardware, and services streams. Join us to drive process automation, strengthen our financial frameworks, and support ChargePoint's mission to build the future of e-mobility.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As the Lead Revenue Operations Analyst and Accountant, you will combine hands-on accounting execution with strategic revenue operations leadership. You will own the revenue lifecycle—from contract review and ASC 606 compliance through journal entries, reconciliations, and close execution. Acting as a strategic bridge between Revenue Accounting, Sales, Legal, and FP&A, you will focus on driving process automation, maintaining audit-ready financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of revenue reporting. Success in your first 6–12 months includes streamlining close activities and elevating team performance through proactive problem resolution.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Lead** the review and analysis of complex sales contracts, purchase orders, and multi-element arrangements to ensure precise revenue recognition under ASC 606.
* **Manage** revenue arrangements in NetSuite, configuring and validating start/end dates, revenue schedules, billing data, and subsidiary ledger entries.
* **Drive** end-to-end monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, preparing journal entries, revenue deferrals, accruals, and variance analyses.
* **Oversee** tracking and milestone-based recognition for project-based revenue, ensuring deliverables are timely and well-documented.
* **Maintain** standalone selling price (SSP) allocation models and prepare comprehensive, audit-ready documentation for external auditors and internal SOX compliance.
* **Reconcile** revenue data seamlessly across Salesforce, NetSuite, and internal reporting tools to ensure unwavering consistency.
* **Partner** cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and Operations, serving as the primary escalation point for revenue coding issues and proactive process fixes.
* **Collaborate** with FP&A to support revenue forecasting, partner rebate programs, sales reserves accruals, and ad-hoc financial analysis.
* **Support** state and government-funded project revenue, carefully navigating special handling requirements and mixed-product accounting treatments.
* **Champion** automation and process improvement initiatives to streamline revenue reporting, reduce manual effort, and strengthen compliance frameworks.
* **Mentor** and guide junior revenue analysts and accountants, reviewing their work to elevate team performance and ensure quality compliance.

**Requirements**

* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, revenue operations, or general accounting, ideally in a SaaS, hardware, or mixed-technology environment.
* Expert-level understanding of ASC 606, including revenue recognition for multiple performance obligations, variable consideration, and contract modifications.
* Hands-on expertise with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred) and CRM platforms (Salesforce).
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and a methodical approach to close execution and audit documentation.
* Demonstrated track record of executing process automation, operational improvement projects, and successful external audit/SOX compliance cycles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (e.g., B.Com/BBA), CA/CPA qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience utilizing Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau or Power BI for financial reporting and analytics.

**Location** India — Remote

title: Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

  

**Reports To**

Senior Manager, Revenue Operations

**Role Summary**

ChargePoint is looking for a Lead Revenue Accountant & Operations Analyst to champion our end-to-end revenue lifecycle. In this critical role, you will bridge the gap between accounting execution and strategic revenue operations, ensuring the financial integrity of our SaaS, hardware, and services streams. Join us to drive process automation, strengthen our financial frameworks, and support ChargePoint's mission to build the future of e-mobility.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As the Lead Revenue Operations Analyst and Accountant, you will combine hands-on accounting execution with strategic revenue operations leadership. You will own the revenue lifecycle—from contract review and ASC 606 compliance through journal entries, reconciliations, and close execution. Acting as a strategic bridge between Revenue Accounting, Sales, Legal, and FP&A, you will focus on driving process automation, maintaining audit-ready financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of revenue reporting. Success in your first 6–12 months includes streamlining close activities and elevating team performance through proactive problem resolution.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Lead** the review and analysis of complex sales contracts, purchase orders, and multi-element arrangements to ensure precise revenue recognition under ASC 606.
* **Manage** revenue arrangements in NetSuite, configuring and validating start/end dates, revenue schedules, billing data, and subsidiary ledger entries.
* **Drive** end-to-end monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, preparing journal entries, revenue deferrals, accruals, and variance analyses.
* **Oversee** tracking and milestone-based recognition for project-based revenue, ensuring deliverables are timely and well-documented.
* **Maintain** standalone selling price (SSP) allocation models and prepare comprehensive, audit-ready documentation for external auditors and internal SOX compliance.
* **Reconcile** revenue data seamlessly across Salesforce, NetSuite, and internal reporting tools to ensure unwavering consistency.
* **Partner** cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and Operations, serving as the primary escalation point for revenue coding issues and proactive process fixes.
* **Collaborate** with FP&A to support revenue forecasting, partner rebate programs, sales reserves accruals, and ad-hoc financial analysis.
* **Support** state and government-funded project revenue, carefully navigating special handling requirements and mixed-product accounting treatments.
* **Champion** automation and process improvement initiatives to streamline revenue reporting, reduce manual effort, and strengthen compliance frameworks.
* **Mentor** and guide junior revenue analysts and accountants, reviewing their work to elevate team performance and ensure quality compliance.

**Requirements**

* 12 - 15 years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, revenue operations, or general accounting, ideally in a SaaS, hardware, or mixed-technology environment.
* Expert-level understanding of ASC 606, including revenue recognition for multiple performance obligations, variable consideration, and contract modifications.
* Hands-on expertise with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred) and CRM platforms (Salesforce).
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and a methodical approach to close execution and audit documentation.
* Demonstrated track record of executing process automation, operational improvement projects, and successful external audit/SOX compliance cycles.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (e.g., B.Com/BBA), CA/CPA qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience utilizing Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau or Power BI for financial reporting and analytics.

**Location** India — Remote

title: Senior Accountant
description:
* **Company Description**
  BENGAL TEA & FABRICS LTD. is a food and beverages company headquartered in India, specializing in tea and related products. The organization operates across multiple business functions, including production, distribution and Online sales. It offers a structured work environment with opportunities to contribute to a growing consumer goods business.
* We are looking for an accountant with the following job description.

Role purpose

The Accountant will own day-to-day accounting, the manufacturing (production) module and the inventory module in our accounting software. The goal is clean books, accurate stock and cost figures, and marketplace payouts that fully reconcile with sales, returns and fees. You will be the single point of control for numbers from raw tea to the customer's doorstep.

Key responsibilities1. Accounting and books

•      Maintain day-to-day books in Tally Prime / ERP: sales, purchases, expenses, journals, bank and cash entries.

•      Post marketplace sales, returns (RTO and customer returns), cancellations and replacements correctly, by platform and by state.

•      Reconcile bank accounts, vendor and customer ledgers every month.

•      Manage accounts payable for tea suppliers, packaging vendors, co-packers, logistics and service providers.

•      Prepare month-end closing entries, provisions and accruals; support quarterly and annual closing.

•      Coordinate with the statutory auditor and tax consultant; prepare audit schedules.

2. Marketplace reconciliation (Amazon, Flipkart and others)

•      Download and reconcile settlement / payment reports from Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and other platforms with orders booked.

•      Track and account for commissions, fixed closing fees, shipping fees, storage (FBA / Flipkart warehouse) fees, advertising spend and other deductions.

•      Identify short payments, unclaimed reimbursements, lost or damaged inventory claims (e.g. SAFE-T, SPF) and follow up until recovered.

•      Reconcile returns: units returned vs. units received back in saleable or damaged condition.

•      Maintain a platform-wise receivables tracker and ageing.

3. GST and other compliance

•      Prepare data for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, including state-wise sales from marketplace reports.

•      Reconcile TCS collected by e-commerce operators (GSTR-8) and TDS (Section 194-O) deducted by platforms with Form 26AS / AIS and books.

•      Reconcile input tax credit with GSTR-2B.

•      Handle GST registrations / additional places of business where stock is held in marketplace warehouses (in coordination with the consultant).

•      Track TDS payable, monthly deposits and quarterly returns; generate e-way bills and e-invoices where required.

4. Manufacturing module

•      Set up and maintain the Bill of Materials (BOM) for each SKU: loose tea, blends, packaging material (pouches, cartons, labels), and other inputs.

•      Record production / manufacturing journals for each batch, including job-work or co-packer production.

•      Track material consumption, wastage and yield against standard; report variances.

•      Calculate cost of production and per-unit cost for every SKU and pack size.

•      Maintain batch numbers, manufacturing and expiry dates as required for food (FSSAI) compliance.

5. Inventory module

•      Maintain stock records for raw tea, packaging material, work-in-progress and finished goods across all locations: own warehouse, co-packer, and marketplace fulfilment centres (FBA, Flipkart Smart Fulfilment, etc.).

•      Record stock transfers to marketplace warehouses and reconcile with platform inventory reports.

•      Conduct monthly physical stock counts and reconcile with books; investigate and report differences.

•      Track near-expiry, damaged and slow-moving stock; flag reorder levels to the operations team.

•      Value closing inventory correctly for monthly and annual accounts.

6. MIS and reporting

•      Prepare monthly MIS: sales by platform and SKU, gross margin, platform fees as % of sales, return rates, and stock position.

•      Prepare SKU-wise and platform-wise profitability statements.

•      Track cash flow, receivables from platforms and payables to vendors.

•      Support budgeting and pricing decisions with cost data.

Who we are looking forMust have

•      B.Com / M.Com with 3–6 years of accounting experience.

•      At least 2 years in a company selling online through Amazon, Flipkart or similar marketplaces.

•      Hands-on experience reconciling marketplace settlement reports, fees, returns and claims.

•      Working knowledge of the manufacturing (BOM / production) and inventory modules in Tally Prime or a similar ERP like Zoho.

•      Sound practical knowledge of GST (including e-commerce TCS), TDS and month-end closing.

•      Good Excel skills: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, pivot tables, SUMIFS, and handling large report downloads.

•      Fluent in English and Hindi or Bengali, with clear written communication.

Good to have

•      CA Inter / CMA Inter.

•      Experience in FMCG or food and beverage, ideally tea, spices or similar packaged goods.

•      Exposure to Zoho Books / Zoho Inventory, Busy, or inventory tools such as Unicommerce or EasyEcom.

•      Familiarity with quick-commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) and their reports.

•      Basic understanding of FSSAI batch and labelling requirements.

Personal qualities

•      Detail-oriented, with a habit of reconciling until the numbers match.

•      Works independently and meets deadlines without close supervision.

•      Comfortable working with operations and warehouse teams to trace stock.

Compensation and how to apply

Up to ₹5,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and skills. Includes statutory benefits (PF, ESI where applicable, gratuity) as per law.

•      
**Working days:**
Monday to Saturday, with 2nd and 4th Saturdays Off. Office-based in Kolkata.

•

Immediate joiners or up to 30 days preferred.
