title: Chartering Manager
description:
**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Preferred Background:**
Relevant shore-based Chartering experience in the Maritime Transportation sector for Bulk Carriers ( Containers exposure is an added advantage ). Sailing exposure as Chief Mate/Master is good to have.

**Joining Location**
- Kolkata

**Role Purpose**

To lead the
**Chartering & Commercial function**
, ensuring optimum vessel employment, competitive chartering revenue, minimum commercial downtime, effective Charter Party management, timely commercial and claims settlement, and development of new business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Chartering & Revenue**

* Identify and secure suitable employment for Dry Bulk vessels through
  **Tenders, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  opportunities.
* For non-tender vessels, strive to secure charter rates at around
  **95% of the prevailing BDI / relevant BKI, BSI or corresponding market index**
  for the vessel tonnage.
* Evaluate market conditions, vessel positioning, cargo availability and prevailing fixtures before concluding employment.
* Explore
  **3–6 month period employment linked to BDI/FFA scales**
  for identified vessels, based on market opportunities.
* Negotiate freight/hire rates and commercial terms with charterers and brokers within the approved authority framework.

**2. Chartering Efficiency & Vessel Utilisation**

* Minimise commercial off-hire and waiting time between completion of one employment /tender and commencement of the next, and minimise avoidable commercial downtime and loss of earnings.
* Plan vessel repositioning and re-hire opportunities to maximise
  **earning days and fleet utilisation**
  .
* Evaluate options based on recent comparable fixtures for similar tonnage in the relevant region.

**3. Voyage Estimation & Commercial Performance**

* Prepare voyage estimates before fixing Voyage Charters and assess expected
  **TCE and voyage profitability**
  .
* Prepare voyage actuals on completion and analyse variance against estimates.
* Monitor vessel earnings and analyse losses arising from
  **off-hire, idling, ballast, repairs and other commercial downtime**
  .
* Prepare voyage analysis, variance and commercial loss reports for Management review.

**4. Charter Party Management**

* Review fixture recaps and
  **Charter Party terms**
  thoroughly before conclusion.
* Ensure Charter Party terms adequately protect the
  **Owner’s commercial interests**
  and minimise revenue leakage.
* Track disputes arising from concluded Charter Parties and ensure learnings are incorporated into future fixtures.
* Work towards minimising Charter Party disputes and their impact on vessel earnings.

**5. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new
  **chartering, cargo and commercial business opportunities**
  for the Company.
* Drive growth and utilisation of identified business segments and vessels in line with Management targets.
* Explore
  **new container business opportunities and sectors**
  , in addition to the existing Chennai–Kolkata sector.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other commercial partners**
  .

**6. Hire, Receivables & Commercial Closure**

* Ensure timely receipt and settlement of
  **hire/freight and additional recoverable**
  , including AWRP, bunker payments and other applicable amounts.
* Target commercial closure and collection of outstanding amounts
  **within 15 days from completion/end of charter**
  , wherever contractually applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance & Accounts for timely reconciliation and closure of commercial receivables.
* Follow up on outstanding commercial dues and ensure timely escalation wherever required.

**7. Claims & Insurance**

* Coordinate and follow up
  **P&I, H&M, commercial, cargo and other applicable insurance claims**
  .
* Liaise with insurers, P&I Clubs and underwriters for timely processing and settlement of claims.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic record keeping of claims, correspondence and settlements.
* Support
  **insurance renewals, negotiations and settlements**
  with appropriate Management approval.

**8. Commercial MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly
  **fleet earnings and commercial performance reports**
  within defined timelines.
* Report vessel utilisation, waiting periods, commercial downtime, voyage performance and loss of earnings.
* Support performance reports with relevant
  **freight market and BDI analysis**
  .
* Prepare quarterly and annual commercial analysis and reports required by the CEO and Management/Board.
* Highlight key commercial risks, performance gaps and opportunities for Management review.

**9. Tenders & Commercial Documentation**

* Prepare and review commercial documents for
  **vessel and cargo tenders**
  .
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of tender documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation, approvals and records relating to
  **fixtures, Charter Parties, tenders, claims and other commercial transactions**
  .

**10. Vessel Sale & Purchase Support**

* Assist the CEO in commercial matters relating to the
  **purchase and sale of vessels**
  , as required.
* Review relevant vessel particulars and commercial documentation.
* Provide commercial inputs and analysis to support Management evaluation and decision-making.

**Skills & Competence**

* Strong understanding of
  **Dry Bulk freight markets, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  .
* Good network and relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other industry stakeholders**
  .
* Strong
  **commercial negotiation, analytical and decision-making skills**
  .
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Commercially driven with a strong focus on
  **revenue, vessel utilisation, cost optimisation and profitability**
  .

**Position Overview:**

The FP&A Lead will be responsible for supporting the financial planning, analysis, and reporting activities of an Australian-based business while being located in Bangalore. This role acts as a critical finance partner to the Australian leadership team, providing timely financial insights, modelling, and performance analysis to support strategic decision-making.

Working remotely with the Australian finance and operational teams, the FP&A Lead will play a key role in budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and performance tracking across the business. The role requires strong analytical capability, commercial acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones in a highly collaborative environment.

**Key Responsibilities / Functions:**

**Financial Planning & Forecasting**

• Lead the preparation and consolidation of annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial plans.

• Partner closely with Australian business leaders to understand operational drivers and translate them into accurate financial forecasts.

• Maintain and enhance financial planning models supporting revenue, cost, and capital forecasting.

**Financial Analysis & Business Insights**

• Provide detailed monthly variance analysis against budget and forecast, identifying key drivers, risks, and opportunities.

• Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to improve financial and operational performance.

• Support the evaluation of financial business cases, including capital investment analysis and return assessments.

**Reporting & Performance Management**

• Prepare monthly management reporting packs for executive leadership.

• Prepare quarterly Board reporting materials for the VP Finance.

• Develop dashboards and reporting tools that enhance visibility of key financial and operational metrics.

• Monitor business performance and proactively highlight emerging risks and opportunities.

**Business Partnering**

• Act as a remote finance business partner to the Australian leadership team.

• Collaborate with operational teams to understand key business drivers including revenue, costs, fleet utilisation, and project performance.

• Support strategic planning initiatives and business transformation projects.

**Process Improvement & Data Management**

• Identify opportunities to automate and streamline financial reporting and planning processes.

• Enhance the use of financial systems, business intelligence tools, and data analytics.

• Ensure consistency, accuracy, and reliability of financial data used for decision-making

title: Sr. Analyst, Engineering FP&A
description:
symplr is seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to provide embedded analytical support for the Technology/R&D organization and help build the financial operating system for engineering investment, workforce planning, capitalization discipline, productivity, and technology cost structure.
  
  
This Bangalore-based role will partner with the Sr. Director, Engineering FP&A, the U.S.-based Engineering FP&A Manager, Engineering leadership, Product & Professional Services FP&A, Accounting, HR, Procurement, and Corporate FP&A to translate engineering activity, capacity, and cost drivers into accurate models, clear reporting, and useful business insight.
  
  
The right candidate is hands-on, analytically rigorous, highly curious, and comfortable going deep into workforce data, engineering spend, capitalization inputs, contractor/vendor analytics, cloud/tooling costs, and recurring FP&A deliverables.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
****Key Responsibilities:****
**ENGINEERING FINANCE ANALYTICS & BUSINESS SUPPORT**

* Support Engineering/R&D FP&A with recurring analysis, reporting, and decision support across workforce, capacity, roadmap investment, technical cost structure, and productivity.
* Translate engineering priorities, product/platform initiatives, security work, technical debt, AI/platform investments, and maintenance activity into clearly structured analysis and model inputs.
* Prepare monthly Engineering financial review materials, variance analysis, metrics packages, and supporting schedules for review with Engineering and FP&A leadership.
* Partner with Product & Professional Services FP&A as needed to support analysis of roadmap affordability, product commitments, implementation implications, and build-versus-buy economics.

**PLANNING, FORECASTING & MODELING**

* Maintain detailed Engineering/R&D planning and forecast models in alignment with Corporate FP&A templates, calendars, definitions, and submission standards.
* Build and update workforce models by team, location, product/platform area, initiative, employee/contractor mix, hiring status, and forecast period.
* Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, variance analysis, and scenario analysis for Engineering/R&D spend, headcount, contractors, vendors, cloud/tooling, and other technology-related costs.
* Prepare accurate, timely, and well-documented forecast inputs that can be reviewed, consolidated, and explained by Engineering FP&A leadership and Corporate FP&A.

**CAPITALIZATION, COST STRUCTURE & PRODUCTIVITY ANALYSIS**

* Support R&D capitalization and OpEx/CapEx analysis by organizing inputs, tracking activity, maintaining supporting schedules, and partnering with Accounting/CAO under FP&A leadership guidance.
* Analyze cloud, tooling, vendor, contractor, and technology infrastructure spend tied to engineering productivity and cost efficiency.
* Maintain reporting and analysis around R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost by product/platform/initiative, capitalized versus expensed development, innovation versus maintenance capacity, and location mix.
* Support vendor rationalization, contractor mix, location strategy, and build-versus-buy analysis by preparing clean datasets, trends, comparisons, and scenario outputs.

**DATA, DASHBOARDS & PROCESS DISCIPLINE**

* Create and maintain repeatable reports, dashboards, and analysis packs that improve visibility into Engineering investment, capacity, productivity, and trade-offs.
* Ensure Engineering FP&A outputs are accurate, traceable, clearly documented, and consistent with FP&A definitions, KPI standards, model architecture, and version-control expectations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring analysis and reporting processes using planning tools, BI tools, and analytical automation.
* Maintain strong data hygiene across headcount, vendor, contractor, capitalization, cloud/tooling, and cost-center reporting inputs.

**WAYS OF WORKING & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP**

* Develop deep fluency in Engineering/R&D operations, technology cost drivers, and symplr’s product/platform investment model.
* Operate as an embedded tower resource rather than a generic shared-services analyst, building enough functional depth to anticipate questions and improve analysis quality over time.
* Work collaboratively across U.S. and India time zones, balancing responsiveness with high-quality, well-organized analytical output.
* Bring curiosity, ownership, and continuous-improvement mindset to a growing FP&A function that is being built as an enterprise decision engine.

**Skills Required**
**Qualifications Required:**

* Bcom/MBA

**Experience & Background**

* 3+ years of progressive finance, FP&A, business finance, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting, analytics, or related experience.
* Experience supporting Engineering, Technology, Product, R&D, SaaS, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or similarly complex operating environments preferred.
* Experience with workforce planning, headcount modeling, variance analysis, forecast support, vendor/contractor spend analysis, or management reporting strongly preferred.
* Exposure to PE-backed, high-growth, scaling, multi-product, or operationally complex businesses is helpful but not required.

**Technical & Analytical Capabilities**

* Strong financial modeling, Excel, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with ability to manage detail while telling a clear business story.
* Working knowledge of workforce planning, scenario analysis, variance analysis, cost-center reporting, vendor analytics, and productivity metrics.
* Familiarity with R&D capitalization, OpEx/CapEx concepts, cloud/tooling cost analysis, and technology cost structures preferred.
* Comfortable working with planning systems, BI tools, ERP/financial systems, and large datasets; curiosity about automation and AI-enabled analytical improvements.

**WAYS OF WORKING**

* Hands-on analyst with strong ownership, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to ask why before accepting surface-level answers.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and commitment to producing accurate, timely, and explainable work product.
* Clear communicator who can summarize analysis, risks, and drivers for finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Builder mindset with a bias toward practical process improvement, scalable reporting, and continuous learning.

**The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.**

title: Analyst II FP&A
description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an FP&A Analyst for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.
  
  
The FP&A Analyst supports ACC’s financial planning, forecasting, management reporting and portfolio analysis activities as a member of the Bengaluru-based FP&A team. Working under the direction of the Director – FP&A and in close coordination with US-based FP&A leadership, the Analyst is responsible for preparing accurate and timely financial analyses, forecasts, reporting and related deliverables for onshore review.
  
  
The role operates within ACC’s integrated Oracle EPM/Fusion planning environment and supports recurring planning and reporting processes, financial and operating variance analysis, model maintenance and data-quality activities. The FP&A Analyst is expected to develop a strong understanding of ACC’s business and operating drivers, identify meaningful trends and exceptions, and deliver well-supported analysis in accordance with established processes, timelines and review standards.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Prepare recurring forecasts, budgets, financial projections and management reporting in accordance with established FP&A processes, assumptions and timelines and under the direction of the Director – FP&A.
* Perform analysis of portfolio and property-level performance, including actual-to-budget and forecast variances, operating drivers, trends and exceptions, and clearly document findings for review by FP&A leadership.
* Prepare financial and non-financial information for monthly management reporting, ensuring supporting data, calculations and commentary are complete, accurate and consistent with established reporting standards.
* Maintain assigned planning models, assumptions, reports and supporting schedules within Oracle EPM/Fusion, following established model structures, driver logic and governance standards.
* Use Excel and other analytical tools to validate financial information, investigate variances, support ad hoc analysis and provide an effective audit layer for information maintained within Oracle EPM/Fusion.
* Perform data-quality and reconciliation procedures across Oracle EPM/Fusion and relevant operational, leasing and accounting source systems; investigate discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues as appropriate.
* Support recurring budgeting, forecasting and reporting calendars by completing assigned deliverables on time, proactively identifying missing information, dependencies or other risks to timely completion.
* Work closely with US-based FP&A, Operations, Leasing & Marketing, Accounting and other stakeholders to obtain complete and accurate information required for financial planning, reporting and analysis.
* Maintain clear documentation of recurring analyses, model inputs, assumptions and supporting workpapers to ensure consistency, transparency and continuity across the offshore-to-onshore handoff.
* Identify opportunities to improve recurring analyses, reporting and planning processes, including opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve the use of Oracle EPM/Fusion, Excel, AI and other automation capabilities.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of Oracle EPM/Fusion planning functionality, Excel and other analytical tools used by the FP&A function.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during budgeting, forecasting, month-end reporting and other peak planning cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CA, CMA or other relevant advanced qualification is preferred.
* Two to four years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, management reporting or a related finance role; experience within a large, multi-entity organization is preferred.
* Strong understanding of core FP&A concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial statement analysis and management reporting.
* Advanced Excel skills, including experience working with large data sets, financial models, lookups, pivot tables and other analytical functions.
* Experience with Oracle EPM, Hyperion, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning or another enterprise planning platform is preferred; direct Oracle EPM/Fusion experience is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, investigate discrepancies and translate financial data into clear findings.
* High attention to detail and demonstrated ability to produce accurate work within recurring reporting and planning deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively within established processes and review standards while exercising sound judgment regarding when to resolve issues independently and when to escalate.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple recurring deliverables and changing priorities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to document assumptions, explain financial variances and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across time zones.
* Demonstrated curiosity about business performance and the ability to develop an understanding of operating drivers beyond the financial statements.
* Experience with real estate, property-level financial analysis, student housing or another asset-intensive operating business is preferred but not required.
* Comfortable working in a team environment with a structured offshore-to-onshore handoff model and regular interaction with US-based FP&A leadership and business stakeholders.

title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:

**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analyst - Accounting
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
Why This Role Is Different
  
  
This role goes beyond routine journal entry posting. You’ll run the technical core of Accounting — inventory accounting, logistics cost accounting, lease accounting, revenue recognition, investment accounting and European subsidiary controllership — on a modern, automation-ready stack.
  
  

* Full visibility into business operations. You’ll see exactly how marketing spend, logistics costs, lease obligations and investment performance flow into the business’s financial results, not just the entries that summarize them.
* Technical depth. Lease accounting (ASC 842), revenue recognition (ASC 606) and investment accounting (ASC 320 / ASC 321) under US GAAP — real technical ownership across some of the more substantive areas of US GAAP.
* Entity ownership. Act as controller for one of our European subsidiaries — own the comparison of actuals to forecast, and sit in FP&A discussions with business heads to understand what’s driving that entity’s profitability, working alongside the VP of Accounting and the Finance Controller.
* A modern stack, with AI built in. NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker, plus access to Claude Enterprise to build your own agents and automate your workflows — with our Engineering team available to support you when you need it.
* Direct visibility. Your reconciliations and MIS are reviewed directly at the VP Accounting level.
* Ownership from day one. You’ll own your GL areas outright within 90 days, not assist indefinitely.

The Ideal Candidate
  
  
We’re looking for a Chartered Accountant with 1 year of experience, strong core accounting fundamentals, and real curiosity about how operational data becomes financial truth. If you’d rather build a reconciliation engine than re-key an invoice — and you want to deepen your grounding in lease accounting, revenue recognition, investment accounting and inventory accounting — this is built for you.
  
  
You’ll work closely with Marketing, Logistics, Operations and external consultants; use NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker; and own workstreams with direct VP Accounting visibility, including controllership of a European subsidiary.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Marketing accrual engineering — build and maintain the monthly accrual model across digital, performance, brand and agency spend; reconcile to invoice-level detail using Looker reports, and post journal entries with a clean audit trail.
* Logistics cost modeling — own first-mile, middle-mile and last-mile carrier costs, freight, customs, duty and tariff; build accrual models tied directly to shipment volumes.
* Inventory accounting — own inventory costing, valuation and reconciliation, partnering with Supply Chain and Operations to keep the inventory sub-ledger tied to the GL.
* Lease accounting (ASC 842) — build and maintain lease schedules, ROU asset and lease liability roll-forwards, modifications, terminations and disclosures.
* Revenue recognition (ASC 606) — own revenue recognition schedules and accruals, including review of contracts with multiple performance obligations.
* Investment accounting (ASC 320 / ASC 321) — own investment accounting and reporting under US GAAP for debt securities (ASC 320) and equity securities (ASC 321), including reconciliations against custodian/bank statements and periodic roll-forwards.
* European subsidiary controllership — act as controller for one of our European subsidiaries; own the comparison of actuals to forecasted numbers, and be part of FP&A discussions with business heads to understand what’s impacting that entity’s profitability, working alongside the VP of Accounting and the Finance Controller.
* Close mechanics — use AI to prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaids and reserves for your owned GL areas, with documentation built for audit walkthroughs, not audit scrambles.
* Reconciliation architecture — GL-to-subledger, bank, vendor, lease, inventory and investment schedule reconciliations, built to be self-explanatory to anyone who opens them.
* Cross-functional partnership — work directly with Marketing, Logistics, Operations and FP&A to flag risk, propose accounting treatment, and resolve discrepancies before they become close-day fires.
* Automation ownership — build and ship your own AI agents on Claude Enterprise, using MCP connectors into NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker, to automate your workflows — with Engineering support whenever you need it.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1 year of post-qualification experience.
* Strong conceptual grip on accounting, accruals, controls and US GAAP — exposure to lease accounting, revenue recognition or investment accounting is a plus, not required.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close, reconciliations and multi-entity accounting.
* A genuine systems mindset — interest in how ERPs, BI tools and automation reshape a close, not just comfort operating them.
* Advanced Excel and comfort with large, system-generated datasets.
* Working knowledge of NetSuite preferred; familiarity with Coupa, Numeric or Brex a strong plus.
* Exposure to workflow tools (Jira / Freshservice) a plus.
* Ability to trace a number back through the operational system that produced it — logic over rote process.
* Comfort with, or willingness to learn, forecast-to-actual variance analysis and FP&A-style business partnering — a plus, not required.
* Sharp communication skills — you’ll present numbers and issues directly to senior stakeholders, including the VP of Accounting and business heads.
* Real curiosity about the story behind the numbers, not just posting entries.
* E-commerce, supply chain or operational finance background preferred, not required.

title: Senior Manager R2R
description:
The R2R Senior Manager is a seasoned finance controller who acts as the business-facing layer of the Record to Report function, sitting between R2R Managers (who run the close) and the R2R Tower Lead (who owns the tower). The role goes beyond core transactional operations to drill into the business: analysing the Balance Sheet and P&L, identifying trend-based issues, policy deviations, exceptions, and financial risks, and converting these into actionable business insights for Financial Controllers and CFO level stakeholders. The role also oversees group consolidation and brings a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and SAP-driven financial data.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Balance Sheet & P&L Analysis**

● Perform in-depth monthly, quarterly, and annual review of the Balance Sheet and P&L across entities, going beyond accuracy checks to assess quality, composition, and sustainability of reported numbers.

● Analyse key P&L drivers (revenue, material cost, conversion cost, overheads, margins) and explain movements against budget, forecast, and prior periods.

● Scrutinise Balance Sheet health, including working capital (inventory, receivables, payables), provisions, accruals, fixed assets, CWIP, and intercompany positions. Challenge unusual, unsupported, or judgment-based balances and ensure appropriate accounting treatment and valuation.

● Present concise, insight-led financial reviews to Financial Controllers and CFO-level leadership.

2.
**Trend-Based Issue Identification & Business Insights**

● Use month-on-month and year-on-year trend analysis to proactively detect anomalies, recurring issues, leakages, and emerging risks before they impact reported results.

● Translate financial data into business insights on profitability, cost behaviour, plant performance, and working capital efficiency.

● Identify root causes of recurring variances and exceptions, and recommend corrective actions to business and finance owners.

● Partner with FP&A and business finance to link accounting outcomes with operational drivers and support business decision-making.

3.
**Consolidation & Group Reporting**

● Oversee group consolidation across entities, including intercompany eliminations, minority interest, foreign currency translation, and consolidation adjustments.

● Review consolidated financial statements and reporting packs for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with group policies and applicable GAAP (IFRS / Ind AS / US GAAP).

● Validate consolidation tool outputs against SAP ledger data and resolve significant differences.

● Provide consolidated-level analysis and commentary on key movements for leadership reporting.

**4. Manufacturing Finance & SAP**

● Apply strong understanding of manufacturing finance – inventory valuation, standard costing, production variances, COGS, capex, and plant-level P&L – to review and interpret financials.

● Leverage SAP (FI/CO, and exposure to MM/PP/SD integration) to drill into transactional data, trace issues to source, and support analysis.

● Identify system-driven or process-driven accounting issues arising from manufacturing operations and drive resolution with plant finance and operations teams.

.5
**Leadership & Governance**

● Provide direction and review oversight to R2R Managers, with month-end close execution delegated to the Manager layer.

● Raise the analytical and business-review capability of the team; coach Managers on financial review, commentary, and risk identification.

● Drive standardization of review frameworks, analytical templates, and exception reporting across the tower.

**Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory, 12 – 15 Years overall, with 10+ years post-CA qualification**

Flexible to align with global stakeholder time zones, as required

description:

Treasury Lead / CFO

bangalore

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Treasury Associate to support our treasury function. In this role, you will consolidate data from banks, lenders and internal teams, maintain debt and liquidity trackers, prepare MIS, keep documentation and reconciliations current, and track compliance, covenant and repayment calendars.

This is a backend support role focused on accuracy, timeliness and dependable data. It is not a front-office dealing, lender-negotiation or fund-raising role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collect balances, drawdowns, sanctions and interest rates from banks, lenders and internal teams, and maintain the master debt and liquidity trackers.
* Prepare weekly and monthly treasury MIS, dashboard inputs, liquidity and debt schedules, and variance data for CFO review.
* Maintain sanction letters, loan agreements, repayment schedules, security and charge documents, and rating letters, and keep the lender data room and filing up to date.
* Reconcile bank balances, debt outstanding, interest, processing fees and charges against the GL and lender statements.
* Maintain the covenant calendar, compile and submit periodic data to lenders and rating agencies, and track limit utilisation against sanctions.
* Maintain the debt-servicing schedule (principal and interest), and flag upcoming dues and funding needs in advance.
* Follow SOPs and RCM, support statutory and internal audits with schedules and evidence, and assist with automation, templates and ad-hoc analysis.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivots); knowledge of basic macros is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and data discipline.
* Ability to handle sensitive financial data with confidentiality.
* Working knowledge of debt instruments such as term loans, NCDs, OD/CC, and securitisation / DA pools.
* Basic understanding of accounting and bank reconciliation.
* Clear written and verbal communication for coordinating with banks, lenders and internal teams.
* Reliability on deadlines and a proactive approach to flagging issues early.

**Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) / CA-Inter or equivalent.
* 2–5 years of experience in treasury back/middle office, banking operations, or financial reporting.

description:
Job Description: Finance Manager

Organization: Reputed Family Office

Location: Bangalore, India. Candidates located in Bangalore, or who can relocate to Bangalore are preferred.

Reporting To: Finance Controller

Employment Type: Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to join a reputed family office based in Bangalore. The role supports the Finance Controller in managing the month-end and year-end close, financial reporting, and statutory and tax compliance across India, the US, and Singapore, along with investor reporting for Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) structures in which the family holds interests. The position calls for strong technical accounting knowledge, multi-jurisdictional compliance experience, and the discretion and judgment expected when handling the financial affairs of a private wealth platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual books closure process for the family office and its holding entities, ensuring timely and accurate postings, reconciliations, and accruals.
* Review and prepare financial statements in accordance with Indian GAAP/Ind AS, US GAAP, and Singapore FRS/SFRS(I), as applicable to each entity.
* Prepare and review Management Information System (MIS) reports, consolidated family wealth dashboards, variance analysis, and cash flow reports for principals and senior stakeholders.
* Manage income tax compliance in India, the US, and Singapore, including returns, advance tax, tax provisioning, and coordination with tax advisors.
* Ensure compliance with GST, Provident Fund (PF), and Employee State Insurance (ESI) requirements for the office and any operating entities, including filings, reconciliations, and timely payments.
* Oversee AIF compliance requirements, including fund accounting review, capital account statements, NAV computation, and regulatory reporting to SEBI and other bodies, for AIF commitments held by the family.
* Prepare and review investor reporting packs, capital call and distribution tracking, and periodic updates on fund performance in line with fund documentation.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, and IT audits, including audit schedules, responses to queries, and closure of observations.
* Review internal controls and processes across the family office and its entities, identify gaps, and recommend improvements to financial governance and IT general controls.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow planning, including household and family expenditure planning in coordination with principals.
* Manage relationships with banks, custodians, fund managers, auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities as required.
* Maintain strict confidentiality over family financial affairs and ensure appropriate access controls over sensitive financial data.
* Drive process automation and efficiency improvements using Excel, Power BI or similar tools, and AI-based tools for reporting and analysis.

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA), or Semi-qualified CA (CA Inter/CA Final pass candidates), or MBA (Finance)/equivalent with 6 to 8 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in books closure, preparation and review of financial statements, and MIS reporting.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong knowledge of the Income Tax Act (India), with working exposure to US federal and state tax compliance and Singapore corporate tax.
* Working knowledge of GST, PF, and ESI compliance.
* Hands-on exposure to AIF structures, fund accounting, compliance requirements, and investor reporting.
* Experience preparing financial statements under US GAAP and Singapore accounting standards (SFRS/SFRS(I)), in addition to Indian GAAP/Ind AS.
* Experience handling statutory audits, internal audits, and IT audits.
* Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced: pivot tables, lookups, macros preferred), MS Word, and MS PowerPoint.
* Practical use of AI tools for productivity, data analysis, and report preparation.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Prior experience in a family office, private wealth management, or high-net-worth advisory environment.
* Experience working with cross-border entities or multi-jurisdiction group structures.
* Exposure to ERP and accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Tally, Zoho Books, or similar).
* Strong communication skills and ability to present financial information to non-finance stakeholders.
* Discretion, integrity, and a high level of ownership, with the ability to work under tight deadlines.

Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with experience, as per the family office's standards.

Interested candidates may please share their CVs to
**suchitra@prabhullc.net**

title: Senior Consultant / Associate Manager – M&A Advisory & PMI
description:
**Company:**
Dream Incubator (DI) India

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–9 years, depending on the position

About Dream Incubator

Dream Incubator (DI) is a Japan-headquartered strategy consulting and investment firm. We support Japanese and international corporations in developing growth strategies, entering new markets, executing M&A transactions, and creating new businesses.

Our India team works closely with Japanese corporations and Indian companies across sectors, including manufacturing, automotive, industrial technology, consumer goods, and other B2B industries.

We are strengthening our M&A advisory capabilities in India and are looking for professionals with hands-on experience in M&A-related consulting and advisory services.

Position Overview

We are hiring for two levels:

* **Senior Consultant (SC):**
  Typically 3–5 years of relevant professional experience.
* **Associate Manager (AM):**
  Typically 5–9 years of relevant professional experience.

We welcome candidates with strong experience in one or more areas of M&A advisory, including Commercial Due Diligence, Operational Due Diligence, acquisition target evaluation, transaction advisory, and post-merger integration.

**Candidates are not expected to have experience across the entire M&A lifecycle.**

The role combines hands-on M&A advisory work with opportunities to support broader corporate strategy and business transformation projects.

Key Responsibilities

Depending on experience and seniority, responsibilities will include:

**1. M&A Strategy and Target Evaluation**

* Support the development of acquisition strategies and investment rationales.
* Identify, screen, and evaluate potential acquisition targets.
* Assess strategic fit, business models, competitive positioning, and potential synergies.

**2. Due Diligence and Transaction Advisory**

* Conduct Commercial and Operational Due Diligence, including market, competitor, customer, and financial performance analysis.
* Evaluate business plans, growth assumptions, profitability, and operational improvement opportunities.
* Support transaction-related assessments and coordinate with financial, legal, and other advisers as required.

**3. Post-Merger Integration and Value Creation**

* Support PMI planning, including Day 1 readiness, 100-day plans, and integration priorities.
* Identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and operational improvements.
* Support the execution and monitoring of value creation initiatives.

**4. Client and Project Delivery**

* Conduct research, financial and operational analysis, management interviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Develop client presentations, analytical reports, and actionable recommendations.
* Work directly with Japanese and Indian clients.
* Coordinate project activities and support junior team members.

Qualifications and Experience

**Requirements for Both Positions**

* More than 3 year experience with strategy consulting firms(MBB), Big Four transaction advisory teams, private equity firms, or corporate M&A teams.
* Relevant professional experience in M&A advisory, transaction advisory, due diligence, corporate development, or post-acquisition value creation.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in at least one substantive area of M&A advisory, such as Commercial DD, Operational DD, target evaluation, or PMI.
* Strong analytical skills, including financial and business performance analysis.
* Ability to independently execute assigned analyses and prepare high-quality deliverables.
* Strong communication skills and proficiency in English.
* Willingness to work in small, hands-on project teams.

**Senior Consultant – Additional Expectations (3–5 Years)**

* Ability to independently execute defined workstreams in M&A advisory projects.
* Practical understanding of the M&A process and relevant analytical methodologies.
* Ability to translate analysis into clear findings and recommendations.
* Experience in strategy consulting, hypothesis-driven problem-solving, and structured thinking is
  **desirable but not mandatory**
  .

**Associate Manager – Additional Requirements (5–9 Years)**

* Demonstrated ability to independently structure complex business problems and develop hypothesis-driven analytical approaches.
* Strong strategic problem-solving capabilities, including logical structuring, prioritization, and synthesis of findings.
* Ability to design and manage major M&A advisory workstreams.
* Experience leading client discussions, developing recommendations, and managing junior consultants.
* Ability to connect M&A analysis with broader business strategy and value creation objectives.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, automotive, automation, engineering, or B2B sectors.
* Exposure to Japanese or other multinational corporate clients.
* Experience working on cross-border M&A transactions.

Important Information About Position Levels

DI's position grading differs from that of many other consulting and advisory firms.

Based on our experience comparing responsibilities, capabilities, and compensation across firms,
**a candidate holding a Manager title elsewhere may be more appropriately aligned with an Associate Manager position at DI. Similarly, an Associate Manager at another firm may be considered for a Senior Consultant position at DI.**

We assess candidates based on their actual capabilities, relevant experience, responsibilities, and compensation expectations rather than their current job titles.

**We strongly encourage applications from professionals who prioritize the substance of the role, professional development, and career opportunities over job titles.**

Candidates who consider retaining or upgrading their current title a non-negotiable requirement are kindly requested not to apply.

Compensation Structure

* For suitable candidates, the expected increase in fixed CTC is approximately
  **10–20% over their current fixed CTC**
  , excluding variable compensation, depeding on situation.
* In addition, DI offers a performance-linked variable bonus ranging from
  **0% to 25% of fixed CTC**
  , subject to applicable policies and performance assessment.
* Candidates should apply only if this compensation structure is broadly aligned with their expectations.

Why Join DI?

* Work directly with Japanese corporations on strategic investment and business expansion opportunities in India.
* Gain exposure to M&A advisory projects beyond a narrowly defined functional specialization.
* Participate in projects covering M&A strategy, due diligence, PMI, and value creation.
* Take meaningful ownership of client deliverables and work closely with senior management in a relatively small, entrepreneurial consulting team.
* Develop broader strategy consulting capabilities while building on your existing M&A expertise

description:

If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). The securitization market is a dynamic marketplace, continuously evolving with new regulations and technological advances every day. This a great opportunity to work in this fast-paced transaction business, support diverse engagement teams, work with a wide variety of clients and lead business development activities on strategic and global priority accounts.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* The primary role of the SFT transaction team is to perform agreed-upon procedures (AUP) to help clients execute securitization transactions successfully.
* Checking the accuracy of our financial models by comparing calculations to the governing documents
* Creating cashflow/analytics models for securitized products, including but not limited to CDOs/CLOs (Collateralized Debt Obligations/Collateralized Loan Obligations)
* Transaction modeling and analytics, which involves cash flow modeling, recalculating certain collateral quality and concentration limitations set out in each transaction’s indenture, including bond principal and interest payments, credit-enhancement, hedging instruments, fees and waterfalls for structured deals
* Construct independent cash flow and collateral models for various structured products utilizing Microsoft Excel
* Create and update detailed agreed upon procedure reports summarizing our results
* Comprehensive and methodical interpretation of prospectus/indenture information and deal structural features including but not limited to collateral, waterfall, triggers, hedges, paydown rules, loss allocation rules, and the ability to extract other pertinent information from prospectuses and indentures
* Perform various analyses on complex excel and third party models (Like Bloomberg, various Rating Agency Portal, Markit etc.) for the valuation of Structured Products
* Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Strong leadership, teaming, technical and relationship- building skills and integrity. These skills along with having a consistent commitment to delivering only the highest quality of work products to your clients, will allow you to easily integrate into the SFT transaction team and reach your professional development goals.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A Post-graduation in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline and approximately 2 years of related work experience.
* Excellent prioritization skills and a commitment to meeting client deadlines
* Strong communication skills for report writing, client presentations and client interactions
* Proficient skills with MS Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Flexibility and willingness to work more than standard hours when necessary to meet client deadlines
* Willingness to work in shift based on the role hired for

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
Prior structured finance experience
  
  
**What We Look For**

* Individuals who demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail & accuracy
* Ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge and possess good business acumen
* Polished verbal and written communication skills in English

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: Executive Associate - Operations & Finance
description:
Executive Associate – Operations & Finance

About the role

We are a finance consulting firm in Bengaluru, currently operated and run by the director alone. We are looking for an Executive Associate to work directly with the Director. You will maintain the books for the company's new ventures, support budgeting and audits, track and manage personal investments of director, and manage travel and personal errands for the Director.

This is a role for a commerce graduate who wants hands-on exposure to accounting and finance operations and open to support director's personal tasks, allowing the director to focus on the core revenue generating activities. Freshers are welcome.

What you will do

1. Venture bookkeeping, budgeting and audit support

- Maintain the books of accounts for each venture: record transactions, file invoices and vouchers, and reconcile bank accounts monthly

- Keep supporting documents organised so every entry can be traced to its source

- Support internal and statutory auditors: prepare schedules and reconciliations, and follow up on their queries until closed

- Coordinate with the CA on bookkeeping, tax and compliance filings.

- Build budgets for new ventures, covering setup costs, operating costs, hiring and a 12–24 month cash runway

- Research costs and gather quotes from vendors, landlords and service providers

- Maintain scenario models and track actual spend against budget

- Keep a project plan per venture and send weekly status updates

2. Investment administration and tracking

- Maintain a consolidated tracker of investments (equities, mutual funds, FDs, bonds, insurance, real estate)

- Monitor maturities, SIPs, dividends and renewals, and send timely reminders

- Execute transactions on written instruction through approved platforms and advisors

- Coordinate with wealth managers, brokers, RMs and the CA; collect statements and capital-gains reports

- Keep KYC, nominations and account documentation up to date

- Prepare monthly or quarterly portfolio snapshots

3. Personal Travel planning

- Plan end-to-end travel: flights, hotels, transfers, itineraries and bookings

- Handle visas, passports, forex, travel insurance and documentation

- Research and present options with costs, and manage changes, cancellations and refunds

4. Personal Expense management

- Track personal and household expenses and recurring payments

- Pay bills, EMIs, premiums and subscriptions on time

- Reconcile bank and credit card statements monthly

5. Vendor and bank liaison

- Act as the point of contact for vendors and service providers; compare quotes and negotiate terms

- Liaise with banks and RMs for account servicing, FDs, loans, cards and documentation

- Follow up on requests and service issues until closed

6. Executive support

- Manage the Director's calendar, reminders and important dates

- Handle errands and administration, draft emails and letters, and keep files organised

What we are looking for

- Graduate in commerce, finance or business administration (B.Com, BBA or equivalent)

- Fresher, or up to 1 year of experience in operations, administration or accounts (internships count)

- Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Basic understanding of banking, mutual funds, FDs and insurance, and keen to learn

- Good communication skills

- Trustworthy and discreet with confidential information

- Organised, proactive and detail-oriented

Good to have

- Familiarity with Tally, Zoho Books or similar accounting tools

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to get work done faster: drafting, research, summarising documents and building spreadsheets

What we offer

- CTC: upto 5 LPA, depending on experience

- Direct exposure to a Director's work across finance, operations and new ventures

- A steep learning curve in bookkeeping, audits, budgeting and investment operations

Location: Bengaluru (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
**Manager Product Control.**
**Purpose of the role**
Product Control is part of Controllership. Product Control ensures traded products are fair valued, correctly accounted and disclosed with prudent valuations, reported to our regulators and Management. We also partner with the business to achieve sustainable financial performance. The Product Control Global Service Centre team is responsible for end-to-end product control tasks including but not limited to preparation, analysis, and reporting of Profit & Loss and Profit & Loss attribution, to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger and balance sheet. The individual will be responsible for handling end-to-end Product Control processes for the European / Middle East Sites.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* To act as an individual contributor delivering Profit & Loss production, analysis & commentaries, Profit & Loss, and Balance Sheet Reconciliations & substantiation, and have sound knowledge of products, valuation, and reporting activities pertaining to Global Markets business.
* Demonstrate a sound understanding of Markets business and processes. Observance to Group policies, audit, controls, and compliance requirements including but not limited to declaration of secrecy, data protection act, health, safety and security, information security, clear desk policy
* Responsible for ensuring that the delivery service of Finance Product Control processes per the standards set out in agreed SLAs within the HSBC Global Resourcing operating framework considering key operational risks and ways to mitigate them and operating a well-defined control environment.
* Responsible for ensuring that the Product Controls are aligned to the Global standards and highlight in case of deviation.
* Continually assess the operational risks inherent in the processes, taking account of changing operating procedures, staff movements, legal and regulatory requirements, management restructures, and the impact of new technology.
* Undertake measures to initiate and implement high-impact quality projects leading to operational efficiency and higher productivity (Within Six Sigma, Lean process improvement methodology)
* Undertake continuous review of processes with the objective of improving the service delivery timeframes and identifying areas of improvement.
* Responsible for ensuring BCP (business continuity plan) is documented, agreed and tested as per agreed timelines.Manage Product control processes in accordance with the group’s reporting requirements

**To Be Successful You Will**

* University degree from a reputable institution with minimum 2 years of experience in related fields (i.e., Product Control, Valuations, etc)
* Experience in partnering with senior stakeholders, and handling conflicts
* Understanding of financial markets products (i.e. debt securities, money markets instruments, Foreign Exchange (FX) swaps, Interest Rates Swaps, Cross Currency Swaps, etc). This entails the understanding of valuation techniques, associated risk sensitivities (i.e. Greeks), and risk factor Profit & Loss analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience in driving project implementation
* Understanding and/or experience in Treasury business
* Understanding and/or experience in Hedge Accounting. Experience with accounting controls for Financial Instruments
* Knowledge and experience with a programming language (i.e. VBA, Python, SQL, C++, etc). Professional qualifications such as MBA, CA, CFA, FRM, etc,

* Exposure to a global tooling group with operations in Korea, India and North America
* Direct working with senior management

Hosur (on-site)

Immediate

description:
**Position Summary**
This position is primarily responsible for performing accounting services for clients. Individuals in this role should demonstrate a basic understanding of business operations and accounting systems as well as a basic familiarity of accounting standards.
  
  
Core competency is the demonstrated ability to carry out the primary responsibilities of the job, which are reflected in the essential duties outlined below.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
The essential duties and responsibilities for this position include the following:
  
  

* Perform recurring transactional accounting responsibilities, including invoicing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash receipts, cash disbursements and payroll transactions
* Perform monthly close procedures, bank reconciliations, sales reconciliations, and system financial statement preparation
* Research and solve more complex accounting issues
* Identify and anticipate problem areas and work to provide solutions
* Assist with clients’ QuickBooks or similar software
* Assist with updating asset/depreciation schedules
* Assist with preparation of work papers and journal entries for clients related to but not limited to investments, deferred revenue, payroll and other items for accrual, such as insurance, property tax, and other pre-paid expenses
* Perform reconciliations and tie out period-end trial balance accounts
* Keep supervisors/managers apprised of assignments and scheduling issues on a timely basis
* Demonstrate a deeper understanding of business operations and accounting systems
* Assume responsibility for assigned engagements with supervision from more experienced staff
* Work closely with more experienced staff to identify and resolve issues encountered in performance of various types of assignments through effective and timely communication
* Establish and maintain a good working relationship and demonstrate effective communication with client and US team personnel at appropriate levels
* Maintain appropriate professionalism in client and team interactions
* Possess effective and clear work paper techniques
* Demonstrate an aptitude for budget and deadline considerations and strive for adherence.
* Experience developing improved processes and efficiencies and deploying these processes on existing clients
* Work with direct report manager to develop an appropriate plan of professional development and take responsibility to ensure that plan is executed
* In reference to carrying out their professional responsibilities, be familiar with and adhere to the relevant ethical requirements of the AICPA, as outlined in the Code of Professional Conduct, as well as those of state accountancy boards and professional societies for which any licenses are held.

**Corporate Compliance**
**Responsibilities**
Understand and adhere to the Firm’s policies and procedures, as well as applicable professional standards. Participate in training and evaluation of knowledge of and adherence to the firm’s compliance policies and procedures specific to the job level.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities or pregnancy to perform the essential functions, unless it would cause an undue hardship to the firm. The employee or potential employee still has their responsibility to be able to perform the essential duties of the position, unless such responsibility is excepted under federal, state, or local law.
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or another relevant field required
* CPA candidate or qualified for other relevant accounting certification, such as CMA, CGMA or CFA

**Skills**

* Basic familiarity with accounting standards
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook
* Proficiency in QuickBooks preferred
* Experience with use of Bill.com integrated with QuickBooks or other programs.
* Experience with Desktop QuickBooks, QuickBooks Online, Sage 50 (Peachtree), Xero, etc.
* Experience preparing financial statements using US GAAP or other basis of accounting
* Knowledge of US GAAP and standards related to compiled financial statements
* Experience with Excel at an intermediate level including understanding and ability to use pivot tables, V-Lookups, H-Lookups, If/then statements, etc.
* Experience in writing instructions for client tasks and company tasks that can be used as guidelines, checklists, training, etc. for clients and employees

title: Prod Planning & Inventory Control Deputy Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Production planning, material planning, inventory control and dispatch planning.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Delivery:

+ Meet site OTIF targets
+ Circulation of rolling dispatch plans to site cross-functional team
+ Ensure monthly dispatch and manufacturing commitments are met.
+ Collaborate with Tech Ops and Project Management team on execution of new product launches and site transfer projects.

+ Managing end to end MRP run and timely material indenting for commercial, life cycle, new product launches and projects
+ Material tracking & scheduling of material deliveries in line with production plan to ensure no line downtime due to material availability.

+ Monitor and control inventory levels of API, RM and PM in line with company targets.
+ Monthly assessment of action plans for slow/non-moving inventory
+ Provide routine destruction note approvals in line with MRB process.

* Timely escalation:

+ Highlight critical issues related to delivery and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive solutions.
+ Maintain transparent communication in all intra and inter-departmental meetings and emails

* Data Analysis and Continuous Improvement:

+ Analyze production and inventory data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to streamline processes
+ Implement process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and improve overall productivity

* MIS:

+ Prepare and present routine reports on production and dispatch performance, including key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics

* Compliance and Safety:

+ Ensure compliance with all relevant safety and quality standards, including ISO 14001 & 5S

Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Powertrain.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Job title:**

Finance Analyst

**Job Introduction:**

The Financial Analyst is responsible for analyzing financial data, preparing reports, supporting budgeting and forecasting processes, and providing insights that help management make informed business decisions. The role involves monitoring financial performance, identifying trends and risks, and ensuring financial accuracy and compliance.

**Major Responsibilities:**

  

* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
  + Prepare annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term financial plans.
  + Analyze actual financial performance against budgets and forecasts.
  + Provide variance analysis and recommend corrective actions.
  + Support business units with financial planning and reporting requirements.
* Financial Reporting
  + Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
  + Develop management dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  + Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial information.
  + Present financial findings and recommendations to management.
* Business Analysis
  + Conduct profitability, cost, and investment analyses.
  + Support pricing, cost optimization, and business case development.
  + Analyze market trends and business performance metrics.
  + Identify financial risks and opportunities to improve profitability.
* Budgeting & Forecasting
  + Coordinate budget collection and consolidation activities.
  + Maintain financial models for forecasting revenue, costs, and cash flow.
  + Monitor budget utilization and recommend adjustments where required.
* Compliance & Controls
  + Ensure compliance with company policies and financial regulations.
  + Support internal and external audit activities.
  + Assist in improving financial processes and internal controls.
* Stakeholder Support
  + Partner with business leaders to provide financial guidance.
  + Support strategic projects, investment evaluations, and management decisions.
  + Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and presentations as required.

**Knowledge and Education:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or related field.
* Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or financial reporting tools is an advantage.

**Work Experience:**

  

* 3-7 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Finance, or Accounting.
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, etc.) preferred.

**Skills and Competencies:**

  

* Financial Analysis and Modelling
* Budgeting and Forecasting
* Business Acumen
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Communication and Presentation Skills
* Stakeholder Management
* Time Management
* Data Interpretation and Reporting

**Preferred Certifications:**

  

* MBA (Finance)
* CA / CMA / CPA / CFA (preferred but not mandatory)
