title: Manager-Internal FC Framework
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Risk and Control manager to document and maintain process and controls documentation for the financial control team within GCFO. The candidate should have a deep understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements for internal controls over financial reporting (ICOFR) which have been encapsulated within the bank’s financial reporting controls framework (FRCF). The candidate will be responsible for identifying and mitigating risks and enhancing the internal control environment within GCFO. This role requires a deep understanding of financial reporting processes, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Report to the team lead will oversee the following activities performed by the team:**

* Training & Education: Help first line control owners understand and meet regulatory requirements relating to ICOFR either by helping to deliver existing training materials for ICOFR or by setting up bespoke training for first line control and process managers/owners.
* Remediation: Help first line control owners to remediate controls that fail design or operating effectiveness testing
* Control design and implementation - Work with first line control owners to design and implement robust internal controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting. Evaluate existing internal controls and implement improvements to enhance control effectiveness.
* Control documentation – Work with and assist first line teams to ensure controls are properly documented and maintained.
* Reporting and Communication: Act as the primary liaison with the Finance Risk & Governance team for the completion of FRCF lifecycle activities on behalf of GCFO. Help Finance Risk and Governance team coordinate and manage control testing activities with first line control owners. Work with the second line Finance Risk & Governance team to help ensure all issues and control deficiencies are logged within the bank’s strategic GRC tooling and the impact on ICOFR is risk assessed.

**Strategy**

* To help GCFO first line teams so they can comply with regulatory requirements prescribed within the UK Corporate Governance Code for internal controls over financial reporting (ICOFR).

**Business**

* The successful candidate will be working with colleagues across GCFO, Finance Risk & Governance and business stakeholders across the wider bank to successfully implement controls that help GCFO meet ICOFR requirements.

**Processes**
**Within GCFO Financial Control Work To**

* Design and implement robust internal controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of financial reporting.
* Evaluate existing internal controls and recommend improvements to enhance control effectiveness.
* Work with process owners to update process and controls documentation to reflect changes in business process or supporting technology/ systems.
* Work with process owners to ensure that controls that fail design or operating effectiveness testing are suitably remediated

**People & Talent**

* Help upskill GCFO staff, so they understand ICOFR requirements and best practices. The candidate must have strong interpersonal and communication skills (oral and written English) as well as networking and negotiation skills. Maintain a positive attitude with the motivation to work under pressure and deliver on multiple deadlines.

**Risk Management**

title: Technology Specialist - IT Vendor Management
description:

**About The Role**
As an ITVMO Demand, Licensing & Compliance professional, you will support enterprise technology demand management, software asset governance, license compliance, and decision intelligence. You will maintain an accurate view of software demand, entitlements, consumption, renewals, and licensing metrics across the technology portfolio.
  
  
You will collaborate across business and technology teams to translate complex licensing, usage, compliance, financial, and technology information into clear business insights and actionable recommendations. You will bring a detail-oriented, analytical, customer-service-focused approach while supporting effective governance and continuous improvement.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage enterprise software demand, including intake, validation, prioritization, forecasting, and ongoing tracking. Validate requests against inventory, existing entitlements, approved standards, usage data, and technology roadmaps to recommend appropriate fulfillment paths.
* Interpret software licensing models and conduct effective license position and compliance reviews by reconciling entitlement records, deployment information, user allocations, inventory, usage, and publisher-specific rules to identify underutilization, over-deployment, duplicate capabilities, compliance exposure, and optimization opportunities.
* Track renewals and subscriptions, create demand forecasts, and develop dashboards and management reporting covering demand, fulfillment, utilization, compliance exceptions, renewal readiness, product rationalization, technology spend, budgets, forecasts, allocations, variances, and operational performance.
* Apply AI-enabled analytics and automation to demand forecasting, spend anomaly detection, license optimization, compliance monitoring, renewal readiness, and reporting. Define, develop, test, deploy, and manage AI agents with appropriate human oversight, role-based access, data privacy, model and prompt controls, traceability, accuracy monitoring, exception escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain data quality standards, controls, procedures, decision records, evidence, and audit-ready documentation. Research licensing and technology changes, partner with application owners, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, finance, legal, risk, and other stakeholders, and support software standardization, catalog governance, rationalization, reclamation, reharvesting, and retirement initiatives.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* A bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science, finance, analytics, or a related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in IT vendor management, software asset management, technology demand management, license compliance, IT governance, or a related function.
* Strong understanding of software licensing models, entitlement records, deployment and usage data, subscriptions, cloud consumption, and infrastructure-related licensing concepts.
* Experience working with software asset management, configuration management, IT service management, inventory, reporting, or business intelligence platforms.
* Ability to analyze large and varied data sets, identify trends and control gaps, reconcile records, and present decision-ready insights.
* Experience with technology spend analytics, budget planning, forecasting, allocation, variance analysis, financial modeling, and executive-level reporting.
* Practical knowledge of AI-enabled analytics, intelligent automation, and the AI-agent lifecycle, including use-case definition, data and workflow design, testing, deployment, governance, monitoring, and adoption.
* Knowledge of audit readiness, evidence management, data governance, policy compliance, risk assessment, and remediation tracking.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical licensing and compliance concepts to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent customer service, critical thinking, decision-making, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
* Embodiment of Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

**These will help you succeed**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex licensing, technology, financial, and compliance information into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and collaborate effectively across technology and business functions.
* Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation and follow-through.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with an interest in AI-enabled intelligence and automation.
* Effective time management and the ability to manage multiple demand, licensing, compliance, renewal, and reporting priorities.

**Work model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Vendor Economics and Opex Analyst, gTech Ads Finance
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), consulting, or a related function.
* Experience executing full-cycle FP&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling within a multinational company setting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with vendor, BPO or shared-services economics (rate cards, staffing and work-driver models, productivity, cost to serve).
* Experience reconciling operational data (hours, volumes) against financial data (invoices, actuals).
* Experience with SQL, BI or analytics tools, and with generative AI tools in finance workflows.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority, including challenging plans with data.
* Ability to work across time zones and with distributed teams (India and US), and to turn complex analysis into a clear commercial recommendation.

**About the job**
-----------------

gTech Ads Finance partners with the leaders of gTech Ads as their CFOs, covering customer experience (CX), gTech Ads Enablement (gAE), Ads Solutions, Global Customer Solutions (GCS) and Large Customer Sales (LCS). We are becoming an AI-first finance team: automated pipelines and AI agents handle the mechanics, so our people can spend their time on commercial judgment and the decisions that move the business.

In this role, you will be the gTech Ads authority on what we spend on vendors, why, and where it could cost less. That covers vendor and extended-workforce spend across gAE, CX and Ads Solutions.

Your job is to make sure strategic vendor and opex decisions rest on the best available view of cost, risk and opportunity, across verticals as well as within them. You will work closely with vendor managers, operations leaders, gSO, and with finance business partners in India and Mountain View. You will bring the data, the insight and the challenge; business leaders make the decisions.

This role is central to making sure the savings we commit to are real, sustainable and visible in the P&L.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and maintain a gTech Ads vendor opex forecast from drivers, on top of an automated baseline. Bring in risks and opportunities from vendor managers and business changes from vertical finance partners.
* Track AI-driven and operational efficiency savings across verticals (committed vs. realized) and check that savings in plans and slides show up in vendor headcount and the P&L.
* Create and maintain cost per case, cost per hour and productivity measures by vendor, site and workflow.
* Spot and size opportunities to consolidate vendors and sites, harmonize rates and change mix. Present recommendations at a quarterly vendor economics review chaired by the Finance Lead.
* Use and improve AI agents and automated tools for forecasting, reconciliation, variance analysis and commentary. Share prompts and tools with the team, and retire manual processes when better options appear.

title: Shipping Cost Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlement
description:
**Shipping Cost Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlement**

**Industry:**
Shipping / Maritime Logistics

**Location:**
Thane, Mumbai

**Experience:**
7+ Years

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**About the Role:**

The role involves analyzing vessel operating costs, validating cost submissions received from shipping partners, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring accurate financial reconciliation of shared shipping operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of shipping or maritime operations, excellent analytical skills, and hands-on experience in
**cost reconciliation, financial analysis, and advanced Excel-based reporting.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Shipping Cost Reconciliation**

* Review and reconcile shipping-related costs, accruals, and financial data received from internal teams and external shipping partners.
* Validate cost calculations related to vessel operations, fuel consumption, voyage duration, vessel capacity allocation, and other operating expenses.
* Identify discrepancies between internal cost records and partner-submitted statements.
* Ensure timely and accurate reconciliation of costs for periodic settlement.

**2. Cost Analysis & Variance Management**

* Analyze differences in shipping and vessel operating costs to identify underlying causes.
* Investigate variations arising from fuel prices, consumption patterns, operational schedules, pricing assumptions, and allocation methods.
* Assess the financial impact of cost deviations and recommend necessary corrections.
* Prepare variance analysis reports and supporting reconciliation statements.

**3. Shipping Operations & Cost Coordination**

* Coordinate with shipping operations, vessel planning, finance, and commercial teams to validate operational and financial information.
* Review vessel deployment and voyage-related data to ensure alignment with cost calculations.
* Liaise with external shipping partners to clarify discrepancies and resolve settlement-related issues.
* Support accurate allocation of shared operational costs between shipping partners.

**4. Cost Data & Financial Reporting**

* Maintain shipping cost databases, master records, pricing references, and reconciliation trackers.
* Review and update cost assumptions relating to fuel prices, charter rates, exchange rates, and other operating expenses.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, reconciliation summaries, and management reports.
* Ensure proper documentation, data accuracy, and audit readiness.

**5. Process Accuracy & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation accuracy and reporting efficiency.
* Standardize Excel-based analysis, trackers, and settlement documentation.
* Support process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Ensure completion of assigned activities within reporting and month-end deadlines.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Shipping, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, preferably 7+ years, in shipping, maritime logistics, transportation, or associated cost reconciliation functions.
* Practical experience in cost analysis, accrual reconciliation, variance analysis, financial settlements, or operational cost reporting.
* Prior exposure to shipping line operations, vessel operating costs, freight-related cost analysis, or logistics finance would be advantageous.
* Experience working with large datasets, multiple cost sources, and periodic reporting requirements.

**Key Skills Required:**

* **Advanced MS Excel:**
  Strong proficiency in Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.
* **Cost Reconciliation:**
  Ability to compare financial and operational cost data and identify discrepancies.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong numerical ability and experience investigating cost variations.
* **Shipping Industry Knowledge:**
  Understanding of shipping operations, vessel costs, logistics, and transportation-related expenses.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Ability to coordinate with internal teams and external business partners.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
  Experience preparing reconciliation statements, cost reports, and management summaries.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  High accuracy in handling financial figures, calculations, and operational data.
* **Time Management:**
  Ability to independently manage deliverables within defined reporting timelines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**

Candidates with experience in the following areas would be particularly suitable:

* Shipping line cost control or financial reconciliation.
* Maritime or vessel operating cost analysis.
* Shipping or logistics finance and settlement operations.
* Cost accounting or accrual reconciliation within shipping companies.
* Vessel operations reporting with hands-on cost analysis exposure.
* Commercial operations involving cost-sharing arrangements or partner settlements.

title: BPO Director
description:
Associate Director – AUM Business Finance
  
  
**Mumbai (Work from Office)**
**This is an Asset Management Business Finance / FP&A role with AUM domain expertise and data-transformation ownership. It is not a Fund Operations, Middle Office, Fund Accounting, trade-processing, settlement, or reconciliation-only role.**
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a senior Asset Management Business Finance / FP&A leader with 10+ years of experience who can answer the core management questions: What is our AUM, why did it change, how does it drive revenue, and how do we create one governed enterprise source for that information?
  
  
The role owns the business-finance view of AUM across public and private markets, including AUM roll-forward, net flows, market/FX movement, Fee-Earning AUM, management-fee revenue, capital raise/capital lifecycle reporting, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, profitability and executive management reporting.
  
  
The successful candidate will also lead transformation of AUM and finance reporting from spreadsheet- and tool-based processes into governed, automated, auditable enterprise reporting supported by modern data platforms, master/reference-data governance and certified data products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
AUM Business Finance & Revenue
  
  

* Own end-to-end AUM reporting and monthly/quarterly AUM roll-forward across public and private market investment vehicles.
* Explain AUM movement across opening AUM, gross subscriptions/inflows, redemptions/outflows, transfers, distributions, market movement, FX, capital activity and other adjustments through closing AUM.
* Own net-flow reporting and attribution by product, strategy, vehicle, client/channel and region; distinguish business flows from market/FX performance.
* Calculate, reconcile and explain Fee-Earning AUM and its relationship to reported AUM.
* Own Revenue-to-AUM linkage, management-fee revenue analysis, fee-rate/yield analysis, accruals, true-ups and revenue variance commentary.
* Support capital raise and alternatives capital-lifecycle reporting, including commitments, subscriptions, calls/drawdowns, distributions and investor activity where applicable.
* Produce trusted management, Finance, Distribution, Product and executive AUM/revenue reporting.

FP&A & Management Reporting
  
  

* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts and long-range planning for AUM, net flows, revenue, expenses and profitability.
* Build driver-based forecasts linking AUM, flows, market assumptions, fee rates, product mix and revenue.
* Perform actual vs budget / forecast / prior-period variance analysis with clear business commentary and root-cause attribution.
* Develop financial models and scenario / sensitivity analysis for AUM, flows, pricing, fee compression, market movements, capital activity and business risks.
* Prepare executive management packs and KPI dashboards covering AUM, flows, Fee-Earning AUM, revenue, margins and business performance.
* Partner with senior Finance and business leaders on performance reviews, risks, opportunities and forward-looking outlook.

Data Transformation & Enterprise AUM Model
  
  

* Lead migration from spreadsheet- and multi-tool AUM/FP&A reporting to a governed enterprise data platform / Lakehouse and certified reporting layer.
* Define the target-state AUM/business-finance data model, operating model, ownership, controls and certification process.
* Govern Fund Master, Security Master, Investment Vehicle hierarchy, Client hierarchy, Legal Entity structure, currency and benchmark mappings.
* Ensure consistent Investment Vehicle and fund/security codes across upstream and downstream systems.
* Integrate ABOR, IBOR, market data, ERP and enterprise data platforms to create a single governed AUM and business-finance source.
* Establish data-quality rules, lineage, reconciliation, certification, auditability and clear data ownership.
* Automate AUM roll-forward, flow attribution, revenue linkage, forecast and management-reporting workflows using Power BI/Tableau and modern data tooling.

Stakeholder & Transformation Leadership
  
  

* Partner closely with Business Finance/FP&A, Distribution, Product, Investment Operations, Fund Accounting, Data and Technology.
* Translate finance requirements into business rules, data definitions, source-to-target mappings, reporting logic and acceptance criteria.
* Lead transformation governance, cross-functional workstreams, UAT, adoption and operating-model change.
* Present AUM, flow, revenue and transformation insights to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Asset Management / Investment Management Finance, Business Finance, FP&A or closely related financial-management roles.
* Recent, direct ownership of AUM/business-finance reporting — not only Fund Operations, Middle Office, Fund Administration or Fund Accounting.
* Demonstrated ownership of AUM roll-forward, net flows and movement attribution.

title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
**Haachi,**
an
**executive search firm**
, is supporting and advising a global high-frequency trading firm in hiring an Equity Research Analyst for its options trading desk, which trades Indian options. This is not a buy-side or sell-side role. The analyst sits alongside traders, producing notes and reports for internal use and advising the traders directly on the desk’s systematic and semi-systematic trading strategies, with real-time directional insight. The analyst maintains active coverage of a wide range of stocks and keeps close watch on the market, including earnings calls, policy changes and other events, assessing how they affect the price of the underlying stock and the price of its options. The analyst’s calls have a direct, immediate impact on the desk’s P&L, so the impact of the research is visible straight away.

**Role:**
Equity Research Analyst

**Location:**
Mumbai or Hong Kong, sitting alongside the traders on the desk

**Experience:**
3-5 years

**Coverage**
: Indian Markets

**About Our Client**

Our client is a privately held global trading firm with offices in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Australia. It has been a market maker in options for decades and now runs high-frequency and semi-systematic strategies across several asset classes. Research sits inside the trading process: ideas are judged by what they add to trading outcomes.

**The Role**

You will sit alongside the traders on the desk, in Mumbai or Hong Kong, and cover the Indian equity and options market. Your coverage is the core of the role: you follow Indian companies and the options market on them closely enough to tell traders what is priced, what is not, and why.

**Who You Will Write For**

-
**Primary readers:**
the derivatives and options traders on the semi-systematic desk.

-
**How they use your work**
: traders read your view within minutes, before the open or during the session, and act on it. Your analysis also feeds the desk's automated strategies.

-
**What this means:**
you are not writing a report for publication or a 12-month target. You are giving traders a direction, a confidence level, an expected move, and the condition that would change your view.

**Coverage**

- Indian single stocks and index options, including weekly and monthly expiries.

- Financials, insurers, IT, autos, and other sectors, with the companies that move the Indian options market most.

- Corporate actions, dividends, results, and regulatory decisions that change the expected move.

**Research Standard**

Your research is built on depth and rigour: the work behind each view is thorough, tested against past events, and checked against the options market. What reaches the trader is precise and succinct. A trader should be able to read a view in seconds and know exactly how confident you are and what would change your mind.

**How Your Work Is Measured**

- Hit rate on direction for event calls, tracked against outcomes.

- Accuracy of your expected move compared with the move the options market implied.

- Speed of first commentary after a company announcement.

- Quality of the scenario analysis, judged by whether the probabilities add to one and match the outcomes over time.

**A Typical Day**

-
**Before the open:**
Review overnight news, filings, and announcements. Send the desk a morning brief with the day's catalysts and expected moves.

-
**During market hours:**
Give real-time commentary on breaking news, results, and corporate actions, each with a direction, probability, and time frame.

-
**Event preparation:**
Build pre-event notes for earnings, dividends, M&A, and regulatory decisions. Estimate the expected move and compare it with the options-implied move.

-
**Ongoing coverage:**
Track financials, insurers, IT, autos, and other sectors. Update valuation and earnings views and flag any change.

-
**Collaboration:**
Work daily with derivatives traders on strategy and execution, and with the global research team across time zones.

**What You'll Do**

- Monitor Indian equity markets for catalysts and market-moving events

- Run event-driven and valuation analysis to find trading opportunities

- Deliver actionable commentary on news, earnings, and corporate actions

- Assess special situations: M&A, earnings surprises, regulatory shifts, and macro developments

- Forecast dividends and assess their effect on option pricing

- Work with derivatives traders to refine strategy and execution

**What our Client is looking for**

**Experience**

- 3-5 years in fundamental equity research, ideally on Indian markets

- Experience in a trading environment, event-driven desk, or investment team is a strong plus

- A record of views that others acted on, with the outcome tracked

**Options and probability**

- Understanding of how implied volatility, skew, and the expected move behave around events

- Ability to build a scenario tree with probabilities and compare it with the options market

- Experience with Indian single-stock options, including weekly and monthly expiries, is a strong plus

**Quantitative skills**

- Event studies: testing whether past catalysts moved the stock

- Basic backtesting, and working knowledge of Python or SQL

- Strong valuation and financial modelling skills

**Communication**

- Delivers a view to a trader in a few sentences, with a direction, a confidence level, and the condition that would change it

- Comfortable working under time pressure in a fast-paced environment

**Education**

- Bachelor's or Master's in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field

- Strong academic record

**Why This Role Matters**

Traders act on your view within minutes, and the desk's automated strategies depend on the quality of the research behind them. You will see the effect of your analysis on live positions, and be measured on it.

Knowledge of plastic raw materials such as HDPE, LDPE, PP, PET, ABS, PC, Nylon, POM, and PVC.

Excellent knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and costing models.
  
  
Strong analytical, numerical, communication, and coordination skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and meet costing and quotation deadlines.

Plastic blow moulding
  
  
Plastic injection moulding
  
  
Consumer and industrial plastic products
  
  
Electrical and electronic plastic components
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Accuracy of product costing.
  
  
Timely completion of RFQ and quotation costing.

* You’ll work directly with the Promoter, shape the finance function of a growing research and media brand, and see your work show up in how the business runs.

title: Assistant Vice President - Credit Risk
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
**If you really want to make a difference – make it with us:**
We are looking for a creative, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individual to join our team in India. You will be responsible for complete life cycle management for investments and managing stakeholders, both internal and external.
  
  
We are life-long learners who believe in our purpose to benefit society by transforming the everyday. We enjoy challenges and continually bring diversity of thought and experience to the table that are key to our success. Join our team and let’s develop together what will be important tomorrow!
  
  
**Position Overview**
You will be involved in providing structured debt financing for Asia-Australia through Siemens Bank GmbH. As part of a strong and established team of project and structured finance risk managers, you will support the Bank's continued growth with a focus on energy and infrastructure transactions. In this context you will underwrite and manage your own projects.
  
  
**You’ll Make a Difference By**

* Underwrite and execute project finance transactions across the energy, infrastructure, and digital infrastructure sectors in Asia-Australia by conducting comprehensive risk assessments and providing structuring input to the Origination team.
* Assess and structure new opportunities with a focus on identifying key risks, optimizing financing structures, and ensuring an appropriate balance between risk and return.

* Lead transaction execution and stakeholder management by coordinating internal teams including Legal, Compliance, Tax, Rating, Asset Management, and Operations,
* Manage and monitor an existing portfolio of project finance assets by assessing waiver and amendment requests, identifying emerging risks and opportunities, monitoring transaction performance, and supporting remedial or optimization initiatives where required. You will also be the first point of contact representing Siemens Bank and SFS towards lenders, advisors, and other external counterparties.
* Develop and maintain effective risk management practices by ensuring compliance with internal policies and contributing to the continuous enhancement of credit, underwriting, and portfolio management standards.
* Maintain a strong understanding of market developments in the energy, infrastructure, and digital infrastructure sectors, including financing trends, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies relevant to the Asia-Australia region.

**Your Success Is Grounded In**

* At least 7-1 0 years of relevant experience in project finance, structured finance, infrastructure finance, or credit risk, with significant exposure to energy and infrastructure transactions.
* Strong credit and risk assessment capabilities, including the ability to independently evaluate complex financing structures and identify key transaction risks.
* Advanced financial modelling skills, including the ability to review, challenge, and sensitize detailed project finance models.
* Experience reviewing and negotiating financing documentation, including loan agreements, security documents, and project contracts.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to interact effectively with advisors, lenders, sponsors and senior management.
* A university degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, ideally supplemented by a professional or postgraduate qualification.
* A proactive and ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outcomes under pressure.
* Strong collaboration skills and intercultural awareness, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, countries, and seniority levels.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in
**Mumbai**
, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow. #SFS

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Join us as Portfolio Manager within the PBWM Multi Asset team, where you will play a pivotal role in strengthening the Multi Asset Class (MAC) platform, deepening advisory enablement, enhancing client engagement and contributing to thought leadership through fund-of-funds discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management.
  
  
This is a client-facing role, directly influencing client satisfaction, asset class allocation decision-making, research-led portfolio management and the translation of market and investment research into actionable client insights.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should**

* Deliver top-down and bottom-up equity insights covering market strategy, sector positioning and fund research.
* Build and maintain financial models, valuation frameworks and scenario analyses.
* Track earnings, guidance, macroeconomic and sector developments and convert them into timely, actionable investment insights.
* Partner with Bankers, Investment Specialists and Product teams to support multi-asset client discussions.
* Conduct ad-hoc, monthly and quarterly client portfolio reviews.
* Provide structured and compliant responses to client queries, clearly articulating rationale, risks and portfolio positioning.
* Produce high-quality manager research notes, thematic research and investment ideas tailored for PBWM clients.
* Work closely with CIO Office, Product, Risk, Compliance and Advisory Governance teams.
* Ensure research and client communication adhere to relevant governance standards, disclosures, escalation protocols and record-keeping requirements.
* Maintain strong awareness of suitability, client segmentation and product risk.
* Strengthen research processes including sector coverage, earnings tracking, templates and approval workflows.
* Support scalable delivery across research notes, presentations, dashboards and client kits.

**Essential Skills / Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in research and/or fund management, including familiarity with portfolio/fund management systems.
* Strong experience in fundamental equity research, with prior coverage of one or more key equity sectors on the buy-side or sell-side.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy formulation, financial modelling and valuation.
* Strong understanding of earnings, catalysts, scenarios and risk assessment.
* Ability to translate investment research into clear, actionable and client-relevant insights.
* Experience in thematic research, investment idea generation and high-quality internal and client communication.
* Strong understanding of risk assessment, suitability and governance requirements.
* Portfolio Management NISM Series XXI-B certification, to be secured as per applicable regulatory requirements.

**Desirable Skills / Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA (Finance), CFA or CA preferred.
* Experience in quantitative research, product strategy or advisory enablement within wealth management, brokerage or institutional environments.
* Understanding of multi-asset portfolio management and Fund of Funds (FOF) structures.
* Prior experience conducting client portfolio reviews on an ad-hoc, monthly and quarterly basis.
* Experience with tools such as Wealth Spectrum, Miles, Bloomberg, MFI, ACE MF and Capitaline.
* Client-centric mindset with strong ownership and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management experience across Investment, Product and Frontline teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce crisp, compliant and client-ready content.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as:
  
  
  

* Quality, accuracy and timeliness of client reviews and research outputs.
* Ability to translate research into clear, actionable and client-relevant communication.
* Effectiveness of stakeholder engagement across the PBWM ecosystem.
* Commercial impact on advisory conviction, client engagement and AUM retention/growth.
* Financial modelling, valuation and investment research capabilities.
* Understanding of multi-asset portfolio construction and fund management.
* Discipline around governance, risk management and control standards.
* Accuracy, diligence and ownership in fund management-related activities.

Job location is Mumbai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To generate returns, manage risk, and ensure the portfolio’s financial stability and long-term success.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Allocation and monitoring of securities within a portfolio, aligned to the banks risk tolerance to framework and changing market conditions, investment objectives and regulatory requirements, utilising specialist software and data analytics tools, to enhance the portfolio management efficiency and effectiveness.
* Execution of research and analysis on various securities (equity, bond, funds) to identify profitable investment opportunities, aligned to the banks risk tolerance.
* Communication of the banks investment philosophy, decision making and investment selection to Clients and other key stakeholders such as Relationship Managers and Investment Advisors.
* Performance monitoring against benchmarks and objectives, analysing risk metrics, and creation of reports for senior colleagues and internal stakeholders.
* Implementation of risk management strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate potential financial risks associated with the portfolio, such as market fluctuations, credit risk, and liquidity risk.
* Conducting of simulations to assess the portfolio's resilience to different market scenarios and economic downturns, identification of potential vulnerabilities and informing on risk mitigation strategies, and communicate key findings to senior executives and board members.
* Monitoring of economic data, industry news, and geopolitical events to anticipate potential impacts on the portfolio and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Research of emerging asset classes, innovative investment strategies, and alternative investments to potentially enhance portfolio returns.
* Stakeholder management of investment banks, market makers, and other external partners as needed for portfolio transactions and information gathering.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

title: Junior Finance Associate
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a driven Junior Finance Associate to join our Finance team, with a primary focus on Accounts Payable and Management Reporting. We’re looking for someone who is hands-on, eager to learn and motivated to take ownership and continuously improve how things are done.

On the Accounts Payable side, you will support day-to-day invoice and expense processing to ensure accurate recording, timely payments, and a smooth experience for vendors and internal stakeholders. On the Management Reporting side, you will support and further develop the Bank’s key management reports, including revenue and KPI reporting, while also contributing to the budgeting and forecasting process. You will work closely with business owners and the wider Finance team to resolve queries, improve reporting, maintain clean documentation and support compliance with internal policies and audit requirements.

**Your AMINA To-Do List**

**Accounts Payable & Finance Operations:**

* Process supplier invoices and employee expenses accurately and on time in our finance systems.
* Ensure invoices are correctly coded, approved, and aligned with internal policies.
* Support payment runs across multiple payment systems and coordinate with relevant internal teams.
* Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, expense, and vendor queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation in line with audit and compliance requirements.
* Support AP-related month-end close activities.

**Management Reporting & Budgeting:**

* Support the preparation of the Bank’s key management reports, including revenue and KPI reporting.
* Develop an understanding of how key metrics are calculated, where the underlying data comes from and how it flows into Finance reporting.
* Support data mapping and validation to help ensure reporting remains accurate, consistent, and reliable.
* Look at our reports with a curious mindset: understand whether the numbers make sense and help identify gaps or areas that could be improved.
* Work with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to understand what information is useful to them and how our reporting can continue to evolve.
* Support the budgeting and forecasting process, building an understanding of the Bank’s key revenue streams, cost areas, and business drivers.

**Ownership & Growth:**

* Bring a proactive, hands-on attitude, take ownership of your work and be comfortable asking questions and learning as you go.
* Work closely with the wider Finance team and business stakeholders, with plenty of opportunity to build your knowledge and gradually take on broader responsibilities.

**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

**Essential:**

* Basic understanding of accounting or finance principles (through education, self‑study, or practical exposure)
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with high volumes of data
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to concentrate for extended periods and take pride in delivering high‑quality, reliable work
* Proactive, positive attitude with a willingness to learn and take feedback onboard
* Comfortable working with systems and technology (prior experience with expense or invoice tools is a plus, but not required)
* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related fields.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience in an operational, administrative, or finance‑related role
* Pursuing advanced qualifications in Finance, especially the CFA Program. Exposure to Accounts Payable, Expense Processing or Budgeting.

**Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
**Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Chartered Accountant (1-2 years)
description:
Job Description – Chartered Accountant (1–3 Years)

Role snapshot

Experience - 1–3 years post-qualification

Company - BDI Group (BSE SME listed, scrip 544468)

Location - Mumbai (head office)

Employment type - Full-time, permanent

About BDI Group

BDI Group is a BSE SME-listed, multi-entity plastic moulding manufacturer headquartered in Mumbai. The group operates 2 entities with manufacturing plants at Pune, Dewas, Hoshiarpur and Zaheerabad.

Role purpose

The Finance Manager will run day-to-day finance, reporting and compliance across all group entities, working directly with the CFO. The role combines hands-on execution (closings, statutory filings, listing compliance) with support on strategic work such as fundraising, acquisitions and the IPO track.

Key responsibilities

**Financial reporting and accounts**

* Drive monthly, quarterly and annual closing across all group entities, including consolidation and inter-company reconciliations
* Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements under Indian GAAP and Schedule III
* Prepare half-yearly and annual results for BSE SME disclosure, with supporting schedules and notes
* Coordinate statutory, internal and tax audits end to end, including audit queries and management representations
* Review plant-level entries, inventory valuation and costing records maintained in SAP

**Taxation and statutory compliance**

* Oversee GST compliance across entities and states: returns, reconciliations (GSTR-2B vs books), ITC eligibility, refunds and e-invoicing
* Support GST audits, notices and appeals, working with external GST advisors
* Manage direct-tax compliance: TDS/TCS, advance tax, tax computations and return filing, including the s.115BAA regime
* Track statutory dues (GST, TDS, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Income Tax) through the monthly compliance tracker so no due date is missed
* Maintain the statutory case register and prepare replies to departmental notices

**FP&A and treasury**

* Prepare annual budgets, monthly MIS and variance analysis by entity and plant
* Build and maintain cash-flow forecasts; monitor working capital, receivables and collections
* Prepare banking proposals and documents for working capital and term-loan limits; ensure covenant and stock-statement compliance

**Team and process**

* Allocate and review work for accounts and compliance staff using the finance master task tracker
* Maintain the internal finance handbook, SOPs and approval controls; drive automation of recurring reports

Candidate profile

**Essential**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant with 1–3 years of post-qualification experience
* Experience in a Big 4 / mid-tier audit or advisory firm, or in the finance function of a manufacturing company
* Working knowledge of AS, Companies Act 2013, GST, Income Tax and TDS
* Hands-on with month-end closing, reconciliations and financial statement preparation
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, financial models); working knowledge of SAP or a comparable ERP

**Attributes**

* High ownership and accuracy under tight statutory deadlines
* Clear written communication with auditors, advisors, bankers and senior management
* Comfortable working across plants and teams, with willingness to travel periodically

What we offer

* Direct exposure to the CFO office of a listed, growing manufacturing group
* Broad scope across reporting, tax, listing compliance, treasury, M&A and IPO work early in your career
* Competitive compensation, commensurate with qualification and experience

**How to apply:**
send your CV to hr@bdi-group.org with the subject line "Finance Manager – CA".

description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Credit Risk Analyst
  
  
What does a successful Credit Risk Analyst do at Fiserv? You will work to identify, Mitigate and eliminate fraud and credit losses to Fiserv and our clients by conducting investigations to identify potentially high risk/suspicious merchant processing activity to protect the firm against financial loss. What you will do: Make real time decisions to properly identify situations that require deeper investigation with the ability to identify emerging fraud trends. Coordinate risk mitigation and fraud remediation efforts with other areas of the business such as Funding, Legal, Operations, Client Services, etc. Communicate regularly with internal and external partners to present high risk activity with recommended and/or required actions. Work in a fast paced environment reviewing many accounts to identify potentially high risk/suspicious merchant processing activity to protect the firm against financial loss. You will review and investigate merchant accounts to assess fraud and credit risk exposure.  Negotiate collateral requirements and restructuring terms as required. Resolve merchant inquiries through scheduled calls. Complete special projects as assigned. You will read and interpret documents. You will calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.  You will exercise discretion and independent judgment in making decisions and interact effectively and positively with all levels of personnel, partners, and vendors. You will work independently or in a team environment & work efficiently in stressful situations. What you will need to have: 2 year degree with prior work experience. 2 years prior customer service experience or 1 year Fraud & Risk Experience Ability to use programs such as Excel & Word Ability to Multi-Task You must be a detailed and organized individual You may be required to work some weekends and holidays to meet deadlines. The ability to meet deadlines What would be good to have: Bachelor’s degree.  (Business, Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Pre-Law, etc.) 1-year prior credit risk experience Experience with MasterCard and Visa Association rules and regulations Customer Service experience with track record of dealing in adverse situations Strong analytical, quantitative and problem-solving skills.

title: Transactional Accountant Manager
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
As a part of the Transaction Accounting team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and efficiency of accounting operations related to financial bookings, reconciliations, accruals, reserves, and reporting activities.
  
  
The role is responsible for executing and monitoring accounting processes in compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and operational procedures while leveraging technology and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial governance.
  
  
You will collaborate with global stakeholders, support process improvement initiatives, and contribute to Allianz's digital transformation journey through the adoption of AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and data-driven insights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Transaction Accounting & Financial Operations
  
  

* Perform monthly accounting activities including accruals, provisions, reconciliations, and financial bookings.
* Review and analyze financial results to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies.
* Conduct balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items in a timely manner.
* Manage accounting for reserves, commissions, client cost allocations, and foreign exchange-related transactions.
* Review open item management and perform timely clearing and resolution activities.
* Support accounting activities related to reinsurance, technical reserves, IFRS reporting, and financial controls.
* Ensure adherence to Standard Work Procedures (SWPs), internal controls, and audit requirements.

Reporting & Analysis
  
  

* Prepare and validate monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting deliverables.
* Perform variance analysis and investigate unusual trends or discrepancies.
* Generate actionable insights through financial data analysis to support business decision-making.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for accounting processes and controls.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation, simplification, and standardization opportunities.
* Support transformation initiatives focused on operational excellence and digital finance.
* Participate in process redesign projects aimed at improving quality, scalability, and productivity.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and enhance service delivery.

AI & Digital Readiness
  
  

* Leverage AI-powered productivity tools, analytics solutions, and automation technologies to improve operational efficiency.
* Use data visualization, analytics, and digital tools to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Demonstrate curiosity toward emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Intelligent Automation, and Process Mining.
* Contribute to building a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and digital adoption within the finance function.
* Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI tools in accordance with Allianz policies and data governance standards.

What You Bring
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of Financial Accounting, Transaction Accounting, and Accounting Operations.
* Good knowledge of balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and month-end close activities.
* Familiarity with General Ledger accounting, financial controls, and reporting processes.
* Understanding of insurance accounting concepts, including reserving and reinsurance, will be an advantage.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP and reporting platforms.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reporting.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify trends.
* Detail-oriented approach with excellent accuracy and control awareness.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive problem-solving and continuous improvement orientation.

Communication & Collaboration
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Experience working in multicultural and global environments.
* Strong influencing and collaboration skills with a customer-centric approach.

Digital & AI Mindset
  
  

* Comfortable working with digital tools, automation solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.
* Interest in leveraging data and technology to improve business outcomes.
* Learning agility and openness to adopting new ways of working.
* Ability to translate business challenges into digital or automation opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Professional qualifications such as MBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent will be advantageous.

**Experience**

* 8-10 years of relevant experience in Transaction Accounting, Financial Accounting, Record-to-Report (R2R), Insurance Accounting, or Shared Services Finance Operations.
* Experience within Insurance, Financial Services, or Global Business Services environments is preferred.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
This role is to provide Project Controls which includes schedule and cost controlling on projects. In Project Controls, our goal is to ensure the right rigor around schedule and cost management processes to deliver projects on-time and within budget. title: Corporate Finance Analyst
description:
Purpose/Objective

The Analyst – Corporate Finance is responsible for supporting financial modeling, data analysis, transaction execution, and reporting to drive strategic financial decisions. This role provides critical support in capital raising, M&A activities, financial structuring, and compliance, ensuring alignment with corporate finance objectives.

Key Responsibilities of Role

**Financial Analysis & Modeling:**

Develop and maintain financial models to support decision-making for capital raising, M&A, and debt/equity financing.

Conduct scenario analysis and stress testing to evaluate financial strategies and risk exposure.

Assist in preparing valuation models, including discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable company analysis, and precedent transaction analysis.

**Capital Raising & Transaction Execution:**

Support the execution of debt and equity financing initiatives, assisting in documentation, due diligence, and investor presentations.

Assist in structuring corporate finance transactions, including syndicated loans, bond issuances, and project finance deals.

Track market developments, interest rates, and investor sentiment to provide insights for capital-raising strategies.

**Reporting & Documentation:**

Prepare and update financial reports, investor presentations, board materials, and regulatory filings.

Ensure accuracy and consistency in financial data and reports provided to senior management, investors, and rating agencies.

Maintain transaction records and financial models to facilitate efficient decision-making.

**Stakeholder Coordination:**

Collaborate with investment banks, credit rating agencies, lenders, and investors to provide necessary financial data and documentation.

Work closely with internal teams, including treasury, legal, tax, and compliance, to ensure seamless execution of finance-related initiatives.

Assist in preparing internal memos and presentations for executive leadership.

**Market Research & Competitive Benchmarking:**

Conduct research on industry trends, macroeconomic factors, and financial markets to assess their impact on corporate finance strategies.

Benchmark company financial performance against industry peers to identify areas for improvement.

Monitor regulatory changes in financial markets and assess their implications for the organization.

**Educational Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; CFA/FRM/MBA preferred.

**Work Experience (Range of years):**

1-3 years in a related field

title: Price Book Assistant
description:
Price Book Assistant

Location: Ahmedabad, India (Remote until Office is Established)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required: 4–5+ Years

CTC: ₹75,000 – ₹1,00,000 per month

Work Hours: US Shift – Must overlap at least 5 hours with US Eastern Time (approx. 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST, or as agreed)

Reports To: Owner

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Price Book Assistant to manage pricing accuracy across multiple retail stores. The role will focus on maintaining accurate cost and retail pricing, ensuring margins are properly maintained, updating prices when vendor costs change, and preparing regular sales and pricing reports for management.

The ideal candidate should be highly detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers and Excel, and experienced in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, or other accuracy-focused roles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Book / Sales Summary Reporting

- Prepare recurring sales summaries for management review.

- Analyze sales performance by item, category, and store.

- Generate and review sales reports using the retail back-office system.

- Compare sales performance across individual stores and the overall business.

- Use sales data to support pricing, purchasing, and inventory decisions.

- Maintain accurate and timely reporting for management.

2. Pricing & Margin Management

- Ensure retail prices accurately reflect current product costs and required margins.

- Review item-level pricing and identify pricing or margin discrepancies.

- Update retail prices whenever vendor costs change.

- Audit margins by item, category, and store.

- Identify products that are underpriced, over-priced, or not meeting the required margin.

- Ensure pricing changes are accurately reflected across the required stores.

3. Excel-Based Price & Cost Updates

- Prepare and manage bulk price and cost changes using Microsoft Excel.

- Review and cross-check pricing data before importing updates into the retail back-office system.

- Perform mass price and cost updates where required.

- Ensure imported pricing data is accurate and meets the required margin structure.

- Maintain proper records of pricing changes and updates.

4. Price Book Accuracy & Maintenance

- Maintain the accuracy of the price book across multiple stores.

- Review item costs, retail prices, margins, and related pricing information regularly.

- Identify and correct discrepancies in pricing and cost data.

- Coordinate with relevant teams/vendors when cost or pricing information needs clarification.

- Ensure pricing information remains consistent and up to date across stores.

Required Qualifications

- 4–5+ years of experience in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, purchasing, or a similar detail-oriented, numbers-focused role.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work with repetitive, accuracy-critical data.

- Good understanding of cost, retail price, markup, and margin calculations.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills for reviewing, comparing, and updating pricing data.

- Comfortable working with POS / retail back-office systems.

- Prior experience with ECRS Catapult is an advantage but not mandatory.

- Ability to analyze sales and pricing reports and identify discrepancies.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage large volumes of item and pricing data.

- Willingness to work in a US shift and maintain the required overlap with US Eastern Time.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who is highly detail-oriented and comfortable working with pricing, costs, margins, Excel, and large volumes of retail data. The candidate should be able to identify pricing discrepancies, maintain accurate price books across multiple stores, and provide reliable sales and pricing reports to management.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Statutory Reporting Manager, GBS - ATR**

**Statutory Reporting Manager – ATR Statutory Excellence**
As
**Statutory Reporting Manager, GBS - ATR**
, you will be a key member of the GBS Account to Report organization, supporting the standardization, governance, and execution of statutory reporting activities across in-scope entities. The role will initially support a pilot scope of 21 holding and financing entities, with the opportunity to expand across additional business units and entities over time as Workiva adoption and statutory reporting requirements grow.
  
  
This role will act as the first point of expertise for Workiva financials, non-leading ledger statutory adjustments, roll forward consistency, reconciliation quality, and routine audit support. Reporting to the
**Senior Manager, GBS ATR - EU Lead**
, the position will partner closely with Controllership, HQ, Business Units, External Audit, GBS ATR leadership, and technology teams to ensure statutory reporting processes are accurate, controlled, scalable, and consistently executed.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Statutory Reporting, Roll forwards & Reconciliation Governance
* Manage and oversee the roll forward of Workiva financials for non-leading ledgers across in-scope entities, ensuring consistent application of statutory reporting templates, data flows, and review practices.
* Reconcile Workiva outputs, non-leading ledger balances, and statutory financial statements back to signed accounts and underlying SAP records, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness.
* Drive consistency in roll forwards, reconciliations, controls, templates, and supporting documentation across entities, with a focus on repeatable execution and scalable ways of working.
* Non-Leading Ledger Adjustments & Technical Accounting Support
* Book, review, or coordinate the posting of statutory adjustments in the non-leading ledger within SAP, ensuring adjustments are complete, accurate, properly supported, and reflected consistently in statutory reporting outputs.
* Investigate, analyze, and document accounting matters under US GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory reporting requirements to support appropriate financial statement presentation and application.
* Apply professional judgment to assess auditor questions, challenge requests where appropriate, and support Controllership and HQ teams in resolving technical accounting or reporting matters.
* Workiva SME Ownership & Technology Enablement
* Act as the subject matter expert for Workiva financials, providing guidance to Business Units, HQ, Controllership, and GBS teams on system use, process design, mapping logic, and reporting requirements.
* Support mapping changes, remapping, new entity onboarding, additional business unit requirements, technical queries, and issue resolution as more entities adopt Workiva.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve technology platforms, including Workiva, and partner with HQ, IT, Digital Finance, and external vendors to enhance controls, automation, reporting efficiency, and user experience.
* Audit Support & Stakeholder Management
* Serve as a key GBS point of contact for statutory audit activities across in-scope entities, including interim audits, year-end audits, audit preparation, audit evidence coordination, and first-line review of comments.
* Support the HQ team in deriving any necessary statutory adjustments during the with preparation and first-level review of Workiva financials and in drafting responses to audit comments, ensuring all responses are accurate, timely, and appropriately supported with documentation before escalation.
* Build strong relationships with Controllership, External Audit, Business Units, HQ, Internal Controls, and GBS ATR leadership to support timely decision-making, issue resolution, and consistent statutory reporting execution.
* GBS Expansion, Process Standardization & Future COE Capability
* Support the phased centralization of statutory reporting activities into GBS, beginning with the pilot scope and expanding one business unit or entity group at a time based on complexity, readiness, and business need.
* Develop repeatable processes, templates, controls, and governance structures that enable a future statutory reporting Center of Excellence capability within GBS ATR.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and strengthen statutory reporting processes, including roll forwards, manual journal posting, reconciliations, audit support, and Workiva administration.

**Qualifications**

* Education
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualification preferred, such as CPA, CA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Experience
* Strong experience in statutory reporting, external audit, controllership, technical accounting, or Account to Report processes, preferably within a multinational or shared services environment.
* Big 4 external audit experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting statutory audits, interim audits, financial statement preparation, audit evidence coordination, and auditor query resolution.
* Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems required, including understanding of leading ledger and non-leading ledger mechanics, manual journal posting, and statutory adjustment flows.
* Experience with Workiva or similar financial reporting, statutory reporting, or disclosure management platforms preferred.
* Skills
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, statutory reporting requirements, US GAAP, IFRS, and local reporting considerations.
* Strong judgment and ability to analyze accounting questions, assess financial reporting implications, and appropriately challenge or push back on auditor requests where needed.
* Strong reconciliation, review, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and focus on control quality.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Controllership, HQ, Business Units, External Audit, IT, Digital Finance, and GBS leadership.
* Ability to build scalable processes, support change management, and contribute to the development of a future statutory reporting Center of Excellence.
* Fluent in English.

This is a founding operator role. You will not inherit a finished system. You will build one.

This is not an HR Manager, Finance Manager or administrative role. It is a hands-on business operator who knows how a staffing company runs behind the scenes.

**You own India business and financial operations end to end:**
controls, monthly close, management reporting, intercompany billing with the U.S., HR and payroll oversight, statutory compliance, and the relationships with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers. You set up the Ahmedabad office and lead key corporate and banking projects. You build the Business Operations team under you. **What you will build in year one**

* A finance and controls function that U.S. leadership can trust without checking the work twice: approval workflows, segregation of duties, auditable records
* The Ahmedabad office: premises, vendors, infrastructure, people
* A steady working rhythm with our Chartered Accountants, Company Secretary and bankers: clear handoffs, complete documentation, deadlines met without reminders
* HR, payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, Professional Tax) run by a specialist you hire and manage
* Oversight of staffing back-office operations: consultant onboarding, timesheets, billing and client portals
* The reporting rhythm: one monthly view of cash, billing, payroll, compliance and open issues
* The systems backbone across Zoho Books, Tally, HRMS and our staffing platforms

* Monthly close, reporting and compliance running on schedule without CEO intervention
* The Ahmedabad office and professional relationships operating with clear ownership

**Who does well here**

* 10+ years in business operations, ideally IT staffing or professional services, with hands-on ownership of India finance operations: monthly close, reconciliations, vendor payments, payroll controls, management reporting
* Has worked directly with Chartered Accountants, tax professionals and payroll providers, and keeps ownership inside the company
* Reads a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow and turns them into management action
* 5+ years managing people; working knowledge of Indian HR, payroll and employment compliance
* Working knowledge of U.S. staffing back-office operations: consultant lifecycle, W-2 and C2C, timesheets, client billing
* Has built processes, controls and reporting in a growing company and been personally accountable for the result. Been there, done that
* A problem-solver who owns outcomes: resolves issues at their level, escalates with options rather than questions, and does not need the CEO to close every open item
* Clear writer and speaker; discreet; comfortable working directly with U.S. leadership

**Preferred:**
Zoho Books, Zoho People, Tally, QuickBooks or comparable systems; SAP Fieldglass, SAP Ariba or similar MSP and VMS platforms; intercompany billing across related companies in different countries; setting up a new office or managing external advisers.

**Why this role**

* Founding seat in a new India headquarters, with the authority to design how it runs
* Direct line to the CEO. Your work is seen, and your decisions carry
* Cross-border scope: U.S. and India finance, tax, compliance and staffing operations in one role
* A path to Head of India Business Operations as the company grows
