title: Team Member-Treasury
description: About Business JOB DESCRIPTION Adani Group: In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.Job Purpose: The Team Member - Middle Office supports treasury operations by monitoring transactions, ensuring compliance with risk policies, and reconciling data across front, middle, and back offices. The role focuses on risk reporting, transaction validation, and process enhancements to maintain operational accuracy and support the treasury’s financial and risk management objectives.Responsibilities2. Trade Execution Control, Valuations & Mandates3. Hedging, Debt Documentation & DCM Coordination4. Audit Compliance Risk Management, Limit Monitoring & System Implementation Limit Setup & Monitoring: Set up, monitor, and enforce exposure and stop-loss limits across treasury activities, providing regular performance and utilization reports to senior leadership. Breach Management: In the event of an exposure or stop-loss limit breach, proactively seek immediate trade ratification and formulate a concrete action plan to bring utilization back within limits. Report breach summaries and subsequent progress to senior management. Risk Analytics: Analyze and control the risk of treasury dealings. Calculate, analyze, and report Value at Risk (VaR) on a regular basis. Stress Testing: Run forward-looking forecasts and simulations using sensitivity analysis and stress testing to provide deep insights into potential portfolio impacts. System Implementation & Reporting: Provide business and risk intelligence to management to assist in the implementation of advanced risk management systems. Execution Source Control: Monitor and control trade execution channels (such as FXGo, Bloomberg Chat, or official Voice calls). Escalate any unauthorized trade execution sources immediately. Dealer Mandates: Maintain up-to-date dealer mandates and ensure that all treasury transactions are executed in strict accordance with corporate authorization rules. P&L Computation: Compute and publish daily Profit and Loss (PnL) statements for all trading / risk management desks of Group Treasury. Valuation & MTM Reconciliation: Ensure the absolute correctness of trade valuations by assessing and testing the pricing methodologies utilized by the FinMechanics (FM) system. Risk quantification: Actively monitor and report quantum of Risk run by desk and ad well as Group along with sensitivity and scenarios. Covenant Tracking & Monitoring: Set up, maintain, and manage a robust tracking framework to monitor compliance with financial, operational, and hedging covenants under existing and new debt documents (including USD Bonds, ECBs, FCLs, and bilateral bank facilities). Ensure zero defaults by proactively flagging covenant headroom risks to senior management. Economic Value of Treasury Activities: Actively analyze, quantify and report on the economic value of Treasury decisions. Hedge Cost Benchmarking: Track, analyze, and publish actual hedge costs against benchmark hedge costs for USD Bonds, External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs), and Foreign Currency Loans (FCLs) on a regular basis. DCM Documentation: Coordinate with key internal and external stakeholders—including legal teams, lead managers, and BUs—to timely execute Debt Capital Markets (DCM) documentation. Audit Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for the internal audit team. Ensure swift resolution of audit findings and establish clear, time-bound action plans to address any noted control gaps.Qualifications Education: Chartered Accountant (CA), Financial Risk Management (FRM), CFA, or MBA in Finance from a premier institution. Experience: 5 to 9 years of direct experience in a Treasury Middle Office, Treasury Control, or Market Risk department within a large multinational conglomerate, major bank, or financial institution.

title: Account Officer
description:
**Job description**

**1. Job Objective**

To manage customer receivables, collection follow-ups, supplier and vendor payments, bank transactions, and account reconciliations while ensuring effective working capital management, accurate financial records, timely payments, and compliance with company policies.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Receivables & Customer Collections**

-Monitor customer outstanding balances, credit periods, and overdue invoices.

-Follow up with customers, dealers, distributors, and institutional buyers for timely collections.

-Prepare daily and weekly customer ageing reports and collection forecasts.

-Coordinate with the sales and dispatch teams to resolve invoice, delivery, e-way bill, and documentation-related payment issues.

-Monitor customer credit limits and escalate overdue accounts to the Finance Manager.

-Reconcile customer ledgers and resolve short payments, deductions, debit notes, and credit note discrepancies.

-Ensure timely accounting and allocation of customer receipts against outstanding invoices.

-Track customer advances and ensure appropriate adjustment against sales invoices.

-Monitor retention money, security deposits, and other recoverable balances, wherever applicable.

**B. Supplier & Vendor Payments**

-Process payments to raw material suppliers, packaging material vendors, transporters, job workers, and other service providers.

-Prepare payment schedules based on due dates, cash availability, supplier terms, and business priorities.

-Ensure timely payments to critical suppliers to avoid disruption in raw material supply and production.

-Verify vendor bank details and maintain appropriate controls over changes to payment instructions.

-Reconcile vendor statements and resolve outstanding differences.

-Track supplier advances and ensure timely adjustment against invoices.

-Ensure appropriate withholding tax deductions and other applicable statutory compliance before releasing payments.

**C. Banking & Treasury Coordination**

-Prepare payment batches through internet banking or ERP systems, subject to authorized approval.

-Monitor daily bank balances, receipts, payments, and fund requirements.

-Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding entries.

-Coordinate with banks regarding failed transactions, payment confirmations, and bank charges.

-Support preparation of short-term cash flow forecasts based on expected collections and supplier payment commitments.

-Ensure proper documentation and authorization for all banking transactions.

**D. Accounting & Reconciliation**

-Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and bank ledgers in the ERP/accounting system.

-Record receipts, payments, credit notes, debit notes, and other relevant transactions.

-Conduct periodic reconciliation of customer and vendor accounts.

-Monitor advances, unapplied receipts, overdue balances, and unreconciled transactions.

-Support monthly closing, balance sheet schedules, and audit requirements.

-Ensure proper filing and maintenance of invoices, payment vouchers, bank advice, and supporting documents.

**E. MIS & Reporting**

-Prepare daily collection and payment reports.

-Submit weekly customer ageing and overdue outstanding reports.

-Prepare supplier due-date and payment planning reports.

-Track collection targets against actual collections.

-Highlight overdue customer balances, disputed invoices, and critical supplier payment requirements to management.

**3. Qualification & Experience**

B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.

3-6 years of relevant experience in finance and accounts, preferably in a manufacturing organization.

Experience with customer collections, vendor payments, bank reconciliation, and ledger scrutiny.

Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements.

Experience with SAP

**4. Required Skills**

Strong knowledge of accounts receivable, accounts payable, and working capital management.

Proficiency in MS Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, and MIS reporting.

Good communication and customer/vendor follow-up skills.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Ability to prioritize collections and payments based on business requirements.

Understanding of manufacturing procurement, inventory receipt, invoicing, and dispatch processes.

High integrity and adherence to financial controls.

* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.

This will entail using his judgment and take decisions as necessary to ensure smooth running of all transactions. The incumbent may delegate such powers as are specifically delegated to him to other members of the branch management team.

* Appreciate importance of thinking out-of-the-box and continuously encourages employees and managers to practice the same.

Vanmoh is expanding its financial services portfolio with a focus on providing customers with accessible and structured

* Review customer financial information, repayment capacity and credit history.

* Monitor the performance of the credit portfolio.
* Track repayment status and overdue accounts.
* Coordinate with the collections team on delinquent accounts.
* Identify early warning indicators and escalate potential portfolio risks.
* Support initiatives to improve repayment performance and reduce delinquency.

* Applications received
* Applications processed
* Approvals
* Rejections
* Disbursements
* Disbursement value
* Turnaround time
* Overdue accounts
* Portfolio performance

* Ensure all credit activities follow Vanmoh’s internal policies and approval processes.
* Maintain proper KYC and documentation standards.
* Ensure customer data and financial information are handled confidentially.
* Follow applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Identify gaps in the credit process and recommend improvements.

**9. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor credit/operations executives where applicable.
* Allocate applications and responsibilities across the team.
* Set team-level targets and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide training.
* Build a disciplined, customer-focused credit operations team.

Portfolio quality

Customer retention

Channel partner productivity

Documentation accuracy

Compliance adherence

Team productivity

Business development

Team management

MIS & reporting

MS Excel

Strong communication skills

We are looking for someone who can balance
**business growth and credit discipline**

title: Retail Operations & Key Accounts Manager
description:

title: Associate III - Data Management (Onboarding and Event Management module)
description:
**Role Description**
Overview of Role
  
  
The Data management team forms part of the wider Onboarding and Event Management module.
  
  
The O&EM team goal is to deliver all onboarding activities required to bring a Client or Client Fund to life on our Investment platform.
  
  
The Data team is responsible for ensuring that all accounts and portfolios are created and maintained on our investment platform and other business data masters with the highest levels of accuracy and integrity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Setup and maintenance of Mandate, Portfolios and other related items in Aladdin, IRIS and other Client Business Data Masters
* Closing of Mandates and Portfolios within Aladdin, IRIS and other BDM’s
* Perform quality assurance checks ensuring data is kept in line across different platforms
* Setup and maintenance of pay away brokers, credit risk counterparties and new custodians
* Review data quality control exceptions to ensure data is maintained to the highest quality based on data governance principles and agreed rules
* Maintenance of Aladdin Accounting data
* Closure of accounts in Aladdin and Client data masters
* Trade delivery configuration and maintenance
* Setup and maintenance of reports to 3rd parties
* Setup of Settlement Instructions
* Maintenance of our subscription and redemption cash flow notification data.
* Act as a role model and point of contact for junior colleagues
* Escalate issues immediately to the Team Leader

**Skills And Behaviours Required**

* 5+ years of working within a data management environment, responsible for multiple datasets across multiple platforms
* Good knowledge of a client operational lifecycle with a focus on new account take-on process in Investment Management.
* Experience in Data structures required to support a process of a new account take-on and transition events
* Managing a high volume of varied tasks efficiently and meeting internal and external deadlines.
* Collecting, verifying, storing, and maintaining accurate operational data.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* A willingness to question instructions that look or seem wrong
* Commitment to delivering a high-quality onboarding and offboarding experience for our clients
* Previous experience working within an Asset Management firm or similar.
* Ideally, previous experience of Aladdin What you’ll be like
* A keen eye for detail is crucial for reviewing data and questioning anomalies
* Strong organisational abilities are needed to manage multiple events simultaneously, prioritising tasks and maintaining a smooth and efficient workflow.
* Strong Investment data analysis background preferably within Asset Management and Investment support function. – ability to manipulate data, query, analyse and profile data.
* A motivated, committed and enthusiastic person who thrives working in a close team environment
* Someone who can identify issues and suggest and help implement solutions quickly and effectively
* The ability to analyse data and workflows to help improve processes and enhance the efficiency of the onboarding experience.
* A proactive learner that is quick at picking up new processes
* Can work on own initiative whilst ensuring the team manager is aware of what you are delivering
* A resilient team member who is good at building relationships

**Skills**
Investment Management, Attention to Detail, Asset Management

title: GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Lead Analyst-Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Lead Analyst
  
  
**Job Span**
: All Cyber Alliances
  
  
**Function**
: GDS ES Growth & Innovation
  
  
**Skill Level:**
High
  
  
**Sub Function:**
GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The GDS Cyber Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will play a pivotal role in strengthening EY’s Cyber Alliance ecosystem by driving high-impact operations, executive-ready reporting, partner enablement, governance, and stakeholder engagement from the GDS Alliances Partner Operations CoE. The role will support the build-out and continuous evolution of a scalable Cyber Alliances operations model, enabling sharper visibility, stronger execution discipline, improved partner program adoption, and seamless delivery of global Cyber Alliance priorities.
  
  
**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Deliver timely, insightful, and leadership-ready operational, financial, sales, pipeline, and program intelligence for Cyber Alliance stakeholders through structured dashboards and reporting, including:
* Tailored revenue, sales, pipeline, opportunity, and performance dashboards that convert Cyber Alliance data into actionable business insights
* Disciplined management and ongoing refinement of the Cyber Alliance book of business
* Opportunity management support covering tagging, hygiene, coordination, issue resolution, and performance tracking for Cyber Alliance pursuits
* Focused prospect, account, and stakeholder tracking to strengthen Cyber Alliance visibility and follow-through
* Tracking of strategic GTM wins, priority pursuits, leadership asks, and high-value Cyber Alliance initiatives
* Curate, refresh, and maintain Cyber Alliance reference materials, enablement assets, partner program guidance, and operating documentation to ensure stakeholders have easy access to current, high-quality information
* Partner with Brand, Marketing and Communications, Cyber Alliance teams, and enabling functions to shape clear, engaging, and fit-for-purpose content and stakeholder communications
* Enable high-quality internal EY Cyber Ecosystem and Alliance leadership meetings through compelling content, crisp pre-reads, coordinated logistics, robust action tracking, and timely follow-through
* Support strategic engagements between EY Cyber leadership and Cyber Alliance partners by coordinating agendas, pre-reads, action logs, and clear documentation of decisions and next steps
* Drive Cyber Alliance operational initiatives across partner processes, tools, portals, certifications, enablement programs, and governance routines, including:
* End-to-end administration and continuous improvement of relevant partner tools, portals, and operational repositories
* Structured access request intake, tracking, governance, issue resolution, and service follow-up
* Certification, skills, competency, and enablement tracking to support alliance readiness and capability building
* Single point of coordination for Cyber Alliance partner tool administration, access governance, operational queries, issue management, and stakeholder support
* Coordinate with the Alliances Investment Team, Cyber Alliance stakeholders, Legal, Finance, and Compliance teams to support Market Development Funds, investment requests, reimbursements, program governance, awareness, process adherence, and management reviews
* Collaborate with onshore Cyber Alliance Enablement contacts on strategic projects, operational transformation, reporting enhancements, continuous process improvement, simplification, automation opportunities, Agentic AI-enabled productivity use cases, and leadership-driven priorities
* Support the initiation, tracking, and operational follow-through of global agreement localization, partner program requirements, and related documentation in partnership with Ecosystem Contracts and relevant internal teams
* Coordinate customized enablement, certification, classroom, virtual, and partner-led learning interventions that build Cyber Alliance awareness, adoption, and capability
* Manage onshore stakeholder expectations, delivery plans, communications, escalations, governance rhythms, and operational cadences to ensure reliable, responsive, and high-quality Cyber Alliance operations support
* Proactively identify, document, and deliver opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, standardize operating routines, automate repeatable activities, and leverage Agentic AI responsibly to improve quality, speed, insight generation, and stakeholder experience across Cyber Alliance operations

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**

* Strong grounding in sales, pipeline, and alliance operations, with practical understanding of opportunity life cycles, pipeline hygiene, GTM reporting, and Cyber Alliance performance measures
* Strong technology orientation with genuine interest in cyber services, cyber ecosystem partnerships, partner program models, and technology-led growth opportunities
* Demonstrated mindset for continuous improvement, automation, AI-enabled productivity, process mapping, documentation, audit readiness, governance, and control-oriented execution
* Working knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and practical ability to identify responsible AI use cases for operations, reporting, workflow orchestration, knowledge management, content generation, research support, action tracking, and stakeholder enablement
* Advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint capability, with Power BI, dashboarding, data visualization, and automation skills considered strong differentiators
* Ability to engage confidently with senior onshore Cyber Alliance stakeholders, Cyber practice leaders, alliance partner contacts, and enabling functions, while building trusted relationships and operating as a dependable business advisor
* Proven ability to operate effectively in virtual, cross-border environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline, and a global mindset
* Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, research, and mitigation skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, work across teams, and drive practical solutions to closure
* Strong project and program management discipline, including planning, budgeting, execution tracking, stakeholder reviews, prioritization, and delivery across multiple fast-moving priorities
* Excellent English communication and business writing skills, with the ability to create polished, structured, audience-ready content with limited input or guidance
* Experience in alliance or partner programs, cyber services, technology ecosystems, sales enablement, professional services operations, or GCC/shared services delivery will be highly valued
* Working knowledge of EY, GDS, Alliances, Cyber, professional services operations, management information systems, independence considerations, and service delivery expectations would be advantageous

**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**

* MBA or equivalent qualification preferred University degree required; background in technology, cyber, business, commerce, analytics, operations, or management preferred Certification in project/program management, cyber fundamentals, alliance or partner management, data visualization, automation, or process improvement would be a strong advantage

**Experience:**

* 9+ years of relevant experience spanning alliance operations, business operations, cyber or technology services, sales enablement, executive reporting, stakeholder management, program coordination, or GCC/shared services delivery

**Working Hours:**

* This role requires strong alignment with US business hours to enable real-time collaboration with Cyber Alliance stakeholders. Manila-based team members are expected to support US Pacific Time, while India-based team members are expected to support US Eastern/Central Time.
* The ability to consistently mirror the relevant US working day is a critical prerequisite for success in this role.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Accounting Services Associate II

* Strong experience in processing large volumes of invoices.
